notes.title: 🏰 New Guardian Armor, Bandanas, and Blades this week!
notes.content:
[h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/78b504fdea3d25cb0c05de457ad357f6c434e27e.png"][/img][b]Battleon Guardians, Bandanas, Statues, Sovereign Blades, & Boss + Gold Updates[/b][/h1][p align="-webkit-left"]Guardians can now claim the brand-new Battleon Guardian Armor, a modern take on the iconic gear from the original AdventureQuest. While the Guardian Tower is still being built, Solestia is handing out this legendary look in both versions of Battleon.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bb2efab376b1c5f2ccb76f1d9ce9c5792293b9bd.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Bandanas Ahoy![/b][/h2][p align="-webkit-left"]Get ready for Talk Like a Pirate Day with a bandana that fits your swashbuckling style. Start your quest at the Quest Board in Battleon, which will lead you to Marina Gomes in Lolosia to choose your perfect bandana.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4680084769eeb3074d26ca82416286d7d5ebd7fe.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Sun Ray House Item[/b][/h2][p align="-webkit-left"]The popular Sun Ray effect has been turned into a glowing house item. It’s available now in the Premium Housing Item shop for 500 Dragon Crystals, letting you brighten up your home with radiant flair.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c17981e615814c76bbcc5fc34e0ea4615facfefc.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Big Spender Rewards[/b][/h2][p align="-webkit-left"]Players who earned the original Sir Sanrick the Fast statue before the price drop are getting something extra. Xero created upgraded versions of the statue with stylish new effects to honor their effort.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e81e1a947d32a51beb999c6da3fadced38c390d8.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Limited Time Shop Update[/b][/h2][p align="-webkit-left"]Two new dragon-inspired swords, the Amethystwing's Sovereign and Sapphirewing's Sovereign, are now in the limited-time shop for 1000 Dragon Crystals each. These will become legacy weapons once they leave the shop after this week.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/aa753f2476ab4a4d05f4b37ad5e0422b11f9a354.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Boss and Economy Changes[/b][/h2][p align="-webkit-left"]Level 53 bosses now drop much more gold, making fights against enemies like Serpnaut and Sir Arthur Lanceler more rewarding. To balance the economy, new Gold Boosts have been removed, ensuring gold doesn’t become a pay-to-win shortcut. As a bonus, Invisible Items are now purchasable starting at level 1.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7f2a250ba3209d502ae3172e4f24561e17e06a80.jpg"][/img][b]Last Week: Bundles, Blades, & Booty Ahoy[/b][/h2][p align="start"]We're celebrating Talk Like a Pirate Day with the return of Gunpowder Mary and her past treasure troves! For the first time ever, old TLaPD Collections (now called Bundles) are back, and once unlocked, they’re available [b]Account-Wide[/b] for all your characters. On top of that, purchased Emotes are now [b]Account-Wide[/b] too -- buy 'em once and your entire crew can dance, cheer, or meme together! Quest-earned Emotes stay character-locked, but your purchased flair is shared across the board. 
[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5bd87b9fd53a8712edfae098b61701b453658fce.jpg"][/img][b]Bravewing's Sovereign Promo Item[/b][/h2][p align="-webkit-left"]September’s promo item is the Bravewing's Sovereign, earned with any purchase such as Dragon Crystals, Guardian packages, or the Starter Bundle. Guardians unlock the Jadewing’s Sovereign variant and a display house item to show off their strength. This exclusive reward disappears when the month ends.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a14d4ab3a25345d7b78e6a143ae7a68e636ff6a0.jpg"][/img][b]Thank you and... next![/b][/h2][p align="start"]🎮 Want to help play test new game features? [url="https://aq3d.com/news/ptr-public-test-realm/?mc_cid=4a2f64f9da&mc_eid=UNIQID"][u]Join the PTR[/u][/url]!
🐉 TLaPD 2025: collection & event
🗡️ New Class Skin
🏰 Battleon revamp
🌳 Greenguard expansion
🎃 Mogloween!
⛏️ New tradeskill: mining[/p][p align="start"][b]Battle on![/b] [/p][p align="start"]Clarion, Artix, Beleen, and the AQ3D team[/p]

notes.title: 🏴‍☠️ Talk Like a Pirate Day Bundles arrrr here!
notes.content:
[h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7f2a250ba3209d502ae3172e4f24561e17e06a80.jpg"][/img]Bu[b]ndles, Blades, & Booty Ahoy[/b][/h1][p align="start"]Ahoy, salty sea dogs ‘nd landlubbers! Time to raise the Jolly Roger, fer [b]Gunpowder Mary[/b]be makin’ landfall in Battleon! Aye, and this here scallywag brought back all her fine [b]Talk Like a Pirate Day Bundles[/b] o’ yore. [/p][p align="start"]But this year, it be no ordinary haul — nay, fer we’ve made a grand change that players have been askin’ for: [b]BRING BACK PAST ITEMS![/b] The AQ3D Crew is bringing back previous seasonal Collections — now called [b]Bundles[/b] — starting with previous TLaPD booty.[/p][p align="start"]And thanks to our shiny new Character Slots, these [b]TLaPD[/b] [b]Bundles[/b] are unlocked [b]Account-Wide[/b], meanin’ once ye buy a Bundle once, it will be[b] unlocked on all your characters[/b]across yer account. Aye, ye heard true, matey: 1 purchase = all characters in ye crew get to pillage in style.[/p][p align="start"]Now, if ye already purchased a TLaPD Bundle in past years, no need worry about diggin’ through old loot! We[b]converted all yer previously claimed Collections[/b] into [b]Account-Wide[/b]goodness too! Check out the [b]Shops Menu[/b], where yer [b]unlocked Bundles[/b] be sittin’ nice and tidy. We’ll keep updatin’ [b]seasonal Bundles[/b] fer all the big events yet to come, so keep yer spyglass polished and yer ears open fer the call of Adventure. Quest. 3D! Yaaarrr![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d6366ab00a11ee5201ef0df6f9a2866b8465f3ad.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Emotes for Everyone[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Emotions are universal, and now so are your Emotes! Starting this week, all [b]purchased Emotes[/b] are officially [b]Account-Wide[/b]. That means if you pick up a dance, cheer, or silly expression in one shop, you’ll be able to use that same Emote across all your characters forever. No more needing to repurchase or wishing your alt could Twerk… Emotes are unlocked for your entire crew![/p][p align="start"]You can find Emotes scattered across Lore, from special shops to the dedicated [b]Emotes Shop[/b] in the Shops Menu. Collect them to build up your perfect set of in-battle celebrations or roleplay shenanigans with your guild. Just keep in mind that Emotes earned from completing quests will remain tied to the character who earned them… because hey, sometimes you gotta work for that special flair.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5bd87b9fd53a8712edfae098b61701b453658fce.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Promo + Limited Time Loot[/b][/h2][p align="start"]For all you shiny-obsessed heroes out there (me being one of them), we’ve got brand new loot to sink your teeth into. The [b]Winged Sovereign Blades[/b] — our latest Promo Item — is available with any upgrade, including DC packages and Guardian.[/p][p align="start"]And that’s not all! Sail into the [b]Limited Time Shop[/b] in the Shops Menu to discover the brand-new [b]Gold Smasher [/b]and [b]Silver Masher[/b] weapons. Bold, brash, and built to bash, these smashers are only here for [b]only 1 week[/b], so grab them while you can. Shiny & smashy makes monsters go splashy.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9bc847573b2401bac7b0de5cd5ae75977d69aecb.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Moving Forward[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Behind the scenes, our team has been steering AQ3D towards a brighter and more rewarding future. With so many [b]exciting changes[/b] and [b]improvements[/b] rolling out, it’s important we [b]revisit older parts[/b] of the game to make sure they align with the new vision we’re sailing toward. Our goal has always been to [b]make the world of Lore as fun, meaningful, and rewarding[/b] as possible for all players, and that sometimes means rebalancing or refreshing existing content.[/p][p align="start"]Recently, we took a fresh look at the [b]Nulgath Saga[/b], making adjustments to better balance the experience and bring it in line with said goals. We’ve also got our eyes on items like [b]Blaze’s Bapper[/b], reviewing their impact on gameplay to make sure everything stays fair and fun. As always, we’ll keep monitoring the state of the game, making improvements, and addressing issues whenever needed. [/p][p align="start"]Adventure never stands still, and neither do we![/p][p align="start"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0135bec1c9f7598de523f781f0847bda20e0ab4e.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Last Chance: 2025 Summer Bundle[/b][/h2][p align="start"]With the introduction of Account-Wide Bundles, we’re [b]extending[/b] the Summer Collection sale for [b]1 more week[/b]! This is your final chance to soak up the sun — and 80% savings — with the [b]2025[/b] [b]Summer Bundle. [/b]This sizzling set of [b]39 items[/b] unlocks [b]Account-Wide[/b], so all of your characters can chill in those warm summer nights knights. Don’t miss the chance to add this exclusive Bundle to your collection before it sails into the sunset. [/p][p align="start"]Get the Summer Bundle from:[/p][list][*][p]Game News → 2025 Summer Collection Promo → Unlock the Collection[/p][/*][*][p]Annette in Battleon[/p][/*][*][p]Annette in Sun’s Set Shore[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a14d4ab3a25345d7b78e6a143ae7a68e636ff6a0.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Thank you and... next![/b][/h2][p align="start"]🎮 Want to help play test new game features? [u][url="https://aq3d.com/news/ptr-public-test-realm/?mc_cid=4a2f64f9da&mc_eid=UNIQID"]Join the PTR[/url][/u]!

🗡️ New Class Skin  
🌳 Greenguard expansion  
⛏️ New Tradeskill: Mining[/p][p align="start"][b]Battle on![/b]
Beleen, Clarion, Artix, and the AQ3D team[/p]

notes.title: 🤩 New Armors LEAKED plus 150% boost & big sales for summer: 50%, 30%, and 25%!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a95c15b15ca6356236f73c65bdbcbd6949e4a5ad.png[/img]
[h1]Boss Trobbles, Sales for Summer, Server Boost, and Sneak Peeks[/h1]
New unique Trobbles now drop from Akilroth Extreme, Super Tengu, and the Death of Games. These are permanent additions, so you can collect them at your own pace!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0ccc1e6681751741f104693de2b5c423b6ae5ce4.png[/img]
[h2]150% Server Boost[/h2]
From now until June 4th, enjoy a server boost of 150% XP and 150% CXP. Let's gooooo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/09a3c6c5f6d2e544d5f03dc16383517d9d3be2bf.jpg[/img]
[h2]Greenguard Armor Previews[/h2]
Thyton has begun work on light, medium, and heavy armor sets for the Greenguard region. These sets will have color variations and will be available through drops, quests, or crafting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/cde43b91ab882c70252c873faf01c4cf32625b6a.png[/img]
[h2]Treasure Chest Sale[/h2]
Treasure Chests are on sale with a 30% discount on Emperor’s Chest and 25% off Warlord’s Chests. Over 400 items in Treasure Chests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/13afcd920b4df8e91db2706afa02203276dd8755.png[/img]
[h2]Battleon Foothill Fixes[/h2]
Improvements have been made to Battleon Foothills for better performance on lower-end devices. Let the team know how it runs for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/55ed56589815810e04f61421bbad79b316dcac0e.png[/img]
[h2]50% Off Inventory Slot Sale[/h2]
Double the storage, half the cost! Enjoy 50% off inventory slots (excluding the first-time bundle) and grab the returning Starter Bundle, packed with Dragon Crystals, boosts, and exclusive gear like the Dire Dragon Travel Form.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/985843270ce5150540d87c9f6d2019f4fa2ddcb9.png[/img]
[h2]Starter Pack Bundle[/h2]
It's back! Time to grab the returning Starter Bundle, packed with Dragon Crystals, boosts, and exclusive gear like the Dire Dragon Travel Form.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5b09bba8e5b779f4f7eac1979daab462ec7d53d5.png[/img]
[h2]LAST CHANCE: Azure and Veridian Star Scythes[/h2]
Time is running out! This is your last week to score the Azure Star Scythe! Guardians get the Veridian variant too, plus a bonus house item to display it in style. And don’t forget, all Dragon Crystal packages come with a 50% bonus!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8fe47d56a7e32ad3e00f3b2304accb9d76c37fc6.png[/img]
[h2]Last week's release[/h2]
Yulgar’s Inn got a fresh new look, smash into battle with new hammers, and a Guardian-exclusive Trobble. Check out last week's release here: https://aq3d.com/news/yulgars-inn-visual-update/ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8bda142cfcb02a66292c624ed940ee11bea35ff5.jpg[/img]
[h2]Guild Spotlight: Gifted Gamerz[/h2]
The Gifted Gamerz Guild is a legendary crew of chaos, friendship, and glory. Meet this guild on the Design Notes! https://aq3d.com/news/guild-spotlight-gifted-gamerz-gift/ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/df6e64b560251f3625aa3f59c757fc131b980ed4.jpg[/img]
[h2]Thank you and... next![/h2]
🏆 A new contest has begun: the Coloring Book of Lore contest! Artix Points await our winners, and the Grand Prize winner will also receive a SIGNED copy of the Coloring Book of Lore, autographed by Artix himself! Contest rules: https://aq3d.com/news/artix-entertainment-coloring-book-contest-2025/
🧝‍♀️ A beautiful new early game experience 
📖 Main storyline continuation
🤫 Other stuff I'm not allowed to reveal yet!

Clarion, Artix, Beleen, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: 👀 Yulgar's got a makeover?! Plus 50% off inventory & Smashing new weapons
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8fe47d56a7e32ad3e00f3b2304accb9d76c37fc6.png[/img]
[h1]Yulgar's Revamp, Smashing Weapons, 50% off Inventory Slot Sale & Starter Pack[/h1]
There's a glow-up in Battleon! Yulgar’s Inn is getting a fresh new look and you can preview it now—bugs, feedback, and all. Should we roll out more sneak peeks like this? Let us know!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d009f76746a0727c5138c3c998cd0d9ee7eb6af5.png[/img]
[h2]Gavel of Smashing[/h2]
Justice has never hit harder! The new Gavel of Smashing lands in Lanceler’s Vault; challenge the Group Lanceler boss and smash your way to this epic hammer and a new weapon variant!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9db6549f1e1736d7cd8c6b20990a1370f05ced13.png[/img]
[h2]Raw Weapons[/h2]
You asked, we swung into action! Introducing Raw weapon variants, starting with the unpainted but powerful Raw Gavel of Smashing, exclusive for Guardians. More raw, more wow incoming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c0445bb6782a9190040a9e7ef82bbe0466423a0f.png[/img]
[h2]Guardian Trobble[/h2]
Trobble trouble continues! The Guardian Trobble is now available for Guardian players — he's fierce, he's fluffy, and he’s totally exclusive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/55ed56589815810e04f61421bbad79b316dcac0e.png[/img]
[h2]Inventory Slot Sale + Starter Bundle[/h2]
Double the storage, half the cost! Enjoy 50% off inventory slots (excluding the first-time bundle) and grab the returning Starter Bundle, packed with Dragon Crystals, boosts, and exclusive gear like the Dire Dragon Travel Form.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/985843270ce5150540d87c9f6d2019f4fa2ddcb9.png[/img]
[h2]New Promo Item: Azure and Veridian Star Scythes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9c3364520d9051a4ffb5584056334e6b13dc8ade.png[/img]
Upgrade in May and score the Azure Star Scythe! Guardians get the Veridian variant too, plus a bonus house item to display it in style. And don’t forget, all Dragon Crystal packages come with a 50% bonus!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a64832e76ab7a1823a7bd1e2b9a83359d45225d2.png[/img]
[h2]Coloring Book of Lore[/h2]
100+ pages of epic art of your favorite Artix characters, ready for your creative touch. Score in-game rewards too: the Paintbender Battlemage! Head on over to HeroMart: https://heromart.com/products/coloring-book-of-lore-coloring-book 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c0445bb6782a9190040a9e7ef82bbe0466423a0f.png[/img]
[h2]Last Week Recap[/h2]
Get ready for chaos and cuteness—over 100 Trobbles can drop from almost anything you defeat in-game! Check out last week's release: https://aq3d.com/news/trobblemania/ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/cb35ba755d6fa699fb7579dc3a9db49a471d5f82.jpg[/img]
[h2]New House Spotlight[/h2]
Built entirely on mobile by Cyrxx, the Elysian Conclave is a 4,800-piece masterpiece with hobbit holes, treehouses, and a hidden dwarven city! Unbelievable home: https://aq3d.com/news/player-housing-spotlight-elysian-conclave-by-cyrxx/ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8998919ba2d2cf560d09e4d46c1a3e47542b0cf7.jpg[/img]
[h2]Fanart Spotlight[/h2]
Knight of Valinor’s incredible fanart and storytelling bring their OC to life in a powerful saga of betrayal, rage, and redemption—an epic tribute to AQ3D community creativity! See some fantastic Fanart: https://aq3d.com/news/aq3d-fanart-spotlight-knight-of-valinor/ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b71a37c042d3d0c2ad020aa053740de8c3dec1b8.jpg[/img]
[h2]Guild Spotlight[/h2]
Do you think your guild has what it takes to steal the spotlight? Share your guild's stats, story, and screenshots with us! New Spotlight soon :) Learn more: https://www.artix.com/posts/adventurequest-guild-spotlight-series/

[h2]Thank you and... next![/h2]

notes.title: 100+ Trobbles, Dwarves, and sneak a peek at secrets & behind the scenes things
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c0445bb6782a9190040a9e7ef82bbe0466423a0f.png[/img]
[h1]Trobblemania, Blade of Awe preview, and sneak peeks![/h1]
Prepare for Trobble, pure chaos, and fun! Trobbles are these adorable little guys that drop from just about anything you defeat in the game. Whether you're farming, questing, or just vibing in a dungeon — you're probably getting Trobbles. Some are tied to events or specific drops, but most are just chillin in global loot. Over 100 to find! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/598210c368d99eaeaef610a422fe86aeb42caef6.jpg[/img]
[h2]Blade of Awe Preview[/h2]
The Blade of Awe is in development by Dage the Evil, with both visual and story elements being carefully planned. The story behind the weapon ties into the upcoming main campaign update, with Dage adding some secret, spoiler-y flair. The design reflects the classic Artix style and nods to past games, matching well with Sanrick's armor for those who love coordinated looks. Details on how to obtain the Blade are being kept hush hush for now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e6a435baa2a8c4c2d47e7cc91d1f63b186689217.jpg[/img]
[h2]How to (not) Make Yulgar's Inn[/h2]
Yergen originally designed a stunning new map for Yulgar’s Inn, but it ended up feeling a bit too modern for Battleon’s cozy, small-town vibe. So, the map’s getting repurposed as a Port Town (perfect fit!), while Yulgar’s Inn keeps its classic structure with some fresh visual updates and new additions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/124507bebb0a740876bcddc8fc60425abf4993b9.jpg[/img]
This includes an exterior blacksmithing area that reflects Yulgar’s role, plus a reworked interior with color-coded zones—main floor, balcony and stairs, bedrooms, and even a bathroom. The goal is to modernize the space without losing its original charm. Did we nail it?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/20b9edb85493342c8844eabbe05a82ee225a4d29.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4db7332ed623d2a7137b63380741ea5e94cd914e.jpg[/img]
[h2]Dwarves![/h2]
We’re working on DWARVES! Yep, a brand-new race with their own homeland and lore. Clarion pitched the idea of antlers and horns on them (because why not?), and Dage took that and ran. The concepts are looking so cool, but I can’t spill much yet—story secrets and all that jazz. Just know it’s gonna add some major variety to Lore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/314fef34d9134c0e78415e01bfd69fd1b1e9feb0.jpg[/img]
[h2]Clarion Has a Beard[/h2]
Clarion has a beard... for maybe a week? Why? Because Oishii asked me if we were ready to roll the release to live, or if I needed to add anything else, and I thought it'd be funny to say "WAIT HOLD ON I NEED TO ADD SOMETHING DON'T ROLL YET!". So here we are.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9d09dcdac63e6f333918230996d7d2b39c15e8a5.jpg[/img]
[h2]Moglin Maker[/h2]
Remember how we were revamping Moglins? WELL—we’re also making them customizable like human NPCs! That means clothes, weapons, and all sorts of cute outfits. We really want non-human characters to shine just as much as the humans in Lore. It’s still a work-in-progress, but I can already tell we’re gonna fall in love with some brand-new moglin heroes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/63af21e184a0be5f374fe287cfcde97ad733b490.jpg[/img]
[h2]Forging Heroes[/h2]
We’ve got BIG characters coming for the story relaunch, and it’s so fun watching them evolve from “words on a doc” to full 3D models. We’ve revealed 3 of them so far—there are 2 more mystery NPCs in the group, so stay tuned. Can’t say much yet (spoilers and all that), but they’re super important to the new story direction. Trust me, you’re gonna want to meet them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d05287646dc9eb8385c9f7563b4537ea51d6e737.png[/img]
[h2]Last Week's Release[/h2]
Mother’s Day at Yulgar’s, Spring Flowers drop off monsters, Blue-Eyed Soul Dragon variants, and bonus Treasure Chest rewards for our amazing Guardians. https://aq3d.com/news/spring-into-celebration-2025/ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/377251bcccceaf14190d3aa5f79c04825a915056.jpg[/img]
[h2]Star Lores Swag @ HeroMart[/h2]
Get the Star Lores Episode IV "A New Hype" Poster, now available at HeroMart! New bonus in-game reward too for AQ3D. Check it out at https://heromart.com/products/starlores-a-new-hype-poster

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9c3364520d9051a4ffb5584056334e6b13dc8ade.png[/img]
[h2]New Promo Items: Azure and Veridian Star Scythes[/h2]
The Azure Star Scythe will be awarded to any player who makes an upgrade purchase during the month of May. This includes not only Dragon Crystals but also any Guardian package and the Starter Bundle. Guardians will receive a variant known as the Veridian Star Scythe at no additional cost. In addition to both weapons, each promo will come with an additional house item to hang your fancy weapon off in your home. Simply head over to the Guardian Tower and speak to Fortes after finishing your Guardian initiation. A friendly reminder that all Dragon Crystal packages have a 50% bonus on them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/154b5f17f28cd7c82a04fc53d1f9572ee606b817.jpg[/img]
[h2]Thank you and... next![/h2]
✨ Our amazing Content Creators have received their Badges! https://aq3d.com/news/first-batch-of-aq3d-content-creator-badges/ 
🏆 Contest winners announced next week
🧝‍♀️ A beautiful new early game experience

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/14ecf2a607342eb55c4eb99b978f749941c82c34.jpg[/img]
[h1]Mother's Day Questline, Spring Flowers, and More[/h1]
Just in time for Mother's Day, a new questline has arrived in Battleon! Visit Yulgar inside the Inn—he’s planning a sweet surprise for Aria and needs your help. While the story’s details are hush-hush to avoid spoilers, there's a special reward waiting at the end, and Spring flower drops are back for house decorating!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a515d52922b27c204bcd51237216874b3c16367b.jpg[/img]
[h2]Blue-Eyed Soul Dragon Heroic Essence[/h2]
The Blue-Eyed Soul Dragon, originally released as a free early-game Travel Form, now has new variants! These include armored and ghostly versions, obtainable through Heroic Essence from level 50 endgame bosses. Visit Sir Arthur Lanceler to exchange your essence for pets or Travel Forms—intended as long-term, earnable rewards just for playing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c34c2f6b49568d2ce18ac3a919a983fe0fd7f1c6.jpg[/img]
[h2]Treasure Chest Rewards Bonus Guardians[/h2]
We’re adding bonus features to Treasure Chest rewards, starting with Guardian-exclusive weapon displays! If you own the Void Star Scythe, you can now claim a matching House Display item from the new Guardian Golem Gift Distributor NPC in Battleon. This system will eventually be automated and retroactively applied to older items too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/501206d7c24b0b5b5336c90e6d168df7300080f9.jpg[/img]
[h2]Moglin Magic[/h2]
Behind the scenes, we’ve been cooking up tech for AQ3D’s massive main story revamp—including custom Moglins! Thanks to Xero and Astra, Moglins will soon have changeable colors, clothing, and models that match modern NPC quality (like Kajits). It’s still a work in progress, but we’re excited to show off a hilariously cursed Moglin in pants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c5fe990a588dadf40b239b6a62478a163ad79595.jpg[/img]
[h2]Critters are Coming![/h2]
Astra is also breathing life into Lore by designing critters like cats, dogs, bunnies, and more! These creatures will populate the world and make it feel more alive and immersive. You may have already seen some in the intro maps, but there’s plenty more to come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/f3e222393da013c36724ce2b3bc62c6b4a8972e9.jpg[/img]
[h2]Improving the Little Things[/h2]
This one’s small, but a big win for devs: our quest-building tools just got a major upgrade! Thanks to Spider’s spawn editor and Zhoom’s help, NPCs now behave better when moved mid-questline. No more weird APOP glitches when characters shift locations—this fix made the Wiggly Whompa release a lot smoother.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7425f60a4e3ddd564effeca70f1726f821422657.jpg[/img]
[h2]Void Star Scythe[/h2]
The Void Star Scythe is in the Treasure Chests. A futuristic weapon made for harvesting kills off your foes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4e1dfd73e61da70b3d817e2ec489b5762a5cfc8f.jpg[/img]
[h2]House Spotlight[/h2]
Some players build houses. Others craft crazy huge castles. And some forge legendary realms fit for the gods themselves! Venture to Olympus: https://aq3d.com/news/player-housing-spotlight-olympus-by-o-d-y-s-s-e-u-s/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4c214af59db59205174e765a2209243a10569967.jpg[/img]
[h2]Guild Spotlight[/h2]
Founded by a close-knit crew of AE Forum friends, Legends of Lore (LOL) is a small, global guild that values friendship over grind. Meet the Legends of Lore: https://aq3d.com/news/guild-spotlight-legends-of-lore/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8069a0fe49b53d995df41dd1b2dfee12875b8a06.jpg[/img]
[h2]Fanart Spotlight[/h2]
Our community has always been bursting with imagination, talent, and love for our games—and nothing shows that better than fanart! Prepare to be wowed :D Check out the Fanart Spotlight: https://www.artix.com/posts/fanart-spotlight-celebrating-community-creativity/ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c0542ad778767a015c9780d88876a833dd55f3b4.png[/img]
[h2]Last Week's Release[/h2]
May the 4th returned, there's new DuckyDucky housing drops, and a sneak peek at AQ3D's revamped intro in Mossmere! Check out last week's release: https://aq3d.com/news/may-4th-returns-plus-community-shop-update/

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/93df37ff6f008dd376cc0f03d2e92be7cda417c2.png[/img]
[h1]May The Fourth Be With You[/h1]
You don’t have to be from a galaxy far far away to celebrate May the Fourth. The Dark Lord returns to Battleon, bringing with him multiple seasonal shops, including… May the 4th, Revenge of the 5th, the May the 4th Housing Collection, Black Helm Crafting, and of course past May 4th collections.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/45f825b2c61d36ef1f1feeead250583e3a400e7b.png[/img]
[h2]Community Shop Update[/h2]
This week, we are rolling out some DuckyDucky housing items for the community shop that will be available for purchase from Zilla’s community shop. You can find Zilla in both Yulgar’s Inn and the Battleon Social District for 10 DuckDucky coins each. In addition to the DuckyDucky house items available in the shops, a special ghostly variant will drop off of the DuckyDucky spawns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0176486295349a1f14fc5adc294c443383b51528.jpg[/img]
[h2]A New Start[/h2]
We’ve been hard at work revamping AdventureQuest 3D over the last year. The team and I are so excited for you to get your hands on the revamped introduction to AdventureQuest 3D, which will start with your adventures in Mossmere that will kick off the new main story for AdventureQuest 3D. All of the gameplay and system changes we’ve been making to AdventureQuest 3D have truly been leading up to this - a brand new main campaign with exciting new characters and mysteries to uncover. All built upon the foundation we’ve been forging with systems like Heroic Skills and Spellforged gear. We look forward to you all questing through Mossmere and arriving at the new version of Battleon, where your journey through Lore will truly begin. And don’t worry… as a thank you for partaking in playing through our new beginning. There will be a reward… a platinum promise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/889bcffc7b16caf9b9eacb3bc4aaa22d81a21a6b.jpg[/img]
[h2]New Battleon?[/h2]
We’re hard at work finishing up Mossmere, but development on AdventureQuest 3D truly never ends. Mossmere was designed to be part of the Greenguard region, so a lot of the assets we’ve been building will be used to revamp the whole of Greenguard, including Battleon, as you can see in the picture above. While still very early, things are progressing fast!

A lot of players have been asking me directly what will happen to the current Battleon… Nothing! Well, for the most part. Current Battleon will remain accessible as a legacy map and be left untouched, save for a portal to the current Battleon. That way, no queststrings will be broken and those who just wanna hang out in Battleon can still do so! So as we build the new story, know that you will still be able to play through all that is currently in the game. I think the only thing we really wanna change is maybe removing the portal cutscenes… At least the ones that are there, that is.

Once we finish Battleon, this will lead us into the new Greenguard that will surround Battleon and Mossmere. While chapter 1 of our new story will take place in Greenguard that doesn’t mean Chapter 2 will be a revamped Heartwood. In fact, right now we’ve been leaning towards something more… coastal…

As I have more info to share, I’ll keep you posted here in the Design Notes, really hoping to return to a more casual and fun design notes style. The kind I grew up reading as a player when I was younger. Thank you for taking the time to read this. Words really can’t describe how excited I am about moving forward with this story we’re cookin!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7425f60a4e3ddd564effeca70f1726f821422657.jpg[/img]
[h2]Void Star Scythe[/h2]
The Void Starsycthe is being added to the Treasure Chest this week. A futuristic weapon made for harvesting kills off your foes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9c3364520d9051a4ffb5584056334e6b13dc8ade.png[/img]

Time is running out! This is the FINAL WEEK to get the exclusive Azure Spear of the Skies, Just make ANY upgrade purchase ~before~ next week's release—whether it's Dragon Crystals or any Guardian package or even the Starter Bundle!—and you’ll score this amazing spear. Go Guardian and get a bonus: the Greenguard Spear of Nature for FREE! Just visit Fortes at the Guardian Tower after your initiation. And don’t forget: all Dragon Crystal packages come with 50% more DCs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d02712340efd8a2fc325fc058c18c2a4380f4f2d.png[/img]
[h2]Last Week's Release[/h2]
We celebrated Earth Day with the new permanent “Spire’s Bloom” questline in Ravenspire, featuring farmable tokens for themed back items and house décor. Reed is also back in Battleon to guide you through returning Earth Day content, including the Voice of the Forest questline. Plus, the first wave of Content Creator badges were awarded—check your Character Page if you’re a YTuber or Streamer to see if you were nominated!

notes.title: 🌱 A New Dawn in Lore: Earth Day, Mossmere Sneak Peek, & the Future of AQ3D
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c1d5057142f8d5fa3c7129eb1df891db2197737a.png[/img]
Hi heroes! To celebrate Earth Day, Reed is back in Battleon, helping players revisit previous seasonal content. This includes loads of returning gear and the nostalgic "Voice of the Forest" questline. It's a great time to explore or catch up on past Earth-themed adventures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/f35869576a249bd267e8655603ce9c6d3de6842d.jpg[/img]
[h2]🌸 Spire’s Blossom[/h2]
A new permanent questline has bloomed in Ravenspire! Visit the town’s gardener to begin “Spire’s Bloom” and earn tokens for eco-themed rewards like back accessories and house items. There’s no rush—this content isn’t going anywhere, so take your time and stop to smell the roses, so to speak.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8b33c45d7d2964fcfc798ec027750ec731aa7a16.jpg[/img]
[h2]🧝‍♀️ Readying for (Re)Launch![/h2]
AdventureQuest 3D's revamped intro and main story relaunch are nearly here, kicking off with a mysterious new job from a client named Solestia. What starts as a simple escort mission quickly takes a magical turn when a shimmering portal opens before you. Stepping through it leads you to Mossmere—a peaceful mining village nestled deep within Greenguard, and the beginning of a much bigger journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2dca133e3e3e9342cfa471d7494de7fae0de1d8d.jpg[/img]
[h2]🌿 Welcome to Mossmere[/h2]
Mossmere is a secluded, serene village built into the rocky terrain of Greenguard, protected by nature itself. You arrive there alongside Solestia, unaware of the secrets about to unfold. What you uncover here will tie your fate to Lore’s—and test the strength of your hero’s heart.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7557e9ca17d45d4649580098dc8298c0ca28231e.jpg[/img]
[h2]🗺️ What Comes After Mossmere[/h2]
Mossmere marks the beginning of AQ3D's new storytelling approach, with each saga expanding a region week by week. Future content will include a redesigned Battleon and an expanded Greenguard. Every release—from big quests to side missions—will help deepen the world and bring each zone to life.

These hubs will be central to their regions and packed with story and exploration content.

notes.title: 🐺 Heroic Skills are finally here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4acbfe8590ce375255b3b5bc094ac0f3aec0e617.png[/img]
[h1]Heroic Skills are here![/h1]
The wait is over—the Heroic Skill system is complete and ready to shape the future of AdventureQuest 3D!

For those unfamiliar, Heroic Skills have been in development ever since we overhauled the Skill System back in November 2024. As a quick refresher, AdventureQuest 3D’s skills now fall into distinct classifications, offering more depth and customization for your hero.

Get ready to experience a whole new level of combat!

Class Skills: Core abilities that come with your class by default.

Cross Skills: Special Rank 10 skills that can be used across all classes.

Base Skills: Fundamental utility skills designed for general use.

PVP Skills: Combat abilities specifically for PVP, which can only be equipped in the Battle Hall.

Heroic Skills: Earned through gold purchases, drops, or quest rewards, these skills let you further personalize your playstyle.

Alongside the updates to skill functionality, we’ve expanded the item bar to support multiple Cross, Base, PVP, and the upcoming Heroic Skills. This allows you to equip up to two extra skills, giving you more ways to customize your hero’s playstyle.

With the launch of Heroic Skills, we’re also extending the action bar—now letting you select up to three skills of your choice for even greater flexibility in battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0ae43b2697f8f70acf97234496fbaae22cd7397f.jpg[/img]
[h2]Summon Werewolf Centurion[/h2]
The first Heroic Skill introduced in AdventureQuest 3D is Summon Werewolf Centurion! This marks the fulfillment of a long-standing promise as we continue working toward highly requested features like mounts. 

The Ticket for Your Own Werewolf Centurion was originally added during the Darkovia saga but never served a real purpose—until now. We wanted to do right by the players who worked hard to obtain it, and turning it into a Heroic Skill felt like the perfect way to bring it to life. Now, you can summon your very own Werewolf Centurion in battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d3f810d0490dc785d33dea6cba8e5e27b5b15953.jpg[/img]
[h2]Flash of Light[/h2]
The second Heroic Skill to join AdventureQuest 3D, Flash of Light, pushes us further toward our goal—giving players more freedom to shape their gameplay and allowing classes to take on multiple roles.

This skill serves as a healing ability, enabling more classes to enhance their sustainability or specialize in group support. As we continue rolling out new Heroic Skills, you’ll gain even more ways to customize your playstyle, especially when combined with Base Skills, Cross Skills, and Spellforged equipment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1e475ec84f740eb10121c22596bfb7bb5d8cb960.jpg[/img]
[h2]Heroic Rewards[/h2]
A new reward system is arriving this week: Heroic Essence! You might be wondering, "Clarion, what’s Heroic Essence?" To which I’d respond, "I have no idea how we’re conversing through a blog post, but hey, that’s a little unsettling!" Then I’d explain—Heroic Essence is designed to grant you extra rewards for battling end-game bosses.

This essence drops at a guaranteed 100% rate from current end-game bosses with high-value loot. Gather enough, and you can visit Sir Arthur Lanceler in his tomb to trade them for unique variants of that boss’s weapon. This system is intended as a long-term reward for the most dedicated players. Moving forward, each major boss will have an essence tied to their gear variants.

On top of boss-specific essence, you’ll also see a more general “Heroic Essence” dropping from all level 50 bosses. These will come into play later, allowing you to obtain items from a special shop—an extra perk for dedicated boss slayers. This marks the beginning of our effort to make boss fights in AdventureQuest 3D more rewarding.

While this system primarily caters to hardcore players, we have plans to introduce additional features for more casual adventurers in the future. Plus, for a limited time, we’re reducing the essence cost for the first batch of rewards. Once this initial period ends, costs will return to their standard rate. Prepare for battle, and claim your Heroic Essence!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/651175ec585518423bbc4d2fbcb455fc31639fd7.jpg[/img]
[h2]Final Batch Of Back Item Conversions[/h2]
The last wave of Back Item to Back Accessory conversions is now complete! After one relentless, sleepless night, every remaining intended Back Item has been transformed into an Accessory. With over 150 fresh conversions, there’s a huge variety of new looks to explore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/be70a8f588d8d32ce0d23b0576bc1f6450869a32.png[/img]
[h2]Last Week's Release:[/h2]
Death's Bow drop! LET’S GOOO! Solve that lvl 50 riddle quest and flex your new gear. Also, check your mail—there's free Death’s Bows because homonyms are awesome. Twerking Emote too to shake peaches & get that “Back it Up” title. Oh, and there’s a Rose Spear in Treasure Chests now, and Piddie the Fool + Chicken Cow are back in Battleon for April Fool's.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/039019d8e02ab4d92e0b14c67e7389ea303f340e.png[/img]
[h2]New Promo Item: Azure Spear of the Skies[/h2]
The Azure Spear of the Skies will be awarded to any player who makes an upgrade purchase during the month of April. This includes Dragon Crystals ~and~ any Guardian package, including the Starter Bundle. Guardians will receive a variant known as the Greenguard Spear of Nature at no additional cost. Simply head over to the Guardian Tower and speak to Fortes after finishing your Guardian initiation. A friendly reminder that all Dragon Crystal packages have a 50% bonus on them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7fd3ab17fba5d0527c282a4eda855b50ac19b282.png[/img]
[h2]New Fanart Spotlight[/h2]
Calling all artists! If you've got art, we wanna see it! Share your work in the new Fanart Spotlight Discord channel for a chance to be featured on the Design Notes. Learn more here: https://www.artix.com/posts/artix-fanart-spotlight/ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d6e2d96360fd88a3343b61508e8b314e035edabc.png[/img]
[h2]Thank you and... next![/h2]
Thank you and... next!

[i]“From the vast expanse of the cosmos, he arrives with stardust in his wake. A grieving father walks the path of shadows, clutching memories that haunt his steps. A burdened warrior stands tall, though the weight of his kin's expectations bows his spirit. Beneath the waves, a monster stirs, its ancient eyes holding secrets older than time. Seriously. It’s like we’re literally giving away souls here. The brand new Dage Collection is packing INSANE value: 19,855 DCs worth of Legion loot, but you get EVERYTHING for just 7,000 Dragon Crystals! 

That’s over 60% off—or, to put it another way, buying 1 dragon mount, 1 pet, and 1 weapon individually costs the same as the entire collection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0200a794ec8fe1ed7da4e600c0fc13b10eb16e0f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/357dcbec61d822bb14ae1ccc6f8047b0c7727331.png[/img]

Empowered Soul Essence (Epic) – 1,200 DCs

Dark Legion Aura (Rare): 5 DCs

Dark Caster Robes (Epic Armor): 0 Gold

notes.title: 💥 Necromancer updates & Lord Malrick!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/75d491370f69b2c285079e90b9705462a7cd6b8f.png[/img]
[h2]Lord Malrick Dreadrunner [/h2]
Lord Malrick Dreadrunner has made his appearance in the Underworld this dark warrior wields the Sacred Wind much like Sir Sanrick the Swift but has sworn allegiance to Dage’s Undead Legion. Malrick is a new level 50 seasonal boss that drops his armor set and weapon, a new Travel Form where you take on the power of a Dreadrunner, and has a 100% chance to drop Sacred Rings for those who need to catch up with Sanrick’s gear. Malrick’s event leaves on the 23rd of April but will return next year during the first release of March 2026.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4125340e8e50f03c6ce7213fbe0ee69179efe309.png[/img]
[h2]Necromancer Changes[/h2]
We’ve heard you loud and clear about Necromancer needing to get looked at. So in combination with Dark Caster coming out as Necromancer’s first Class Skin with this upcoming Dage collection, we’ve made some changes to how Necromancer performs in the hope of bringing its power more in line with the other classes.
* Summon Undead now lasts 20 sec / 30 sec, up from 8.75 / 11.25
* Summon Undead now has increased HP and Armor
* You can now resummon your Undead which will replace the current summon
* Summon Undead now has ranged attacks.
* Grand Summon now has increased HP and Armor
* Grand Summon now has a new Sweep attack

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5edce024ebb456413c4b2c52423f23e339260686.png[/img]
[h1]Legion Gifting Returns[/h1]
The fan-favorite Legion Gifting event is back! Players can now participate by speaking to the Underworld Summoner located in Battleon. Don't miss this chance to share rewards and earn exclusive items during this highly-anticipated event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c6c25df19dd0bba6adcc43e456cfaaccddc674c9.png[/img]
[h2]Battle Maid & Battle Butler Collection Updates[/h2]
The Maid & Butler Collections have been updated! New additions include:
* The elegant White Battle Maid & Butler armor, now available for all collectors.
* A selection of other exciting goodies added at no additional charge for current Maid / Butler Collection owners.

[h2]Balance Changes:[/h2]
Provoke (Cross Skill):
* Cooldown reduced to 10 seconds (down from 20 seconds).
* Range increased to 6.
Mage Meteor Volley (Ultimate):
* No longer requires Mana to cast.
Guardian Summon (Ultimate):
* Now does damage in a small AoE (Area of Effect).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/70d72951986ccd0544a52667e4ee3263bbb94c0b.png[/img]
[h2]Crossbow Functionality Change
[/h2]Good news for ranged weapon enthusiasts! The Dark Crossbow and Silver Crossbow have undergone an exciting functionality update. These crossbows now operate as guns, allowing players to fire projectiles easily and precisely at their targets instead of.. Uh hitting them with the crossbow in melee range?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9bf78bded8d90c01f4a7a55656d984188a1d063e.jpg[/img]
[h2]Legends Never Die! [/h2]
In the vast world of Lore, the ARCPH guild stands as a testament to unbreakable bonds and enduring friendships. Led by the late Rexardo, a dedicated leader known for his extensive knowledge and mentorship, the guild flourished under his guidance. Sadly, Rexardo passed away in November, but ARCPH continues to uphold his legacy, cherishing the lessons he imparted and the community he fostered. Meet this guild and honor our fallen friend at http:// https://aq3d.com/news/guild-spotlight-arcph-and-rexardo/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/539fb39226a919dae211828ab0793ac1d0d4968e.jpg[/img]
[h2]80+ Back Items Converted into Back Accessories[/h2]
Many beloved back items have been transformed into "Back Accessories," a new category of equipment that allows players to stack them with a cape in the same way the Burning Wings of Valor worked. This is the first batch of items to be converted, stay tuned for more! See the full list on the Design Notes. https://aq3d.com/news/battle-maids-and-battle-butlers/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/76ea15c67077b7a06cebd69676337d2e29e99c04.jpg[/img]

Snap your best screenshots for a chance to win Dragon Crystals, a shoutout from Dage the Evil, and eternal Legion glory! Ends this Sunday, March 16th. https://aq3d.com/news/screenshot-saturday-dages-dominion-co-op-sandbox-contest/

notes.title: ⚡️ Level up to 50 faster with the Forged Bladecaster Set!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8ef1aef15096955df4254fe9a90e7c2b6969a58b.png[/img]
[h1]Forge the Bladecaster Armor Set[/h1]
Yulgar’s menu of blacksmithing goodies expands this week with the addition of the Forged Bladecaster Set. Intended to help players get caught up to level 50, this level 46 armor set provides not only good stats but a unique Spellforged effect on the cape...

[h2]New Spellforged Back Effect: Deflection[/h2]
Introducing the newest Spellforged effect to arrive in AdventureQuest 3D… Deflection! With a 2% chance to activate on hit, you will gain max evasion for the next second of combat allowing you the chance to avoid damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/dec93e77a8bea8de25e8124b4da40b4e5617e09c.jpg[/img]
[h2]Player Housing Spotlight: The Ernhold[/h2]
The Ernhold is a towering Gothic fortress in Greenguard featuring high walls, spires, and a grand chapel linked to its keep. Built by fellow players Tercelian & Castarine, this is a [url=https://aq3d.com/news/aq3d-player-housing-spotlight-the-ernhold-by-tercelian-and-castarine/]spectacular sandbox housing build you have got to see[/url]!

Additionally, we’ve increased the stats on the Scared Wind Helmet and Pauldrons.

notes.title: 🤩 Unlock the Speed of the Sacred Wind!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ee98bdc44949f8d47330193f159c8ae77540519d.jpg[/img]
[h1]Sir Sanrick, Knight of the Sacred Wind[/h1]
This week, AdventureQuest 3D welcomes a new NPC that will add a layer to the Daily Boss Zones. Sir Sanrick the Fast, Knight of the Sacred Wind can be found training his speed within the Battleon Scholar district. If you can catch him you’ll be able to ask him how he’s so fast. Turns out it’s a combination of training and his magical armor that is powered by the 7 Order Gemeralds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c3c3661bbba0fa36a2479f985f0197dc644b7247.png[/img]
[h2]Armaments of the Sacred Wind[/h2]
Sir Sanrick will explain how to create armor like his using the 7 Order Gemeralds. For those of you who are level 50, you’ll find Sacred Rings now drop within the Daily Boss zones. Once you collect 100 of them you will be able to spar with Sanrick to make an Order Gemerald appear! Upon collecting 7 of them, you will be able to combine their powers to create an Armament of the Sacred Wind of your choice.

[h2]New Spellforged Boots: Greaves of the Sacred Wind[/h2]
While all of the Armaments of the Sacred Wind are level 50 Epic quality gear the boots specifically are Spellforged. Their effect? 25% chance on hit to gain a 60% movement speed for 5 seconds. Hopefully, you enjoy zooming through the battlefield!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c0d07ca4148c5b1c6bc27ff7be7c06953a95ad12.jpg[/img]
[h2]Last Chance for Frozen Doom Weapons[/h2]
While the Frozen Doom Weapon Mini Collection has left there is still a chance to buy them individually this week before they leave.

[h2]Removing Spellforged Effects From Scaled PVP[/h2]
No date to confirm yet, however, we will be working on disabling Spellforged effects for scaled PVP with the goal of possibly introducing an unscaled PVP mode at a later date.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e15be9490485d675c186ff852997791c3cc66745.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Hop on! 🐸 Frogzard Mount & Gifts Galore
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d1eb65e2c00a1c134a25ac29e78ea84fdd132fcd.jpg[/img]
[h1]Free For All Players: the Frogzard Rider Mount[/h1]
We're thrilled to introduce a brand-new free player mount, the Frogzard Rider! This formidable zard is now available for all adventurers to ride. Long-time players will surely appreciate this nostalgic reference. Hop on and enjoy the ride!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/fd039b79658b52c9f9759999a5121225b39950af.jpg[/img]
[h2]Frostval Doddery[/h2]
Get ready to spread some festive cheer with the new variant of Doddery! The Frostval Doddery has arrived, bringing a touch of holiday magic to your adventures. Don't miss out on this seasonal delight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6deebe97061c84c1e701ead80a06b8e2824831f5.jpg[/img]
[h2]Return of Beleen's Birthday Shop[/h2]
Beleen's Birthday Shop is back, and it's brimming with pink goodness! Celebrate Beleen's special day by checking out the shop and grabbing some exclusive items. Pink never looked so good!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1c8b9076a8f5547aa95760bba655640a6b580adb.jpg[/img]
[h2]Artix’s Gifts[/h2]
Head over to Yulgar's Inn and talk to Artix to access the Holiday Gift Shop. Artix has prepared some special gifts for you to enjoy during this festive season. Make sure to visit and see what surprises await you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8b6b9faa56576027181207942d711175f6dc6fdd.jpg[/img]
[h2]2024 Frostval Collection[/h2]
Unlock icy gear and the Reindeer of Doom Mounts in this year's Frostval Collection. Get your mitts on the Frozen Doomknight Set, the Iced Warrior Set, and a snazzy Claus Set. Two Reindeer Pets and 2 Mounts are also included in this Collection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bbaac88276df658648258d42f5f2b6b3d7fc9c57.png[/img]
[h2]Reindeer Mounts[/h2]
Ride into battle on the Mounted Reindeer of Doom or the bluefur Mounted Reindeer of Bluem! Available as part of this year's 2024 Frostval Collection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/899c5efb4229ef5d988906a76d991d1a9efe18a4.png[/img]
[h2]Home Sweet Home[/h2]
Unlock all new Frostval-themed House Items when you get the 2024 Frostval Housing Kit! Purchasing the Housing Kit will get you access to all the House Items in the shop for free. Perfect for decorating your new Snowy Cabin House Map (also included in the 2024 Frostval Housing Kit). The Frostval Decorations shop has even more House Items in it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/f6d222069e2277caf79d508afa5f892955671c47.png[/img]
Plush Moglins have also arrived for your homes! Find them in the Dragon Crystal Shops or Premium House Items shop—choose your favorite or collect them all. Kickstarter backers and Moglin Plushie owners can claim one of each for free at Hootenheim in the Bank!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c7fea65dda4beddd17fa146b8b7ad0ee20ef5d1e.jpg[/img]
[h2]Holiday Contests Happening NOW[/h2]
From sweet treats to mischievous moglins, Artix’s holiday contests are the perfect chance to showcase your creativity – and win epic prizes, too! It’s time to join the fun and spread seasonal cheer (and maybe some cookies, too).  https://aq3d.com/news/artix-entertainment-holiday-contests-2024/ 

[h2]Mail System Revamp[/h2]
Our mail system has undergone a significant revamp! With added features, we can now send rewards directly to your mailbox. Make sure to check your mailbox regularly for any surprises and gifts. This update aims to enhance your in-game experience and make it easier for us to share rewards with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4e24c2f7b279412a3c8eccafe762e5d89b7f2010.jpg[/img]
[h2]Thank you and... next![/h2]
Thank you for coming with on this adventure. It’s been full of a lot of change and we hope to carry this through to 2025 with even more exciting releases!
🌈 Endless colors for skin, hair, beard, lips, and stache
🤺 Sir Lanceler questline inspired by the original AdventureQuest

notes.title: 🎄Mounts are here! Plus 3 new Armor sets in the 2024 Frostval Collection
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7e7efb9df4acce9204908b8a14efd5a65d3f46d4.png[/img]
[h1]2024 Frostval Collection[/h1]

The 2024 Frostval Collections have arrived! Unlock Icy gear and AQ3D's very first Mount! Ride the Reindeer of Doom and face your enemies head on.

Get the Frozen Doomknight Set, the Iced Warrior Set, and a snazzy Claus Set (perfect for a fancy dinner party). Two Doom Reindeer Pets and two Mounts are also included in this year's Collection. The Collection will be available for a limited time only!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bbaac88276df658648258d42f5f2b6b3d7fc9c57.png[/img]
[h2]Mounts[/h2]
The AQ3D team has been doing a lot of work behind the scenes to be able to finally get the first Mounts into the game! There were a lot of technical concerns that had to be addressed and functionality and support which had to be built, but we are hoping that players will be excited by this new feature!

Ride into battle on the Mounted Reindeer of Doom or the bluefur Mounted Reindeer of Bluem! Available as part of this year's 2024 Frostval Collection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/899c5efb4229ef5d988906a76d991d1a9efe18a4.png[/img]
[h2]2024 FROSTVAL HOUSING KIT AND DECORATIONS[/h2]
Unlock all new Frostval-themed House Items when you get the 2024 Frostval Housing Kit! Purchasing the Housing Kit will get you access to all the House Items in the shop for free! Perfect for decorating your new Snowy Cabin House Map (also included in the 2024 Frostval Housing Kit).

The Frostval Decorations shop has even more House Items in it that you can earn or purchase to decorate with all year round.

Players can find all of these shops on Blizzy in Battleon, or in the Shops button in the Main Menu / Main Interface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/f6d222069e2277caf79d508afa5f892955671c47.png[/img]
[h2]PLUSH MOGLIN HOUSE ITEMS[/h2]
These cuddly guys have made their way into AQ3D Homes! You can find them in the Shops menu under the Dragon Crystal Shops button and in the Premium House Items shop. Pick your favorite and take them home with you! (or collect them all!)

As a thank you and a bonus to those who backed the Moglin Kickstarter, as well as any player who has purchased and unlocked the Moglin Plushies, you will be able to get one of each of these Plush Moglin House Items for free! Find them at Hootenheim in the Bank where your other Heromart and Kickstarter Moglin rewards are accessed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/25bc528921b427eee8bf2bfbb5d2061959b5ba4a.png[/img]
[h2]FROZEN DOOM WEAPONS[/h2]
These Frozen Doom Weapon skins would go along perfectly with this year's Frozen DoomKnight Set. Don't forget to unlock them before they go away!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/aee2cea4a4cec08a0f3353a513e764ef3503170e.jpg[/img]
[h2]MONTHLY PROMO ITEM[/h2]
Time is running out to get this month's promo item! Unlock the Frozen Skullsplitter of Doom when you make any upgrade in the shop today! Go Guardian and get the Guardian Dragon Cleaver at no additional cost. 

As the year winds down, we'd like to thank all the players for their support and hope that you'll join us for all the great things that are yet to come! Stay tuned for what's coming next week!

[b]Battle on,[/b]
Clarion, Artix, the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: A Frozen Friday the 13th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9d24b5d993bdaf6a7186ec00005d1009831ca47a.png[/img]
[h1]New Upgrades for Doom Weapons[/h1]

The ShadowReaper of Doom has received a powerful new upgrade! This upgrade grants it a Spellforged effect and brings it up to level 50, making it even more formidable in battle.

Spellforged - Doomsunder: 25% chance to do 25% damage and -10% armor for 4 sec to enemy

Spellforged Passive - DOOOOM!: +10% to Attack -20% to Max HP

The Necrotic Staff of Doom also gets a new upgrade, giving it a Spellforged effect and bringing it up to level 50. Additionally, the model of the Necrotic Staff of Doom at max level has been updated to align with the newer Doom Weapons.

Spellforged - Doomclaw: 10% chance to Burn enemy for 50% attack over 4 sec and slow for 80% for 3 sec

Spellforged Passive - DOOOOM!: +10% to Attack -20% to Max HP

To gain access to the new Doom Weapon upgrades, you must seek out the Mysterious Stranger within the Isle of the Dead. He holds the key to unlocking the true potential of these powerful weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/15bb8a49b74bb1d2b7fca79e19b5b9f3eafa2928.png[/img]
[h2]Frozen Doom Mini Collection[/h2]
A brand-new collection featuring frozen variants of all the current Doom Weapons will be available for one month. Don't miss your chance to add these chillingly cool items to your arsenal!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5edec8335c8e2a95db6dc6b542dec6702208d35f.jpg[/img]
[h2]Camp Gonnagetcha[/h2]
Camp Gonnagetcha returns for one week! Prepare yourself for the challenges and adventures that await in this fan-favorite event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2aa33bde101b8718cdada1c6f4ee80fa10e6e0b2.png[/img]
[h2]New Treasure Chest Items[/h2]
We've added some exciting new items to the treasure chests! Look out for returning Frostval items and the brand-new weapon, the "Twin Skullsplitters of the Legion." Don't miss your chance to add these to your collection!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/aee2cea4a4cec08a0f3353a513e764ef3503170e.jpg[/img]
[h2]Dage's December Promo[/h2]
The December Monthly Promo items have arrived! This month, we're featuring the "Frozen Skullsplitter of Doom" as the new promo item as a bonus for any upgrade package. Guardians will also receive the "Guardian Dragon Cleaver" at no additional cost. Make sure to grab these limited-time items while you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4e7bed84bfdd582c8db7a447fa76422a085869be.png[/img]
[h2]Thank you and... next![/h2]
Wow--we had an absolutely amazing year with tons of new content, features, and improvements. From Oracle Class to Azurecrest to new game features like Sandbox Player Housing, there was just sooo much fun released in 2024. [url=https://aq3d.com/news/2024-year-in-review/]Check out the Year in Review here[/url]!
Coming soon:
🌈 Endless colors for skin, hair, beard, lips, and stache
🎄 The new Frostval 2024 Collection
🦌 A massively requested player request: ridable mounts! 
🤺 Sir Lanceler questline inspired by the original AdventureQuest

We hope you enjoy this week's update and all the exciting new content. As always, thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. And always remember to…

Battle on!
Clarion, Artix, Beleen, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

Happy Thanksgiving to all of our Heroes who hail from the United States of America! In honor of the holiday, we have a new questline in Yulgar’s Inn that will unlock a new emote and some thematic housing items to fill your houses with delicious food!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2d8f42095202602f3377f175c90ed0ed1794cc2a.png[/img]

I present to you the PALADIN line of Gaming PCs with some racer-style chairs and monitors! Talk to BattleTron in Battleon to get access to this shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/114e688a67f9cf8a8aae60b3d822fcb53045494c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0eb582f3a0d00799776ca0a4e39e437a5ced41e4.jpg[/img]

We've brought the server boost back. That sets XP and CXP gains to 150% and we've added an addition the will allow players to gain double the rewards from daily quests!

This week the Black Friday and Cyber Monday items are returning to Battleon via the Mysterious Stranger and BattleTron Defender. But beyond returning items, they’re bringing some new goodies too! The Mysterious Stranger has some blacked-out versions of some iconic AdventureQuest items while BattleTron Defender has a new selection of Hard-Light code-themed items.

First, is the Ancient Dragon Ultra Greatsword, to get this massive blade, just purchase any package in the upgrade shop, now with 50% extra Dragon Crystals on select packages. notes.title: 🎉 New Skill System, Action Bar, and Quickstep Dash!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/386a125b4988371e0dcb2eb5a1157b927b2c2156.png[/img]
[h1]Hotbar Revamp & a late Steam update because the images were not loading in the backend of Steam 🤷‍♀️[/h1]
The feature announced a few weeks ago has finally made its grand entrance into AdventureQuest 3D. What started off as a way to equip two Cross Skills has evolved into something a lot bigger… Let’s get into it! (This release was on Thursday, November 14, 2024, just fyi) 

[h2]How Skills Work[/h2]
First off, Skills have been revamped to fit into different categories. We’ll start with the most basic skill type and most likely the first kind of skill you’ll use in the whole game, Class Skills. Class Skills are skills the skills that are built into your class. These cannot be changed and are the basic blueprint of how your character plays. Second, we have Cross Skills. Cross Skills are those neat abilities you unlock when you reach rank 10 with a class and can’t slot into any other class you like letting you customize the way you play ever so slightly. Now, here is where we start talking about NEW things. The first big change is we’ve added a brand new type of skill, these are known as Base Skills. Base Skills are a baseline set of abilities that every character will start with, You might recognize them as these were originally all PVP except for Quickstep. Base Skills are mostly focused on utility and will allow us to design encounters with the knowledge players have these options available to them to overcome specific challenges. The penultimate type of skill in the game is PVP Skills. PVP Skills can only be equipped while in the Battle Hall (/join PVPLobby). These skills as the name suggests only work in PVP and are oriented around that. Finally, the last skill category we’ve made is Heroic Skills… Currently, there is no way to access Heroic Skills, however, once we release them I think they have the chance to be one of the most exciting new features in AdventureQuest 3D. Heroic Skills will be obtainable through all different means. From questing to buying from shop vendors with gold, or even from powerful bosses! These skills will allow you to open up what your character can do providing you the ability to heal yourself or party members. Shoot out shadow magic to cause a debuff or even call down lightning on your enemies. Essentially, Heroic Skill can be anything! With this new skill type, you will be able to really make your Hero YOUR hero.

[h2]More Slots![/h2]
None of this would really matter if we only had one slot to work with like we did with Cross Skills. But, we’ve changed this. The hotbar has been completely revamped to allow skills of all types to be slotted into them. While this week we are launching with 2 available hotbar slots as we receive feedback we can open it up and tweak things to have all additional hotbar slots open to customize with what ever Item or Skill you like.

[h2]So Let’s Recap![/h2]
Class Skills: The Skills baked into your class.
Cross Skills: The Rank 10 Skill you unlock that works across all classes.
Base Skills: Skills based around basic utility.
PVP Skills: Skills usable in PVP. Must be in the Battle Hall to equip them.
Heroic Skills: Skills you can buy, get as a drop or quest reward. Used to customize your playstyle further.
Essentially, you are building a house! (No, not player housing, we already have that!) The Class is your foundation but the walls and furniture, everything around it that makes it YOUR house are the Cross Skills, Base Skills, and Heroic Skills you choose to make your house… well, YOUR house. Except it’s not a house it’s the Hero who will save all of Lore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e96cc05fe42a49fa470fd602670360ecda193e54.png[/img][h2]The Bone Inspector[/h2]
A new questline has been added to the Isle of the Dead for heroes close to the start of their journey through lore. Head on over and talk to Sir Ossian and help this strange knight search for the ideal bones for his collection and earn the Embossed Knight set. The Goal of this questline is the smooth over some gearing pains in the early game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/044082b73319ef360d7052b0c0b5109ffa7fa75d.png[/img]
[h2]More Gorses and More Gooncorns[/h2]
We 'herd' your feedback on wanting a daily quest for the Gorses and Goonicorn content! So gallop over to Luigi, who’s now saddled up with a new daily quest to help you trot away with some Vials of Goo. Gorse and Goonicorn statues await! Goo luck!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9ac6ea06eab9875a4a69e5d6a20e606c1e39756d.png[/img]
[h2]The Wandering Light[/h2]
The Wandering Light gear has also received a daily. Lady Phimion will have a quest for you to clear the dungeon to earn Motes of Wandering Light.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/07a3625473887223cb3802075d1d2f9b12481a27.png[/img]
Two new items dove into the Treasure Chest loot pool in the previous week's release! Variants on the Dragon Ultra Greatswords, which are this month's primo promo items. The Legion Dragon Ultra Greatsword and the Knight's Dragon Ultra Greatsword can be acquired from an Emperor's Chest, Warlord's Chest, or Soldier's Chest. Good luck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/617fe425b92b3191c7ae928233ab0dccff6209cf.jpg[/img]
[h2]New Promo Item: Ancient Dragon Ultra Greatsword[/h2]
This November, wield legendary strength with the Ancient Dragon Ultra Greatsword – a weapon forged in dragon fire and brimming with power! Secure this mighty blade when you purchase any package in the Upgrade Shop. Select packs now come with 50% extra Dragon Crystals too, which I *know* you’re gonna need for the upcoming holiday season! Wanna snag an even greater greatsword? Go Guardian to unlock the exclusive Guardian Dragon Ultra Greatsword as an added bonus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1c2860cacd7658c4456c7e3944d8c06a92e148f9.jpg[/img]
[h2]Thank you and... next![/h2]
🏆 Over 200 amazingly eerie entires poured into the Screamshot Contest! We are thrilled to award 40+ players with prizes who showcased their creativity and frightful fun in so many wicked ways. Check 'em out at https://aq3d.com/news/2024-screamshot-contest-winners/
🎃 Our players really 'squashed' the competition in our Artix Pumpkin Carving Contest! Feast your eyes at https://aq3d.com/news/artix-pumpkin-carving-contest-winners-2024/ 
✨ Guild Spotlight next week! Do you want the chance to have your Guild featured on the Design Notes? Enter your guild at https://aq3d.com/posts/adventurequest-guild-spotlight-series/
🌈 Endless colors coming for skin, hair, beard, lips, and stache! No longer will you be stuck to predefined colors -- find the color palette that's perfect for you.
🎄 Frostval, Friday the 13th, and festive festivities coming soon! 

[h2]Closing Thoughts[/h2]
We want to make AdventureQuest 3D the game we can, with changes like Spellforged Gear and now this change to how skills and the hotbar work I feel more than ever we are on the right path to really opening up AdventureQuest 3D to put player choice at the center of how they play their character. We will continue to look at ways to add depth to the game and help it evolve into the game the players deserve. Thank you for being with us on this journey.

[b]Battle on,[/b]
Clarion, Artix, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b12c7cbb654bde7aadef0a87d25270db3c0a37ef.jpg[/img]

The denizens from Mystcroft have recently relocated to a charming new district known as Treat Street. This area offers a new trick-or-treat experience away from the hustle and bustle of Mystcroft. notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/734406fe5b2f132f2c2d97808e927089ceed92d1.jpg[/img]
[h1]Mystcroft & Moglween Returns[/h1]

Tis the spooky season of Mogloween,
And the Grave Digger Outfit looks wickedly mean.
Pumpkin Hunters take aim at the moon,
In Corpse Paladin’s armor, you'll hear a dark tune.

In the dead of night, the Suit of Darkness gleams,
While Doctor Bloodstone’s Coat unravels dark schemes.
In the Arachnarette’s Outfit, webs finely spun,
With the Gown of Darkness, the nightmare’s only just begun.

Witch Hunter’s on guard and fully aware,
Harvest Defenders protect crops with care.
Masquerade dresses in colors so bold,
Like Red, Blue, Green, and of course Gold.

The Haunting Wraith Robes drift in the mist,
And Princess Vampina’s Dress is hard to resist.
Gourdian Knights guard the Pumpkin Lord’s flair,
Iron Bat Armors soar through the air.

The Pumpkinmancer’s Robes cast a cursed spell,
In the Witch Robe, you’ll hear a ghostly bell.
Arachnan spins webs, Headless Horseman does ride,
In Mad Scientist coats, dark secrets abide.

Armed with weapons and capes and helms to behold,
These armors tell tales that will never grow old.
So don spooky outfits and enjoy ghoulish delight,
For the season of Mogloween is such a fun fright.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6c4740cd4f67c13f1cdf6259f201001e1c11aafe.jpg[/img]
[h1]The Blackthorn Fleet Seek Revenge On The Midori Kage Clan[/h1]
The winds of war blow once again across Lore. A tale of revenge and duty is about to unfold. The Blackthorn Fleet, a group of fierce pirates led by Captain Mordred Blackthorn, demands the head of Master Kurohane, the leader of the Midori Kage ninja clan, to avenge the death of Mordred’s only son, Arthur Blackthorn. With tensions higher than ever, a mysterious voice calls to Mordred, offering a chance to avenge his son by summoning him to the Island of Titans with promises of power. Unbeknownst to him, Ninja Master Kurohane is also heeding a similar call, one that warns of a calamity threatening his clan but offers a way to prevent it. It’s time to pick a side, brave hero of Lore. Travel to the Island of Titans and fight for the cause you believe in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/130f3ca0975828580ac791a9d333ecac42ddd90e.jpg[/img]
[h2]The Blackthorn Fleet[/h2]
The Blackthorn Fleet is a formidable group of pirates feared by the people of Lolosia. They believe in a life of freedom, unshackled by society’s rules, as free as the wind that blows across the ocean. Unfortunately for those around them, this means they steal and do as they please.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4f46b2b950a74b67cdc5b2baca21522b8025b1cf.jpg[/img]
[h2]The Midori Kage Clan[/h2]
A secretive ninja clan with a long history, the Midori Kage have outposts across the Mysterious Islands. Over the years, they have accumulated many valuable treasures and relics. The Midori Kage value tradition and honor and do not take kindly to outsiders trespassing in their territory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ca2c51e5332f4f7f1845d9dee7d695c8e18b26fd.jpg[/img]
[h2]War Has Changed[/h2]
The AdventureQuest 3D war system has been completely revamped. Previously, you had to turn in quests to gain progress for the war meter, with all quests counting for the same amount of progress. Now, you can gain progress for your faction’s war meter through various means. Killing monsters, summoning additional troops, and even repairing structures can all contribute to filling up the meter and can be worth different amounts. Additionally, for this war, we are experimenting with a dual storyline, updating the story of the ongoing conflict weekly, so don’t forget to check back!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a032910ad830353d7e271cf82c765a8abf97ee3a.jpg[/img]
[h2]Spawn Reinforcements[/h2]
By completing quests, defeating enemy units, and fishing, you can gather materials to turn in with your faction’s NPCs in exchange for items to spawn the reinforcements of your choice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3d651b4e8ae8730c8e9654cf27f366d40807aa39.jpg[/img]
[h2]Rewards![/h2]
As the war meter fills up for your faction, you will be able to earn more rewards, including pets, travel forms, armors, and weapons. This time, the items you can unlock are themed around the specific faction you are fighting for.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e37747ac22a2e6a2772d8ee0ccc6564d58e4cb8c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Returning Content[/h2]
With it being Friday the 13th Camp Gonnagetcha has opened up once more! Head on over to Yulgar’s Inn and speak to Dottie, the High Archcounseler to book your trip to Campe Gonnagetcha while it’s still open.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/701d6588631874edfeacf2e82db949eb0711336b.png[/img]
[h2]New Promo Items: Draconic Dread Canons[/h2]
Our September promo item are the Draconic Dread Canons! To get this menacing dragon gun, just purchase any package in the upgrade shop, now with 50% extra Dragon Crystals on select packages. For those that get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the Draconic Canons at no extra cost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/878c7072d28cf4fe36e19fdd436c146f9deed43d.jpg[/img]
[h2]An Evolving Conflict…[/h2]
Next week, the war continues with an expanding plot unique to both factions. And of course, the Talk Like a Pirate Day collection will arrive! This collection will be themed around the war and feature two new class skins: the Doom Pirate and the Doom Ninja.

[b]Battle on,[/b]
Clarion, Artix, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: 🎩 Enter the HATch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7a9a1c280ae61d307359b101d6f76e7af09beb45.png[/img]
[h2]Enter the HATch[/h2]
A strange… person?... has shown up in the town of Battleon this week. If you head over to the Barber Shop you will find Hatrick, the Man of Hats. Hatrick, as you might guess really enjoys hats. He’s obsessed with them in fact. He travels the land in search of rare hats to add to his hat collection, however. This time he needs your help to obtain a hat. Travel to the Hat Tomb and grab it for him. Obviously, this is a simple task for a hero such as yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7ab416c7d0d62b2b794b588a012adc142fa7b037.png[/img]
[h2]Collect Hats[/h2]
Once you’ve helped Hatrick out a little you’ll be able to obtain hats from him and.. Horns? Hat-orns…? Collect Powerful Hat Essence from all monsters in the zones. You can also earn Powerful Hat Essence by running the 3 Daily Quests that Hatrick will have available to help you along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bdfabd6c49e5986f2d76cdedf536560e0d34e799.png[/img]
[h2]Travel Forms and Pets?![/h2]
Hatrick also has Travel Forms and Pets?!… They wear hats so no rules are being broken with this theme!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/26f037c37549ec13529f30848b86852078bc33dd.jpg[/img]
[h2]Class Balance Changes[/h2]
In our ongoing effort to tune classes and put more fun and power in the hands of the player, we’ve made some changes to both the Pirate and Ninja classes, giving them some AoE.
[list]
[*] Pirate: Flak Shot is now an AoE
[*] Ninja: Both Slashing Gale and Fire Strike are now AoEs
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/701d6588631874edfeacf2e82db949eb0711336b.png[/img]
[h2]New Promo Items: Draconic Dread Cannons[/h2]
Our September promo item is the Draconic Dread Cannons! To get this menacing dragon gun, just purchase any package in the upgrade shop, now with 50% extra Dragon Crystals on select packages. For those that get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the Draconic Cannons at no extra cost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6fa7490f187fb6b1f18bf0abdcf30cd6d89c7160.png[/img]
[h2]Prepare For War…[/h2]
Next week the Pirate vs Ninja war begins! We’ve been working hard behind the scenes to create a new war using feedback from the Invasion From the Deep. One of these changes is how the War Meter is progressed. Originally, you would only get a set amount from turning in a quest… Any quest. We’ve worked hard to change that system to allow you to earn varying amounts of progress so harder quests will fill the meter faster. But, it doesn’t stop there! These updates to the war system go beyond allowing different quests to have varying impacts on the war effort. Kills and other actions can now count towards filling up that bar. We look forward to seeing you on the battlefield!

Battle on,
Clarion, Artix, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team
