notes.title: 🗺️ Explore a brand new map, uncover Azurecrest secrets, and evolve your Lance!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9ccb97e2fc22f4c42fcd06590cfb57e6a7f3a29b.jpg[/img]
[h1]Embark to Azurecrest Island[/h1]
This week players will meet up with Bob-O once again and learn more about the Azurecrest Lance. Travel to a mysterious island that once was a home for both Water Elves and early Lolosian settlers. Uncover it’s dark history and eventually empower your Azurecrest Lance into one of two new powerful Spellforged weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/98abb9455fad9ee1ef681f16b405dfd849d2c6e0.png[/img]
[h2]Azurecrest Armor[/h2]
The Azurecrest armor is but one of the rewards you’ll find on your adventures. This statted rare quality gear will be an alternative way to get caught up if you’re feeling a little behind in gearing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1593ad254e19d756c2caa250077fb78c7e9eea5c.jpg[/img]
[h2]Will you choose Redemption?[/h2]
One of the two upgrade paths you can choose for the Azurecrest lance is Redemption. This regal weapon has the power to call down lightning dealing high damage to the enemy struck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/083a4b536fd69af6adbbe09e57d21501e041086e.jpg[/img]
[h2]Or Scorn?[/h2]
The alternative is Scorn, a loathsome shadowy weapon that drains the life force of your enemies healing you with every strike. The choice is yours to make, but don’t feel too bad you can eventually create the opposite weapon to the one you chose as the boss at the end of the Azurecrest Lance’s storyline has a chance to drop more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/fac1b7bbe99ea2d175ddf3511eaf4541b258bae3.jpg[/img]
[h2]Primal Orb Pet Update[/h2]
Last week I released a statement about an error I made in releasing an item that was supposed to be reserved to players who purchased the Primal Orb Pet. As promised we are providing a shop attached to the Primal Orb Pet that will give you access to a Fiend Cape of Nulgath without the requirement of any Lost Fragments of Nulgath. Additionally, I had asked Dage to craft an exclusive version of the game known as the Primal Fiend Cape of Nulgath which will also be in the shop for no additional cost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1577b76aa88a609df490f5fd3e6d24e67374c292.png[/img]
[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
I’m really excited to share some information on what we’ve got cooking. The team is hard at work creating a unique Talk Like a Pirate Day event this year. But, this isn’t your typical Talk Like a Pirate Day affair. As a long-time fan of Artix Entertainment and the original AdventureQuest, I’m super excited to announce we are working on a Pirate vs Ninja War for this year’s Talk Like a Pirate Day. Splinter factions within the two groups have formed and seek to put an end to the opposing side once and for all. However, this desire for destruction has awoken an ancient evil from deep within the Mysterious Isles. A new island emerges from the sea and an unseen voice calls out to the war-hungry leaders of both factions. Whispers of ancient weapons of unparalleled destruction can be theirs, an ultimate solution to their problems… DOOM to the opposing faction.

The Pirate vs Ninja War introduces two new DOOM weapons into AdventureQuest 3D. Along with two new Class Skins. It’s with great pleasure that I announce the Doom Pirate and Doom Ninja, we’ve been working on this stuff in the background for a while now and the team is really excited for you guys to get your hands on this sometime in September.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6532a87f08a89148286dc0a90c258ecc5974cc76.gif[/img]
[h2]Beyond that…[/h2]
We’ve begun work on a new Saga about a month ago. I can’t say too much about it yet, but I’d like to show you early progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a58274c663d0d6dac7c0fb80acb2fe414188f38b.jpg[/img]
[h2]New Promo Items: Azurecrest Shield[/h2]
Our August promo item is the Azurecrest Cape and Shield! To get this regal shield, just purchase any package in the upgrade shop, now with 50% extra Dragon Crystals on select packages. For those that get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the Shadow Azurecrest Cape and Shield at no extra cost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b71a37c042d3d0c2ad020aa053740de8c3dec1b8.jpg[/img]
[h2]Thank you and... Next![/h2]
We'll be showcasing our first Guild next week! [url=https://aq3d.com/news/adventurequest-guild-spotlight-series/]Share your Guild’s story and some screenshots for a chance to be featured on our Design Notes[/url]. Additionally, we're thrilled to announce the upcoming Pirate vs Ninja War event for Talk Like a Pirate Day, featuring new Doom weapons and class skins. Furthermore, our team has started work on a new Saga, and AQ3D will soon see a new homepage, a server boost, and the exceedingly 'pup'ular Dog Day, too!

[b]Battle on,[/b]
Clarion, Artix, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7397bae34d16e6d60bfb873002624ed2368b5d7f.jpg[/img]
[h1]Gnome Problem[/h1]
Doddery the Gnome has made his presence known across Lore by being a bit of a nuisance. You can find him in Warlic’s Magic Shoppe where he has a nifty little shop. But, If you find him in a daily boss map you can fight him for some extra goodies. Both the Travel Form and Pet will be obtainable through gameplay or can be purchased with Dragon Crystals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3e2b1d46f9098052b468b76b5607982426c9166d.jpg[/img]
[h2]Blue-Eyed Soul Dragon[/h2]
Starting this week during the intro in Death’s Lair, Death will award you with a stone that unlocks the Blue-Eyed Soul Dragon Travel Form and Pet. But fear not existing heroes! If you return to Death’s Lair via the Travel Menu, you can unlock the Blue-Eye Soul Dragon for yourself. To be clear, the Blue-Eyed Soul Dragon is free for all players. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/cab1e7641a87e198ff17a0da93e6bc8bdd963390.jpg[/img]
[h2]Legendary Oracle Class Set[/h2]
The Legendary Oracle set arrives in all of its mystical glory! Achieve Rank 50 with the Oracle to unlock this vibrant appearance. We can’t wait to see the awesome screenshots you’ll share on socials!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0eb582f3a0d00799776ca0a4e39e437a5ced41e4.jpg[/img]
[h2]Server Boost[/h2]
Woohoo! For one week we will be running a 150% XP and Class XP boost to assist in your adventures. Grind hard, heroes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0f7a7cebbb11e0f70aa33b455da9f906c8291d31.jpg[/img]
[h2]Last Chance! Promo Items: Starlight Longsword[/h2]
This week is the last chance to obtain our July promo item is the Empowered Starlight Longsword! To get this starstruck blade, just purchase any package in the upgrade shop, now with 50% extra Dragon Crystals on select packages. For those that get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the Starlight Longsword at no extra cost.

[b]Battle on,[/b]
Clarion, Artix, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: New Spellforged Items: Halo of the Sun Warrior
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b53ce9ea867dce662004895e698d4028ba44af0f.jpg[/img]
[h1]Halo of the Sun Warrior[/h1]
Hello, adventurers! I hope everyone has been having a great week. For this update, we will be introducing two new Spellforged items into AdventureQuest 3D. Two golden halos will be craftable by collecting materials from Lumenion; one halo will grant you a haste buff on proc while the other a crit buff. Once you’ve gathered the material from Lumenion, you can head to Yulgar and forge the halo of your choice!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e69166dd86ee832e6f4a47f38da7953eba62dc9f.jpg[/img]
[h2]Ignite your Halo[/h2]
While you will first forge a normal metal halo you will be able to upgrade it into a Spellforged helm of your choice!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c0d9c13bad235f64825479464a76123f14214c9e.jpg[/img]
[h2]Lumenion Statues[/h2]
Lumenion will also be dropping 4 statues starting today. This ofc begs the question… where is he storing such large lawn ornaments!? Two statues will be of Lumenion while the other two will be of the Blinding Starlight of Destiny.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/89108ad2259a403bbe6f444f8c2b0fdfc6076843.jpg[/img]
[h2]2024  Summer Collection Update[/h2]
Three new items have been added to the 2024 Summer collection this week! But you better hurry, because our summer goodies leave on July 31st. So if there’s anything in that collection that you must have right now… you better buy now before they go bye-bye!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b5701d19afb022ca86b61e257b182c128de938ba.jpg[/img]
[h2]Summer Grill Out War Shop Update[/h2]
In addition to the Summer Collection being updated, we’ve also added a new item to the Summer Grill Out War Shop for gold. 

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
We’ve made some changes to the Sun Fury Scythe to not only make it stronger but we’ve also increased the amount of ore you obtain to craft it easier. This is done with the intent of making it easier to obtain the Sun Fury Scythes while you are leveling through the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3b6bc0dc0dd6f0d4fca1b13f27ccc238157ace2a.jpg[/img]
[h2]New Promo Items: Starlight Longsword[/h2]
Our July promo item is the Empowered Starlight Longsword! To get this starstruck blade, just purchase any package in the upgrade shop, now with 50% extra Dragon Crystals on select packages. For those that get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the Starlight Longsword at no extra cost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bd64da5af6c0127fa42af76b87960d2afe6fcb4d.jpg[/img]
[h2]Sizzling Summer Postcard Winners[/h2]
Over 20000 Artix Points have been awarded! We had such a spectacular turnout for our first-ever Artix Summer Postcard Contest, so it was challenging to narrow down the winners. We cannot believe how talented you all are! [url=https://aq3d.com/news/artix-summer-postcard-contest-winners/]Check out our wonderful winners who submitted fanart, fanfic, or both[/url]!

Clarion, Artix, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: Starlight Paladin Class Skin
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/324a71b6157880ddcde7d839e9fdd581872fe01e.png[/img]
[h1]Starlight Paladin Class Skin[/h1]
This week in AdventureQuest 3D players can purchase the Starlight Paladin class skin. Harness the power of Starlight and wield it as a weapon to shatter your foes or a bulwark to protect your allies! The Starlight Paladin class skin can be purchased from Artix in Battleon at in the Shadow of the Wind Village. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8b692e18f8dcdba184f44cb002aaa69dac3e82dd.jpg[/img]
The class skin features a star-themed twist on the classic Paladin’s skills and matches the Blinding Starlight of Destiny and this month’s promo item, The Starlight Longsword, perfectly!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/aafc633980aaa08203ccf3f8a92aad2f76111599.jpg[/img]

[h2]Return to the Deep[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/99216635e2719f8d0f4eb0f758cea06eed1c13cf.jpg[/img]
This week will also bring additional drops to the Deep Grotto dungeon. All of the bosses within the dungeon now have a chance to drop pieces of the Clawgrah set. This rare set features devastating claws as weapons that will allow you to rip and tear through any of your foes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/97ce97523b3dd798e0042146e2df5d5ac211feed.jpg[/img]
We’re also updating the icons of the game and introducing some brand-new ones. Spellforged will have a unique color and gem on their icon to indicate they have a Spellforged effect on them. This will allow players to look at their inventory and know right away which gear has effects and which doesn’t.

[b]Oracle Class:[/b]
[list]

[b]Misc Changes[/b]

[*] Enemies within the Deep Grotto have been further tweaked to smooth out the experience.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3b6bc0dc0dd6f0d4fca1b13f27ccc238157ace2a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Enter the Deep Grotto Dungeon if you dare... hardest Dungeon in AQ3D!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/607e679acd320c8a17d73e5fad621236dac30e66.jpg[/img]
[h1]Invasion from the Deep…Part 2![/h1]
The battle has been won but the fight has only just begun… Venture deep under the sea and take the fight to the home of the scronches. They ruined your grill-out and now it’s time to bring the pain to these slimy invaders… Welcome to the Deep Grotto! This brand-new dungeon is now unlocked in Heroes Cove as a reward for clearing the Invasion from the Deep War. Inside the Deep Grotto you’ll find a challenge designed for end-game players full of level 50 monsters. As if that wasn’t challenging enough, THREE new bosses await, and 16 pieces of level 50 gear to boot! Clearing the Deep Grotto will require good positioning and the ability to prioritize defeating the right monsters. Do you have what it takes to clear the Grotto of the Deep, or will you be lost at sea?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/60202de6f0a73349c1aab990fd35b55cb1a56d2a.jpg[/img]
[h2]The Vile Deep Hydra[/h2]
Stay on the move when battling the Vile Deep Hydra! Its poisonous cloud attacks and water jets will punish anyone not remaining on the move!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7cb70b2942a18602443794af9c28070bb0e722dc.jpg[/img]
[h2]Clawgrah the Deepest Claw[/h2]
This bioluminescent crab monster is a brawler, but don’t be intimidated by his large size! Try to keep close to Clawgrah so you are better positioned to dodge his massive AoE attacks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6b5a50196ff14c1e8a41660e170510a8ce926d67.jpg[/img]
[h2]Serpnaut - Menace of the Deep[/h2]
Serpnaut is the last challenge that waits for all those who wish to take on the Deep Grotto… His attacks are a mixture of everything you’ve faced during your trials in the dungeon. Use everything you’ve learned to take down this evil creature and claim your rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e720d0ed3ac27058c6e494818b9c44228bb961bf.jpg[/img]
[h2]The Summer 2024 Collection[/h2]
This week also brings the 2024 Summer Collection! Within this vast collection of summer-themed items you’ll find:
[list]
[*] The Tidal Tempest Set
[*] The Abyssal Set
[*] 2 Tie-Up Swimsuits
[*] 4 Weapons
[*] A Bloodfairy Travelform and Pet
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2a3d697dbcd18f44340197a6fb183a5621ba79eb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b9c959848287c2d144e376cf36803f977ac35360.jpg[/img]
[h2]The Heroes Cove Housing Collection[/h2]
Is home decorating more your thing? We’ve got you covered! Along with the Summer 2024 Gear collection we have the Heroes Cove housing collection. In this massive pack of housing goodies, you’ll find many assets featured within Heroes Cove including the Cove itself as a map. From grills to sea bubbles, you can create your own perfect beach getaway today!

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Defender sets from Battleon Siege are no longer statted, however, if you’ve previously obtained statted versions, you will be able to keep them.
[*] Atlantis Raid no longer requires queueing.
[*] The ShadowReaper of Doom upgrade path no longer requires a Sacrifice of Power.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/66586816d0eadc69c7156cdff26adab853a3327c.jpg[/img]
[h2]LAST CHANCE! Rubber Ducky Hat, House Item, and 50% bonus DCs[/h2]
What the duck is that?! Now you can totally ‘wing it’ with the adorably awesome Rubber Ducky Hat! To adopt your feathered friend, just purchase any package in the upgrade shop, score 50% extra Dragon Crystals, AND as an added bonus, you’ll unlock the Rubber Ducky House Item. For those who get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the exclusive bubble-blowing variant helm. Because bubbles rule. And so do you! Thank you for helping support AQ3D – we love that you love us (and rubber duckies too)! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/aa9878cc562981770d3bee2cde0dfdbea514ad1f.jpg[/img]
[h2]Thank you and… next![/h2]
We just wrapped up two contests: the Co-Op Sandbox and National Pink Day. There were so many spectacular entries and judging is currently underway! But if you missed out on those, you still have time to enter our summer Postcard Contest. We welcome artists and writers alike to showcase their talents with fanart, fanfic, or both! Artix Points await our winners. Summer Postcard Contest sunsets June 30. [url=https://www.artix.com/posts/artix-summer-postcard-contest/]Full contest details here[/url]!

[b]Battle on,[/b]
Clarion, Artix, Beleen, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: Level Cap increases to 50! Plus, the summer of battling on begins ⚔️
notes.content:
[h2]Summer of Battling On: Invasion from the Deep![/h2]
Do you hear that? It’s the sweet sound of fun waves on the beach, that’s right it’s time for some fun in the sun. Head on over to Heroes Cove and join in on the good times. Experience the exotic wildlife, enjoy the scent of meat on the grill, fish to your heart's content… battle invading creatures from the depths of the sea!? Scronches invade from the depths in search of MEAT, defend the beach, and win the war!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/invasion-from-the-deep/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/fdab4e3457308c83d6efbd5ba5ee3c560f63ee70.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Explore Heroes Cove[/h2]
Heroes Cove may not be what it seems at first, but there are secrets to uncover, and wildlife to do battle with! From Blood Faries to Sea Dickens, who knows what you might find!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/invasion-from-the-deep/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/be37f8a7dabb40755e0273b70f6fb33bec3fcb9b.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]War… War Never Changes.[/h2]
With the arrival of summer comes a new war at Heroes Cove, the slimy schronches rise up from the deep to claim the cove for themselves. Of course, we can’t let them steal our BBQ. Complete quests to progress the war meter, as the war meter fills you will gain access to new items in the war shop from Annette and once the mete fills you will gain access to the dungeon! Battle monsters, turn in quests, get rewards, and turn the tide of the war! 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/invasion-from-the-deep/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e27bff067c958f3113ef52b2d01203eb9af25415.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/invasion-from-the-deep/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3de37ec676b0e7e2372975e18ff3b2290025da93.jpg[/img][/url]


[h2]A Sneak Peak at Items[/h2]
Here is a sneak peek at some of the items you can find in Heroes Cove, some are rewards from the war while others can be bought or gained through other means.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/invasion-from-the-deep/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/80eac3f45e60d6e522c9dbb331c3ab55e16beaae.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Level Cap Raised to 50[/h2]
In preparation for what’s to come a hero must get strangers. Players will be able to ascend to a new level of power! One must be ready for the villains ahead, so start your training arc now.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/invasion-from-the-deep/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/075d91a1b0ef8197a27fa23ce151c66f7ba291ca.jpg[/img]
[/url]
[h2]Returning Content[/h2]
This week also sees the return of previous summer collections for al la carte sales, by speaking to Annette. That includes the summer collections from 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022 and 2023. Beyond that, the events in Pointe Less Isle have also returned.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/invasion-from-the-deep/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c662cf4087aa5d1b5233418a184fd0cc102ff4c3.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Fiend Dricken[/h2]
A long-requested travel form arrives in the Oversoul. Take on the Nulgath Challenge and fight for your chance at this Guardian-only Fiend Dricken Form!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/invasion-from-the-deep/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9f60d695c7b6bc4fd16d790cdb9c70542bfc360e.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New Sounds[/h2]
The combined powers of Broomtool and Jongaar have brought a new feature to the game. When you submerge under the water in Heroes Cove you’ll notice a more dynamic change in your audio to represent being underwater.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/invasion-from-the-deep/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0eb582f3a0d00799776ca0a4e39e437a5ced41e4.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Server Boost[/h2]
Starting on June 19th and ending on June 26th we will be running a 150% server boost for XP and CXP to help you catch up or achieve the new level cap of 50.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/invasion-from-the-deep/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/26f037c37549ec13529f30848b86852078bc33dd.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
Last week some changes made it to live which, while unintended, served to be pretty exciting. For the most part, the spirit of these changes is fine but essentially Warrior and Mage could endlessly scale, we’ve reigned them in just a bit and will be monitoring the situation moving forward. To make up for the change in Mage’s damage output we’ve increased the AoE on their fireball as compensation. While these changes look big on paper it really took crazy circumstances to pop off with the amount of stacks required to break them.

Warrior Class Changes:
Warrior’s Protection stack cap has been reduced from 9001 to 20
Mage Class Changes:
Mage’s Fire Aspect stack cap has been reduced from 9001 to 20
Mage’s Fire Ball AoE has been increased from 3 to 5
This week we have more than class balance changes, we’ve also shifted scaling in some older maps as we move to rebalance the game.

Scaling Changes:
The 20th Anniversary Maps level scaling cap has been reduced to 20.
The Moon level scaling cap has been reduced to 20.
Skullpunch Island level scaling cap has been reduced to 20.
Atlantis level scaling cap has been reduced to 20
In our ongoing discussions about AdventureQuest 3D, we’ve focused on the Nulgath content. Over the past year, Nulgath weapons have dominated the game, they’ve been the best-in-slot weapons since their release. However, this dominance has had unintended consequences for the game’s economy and reward system. Players have provided feedback that other rewards don’t feel as valuable because Nulgath items are so powerful. Addressing this issue isn’t straightforward. Simply releasing more items at a slightly higher level won’t solve it, as Nulgath weapons are hard-coded to be exceptionally potent. Unfortunately, this situation isn’t conducive to a healthy MMO reward structure or the game’s long-term health. To improve the game experience, we’re taking action. While this will involve nerfing some existing content, we’re committed to creating a more balanced environment with diverse rewards. In the upcoming patch, we’ll adjust the infusion cap for many weapons. If you’ve already exceeded the default cap, don’t worry, you’ll retain your progress.

Item Changes:
Multiple level 42+ items have had their cap lowered to be in line with similar items. This does not affect items already infused above 42.
Sandstorm Capstones and Infusion Runes are now tagged as Items, this will allow players to sell or destroy them to remove them from their inventories.
Fiendish Capstones and Infusion Runes are no longer obtainable or required; convert your Capstones at Maximus

notes.title: 🎉 Oracle Class is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a9934ef7392120674975c09cbab838039ec2fbc8.jpg[/img]
[h2]Master the mystic Oracle Class[/h2]
The time has come, heroes! Brace yourselves, for now you can harness the power of the Oracle Class in AdventureQuest 3D! Oracles are the very essence of cosmic might manifested. When you enter the realm of these formidable fate-benders, you’ll master the Time Vortex, Cosmic Shadow, Reset Variance, Threads of Fate, and Cosmic Reverberation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ddd07976bd3c3007707fd1fc0902561597b03fbe.jpg[/img]
[h2]Oracle Class Skills and Abilities[/h2]
With precision skill shots and expansive AoEs, Oracles ensnare and annihilate their foes with their arsenal of abilities.

[b]Auto Attack[/b]
Strike repeatedly with bursts of magical energy, overwhelming your enemies with relentless force.

[b]Cosmic Shadow [/b]
Launches a spectral spear of ethereal energy that slices through foes with deadly precision. This ranged attack not only hits its mark but also pierces enemies behind it, inflicting the "Bad Omen" debuff. Bad Omen increases damage taken by the enemy by 5% per stack. 25% is the max stack of Bad Omen.

[b]Reset Variance[/b]
Mastering Reset Variance is the hallmark of an Oracle. Launch a Time Vortex, strike from afar with Cosmic Shadow, and when your enemy is near defeat, Reset Variance to unleash another Vortex. Each calculated kill resets your cooldowns, readying you for your next strike. This skill also applies Bad Omen.

[b]Time Vortex[/b]
Control the battlefield with a swirling maelstrom of temporal energy. This AoE attack slows reality, rends flesh, and places Bad Omen on all enemies caught within. 

[b]Threads of Fate[/b]
Invoke the ultimate power of the Oracle. Threads of Fate cuts the target’s current HP by 50% instantly (5% max against bosses) and descends a full stack of Bad Omen upon them, binding their fate to doom. Use this skill at the beginning of the battle for maximum impact.

[b]Cosmic Reverberation[/b]
Channel cosmic power to mark an enemy, healing all allies who strike the marked target. This cross skill is essential for bolstering your team’s endurance.

No matter if they are friend or foe, Oracles are formidable beings who bend fate to their will. Their mastery over cosmic forces makes them unparalleled in battle, weaving devastation and destiny with precision and power. Embrace the arcane, and step into the shoes of an Oracle to wield these otherworldly abilities. BTW, we let our players vote, so Oracle Class has arrived now without its Legendary Armor set. That set will come at a later date!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/11be173c00f2731d5acde440671a441d37f8665f.jpg[/img]
[h2]Meet Lothain, the Oracle Class Trainer[/h2]
Do you dare control time, shroud your enemies in shadows, and alter the threads of fate itself? Then join the ranks of the Oracle Class and become the newest legend in Lore! 

The cosmos awaits your command… seek out Lothain in Battleon if you are ready to answer the call!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/26f037c37549ec13529f30848b86852078bc33dd.jpg[/img]
[h2]Paladin Class Revamp[/h2]
We’re examining adjustments to class mechanics to enhance their overall experience. During my playthrough on stream, I noticed that some classes had downtime or lacked impact. Our goal is to gradually address this by introducing class rebalancing. Ultimately, we want every class to be enjoyable to play!

[b]Paladin Class Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Ardent Virtue: Stacks of Ardent Virtue now refresh the cooldown of Radiant Blade once consumed.
[*] Holy Shield: The baseline duration of Holy Shield's duration has been altered from 1.5 seconds to 2.0 seconds but the upgraded version has been changed from 3.5 to 5 seconds.
[/list]
Starting with Paladin we are making some changes to the way Paladin’s Ardent Virtue works. Moving forward, Ardent Virtue will refresh the cooldown of Radiant Blade when consumed. This will offer more uptime on the ability giving you more time to press the fun button, but… It also opens the paladin up to lining up a few stacks of Ardent Virtue and unleashing a barrage of multiple Radiant Blades at once during an armor break to snapshot that damage in that window. This allows the paladin to come up with more strategies! Will you weave in your Radiant Blade strikes between your other cooldowns? Will you save them for an armor break? The choice is yours!

The Ardent Virtue changes are not the only tweaks we made to the paladin class. Holy Shieldnow lasts longer, too! I believe these class changes should solidify the class fantasy of being a heavily armored champion of the light.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c8c671e306a479add68eb203a095cef485e2f497.jpg[/img]
[h2]Umm… surprise!?[/h2]
So… While writing these design notes I found out some class changes that had been in testing made it to live by mistake! We will be monitoring how they change the game. 
[list]
[*] Warrior's Whirlwind: Maximum Protection stacks increased from 12 to 9001.
[*] Rogue's Toxic Surge: Max stack bonus increased from 4 to 8.
[*] Mage's Fire Ball: Fire Aspect maximum stacks increased from 3 to 9001.
[*] Healer's Renew: Kinship maximum stacks increased from 40 to 9001.
[*] Berserker's Battle Fervor: Battle Fervor now makes the Berserker unstoppable.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/66586816d0eadc69c7156cdff26adab853a3327c.jpg[/img]
[h2]Rubber Ducky Hat + House Item[/h2]
What the duck is that?! Now you can totally ‘wing it’ with the adorably awesome Rubber Ducky Hat! Just look at that wittle wellow birb boi perched perfectly upon your head. Good thing he’s potty trained, huh? To adopt your feathered friend, just purchase any package in the upgrade shop, score 50% extra Dragon Crystals, AND as an added bonus, you’ll unlock the Rubber Ducky House Item. For those who get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the exclusive bubble-blowing variant helm!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/14255a56bf8f434917c796f046a53c76ba0db103.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/co-op-sandbox-contest/]New Contest: Co-Op Sandbox[/url][/h2]
Unleash your creativity in our Co-Op Sandbox Contest! Team up with friends to build incredible things using the new Multi-Build house feature. The contest runs until Wednesday, June 19, with prizes up to 6,000 Dragon Crystals for the top team. Submit your multi-build masterpieces and you + your team will have a chance of being crowned “Sandbox Supreme.” 
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/co-op-sandbox-contest/]Full contest details here![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/aa9878cc562981770d3bee2cde0dfdbea514ad1f.jpg[/img]
[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/artix-summer-postcard-contest/]Artix Summer Postcard Contest[/url][/h2]
Celebrate the sizzle of summer with our first-ever [url=https://aq3d.com/news/artix-summer-postcard-contest/]Artix Summer Postcard Contest[/url], where artists and writers alike can showcase their talents. Create Artix-themed postcards using any art medium and/or write a short fanfic on the back! Artix Points prizes for our winners! Open to all Artix Entertainment players from every Artix game. Contest runs until Sunday, June 30, 2024. Unleash your creativity and let’s make waves this summer! 

Battle on,
Clarion, Artix, Beleen, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: Housing Improvements
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/housing-improvements/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9ef917eff452f0d264ec20cb2257df835c81dd7e.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]
Revamped playing housing + Multi-build arrive in AdventureQuest 3D[/h2]
AdventureQuest 3D is introducing two significant housing improvements this week. First, we’re eliminating purchasable housing slots. If you’ve already purchased a house, you can now use it immediately. Additionally, we’ll be providing refunds for any housing slot purchases in the form of Dragon Crystals. We hope this makes getting into building your dream house more simple and straightforward. Beyond that Guardians will get a +1000 House item limit bonus.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/housing-improvements/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/cdee5f57e484ee2100f45273231edf64612f1177.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]New Function: Multi-Build[/h2]
The housing improvements don’t stop with the changes to housing slots and guardian bonuses. We’re also introducing Multi-Build! No longer will you be stuck building your home solo. Party up and assign your friends as builders, and work together to create your dream home.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/housing-improvements/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c51904e9cabad5eb93693ceb6c2a7f6d6ca66a6f.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]BMany Improvements[/h2]
As mentioned in a previous post, we’re closely monitoring the changes we’ve made to areas where scaling has been removed. Your voices have been heard loud and clear! Now, more skeletons spawn within the dark reaches of the Bone Zone. But skeletons aren’t the only horrors lurking in the deepest corners of the BMany Dimension. Legends speak of powerful BOne versions of familiar faces that roam the graveyard, seeking battle. Who knows what rewards await those who dare to face them? And beyond that, an even more sinister foe lies in wait for any unlucky traveler who crosses its path.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/housing-improvements/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/acd3be9f77ba053654681ae8cb4790455959a848.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]New Map Interface[/h2]
The map interface in AdventureQuest 3D has undergone a revamp, accompanied by a stunning new painting depicting the world of Lore. This updated interface now includes clickable nodes that lead to various locations across Lore, providing players with a better sense of the game world.
 
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/housing-improvements/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/f49befe5e5b36702baa913ab2d72d3b79aaa066d.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Week-Long Server Boost![/h2]
For one week we will be doing a server boost for 200% XP and 200% Class XP. So! If you’re behind on leveling up or just wanna get some class ranks grinded out take advantage of this week!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/housing-improvements/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/27ab1c4e4a71dd02a173f47658f9a45d15e81ba8.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Leaving Next Week: The Songs of Pastels[/h2]
It’s the last chance for our May promo item is the Song of Pastels Aura! To get this ethereal aura, just purchase any package in the upgrade shop, now with 50% extra Dragon Crystals on select packages. For those that get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the Fluttering Song of Pastels, an exclusive butterfly-themed variant at no extra cost.

Battle on,

Clarion, Artix, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: Scaling removed?!?! Check out our new game release, too.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/cb20a6264da052e57e78536973cc69076dbb6f3d.png[/img]
[b]Greetings, heroes![/b]
This week we journey to Lolosia and begin their quest by speaking to Gunpowder Mary, the Governor of Lolosia. It’s there you’ll be informed of a suspicious character by the name of Bob-O, who prefers to be called “Bob-O Saltiest Seadog in the Sea”. It’s this encounter that will end with you receiving the long-lost Atlantean weapon known as the Azurecrest Lance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e5e91b390ca479770713c94c041335dc97d0dba0.jpg[/img]
[b]The Azurecrest Lance[/b]
While on the surface the Azurecrest Lance may seem to hold little value this relic of a forgotten era holds a secret potential that is yet to be discovered…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/926a6e5bac880a21ef9839d1ebda4aa447406b8e.png[/img]
[b]Tip the Scales[/b]
We’ve been listening to player feedback and have made the decision to remove level scaling from non-seasonal content in  AdventureQuest 3D. I want to be transparent with you guys, this will take time. Starting today the goal is for content updates that are not seasonal (An example of seasonal content would be Mogloween) and feature new areas that will not be level-scaled. This will be paired with a rollout of revamps and rebalancing of older zones to fit this new design goal. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/aaa0d1c299520cc158819ea376b4c8f49a16689f.jpg[/img]
[b]BOne, BTwo, BMany[/b]
Starting today, The Bmany variant of Bonecliffs has had its scaling removed. This will be the first of many older maps to get this treatment. We’ll be monitoring the situation and tweaking numbers as needed to offer the best experience we can.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/18689c89cfb32189c1683e438d1caeb4fd0333b8.jpg[/img]
[b]Housing Fix[/b]
On Monday we ran into an issue where players on Android were getting an error with housing. By the time you read this, a new version of the game should be available to be downloaded which should correct this issue. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a7e17c5ed9be554c1ec31bd1801767d517782c23.png[/img]
[b]Gaz’s Big Blow Out[/b]
For one week only Gaz has brought back a whole whack of items spanning across multiple seasons! Mogloween, Talk Like a Pirate and Frostval! That’s right, items from these collections will be available to purchase al a carte. So if you missed anything you want from the collections listed below now’s your chance to pick up something nice.

[list]
[*] [b]Mogloween 2020
[*] Mogloween 2021 
[*] Talk Like a Pirate 2019
[*] Talk Like a Pirate 2021 
[*] Frostval 2019
[*] Frostval 2021[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/06b7ec066e6b29d501ed420a0797bdb76b9cd2b6.jpg[/img]
[b]New Promo Items: The Songs of Pastels[/b]
Our May promo item is the Song of Pastels Aura! To get this ethereal aura, just purchase any package in the upgrade shop, now with 50% extra Dragon Crystals on select packages. For those that get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the Fluttering Song of Pastels, an exclusive butterfly-themed variant at no extra cost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/679800f0fa4fee119536425e29623c8c94e86f55.jpg[/img]
[b]Check out our amazing winners![/b]
OMG we just finished judging two spectacular contests: [url=https://aq3d.com/news/screengrab-contest-winners-announced/]Screengrab Saturday[/url] and [url=https://aq3d.com/news/may-the-fourth-contest-winners-announced/]May the Fourth[/url]. And let me tell you: these entries are literally out of this world! TBH, not even surprised because our gaming community is the absolute best. Your passion and skills are seriously next level, and we’re so proud to have such incredible players like you with us!

[b]Battle on,[/b]
Clarion, Artix, the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: Spring into Celebration
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/spring-into-celebration/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e58b6e835bf968cebc17b18c78d611f37be13d8e.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Spring Into Celebration[/h2]
The fragrance of flowers fills the air as we embrace Spring in AdventureQuest 3D. Players can now visit Serenity at Yulgar’s Inn to explore a brand-new shop. There, you’ll find an array of spring-themed cosmetics, including beautiful bouquets of flowers and charming mugs that pay tribute to the mothers of Lore.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/spring-into-celebration/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8773b09cb9e132c7bb9e7b95f4c1ea03067b96f4.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/spring-into-celebration/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d768dd6d12d54801d7d9a005ab2c6d41dc128da5.jpg[/img]
[/url]Collect Wildflowers
Embark on epic battles across Lore to gather Wildflowers, a delightful free-player housing item. This vibrant bundle of colorful blooms is guaranteed to elevate your flora game to new heights. The best part? Any monster can drop them!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/spring-into-celebration/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b078bd7178a9a7ebef69ad90ba427f90b0e62675.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Hands-Free[/h2]
Players have been asking for it, so feast your eyes on this: the highly anticipated Invisible Weapon item now known as the “Paci-fist.” In addition to the original design, two new variants for guns and bows have been introduced. Players can now rely on their fists to communicate with the big baddies across Lore. These formidable weapons are not limited-time offerings; They will be available in Warlic’s Invisible Shop, nestled within his mystical Magic Shoppe.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/spring-into-celebration/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b22a5d41b44347b2f8b129d272baf5819c97569c.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Last Chance for Earth Day[/h2]
As the vibrant days of spring unfold, we bid farewell to the Earth Day Dragon Crystal shop on the 22nd of May. This departure is but a seasonal interlude. Just as the seasons cycle, so too shall the Earth Day Dragon Crystal shop reawaken next year, ready to unveil new wonders and treasures.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/spring-into-celebration/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/68e6afbf9c5656cf2cd709a00acebd95719c1730.png[/img][/url]

Our May promo item is the Song of Pastels Aura! To get this ethereal aura, just purchase any package in the upgrade shop, now with 50% extra Dragon Crystals on select packages. For those that get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the Fluttering Song of Pastels, an exclusive butterfly-themed variant at no extra cost.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/spring-into-celebration/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ed6f702bb19af386eba194ac6a104cf3cbb5a5de.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Later this week: Screengrab winners announced[/h2]
We had 120 entries in our Screengrab Video Contest! Narrowing down the best of the best is no easy feat, but we are excited to announce that the winners will be revealed Friday! Our grand prize winners will see their video clip(s) featured on the new AQ3D website in development. Thank you all for sharing such wonderful moments with us — and we cannot wait to share them with all of you, too! 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/spring-into-celebration/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/421f0487e46b596868da094cb116be03c6db4445.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Next week: May the 4th winners revealed[/h2]
The Force was strong with this contest! So many spectacular screenshots poured in to celebrate May the Fourth and Revenge of the Fifth. And some of the screenies we saw looked like legit scenes from Star Wars! But shh, don’t tell LucasArts that :p 

Your creativity knows no bounds, and we are absolutely blown away by the incredible talent and passion you all showcased. From epic Star Saber duels to reimagining iconic Star Wars scenes, each entry transported us to a galaxy far, far away. Your dedication to capturing the essence of the Force and the spirit of adventure in AQ3D is truly inspiring! Thank you for making this contest a resounding success and for keeping the Force alive in our gaming community. 

May your adventures continue to be filled with wonder and excitement, and may the force always be with you!

Battle on,
Clarion, Artix, the AdventureQuest 3D Team

tags.feature: Players can now visit Serenity at Yulgar’s Inn to explore a brand-new shop. There, you’ll find an array of spring-themed cosmetics, including beautiful bouquets of flowers and charming mugs that pay tribute to the mothers of Lore.

Collect Wildflowers
Embark on epic battles across Lore to gather Wildflowers, a delightful free-player housing item. This vibrant bundle of colorful blooms is guaranteed to elevate your flora game to new heights. The best part? Any monster can drop them!

Hands-Free
Players have been asking for it, so feast your eyes on this: the highly anticipated Invisible Weapon item now known as the “Paci-fist.” In addition to the original design, two new variants for guns and bows have been introduced. Players can now rely on their fists to communicate with the big baddies across Lore. These formidable weapons are not limited-time offerings; They will be available in Warlic’s Invisible Shop, nestled within his mystical Magic Shoppe.

New Promo Items: The Songs of Pastels
Our May promo item is the Song of Pastels Aura! To get this ethereal aura, just purchase any package in the upgrade shop, now with 50% extra Dragon Crystals on select packages. For those that get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the Fluttering Song of Pastels, an exclusive butterfly-themed variant at no extra cost.

[h2]The quest for the Cosmic Raiment marches on! [/h2]
Seek Loremaster Hazel and become one step closer to claiming the elusive Cosmic Boots in this week’s release.
Greetings, brave adventurers!

This week in Adventure Quest 3D, the quest for the Cosmic Raiment set continues on. Previously players were able to obtain the following pieces:
[list]
[*] Cosmic Cloak
[*] Cosmic Gloves
[*] Cosmic Pauldrons
[*] Cosmic Wrap
[*] Cosmic Garment
[/list]
But fear not! The journey isn’t over yet. Starting this week, you’ll have the opportunity to acquire the elusive Cosmic Boots. With each piece collected, you’ll come one step closer to completing the full set and unlocking its cosmic power via the Awakened variant!

Prepare yourselves, for greater challenges await as you seek out the remaining pieces. May the stars guide your path, and may your courage shine as brightly as the cosmos itself.

Safe travels, adventurers!

notes.title: May the Fourth Be With You
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/may-the-fourth-2024/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/264ec0f2b5fd8b2627e5d8c07f7f8b02e4efcc17.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]The Fourth Unleashed[/h2]
To celebrate May the Fourth we will be introducing a whole galaxy far far away’s worth of items to Adventure Quest 3D. From Star Sabers to Armor sets to Housing items, we’ve got a whole lot of sci-fi goodness waiting for you in this week’s release.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/may-the-fourth-2024/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8d24143100127f6c5089fb5a01cb841204333dea.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Out of this World Armors[/h2]
From the far corners of the galaxy come three new armor sets: the adventurous Galactic Outrider, the mysterious Xith, and the black and red-clad Dark Xith. Forge your destiny among the stars as you become a legend of Lore… or a harbinger of dark-side destruction!   

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/may-the-fourth-2024/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8612181336b2632490237c44073c16ee22bdf59c.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]New Star Sabers[/h2]
Four new Star Sabers are now available! Your non-copyright-infringing Star Sabers come in three flavors: Electric Yellow, Red, and Blue. As an added insanity bonus, someone thought it was a good idea to make triple-spinning Spinning Sabers so that a whirlwind of chaos accompanies you to every adventure far far away…    

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/may-the-fourth-2024/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/682fdc72752fa0289fe5559199e98d7d9288862c.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]To the Captain’s Quarters[/h2]
Live amongst the stars with the new House that is heavily inspired by Mech Quest the Captain’s Quarters House and accompanying house items is all you’ll need to create the starship house of your wildest dreams.
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/may-the-fourth-2024/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ccadd2125a191b9818ee91049785192f3355585e.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Face Commander Mogrevious[/h2]
Commander Mogrevious has arrived in Battleon’s Social District! Group up with fellow champions of Lore and do battle with this mechanical menace to earn awesome loot.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/may-the-fourth-2024/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7bc9e6d49d8884d1c9d783b86f6372281cbbe47a.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Gold Star Sword + Doom Star Katana[/h2]
Don't forget to check out the Daily Treasure Chests. The Gold Star Sword and Doom Star Katana have returned to the Daily Treasure Chests – but they’ll only be available until June 5th! 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/may-the-fourth-2024/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/329326f05f20ee73c76bb3920ba9730d68bb12f0.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]New Art at Burger Hero[/h2]
If you’re craving an amazing burger AND amazing art, look no further than Burger Hero! We have on display the winning Burger Hero posters, created by our fellow players Clockwerk, Horoboros, Reflet, Reinari, Revindel, and Sato Riku. If you see these artists in-game, be sure to ask for an autograph – signed in ketchup, of course :3

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/may-the-fourth-2024/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/68e6afbf9c5656cf2cd709a00acebd95719c1730.png[/img][/url]
[h2]New Promo Items: The Songs of Pastels[/h2]
Starting this week the Song of Pastels aura will be available! To get this ethereal aura, just purchase any package in the upgrade shop, now with 50% extra Dragon Crystals on select packages. For those that get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the Fluttering Song of Pastels, a butterfly-themed variant at no extra cost.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/may-the-fourth-2024/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/421f0487e46b596868da094cb116be03c6db4445.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Coming Soon: Screenshot Saturday[/h2]
Saturday is officially May the Fourth – so we are celebrating with a Screenshot Saturday contest, intergalactic style! Stay tuned to the Design Notes and Twitter for the contest rules.

Also! Don’t forget about our Screengrab Saturday contest going on right now. Enter short video clips for a chance to be featured on the new AQ3D website! Full contest rules here. Best of luck, everyone! 

Battle on,
Clarion, Yergen, Oishii, Blaze, Broomtool, Beleen, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: The Wandering Light
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/the-wandering-light/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a7fde4d111e3f9acd34e34666c5fe3a100728975.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Follow the Light[/h2]
Recently arrived in the town of Battleon, Lady Phimion seeks out members affiliated with the Cult of Mortis, a secretive group of death magic practitioners who adhere to the teachings of an enigmatic necromancer whose name is still unknown to even the most experienced undead slayers. Known to those she encounters as ‘The Wandering Light,’ Lady Phimion has taken it upon herself to eradicate this group before they unleash a tide of darkness upon Lore. Join her in cleansing the depths of the Battleon Cemetery before Battleon becomes ground zero of a zombie apocalypse!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/the-wandering-light/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/db4ac7dd10e028c63832d114583abf3d3ce0be6b.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Armor of the Wandering Light
[/h2]For your unwavering dedication and valor in putting an end to this relentless potential undead scourge, a remarkable reward awaits you... the Armor of the Wandering Light. This illustrious armor, steeped in ancient tradition, is not merely a physical protection but also a symbol of your triumph over darkness. To acquire it, you must collect the Motes of Wandering Light for the venerable Lady Phimion, who guards the secrets of its creation. Each mote you offer represents a fragment of your courage and resilience, and as you gather them, the armor’s luminescent glow intensifies, resonating with the very essence of your heroic deeds.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/the-wandering-light/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ca990da1f459024a4230886043b149694780a797.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Spear of Piercing Light[/h2]
However, there’s more to the tale. Beyond the initial revelation, it becomes apparent that the blessed spear wielded by Lady Phimion holds a significance that extends beyond mere legend. This formidable weapon, known as Spear of Piercing Light is not only a symbol of her unwavering devotion but also a beacon of hope for those who stand against the encroaching darkness. Its holy glow, fueled by the very essence of the Motes of Wandering Light, grants it unparalleled power. A shining force capable of piercing through the veil of malevolence that shrouds the Cult of Mortis. As Lady Phimion embarks on her quest to thwart their sinister plans, she clings to the spear’s hallowed grip, knowing that its divine purpose is intertwined with the fate of Lore itself.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/the-wandering-light/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ec251c6908d7a172c5abefab9b837e1e7f80a2b5.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Increasing Housing Slots[/h2]
Commencing today, adventurers have the opportunity to broaden their housing horizons by securing additional slots for 2,000 Dragon Crystals apiece. These coveted slots offer abundant space for customizing your diverse array of properties throughout the world of Lore. Whether you envision a rustic cabin nestled in the forest, or dare to dream of your personal space base perched upon the moon, these new slots unleash boundless possibilities for players to set their creativity free. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/the-wandering-light/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/248bb7daa7184b1fb1028a46d900c588b1634e18.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Last chance to get the Azure Cloak of the Motionless Falls[/h2]
This is the last week the Azure Cloak of the Falls will be available! To get this amazing item, just purchase any package in the upgrade shop, now with 50% extra Dragon Crystals on select packages. For those that get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the Azure Cloak of the Roaring Falls, an animated variant that is only for Guardians. Leaves next week – so now’s your last chance to claim this Cloak!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/the-wandering-light/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bee1683c93582a3f933fff6a1eaa3e29d765570d.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Coming Soon: “Screengrab Saturday”[/h2]
We are currently building a brand-new AQ3D homepage, and we are looking to showcase some of our amazing players front and center! Starting this Saturday, you’ll be able to share your most epic moments in Lore for a chance to win prizes and possibly be featured on the new website for the world to see. Contest details coming Friday! 

Battle on!

Clarion, Yergen, Oishii, Blaze, Broomtool, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: A Plea From the Woods
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/earth-day-2024/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c32eb4e4e872d66dabbd5cb02b8126ab41f985b6.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Answer the Voice of the Forest![/h2]
In the depths of Heartwood Forest lies a grotto that is home to an enchanted, wise old tree known as the Voice of the Forest, an ancient tree that serves Lore herself. Unfortunately, not all is well. A corrupting force strikes at the very ground we stand on, sending tremors throughout Lore’s soil causing great pain to all who are connected deeply with her… The Voice of the Forest calls out for your help, Hero of Lore! Will you heed its call?

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/earth-day-2024/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0aeb8f553ea2c11a794de4c42f4c2488147ac0cd.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Earth Day 2024 Rewards[/h2]
Once you complete the new storyline for Earth Day your efforts will be rewarded with nature-themed gear. Appropriate for the celebration of Earth Day! You’ll be able to pick from the Twisted Vine Staff, The Twisted Vine Blade, The Twisted Vine Helm, and the Globe of Lore housing item. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/earth-day-2024/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/95ce9c4910dbe1427f80339f7dbd0f5582416c73.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Lore’s Protector[/h2]
On top of the rewards earnable for completing the Earth Day 2024 questline, we will also be introducing a new Dragon Crystal weapon to the Earth Day Items shop. Introducing the massive hammer known as Lore’s Protector.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/earth-day-2024/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d72fc8fb520e22784df604514b68016c10fe1a72.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Epic New Music by Jongaar[/h2]
Heartwood has 3 new soundtracks! Click the Listen button at the top of the page, or head on over to Jongaar’s Twitter to hear magical music befitting that fantasy forest. Of course you could always play through Heartwood to hear it firsthand! 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/earth-day-2024/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/615923c6970e5f5bd16648c3bc1079b7dae75dee.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Get the Azure Cloak of the Motionless Falls[/h2]
The Azure Cloak of the Motionless Falls is now available for a limited time only. To get this amazing item, you need to purchase any package in the upgrade shop, now with 50% extra Dragon Crystals on select packages. For those that get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the Azure Cloak of the Roaring Falls, an animated variant that is only for Guardians!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/earth-day-2024/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/615923c6970e5f5bd16648c3bc1079b7dae75dee.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Last Chance! [/h2]
Here’s everything leaving next week:
Gimic, Grenwog, Solar Eclipse armor set, and Chicken Cow invasion in the Social District. Get your glorious gear and battle that hybrid moooo-nstrosity before it’s too late.

Battle on!

Clarion, Yergen, Oishii, Blaze, Broomtool, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

PS: We had over 200 amazing entries in our Sandbox Screenshot contest! Stay tuned to the Design Notes — we’ll be announcing the winners tomorrow. Prepare to be AMAZED!! Eeeeep! *audible Beleen squeals*

notes.title: Build a Burger Workshop
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/Burger-Hero-House-Grenwog-8-Bit/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8651237d808ecc72245733e635717e84976ad462.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Build a Burger Workshop[/h2]

Transform your home into a cheeseburger paradise with Burger Hero Home Franchise! Then dive into pixelated adventures with 8-Bit Travel Forms. Join us for eggstra special Grenwog shenanigans and check out our newest April promo item!
New Housing Items Are on the Menu!
Ladies and gentlemen, gather around! 

Are you starving? Craving that irresistible aroma of sizzling grease and the tantalizing taste of questionable-quality meat? Ah, the culinary thrill of standing in line, your stomach growling, while your inner voice screams, “Maybe I should eat literally anywhere else!” But who needs quality when you can have grease-soaked glory?

Introducing the [b]Burger Hero Home Franchise Experience[/b]! 

Picture this: You’re lounging on your couch, remote in hand, and suddenly, like a beacon of caloric hope, [b]Burger Hero[/b] materializes in your living room. No more tedious walks to the local joint - Nah, that’s for amateurs! We’re flipping the script. You’re the boss now!

Why settle for mundane home decor when you can transform your abode into a burger paradise? With our exclusive Burger Hero housing items, you’ll be the envy of your neighbors. Imagine the conversations:

Neighbor: “Hey, did you redecorate?” 

You: “Oh, just turned my kitchen into a mini Burger Hero. No biggie.”

Benefits of the Burger Hero Home Franchise:

[b]Zero Commute:[/b] Forget the whole transforming into a frogzard and running as fast as you to get to work. Your living room is your office now. Just slide into your slippers and start flipping those pixel patties.

[b]Customize Your Menu:[/b] Want a triple-decker bacon Hero Burger for breakfast? Go ahead! It’s your franchise. We won’t judge.

[b]VIP Seating:[/b] The best seat in the house? That’s your couch, my friend. No reservations needed.

[b]Employee of the Month:[/b] Spoiler alert—it’s you. Every month. Because who’s gonna outperform you in your own home?

[b]Burger Hero Swag:[/b] Rock that apron with pride. Bonus points if you wear it while binge-watching cooking shows.

Act now! Be the pioneer of the [b]Burger Hero[/b] revolution. [b]Your home, your rules.[/b] And remember, folks, [b]“When life gives you housing items, make burgers!” [/b]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/Burger-Hero-House-Grenwog-8-Bit/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/827ff959f308e3cbd1199eee4db39fbc07594800.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]8-Bit Travel Forms[/h2]
Look, I’m gonna level you with here…

You know those snazzy polygons that dance across your screen? Yeah, they’re cool and all, but let me tell you what’s even cooler: [b]PIXELS[/b]! Those tiny, square wonders that weave the very fabric of our digital existence. They’re like the building blocks of this [b]3D Adventure Quest world[/b].

And guess what? These magical pixels aren’t just for show. They’re the secret sauce behind our brand-new Travel Forms! 

“So how do I obtain these new travel forms?” I hear you asking. Head over [b]8-Bit Clarion Dawnforger in Battleon[/b], and prepare to be amazed. He’s got a collection of these pixelated wonders, and you’ve got options:

Grab the whole set at a sweet [b]discount[/b]. It’s like getting a pixelated buffet for your character. Or if you prefer there’s always the [b]à la carte [/b]option.

So if you ever wanted to be an [b]8-Bit Alma[/b] running at an above-average speed now’s your chance!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/Burger-Hero-House-Grenwog-8-Bit/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/722a7522b1bdb962b643e38bc7fe3b1871125ee2.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]8-Bit Housing[/h2]
On top of the travel forms, we will also be introducing housing assets from 8-Bit Battleon! So yes, dust off those gamepads and blow into that cartridge because it’s time to reject modernity and embrace tradition! Embrace the NEStalgia and get your 8-bit building materials by talking to [b]8-Bit Clarion Dawnforger in Battleon![/b]


[h2]Grenwog Strikes Back[/h2]
[b]Hooper[/b] claims the [b]Grenwog [/b]has returned. You’re not a [b]Grenwog [/b]denier, are you? Just outside Battleon, you’ll find Hooper hot on the trail of proving the [b]Grenwog [/b]exists! But be warned, hero. The [b]Grenwog[/b] (that is totally real) will be ready for a fight! Drop down into the deepest depths of the [b]Grenwog’s Lair[/b]. Band together with fellow heroes, set traps, and battle the [b]Grenwog [/b]to collect [b]Chocolate Grenwog Eggs[/b] to turn in for cool rewards. However, there are alternative ways to obtain those delicious eggs! They have a small chance to drop globally while the event runs.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/Burger-Hero-House-Grenwog-8-Bit/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/37fe104eb5c9a9aa83a443db24d327e947c522ab.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Grenwog Treasures[/h2]
Two new weapons are being added to [b]Hooper’s Grenwog Nest Shop[/b] the [b]Eggsecutioner Axe[/b] and [b]Eggsassin Daggers[/b]. These new tools of destruction match great with the [b]Bunny Berserker[/b] set which is also available in the shop.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/Burger-Hero-House-Grenwog-8-Bit/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6a8e4d9b8f1fa0af6c3f2bf8ba9e91c1aa5e68e8.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Eggcelent Friends and Foes[/h2]
On top of NPCs like [b]Piddle the Fool[/b] and the [b]Dricken Acolyte[/b] returning to Battleon, the Social District will be the stage of the Chicken Cow Invasion. But more exciting than all of that is the arrival of [b]Egglin [/b]in [b]Battleon[/b]. Help [b]Egglin [/b]find his brother [b]Roggbert [/b]in [b]Arcangrove[/b] to earn [b]Scrambled Eggs[/b] that you can redeem for [b]EGGCELENT rewards[/b].

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/Burger-Hero-House-Grenwog-8-Bit/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/22cd0e05d50f3c4a338b1a947b902e44a3178c92.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Get the Azure Cloak of the Motionless Falls[/h2]

notes.title: Wiggly Whompa & House Bug Bashing
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7383b7f687049a1cb833718dd2b25a397bdca2bd.png[/img]

[h2]Great Greetings and Sweet Salutations! 
[/h2]
Welcome to the whimsical world of AQ3D, where weekly wonders await as we craft creative content for warriors worldwide. In this week’s whirlwind, we whipped up our new April Fool’s event, bashed a bunch of bugs, and gave a glimmering Gold Boost to every player! 

While we wished to give Grenwog goodies + returning April Fools loot this week, our hands were overflowing with tantalizing tasks – and melting chocolate. Fear not my friends, for sweet surprises are simmering and shall soon be summoned during next week’s release! 

Now is the moment to marvel at the magnificence happening here, heroes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/14358df1d29d247b418417343a570fcf5e2fc4ed.jpg[/img]

[h2]Wiggly Whompa’s Whimsical Writing [/h2]
Calling all gallant gamers and valiant voyagers! Prepare to be enchanted by the whimsical words of Wiggly Whompa. Delivered directly by the dashing dapper chocolatier himself, dive into the daring delights of his decadent [url=https://aq3d.com/news/wiggly-whompa-whimsical-wonderland/]Design Notes right here[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/36f94197f5364e371e06d8cba979911b3cda17ac.jpg[/img]

[h2]Whompadoodle Caboodle [/h2]
At Wiggly Whompa’s Chocolate Experience, you will be taken on a ride of whimsy and wonder. Complete the quests given by Wiggly and his Whompadoodles and you will be rewarded with Whompa Jelly Beans! Trade in these beans at the “gift shop” (the Whompadoodle behind the desk at the front) and you can get your very own set of Whompadoodle attire! The mysterious chocolate maker The Unknown also has some drops for those daring enough to defeat him. 

Did I mention the [b]Wiggly Whompa Housing Collection[/b]! Get your hands on all sorts of props and a new map for building the house of your dreams! Speak to the green-haired Whompadoodle who will happily take your jelly beans in exchange for desirable Whompadoodle attire! And it’s a good thing there’s enough jellies going around, unlike the super sad jelly bean shortage of Glasgow, circa 2024.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8e191c68bb6572a4356d2cd69c71bfed916d09bc.jpg[/img]

[h2]Sweet Gold Boost [/h2]
Wiggly Whompa knows this is your “golden ticket” to glory! Enjoy 2x Gold rewards until next week’s release. Plus, Gold Boost tokens can be bought from the Potion Shop in the menu for an additional 50% Gold boost. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/18689c89cfb32189c1683e438d1caeb4fd0333b8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Major Housing Fixes[/h2]
Last week we released the brand-new and highly-anticipated feature, [url=https://aq3d.com/news/new-feature-player-housing/]Player Housing[/url]! Players are LOVING it and are building absolutely amazing things that are legit blowing our minds. Unfortunately, the awesomeness of housing was legit crashing mobile devices, so Broomtool, Blaze, and the AQ3D team have been rolling out fixes in order to make housing bug-free on Android and Apple. We also just released a major update in this week’s release that should dramatically improve housing performance on mobile. We sincerely apologize for the crashes housing caused, but we are thankful for your patience, understanding, and support as we navigate this brand-new game-changing adventure together! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/095784bf7839c918271128437c34f820d2620594.jpg[/img]

[h2]Lucky Day going away[/h2]
This is the last week to get Lucky Day loot! The time is nigh to tackle the test of the Clover Crusaders, for they'll soon vanish from our verdant vistas. Venture forth, collect Clover Leaves, and confront Lucky Day legends for a chance to pluck the prized Crown of the Clover Conqueror and Prosperity's Plunder – with a seriously sensational 7.77% success rate! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6e964bf76cb9c664832eaeb3813e97cbf00d1d69.jpg[/img]

[h2]Last chance to score these wings![/h2]
The [b]Wings of the Astral Veil[/b] are only available for a limited time – and that [b]time is running out![/b] To get these amazing wings, all you need to do is [b]purchase any package[/b] in the upgrade shop, now with [b]50% extra Dragon Crystals[/b] on select packages. For those that get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the [b]Spectral Wings of the Astral Veil[/b], a ghostly variant that is for [b]Guardians only[/b].

🚨 Come release next week, these wings will no longer be available, so now is your [b]final chance to get the Wings of the Astral Veil[/b]! Purchase any package in the upgrade shop to claim your Wings 🚨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/55723449cd4505914e203ed8c9cceba231cc9a69.jpg[/img]

So many entries… and so little [i]thyme[/i] 😆 The [url=https://aq3d.com/news/design-burger-hero-poster-contest/]Burger Hero Poster Contest[/url] is underway and we’ve received so many sizzling submissions so far – but this contest ends super soon! Submit your awesome art [b]no later than 11:59pm EDT[/b] on [b]Monday, April 1, 2024[/b] on the Burger Hero Contest Google Form.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/cff4a8f9ff04b187da9239123118f68c92d945aa.jpg[/img]

[h2]Sandbox Screenshot Contest[/h2]
There have been [url=https://aq3d.com/news/creative-contest-craze/]no shortage of contests[/url] this month! Might be the most amount of contests in Artix history 😅 We are celebrating the release of our newest feature by welcoming all players to showcase their creativity by designing houses, creating items, and building parkour courses. [url=https://aq3d.com/news/screenshot-saturday-sandbox-contest/]Full contest rules can be found here[/url], and please note that we’ve extended the deadline an additional week to allow our beloved players extra time to build their masterpieces! You are all soooo talented, and we are blown away by all the submissions we are seeing so far. Keep up the amazing work, heroes!

[b]Battle on,[/b]
Blaze, Clarion, Yergen, fisn, Broomtool, probably Beleen, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: A Place to Call Home
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/new-feature-player-housing/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c9f809d18b88d217cda9997d8d693263d9f3f094.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]It’s Time to B.U.I.L.D.![/h2]
Exciting news! Housing is making its grand entrance into [url=https://aq3d.com/]Adventure Quest 3D[/url] this week! Make your way to the [b]Battleon Trade District[/b] and have a chat with the [b]B.U.I.L.D.[/b] Foreman, [b]Brigitte[/b]. She’ll set you on an introductory quest that culminates in you acquiring your very own house! What does this mean for you? Well, as the valiant hero of Lore, you now have a cozy abode to call your own. But wait, there’s more! As a player, this feature grants you the power to customize a delightful slice of Lore. So go forth, decorate, and make your mark on the world!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/new-feature-player-housing/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/df973536951cdbbe91b0dc87de2cc6cfe87a0556.jpg[/img]
[/url][h2]How does it work?[/h2]
Once you’ve unlocked your first house, accessing it is a breeze. Simply locate the new housing button in the menu. From there, click on the inviting door icon, and presto! You’ll step into your very own abode. Now that you’re inside your house, it’s time to personalize it with housing items you’ve collected. Don’t fret—you’ll start with a few essential items. Not only can you place these items, but you can also rotate them, adjust their size, and rearrange them to your heart’s content. Here’s the exciting part: objects within your house have collision, which means you can create mini parkour areas or arrange furniture strategically. But how do you acquire new items? I’m glad you asked! Head over to the [b]B.U.I.L.D. Depot[/b] in the [b]Battleon Trade District[/b]. There, you can purchase housing items using gold from the Basic House Items shop or trade in [b]Wood Planks[/b] and [b]Building Bricks[/b] at the [b]B.U.I.L.D. House Items[/b] shop. And that’s not all! Niall has a Special Furniture Collections button, featuring [b]Legion-themed[/b] house items. Some of these treasures require gold, while others demand Dragon Crystals. Now, let’s talk about collections. Instead of buying an entire collection as individual items, you can use the new “Purchase Now” button. Why is this beneficial? Imagine you want multiple copies of a chair from a collection. If you own the collection, you can snag as many chairs as you’d like without any extra cost. So unleash your creativity—build that tower of chairs and tables. That's just the beginning, however. As time goes on we will expand on features and ways to obtain new housing items via quests and drops... In fact, for those who have completed a wing in the Battleon Museum, you'll be able to talk to Danicka Rose to collect a banner for each wing you've filled up with moments!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/new-feature-player-housing/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1f300f8d5ab3c852a855940d8f116f94300034a7.png[/img]
[/url][h2]Museum Update[/h2]
We’ve taken note of the valuable feedback regarding the Battleon Museum. As a result, we’ve adjusted the number of moments needed to create displays across most zones in this initial wave. Additionally, thanks to bug reports from players, we’ve addressed issues where certain monsters were not dropping moments. [b]Your feedback is greatly appreciated![/b]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/new-feature-player-housing/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/438352cebec0aa34a0ac5a16fbc266bd82de34be.jpg[/img]
[/url][h2]The Return of the Clover Crusaders[/h2]
The [b]Clover Crusaders[/b] have returned to Lore and are seeking to test their mettle against only the strongest heroes Lore has to offer! You’ll find these emerald-clad knights wandering various zones throughout the game world. Just like last time they drop [b]Clover Leaves[/b] which you can trade in at the Battleon Social District for Lucky Day rewards. While you’re there, why not do battle against returning Lucky Day bosses including [b]King Sneed the Clover Conqueror[/b] who has a chance to drop a special green variant of the cardboard crown called the [b]Crown of the Clover Conqueror[/b]. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/new-feature-player-housing/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1dc50701c99343eeb09852b79a530591c6059263.jpg[/img]
[/url][h2]Prosperity’s Plunder[/h2]
Are you feeling lucky? Try your chances at obtaining this drop off the Clover Crusaders! We don’t normally share drop rates but this is a special occasion. It’s… [b]7.77%[/b]. Happy hunting!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/new-feature-player-housing/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2709859cd883f2bebb779b7fbaba634cf6fccc3f.png[/img]
[/url][h2]Lost in the Mail[/h2]
Earlier this week we sent mail out to players containing a promo item. However, there was an issue where some people didn't receive the mail... we think this might have to do with mail privacy issues. Now, we don't want anyone missing out on this promo item – so we placed the item in a promo shop in the Shops menu. This item is limited time and will be available from now until September 4th.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/new-feature-player-housing/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/27b7d944be02c2276ef9e746d95361288dc3af05.png[/img]
[/url][h2]Get Legion Wings for a limited time[/h2]
The [b]Wings of the Astral Veil[/b] are now available for a limited time only. To get these amazing items, you need to purchase any package in the upgrade shop, now with [b]50% extra Dragon Crystals[/b] on select packages. For those that get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the [b]Spectral Wings of the Astral Veil[/b], a ghostly variant that is only for Guardians!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/design-burger-hero-poster-contest/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4d1b9dcd7cb10922762bbab603111381afeaf5c4.jpg[/img]
[/url][h2]New Contest: Design a Poster for Burger Hero[/h2]
Calling all aspiring artists and seasoned fry cooks worldwide: we invite you to [b]design a poster for Burger Hero[/b]! We know it’s a dream come true for many a hero who wishes to have their art immortalized in digital fast food restaurants, and now is your chance! 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/design-burger-hero-poster-contest/]Read the juicy contest details here.
[/url]
Battle on!
Clarion, Yergen, Oishii, Blaze, Broomtool, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: That Belongs in a Museum!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battleon-museum-grand-opening/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/74bcdaebfb310ee9ccf26878729c7ef4d4a910f5.png[/img]
[/url]That’s right! The long-awaited Battleon Museum is opening up to everyone in this week's historic release of [url=https://aq3d.com/]Adventure Quest 3D[/url]. Head on over to the Scholar District of Battleon and lend a hand to the chronomancer-turned-curator Danicka Rose by helping her fill out the museum’s displays with creatures big and small that you’ve encountered on your many adventures through Lore.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battleon-museum-grand-opening/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d7601a80dc7d74c4f5c659796c7fff9170ef7d07.png[/img]
[/url][h2]Danicka Needs Your Help[/h2]
While Danicka has grand ambitions to fill the museum with anything and everything of notability that Lore has to offer, she currently has… nothing. That’s where you come in! Talk to Danicka in the museum lobby to begin an introduction quest line that will get you started and have you collecting “Moments” which will be required to create your very first display.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battleon-museum-grand-opening/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1f300f8d5ab3c852a855940d8f116f94300034a7.png[/img]
[/url][h2]What’s a Moment?[/h2]
You might be asking, “What’s a Moment?” Well, I’m so glad you asked. [b]Moments are a new type of item[/b] being added to [url=https://aq3d.com/]Adventure Quest 3D[/url] this week. They drop off enemies that you’re able to make museum displays of. What’s unique about Moment in comparison to previous item types currently in the game is that [b]Moments are automatically looted and added[/b] to the token section of your inventory [b]and don’t take up any bag space[/b]. Once you’ve collected enough Moments, don’t forget to head back to the Museum to create a display! (And earn a nice chunk of XP… and maybe a title for completing an exhibit!)

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battleon-museum-grand-opening/][h2]A New Layer of Gameplay[/h2]
[/url]The Museum is intended as [b]our take[/b] on a bestiary or [b]monster log[/b] and as such will be updated over time to cover monsters across the whole game world. With that in mind, it’s important to state you probably shouldn’t expect to knock this out in a weekend! The museum is meant to be played at your own pace and is more of a complementary layer over existing gameplay.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battleon-museum-grand-opening/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e60cd7002aed86aedacc2774ec76ec7581493ea6.png[/img]
[/url][h2]The Mythical Blue Cloak[/h2]
Are you in search of a new fashion piece? The pinnacle of your rare item collection? Just want a cool-looking [b]blue[strike] cape [/strike]CLOAK[/b]? Well, if that’s the case head on over to Battleon, and standing just outside Yulgar’s Inn you’ll find [b]Clarion Dawnforger[/b], speak to him and craft your very own best-in-slot cosmetic back item today! (At just the low cost of [b]5 Blue Capes[/b], what a steal!)

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battleon-museum-grand-opening/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4beda6582affed024eb7251ab0588bebad0a772b.jpg[/img]
[/url][h2]Tune in to the Adventure Quest 3D Dev Stream[/h2]
Ready yourselves, fellow heroes of Lore! For the last few weeks, I’ve been streaming on the Artix Entertainment Twitch Channel. Can you imagine it? Me and my trusty feline sidekicks adventuring and even sometimes questing across the third dimension every weekday at 6 PM EDT. Whether you are a veteran guardian of Lore or a plucky young squire just learning how to whirlwind pull up a seat and join in on the adventure!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/dagecollection2024//][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7ae8a5196eed0232ffb572f23c4d5a0541e0f5c9.png[/img][/url]
[h2]The 2024 Dage Collection[/h2]
Last week we released the [b]2024 Dage Collection[/b] featuring a personal favorite design of mine, the [b]Legion Necromancer.[/b] That collection is still available for purchase so if you like Dage’s Legion swing on by to Battleon and talk to the Legion Necromancer to have a look at the collection!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battleon-museum-grand-opening/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/27b7d944be02c2276ef9e746d95361288dc3af05.png[/img]
[/url][h2]Get Legion Wings for a limited time[/h2]
The [b]Wings of the Astral Veil[/b] are now available for a limited time only. To get these amazing items, you need to purchase any package in the upgrade shop, now with [b]50% extra Dragon Crystals[/b] on select packages. For those that get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the [b]Spectral Wings of the Astral Veil[/b], a ghostly variant that is only for Guardians!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/screenshot-saturday-dark-lord-dage///][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8ddcf4270d0964930c26e54670941936c38cbafc.png[/img]
[/url][h2]Snap Sinister Screenshots[/h2]
Calling all Undead Legion minions: join us in celebrating Dage the Evil's birthday in our latest Screenshot Contest. Venture into the spookiest realms of Lore, capture the essence of the Dark Lord, and have a chance to win a prize... and maybe a [b]shoutout from Dage himself![/b] The contest ends this Sunday night. Read the full contest details here!

[b]Battle on! [/b]
Clarion, Yergen, Oishii, Blaze, Broomtool, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

P.S.  HeroMart has a poster of Dage on his Throne available now. Skillfully crafted by Diozz, and ready to dominate your wall >:D
