[b]A horrifying new fight for those who have unlocked the Arena of Souls[/b]
Calling all heroes! A Legion Dragon has been resurrected by a vile necromancer. We need your help to defeat him and his minions. Be careful though, the necromancer has recruited himself a group of samurai warriors to aid him! Once the challenge is cleared, you will be rewarded with great loot, including new [b]Legion items[/b] and a title! You can access the challenge by talking to the book next to the door to the Arena of Souls. You will need to be level 45 and have completed the Underworld story to access the fight.

[h2]Challenge Rewards[/h2]
[list]
[*] Soulbane Ninkata
[*] Soulbane Oni Mask Snarling Death
[*] Soulbane Oni Mask Shadows
[*] And a new Title! “Soulbane Samurai” 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/897c30c4891451493cb3f23677ee74f7a937d3af.png[/img]

[h2]Legion Summoning (Gifting)[/h2]
Finally, it is back! Buy a [b]Summoning Rune[/b] from the Underworld Summoner... and use it to summon a Legionary for you and all of your friends to battle. For those who want to host their own events in game, we also have [b]Greater Legion Summoning Runes[/b]. The Greater Legion Summoning Rune will spawn a Greater Legionary which can summon up to 6 lesser legionaries. Sometimes the summoned lesser legionaries will be upgraded to a [b]Rogue Legionnaire[/b], which has [b]double drop rates[/b] and a chance to get a [b]live event coin! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d3133105a94af2357e773e522997cfbbc9a8cc71.png[/img]

[h2]Legion Gifting Rewards[/h2]
These summoned monsters always drop a special currency known as [b]Legion Soul Remnants[/b]. These can be used to get items from the shop on the bridge in town. Summoned monsters also have a chance to drop one of 15 items including weapons, armor, and exclusive travel forms.

[b]New and returning* Legion Gifting Rewards[/b]
[list]
[*] Legion Dricken
[*] Legion Dricken with daggers
[*] Legion Death Shiver Scythe
[*] Crown of the Forgotten Monarch
[*] Cape of the Forgotten Monarch*
[*] Visage of the Forgotten Monarch*
[*] Ruined Blade of the Forgotten Monarch*
[*] Brute Helm of the Legion*
[*] Brutal Mace of Breaking*
[*] Death Mask of the Legion*
[*] Death Spike of the Legion*
[*] Spiked Crown of the Legion Magi*
[*] Skull Staff of the Legion Magi*
[*] Legion Runed Blade
[*] Legion Skull Scepter
[*] Legion Stabbers
[*] Legion Rogue Dagger
[*] Legion Rogue Dark Dagger
[*] Legion Rogue Hood
[*] Legion Rogue Hood With Skull
[*] Legion Rouge Shoulder
[*] Legion Rogue Cape
[*] Legion Rogue Armor
[*] Legion Rogue Gloves
[*] Legion Rogue Belt
[*] Legion Rogue Boot
[*] Legion Deathcaller Dual Skull Pauldrons
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1f2bcc677ab80a3e10c99948c2965fec01b9165c.png[/img]

[h2]PvP Rewards[/h2]
New special legion PvP rewards are now available in the Battle Hall. The [b]Savage Great Sword of the Legion[/b] and the [b]Legion Star Katana[/b] can be found by talking to High Marshal Firebrand in the [b]Special PvP Rewards[/b] shop. Only the most prestigious of PvP-ers will be able to get these, running a high price of 10,000 Marks of Glory, and requiring Glory Rank 50.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/27b7d944be02c2276ef9e746d95361288dc3af05.png[/img]

[h2]Get Legion Wings for a limited time[/h2]
The [b]Wings of the Astral Veil[/b] are now available for a limited time only. To get these amazing items, you need to purchase any package in the upgrade shop, now with 50% extra Dragon Crystals on select packages. For those that get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the Spectral [b]Wings of the Astral Veil[/b], a ghostly variant that is only for Guardians!

For those of you that are already a Guardian, you will get both the Wings of the Astral Veil and the Spectral Wings of the Astral Veil upon purchasing any Dragon Crystal package in the upgrade shop. Check your inventory on your next login to see both blades in your inventory.
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/dagecollection2024/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/623d7da86f6f73b1d2ca115440d584d50aef55fb.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Let the March of the Legion begin! [/h2]
No matter if necromancy or ninja…mancy… is your calling, let us not forget the true significance of a birthday. For the birth of Dage the Dark Lord marked the beginning of a new era for the forces of darkness – and fantastic art design. Let this day be a reminder that even in the depths of darkness, there is always the promise of achieving greatness! 

Thank you and be careful in that new AdventureQuest 3D challenge fight.... You and your friends are in for the fight of your un-lives.

[b]Battle on!
The AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

notes.title: A Vampire Hunter Mystery!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d3055a6f4dfa0eab82da1d8f2db5978f5059c99d.png[/img]

[h2] Join us in-game and battle evil for honor, glory, and the ShadowSunder Blade.
[/h2]

Greetings, Hero! A new mission has emerged from the shadows, beckoning you to a tale of mystery and sorrow. In every main saga zone, a new NPC awaits with a shop filled with gear tailored to your level. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/44e1a33b4873f267c86461544ca61d636e8f073a.png[/img]
Additionally, we've supercharged the XP from questing in the early zones of the main story, and a week long  gold boost to boot! Let’s dive into the details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7dffaac79dd9e23e1c9bdcedcab766fbb7e88f7a.png[/img]

  [h2]A new Adventure/Quest: A Shadow of One's Self[/h2]

Embark on a poignant journey in "Shadow of One's Self." A woman’s lover has vanished into the night, leaving only silence and mystery in his wake. She needs your help to uncover the truth of his fate. Can you solve the mystery and bring her closure? During the Darkovia saga, seek out Altaria in Boog's Tavern to begin the quest. 

[b]You will be rewarded with...[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/459af10eb13841b30a2da969b7de339de823fe62.png[/img]
Shadowsunder, a blade that gleams with the promise of resolve and strength.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5680d4f385398e96dbbcd77e64da2cd0a17425e7.jpg[/img]

  [h2]This new adventure unlocks half way through the Darkovia Saga.[/h2]

You can play this new story adventure once you have completed the vampire & werewolf fueled Darkovia Saga. If you have not played through the Darkovia Saga yet, then prepare to step into the war between the Vampires and the Werewolves as both sides attempt to fulfill the prophecy of the Blood Moon. To begin or continue this level 18+ saga (That is level, not age.... although Safiria's dress really is something... the new quest is level 21. Which makes sense. It does start in a tavern after all.)  Open your adventure menu and go to Main Story and then Darkovia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3f3504c4f45a68b2652959cd6374e100ebd07220.png[/img]

  [h2]Get some gear… Justin Case[/h2]

Players with low level gear have been asking where to get better gear during the main story. Look no further than Justin Case. He is a NPC dedicated to making sure you’re well-equipped for the challenges ahead. Justin's shop offers level-appropriate gear to ease your journey through each of the main saga zones. He is located at the beginning of each of the main saga zones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e06ca6151d994c6205b12303e80a693e388c8281.jpg[/img]

  [h2]Main Story XP Increase[/h2]

We increased the XP for main story quests from Doomwood all the way to Ashfall, including dungeon side quests from Greenguard through Shadowskull Tower. These changes are designed to streamline your adventure, making it easier to progress through the main story uninterrupted.

  [h2]Lunar New Year is Leaving[/h2]

The Lunar New Year celebration is drawing to a close, and with it the Lunar New Year shop is now closed, but not to fret, hero!  The Dragon Guardian shop will transition to its new home in the Guardian Tower on Guardian Fortes. Make sure to secure your dragon-themed items before the Year of the Dragon festivities conclude!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bb7d4d695f13d71dae6ba3d2504edaf36826064e.jpg[/img]

  [h2]Dage Collection Coming Next Week![/h2]

Next week heralds the arrival of the Dage collection, complete with blue flames and skulls. The update will include gifting and a challenging level 45 boss fight. Prepare your gear and rally your allies; epic battles and legendary rewards await.

See you in game and…

  [b]Battle On![/b]

  [b]Your friendly neighborhood AQ3D team[/b]

notes.title: The Tailor Scouts Meet the Fashion Police!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tailorscoutsq2/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/35af913c3357eb77f0fd6bbe29b3145e2d12a890.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The Best in Fashion![/h2]
Join the Tailor Scouts on their mission to retrieve the coveted Mithril Shears. These shears are a magical item that will help Winnie make new, more powerful costumes, taking their style to the next level! However, an encounter with the Fashion Police pokes a hole in their plans and threatens an old friendship. Help the Tailor Scouts stop the Fashion Police and maybe even save an old friend in the process.

[b]Note[/b]: You must complete the first quest, “Tailor Scouts” in order to begin this quest, “The Mithril Shears”.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tailorscoutsq2/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7100/defeatfashionpolice.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Defeat the Fashion Police![/h2]
When you talk to [b]Winnie[/b] in Battleon about [i]The Mithril Shears[/i], she informs you that Tailor Scout Melanie is taking longer than expected to retrieve the coveted magical Mithril Shears from Arcangrove. The mission is simple, find Melanie and help her bring home the shears. However, the Fashion Police show up just in time to snag the Mithril Shears before you can. Help Melanie and the other Tailor Scouts track down the Fashion Police and get back those shears for Winnie! On the way, you just might save an old friend from becoming a fashion victim herself.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tailorscoutsq2/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7099/knowledgeispower-bg.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Knowledge is Power![/h2]
Earn these Tailor Academy Uniforms and Shoes as you play! Later, you can craft the Fashion Police outfit as well (and additional Tailor Academy Uniforms), from Winnie’s [b]Tailor Academy Uniforms shop[/b] when you complete the Mithril Shears quest.

[h2]AQ3D Soundtrack Update[/h2]
As of this release, all commercial music within AdventureQuest 3D (with the exception of some tracks provided by guest artists) has been removed from the game maps! Jongaar (with some help from Broomtool) has spent many months replacing the soundtracks in the main maps with his own custom music, and is continuing to work on replacing the music in the side story and event maps as well. This is a huge task and will take a long time to get every map filled with new soundtracks. However, this means that our content creators are now free to stream AQ3D with the sound on without fear of their stream being demonetised. So, if you happen to enter a map without a soundtrack playing in the background, that’s not a bug. New music is on the way!

[h2]Last Chance![/h2]
Carnaval has left the Social District until next year.
[list]
[*]Lunar New Year event ends near the end of February.
[*]Heroes Heart Day Collection and related content leaves around March 13th, 2024.
[/list]
[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
Next week is the last week of February, which means… Gold Boost! This will be quickly followed by the new March Promo Item, so head to the Upgrade Shop to grab your Crimson Moon Sword before it’s too late.

[b]See you in game and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

notes.title: Get Ready, Heartbreakers, for Heroes Heart Day!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/hhd24mail/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4b9d959a8ce459938fed20398ccf0dbc307621e1.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Happy Heroes Heart Day![/h2]
We’re showing our love and appreciation for the Heroes of Lore as we celebrate Heroes Heart Day! Enjoy a new Heroes Heart Day Collection and a related heartbreaking quest from Romeo Valentale. We’ve also implemented the new Mail system so you can send messages to your friends even when they are offline! Plus, level 45 challenges have appeared in the Battleon Foothills, and Lunar New Year celebrations continue with a Dravir pet added to Saber’s shop!

[h2]2024 Heroes Heart Day Collection[/h2]
Visit Maurice in Battleon to buy the items you want or purchase the Collector’s Chest to get all of the items and the title, “Heartbreaker”.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/hhd24mail/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7096/heroesheartdaycollection2024_2.jpg[/img][/url]
[list]
[*]Heroes Heart Day Collector’s Chest and “Heartbreaker” title
[*]Dragon Frog Travel Form (alternates between 4 color variations each time it’s used)
[*]Cerulean the Dragon Frog (pet)
[*]Fable the Dragon Frog (pet)
[*]Cinnabar the Dragon Frog (pet)
[*]Andromeda the Dragon Frog (pet)
[/list]
Click your Dragon Frog pet to make it dance!
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/hhd24mail/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7097/heroesheartdaycollection2024.jpg[/img][/url]
[list]
[*]Royal Heart armor set
[*]Royal Heart Daggers
[*]Royal Heart Sword
[*]Royal Heart Spear
[*]Enitenlav armor set
[*]Pistol of Eros
[*]Devoted Heart Staff
[*]Betrayal’s Blade
[*]Heart Beat Hammer
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/hhd24mail/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7095/thecuupidorganization.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Calling All Heroes![/h2]
There’s an emergency in Seleden! [b]Romeo Valentale[/b] needs you to meet his friend, [b]Enitenlav[/b], there in the forest who needs your help. Enitenlav created a matchmaking mishap between some of the creatures of Seleden Forest and needs your help sorting it out. If you do well, Romeo will reward you with a heartful reward: the Crystal Heart Sword!

[b]Note:[/b] The Heroes Heart Day shops and quests are seasonal (temporary) but come back every year.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/hhd24mail/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7094/yearofthedravir.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Lunar New Year Celebration Continues![/h2]
This [b]Blackened Heart Dravir pet[/b] is ready to leave its nest and explore the wold with you! Just in time for the Year of the Dragon celebration. Visit Saber’s Lunar New Year Shop to pick up your own dravir companion for a handful of Dragon Crystals; or, if you’re a Dragon Guardian, get one for Free from the Guardian Tormir.

Also, fear not! If you aren’t able to become a Dragon Guardian before the Lunar New Year shops close, the Dragonscale Guardian Equipment and Blackened Heart Dravir pet will remain available in the Guardian Tower until the next Lunar New Year.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/hhd24mail/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7093/mailtimev2.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]New Feature: Mail![/h2]
You can now send and receive mail in AdventureQuest 3D! Click the Mail button in the Menu to open your inbox and see the messages awaiting you. At the top of the Mail tab, you can also Compose (write) messages to send to your friends and Guild members by clicking the button that looks like a letter. Here you can type in the name of the Player you want to send a message to, even if they are offline, and type out your message just like an email.

That’s not all! The Dev Team can also use this Mail feature to send occasional rewards directly to your inbox!

However, If you don’t want to receive messages from other players, you can check the Mail Blocked setting in the Mail tab. In the future, we would like to update the Mail Settings to allow you to choose the types of people who can send you mail (only Friends, Guild Members, your Party, or All Players). For now, write your heart out!
 
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/hhd24mail/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7092/level45challengebooks.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Level 45 Challenge Books![/h2]
Return to the Battleon Foothills (the new intro area) when you reach level 45 to discover the appearance of three new Challenge Books. The challenges have special rewards, like pets, travel forms, and titles but require great skill and strategy to win! These Challenge Books only appear once you have reached level 45, so get going and level up!

[h3]Challenges[/h3]
[b]Book 1: Darkovian Alpha Werewolf Challenge[/b]
[b]Book 2: Voidrakar Raid[/b]
[b]Book 3: Green Dragon Foothills[/b]

[h2]Last Chance![/h2]
[list]
[*]Lunar New Year event ends near the end of February.
[*]Carnaval event leaves the Social District around February 21st.
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/hhd24mail/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7091/heroesheartday2024.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
The Tailor Scouts are coming back to help a friend in need! Will you be ready to answer the call of friendship?

[b]See you in game and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

notes.title: Celebrate the Lunar New Year!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunarny2024/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7a728f9215c68004812b6f2fb50e2f77b1c22141.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Happy Lunar New Year![/h2]
The Lunar New Year is a time where citizens all around Lore celebrate their good fortune and prosperity! Meet Saber in the Social District to get started on your Lunar New Year festivities! She has exciting quests and shops with delightful rewards based on the year’s (and past) animal representative, and 2024 is the year of the dragon!

[b]Note:[/b] The Lunar New Year shops and quests are seasonal (temporary) but come back every year.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunarny2024/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7087/yearofthedragon.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]It’s the Year of the Dragon![/h2]
Check out the new Dragon Scaled Guardian shop where a brilliant new golden dragon armor is exclusive to Dragon Guardians only! If you purchased the Dragon Guardian upgrade from Upgrade Shop, you can get the whole set from this shop for FREE! Just talk to Guardian Tormir in Battleon or Saber in the Social District.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunarny2024/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6494/darkoviaforestfullmoon.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Moonlight Shop[/b]
Saber will trade you special items for delicious Moonlight Biscuits from Darkovia. Moonlight Biscuits drop from monsters all around Darkovia this February, including the dungeons.

[b]Lucky Envelope Daily[/b]
Turn in 5 Moonlight Biscuits for a Lucky Envelope and some Firecrackers! This is based on the real life tradition of giving red envelopes during the Lunar New Year celebrations which symbolize good wishes and luck for the future. Red envelopes usually contain money, so these Lucky Envelopes can be sold for 5000 gold.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunarny2024/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5385/carnaval_aq3d.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Carnaval![/h2]
Carnaval starts in Rio on February 9th, so we’re taking the party to the Social District with the Carnaval Sneevils! These guys are barrels of fun and drop Carnaval Feathers to trade with the Adventuretainer for colorful gear! The party lasts for two weeks, so grab your friends and get ready to get down with the Adventuretainer.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunarny2024/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7086/battleonfoothills.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]New Intro is Live for All![/h2]
Thank you so much for joining our live playtest of the new intro zone, [b]Battleon Foothills[/b]. We have used your wonderful feedback to polish and smooth out the rough edges.

New players will enter the Foothills after leaving Death’s Lair. That’s right. Vane no longer tosses you across the lands of Lore. Instead, they will encounter the various NPCs who can continue to teach them the gameplay basics of AdventureQuest 3D before moving on to the city of Battleon. Hopefully this will result in less confused players once they begin the core story and begin to explore the game on their own.

You can still return to the Battleon Foothills through Heroes Bend (to the right of the Crossroads) after passing the Blue Flying Eyes, but just know that everyone’s quest progress for this area has been reset. Also, by popular demand, [i]Dragonwatch Keep[/i] will remain accessible, just detached from the tutorial and main storyline. You can find it easily in the Adventure Menu under Side Stories.

[h2]Last Chance![/h2]
[list]
[*]Lunar New Year event ends near the end of February.
[*]Carnaval event leaves the Social District around February 21st.
[/list]
[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
Next week Heroes Heart Day celebrations begin! Maurice will return to Battleon to show you his love and appreciation with a new Heroes Heart Day Collection.

[b]See you in game and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

notes.title: A New Start
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/newstart/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/db1a77e86c9c960daa78fd9bc1d96ae5d946134e.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Smoothing Out the Wrinkles![/h2]
Hello Hero!
It’s time that AdventureQuest 3D’s early game got a refresh. The game has changed a lot over the years, mostly in the newer maps and late game story lines; so, alongside the regular content releases, we’re steadily working on making the game’s progression feel more intentional and smooth.
And so, we must begin at the beginning. The tutorial.

We actually really like how the current tutorial in Death’s Lair feels, and our fancy data charts prove that most new players like this too. However, after that, it’s clear that players weren’t keen on the Void attack on Dragon Watch. So, we will be removing that map (after this live playtest) and use a new approach that is more reflective of the general gameplay and tone of the AQ3D.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/newstart/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7084/intromap.jpg[/img][/url]

Taking place right after leaving Death’s Lair, you will enter a brand new map to learn more of the gameplay basics. Encounter various NPCs who are more than happy to help a new hero learn how to build the skills they need to be successful before moving on to the city of Battleon.

So, get ready to view the game through a newb’s eyes and help us playtest the tutorial live!
Talk to Twilly in Battleon to join the new map and play through the same quest line that new players will experience as we teach you to switch classes, use travel forms, and more! Then please fill out the feedback survey from Twilly when you complete the questline so we can make adjustments for the final version.

[h2]New Drops![/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/newstart/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7082/fantasyarmors-notext.jpg[/img][/url]
The monsters in this new area have a chance to drop an assortment of new cosmetic items perfect for starting a new adventure.

[h2]Gold Boost![/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/newstart/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7083/goldboost.jpg[/img][/url]
[h3]Enjoy a week of 2x bonus gold on all monster kills and quests![/h3]

[h2]Last Chance![/h2]
[b]New Promo Item[/b] releases on Thursday, February 1st, 2024, so if you haven’t gotten the Frosty Torrent Rune Blade from the Upgrade Shop, now is the time!

[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
February 1st brings a new promo item to the Upgrade Shop, and next week we celebrate the Lunar New Year!

[b]See you in game and…[/b]

notes.title: Cloak Yourself in Cosmic Attire!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/cosmiccloak/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2e0419a6af0357729c76153508cd617f0a1fcf83.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Cloaked in Mystery[/h2]
Loremaster Hazel has made more progress in her research about the Cosmic Raiment! Journey to the highest heights of far away places as you follow Hazel’s cryptic clues.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/cosmiccloak/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7067/cosmiccloakfrontandback.jpg[/img][/url]

Once you have solved the clues and brought back evidence, Hazel will be able to piece together a pattern to craft the Cosmic Cloak. With a little more sleuthing you can gather additional materials to ‘awaken’ the Cloak into a more Epic and stylish piece.
 
[h2]What is the Cosmic Raiment?[/h2]
Loremaster Hazel has been researching a long-forgotten cosmic being that once roamed the lands of Lore. The writings she uncovered contain clues on how to unearth the remnants of this being, specifically the materials used to create its clothes and gear which Hazel calls the Cosmic Raiment. Additional special materials can be gathered to ‘awaken’ the pieces of the raiment to make them.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/cosmiccloak/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7065/cosmicraimentv2.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3]Cosmic Companion[/h3]
Hazel awakened this Cosmic Companion during her initial expedition and seems to have created a special bond with it. If you choose, it will tag along with you and communicate your research findings back to her.

The Cosmic Companion quest pet allows you to access the Cosmic Raiment quests and quick travel back to the Loremaster’s Lodge with just a click wherever you are! And your pet will always be updated with the release of each new piece.

[h2]
Last Chance![/h2]
[list]
[*]Frostval Collection, Gift’thulu, and related seasonal activities will leave around the end of January, 2024
[*]Gaz’s Last Chance Shop closes on January 31st, 2024.
[/list]
 
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/cosmiccloak/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7068/loremasterhazel.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
We’ve been working on the new player experience and we look forward to releasing a new introduction following Death's Lair next week.

[b]See you in game and…[/b]

notes.title: XP Boost & Special Guest NPC! FG3000
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c0ea1ed4d5140ca6bae2cf214a3a30698659533a.png[/img]

[h2][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JW3AeF6sCgw]FG3000[/url] is in town with a shop full of Cosmetic items you can get for gold.[/h2]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JW3AeF6sCgw]FG3000[/url] is a well-known, high-energy, and super-positive MMORPG reviewer... and today, he is officially a video game NPC in [url=https://www.aq3d.com]AdventureQuest 3D[/url]! Find him in town with a shop full of cosmetic items that you can get for gold. He also happens to know the location of a lost sword... his lost sword. Which can be yours with an ample about of monster-murder.  And to help any new players who need to level up in order to get this weapon, a server-wide XP Boost has been activated!

[h2]Story Time[/h2]

[b]How in the world did this happen.....?[/b]

FG3000 surprised the team and community by releasing a great video on our game called "[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JW3AeF6sCgw]24 HOURS of Adventure Quest 3D (Mobile/PC)[/url]". 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JW3AeF6sCgw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a3bf07af31be3903701a72f3c93038014045752e.jpg[/img][/url]

We were honored! ... And retaliated by making him into an NPC.

(Do not worry... we reached out and got permission first.)

[h2]FG3000 is in game now![/h2]

Find him standing near the bridge in AdventureQuest 3D's Town of Battleon with a shop full of cosmetics for all players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ef8366851538bf72ba089b9ff99745fe11993206.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hair Today, Gone Tomorrow![/h2]

Bonus! You can unlock FG3000's wickedly "dread"-ful (#seewhatididthere?) hair style using an item from his shop. Using the item will unlock the hair as an option in the barber shop.

[h2]The Sword of Swordness[/h2]

We hid a FG3000 sword on a monster somewhere in the world.... somewhere.... and if you can find the monster that drops it, it will be yours.

[h2]A win for the community[/h2]

This was an interesting thing to try-- and it might just bring some new friends to play with to AdventureQuest 3D. Before this release I talked to community YouTubers Gold Raven and Lag who enthusiastically agreed. Lag said, "A win for the game is a win for all content creators of the game, that's the way I see it."

[h2]XP BOOST[/h2]

Gain experience faster while the server-wide XP boost is active this week. From now until next Wednesday at 11:59pm EST you will get 200% experience. (Note: Boosts character XP only, not class.) It is the perfect time to level up in AdventureQuest 3D.

Thank you and...

[b]Battle on![/b]
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team


[b]P.S.[/b] Be sure to subscribe to [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JW3AeF6sCgw]FG3000's YouTube Channel[/url]

notes.title: The Legacy of Nulgath
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgathlegacy/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7010187c2027ff9fc0effed7f62d791ef316c59c.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New Quests and Rewards![/h2]
Continue to enjoy the Nulgath Finale with more side-quests, rewards, and improved gameplay experience. Talk to Oblivion in Battleon to dive back into the OverSoul! Nulgath-themed Quest Pets received some updates, many with new quests, so talk yours today to start earning new rewards!

The Chest Shop has also gained two new items this week, and Stryche is in the Scholar District with the latest calendar rewards!

[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgathlegacy/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7052/nationcompanions.jpg[/img][/url]

Side-Quests and Quest Pets[/h2]

[h3]Hire Quests (Servants of Nulgath quest pets)[/h3]
You can now ‘hire’ Servants of Nulgath to serve you directly! These quests aren’t designed to be the most difficult but they are still rewarding to complete! Each Servant is earnable through gameplay and comes with their own exclusive quests that will have you exploring all levels of the OverSoul. You hire these Servants from Malakai, where else, at the Throne of Nulgath.

[h3]Combat Style Quests[/h3]
The Oblivion Blade of Nulgath now offers an array of Combat Style quests. These quests let you choose a unique combination of weapons to dual wield and master, tailored to your own preferred combat style. You must own the weapons you want to wield and, remember, the reward is only a cosmetic representation of your mastery.

[h3]Nation Loyalty Quests[/h3]
Skew has off-loaded his “Nation Loyalty” quests to Oblivion. Continue or begin your journey toward becoming a loyal follower of Nulgath with these quests.

[h3]Juggernaut Items[/h3]
Juggernaut Items are the best that the Nulgath Nation currently has to offer, which means they are also the most sought after and difficult to obtain. Only the most dedicated follower of Nulgath should attempt to obtain them. But with great sacrifice comes great reward.

[h3]Hanzo Void[/h3]
3 new Reward Quests have been added to Hanzo Blademaster NPC, and some new quests and updates have been made to Hanzo Quest Pet. 
[b]Hint:[/b] Some of the new Hanzo weapon rewards are required for Combat Style quests, so take a look at the rewards before you start.

[h3]Oblivion’s Quest Pet Sale![/h3]
The Oblivion's Archfiend's Servants Artifacts shop is having a sale on Quest Pets. [b]Save 25%[/b] when you buy a quest pet from this shop until January 24th, 2024. Oblivion has also added two new Travel Forms that will appeal to you followers of Nulgath, the Dread Fiend and Infernal Fiend travel forms. Find Oblivion in Battleon or the OverSoul to peruse his wares today!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgathlegacy/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7051/nationsetsandswords.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Improved Experience[/h2]
Many side-quests and dungeons in the Nulgath Finale maps have been adjusted for better gameplay experiences, including new rewards, greater availability of some crafting materials, renamed quests for clarity and consistency, and additional quests on Quest Giver NPCs. The most affected areas and NPCs are the Shadow Dungeon (Prison) with dozens of new drops, Oblivion Blade of Nulgath quest pet, Nulgath’s Larvae quest pet, and Crag and Bamboozle quest pets.

[h2]A Special Message from Sir Fainal, our Nulgath Farming Designer[/h2]

Hello Nation followers, 
I wanted to let you know that I’m going to be hosting a small Feedback Forum thread discussion on our official Discord server, AE Official. In said thread you can drop your constructive feedback. If something is too strong, too profitable, not profitable enough, etc. All in exclusive regards to Nulgath Farming, that is. Balance numbers may be adjusted, and rewards tweaked depending on feedback.

To find it go into the [url=https://aq3d.com/community/artix-games-discord/]AE official Discord[/url], find the AQ3D-discussion. Just above #AQ3D-Yulgar you will use the forums. Join to leave your feedback. Remember to be courteous and follow our discord rules while doing so, all constructive feedback and suggestions are welcome, as long they are balanced.

[h2]Daily Chest Shop Additions[/h2]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgathlegacy/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7050/dailychestadditions.jpg[/img][/url]

If you haven’t reached the Nulgath Finale yet, you can still get some cool rewards this week in the Chest Shop! Two new spears have been added to the [b]Daily Chests[/b] and [b]Chest Shop[/b]: the Foreboding Shadow Spear (red) and the Phantom Shadow Spear (blue). Use your [b]Treasure Shards[/b] to buy them outright or try your luck when you open your Daily Chest!

[h2]2024 Calendar HeroMart Rewards[/h2]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgathlegacy/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7049/2024-calendar-collection.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3]Talk to [b]Stryche[/b] in the Scholar District to get your hands on the new 2024 calendar items.[/h3]
You can use your HeroPoints to get the pieces of the Chrono ShadowHunter Collection from the HeroPoints Rewards shop.

If you bought the [url=https://heromart.com/products/2024-artix-calendar-this-game-is-undead-poster]2024 calendar from HeroMart[/url], use the code that came with your calendar delivery to unlock the 2024 Chronomancer Collection, which includes both the Chrono ShadowHunter and Chrono ShadowSlayer Collections. You can always access this collection through Stryche or at the Bank through Hootenheim, the bank manager.
 
[h2]Last Chance![/h2]
[list]
[*]Gold Boost ends at midnight EST on January 10th, 2024!
[*]Frostval Collection, Gift’thulu, and related seasonal activities will leave around the end of January, 2024
[*]Gaz’s Last Chance Shop closes on January 31st, 2024.
[/list]
 
[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
Loremaster Hazel is ready to share the next step in her research with you! Follow where the clues lead you to discover the next piece of the Cosmic Raiment.

[b]See you in game and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

The Oblivion's Archfiend's Servants Artifacts shop is having a sale on Quest Pets. [b]Save 25%[/b] when you buy a quest pet from this shop until January 24th, 2024. Oblivion has also added two new Travel Forms that will appeal to you followers of Nulgath, the Dread Fiend and Infernal Fiend travel forms. Find Oblivion in Battleon or the OverSoul to peruse his wares today!

Many side-quests and dungeons in the Nulgath Finale maps have been adjusted for better gameplay experiences, including new rewards, greater availability of some crafting materials, renamed quests for clarity and consistency, and additional quests on Quest Giver NPCs. The most affected areas and NPCs are the Shadow Dungeon (Prison) with dozens of new drops, Oblivion Blade of Nulgath quest pet, Nulgath’s Larvae quest pet, and Crag and Bamboozle quest pets.

Two new spears have been added to the [b]Daily Chests[/b] and [b]Chest Shop[/b]: the Foreboding Shadow Spear (red) and the Phantom Shadow Spear (blue). Use your [b]Treasure Shards[/b] to buy them outright or try your luck when you open your Daily Chest!
You can use your HeroPoints to get the pieces of the Chrono ShadowHunter Collection from the HeroPoints Rewards shop.

If you bought the [url=https://heromart.com/products/2024-artix-calendar-this-game-is-undead-poster]2024 calendar from HeroMart[/url], use the code that came with your calendar delivery to unlock the 2024 Chronomancer Collection, which includes both the Chrono ShadowHunter and Chrono ShadowSlayer Collections. You can always access this collection through Stryche or at the Bank through Hootenheim, the bank manager.
Loremaster Hazel is ready to share the next step in her research with you! Follow where the clues lead you to discover the next piece of the Cosmic Raiment.

notes.title: Take the Fight to the Frostlorn!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostlornonslaught/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6b47b80c7611ee7ec6f6e4e51d15a107a82a1f50.png[/img]
[/url]

[h2]Happy 2024![/h2]
We’re ringing in 2024 with a Gold Boost! Get double gold rewards when you complete quests and kills monsters, like in our new dungeon Frostlorn’s Icy Onslaught. The Frostval Champion wants Battleon’s heroes to take on the Frostlorn army’s strongest generals. Also, for this month only, Gaz is offering up his hoard of 2023 promo items for sale.

[h2]Frostlorn’s Icy Onslaught [/h2]
[b](Max 15 players) [/b]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostlornonslaught/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7045/icyonslaught_notext.jpg[/img][/url]

You fought the Frostlorn army in the siege at Battleon’s gates, but now you can take the fight to them. Visit the [b]Frostval Champion[/b] in Battleon to engage in combat against each of the Frostlorn army’s generals and mighty champions in combat one-by-one. Some you have seen before, but the army continues to grow and so new foes await you, untested by your might.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostlornonslaught/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7044/frostlornonslaughtrewards.jpg[/img][/url]

Gaz is offering these items for a flat fee of 1,000 Dragon Crystals. The Last Chance Shop is only open for a limited time and will leave his stall on January 31st. The promo items from 2023 will then become Legacy.

[b]Reminder:[/b] Guardians cam always purchase any Guardian-only promo item they missed from Fortes in his "Special Guardian Rewards" shop with Guardian Class Tokens.
 
[h2]Gold Boost[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostlornonslaught/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6854/goldboost.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]It’s 2024, so let’s ring in the New Year with double gold rewards![/b]
Enjoy boosted gold rewards to monster kills and quest rewards until January 10th, 2024.
 
[h2]Monthly Promo Item[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostlornonslaught/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/7041/jan2024promo_1080.jpg[/img][/url]

Buy any upgrade package or Dragon Crystal pack from the Upgrade Shop this month to get the Frosty Torrent Rune Blade!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/janpromo2024/]Click here to read the details![/url]

notes.title: Give the Gift of Gift’thulu!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2023giftthulu/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0fbc1cdc4a80f1baa065d018f664c590819de414.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Fun for everyone![/h2]
We filled Gift’thulu with brand new gifts for all of Battleon’s heroes! Talk to the [b]Festive Gifter[/b] to buy Gifting Runes that allow you to spawn this giant gift monster for you and your friends. Upon its defeat, you are all gifted with various prizes and Gift Tags.

If you are a Guardian, you can get one Guardian Gifting Rune each day of this gifting event from [b]Zoria[/b] in the Guardian Tower. She’s easy to spot in her festive red hood. Just give her five Guardian Class Tokens to receive your Gifting Rune. The Guardian Gift’thulu contains some exclusive drops just for you and your fellow Guardians! Enjoy!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2023giftthulu/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6994/gifting-leaderboard.jpg[/img][/url]

For the competitive gifters, the [b]Gifting Leaderboard[/b] is back! Climb to the top of the board by using regular Gifting Runes to spawn Gift’thulu for your fellow heroes. The amount of heroes fighting your Gift’thulus adds points to your score!

Share the Gift of Gift’thulu in public for the best experience, so check out the “Go Gifting” button on the Festive Gifter to see all of the perfect public gifting spots for large groups.

[b]Note:[/b] Please don’t spawn Gift’thulus in Yulgar’s Inn. They often get sucked into the floors and are never seen again… Weird.

[h2]The Gifts![/h2]
These items drop at random from the Gift’thulu, so be sure to join the fun whenever you can!
[b]Note:[/b] Not all items listed are pictured in the images.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2023giftthulu/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6993/newtogiftthulu.jpg[/img][/url]

[list]

[*]Snowy Fiend Hood
[*]Sooty Fiend Hood
[*]Dark Fiend Hood
[*]Crimson Fiend Hood
[*]Icy Fiend Hood
[*]Emerald Fiend Hood
[*]Golden Fiend Hood

[*]Blushing Fiend Hood

At the [b]Gift’thulu Shop[/b], you can spend the Gift Tags to buy yourself exactly what you want. The shop contains all items from this year and previous years. It also includes the item [b]Full of Gifts[/b], which unlock the title [i]“Gift Unwrapper”[/i] and can only be obtained through the shop.

[h2]2023 Frostval Collection Additions[/h2]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2023giftthulu/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6991/frostvalitemsadded.jpg[/img][/url]

The Frostval Collection keeps getting better! We’ve added a few special items we just couldn’t wait to share with you.

notes.title: The Nulgath Saga Finale is Here!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgath-saga-finale-2023/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bccb040523bcf11ed782d292b9e357eb9a0d88b6.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The Finale Begins[/h2]
In this epic finale of the Nulgath Saga, delve deep into the Shadow Dungeon to retrieve the missing piece of Dage’s soul to make him whole and team up in combat against Nulgath, the Archfiend! You can also now [b]increase your max level to 45[/b] and earn [b]new capstones[/b] and [b]infusion runes[/b]. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgath-saga-finale-2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6971/oblivion-in-battleon.jpg[/img][/url]

Seek out Oblivion in Battleon or go to your Adventure Menu to begin the epic conclusion of the Nulgath Saga! Complete the saga, collect and craft dozens of new weapons and armor sets, and team up with friends in the Challenge dungeon.
 

[h3]The Final Piece[/h3]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgath-saga-finale-2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6974/retrieve-dage-soul-aq3d.jpg[/img][/url]

Find a way to get back the final piece of Dage’s soul so that he can become whole in the Oversoul. 
The Shadow Dungeon seems like a good place to start…

[h3]An Epic Showdown[/h3]
With Dage back to his powerful self, the two of you can reach Nulgath’s Throne and defeat Nulgath once and for all!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgath-saga-finale-2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6976/nulgath-challenge.jpg[/img][/url]

… Or, if once is not enough, you can defeat him over and over again with friends in the Challenge version of the fight!


[h3]Quest Pets[/h3]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgath-saga-finale-2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6977/quest-pets-nulgath.jpg[/img][/url]

When you have finished the story, continue enjoying the saga with these quest pets! These pets have exclusive side-quests and rewards attached to them. Visit Oblivion in Battleon after completing the saga to get yours! 
 
[h3]Fun Extras[/h3]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgath-saga-finale-2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6973/capstones-infused-fiendish-runes.jpg[/img][/url]

[i][b]Capstones and Infused Fiendish Runes
[/b][/i]When you exceed the new level cap of 45 you can earn more Capstones and NEW Infused Fiendish Runes for more end-game gear. Talk to Maximus in Battleon, near Cysero’s Forge, to start crafting the Corrupt Lionfang Paladin armor set!


[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgath-saga-finale-2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6972/thyton-pic.jpg[/img][/url]

[i][b]Thyton is visiting Battleon! 
[/b][/i]Find him in Yulgar’s Inn to shop his items, play his story - the Westemere saga, and learn to fight like a Ninja. 


[h2]Last Chance![/h2]
[list]
[*]Bank Vault and Bank Pet discounts EXTENDED to end around December 6th, 2023.

notes.title: BattleTron Returns for Black Friday!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bfcm23/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/90a28119659dca78d1f0052862493da084d09bd1.png[/img][/url]

[h2]BattleTron Defender[/h2]
BattleTron Defender has returned to Battleon with the Black Friday and Cyber Monday shops, as well as the CyberWolf Trove. These shops include NEW and previous items available for individual purchase. Many items are available for gold, so don’t be shy to peruse the BattleTron’s wares.

While you are adventuring, you will also find the CyberKnight invading the Daily Boss maps and some seasonal items have returned to the Daily Treasure Chests.

[h2]New Black Friday Items![/h2]
This year’s new items for the Black Friday Shop include:

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bfcm23/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6968/blackfriday.jpg[/img][/url]

[list]
[*]Onyx Tailor Scout armor set
[*]Onyx Tailor Scout Wand (melee)
[*]Onyx Tailor Scout Sword (melee)
[*]Onyx Spiked Glaves (melee)
[*]Black Bat Wings (back)
[*]Reaper’s Toothpick (melee)
[*]Reaper’s Eclipse Toothpick (melee)
[*]Onyx Guardian Blade (Guardian only)
[/list]

[h2]New Cyber Monday Items![/h2]
Cyber Monday is on the other side of the weekend! Check out these new items in the Cyber Monday Shop.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bfcm23/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6969/cybermonday.jpg[/img][/url]

[list]
[*]Melodia Fan armor set
[*]Pink Keyboard (melee)
[*]Electric Spiked Glaives
[*]Cyber Dragon Wings (back)
[/list]

[h2]Seasonal Items and Activities[/h2]
We also have some seasonal items and activities returning for a limited time.

[h3]CyberWolf Trove[/h3]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bfcm23/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6965/cyberwolftrove2.jpg[/img][/url]

Do you have what it takes to join the CyberWolf Vanguard? Start the trove to begin a series of quests to collect awesome items for you to keep in your own personal trove (a free Collection) to be accessed again at any time at the bank.

[h3]Daily Boss Invader[/h3]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bfcm23/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6964/cyberknight.jpg[/img][/url]

The CyberKnight has invaded the Daily Boss Fight maps. Defeat him to collect pieces of his gear to equip for yourself!

[h3]Daily Chests Rewards[/h3]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bfcm23/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6963/bfcm-chest-rewards.jpg[/img][/url]

Legion TechnoKnight and Robowolf travel form now have a chance to drop from your Daily Treasure Chests. You can also purchase them with Treasure Shards in the Chest Shop.
 
[h2]Invest in Battleon's Bank[/h2]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bfcm23/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6962/loyalbankmember_header.jpg[/img][/url]

The bank needs to collect on some debts from the citizens of Lore who are behind on their investments. If you are willing to make some visits on behalf of the bank, and help out a few friends along the way, you may have what it takes to become a Loyal Bank Member. This grants you a free bank vault, plus the title ‘[i]Repo Hero[/i]’.

Talk to Hootenheim about “Investing” at the bank to begin your quest – But you must have first completed the Bank’s main story quests! Completing those [b]also[/b] gives you a free bank vault, so it’s a Win-Win!

[h2]Need More DragonCrystals?[/h2]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bfcm23/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6967/blackfridaymoredragoncrystals.jpg[/img][/url]

You get 50% extra DragonCrystals when you buy them from the Upgrade Shop in AQ3D! This includes Guardian and Adventurer’s Pack bundles as well! Fill up and enjoy the bonus DCs!

[h2]Last Chance![/h2]
[list]
[*]Dottie, the ArchCounselor of [b]Camp Gonnagetcha[/b], is preparing to leave Battleon [b]around November 29th[/b], 2023. She has moved closer to Yulgar’s Inn for now to make way for the BattleTron Defender.
[*][b]Bank[/b] Vault and Bank Pet discounts end [b]around November 29th[/b], 2023.
[*][b]Black Friday/Cyber Monday[/b] seasonal shops and activities will leave AQ3D [b]around December 20th[/b], 2023.
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bfcm23/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6931/nulgaths-throne-preview.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
The highly anticipated Nulgath finale is on its way! Recover the missing piece of Dage's Soul and finally confront Nulgath in an epic battle!

[b]See you in game and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

notes.title: Your Inventory is Sorted!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/inventoryupdate/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5d468455bd836046a149cdfbdb9e8f209171b590.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Faster, Smoother, Better[/h2]
We are excited to bring you a faster, smoother, better way to sort through your item inventories. Your inventories are looking a little cleaner after this update with new filters, sorting options, and an updated UI. This update affects your Main or Bag Inventory, your Bank Vault inventory, and your hotkey bar’s Usable Items inventory.

[h2]Your Bag/Main Inventory[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/inventoryupdate/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6950/oldandnewinventory.jpg[/img][/url]

At the top of the inventory you can now see how many items you have in total (including items that do not take up Bag slots, like pets and travel forms – this is called Inventory – and how many items are in your Bag slots out of the maximum Bag slot limit (seen as XXX / YYY).

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/inventoryupdate/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6951/inventoryexplanation.jpg[/img][/url]

Also, Item Category buttons have been condensed into general categories and are now a gold color. Most Categories have additional Filters and Sorting options. For example, the category Weapons can be filtered to only show Melee, Ranged, or Pistol type weapons, and it can also be sorted in alphabetical order from A-Z, by Newest items, or by Power level.

[h2]Bank Vault Sorting[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/inventoryupdate/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6952/bankvaults.jpg[/img][/url]

Bank Vaults now include an All Vaults option for searching through the entire inventory of your vaults at once! Also, just like the Main Inventory, Vaults can be filtered into subcategories and sorted.

Also, items which are transferred to and from the bank will be considered ‘new’ to the destination vault/inventory, placing them at the top when sorting by ‘New’. This allows you to rearrange your items in your bank vaults and your inventory and prevents items from going out of sight when transferring them.

[h3]By the way![/h3]
While you are in the Bank, turn up your music volume and enjoy the new soundtrack Jongaar composed!

[h3][i]Limited Time Only[/i][/h3]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/inventoryupdate/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6953/bankdiscounts.jpg[/img][/url]

Expand your bank space with discounted Bank Vaults and access them on the go with moglin Bank Pets. These adorable moglin Bank Pets allow you to access your bank vaults from wherever you are with just a pat on their head (or back; they are clickable wherever really). Talk to Hedwig Hootenheim, the Bank Manager, to pick out your Bank Pet.

Bank Vaults are discounted to only 750 DCs and Bank Pets are discounted to 1500 DCs! This sale only lasts until the [i]end of November[/i], so hurry!

[h2]Hotkey Bar Sorting![/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/inventoryupdate/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6954/hotbar.jpg[/img][/url]

Gone are the days of scrolling to the very bottom of the Usable Items list to add the items you just bought to your Hotkey bar. The Usable Items can be quickly sorted by New, A-Z, or even filtered by category for the specific item type you need. Now you can equip your items on the fly. This is especially useful for restocking Health Potions in the middle of combat or equipping that stack of consumable buffs you forgot you needed.

[h2]This Isn’t the End[/h2]
This is only the first pass at inventory updates. We are working on bringing additional (more complex) functionality like ‘Drag and Drop’, a highly requested feature by you the players. Let us know on social media what else you would like to see to improve the Inventory experience!

[h2]Last Chance![/h2]
[list]
[*]Camp Gonnagetcha is closing and Dottie is leaving Battleon at the end of November. Join your friends around the campfire to defeat Shrade a few more times before saying goodbye to him and all of the camp counselors until next Friday the 13th!
[*]Bank Vault and Bank Pet discounts end around Wed, November 29th, 2023.
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/inventoryupdate/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6949/inventoryupdate_header.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
Next week is Thanksgiving in the United States! We’re doing another small release next week so the team can focus on spending time with their families.

[b]See you in game and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

notes.title: Discover More of Lore!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/discoverlore/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6fea30966c990c1f80b66083d258e9a105c5fbb8.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Get More From Lore![/h2]
Loremaster Hazel has found a clue for the next piece of the Cosmic Raiment. Head to the Loremaster’s Lodge to find out where you will go next as her partner in this research. Meanwhile, the Quest Board has three new Odd Jobs for you to fulfill to put some extra gold in your pockets.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/discoverlore/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6933/cosmicgloves.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Cosmic Gloves[/h2]
Loremaster Hazel has found a clue about the cosmic being and the next piece of the Cosmic Raiment: The Cosmic Gloves. Head to the Loremaster’s Lodge to get caught up on her latest research and find the next stop [i]Unearthing the Raiment[/i].

Travel to dangerous, yet exciting, locations around the world of Lore to learn more about the mysterious cosmic being Hazel is researching. Once you have gathered enough for Hazel to create a pattern, you can gather all the thread and materials you need to craft these gloves with her Daily and Repeatable quests for more threads.

As usual, once you have crafted the gloves, you can gather more materials to craft the Awakened Cosmic Gloves as well.

[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/discoverlore/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6934/takeonnewoddjobs.jpg[/img][/url]

Take on New Odd Jobs[/h2]
If you are in need of some quick gold, the Quest Boards around Lore have some great options: Daily Boss Battles, Random Adventures, and today’s focus - Odd Jobs around Lore. The jobs will help you get to know the different locations around the world of Lore by filling small requests (1-3 objectives) for NPCs according to your preferred level range. This is the start of the Quest Board refresh as we update it with new quests and put extra gold in your pocket. Each Odd Job is repeatable and additionally rewards Level Rewards tokens used to buy items from Cysero’s Forge.

[b]New in Levels 1-10[/b]
[i]Sneevil Tea Party: [/i]Travel to various maps around Greenguard to collect a special blend of ingredients for the Sneevil Tea Party. Your reward includes a sample of Sneevil Sipping Tea.

[i]Slime Farmer[/i]: Ol’ Jeb is looking for a brave adventurer to go down into Yulgar’s Sinkhole to collect Exotic Slimes for his collection. He’s willing to pay a little extra gold for your trouble.

[b]New in Levels 16-20[/b]
[i]Atlantean Basket Weaving[/i]: The Atlantean Council wants to revive an old tradition, Atlantean Basket Weaving. Discover the lost blueprints and collect the materials required to weave one of the baskets and the council will reward you for your effort.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/discoverlore/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6931/nulgaths-throne-preview.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Nulgath Finale Update[/h2]
Yes! The Nulgath Saga Finale is coming! We’re putting the finishing touches on it now as we set up shops, finalize boss fights and challenges, and playtest the story to make sure we bring you the epic finale you all deserve. When it is done, you finally get to meet Nulgath face-to-face in a fight for Dage’s soul. We hope to have it ready for you soon.
 
[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
Your inventory is getting an update! Thanks to all of the player feedback on PRT, your bank and backpack inventory will be easier to navigate with new sorting options, including sort A-Z or by item Power! Check out the latest version on [url=https://aq3d.com/community/public-testing-realm/]our PTR server[/url].

[b]See you in game and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

notes.title: November Promo 2023: Gladius of Autumn Harvest
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/novpromo2023/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0fc4f5250ea2e8affd8844eaa450c7f01984141c.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Gladius of Autumn Harvest[/h2]
[i]This elegant sword is crafted from a silvery metal alloy firm a steel but light as a twig. A World Tree branch was pruned to become the hilt and infused with powerful Druidic magic to combine these two opposing elements.[/i]

The [b]Gladius of Autumn Harvest[/b] weapon is included with all packages from the Upgrade Shop, including Guardian and Lore Strider. Guardian packages also give the [b]Gladius of Summer Light [/b]weapon. Check your inventory on your next login after purchase.

[b]Note:[/b] All accounts that had made a purchase from the Upgrade Shop in November prior to this update on November 1st, 2023, were retroactively awarded these items.

[h2]What if I'm already a Guardian?[/h2]
Great! When you buy any package, you will get both versions of the [b]Gladius of Summer Light[/b] directly added to your inventory.

If you miss the promotional period, Guardians can still get the [b]Gladius of Summer Light[/b]. Head to the Guardian Tower to talk to Fortes. He has a shop for "Special Guardian Rewards" where you can buy the [b]Gladius of Summer Light[/b] and any other special Guardian items released through these monthly promotions with Guardian Class Tokens. Make sure you have completed the Guardian Initiation to unlock class gear.

notes.title: You’re Invited to Pizza Hero Horror Nights!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/pizzahero/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a916cb79eaa67d92006f08d49ee032c978af7d8d.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Introducing Mario[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/pizzahero/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6914/meetmario.jpg[/img][/url]

You've been to Burger Hero. Now it's time to experience Pizza Hero Horror Nights, an old pizza place turned horror attraction. Mario is at Burger Hero spreading the word about Pizza Hero’s frightful new experience. And… They need some overnight security.

Anyway, you can’t miss him. He’s with his friend, Peter P, the other guy dressed in Pizza gear. Wait. Was Peter the Pizzamancer just reusing an old Pizza Hero uniform?

[h2]Pizza Hero Horror Nights[/h2]
Okay, so this place is definitely not in its glory days. You don’t wonder why it got turned into a horror attraction. They didn’t do much to fix up the remnants of the old restaurant. It’s dark, dirty, and the place just gives you the creeps. Even Perry, the happy pizza slice, exclaims, “Don’t Touch Me!” on his poster. Doesn’t seem too friendly for a mascot.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/pizzahero/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6913/perry_dont-touch.jpg[/img][/url]

Guess you better start your security shift and find out what’s really going on here. Maybe it really is just a couple kids messing around…

[h2]Meet the Gang… or not…[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/pizzahero/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6912/nevermeetyourpizzaheroes2.jpg[/img][/url]

For some reason, only the posters of Perry are completely illuminated… And, come to think of it, you’ve seen a lot of Perry everywhere, but the others... Perhaps they were beyond repair by the time Pizza Hero was given a second life. Perhaps they are just waiting for their time in the spotlight…

[h2]Fright Night Fans[/h2]
You may run into some regular customers during the day. If things start getting… strange, they could have useful information regarding what goes on here at night. It’s worth a try.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/pizzahero/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6911/fivenightsatpizzahero.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]It’s Only Five Nights...[/h2]
Mario assures you that all you have to do is monitor the place over night for five nights to stop any intruders overnight. Then, you report back to him each morning with your observations. Seems pretty simple. There is even a Security Room with television monitors. Touch the monitor to begin your shift, and don’t forget to turn up/on your volume. Just don’t get caught sleeping on the job or you won’t earn your shiny new Title.

Successfully surviving all five nights also unlocks your ability to hang out with friends in Pizza Hero after hours. Yay! Who wants a Pizza Party?

[h2]Pizza Hero Merch![/h2]
After you have completed your shifts, use your hard earned gold to buy some Pizza Hero merchandise based on the Pizza Hero Horror Nights gang. Who is your favorite mascot?

If you want real life Pizza Hero merchandise, keep your eye on [url=https://heromart.com/]HeroMart.com[/url] where we’ll be releasing frightfully fun new t-shirts.
 
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/pizzahero/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6857/goldboost_1080.jpg[/img][/url]

It’s the end of the month, so let’s go out with a bang! In double gold rewards! Enjoy boosted gold rewards to monster kills and quest rewards until November 2nd, 2023.

The October promo item, “Sword of Rising Evil”, will soon be replaced for November. Make a purchase from the Upgrade Shop to get it before October is over!

[h2]Myx It Up![/h2]
The brand new Mogloween Collection is now available! Talk to Myx in Battleon to buy the whole collection with the Collector’s Chest (including an exclusive title) or buy only the items you want to mix and match with previous collection items.

[h2]The 2023 Mogloween Collection[/h2]

[h2]Dare To Power Up the Doom Weapon?[/h2]
Where the tournament took place, now stands at its center, the ShadowReaper of Doom. It wants to be fed!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2023mogloweencollection/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6904/empoweryoursrofdoom.jpg[/img][/url]

Talk to the ShadowReaper of Doom to begin your[i] Unlucky Doom Essence[/i] quests. These quests require you to defeat Gaven Ravenspire in the Crypt Challenge or face off once again with the Doom Guardian to gain Unlucky Doom Essence. Use this essence to feed the darkness and power up your ShadowReaper of Doom.

After upgrading to the Bone ShadowReaper of Doom, you will be able to accept the quest to upgrade it to the level 44 [b]Horrific ShadowReaper of Doom[/b] with 940 power! The new Best In Slot weapon! However… this requires a great Sacrifice of Power…

[i][b]This Special Artifact will cast on you the Special effect DOOOOM! while equipped as your main weapon: Increasing your Attack by 10% but reducing your total HP by -20%.[/b][/i]

Sacrificial remorse? Skew may be willing to help you out. But just this once.
 
But first, see what the [b]Ghost Guardian[/b] outside of the crypt has to offer…

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2023mogloweencollection/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6905/ravenspire-weapons.jpg[/img][/url]
 
[h3]Ravenspire Darkness-Touched Weapons[/h3]
The Ghost Guardian will help you craft the Ravenspire Dark Bow and Ravenspire Dark Sword with ‘Guardian’s Oath Fulfilled’ tokens dropped by the enemies inside of the crypt.

[h3]Guardian Serving Doom[/h3]
In taking this Guardian-only quest from the Ghost Guardian in Ravenspire, you can embrace the darkness and follow the path towards earning the title of “[i]Doom Guardian[/i]”.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2023mogloweencollection/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6895/creepingitreal_header.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]There’s So Much More To Do![/h2]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/octtopthings/]Read about the Top Ten Things To Do In October![/url]

Taco Day is gone. Taculous has been vanquished for now and Taco Tito has taken his tacos home to feast on.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2023mogloweencollection/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6901/mogloween2023collection_header.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Friday the 13th: Ravenspire - Birth of a Doom Weapon
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/f13ravenspire/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ea27d0b02adb3339e62b3c9ebe00c651fc324c21.png[/img][/url]

[h2]You’re Invited![/h2]
You’re the special guest for Ravenspire’s annual Moon Festival. The town is making preparations for the big tournament but strange portals and mysterious people have been popping up around town. Perhaps the local Chronomancer can help you put things right in the nick of time!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/f13ravenspire/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6892/ravenspire.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Welcome to Ravenspire![/h2]
The Duchess of Ravenspire has invited you as the honored guest at the annual Ravenspire Moon Festival. People have flocked from all over to celebrate and compete in the big tournament. The town has been through hard times lately, so they are really looking forward to this event. However, strange portals have been popping up around town making the residents nervous. Will you make things right and help them make this the best Moon Festival yet?

Talk to [b]Nevermore[/b] in Battleon to get started, and when she returns to Ravenspire in a few weeks, you can always return to finish your quests through the House of Oddities - where all Friday the 13th stories live - or go to the Side Stories in the Adventure Menu.

Complete the story to earn the title “[i]Savior of Ravenspire[/i]” and unlock Bonus Content!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/f13ravenspire/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6893/siriusthechronomancer2.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Sirius, the Chronomancer[/h2]
Sirius is the first resident of Ravenspire to welcome you. Chronomancers have the ability to travel through time. He knows just how great you are, and how dark the future can be… He expects great things from you! But be careful. Trying to alter time too much can be dangerous.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/f13ravenspire/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6894/theshadowreaperofdoom.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Birth of a Doom Weapon?![/h2]
A Mysterious Strangers seems intent on creating this Doom Weapon in Ravenspire… and that YOU are the one meant to wield it. When the moon rises and the barrier between the planes of darkness and light is weakest, only then is when a Doom Weapon can be created. This is a once in a lifetime chance. Can you prevent the Mysterious Stranger from summoning whatever forces are needed to create such a powerful and evil weapon? What will you do if he succeeds? The fate of this Doom Weapon, and the world, is in your hands.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/f13ravenspire/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6891/shadowreaper.gif[/img][/url]

If you choose to wield this weapon and empower it with the blood of your enemies, you will gain great power but at great cost.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/friday-the-13th-origins-story-time/]Learn about the history of Doom Weapons in Artix Entertainment in Beleen’s post[/url].

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/f13ravenspire/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5606/houseofoddities.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Need More Friday the 13th?[/h2]
If you would like more Friday the 13th content, head to the [b]House of Oddities[/b] in Battleon to play more stories rife with terror and suspense. You can travel into the Odd Snow Globe for an unforgettable night at a cabin in the woods, teleport to a different dimension using the Transdimensional Crystal to encounter a friend’s worse half trapped inside, or go back in time with famed Aurelio Voltaire to learn how about his daring daring adventure with pirates on Skullpunch Island.

For something a little different, Dottie, the High ArchCounselor of [b]Camp Gonnagetcha[/b] is in town for a few weeks for those who want to face their fears against the camp legend Shrade. This stalking horror comes in many forms and terrorizes the camp by night. Save the camp or, at least, save yourself.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/f13ravenspire/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5613/campshrade-april2018-header.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3]Things are Changing at Camp Gonnagetcha[/h3]
[list]
[*]Camp Craft Badges are now Tokens. We’ve increased the droprate of these tokens from all mobs.
[*]Camp Badges and quests to turn in Camp Badges at Zip and Ace have been removed.
[*]Camp Uniform crafting shops have been consolidated into a single shop where items can be purchased with Camp Craft Badges.
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/patchnotesoct1223/]Read the rest of the patch notes here![/url]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/f13ravenspire/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6890/mogloween_1920.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Ready for Mogloween?[/h2]
The barrier between Lore and Mystcroft is open once again for Mogloween. Say hello to our spooky friends from Mystcroft if you see them around town. Myx the Cauldron is on the bridge to show you into town and present to you the previous years’ Mogloween Collections. There is plenty to see and do in Mystcroft. What tricks and treats will you encounter this Mogloween season?

[h2]Last Chance[/h2]
Talk Like a Pirate Day 2023 Collection and Captain Crisp have left.
[list]
[*][b]Taco Day[/b] is leaving around October 18th, 2023
[*][b]Nevermore[/b] leaves Battleon around November 8th, but you can return to Ravenspire year round.
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/f13ravenspire/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6889/oddities-doom-weapon.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Thank you and… Next![/b]
Get ready to dress for distress when we reveal this year’s Mogloween Collection!

[b]See you in game and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

notes.title: Your Guild Just Got Better!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/guildsupdate/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6b1730b5d7cb0e664af39a415c7c40651759fb92.png[/img]
[/url]

[h2]Your guild has become a lot more interactive with new features![/h2]
Guillermo the Guild Representative is in Battleon to help you get familiar with guilds. He’s got the answers to your basic questions regarding guilds, but in this post we’re going to dive a little deeper into the details. Guild Leaders can provide guild boosts, members can help get their guild to the top of the leaderboard, and more! Plus, you’ve got a week of double gold rewards to celebrate.
 
[h2]A Guide to Guilds[/h2]
If you already know the basics, feel free to jump to the bottom where we have listed “[b]Just the Features Please[/b]”.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/guildsupdate/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6850/guildcreation.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Starting a Guild is Easy![/h2]
Open the game menu and click on the Guild button. If you are not already in a guild, you will see a short description of how to create a Guild Name and Guild Tag. Then you must pay 10,000 Gold to complete the guild creation. If your Guild Name and/or Tag has not been used already, your guild is complete and you are now a Guild Leader.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/guildsupdate/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6851/guildinvitation.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Grow Your Guild[/h2]
Click on a player’s nameplate and choose “Send Guild Invite”. This sends them an immediate invitation to join your guild. If they choose Yes, they are added as proud members of your guild. Guild Invites can be turned off in the game Settings, so make sure the player has your consent before you invite them! Now, invite your friends to join your Guild and watch it grow!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/guildsupdate/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6852/guildmenulayout.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Guild Menu[/h2]
While you are part of a Guild, clicking the Guild Icon will take you to the Guild Menu. This shows you:
[list]
[*]Guild Name
[*]Guild Info (? button)
[*]Guild Shop (Guild Leader only) - [b]NEW[/b]
[*]Guild Leaderboard button - [b]NEW[/b]
[*]Guild Level and XP progress in Level - [b]NEW[/b]
[*]List of Guild Members (icons denote rank; Guild Leader / Officer / Member)
[*]Guild Tax % - [b]NEW[/b]
[*]Edit Guild Tax % button (Guild Leader only) - [b]NEW[/b]
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/guildsupdate/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6853/guildoptions.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Guild Member List[/b] also displays each member's "last online", a highly requested feature. Options for interacting with individual members are also here, such as Whisper, Invite, Summon etc. Guild Leaders and Officers have additional permissions such as Demote, Promote or Kick. Just click on the members name to interact.

Guild Leaders can update the guild details from the [b]Guild Info[/b] ([b]?[/b]) button and update the MOTD (message of the day). Other members can click on the ([b]?[/b]) button to see the MOTD as well as other details or to Leave the Guild.

[h3]Additional Details on Guild Taxes and Boosts[/h3]
Guild Taxes apply to [i]all members[/i] including the Guild Leader. The taxed gold is deducted automatically from all gold that your guild members receive while playing. This gold goes into the Guild Fund which the Guild Leader uses to purchase Guild Powers to give the whole guild a temporary boost. Guild Leaders purchase boosts from the Guild Shop (Toolbox icon) which appears for all of the Guild Members as an incon above their hotbar just like a regular boost/buff.

[h2]Just the Features Please![/h2]
Here’s a quick review of the features in a simplified format for those who already know the basics.

[h3]Guild Leader Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Manage Guild Funds and Tax Rates (% of Gold earned that goes to the Guild - maximum 50%)
[*]Guild Shop (Buy temporary boosts for your Guild members! Boosts are unlocked by Guild Level)
[*]Edit Message of the Day
[*]Demote, Promote or Kick Members
[/list]
[h3]General Guild Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Last Online Date for Each Member (or Green Dot if currently online)
[*]Guild Level and Experience (XP earned by the players contributes to Guild Levels)
[*]Leaderboards (see rankings of Guilds by level and XP)
[*]Guild Currency and Taxes (gold earned by members can now be "taxed" by the Guild Leader to contribute to Guild Funds)
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/guildsupdate/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6857/goldboost_1080.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Gold Boost![/h2]
Enjoy a week long gold boost as we end the month and celebrate the new Guild improvements. Get double the gold rewards while you slay monsters and complete quests only! Also, check out our latest post about 
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/piratethings/] all the things you can do to keep the Talk Like a Pirate Day celebrations going[/url] and rake in the gold on your pirate adventures!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/guildsupdate/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6848/piratesiege.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Pirate Siege 3v3 Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]The Siege can now begin even if no opponents join. The map has been unlocked to new players joining the Siege and players can continue to join as the battle goes on, but the siege can now also be played solo.
[*]Siege Tokens are now Token items and Ship Supplies for the battle can now be simply purchased instead of requiring a Quest Turnin.
[/list]
[b]Siege Rewards:[/b]
[list]
[*]Plundered Goods and Plundered Hoard are now updated to be Token Items.
[*]Materials needed for crafting Siege Gear can now be purchased with these Tokens instead of crafted (Pirate Goods)
[*]Drops of Plundered Goods increased 5x to match the old bulk crafting amounts.
[*]Dye shop added to Crabby for easier access.
[*]Tailoring Dyes are now simply purchased with Daily Boss Trophies
[*]Daily Boss Trophies are now Tokens
[/list]
[h2]Last Chance[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Gold Boost[/b] ends around October 4th, 2023
[*]The [b]September promo[/b] ends soon! Get your Sea Dog's Falchion when you buy more DragonCrystals from the Upgrade Shop this month.
[*][b]Talk Like a Pirate Day[/b] 2023 Collection and Captain Crisp will be leaving around October 11th, 2023
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/guildsupdate/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6849/guildimprovements_header.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
October is around the corner! A new monthly promo item will replace the Sea Dog’s Falchion in the Upgrade Shop. Also, Taco Tito returns to the Social District to celebrate National Taco Day!

[b]See you in game and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

notes.title: The Search for the Cosmic Pauldrons
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/cosmicpauldrons/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/f04be9bafcea7e429c0dcf65f48a0f1e834ee72c.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Loremaster Hazel is on the case![/h2]
Loremaster Hazel has some information about the next item: the Cosmic Pauldrons. Return to the Loremaster’s Lodge across from Yulgar’s Inn to get started. She will be excited to share what she's learned!

[h2]Researching the Cosmic Raiment[/h2]
Investigate the lairs of terrifying monsters and navigate mystical glens for more clues on Hazel’s research. This third piece is called the Cosmic Pauldrons. Once you have obtained all of the materials, you will be able to piece together your Cosmic item. If you so choose, you may ‘awaken’ its Epic power through collecting additional materials.

[b]Note:[/b] If you are still working on piecing together the Garment or Wrap, check out the Research Crystal on Hazel’s desk. It’ll help get you back to the locations where you found the crafting materials for your item.

[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/cosmicpauldrons/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6825/cosmicpauldrons.jpg[/img][/url]

The Cosmic Pauldrons[/h2]
Begin researching the third piece of the raiment by choosing the “Unearthing the Raiment” option when you talk to Hazel in the Loremaster's Lodge. Don’t forget to take your trusty Cosmic Companion along with you, so you can Turn In and Accept your quests while you’re away from Battleon.

[h2]Additional Cosmic Quests[/h2]
When you have completed the current questline, you can Accept a Tangled Skein daily quest. These quests allow you to gather additional Threads for crafting all of the Cosmic items. 
Meanwhile, you can also Accept the repeatable “Gathering the Threads” quests to earn Threads specific to a certain item. The repeatable quests give you less Threads but you can do the quest as many times as you want in one day.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/cosmicpauldrons/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6826/tlapdcollectionaddons.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]New Additions to the 2023 Talk Like a Pirate Day Collection![/h2]
Since you loved these little guys so much, we added their alternate forms to the Collection. You can now choose to have Macawliday and Rapscallion as either a travel form or a pet… or both!
 
[h2]Last Chance[/h2]
Zephyrath has left the Social District and the double Samurai Class Tokens boost has ended.
[list]
[*][b]Talk Like a Pirate Day 2023 Collection and Captain Crisp[/b] will be leaving around October 11th, 2023
[/list]
 
[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
Guilds are getting their highly anticipated update soon! Your guild will become a lot more interactive with tons of new features!

[b]See you in game and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]
