notes.title: Arrrr You Ready for Talk Like a Pirate Day?
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tlapd2023/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a8c6db0743975e377868488ef36748c812bd78bb.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Talk Like a Pirate Day is back with a barrel o’ fun![/h2]
Gunpowder Mary has returned to Battleon with the 2023 Talk Like a Pirate Day Collection. Pick and choose your favorites from the collection or buy the Collector’s Chest to get everything in the collection plus the title “Barrel o’ Monkey”. Sneaky ol’ Captain Crisp has follow in Mary’s wake to get his revenge on Captain Rhubarb by selling Cursed Ship Summoning Runes. Summon Cursed Ships for your friends and the community and each successful defeat of the ships delivers a pile of loot to plunder!

[h2]The 2023 Collection[/h2]
Thar be a treasure trove of goodies in this year’s Talk Like a Pirate Day Collection! Take a gander at what’s in store for yer self!
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tlapd2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6817/tlapdcollection1.jpg[/img][/url]

[list]
[*]Collector’s Chest with Title “[i]Barrel o’ Monkey[/i]”
[*]Rapscallion the Monkey (Travel Form)
[*]Macawliday (Pet)
[*]Soul String Rod (Fishing Rod)
[*]Legion Spiked Bobber
[*]Legion Flintlock Cutlass
[*] Legion Eclipse Pirate Armor set

[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tlapd2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6816/tlapdcollection2.jpg[/img][/url]

[list]
[*]Wave Breaker Longsword
[*]Greater Wave Breaker
[*]Shark Bait Helm
[*]Cobalt Privateer's Hat
[*]Skullywag's Gilded Cutlass
[*]Tribal Lorean Punk Pirate set 
[*]Tribal Lorean Hatchet (Melee Weapon)
[*]Tribal Lorean Hatchet and Blunderbuss (Melee Weapon)
[*]Tribal Lorean Blunderbuss (pistol)
[*]Tribal Lorean Blunderbuss and Hatchet (pistol)
[/list]

[h2]Summon a Cursed Pirate Ship for your Friends![/h2]
Captain Crisp is a long time rival of Captain Rhubarb and he’s brought a whole lot of firepower with him to Battleon. With a Cursed Ship Summoning Rune a life-sized Cursed Pirate Ship will instantly appear and begin attacking with the full force of its cannon power. Sunder the cursed ship to plunder its loot! Every ship has a stack of Captain Crisp’s Tokens which can be used to purchase the rarer items found aboard a pirate’s ship. There is also a chance of looting some of Captain Crisp’s own ‘Crispy Dubloons’ to add to your own pocket.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tlapd2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6815/cursedpirateshipsummon.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Captain Crisp’s Haul[/h2]
[list]
[*]Cursed Ship Summoning Rune
[*]Captain Crisp Uniform 
[*]Captain Crisp Belt
[*]Captain Crisp Boots
[*]Captain Crisp Hat
[*]Captain Crisp’s Spoon 
[*]Deep Sea Pirate’s Swill (consumable - Blue Pirate travel form)
[*]Honeyed Wheat Pirate’s Drink (consumable - Gold Pirate travel form)
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tlapd2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6814/tlapd-liveevent.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Beleen’s Talk Like a Pirate Day Live Event![/h2]
We be celebratin' this grand occasion in style with a special in-game Live Event on Tuesday, September 19! Mark yer calendars (best with an X to mark the spot), brush up on yer "yo ho hos" and "aye ayes," and get ready to have more fun than a barrel o’ monkeys, because September 19th be a day ye won't want to miss nor forget!

Live Event time and Location be announced soon, so ye best be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/aq3dgame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/AdventureQuest3D]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/aq3dgame/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://discord.com/invite/FQsFCGV]Discord[/url] to be the first to plunder the details!

[h2]Last Chance[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Zephyrath[/b] is expected to leave the Social District around September 20th, as well as ending the double Samurai Class Tokens boost.
[*][b]Talk Like a Pirate Day 2023[/b] Collection and Captain Crisp will be leaving around October 11th, 2023
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tlapd2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6813/tlapdgunpowdermary.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
Loremaster Hazel is researching clues to help you find the next pieces of the Cosmic Raiment!

[b]See you in game and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

notes.title: Defeat Zephyrath in the Social District!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6f2a93b77359dd596305191ac559277e1c58b4cb.png[/img]

[h2]It's Storming in the Social District![/h2]
Zephyrath has blown into the Social District from the World Tree and we’re expecting prizes to drop for two straight weeks. We’re calling on the Samurai for aid, so talk to Hensou if you’d like to join the team of Samurai and earn extra class tokens.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/hurricaneparty2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6776/zephyrath.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Fight Zephyrath![/h2]
Head straight for the Social District to fight Zephrath. This contrary storm elemental has escaped the World Tree and alternates between wind and water, depending on its mood. Team up with your fellow heroes and local Samurai to defeat it and earn strikingly good rewards while you're at it!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/hurricaneparty2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6774/hurricaneweapons.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Strikingly Good Rewards[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]From Zephyrath[/b]
[/list]
Defeating the menacing storm will earn you the chance of receiving the new [i]Lightning Striker[/i], new [i]Thundercloud Shortsword[/i], and some other familiar stormy items!
[list]
[*][b]From Rose[/b]
[/list]
Turn in your Social Flyers and Ultra Party Streamers to Rose’s “Battleon Social Prizes” to earn the Hurricane Spinner!
[list]
[*][b]From Hensou[/b]
[/list]
Stop to talk to Hensou in Battleon on your way to the Social District to buy the mighty new Samurai blade: Storm Bringer! And, while you’re at it, equip your Samurai class because…

[h2]Double Samurai Class Tokens![/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/hurricaneparty2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6327/samuraiclass.jpg[/img][/url]

Jump back into the action with Hensou as you earn DOUBLE class tokens for the Samurai Class Training quest for Two Weeks! If you don’t have Samurai class yet, talk to Hensou to begin learning and benefit from the double class tokens to earn your Samurai gear faster.

[h2]Last Chance[/h2]
The [b]Dog Days[/b] are over. Aria has rounded up the puppies and brought them back to her Pet Shop.
[list]
[*]The Social District event ends around September 20th, including the double Samurai Class Tokens boost.
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/hurricaneparty2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6776/zephyrath.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
Talk Like a Pirate Day is September 19th, so you know what the means… The 2023 Talk Like a Pirate Day Collection is coming! Arrrr… you excited??!! I know I am!

[b]See you in game and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

notes.title: September Promo Item: Sea Dog's Falchion
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/septpromo2023/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0e477f67abf317c6bf7df03ea8da615f77ce2ac5.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Sea Dog's Falchion[/h2]
[i]This falchion serves a Sea Dog well with a sharp blade and a spiked crossbar for a deadly right hook![/i]

The Sea Dog's Falchion weapon is included with all packages from the Upgrade Shop, including Guardian and Lore Strider. Guardian packages also give the Dead Man's Falchion. Check your inventory on your next login after purchase.

[b]Note:[/b] All accounts that had made a purchase from the Upgrade Shop prior to this update on September 1st, 2023, were retroactively awarded these items.

[h2]What if I'm already a Guardian?[/h2]

notes.title: The Search for the Cosmic Wrap
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/cosmicwrap/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0cb131d572206f4ba2e963004a1968e1c73f72f7.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Return to the Loremaster’s Lodge[/h2]
Loremaster Hazel has some clues on the location of the Cosmic Wrap. Visit her Lodge across from Yulgar’s Inn and say hello. She will be excited to meet you and share what she's been researching!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/cosmicwrap/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6766/loremaster-hazel.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Researching the Cosmic Raiment[/h2]
Explore dungeons and dark places for clues to the whereabouts of the pieces of the raiment. The first piece was the Cosmic Garment (armor) and now Loremaster Hazel sends you back out to find the materials to create the Cosmic Wrap (belt). Once you have obtained all of the materials, you will be able to piece together your Cosmic item (and future Cosmic Raiment pieces). If you so choose, you may ‘awaken’ its Epic power through collecting additional materials.

[h2]The 2nd Piece: Cosmic Wrap[/h2]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/cosmicwrap/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6767/cosmicwrapv2.jpg[/img][/url]

Begin researching the second piece of the raiment by choosing the Cosmic Threads option when you talk to Hazel in the Loremaster's Lodge.

[h2]Your Cosmic Companion[/h2]
The Cosmic Companion seems to have a special bond with Hazel. If you choose, it will tag along with you and communicate your research findings back to her. With the [b]Cosmic Companion pet[/b], you can resume the quest and turn-in your objectives on the go! Pickup your companion from Loremaster Hazel in her Lodge!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/cosmicwrap/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6768/cosmicqueststart.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]Last Chance[/h2]
[b]Dog Days[/b] will be over around September 6th, 2023. Aria will round up the puppies and bring them back to her Pet Shop.

[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/cosmicwrap/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6766/loremaster-hazel.jpg[/img][/url]

Thank you and… Next![/h2]
The September promo item will be released next week, so this is your last chance to get the [i]Blinding Sun Staff[/i] from the Upgrade Shop with your purchase.

[b]See you in game and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

[h2]Aria Let the Dogs Out![/h2]
Aria has wrangled the kitties back into her pet shop and let the dogs out to play for National Dog Day! Rose is cleaning up the Social District, but you can still find Aria on the bridge surrounded by a pack of puppies.
 
[h2]What’s in Store for National Dog Day[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/dogdays2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6145/doggieapoption.jpg[/img][/url]

Aria has combined the Doggie Adoptions (pets) and Doggie Travel Forms shops into the new [b]Doggie Stuff[/b] shop, plus she’s added new pets and dog-themed gear.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/dogdays2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6143/aq3dklaus.jpg[/img][/url]

He is tracking down a fiend lycan called Valnaroth whom he has been hunting for a long time. Team up with Dante, assist him in defeating this great scourge, and earn the title “Archfiend May Cry”.

notes.title: Item Augments and Gold Boost!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/augmentsgoldboost/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/24e38de0b0c6f65fe16ed49f23b0456b91debfdd.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Augmenting Items with Stat Modifiers[/h2]
Who is ready to stack some stats and customize their character build? Equipable items now have the chance of dropping with various stat modifiers. Modifier quality ranges from Defective to Fiendish, with a variety of stats being affected within those ranges, and the chances of getting a higher tier modifier is shown in a handy guide on the side of the menu. And, yes, these augments stack on top of Infusions.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/augmentsgoldboost/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6690/augment-rerolling.gif[/img][/url]

If you have an item that doesn’t have a modifier yet, or you don’t like the modifier your item came with, you should visit Maximus in the Battleon Town Square. Appropriately positioned near Cysero’s Forge, Maximus offers stats upgrades via Infusion and, now, Augment Rerolls via the Augment System. Maximus will show you which of your items is able to be augmented, which you then select to be modified. Rerolls, like Infusion, cost Gold for each time you use it, so keep an eye on your money as you reroll. You can always come back when you have more.

Gold Raven did a short 5 minute video reviewing the Augment System while it was on the PTR server (showing the old UI) if you want a quick visual tutorial. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5vJpbGb4WGQ]Click here to watch[/url]. OR if you want to read an in-depth explanation of the system, [url=news/new-game-feature-item-augments/]read our post HERE[/url].

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/augmentsgoldboost/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6688/gold-boost.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Server Wide Gold Boost![/h2]
In honor of the release of the Augment System, we’ve boosted the servers with double gold rewards until next week’s release. Plus, Gold Boost tokens can be bought from the Potion Shop in the menu for an additional 50% Gold boost. Take advantage of all the extra gold you get while adventuring to try out Maximus’ Modifier Rerolls!

Also, we’re thinking of making Gold Boosts a regular end-of-the-month update. What do you think?

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/augmentsgoldboost/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6689/ornate-classic-phoenix-blade.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Phoenix Gear Troves![/h2]
Thok’s Phoenix Gear crafting shop gives a lot of gear! So we’ve made troves for those items to save your inventory and bank space if you choose to complete the Phoenix Ranks quests and craft them all. You need to complete a Phoenix Rank quest and earn its title to unlock the respective trove.
Unlocking one of these troves also unlocks the Ornate Classic Phoenix Blade.

[h2]Wasteland Void Invasion Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Increased exp/gold rewards on all voids
[*]Increased requirements for Void Hunting
[*]Voids level and hp has been increased and attack decreased
[/list]
[b]How does it work now?[/b]
Every 5 minutes 8 Voids will spawn in the wasteland. A notification will let you know the Voids are invading lore. After the players defeat the Voids, a 5-minute timer will initiate on which the Voids will respawn. However, when and only when all 8 Voids are defeated, the 5 minute timer will begin to count down; incentivizing players to team-up and fully defeat a wave in order to spawn another.

[h2]Last Chance[/h2]
Don't forget to check your inventory for [b]your legacy Vengenator sword[/b], our limited time free item for logging in during the past week.
[list]
[*]July Monthly Promo Item leaves the Upgrade Shop on Aug 2nd, 2023
[*]July 4th event will leave Aug 2nd, 2023
[*]Daily Chest Summer seasonal items and Pointe Less Isle Summer content leaves around Aug 30th, 2023
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/augmentsgoldboost/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6688/gold-boost.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
Next week is the first week of August. Look forward to an exciting new monthly promo item in the Upgrade Shop. We also have lots of exciting things in the works like Player Housing, Guild updates, and a fun new contest arriving this Friday! [url=https://aq3d.com/news/new-game-release-nulgath-augment-system-and-updates/]Check out all the news here[/url]!

[b]See you in game and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgathforgequests/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/21d590f0979e26ee8afbc97825f98d16a00573ac.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The power is In Your Hands![/h2]
A Blood Fiend Guard is now stationed at the Oversoul Anvil. Earn extra crafting materials from him to use at the Oversoul Anvil, newly stocked with more weapons! And then, help Thok and his fellow Paladins stop the Void Fiend Invasion into the Wasteland.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgathforgequests/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6671/bloodfiendguard.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Blood Fiend Guard[/h2]
Nulgath is taking extra precautions in the Forge of the Forlorn. A Blood Fiend Guard is now stationed at the Oversoul Anvil. Luckily he’s looking to pass off some of his… responsibilities… to those looking to empower their weapons at the Forge with four new side quests.
[list]
[*]Daily Nation Weapon Fragments
[*]Soul Gems Daily
[*]Polishing Living Weapons (Repeatable) - Nation Weapon Fragments reward
[*]Soul Gems: Living Weapon Fragment (Repeatable) - Tainted Gem and Soul Gem reward
[/list]
[h2]Forged Anomalies[/h2]
The Oversoul Anvil allows you to craft weapons of varying power. Even more weapons have been added to the Nulgath Nation Armaments shop, now with special effects for the ones with “anomalies”. Click on the anvil to start crafting the weapon most suited for you!

To learn more about these special weapons, read the post from Beleen and Sir Fainal explaining them in detail.

Here are the newest anomalies from the Oversoul Anvil in the Forge of the Forlorn.
[list]
[*]Tainted phoenix Blade of Nulgath
[*]8th Ultimate Betrayal Blade of Nulgath
[*]Assassin's Bloodletters of Nulgath
[*]Abaddon's Blessed Cruelty
[*]Focus Hex Staff of Nulgath
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgathforgequests/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6670/voidinvasion.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Void Invasion[/h2]
Stop the waves of Void Fiends escaping from the Oversoul portal into the Wasteland!
Talk to Thok after you have completed the quests from the Phoenix Blade of Nulgath questline to unlock his “Void Hunting” quests. Earn Thok’s Approval and Nation Void Scraps for completing these quests by defeating the waves of enemies.
[list]
[*][b]Void Hunting: Nation Invasion Waves[/b]
Face new enemies streaming into the Wasteland every 5 minutes and defend our side of the portal from the invasion of Nulgath’s Void Fiends.
[*][b]Void Hunting: The Root of the Problem (Daily) [/b]
Adventure deep into the Hall of Eternal Waiting to track down and defeat Void Guards.
[/list]
[h2]Quality of Life Adjustments[/h2]

[b]Oversoul Anvils:[/b] The anvils in the Forge of the Forlorn having an inconsistency opening menu while interacting has been fixed for easy access to players. Remember that one the left anvil is too cluttered with players; you can utilize the other anvil on the other side of the Forge map to open the same menus and crafting shops.

[b]Fiend Hunting and Catacombs farming methods for Dark Crystal Shards: [/b]
The drop rate of the quest Dark Crystal Shards in Fiend Hunting has been very slightly reduced after finding that the drop rate was slightly over-tuned.

Also, AFK timers have been added to the catacombs. Inactive players will be kicked out of the map after 5 minutes of inactivity to facilitate players farming through this method.

[h2]Last Chance[/h2]
[list]
[*]July 4th event will leave Aug 2nd, 2023
[*]Daily Chest Summer seasonal items and Pointe Less Isle Summer content leaves around Aug 30th, 2023
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgathforgequests/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6669/forgequests_header.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
Take stock of your favorite weapons and gear because the Augment System is coming to give them brand new stats!

[b]See you in game and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/3bextras/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/86068092426fa87adf95c9145465dfcc4eb6f5fe.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Extra! Extra![/h2]
Return to the Oversoul to begin forging new powerful weapons at Poniard’s anvil in the Forge of the Forlorn. While you’re there, defeat any sentient blades you encounter. They now drop Nation Weapons Fragments, useful materials for crafting Nulgath Nation Armaments.

[h2]Uniquely Powerful Weapons[/h2]
At the very same anvil where you crafted a mighty weapon for Poniard, the Forge of the Forlorn calls you back to it with many new and uniquely powerful weapons to craft.
The anvil allows you to craft weapons with unique, or unusual, stats. For example, a weapon may offer a very high Critical bonus but reduces Haste. Or perhaps it only affects a single stat. It’s important to focus more on the description and stats when choosing your weapon than looks alone.
The intention of implementing this system is to provide options to players without Best in Slot weapons (like Phoenix Blade of Nulgath II, 8th Betrayal Blade, Hex Staff, etc). These are mostly optional weapons for players trying to catch up, players at different level ranges, and players with different difficulty levels and different levels of upgrades.

So choose your weapon(s), and choose wisely.

[b]Note:[/b] This is an experimental system. It can also be applied to other gear, so please let us know what you think.

notes.title: Nulgath: 3B - Blood and Iron
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgath3b/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2a169df17336b7de4bc02dfd8e36c4fa4c07097e.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Forge ahead, deeper into the Oversoul[/h2]
Slay your way through the trials ahead to feed the maw and draw ever closer to the Throne of Nulgath… and closer to getting the rest of Dage’s soul back.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgath3b/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6646/archfiendspaladins.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Archfiend’s Paladins[/h2]
Nulgath has claimed the Golden Onslaught as his own and they are now true believers in his supreme power. It would be so much simpler if you just joined them. Surely you don’t think you can defeat Nulgath…

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgath3b/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6643/forgeoftheforlorn.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Forge of the Forlorn[/h2]
This is where the Oblivion Blade was forged, and others like it, by the forlorn residents of this great forge. Learn the art of the forge from the most skilled and most forlorn weapon smith, Poniard.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgath3b/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6642/prismofpain.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Prism of Pain[/h2]
Nothing is as it seems in the Oversoul and that rings especially true here. A little cat guarding a map full of bones and lasers? Sounds like the only one who will be in pain is the one who has to cross all of those lasers. … Oh, wait. That’s You. Well, you’ll figure out something.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgath3b/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6641/hallofeternalwaiting.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Hall of Eternal Waiting[/h2]
Waiting for Customer Service can feel like an eternity. Here it really can be an eternity. Perhaps there’s some way you can get things to move along faster. You don’t really belong here after all. And neither does someone else… or so they claim.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgath3b/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6640/mangle-pet-shop.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Shop with Mangle![/h2]
Talk to Mangle, Petmonger in the Forge of the Forlorn, to purchase some fiendishly fun new pets!
[list]
[*]Hex Orb Pet (quest pet)
[*]Blood Orb Pet (quest pet)
[*]Office Makai (cosmetic pet)
[*]Vicious Overgrown Cat (cosmetic pet)
[/list]
[h2]
Last Chance[/h2]
[list]
[*]Daily Chest Summer seasonal items and Pointe Less Isle Summer shops leave around Aug 30th, 2023
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgath3b/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6639/nulgathsaga3bbloodandiron_poster.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
Let your fun in the sun continue with the 2023 Summer Collection, followed by the new July promo item!

[b]See you at the Maw and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

[h2]Get Extra Daily Quest Rewards and Experience Points All Week![/h2]
Our regularly scheduled release was unable to go out this week, so we're giving you a week of boosted Daily Quest rewards and Experience Points to make up for it. That means Double Daily Quest rewards, and 150% standard experience and Class experience points! This boost will last until Midnight on Thursday, June 29.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/serverboost/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6617/theforge.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]What Happened to the Nulgath Release?[/h2]

Nulgath 3B is so close to being finished, but it seems some of the monsters and even quests have gone on strike. We’re currently negotiating terms and expect them to be resolved by next week.

Real talk, our hard-working testers found some bugs that just can’t be squashed in time to release this week as scheduled. We’re taking this extra time to make sure that this release is able to be completed and enjoyed as intended. The team is excited to show you what we’ve been working on so hard as much as you want to play it. Maybe more!
 
So, for now, head to Pointe Less Isle and earn double Pointe Less Trophy tokens for the Summer shops, go to a Class Trainer and get more Class Tokens *and* Class XP, and you might want to complete the Nulgath Saga 3A quests so you’re ready to begin part 3B next week! All while getting extra standard Experience Points while you’re at it!

notes.title: Players, Sheathe Your Weapons!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sheathing/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c3bc31d1f86303494c6b7822f032b1248056f3ec.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Hands Free Adventuring[/h2]
The new weapon sheathing feature is here! Turn on Auto-Sheathe to run around Lore with your hands free! Your weapon will rest on your back (or at your side) while you run, rest, emote, and interact with NPCs.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sheathing/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6609/toggleautosheathe.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Toggle Auto-Sheathing[/h2]
Go to the game Menu, then Settings. In the Options (General) scroll down to Controls and check the box for Auto-Sheathe Your Weapons. Now (most of) your weapons will be sheathed until you are ready for combat! And after combat is done, and you’re out of harm’s way, the weapon will re-sheathe itself! How cool is that?!?

Just know that some non-standard weapons (like books and drinks) may look silly when sheathed. Also, for now, bows and a very few select other weapons are unable to be sheathed. So those will be worked on in Phase 2 of Sheathing.

[b]Hint:[/b] You can also type [i]/sheathe[/i] into chat to sheathe your weapon in a jiffy!

[h2]Screenshot Saturday![/h2]
Keep your eyes on AQ3D.com and Twitter for the rules and prizes for this week’s Screenshot Saturday: Sheathing Edition! Start practicing your hands-free poses!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sheathing/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6604/june2023promo.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]June Promo Item[/h2]
Head to the Upgrade Shop to get your Gauntlet of Might included with any purchase! And Guardians get a [i]Flaming[/i] Gauntlet of Might as well!

[b]Note:[/b] All accounts that had made a purchase from the Upgrade Shop prior to this update on June 1st, 2023, are retroactively awarded these items.

As the team begins adding quests and rewards to the next installment of the Nulgath Saga, you will begin a quest of your own for a new exciting reward!

notes.title: The Archivist’s Tome: Volume I
notes.content:
[h2]The Archivist Enthusiast[/h2]
Head to the Arcangrove Tower Library and discover the mysterious Weathered Tome… Then find an enthusiastic apprentice eager to help you uncover its secrets.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/archiviststomev1/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6589/restoretheweatheredtome.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Restore the Weathered Tome[/h2]
This is one of many lost tomes belonging to the famed Arcangrove Archivist. There is an apprentice in the Library who has studied the Archivist’s work and is excited for an opportunity to use their knowledge to decipher the remaining notes for you. Since much of the Archivist’s research was scattered throughout LORE during their studies, a seasoned hero like yourself should have no problem locating the missing pages and reuniting them into a complete volume with their help.

[b]Note:[/b] Don’t leave any dungeons without capturing any required “Energies” for your quest.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/archiviststomev1/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6590/archivalrewards.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Archival Rewards[/h2]
When you have found all of the pages and complete the tome, you will be rewarded with “The Archivist’s Drape” and the title “[i]The Wizard’s Scribe[/i]”.

You can find the “Archivist’s Blade” when you open your Daily Chest (a permanent addition”, as well as the Chest Shop to purchase for Treasure Shards.

notes.title: Ambush at Treefern Camp
notes.content:
[h2]Re-U-Knighted[/h2]
Arathor is pretty excited to meet up with the rest of the Knights of the Iron Bulwark. Head to Yulgar’s Inn to go with him to their camp in Treefern.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ironbulwarksaga/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6564/ironbulwarkknights.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Meet the Knights of the Iron Bulwark[/h2]
Your arrival with Arathor seems to be just in time. The knights have been ambushed by bandits! Guardian Gardenia is there too; and she brought a friend. The Iron Bulwark has a fighting chance now that everyone has arrived. Get rid of the bandits so you can finally get to know the rest of the knights.

[b]Note:[/b] Guardians will benefit from chatting with Guardian Gardenia at the Treefern Camp.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ironbulwarksaga/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6563/merchantsofdeath.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Merchants of Death[/h2]
This doesn’t seem like a random attack. These Merchants of Death took supplies from the camp and have been harassing a Treefern resident. See what you can learn about their hideout and what they are doing here.

[b]Note[/b]: There are wooden chests hidden throughout Treefern. Though they are sturdy and difficult to open, inside are great rewards.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ironbulwarksaga/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6562/gradydeighton.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]What is Grady up to?[/h2]
Grady Deighton is the leader of the Merchants of Death. He can be identified by his mask and shimmering crystalline sword. Grady seems to be targeting the Iron Bulwark specifically. But why?

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ironbulwarksaga/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6561/ailssasblacksmithing.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Ailssa’s Blacksmithing Crafts[/h2]
Ailssa Mabbot will craft new weapons for Iron Bulwark members. Even new Recruits. Talk to Arathor to begin building your Iron Bulwark Reputation and Use your Recruit token once you’ve earned it to unlock Ailssa’s shop.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ironbulwarksaga/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6560/celebrateearthday.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Every Day is Earth Day[/h2]
Every day is a day to help nurture and restore the earth. We celebrate Earth Day this year on April 22nd as we remind ourselves of the beauty of nature and why it is important to cherish it.

Reed, the young Greenguard Mystic, is in Battleon under a big blue tree by the bridge to guide you back to the Voice of the Forest so you can nurture the sapling you planted last year into a sproutling. Your reward for “Revitalizing the Heartwood” is a luminous Blooming Seed Staff and the “Sproutling” title.

The Voice of the Forest has all of its quests (including the Earth Day Trove) available all year round.

notes.title: XP Boost All Week Long!
notes.content:
[h2]Get Double Experience Points All Week![/h2]
Since our regularly scheduled release was unable to go out this week, we're giving you a week of double experience points to make up for it. That means double standard experience and double class experience points. PLUS, we've thrown in double Contract of Nulgath rewards for those working on the Nulgath Saga. This will last until next week's release goes Live on either Wednesday (April 26) or Thursday (April 27).

[b]What Happened to the Release?[/b]
Well, this release relied on the use of new game building tools our team developed and are working to integrate. With all of the developer tools we are working on, we want to be sure they are stable for releasing, and they are not quite there. So, we have to delay our meeting with the Knights of the Iron Bulwark to another date. However, we are continuing to work on the next section of Nulgath Part 3 and also preparing for the early May releases [i]fourth-coming,[/i] and we are looking forward to you playing them in the coming weeks.

[b]See you in game and...[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

notes.title: NEW Legion Pinatas and Nulgath 3A Bonus Content
notes.content:
[h2]Legion Summoner[/h2]
You have pledged your undying loyalty to the Legion... but this is not enough. You must constantly strive to hone your skills in battle. The Legion Summoner is in Battleon to teach you to summon combatants to spar against and hone your skills. Summon combatants for you and your Legion allies to spar against with Legion Summoning Runes and reward your successes with tokens of honor and prestige.
This works just like the Gifting Runes, Fools Gift, Fire Starters, and other summoning monsters we’ve released. Legion Summoning Runes summon a monster for you and your friends to fight. Greater Legion Summoning Runes summons a monster that summons more monsters for a more worthy fight. The loot dropped from either of these “pinatas” can be a random item from the plethora of Legion Pinata items, but you will always get Legion Soul Remnant tokens which can be used to purchase the specific item you want from the Legion Summoner.
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/legionpinatanulgathbonus/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6557/legionpinataparty_header.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Legion Reward Shops[/h2]
The Legion Summoner has two shops: Legion Remnant Shop and Legion Battle Rewards.
Both shops contain all of the possible items that can be dropped from the summoned monsters, as well as the Legion Summoning Runes and Greater Legion Summoning Runes. All of the items in the Remnants shop, except the Runes, can be purchased with Legion Soul Remnant tokens. All of the items in the Battle Rewards shop can be purchased with Dragon Crystals.
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/legionpinatanulgathbonus/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6558/legionremnantshop.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Legion Rewards[/h2]
[list]
[*]Legion Rogue Armor
[*]Legion Rogue Hood
[*]Legion Rogue Hood with Skull
[*]Legion Rogue Belt
[*]Legion Rogue Boots
[*]Legion Rogue Gloves
[*]Legion Rogue Cape
[*]Legion Rogue Dark Dagger
[*]Legion Deathcaller Dual Skull Pauldrons
[*]Legion Runed Blade (Weapon)
[*]Legion Stabbers (Weapon)
[*]Legion Death Shiver Scythe (Weapon)
[*]Legion Skull Scepter (Weapon)
[*]Legion Dricken (Pet)
[*]Legion Dricken Travel Form ([b]Drop only[/b])
[*]Legion Dricken with Daggers (Pet)
[*]Legion Dricken with Daggers Travel Form ([b]Drop only[/b])
[/list]
[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/legionpinatanulgathbonus/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6556/nulgathbonuscontent_header.jpg[/img][/url]
Nulgath 3A: Bonus Content[/h2]
When you have completed the latest Nulgath Saga story content (3A), head back to the Wasteland and the Oversoul to earn new rewards and powerful upgrades. Plus, some new perks have been added to older content.
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/legionpinatanulgathbonus/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6555/paladingearupgrades.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Lionfang Paladin Gear Upgrades[/h2]
Below the Portal to the Oversoul in the Wasteland await Paladins Ryker and Everett. They are ready to assist you with, not only new Lionfang Paladin gear, but also, power upgrades to that gear.
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/legionpinatanulgathbonus/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6554/errantvoidsofnulgath.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]World Bosses: Errant Voids of Nulgath[/h2]
New foes roam the Oversoul and the Wastelands. They are called Errant Voids of Nulgath. Skew will make you a Dark Deal to hunt these Errant Voids, but they are tough and won’t cross your path often. Make sure you’re ready to make this dark deal.

Thok and Sir Fainal are patrolling the Wastelands with allied Warriors and Guardians, and they have brought spare Phoenix Warrior equipment for those who need it. Thok will also make you a sweeter deal for hunting the Errant Voids and provide assistance while on his quest.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/legionpinatanulgathbonus/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6553/bladequestpets.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Skew’s Quest Pets[/h2]
Are you looking for more power? Well Skew offers you a dangerous quest with the promise of the 8th Betrayal Blade of Nulgath Quest Pet as a reward.

If you already own the Phoenix Blade of Nulgath, you might see a sentient version hanging around the portal to the Oversoul. You should talk to it and ask what that’s about. Maybe it’ll join you on your quests??

[b]Note:[/b] The Skew Quest Pet has been updated with even more quests, and the “A Lucky Deal” quest (wherever you find it) has been updated to include monsters from the Oversoul as well.

[h2]Last Chance[/h2]
[list]
[*]Grenwog event content leaves May 3rd, 2023
[*]Returning April Fool’s Day event content leaves May 3rd, 2023 (Burger Hero and Pizzamancer are permanent)
[/list]
[h2]
Thank you and… Next![/h2]
The Knights of the Iron Bulwark will be called upon for another quest soon. Suit up with Aranthor in Yulgar’s Inn to prepare for the call.

[b]See you in game and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

notes.title: The Grenwog Returns
notes.content:
[h2]Grenwog Hunter[/h2]
Hooper has been investigating the Grenwog for years. The tracks always lead him to Battleon’s surroundings, but he has never caught sight of the creature. Hop down deep into what may be the Grenwog’s Lair, and fight monsters of all flavors: Rock Candy, Taffy, Hard Candy, and... Angry Carrots? While you’re in the cavern, gather Pixie Dust to harvest and place carrots to lure the Grenwog to you, just like a professional Grenwog Hunter would do!

[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/grenwog2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5983/promo-aq3dgrenwogholeitemsdage.jpg[/img][/url]

Hooper’s Grenwog Shop[/h2]
If you’re lucky enough to encounter the Grenwog, and survive, return to Hopper with the Chocolate Grenwog Eggs you collected. He will happily trade them for some delicious new armors and weapons.
You can also earn Chocolate Grenwog Eggs from Time Carrots and the Bunny Berserker in Old Battleon. However, Grenwog is the only monster with guaranteed Chocolate Egg drops every time.

[h2]What’s going on in Old Battleon?[/h2]
Old Battleon sprouted... Mysterious Time Carrots?! We have no idea what's up with that, but maybe you can investigate! Whatever the case may be, keep an eye out for the dreaded Bunny Berserker…

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/grenwog2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5985/promo-aq3deastermonsterdrops.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Monster Drops[/h2]
There are plenty of drops to go around!
Fight the Grenwog and Past Battleon monsters for a chance at picking up various delicious carrot items or a Grenwog Pet.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/grenwog2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6549/april2023promo.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]April Promotional Item[/h2]
[i]This smiling creature assures you it only wants to keep you company and keep your head warm. If not hat, why hat shaped?[/i]

The [b]Creature 83 Head Warmer[/b] is included with all packages from the Upgrade Shop, including Guardian and Lore Strider. Guardian packages also give the [b]Albino Creature 83 Head Warmer[/b]. 
Check your inventory on your next log in after purchase.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/april2023promo/]Click here to read the full details.[/url]

[h2]Mobile Ads Update[/h2]
Mobile Ads are now working. Mobile players can once again earn free Dragon Crystals by watching ads. Watch on!

[h2]Last Chance[/h2]
[list]
[*]Returning April Fool’s Day event content leaves May 3rd, 2023 (Burger Hero and Pizzamancer are permanent)
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/grenwog2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5982/promo-aq3dcatchingthegrenwog.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you and Next…[/h2]
Nulgath side-content is getting final touches and testing. Get ready to return to the Oversoul to earn new weapons and armor.
 
[b]See you in-game and...
Battle On![/b]

notes.title: Welcome to Burger Hero
notes.content:
[h2]The Grand Opening![/h2]
Welcome to Burger Hero, home of the Hero Burger. You’d be a fool to miss the Grand Opening of Burger Hero. People are flocking to this new fast food establishment from all over Lore. Wandy is in Battleon promoting the restaurant with free coupons!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/burgerhero/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6546/freshestingredients.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Burger Hero[/h2]
Burger Hero is brought to you by Crustation Man. Line up for your chance to taste Dricken Tendies, a Monster Burger, a Hero Gyro, and the Hero Burger. At first glance, everything seems great, but something terrible is clogging the toilets and there is something unusual about the food supply.
With the buzz Burger Hero is getting, it will be sticking around for a long time… (it’s evergreen).

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/burgerhero/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6545/jointheburgerheroteam.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Hey there Part Timer[/h2]
If you’re in need of a job, Burger Hero will find a place for you. Crustation Man has some Part Time shift work for you to earn Burger Hero Promotion Points. Use these points to buy exclusive items from the Burger Hero Merch Shop. Pick up the Part Timer Rank token and Use it to unlock the title “Part Timer” and special quests with Wandy.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/burgerhero/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6547/wandyandcrustationman.jpg[/img][/url]

Wandy is the lead server at Burger Hero. She’s a go-getter who knows how to get ahead. Talk to her to pick up some extra shifts and earn more Promotion Points. Maybe Crustation Man will finally give you that promotion you’ve been asking for.
 
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/burgerhero/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6544/pizzamancer.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Pizza Time![/h2]
Burger slinging isn’t your vibe? Peter P is hanging out by the Burger Hero with a different proposal. How about becoming a Pizzamancer?

Pizzamancer is a new cosmetic class requiring the Moglomancer class. Pizzamancer includes new class skill animations, new skill names, and the “Cowabunga” title. Plus, you unlock the Pizzamancer Gear shop to earn the full Pizzamancer armor set and Pizza Slicer weapon. Don’t have the Moglomancer class yet? Head to the Pet Shop and find Mo G. Lynn to start earning the class or buy it from the Classes menu for Dragon Crystals.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/burgerhero/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6548/verysmolpetshop.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Very Smol Pet Shop[/h2]
Casey and his cat friends really love pizza. Though maybe not as much as Peter P. They are pretty chatty if you want to lounge around while digesting your Hero Burgers or after a long shift. Casey also has a Very Smol Pet Shop for you to buy, or turn into, one of these adorable cats for yourself.
 
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/burgerhero/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5446/aprilfools2021.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Returning April Fool’s Fun[/h2]
It’s not April Fool’s Day without Piddie the Fool! He’s back in Battleon with his Fool’s Day shop, including Mutatium potions and Fool’s Gifts. Meanwhile, a giant Chickencow has landed in the Social District and Aria could use your help investigating its mysterious appearance.

[h2]PvP Block Skill[/h2]
The Block skill in PvP has been adjusted and is ready to play. It no longer has Reflect and you are Silenced for the duration.

[h2]Last Chance[/h2]
[list]
[*]Returning April Fool’s Day event content leaves May 3rd, 2023 (Burger Hero and Pizzamancer are evergreen)
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/burgerhero/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6543/burgerhero.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
More Nulgath side-content is coming soon and Hooper is currently tracking the Grenwog to Battleon.

[b]See you in game and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

notes.title: King of the Makai - New Quest Pet
notes.content:
[h2]King Masher[/h2]
This is King Masher: King of all Makai. He is a new Farming Quest Pet with exclusive rewards via Nulgath Farming methods, developed by Sir Fainal Oremor. His many quests will take you into The Fiend Lands to collect Essences of Nulgath, Contracts of Nulgath, Tainted Gems, and more. Buy this new quest pet from the Special Pets shop on Gaz in Battleon (or the Chest icon on the screen) and click on King Masher to pop up his quests and get started.

[b]Note:[/b] The Nulgath Saga region has been renamed The Fiend Lands in the Travel and Adventure Menus.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/kingmakaiquestpet/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6520/kingmakaimasherpet.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Contract of Nulgath: The Lucky Deal[/h2]
This particular quest is a new design. It is not meant to be farmed, like the others, since the drop rate is extremely low, even compared to the other Contracts of Nulgath farming method. This quest is meant to be carried with you while you farm the other Nulgath Farming quests.

Every monster, mini-boss, and boss of the Wasteland; and every monster, mini-boss, and main Fiend Boss in the Catacombs (with the exception of the lesser insects in catacomb 2) have a very rare chance of dropping an Unidentified 13.

Seleden Forest monsters are excluded from this quest. Only Wasteland and Catacombs monsters will count for the Quest Item drop, so it is best to have completed Part 2 of the Nulgath Saga before accepting these quests.

[b]Note:[/b] Contract of Nulgath max stack has been increased from 1 to 2. And this quest is also available in Bamboozle's farming quests as well as being retroactively added to the Crag Quest Pet.

[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/kingmakaiquestpet/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6521/kingmakaicape.jpg[/img][/url]

The King Masher’s Quest Reward Preview Shop[/h2]
This shop is to preview reward items only. Ignore the Impossible Preview Tokens of Nulgath cost.
[list]
[*]Complete the [b]To Serve a King[/b] quest to get:
King Masher Clinger (back - shown in image)
[*]Complete the [b]King Makai Core Essence[/b] quest to get:
King Masher Travel Form
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/kingmakaiquestpet/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6522/doublecontractofnulgathdroprate.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]One Week Only: Bonus Nulgath Contract Rewards[/h2]
All methods of obtaining Contracts of Nulgath have been doubled for 1 week - including the quest pet rewards. This bonus ends with next week’s release.
 
[h2]Bug Notice[/h2]
We're aware that some players have been unable to talk to some NPCs to turn in / complete their quests. This bug is currently being investigated. Thank you for your bug reports.

[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/kingmakaiquestpet/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6518/march2023promo.jpg[/img][/url]

March Promo Item[/h2]
[i]This battleaxe's three merciless skulls hunger for the souls of the fallen.[/i]

Buy any upgrade package or DragonCrystal pack from the Upgrade Shop during March 2023 to get the [b]Merciless Battleaxe of the Legion[/b]!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/kingmakaiquestpet/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6379/promo-giftleaderboard.png[/img][/url]

[h2]2022 Gift’thulu Giving Leaderboard[/h2]
The top 10 Gift’thulu givers have been immortalized on the [url=https://aq3d.com/about/leaderboards/]AQ3D.com Leaderboards page[/url] and were rewarded with a Greatest Gifter badge and title.
 
[h2]Last Chance[/h2]
Lunar New Year content has left until next year.
[list]
[*]Double Nulgath Contract Rewards ends March 8th, 2023
[*]Heroes Heart Day content leaves March 15th, 2023
[/list]
[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
A new venture is coming to Battleon that is sure to whet your appetite. Feeling hungry, Hero?
Following that is this year's Dage Collection.  
 
See you in game and…
Battle On!

notes.title: Beleen Brings Back the Cursed 20th Anniversary of Doom!
notes.content:
[h2]Back from the Dead[/h2]
Relive the Cursed 20th Anniversary of Doom event with all new host Beleen, the Pretty Pinkomancer. Play through this event in the style of a B-Horror movie marathon with six frighteningly terrible games. Or are they so awful they’re good? You decide!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/beleen20th][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6502/20thanniversarybeleen_header1.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]What is this event?[/h2]
You must be new to our game. Welcome! 

The event celebrates the 20th anniversary of Artix Entertainment creating games… with a few adjustments from its original run in 2022. It is now hosted by Beleen, the Pretty Pinkomancer, and features voice acting, music, and cameos from returning guests George Lowe, Aurelio Voltaire, and Kimberly Freeman. You're the guest of honor in this special event and it is now permanent content. So grab your sword, dust off your spell book and head to Yulgar’s Inn to start the adventure…

If you would like information about the original event, [url=https://aq3d.com/news/20thanniversary/]click to read this post[/url].

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/beleen20th][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6497/beleen2.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Who is Beleen?[/h2]
Beleen is the perky, pink-loving punsmith who joined the team as one of the main writers for AdventureQuest Worlds during the first part of the Chaos Lord Saga, then flooded our marketing and community management teams with her positivity and puns. Recently, she's returned to work on several in-game events with the teams... including the script for this event! That's why it made sense to have her take over as the host for the event’s revival, and finally bring Beleen into 3D.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/beleen20th][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6504/lookwhosback.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Look Who’s Back![/h2]
While we had to say goodbye to some of the special guests in the original event, a few friends decided to stick around. Boy are we lucky to have them.

[b]Aurelio Voltaire[/b]
You’ll find him inside of Scarbucks, playing guitar for the locals. When you finish the Scarbucks game, you’ll unlock the dance party where you can listen to a track from Aurelio Voltaire’s latest album “The Black Labyrinth - A Requiem for the Goblin King”.

[b]The A.I. formerly known as Kimberly Freeman[/b]
Veterans of our games may not recognize her in this event. She has taken the form of your good pal and robot A.I. known as KIMBr:L3 in Derpicorn Apocalypse. Turn up your volume to hear a song from her band Audio Rate FM play in the background.

[b]George Lowe[/b]
There’s no better way to pass the time in AFK: The Game than with quips of George Lowe cheering (or jeering?) you in the background and rewarding you with a shop full of prizes for your time well spent.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/beleen20th][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6500/completeyourtrove.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Your 20th Anniversary Trove[/h2]
It’s time to complete your trove quest! While we did remove the ability to obtain any of the items in the original event with “20th Anniversary” in the title, we made an exception for those who already started their 20th Anniversary Trove. It took a lot of brainstorming and fine-tuning, but as long as you already started the trove during the original release in 2022, you can still obtain these items to turn in for your trove. You will have to be on the quest to turn in that item in order to unlock the item in a shop and/or for it to drop from a monster in the appropriate map. So go forth and complete your 20th Anniversary Trove!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/beleen20th][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6501/marathonofadventures.png[/img][/url]

[h2]What’s New in this Event?[/h2]
We wanted to reward the players who went above and beyond during the original release. Those who achieved the highest ranks possible in any of our B-Horror adventures and earned Legendary items. So, we made a few adjustments to honor those achievements in this permanent version of the event.

[b]Main Story Line:[/b]
[list]
[*]Bean Twilly Pet is a Legacy item.
[/list]

[b]Ring of Doom:[/b]
[list]
[*]Daily quest reward increased 100 medals
[*]"Lord of the Ring of Doom" badge/title is Legacy and replaced with "King of the Ring of Doom" - Legendary "Ring of Doom Champ Belt" is Legacy and replaced with Epic "Ring of Doom Grand-Champ Belt" with higher requirement
[/list]

[b]Zom-bae:[/b]
[list]
[*]Legendary "Axe of 1000 Corpses" is Legacy and replaced with Epic "Axe of 999 Corpses"
[/list]

[b]8-Bit Battleon:[/b]
[list]
[*]Legendary "Pixel Blade of Awe" is Legacy and renamed “Classic Pixel Blade of Awe”. It has been replaced with Epic "Pixel Blade of Awe"
[/list]

[b]AFK:[/b]
[list]
[*]"AFK Legend" badge/title is Legacy and replaced with "AFK Eternal"
[/list]
 
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/beleen20th][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6505/hhd20212.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Bard of Heroes Heart Day is in Battleon[/h2]
Say Hello to Maurice, the Bard of Heroes Heart Day. His arrival heralds the coming of this year’s Heroes Heart Day Collection next week. In the meantime, you can browse his Heroes Heart Clothing shop, previous collections, and take on a quest to Spread the Love throughout Battleon.

[h2]Last Chance[/h2]
[list]
[*]Camp Gonnagetcha closes on Feb 15th, 2023
[*]2022 Gift’thulu Giving Leaderboard ends Feb 22nd, 2023
[*]Blaze Gifting and Social District event ends on Feb 22nd, 2023
[*]Lunar New Year content leaves March 1st, 2023
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/beleen20th][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6499/heroesheartday.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank[b] you and… Next![/b][/h2]
The 2023 Heroes Heart Day Collection will be available in Maurice’s shop!

[b]See you in game and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

notes.title: Celebrate 2023: Year of the Rabbit
notes.content:
[h2]Happy Lunar New Year![/h2]
This year’s lunar zodiac animal is the Rabbit. In Chinese culture, rabbits symbolize the moon because the shadows of the moon resemble a rabbit. Our team has created several items with these themes in mind.

Read on to find out what they are and where to get them…
 
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunarny2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6492/lunarnewyearshop.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Saber’s Lunar New Year Shops[/h2]
[h3]Lunar New Year Shop[/h3]
[list]
[*]The Hare's Blade of Fate [weapon]
[*]Rabbit Cheongsam [armor]
[*]Rabbit Changshan [armor]
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunarny2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6493/moonlightshop.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3]Moonlight Shop[/h3]
Saber will trade you these special items for delicious Moonlight Biscuits from Darkovia. Moonlight Biscuits drop from monsters all around Darkovia this February, including the dungeons.
[list]
[*]Sticky Dumpling [consumable travel form]
[*]Lucky Golden Earrings [helm]
[*]The Hare's Lucky Katar [weapon]
[*]The Hare's Auspicious Blade [weapon]
[*]The Hare's Prosperous Voulge [weapon]
[*]The Hare’s Charm [use to get “Lucky Rabbit’s Foot” title]
[/list]
 
[h2]Lucky Envelope Daily[/h2]
Turn in 5 Moonlight Biscuits for a Lucky Envelope and some Firecrackers! This is based on the real life tradition of giving red envelopes during the Lunar New Year celebrations which symbolize good wishes and luck for the future. Red envelopes usually contain money, so these Lucky Envelopes can be sold for 5000 gold.
 
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunarny2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6494/darkoviaforestfullmoon.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Strange Happenings in Darkovia[/h2]
Strange visitors are drawn to Darkovia’s Forest this Lunar New Year. Keep an eye out for anything strange and report back to Saber with your findings.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunarny2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6466/startyourownbonfire.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Horn of Hype Hotfix[/h2]
The Horn of Hype had an issue where Party Blaze could be Stunned and Silenced making him unable to spawn anything. The hotfix went out on the same day, however, those who purchased the Horn of Hype before the fix have been reimbursed with a new Horn of Hype in their inventory. Blaze on!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunarny2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6491/february2023promo.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]February Promo Item[/h2]
Get the Heartfelt Saber free with any purchase from the Upgrade Shop. Guardian’s also receive the Rose Gold Heartfelt Saber. [url=https://aq3d.com/news/feb23promo/]Read the full details in the post.[/url]
 
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunarny2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6467/animeopeningvideocontest.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Anime Opening Video Contest[/h2]
Make an anime opening video using the Tailor Scouts theme song for the chance to win one of 3 Emperor's Chests! Or make a digital Tailor Scouts poster for the chance to win one of 5 Warlord's Chests. Submissions accepted until February 8th. [url=https://aq3d.com/news/tailorscoutcontest/]See the full post for details.[/url]

[h2]
Last Chance[/h2]
[b]Gaz’s Last Chance Shop has closed. All promo items from 2021 and 2022 are now Legacy.[/b]
[list]
[*]Camp Gonnagetcha closes on Feb 15th, 2023
[*]2022 Gift’thulu Giving Leaderboard ends Feb 22nd, 2023
[*]Blaze Gifting and Social District event ends on Feb 22nd, 2023
[*]Lunar New Year content leaves March 1st, 2023
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunarny2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6495/yearoftherabbit-notext.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
Maurice, the bard of Heroes Heart Day will be returning to Battleon next week, shortly followed by this year’s collection.

notes.title: Blaze's Bonfire Returns!
notes.content:
[h2]Who is Blaze?[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/blazebonfire2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6463/blaze.jpg[/img][/url]

[i]"A long time ago the raw element of fire was threatening to consume the world in flames. Blaze sacrificed his body to control the flame, imbuing him with the power to control fire, ensuring it does not consume the world. The flame slowly burns away at his body and when he uses his power, there are severe consequences. He wants to be a light to the world, but the brighter he burns, the shorter his wick."[/i]

Blaze in real life is a programmer and game designer for AdventureQuest 3D. His passion is in class design and enhancing the social aspects of our game.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/blazebonfire2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6464/blazebirthdaygifts.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Battleon is a Bonfire[/h2]
There is a Blaze in the Social District. Actually, there are FOUR different forms of Blaze to fight. As usual, talk to Rose to earn Social Flyers for Social Event Prizes. Plus, Blaze has a Daily quest “Illuminate the Shadow” which gives 100 BlazeCoins for completing it. You may also get lucky and receive the rare Chibi Blaze Pet as a drop.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/blazebonfire2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6465/risingphoenix.jpg[/img][/url]

In Battleon, Blaze has shops full of goodies to buy. The BlazeCoin Gift Shop has lots of hot weapons and armor sets, including 1 new armor set and 4 new weapons. You can also get BlazeCoins by defeating Gifting Inferno and Gifting Fire.

Blaze’s Birthday Shop has all of the same things as the Gift Shop but with a few extras, and everything here costs DragonCrystals. The Birthday Shop exclusive items are the Summoning items:
[list]
[*]Horn of Hype ([b]NEW![/b] Summons “Party Blaze”)
[*]Fire Starter (Summons “Gifting Fire”)
[*]Wide Blaze’s Calling Card (Summons “Wide Blaze”)
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/blazebonfire2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6466/startyourownbonfire.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Horn of Hype[/h2]
The latest of Blaze’s summoning items. Use the Horn of Hype, Fire Starter, and Wide Blaze Calling Card to summon an enemy for your fellow players to fight.

Use the Horn of Hype to summon a Party Blaze which, itself, summons up to 6 Firestarters, or something even more special. While Party Blaze is invincible, all spawns killed do drop loot. Party Blaze despawns after he has reached his summoning maximum.

For more detailed information on the Bonfire, [url=https://aq3d.com/news/BlazesBonfire2021]read this post from the first Blaze’s Bonfire event[/url].

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/blazebonfire2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6467/animeopeningvideocontest.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Anime Opening Video Contest[/h2]
Make an anime opening video using the Tailor Scouts theme song for the chance to win one of 3 Emperor's Chests and a badge! Or make a digital Tailor Scouts poster for the chance to win one of 5 Warlord's Chests. Submissions accepted until February 8th. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tailorscoutcontest/]See the full post for details[/url].

[h2]
Last Chance[/h2]
Frostval maps, collection, and shops have left AQ3D until next December.
[list]
[*]Gaz’s Last Chance Shop leaves January 31st, 2023
[*]2022 Gift’thulu Giving Leaderboard now ends Feb 22nd, 2023
[*]Camp Gonnagetcha closes on Feb 15th, 2023
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/blazebonfire2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6462/blazesbonfirereturnsheader-notext.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
Return to the Social District next week as Saber opens her Lunar New Year shop to celebrate the year of the Rabbit! Plus, the February promo item will become available.

[b]See you in game and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

notes.title: New Year's Gift!
notes.content:
[h2]Happy 2023![/h2]
Ring in the new year with our gift to you – 30 more inventory slots. Head to Upgrade Shop to load up on more DragonCrystals to get this month’s new promo item, then talk to Gaz in Battleon for a last chance to get promo items from previous years.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nygift2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6445/freeinventoryspace2023.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Our Gift to You[/h2]
Everyone’s inventory space is getting an increase. This is our gift to you! Everyone gets 30 more slots. Guardians also get an additional 10 for a total of 40 new slots. This increase now makes the base inventory 90 total slots for all future players as well.

[b]Note:[/b] Due to the app stores not being able to finish the review process in time, the inventory expansion has been delayed. The changes will go live as soon as it is approved.
 
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nygift2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6447/lastchancepromoshop.jpg[/img][/url]

Gaz has collected all of the regular (non-Guardian) promo items from the past two years and put them in a shop. Now is your chance to get any regular promo item you missed out on. Gaz is offering these items for a flat fee of 1,000 Dragon Crystals. The Last Chance Shop is only open for a limited time and will leave his stall on January 31st. The promo items from 2021 and 2022 will then become Legacy.

[b]Reminder:[/b] Guardians cam always purchase any Guardian-only promo item they missed from Fortes in his "Special Guardian Rewards" shop with Guardian Class Tokens.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nygift2023/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6444/jan23promo.jpg[/img][/url]

[i]Forged in the Furious Fires of Mount Nulgore. This Axe holds the rage and fury of Nulgath and his followers.[/i]
The Axe of Nulgore is included with all packages from the Upgrade Shop, including Guardian and Lore Strider. Guardian packages also give the Toxic Axe of Nulgore. Check your inventory on your next log in after purchase.

[b]Note:[/b] All accounts that had made a purchase from the Upgrade Shop prior to this update on January 1st, 2023, were retroactively awarded these items.

notes.title: Lolosia Saga: Atlantis Finale
notes.content:
Are you ready for the final boss fight of the year? Join us in AQ3D to complete the entire Lolosia Saga. Complete the Sea God’s Trident and reach the new level cap of 42! Plus, we’re preparing for the New Year’s Eve Live Events.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/atlantisfinale/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6438/aq3d-bestdefenseisagoodoffense.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Shipyard (Dungeon)[/h2]
King Nautilus will help repair the trident but Atlantis will be vulnerable to the Sea Ogres with him being distracted by this task. Find the Shipyard and stop the Sea Ogre incursions once and for all. Inside this dungeon you will battle your way through Sea Ogres, dangerous sea animals, and… darkness.

[b]Hint:[/b] Look for the sand paths and use pools of Light to combat the Darkness.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/atlantisfinale/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6440/aq3d-theseagodrises.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Sea God Rises (Boss Fight)[/h2]
Race to the water’s surface to face the Sea God once the trident has been reforged. Amongst the debris of shipwrecks, avoid the Sea God’s tentacles and combat his powerful attacks with help from your friends. You must find a way to subdue him to bring peace to all who sail, and live in, the sea.
Talk to Aquella to replay the story version of this fight, or play the level 40 Challenge with up to 10 of your fellow players.

[b]Note:[/b] There is also a chance to pick up a Coral Headpiece which resembles Atlantean Water Elf ears.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/atlantisfinale/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6441/aq3d-aquasoldiereliteaquasoldier.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Aqua Soldier Gear (Level 40+)[/h2]
You can obtain pieces of Aqua Soldier gear from the Shipyard and the Sea God fight. However, Sulfin has returned to his shop with Kenai in the city of Atlantis. They have shops to help you acquire missing pieces and upgrade their power stats, if you like. 

[h2]King Nautilus Set (Cosmetic)[/h2]
The Royal Guards know how you can get your hands on a set of King Nautilus’s clothing. Earn enough Royal Favor to persuade the palace tailors to let you take home a set of your own. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/atlantisfinale/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6435/aq3d-2022frostvalcollection.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]2022 Frostval Collection[/h2]
Huzzah, it’s here! Visit Blizzy in Battleon or in the town of Winter’s Grasp to get the 2022 Frostval Collection now. Buy the Collector’s Chest and get the title “Frosted”.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/atlantisfinale/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6439/aq3d-elviratravelcrystal.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Elvira is Preparing to Leave AQ3D[/h2]
Elvira has moved next to the Travel Portal in preparation to leave the game. All access to 20th Anniversary content has moved with her and is only available on Elvira now. When Artix finishes his Live Events on New Year’s Eve, Elvira and all of the 20th Anniversary content will be removed. The individual mini-game maps will return to the game permanently after we have done some re-working to completely remove some of our special guests from the content. 20th Anniversary Troves will be able to be completed when the maps return. 

[b]For more information,[url=https://aq3d.com/news/questions2022/] read Artix’s design notes post[/url].[/b]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/atlantisfinale/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6442/live-events.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Ring in 2023 with Artix[/h2]
Artix will be back for his New Year’s Eve Live Events to ring in 2023 around the world. This year he will only be able to host 3 Live Events, but we encourage you all to ring in the new year with your friends in AQ3D as well. 

Also, go get your [u]New Year’s gift from Artix’s Holiday Presents shop[/u].

[b]New Years Eve Live Event Schedule[/b]

[h2]Last Chance[/h2]
[list]
[*] 20th Anniversary Event ends around December 31st, 2022 (depending on your time zone). 
[*] 50% Dragon Crystal Bonus ends January 18, 2023.
[*] Frostval maps and shops leave January 25th, 2023
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/atlantisfinale/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/4655/aq3d_2020_newyears.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
Next week Gaz will be offering a rare opportunity to acquire any of the non-Guardian monthly promo items for a limited time but at a steep price. Don’t fret, because you will also get your New Year’s Gift from the team: Free extra inventory spaces! 
 
[b]Happy Holidays and…[/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]

notes.title: Frostval Collection and New Town of Winter's Grasp
notes.content:
[h2]Winter’s Grasp[/h2]
Start a new Frostval adventure in the town of Winter’s Grasp. A haven for all creatures, Winter’s Grasp invites you to join their celebration. Meet the residents and find out what makes this town so special.

You can also find your way to the original Frostval event maps and dungeons with [b]Blizzy[/b] here in Winter’s Grasp and in Battleon.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/wintersgrasp/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6429/aq3d-mayorkane.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Mayor Kayne[/h2]
The mayor is busy getting ready for the big celebration. Everyone is welcome. Care to lend a hand? And maybe you can help him find out what is behind the mysterious beast sightings recently. Word seems to have spread and drawn the attention of Hale, a monster hunter.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/wintersgrasp/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6431/aq3d-themonsterofmountscrunch.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Monster of Mount Scrunch[/h2]
Hale is certain the reports of the beast sightings point to werewolves, but Mayor Kayne is not convinced. Follow the beast up Mount Scrunch and learn what this beast is once and for all.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/wintersgrasp/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6436/aq3d-mountscrunchrewards.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Mount Scrunch Rewards[/h2]
Your hard work isn’t for nothing. The various beasts on Mount Scrunch have loot hidden up there. As you battle your way to the mountaintop, you may get some of these awesome rewards.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/wintersgrasp/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6432/aq3d-wintersgrasprewards.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Hale’s Winter’s Grasp Rewards[/h2]
Return to Hale to get similar monster hunting armor pieces made with the green fur of the monster and a couple new weapons.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/wintersgrasp/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6428/hollyjollyheadsplitter.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Frozen Artifact[/h2]
Hale would like you to retrace your steps to be sure we know the truth about the monster of Mount Scrunch. Help her out and you’ll obtain an elusive frozen artifact, the Holly Jolly Head Splitter. [i]This item will become [b]Legacy[/b] (unobtainable)[/i] after Frostval leaves around January 25, 2023. Get it while you can!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/wintersgrasp/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6425/aq3d-2022frostvalcollection.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]2022 Frostval Collection[/h2]
Huzzah, it’s here! Visit Blizzy in Battleon or in the town of Winter’s Grasp to get the 2022 Frostval Collection now. Buy the Collector’s Chest and get the title “[b]Frosted[/b]”. [url=https://aq3d.com/news/2022frostvalcollection/]Read the details in the Frostval Collection pos[/url]t.
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/wintersgrasp/]

[img]https://aq3d.com/media/6421/calendarcollage_1920x1080.png[/img][/url]

[h2]2023 Artix Calendar Pre-Order is now LIVE![/h2]
Unlock Paladin Chronomancer exclusive in-game items for AQWorlds, AQ3D, DragonFable, EpicDuel & AQ Classic. Shipping starts in late Dec. Pre-Orders ship first, or you can SKIP THE LINE & save with the 20th Anniversary Bundle! Pre-Order now on [url=https://www.heromart.com/]Heromart.com[/url]

[*]50% Dragon Crystal Bonus ends January 18, 2023.

[/list]

notes.title: Atlantis Update + XP Bonus
notes.content:
[h2]Catch Up with Bonus Experience All Week![/h2]
Whether you are trying to rank up your classes or trying to max out the level cap, you will get further this week with 50% bonus Experience Points (including Class Experience). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b755635eec9275341205c532ca61a452c848061c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Free Gift and Gift’thulus![/h2]
Talk to Artix in Yulgar’s Inn to receive your Holiday Present. Choose one or more of the free gifts in the Holiday Presents shop. Also, check your inventory because Frostval came early. You will find a handful of free Gifting Runes in your Tokens so you can spawn Gift’thulus with your friends and fellow players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5c1be3c646df47ce9b4fb5bfc0fe88d89e00eee8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Where is the Atlantis Finale?[/h2]
The team has been working hard on the new maps, dungeons, and overall gameplay experience; however, we do not currently feel that it is ready for release. After discussing it with our team, we decided that delaying the release is what was best for the wellbeing of the team and the player experience. Since players frequently request that we take the extra time to give the best quality experience that we can, we feel confident that you will support our decision. So, we are giving ourselves a couple extra weeks to release a finale worth waiting for.

One of the setbacks faced was with the Unity upgrade. Our system has been long out of date because it takes a lot of dev time to make our game compatible with the new features in an upgrade. However, we have seen the issues that persist from being out of date becoming more frequent. During the upgrade process we ran into some kinks that require our devs to go in manually to fix. We ended up reverting the upgrade for now until we can set aside the dedicated time required to successfully resolve these issues. As of now, we have no concrete estimate of when the upgrade will happen; though it will be the start to solving long-standing bugs and providing a better experience for everyone. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0daabce13f9cc0607e1ecd30cdc640590e0621ac.png[/img]

[h2]Black Friday/Cyber Monday Shops Extended[/h2]
With the delay of the Atlantis Finale, we have decided to keep the Black Friday and Cyber Monday shops in-game for one more week.

notes.title: Lolosia Saga: Part 3 - Journey to Atlantis
notes.content:
[h2]Explore the Lost City of Atlantis[/h2]

Atlantis is no city of ruins. It’s well kept and quite statuesque. Yet… there doesn’t seem to be anyone around. Where did all of the inhabitants go? Explore the city and see what you can find out.

[b]Note: [/b]Atlantis has been added to the Adventure Menu - World Areas, but you must have be on or completed the “Journey to Atlantis” quest to unlock it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ad53d57a2b0e97ebb8712262e9973f7da4d7bf3b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Aquella[/h2]

This is one tough Water Elf. Aquella doesn’t like that you and your friends are in Atlantis. If you can prove that you’re there for noble matters, then she may be inclined to help you get what you’re after. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0d08e43d50f52c773a413b23dd03b50480dfe18f.jpg[/img]

[h2]An Audience with the King[/h2]

A daunting task lies ahead of you. Completing the trident helps the Pirates and the Ninjas, but why should Atlanteans care about what happens to “topsiders”? You must convince the King of Atlantis to let you take the third piece of the trident. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1a8b8505de5889654368b9b87fa9969c3996f6d5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Atlantis Mini-Collection[/h2]

Talk to Shelladonna in Battleon to get your hands on this treasure! Purchase the Atlantis Collector’s Chest and your Sea Ogre pet will open the collection for you whenever you click on it.

[list]
[*] Atlantis Collector’s Chest (includes badge and title “[b]Sea-Bastion[/b]”)
[*] Sea Ogre Travel Form
[*] Sea Ogre Pet (Collection Exclusive)
[*] Royal Atlantean Armor
[*] Royal Atlantean Helm
[*] Royal Atlantean Shoulders
[*] Royal Atlantean Left Shoulder
[*] Royal Atlantean Cape
[*] Royal Atlantean Gloves
[*] Royal Atlantean Boots
[*] Royal Atlantean Belt
[*] Royal Atlantean Spear
[*] Royal Atlantean Spear with Shield
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d6fc7b411b84a6982456e66c44b393483c799a11.jpg[/img]

[h2]Water Elf Armor Set[/h2]

Show Aquella that you’re here to help and she’ll reward you with your own set of Water Elf clothes. You’ll look almost like the Atlanteans with this outfit. If only you could do something about your ears…  

[h2]Last Chance[/h2]

[list]
[*] Black Friday and Cyber Mondays shops leave Battleon on December 14th.
[*] 20th Anniversary Event ends [b]around December 30th, 2022[/b]. Event game maps will be moved to Adventure Menu permanently
[*] 50% Dragon Crystal Bonus ends January 18, 2023.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/32ec61a1d2dd43fb642bf5b56d75d2b00f4da1b0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]

The final chapter of the Lolosia Saga is coming to a close. You can look forward to new dungeons, drops, and a level cap increase! Plus, the 2022 Frostval Collection is coming soon.

See you in game and...

[b]Battle on![/b]

notes.title: Prepare to Enter Atlantis
notes.content:
The Blade of the Deep is ready to set sail to Atlantis! Grab your SCUBA gear and get ready to explore the mysteries of the great deep below. But first… you’ve got to figure out how to get pirate Capt. Rhubarb into the Shadow of the Wind village. Also, get your free gift of Holiday Spear-It with any purchase from the Upgrade Shop this month!

[h2]Rhubarb in Disguise[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/atlantisprep/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6404/aq3d-rhubarbindisguise.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3]{Spoiler Warning: Do not read this section if you are not caught up on the Lolosia Saga][/h3]
Yuki Jin and Capt. Rhubarb agreed to work together to find the third piece of the trident. The residents of Yokai aren’t aware of this. A pirate can’t just walk into the Shadow of the Wind village. Gather materials to make a ninja disguise for Capt. Rhubarb so he can meet Yuki Jin at the docks and set sail to the lost city of Atlantis!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/atlantisprep/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6405/aq3d-brinybrewedbeverage.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Briny Brewed Beverage[/h2]
Happy Fisk is excited about you going to Atlantis and what that could mean for business. He hopes to create a drink that Atlanteans would enjoy and that Blue Bart can add to his menu. Fisk would like your help coming up with drink recipes to try out. Complete your underwater preparations to unlock this special quest from Happy Fisk on Lolosia and earn a special reward. CHEERS!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/atlantisprep/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6406/aq3d-leaderboards.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Leaderboards on AQ3D.com[/h2]
View the top scorers from AFK: The Game and top givers of Gift’thulu in 2021 now on [url=https://aq3d.com/about/leaderboards/]AQ3D.com[/url]. We added a new “Leaderboards” tab under “Games” on the navigation menu at the top of the page. Click on “Minute Men” to see the AFK top scorers, and “Gift’thulu 2021” to see the top 10 Gift’thulu gifters.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/atlantisprep/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6401/dec22promo.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Gift of Holiday Spear-It[/h2]
Spread holiday cheer when you log in to reload your DragonCrystals (with 50% extra) this December and get the gift of Holiday Spear-It! Guardians will also receive a Frosty Holiday Spear-It with purchase or can go to the Guardian Tower to purchase one with Guardian Class Tokens.

[h2]Last Chance[/h2]
[list]
[*]Black Friday and Cyber Mondays shops leave Battleon on December 14th.
[*]20th Anniversary Event ends around January 1st, 2023. Event game maps will be moved to Adventure Menu permanently
[*]50% Dragon Crystal Bonus ends January 18, 2023.
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/atlantisprep/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6407/atlantis-preview2.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you and… Next![/h2]
Explore the lost city of Atlantis and meet its inhabitants! New creatures and adventures await you in the great below.

[b]See you in game![/b]
[b]Battle On![/b]
