A dark alternate dimension is contained within a large mysterious crystal in Mysterious Johnson’s House of Oddities... as well as an evil version of Warlic. Help Mysterious Johnson and the true Warlic to put away this evil for good.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkwarlic/]Read the details here[/url]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/multiversestaves/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6030/promo-aq3dstaffofshattering.jpg[/img][/url]

A staff has been discovered that is capable of opening portals to multiple dimensions. Gather elemental essences from inside Dark Warlic’s domain and in our world of LORE to power the Staff of Shattering.
Complete the quest to unlock the "[b]Multiverse Staff Shop[/b]”. All creatures in the Dark Warlic's domain have a chance to drop Multiverse Shards. Use these Shards to create alternate versions of the Staff of Shattering from this shop.

NEW News Page![/h2]
[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/multiversestaves/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6031/newspagepromo.jpg[/img][/url][/h2]
Our in-game News page got an update! You can now see multiple news cards by scrolling to the left or right. Each card also includes a title and brief description. Click anywhere on the news card to teleport to the advertised shop or release. We would love your feedback on how this compares to the previous News page.
[b]Edit:[/b] The news page update is coming with the next game version. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/multiversestaves/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5996/promo-seasonscleaning.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]What Left in this Release?[/b]
Nothing!

Prepare for your return to Skullpunch Island with Aurelio Voltaire! What’s that? You’ve never been to Skullpunch Island? Sure you have! Voltaire and his perky companion Tuk are happy to remind you in next week’s release.

Also, this time of year we want to honor all the veterans across the globe that fight to keep us safe. Winnie and Thyton have created new military-inspired armor sets and weapons to be earned in-game. These items will be released with the Skullpunch release.

Until then…

notes.title: Friday the 13th - Transdimensional Crystal
notes.content:
[h2]A New Oddity[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkwarlic/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6023/promo-aq3dhouseofoddities.jpg[/img][/url]

Return to the Oddities Shop where a strange new artifact awaits. A large mysterious crystal sits on a shelf among an assortment of other strange trinkets Mysterious Johnson has collected. A dark alternate dimension is contained within... as well as an evil version of Warlic. Help Mysterious Johnson and the true Warlic to put away this evil [i]for good[/i].
Also, Dottie is back in Battleon to take you back to Camp Gonnagetcha if you want to revisit the previous seasonal Friday the 13th Shrade content.
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkwarlic/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6024/promo-aq3dloot.jpg[/img][/url]

 
[h2]Elementals of Destruction[/h2]
Dark Warlic has conjured elementals to attack the structure of the crystal. Enough damage will cause it to break and release him. Destroy the elementals to keep Dark Warlic inside.
Complete Warlic’s “Elemental Studies I” quest to earn the [b]Elemental Corruptor[/b] title and a special Staff of Notes.
[h3]Destroying the elementals also gives you a chance to receive:[/h3]
[list]
[*]An elemental staff (seen above)
[*]Corrupted Mote
[*]An elemental aura.
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b] The type of staff or aura depends on the type of elemental you kill.
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkwarlic/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6027/promo-aq3dwarlic-notext.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Break the Connection[/h2]
Help Warlic investigate the connection between the giant sigil and the elementals. Perhaps he will figure out a way to break it and confront Dark Warlic.
[h2]The Shattered Soldier[/h2]
This soldier has a magical connection to Dark Warlic. What happens if that connection is broken?
Defeating this two-headed soldier gives you a chance to receive:
[list]
[*]Shattered Soldier Left Helm
[*]Shattered Soldier Right Helm
[*]Corrupted Mote
[*]Darlic’s Mirror Fragment
[/list]

[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkwarlic/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6025/promo-aq3delementalsv2.jpg[/img][/url][/h2]
[h2]Corrupted Elementals Shop[/h2]
Can’t get enough of the Corrupted Elementals? This is your one stop shop for all your needs. Pets, auras, and awesome shoulder equips. Each item costs Corrupted Mote tokens.
[list]
[*]Cursed Flame pet and consumable aura
[*]Toxic Smog pet and consumable aura
[*]Corrosive Soot pet and consumable aura
[*]Acid Rain pet and consumable aura
[*]Cursed Flame Candela (shoulder)
[*]Toxic Smog Candela (shoulder)
[*]Corrosive Soot Candela (shoulder)
[*]Cursed Portal Spires (shoulder)
[*]Toxic Portal Spires (shoulder)
[*]Corrosive Portal Spires (shoulder)
[*]Acid Portal Spires (shoulder)
[*]Corrupted Mote tokens (purchasable with DCs)
[/list]

[h2]Dark Warlic’s Garb[/h2]
You too can dress like Dark Warlic… er, Darlic… by collecting Darlic’s Mirror Fragments to turn-in to Warlic. The good Warlic.
[list]
[*]Darlic's Armor
[*]Darlic's Helm
[*]Darlic's Shoulder
[*]Darlic's Cloak
[*]Darlic's Glove
[*]Darlic's Belt
[*]Darlic's Boot
[*]Darlic's Staff
[/list]

[h2]Pocket Residue[/h2]
Earn extra Corrupted Motes and Mirror Fragments by completing the Pocket Residue daily quest on Warlic.
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkwarlic/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5996/promo-seasonscleaning.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Seasons Cleaning[/h2]
[b]What Left in this Release?[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Grenwog[/b] seasonal content
[/list]
[b]What's Leaving Next?[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Carnaval[/b] seasonal content - leaves May 25th
[*][b]May the 4th Be with you[/b] seasonal content - leaves June 1st
[*][b]Camp Gonnagetcha[/b] - leaves June 8th
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b] All Friday the 13th content in the Oddities Shop is permanent.
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkwarlic/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5998/promo-comingsooninaq3d.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Wait a minute! Is something... or someone... missing in this release?[/h2]
Yes. Why yes, a few things are mysteriously missing from this Friday the 13th release. The ship that was originally scheduled to take us to Skullpunch Island is nowhere to be found. Or is it? There is only one Friday the 13th this year... but who cares about dates when you have a few capable Chronomancers nearby. Keep your eyes and ears peeled here for some exciting breaking news.
Meanwhile, the team is hard at work building all of the upcoming story releases for you. These include the Nulgath Saga and the Main Vane Storyline.  Also new classes.... we are long overdue for new classes. We would love your input on our story focused direction. We are going to ask you some questions in a player feedback form soon... check the Artix's Twitter and Facebook for the link.

Dark Warlic has conjured elementals to attack the structure of the crystal. Enough damage will cause it to break and release him. Destroy the elementals to keep Dark Warlic inside.
Complete Warlic’s “Elemental Studies I” quest to earn the [b]Elemental Corruptor[/b] title and a special Staff of Notes.

Destroying the elementals also gives you a chance to receive:
[list]
[*]An elemental staff (seen above)
[*]Corrupted Mote
[*]An elemental aura.
[/list]
Help Warlic investigate the connection between the giant sigil and the elementals. Perhaps he will figure out a way to break it and confront Dark Warlic.

This soldier has a magical connection to Dark Warlic. What happens if that connection is broken?
Defeating this two-headed soldier gives you a chance to receive:
[list]
[*]Shattered Soldier Left Helm
[*]Shattered Soldier Right Helm
[*]Corrupted Mote
[*]Darlic’s Mirror Fragment
[/list]

Can’t get enough of the Corrupted Elementals? This is your one stop shop for all your needs. Pets, auras, and awesome shoulder equips. Each item costs Corrupted Mote tokens.
[list]
[*]Cursed Flame pet and consumable aura
[*]Toxic Smog pet and consumable aura
[*]Corrosive Soot pet and consumable aura
[*]Acid Rain pet and consumable aura
[*]Cursed Flame Candela (shoulder)
[*]Toxic Smog Candela (shoulder)
[*]Corrosive Soot Candela (shoulder)
[*]Cursed Portal Spires (shoulder)
[*]Toxic Portal Spires (shoulder)
[*]Corrosive Portal Spires (shoulder)
[*]Acid Portal Spires (shoulder)
[*]Corrupted Mote tokens (purchasable with DCs)
[/list]

You too can dress like Dark Warlic… er, Darlic… by collecting Darlic’s Mirror Fragments to turn-in to Warlic. The good Warlic.
[list]
[*]Darlic's Armor
[*]Darlic's Helm
[*]Darlic's Shoulder
[*]Darlic's Cloak
[*]Darlic's Glove
[*]Darlic's Belt
[*]Darlic's Boot
[*]Darlic's Staff
[/list]
Earn extra Corrupted Motes and Mirror Fragments by completing the Pocket Residue daily quest on Warlic.

notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/may4th2022/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c10532a2706b90a25a7f7a92489b7a204b53ca4a.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/may4th2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/6016/promo-aq3dnewitems.jpg[/img][/url]

This Friday the 13th you return to the Oddities Shop to discover what new trinket Mysterious Johnson has gotten hold of, and what adventure it will take you on.

notes.content:

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/carnaval-fireice-2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5998/promo-comingsooninaq3d.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Happy Earth Day!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/earth-day-2022/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bb982c80505a343cc40b3374ba59ca6802c06983.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]A Quiet Place[/h2]
In the heart of the Heartwood Forest, talk to the giant tree called "Voice of the Forest" to help
new saplings spring to life as we celebrate Earth Day. The Voice will teach you to encourage seedlings to sprout from the Earth by gathering materials from around Lore. Unlock the 2022 Earth Day Trove by completing the “A New Seed” quest.
 
[h2]The 2022 Earth Day Trove[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/earth-day-2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5990/promo-earthdaytrove.jpg[/img][/url]

[list]
[*]Druidic Armor set
[*]Earthen Horns
[*]Earthen Dagger
[*]Earthen Horned Mask [i][b]**Guardian only**[/b][/i]
[*]Aura of Growth
[/list]
 
[h2]Earth Day Items (DC Shop)[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/earth-day-2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5991/promo-earthdaydcitems.jpg[/img][/url]

[list]
[*]Earth Day Celebratory Sword
[*]Earthen Cleaver
[*]Earthsworn Zweihander
[/list]
 
[h2]Celebrate Earth Day in Real Life[/h2]
While you heroically help Heartwood’s forest flourish in-game, it is also a great opportunity to think about how to use your powers to help the real world too. You can make a difference by picking up trash around your neighborhood, raking your yard, making a pinecone bird feeder, planting a garden… and if you’re feeling devious, find some dandelions and blow their seeds. People think of dandelions as weeds, but they are a great source of food for insects and humans, and help restore depleted minerals to the soil.

J6 shared with us an Earth Day tradition from his home, called [b]Earth Hour[/b]. [i]“Everyone in the neighborhood shuts down for an hour. No lights, no TV, no phone… and it's amazingly peaceful. You take the time to talk more with your family, discover new card games, find fun things to eat that don't require an oven, and most of the time we go way beyond the hour and just forget to turn everything back on. It'll melt your worries away and might make you realize how much noise electricity makes in your life.”[/i]

We're the dominant species on the planet, but we're just one species out of millions who need it to survive. We have the time, the skill, and the knowledge to make it habitable, so start with your own backyard and watch the positivity spread outwards from there.
 
[h2]A new addition to Death’s Stash[/h2]
A much requested item, the Red Reaper’s Skull Belt is now available in Death’s Stash, for those who like to explore. If you don’t know where Death’s Stash is, maybe try going back to where it all started…
 
[h2]Seasons Cleaning[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/earth-day-2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5888/promo-lastchance.png[/img][/url]

This week, April Fowls and Heroes Heart Day have left Battleon! Now that the fowl invaders have been successfully repelled, Maurice can finally take his vacation until the next Heroes Heart Day.
Next week, the Lunar New Year shop will be closed for business, so get your gear to celebrate the Year of the Tiger while you can!
 
[h2]Coming soon to AQ3D[/h2]
We are excited about how well the upcoming Nulgath saga is coming together. The map, the monsters, the dungeon experience. We just need a little more time to make sure it is ready for release. If you would like to see how it’s going so far, [url=https://aq3d.com/news/nulgath-artsneakpeek1/]Artix posted a sneak peak of Dage’s artwork[/url] on the monsters and weapons you will find in the beautifully haunted Red Forest.

See you in-game.

[b]Battle on![/b]
[b]Artix, Glisel, and the AQ3D Team[/b]

notes.title: The Grenwog is real?!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/grenwog-2022/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4147907237527a5d19512cd0771b93453812335e.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Catching the Grenwog![/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/grenwog-2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5982/promo-aq3dcatchingthegrenwog.jpg[/img][/url]

Exit the gates of Battleon and find Hooper in the Crossroads to begin learning what he’s uncovered about the Grenwog. Hooper has been investigating this for years and needs your help uncovering clues to find the Grenwog's nest. And maybe grab some delicious snacks... I mean bait... in the hunt for the Grenwog.

[h2]The Trap is Laid[/h2]
Hop down deep into what may be the Grenwog’s Lair, and fight monsters of all flavors: Rock Candy, Taffy, Hard Candy, and... Angry Carrots? While you’re in the cavern, gather Pixie Dust to harvest and place carrots to lure the Grenwog to you, just like a professional Grenwog Hunter would do!

[h2]What’s going on in Old Battleon?[/h2]
Old Battleon sprouted... Mysterious Time Carrots?! We have no idea what's up with that, but maybe you can investigate! Whatever the case may be, keep an eye out for the dreaded Bunny Berserker…

[h2]Grenwog Nest items[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/grenwog-2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5986/promo-aq3dhoopersgrenwogshopdage.jpg[/img][/url]

Once you've picked up some Chocolate Grenwog Eggs from Time Carrots, the Bunny Berserker, and even the Grenwog itself, take them to Hooper and trade them for some delicious new armors and weapons! 
[b]*Note:[/b] Grenwog has the only guaranteed Chocolate Egg drops every time.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/grenwog-2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5983/promo-aq3dgrenwogholeitemsdage.jpg[/img][/url]

[list]
[*]Bunn Dynasty Samurai Armor set
[*]Bunn Dynasty Head Morph
[*]Bunn Dynasty Carrot Bow
[*]Bunny Berserker Armor set
[*]Bunny Berserker Head Morph
[*]Bunny Berserker Double Bladed Spear
[*]Carrot Claw
[/list]
[h2]What Happens to the Old Grenwog Items?[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/grenwog-2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5984/aq3doldgrenwogitems-edit.jpg[/img][/url]

You can still get Gunter Armor, Grenwog weapons, and Ears and Tails in every color, all from Hooper's Grenwog Shop! They no longer cost Zard Eggs. Now they cost Chocolate Grenwog Eggs!

[h2]What About Drops?[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/grenwog-2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5985/promo-aq3deastermonsterdrops.jpg[/img][/url]

There's plenty of drops to go around! Fight the Grenwog and Past Battleon monsters for a chance at the following items:
[list]
[*]Carrot Sword
[*]Carrot on a Stick
[*]Grenwog pet
[*]Golden Carrot Sword
[*]Golden Carrot on a Stick
[/list]

[h2]DC Bonus and Double Daily Rewards Ended![/h2]
We hope you enjoyed earning Double Daily Rewards for the time it was up! If you missed out, we’ll definitely be doing that again, so make sure you’re signed up to [url=https://game.aq3d.com/account/Home/Newsletter]our mailing list[/url] at [url=news/]aq3d.com[/url] to find out when we do rewards next!

[h2]Breaking News[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/april_fowls_day/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/038e336bd9b003257e047ff6c207b1b8bf923b60.jpg[/img][/url]

The invasion of Chickencow creatures from outer space has been fought back by the Heroes of Battleon, alongside the brave members of the Guardians. Heroes and Guardians should continue to mop up the last of the invading forces residing in Battleon Social District. We spoke to renowned Paladin, Pun-adin and slayer of undead things, Artix, for an update on the situation:

Artix - "We've successfully bawk-sed the fowl invaders into the Social District of Battleon, after a high steaks gambit by our Heroes and Guardians. We've yet to discover if this egg-vasion was led by some kind of cow-mmander or Dairy Queen, but we fully eggs-pect the udder madness of it all to end some time next week. Don’t worry, the time will fly right by"!
Thank you so much for that commentary, Artix! We can’t wait to moo-ve on from this terrifying eggs-perience.

In other news, local romantic Maurice, who went missing last week, has now been found! He is reportedly okay, and just had an ailment to recover from. Maurice has informed this crew that he’ll be back in town for one week, before taking his regular year long vacation next week. You can find Maurice sipping on Moglinberry Juice in Yulgar’s Inn.

Now back to your regularly scheduled Design Notes.

[h2]Coming soon to AQ3D[/h2]
Is your birthday on Earth Day? Even if it’s not, we have some great news! April 22nd is Earth Day, and we’re celebrating with an environmentally friendly collection. Get ready to represent nature in all its glory with a brand new trove. After that, who’s to say? It could be the return of a malevolent villain… We’ll just have to wait and see!

See you in-game.

[b]Battle on![/b]
[b]Artix, Glisel, Rellik, and the AQ3D Team[/b]

notes.title: Siege of Souls
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/siege-of-souls/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/fdcff21ea3e91d30cfa5ae1c72b0121b54ce0e7e.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Siege of Souls PvEvP[/h2]
The Legion Vs Paladin fight has now escalated to a full blown PvEvP battle!

[h2]Fight Both Monsters and Players![/h2]

This is "player versus environment versus player." This new game mode will send your team in against other players and their powerful defenses. Face your foes, complete your objectives, and earn glory in battle. For the next 2 weeks, the Siege of Souls will be completely taking over PvP, as the battle rages fiercely, but our experts believe that it should slip into the regular rotation of PvP after those 2 weeks are done. With a very heavy PvEvP style, it’s a little different than what you might be used to!

[h2]How to Play Siege of Souls[/h2]
Join the Queue in from your PvP menu or the Battle Hall! It’s really that easy!
No more need for assault supplies. This map is fully PvEvP. Your team will be randomly assigned to a side, Legion or Paladin. Assault the enemy base and take down their General.

Very powerful Turrets have been added to assist in protecting your base and must be defeated before the General can be killed. A powerful Big Bones, and an army of skeletons (legion) or Palatron, and an army of wolves (paladin) will also spawn to assist you in attacking the enemy base.
Destroy the enemy General for a decisive victory, otherwise, the game ends after 10 minutes. The team with the most points at the end wins. Gain points for each enemy player, mob, or turret destroyed. Even if you don’t land the kill shot on the turret, you’ll still get points! Earn stacks of Fervor for kill shots on enemies!
[h2]Fervor? What’s that?[/h2]
Fervor is a 4% health and damage buff that stacks with each kill shot, OR you can walk over a Crystal that spawns on the map for 3 stacks of Fervor. There are 3 crystal spawns in the map.
If you die with more than 10 stacks of Fervor, you lose 2 stacks. You cannot drop below a minimum of 10 stacks from death in game. Wow, we said “Fervor” a lot just now! Fervor, fervor fervor. It’s lost all meaning now xD
[h2]Is there anything else new?[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/siege-of-souls/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5953/promo-aq3dpvpnewui.jpg[/img][/url]

Yes! You may notice a new mini objective map in Siege of Souls. It’s a new UI for this game mode that displays the current state of the defenses. Each node represents a turret, and the skulls represent the boss. 
If they are outlined in yellow, they are invulnerable and you need to kill a closer defense to take down the invulnerability. If the node is gray it has been destroyed. Pretty neat, huh?

[h2]What happens to the old quest rewards?![/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/siege-of-souls/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5954/previous-paladin-rewards.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/siege-of-souls/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5955/previous-legion-rewards.jpg[/img][/url]

The Legion Assault and Golder Order Assault rewards have been moved to the Battle Hall. The quests have been removed permanently. Since these were repeatable quests, there were no badges or titles associated with completing them. Don’t worry, nothing has gone rare! Paladin Rhys and Deadeye have both returned to their factions, extremely proud of the work they’ve done. See High Marshal Firebrand for the new shop: Siege of Souls Rewards.

[h2]New rewards in the Siege of Souls Rewards Shop![/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/siege-of-souls/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5952/promo-aq3dsiegeofsoulsrewards.jpg[/img][/url]

New rewards have been added to make the Siege of Souls even more interesting! Check out the list below, then check them out in the Battle Hall’s new shop: Siege of Souls Rewards.
[list]
[*]Insignia of the Legion Onslaught (Consumable for Title)
[*]Insignia of the Golden Order (Consumable for Title)
[*]War Glaives of the Legion
[*]Blessed War Sword of the Golden Order
[*]Serrated Katar of the Legion
[*]Blessed War Hammar of the Golden Order
[*]Horned Kabuto of the Legion
[*]War Maul of the Legion
[*]Grave Hammer of the Legion
[*]Jagged Dagger of the Legion
[/list]
[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
New patch notes for version 1.84.0! Check them out [url=https://aq3d.com/news/patchnotes1840/]here![/url]

[h2]Coming soon to AQ3D[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/siege-of-souls/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5951/grenwog-sneakpeak.jpg[/img][/url]

April is just around the corner, which means… a new promo pet. Check the Upgrade Store on April 1st to see the spicy new pet (and travel form for Guardians). Also, the seasonal Grenwog content is getting a revamp! Dage is working on bringing the Grenwog monster to life, there will be new quests, new rewards, and a full Grenwog dungeon filled with colorful eggs.

See you in-game.

notes.title: Ravagers of the Legion
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/legion-spinner-2022/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8c06bb23759efd161190d32a87a224dfc1fc4dd4.jpg[/img][/url]

Greetings Heroes! Can you help the head of The Ravagers, an elite group within the undead Legion, find his missing soldiers? Pivot around Lore and track down the missing Ravagers for a revolutionary reward!

[h2]Prove Your Worth[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/legion-spinner-2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5943/promo-proveyourworth.jpg[/img][/url]

Go down for a visit to the Underworld and find Farfa, the leader of the legendary Legion Ravagers! Farfa’s elite soldiers have gone missing in action. Help track them down and prove your worth to Farfa in exchange for his knowledge of a legendary ancient weapon… the Fidg'it Spi'nar!
You can find Farfa near the Warfiend in the Underworld. To get there, follow the path and take a right, then another right. Keep in mind that the Underworld is ideal for players above level 12!

[h2]The Fidg’it Spi’nar[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/legion-spinner-2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5944/promo-craftingyourspinar.jpg[/img][/url]

The legendary Fidg’it Spi’nar is used by specialists within the Ravagers of the Legion. An ancient buckler forged to look like a skull. With fast-spinning scythe-like blades adorned in skeletons, this weapon will claim the souls of anyone caught in the destructive path.

Also, it's fun to spin when you're bored.

Equip the Legion Ravager armor from the 2022 Dage Collection, along with the Fidg’it Spi’nar, and become a true Ravager!

Fidg'it Spi'nar crafting unlocks once you complete the Prove Your Worth questline. Collect Underworld Metal Shards from Daily Bosses, and Fractured Souls of the Forgotten in Pointe Less to craft your very own Fidg'it Spi'nar!

[h2]Seasons cleaning![/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/legion-spinner-2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5941/lastchance-mary.jpg[/img][/url]

We’re continuing our seasonal cleanup effort, sending NPC’s home after they’ve long overstayed their welcome in Battleon! To that effect, Gunpowder Mary has been convinced to return the TLAPD collections to the depths of the sea until it’s time to uncover those treasures once again, the Midnight General has gone back to the darkest darkness, and the Cyberknight has reuploaded his consciousness to, well we don’t know exactly where he went, but he said he’d return some day when we need him the most.

[h2]Content Creator Highlight[/h2]
To show our appreciation for all the amazing content creators, we’re highlighting a new video every week! This week, we’d like to show our appreciation for Camarguets! He makes great videos about AdventureQuest Worlds for Portuguese speakers, and we hope he’ll try his hand at AdventureQuest3D too! If you want to hear more about AdventureQuest Worlds in Portuguese, and convince him to make some AQ3D videos, then head over to YouTube and check out [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCnCpu-qTQHqFTm5XzEa7fnw]Camarguets[/url] now!

[previewyoutube=8EpvUzOkWMQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Coming soon to AQ3D[/h2]
Dage the Evil brings you back to the on-going fight between the Legion and Lion Fang’s Paladin order with a very exciting update. You can try it out now in the Public Test Realm! To find out how to join the Public Test Realm, head on over to [url=https://aq3d.com/news/ptr/]this page[/url] and get ready!
See you in-game.

notes.title: March Promo + Message from the AQ3D Team
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/march2022promo/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9097907d3b025de58d1b2efcfb19dc87a15343cd.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Legion Skeleton Pet and Travel Form[/h2]
Dage has granted this soul the freedom to follow you around. Give thanks to Dage for We Are Legion!

This Legion Skeleton pet is included with all packages from the Upgrade Shop, including Guardian and Lore Strider. Guardian packages also give the travel form version. Check your Pet and Travel Form inventories on your next log in after purchase.

Note: Purchases made in the Upgrade Shop since March 1, 2022 were retroactively rewarded the pet (and travel form if Guardian membership was purchased).

[h3]What if I'm already a Guardian?[/h3]
Great! When you buy any package, you will get the Legion Skeleton Pet and the travel form directly added to your inventory.

If you miss the promotional period, Guardians can still get the travel Form... but you'll miss out on the Legion Skeleton Pet! Head to the Guardian Tower to talk to Fortes. He has a shop for "Special Guardian Rewards" where you can buy the Legion Skeleton Form and any other travel forms released through these special promotions with Guardian Class Tokens. Make sure you completed the Guardian Initiation to unlock class gear.

Get [b]50% bonus DragonCrystals[/b] from any package in the Upgrade Shop once again! This time it won’t stick around all year, so get your bonus DragonCrystals while you can!

[h2]A Change for the better![/h2]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/changeforbetter/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/cbb7f469cd489a7ec507473ee0c31fe3f22dbda6.jpg[/img][/url]

The AdventureQuest 3D team is trying something different with our release schedule this month. With Dage’s birthday release coming soon, the team is quite busy preparing features and fixing bugs, related and un-related to this release, to make it go as smoothly as possible. This week’s release being dedicated to just the monthly promotion will give us a week to catch up on the backlog of things that got delayed due to some bigger priority releases over the past couple of months, and more hands-on time with the Dage release. Ideally, we will continue to give ourselves a light release once a month in hopes that it will enable us to tackle the longer-term projects without sacrificing important smaller projects as well. This method has been implemented by other Artix Games teams and we have high hopes that it will work out just as well for us.

We thank you for your patience and understanding as we strive to bring back some balance to our work ethic and ensure we’re making releases you will enjoy.

[h3]Also,[/h3]
As a reminder, please update your passwords and email addresses for your Artix Games accounts at least once a year. And be sure to confirm your email address on those accounts. Many of the Support tickets we receive are about trying to recover old accounts and hackers are more easily able to find your old login information from other sites. We have updated our verification systems to notify a confirmed email address if an attempt is made to change it on an Artix Games account. The owner of the email address must confirm the change before it is made.

If you forgot the password to the email address on an old account, please contact your email provider to recover your password. They have the ability to recover the password or offer other solutions to help you regain access. If you are still unable to recover your old email, then our Player Support will do their best to assist you.

Keep your accounts safe by keeping them up-to-date.

Battle on!
[b]Artix, Glisel, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

notes.title: Westmere Saga: Mission II
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/westmere-part-2/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/dac015837ab010060ccb6b1461c3deed5c557750.jpg[/img][/url]

Greetings Heroes! Thyton has recently received intel on a new threat to Lore… Visit him in Westmere for more info on this latest threat and help him stop it! Thyton's birthday shop has also returned with a new addition. Make sure you stop by his NPC and take a look.
[h2]The Return to Westmere[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/westmere-part-2/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5911/checkonwestmere.jpg[/img][/url]

There are still monsters infected with Bane roaming Westmere. It's not safe for the townspeople to stay, but they won't go. Log in to help Thyton find the root of the Bane problem, and put a stop to it!
[h2]Murin[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/westmere-part-2/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5910/murinpromo.jpg[/img][/url]

Deep in the Westmere Mine, the mysterious Murin has set up an extensive operation… but what is it for? Investigate the mine and collect her research notes for Thyton, and he will reward you with some new equipment.
[h2]Thyton’s Birthday Shop![/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/westmere-part-2/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5912/thytonbirthdayshop2022.jpg[/img][/url]

There is a new addition to Thyton's Birthday Shop. These Warped Wings are a great fit whether you're a Warpmancer or Warpslinger.
[list]
[*]Warped Wings
[*]Warpslinger set
[*]Warpmancer set
[*]Crossfire and Longshot (pistol)
[*]Dustmaker and Spite (pistol)
[/list]
[h2]Westmere Mine[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/westmere-part-2/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5913/westmere2news-1.jpg[/img][/url]

Use your ninja stealth to investigate the mine with Thyton. Watch out for traps and prepare for this mission to get... explosive.
[h2]Westmere Mine Challenge[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/westmere-part-2/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5914/westmereminechallenge.jpg[/img][/url]

Return to the Westmere Mine with a party after you complete the story for the repeatable level 20+ dungeon and level 30+ challenge! Collect Murin's Research Notes and use them to craft Bane Corrupted Equipment.
[h2]Bane Corrupted Equipment (level 31)[/h2]
[list]
[*]Bane Ornithon set
[*]Bane Ornithon Shroud (alternate back)
[*]Bane Ornithon Visage (helm)
[*]Earth Shatter
[*]Bane Stinger (bow)
[*]Bane Aura Potion
[/list]
[h2]Bane Weapon Crafting (level 20-22)[/h2]
Accept Thyton’s Bane Weapon Crafting quests before you head into the repeatable dungeon or Challenge to gather the required materials to craft your own Bane Weapons in the Bane Weapon Merge Shop.
[list]
[*]Bane Hand Cannon
[*]Bane Cannon Gauntlets
[*]Bane Propelled Gauntlets
[*]Bane Blade
[*]Bane Crystal Saw
[*]Bane Quills
[*]Bane Scepter
[*]Nevermore
[*]Crystalline Bane Basher
[/list]
[h2]A new Adventure Menu![/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/westmere-part-2/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5915/advmenu.jpg[/img][/url]

We’ve built an all new Adventure Menu for you to use! This should be easier and more intuitive to navigate for new and veteran players alike. Check it out and give us your feedback!
[h2]Content Creator Highlight[/h2]
To show our appreciation for all the amazing content creators, we’re highlighting a new video every week! This week, we’d like to show our appreciation for Helimod, who made a lovely Valentine’s Day poem for his favorite dev. Check it out below, and make sure you like and subscribe!

[previewyoutube=_2XlKxAsaGg;full][/previewyoutube]

March is fast approaching, which means Dage’s Birthday is almost here! Be prepared for an all new dark and deadly Dage Collection… Keep an eye on Dage’s twitter for sneak peeks of his work on the collections for AQ3D and AQW.

notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heroes-heart-day-2022/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1e123a24d962faf26c748678e12f1343cee43d68.png[/img][/url]

'Tis the week to celebrate your love... of adventure! It's Heroes Heart Day and for this Valentines-themed release we are celebrating with new pets, travel forms, armor sets, weapons, & auras which are in-game now. Go to town and talk to the snazzy looking fellow with the lute on the bridge named Maurice.
[h2]Dark Heart Armor Set[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heroes-heart-day-2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5897/promo-heroesheartdaycollection.jpg[/img][/url]

[*]Dark Heart Belt
[*]Dark Heart Boot
[*]Dark Heart Glove
[*]Dark Heart Wings
[*]Dark Heart Helm
[*]Dark Heart Shoulder
[*]Dark Heart Sword
[/list]
[h2]Valentine Lolita Armor Set[/h2]
Lolita fashion is a subculture from Japan that is highly influenced by Victorian clothing and styles. A very distinctive property of Lolita fashion is the aesthetic of cuteness. The extra sweet Valentine Lolita Armor Set is chock-full of candies and chocolates.
[list]
[*]Valentine Lolita Armor
[*]Valentine Lolita Shoes
[*]Valentine Lolita Gloves
[*]Valentine Lolita Hat
[*]Valentine Lolita Skirt
[/list]
[h2]Valentine Ouji Armor Set[/h2]
Ouji, a term which means "Prince", is a subset of Lolita fashion which is often seen as a more masculine alternative to usual Lolita dress. Our princely Valentine Ouji Armor Set is packed with sweetness!
[list]
[*]Valentine Ouji Armor
[*]Valentine Ouji Shoes
[*]Valentine Ouji Gloves
[*]Valentine Ouji Hat
[*]Valentine Ouji Belt
[/list]
[h2]BUT WAIT, THERE’S MORE![/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heroes-heart-day-2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5898/promo-hhdritems1.jpg[/img][/url]

There’s still so much more waiting for you in the Heroes Heart Day Collection! See what piques your curiosity below, then log in and check it out in game!

[*]Love at First Scythe
[*]Spirit of Flirting Pet
[*]Cuddly Dragon Travel Form
[*]Cuddly Dragon Pet
[*]Heart Bow Wand
[*]Heart Crystal Sword
[*]Heart Crystal Dagger
[*]Dizzying Love Aura
[*]Blush Aura
[*]Collector's Chest Badge and "Dark Heart" Title
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heroes-heart-day-2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5899/promo-hhdritems2.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Steam Deck news[/h2]
Plan on getting a fancy new Steam Deck later this month? Well we have news for you! AdventureQuest3D is officially playable on Steam Deck. That means you can get your AdventureQuest-ing on in yet another way!
[h2]The Game Plan cleanup and update[/h2]
You may have noticed some changes to the AdventureQuest3D Game Plan yesterday! We’re currently cleaning it up to make it a whole lot easier to read! The goal for this is to be as transparent as possible (without spoiling too much), including our most current plans for improvements, new questlines, and more. This process may take a short while as there is a lot to sift through, so please be patient!
[h2]Coming soon to AQ3D[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heroes-heart-day-2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5895/westmeremineconcept.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3]Westmere: Mission Two![/h3]

We will be releasing the next part of the Westmere saga very soon! Join Thyton (the shadow specialist) and his elite team for a covert mission to save the town (or the world?) from strange new invaders. In this new installment, you will be hunting an evil Battlemage from another dimension. Get ready for Mission Two!
Note: If you haven’t played part 1 of the Westmere story yet, head to Westmere from the Adventure Menu’s “Side Stories” section or the Travel Portal under Greenguard.

March is fast approaching, which means Dage’s Birthday is almost here! Be prepared for an all new dark and deadly Dage Collection… Keep an eye on Dage’s twitter for sneak peaks of his work on the collections for AQ3D and AQW.

[h2]Talk to Maurice[/h2]
He's a Minstrel of Love. He has come to Battleon to inspire the heart of every hero! Talk to him on the bridge to get daily quests and the previous Heroes Heart collections (including an effect potion, pets, and a travel form). You'll be seeing him again when the 2022 collection arrives, which will include new sets, weapons, a cuddly Pet/Travel Form, and new auras.
[h2]February Battle Concert Delayed/Postponed[/h2]
Hiya guys,
Writing to let you know that we are going to have to postpone or replace the Battle Concert we had originally scheduled for February. (I am so bummed!) The band was excited, but due to the unique nature of their music we needed to get some 3rd party licensing which we will not be able to do in time. Keep an eye on [url=http://www.AQ3D.com][/url][url=http://www.aq3d.com]AQ3D.com[/url] and our Social Media for updates about future concerts and more!

notes.title: Warlic’s Magic Potions and Wisps!
notes.content:
[url=www.aq3d.com/news/magicshop2022][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0a35b42c823659f92ea40f99353d038b77048159.jpg[/img][/url]

Greetings! Warlic has been hard at work researching and uncovering new recipes for auras, and has also discovered a way to turn you into a wisp. Craft new potions which give you a magical aura, by logging in to collect materials from all around Lore! Read on to find out more…

[h2]New Auras at Warlic’s Shop[/h2]

Warlic has sourced brand new recipes for amazing Auras. Be prepared to venture far and wide to hunt the ingredients, it’ll be worth it!

[url=www.aq3d.com/news/magicshop2022][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/749671f7a6dd514ea3b0b2a26b6d76082cd29297.jpg[/img][/url]

[*] Death’s Shadow Aura
[*] Firefly Aura
[*] Embers Aura
[*] Stone Aura
[*] [b]GUARDIAN ONLY:[/b] Nature’s Aura
[*] Heartwood’s Aura
[*] Decaying Aura
[*] Arcane Aura
[*] Vampiric Aura
[/list]
[h2]Wisps-A-Plenty at Warlic’s Shop[/h2]

Don’t ask how, but Warlic has figured out how to make a Wisp Travel Form. There are new temporary and permanent Travel Forms for sale now!

[url=www.aq3d.com/news/magicshop2022][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8a61defb0f128bbe573e1a783815ac648f9c76bc.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Temporary Travel forms:[/b]
[list]
[*] Teal Wisp Spirit
[*] Red  Wisp Spirit
[*] Purple Wisp Spirit
[*] Pink Wisp Spirit
[*] Orange Wisp Spirit
[*] Green Wisp Spirit
[*] Doom Wisp Spirit
[/list]
[b]Permanent Travel forms:[/b]
[list]
[*] Teal Wisp Form 
[*] Red  Wisp Form
[*] Purple Wisp Form 
[*] Pink Wisp Form 
[*] Orange Wisp Form
[*] Green Wisp Form
[*] Doom Wisp Form
[/list]
[h2]A New Aura for Guardians[/h2]

Guardian’s rejoice! For the loyal, brave, and few sworn defenders of Lore, there is now a Golden Guardian Aura for you in the Guardian Tower. 

[h2]Frostval Seasonal Content is now gone![/h2]

You may have noticed that Lore remained rather chilly for a little longer than normal, that’s because we left the temperature a little low so our friends around the world who have been affected by multiple natural disasters could have a chance to take part in the festivities. We sincerely hope that things are getting better for all of our friends affected by these terrible times, and know that there is always a place for you in our hearts, our minds, and our games!

It’s time to let the sun shine through once again in Battleon!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/magicshop2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5877/aq3d_header_charlie.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]The Moistverse leaving soon[/h2]

Have you been solving the Moistverse crisis? You should be, there are 2 weeks left to collect everything, get the best score you can on the parkour leaderboard, and remove all the Charlie variants you can! Don’t forget, there is a trove so you can keep your souvenirs and commemorate your victory over the Moist Epidemic.

[h2]Coming Soon to AQ3D[/h2]

Next week on AdventureQuest3D, Heroes Heart Day will be celebrated! Bring all the romance and warm fuzzy feelings you have to Battleon and take part in special events with the dev team. Make sure you follow @AeRellik on Twitter to find out when the special events begin! 

[url=www.aq3d.com/news/magicshop2022][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bdaa7d6fdd4198356b82842830dd4a3041b683a9.jpg[/img][/url]

Thyton and the team are still hard at work on new content for Westmere, which will be coming soon!



See you in-game.

[b]Battle on!
Artix, Glisel, Rellik, and the AQ3D Team[/b]

notes.title: It's The Year of the Tiger!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunarnewyear22/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0c34d8c0308b777ec4bfaa38aca9fd3155e15872.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]It’s the Year of the Tiger![/h2]
Greetings! We finally got to witness the man, the myth, the legend himself, Charlie/Penguinz0/MoistCr1TiKaL play through a very special release in AdventureQuest3D. We hope you all had as much fun as we did watching his stream and playing through the INSANE map! [url=https://aq3d.com/news/charlieverse/]The MoistVerse[/url] is still open for another couple weeks, so join the madness while you still can.
This week marks the beginning of the Lunar New Year. Our team has created several sets and items themed around this year’s zodiac animal, the Tiger. Read on to find out what they are and where to get them…

[h2]New Shops on Saber in Battleon’s Social District[/h2]
Saber is celebrating the Lunar New Year in Battleon’s Social District with new shops, and a new quest!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunarnewyear22/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5887/promo-lnyshop.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Lunar New Year Shop[/h2]
For those who just want to be festive, a golden tiger is embroidered on these red silken clothes.
[list]
[*]Tiger Cheongsam Armor (traditionally for ladies)
[*]Tiger Changshan Armor (traditionally for men)
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunarnewyear22/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5886/promo-renyinshop.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Legendary Ren Yin Shop (DC shop)[/h2]
Ren Yin refers to the elemental symbol and animal symbol for the year 2022: Ren (water) Yin (tiger). Dage designed a magnificent set fit for a legendary warrior representing the year of Ren Yin.
[list]
[*]The Tiger’s Fangs
[*]The Tiger’s Crest
[*]The Tiger’s Crown
[*]Ren Yin’s Ribbon
[*]Ren Yin’s Gloves
[*]The Tiger’s Vest
[*]Ren Yin’s Slippers
[*]Ren Yin’s Sash
[*]Blue Tiger Claw Darts (pistol)
[*]Red Tiger Claw Darts (pistol)
[*]Blue Tiger Claws (weapon)
[*]Red Tiger Claws (weapon)
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunarnewyear22/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5885/promo-porcelaintigershop.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Porcelain Tiger Quest[/h2]
Saber’s shipment of supplies is late and she needs an intrepid hero to investigate what happened to it. Help her track and find her shipment so that she can create the exquisite Porcelain Tiger Armor for her shop. Your reward is the full set of armor plus the title of “The Porcelain Tiger”.
[list]
[*]Porcelain Tiger Polearm
[*]Porcelain Tiger Shoulder
[*]Porcelain Tiger Helm
[*]Porcelain Tiger Cape
[*]Porcelain Tiger Gloves
[*]Porcelain Tiger Boots
[*]Porcelain Tiger Belt
[*]Porcelain Tiger Armor
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunarnewyear22/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5884/feb2022promoitem-1080x1920.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]February Promo Item: Tiger Follower Pet[/h2]
In honor of the year of the Tiger, this furry feline can follow you around on all of your adventures. [url=https://aq3d.com/news/feb2022promo/]Purchase an item from the Upgrade Shop[/url] during the month of February and this Tiger Follower will paw it’s way into your Pet Inventory. If you become a Guardian, or are one, you can also unlock your own Tiger Form in the Guardian Tower.

[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunarnewyear22/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5883/promo-lunarny.jpg[/img][/url]

Coming Soon to AQ3D[/h2]
Now that January has wrapped up and our special guest event has been released, we’re ready for a story update in Westmere! Thyton has been working hard with a small team of devs to create the next installment of his adventure. Keep checking the Design Notes every week for more info, and make sure you’re signed up to the newsletter!

See you in-game.

notes.title: MoistCr1TiKaL (penguinz0) Special Event in AdventureQuest 3D
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1ece7ec760f9684da591ccae6928dc4fddc7ef67.jpg[/img]

[h1]Cr1TiKaL Special Event in AdventureQuest 3D[/h1]
 
[b]Happening Now[/b]

MoistCr1TiKal (aka Charlie) from the youtube channel Penguinz0 is in [url=https://www.aq3d.com]AdventureQuest 3D[/url] for the most unusual special guest event in the history of the game.

[i][b]IMPORTANT NOTE:[/b] Charlie has not seen this event. He has no idea what is in this special event. I mean, we got permission first. We built it with his friends and manager. Charlie will stream playing it "sight-unseen" on Twitch. But we have no idea what will happen when he does. What could possibly go wrong?[/i]

[url=https://www.aq3d.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1ea581b7bece5384a6e63abe4be9635b50dbb11d.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Story map event....  Moistverse: Resurrected[/h2]

In a recent Youtube video, Charlie officially killed the Moistverse. It was a meme. A meme centered around an uncanny number of people who were dressing up like Charlie in other videos and photos. A multiverse of Charlie variants. Like I said, Charlie killed it. Well, at least he thought he did. Hop in game and talk to Charlie. He's standing on the bridge in AdventureQuest 3D's home town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2e73aeb6ad16c7b68971f6f33472e4e79ff43da7.jpg[/img]
 
[h2]About Charlie / MoistCr1tikal / penguinz0[/h2]

Charlie makes videos on YouTube and streams on Twitch.

WARNING!
The content on Charlie's stuff includes profanity, wholesome vulgarity, obscene subject matter, dead-pan sarcasm, and should only be viewed by mature viewers with a sense of humor. Our player support team is looking forward to complaint emails from your angry parent.

[list]
[*]  [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/penguinz0]penguinz0 YouTube[/url]
[*]  [url=https://www.twitch.tv/moistcr1tikal]MoistCr1tiKaL Twitch[/url]
[*]  [url=https://linktr.ee/TheGentleMen]The Gentle Men (Band)[/url]
[/list]

[url=https://www.aq3d.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/10d669a071935537f98eeb13417ccb920b3a628d.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]HOW DID THIS HAPPEN?[/h2]

How did MoistCr1TiKaL end up in a family friendly (well, it *WAS* family friendly) game like AdventureQuest 3D?  Grab a can of goblin fuel energy drink and join us for story time. It was just a few months ago. Artix, the creator of AQ3D got swat-ed. One of the law enforcement officers mentioned there was another gamer in the area dealing with some stuff. Turned out to be Charlie. Next thing you know, the entire Artix Entertainment staff is wearing plain white T-shirts. The rest is a history.... that you are about to make.
Meet the Moist Crew

There are a lot of amazing people behind the scenes of Charlie's videos.

[*] Danny (Videographer) - Family Friendly Quests
[*] Chelsey (Video Editor) - Crafts and Shops
[*] Caleb/Swolejoels (Streamer)
[*] Rex Gunderson (Stramer / Guns Expert)
[/list]

 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bc5be0c0c032beb07f9c16bd7b6b32126c188c59.jpg[/img]

(Rumored to appear in 2D AdventureQuest World's town)

[h2]The event happening now in AdventureQuest 3D[/h2]
Charlie is standing on the bridge in the home town of Battleon. This event features:

notes.title: New Emotes and XP Boost Week
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/new-emotes-2022/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8af9bd29c4d72b5b7a7fef4af27492fcbfc25987.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]New emotes and a week of bonus XP![/h2]
Greetings! We’re more than halfway through January and getting closer and closer to some very big releases… This week’s release includes a reorganized emotes list, 2 new emotes, and a WEEK LONG XP + CLASS XP BOOST. Please make sure to install version 1.81.0 when it becomes available for you. You may need to relaunch your mobile app store to see the update; thank you. Log in now and level up! 
[h2]Joy Emote[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/new-emotes-2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5871/joy.gif[/img][/url]

If you’re happy and you know it type /joy *CLAP CLAP*. Jump for joy with the new Joy Emote!
[h2]Shoulder Weapon emote[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/new-emotes-2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5872/shoulderweapon.gif[/img][/url]

Sometimes carrying around a massive weapon can get tiring, why not take a load off and rest it on your shoulder every now and then? Just make sure you don't forget to give it a good flourish first!
[h2]A week of bonus XP![/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/new-emotes-2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5875/promo-xpboostweekplusclass.jpg[/img][/url]

Leveling up can be rough, so we’ve decided to turn on bonus XP AND bonus class XP for a full week! Have fun, and make use of the boost while you can!
[h2]A new contest![/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/new-emotes-2022/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5874/unknown-30.png[/img][/url]

Our community has so many talented artists, but what about writers? Flex your creativity with words in our upcoming Writing Contest for a chance to win some Artix Points, redeemable for DC’s. Make sure you follow [url=https://twitter.com/AE_Contests]@AE_Contests on Twitter[/url] to find out more!

[h2]Coming Soon to AQ3D[/h2]
Special Guest Event Next Week!
*gulps* Join us next week in AdventureQuest 3D for the most unexpected, dangerous, and weird event in the games history. Our guest is a popular YouTuber who... is probably going to cause us to lose our T for Teen Rating. Player support is already bracing for the angry emails. O_o
See you in-game.

Leveling up can be rough, so we’ve decided to turn on bonus XP AND bonus class XP for a full week! Have fun, and make use of the boost while you can!

[h2]Battle on into the New Year in AdventureQuest 3D![/h2]
Login for your Free Axe gift "The Blinding Light of Frostval". Join us for 8 live events on New Years Eve! New rewards have been added to the live event shop.  Also, check out gold Raven's the year in review video!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/happy-new-year-2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5855/promo-newyearheader.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]A gift to you...  Blinding Light of Frostval![/h2]
That’s right! The Frostval spirits are overcoming us, so login to claim The Blinding Axe of Frostval axe to  “slay-bell” the undead! It’s surprisingly festive for an axe. Just talk to Artix (the Paladin) in Yulgar's Inn.

notes.title: Frostval: Gift’thulu Rises
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval-giftthulu/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/933af8ef1557f40384a789ab219790b1e84afa94.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]The Call of Gift’thulu[/h2]
[h3][b]"Iä! Iä! Gift’thulu fhtagn!"[/b][/h3]

Deep beneath the snow covered fields, The Great Gifting One slumbers, dreaming up new gifts, and awaiting the fated days of Frostval where it can return once more to the worlds above to give presents to those who prove they are worthy…

The Gifting Shrub in Yulgar’s Inn has obtained the runes required to summon Gift’thulu, so go and talk to it!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval-giftthulu/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5825/promo-giftthulurewards.png[/img][/url]

New Gift’thulu rewards:
[list]
[*]Polar Ninja Armor Set
[*]Frosty Katana
[*]Ice Kunai
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval-giftthulu/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5826/promo-spiritsoffrostvalpets.png[/img][/url]

Spirits of Frostval pets are also making an appearance!
[list]
[*]Spirit of Giving pet
[*]Spirit of Taking pet
[*]Spirit of Caring pet (Guardian Only)
[/list]
[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval-giftthulu/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5831/promo-giftleaderboard.png[/img][/url][/h2]
[h2]Gift’thulu leaderboard?![/h2]
We were inspired by the way the community took initiative last year… and all year with other spawnables… to make sure everyone was able to participate and receive gifts. We want those who spread the most cheer to be recognized, so we made the Gifting Rune leaderboard! Players whose Gift'thulus share gifts to the most players will rise up the leaderboard. Don’t have enough DCs to buy a Gifting Rune? We added some in the Daily Chests so everyone has a chance to get at least one Rune for free during Frostval.

Be aware though, only regular Gifting Runes count towards your total, and only the top 100 will be displayed! If you aren’t in the top 100, you will always be displayed as 101, even though you may be lower than that. The Giving Shrub will fix this soon!
[h2]A new Daily Quest for Guardians![/h2]
Visit the Guardian Tower for a new daily to receive a free Guardian Gifting Rune!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval-giftthulu/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5827/promo-pvpnewmap.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New PvP map[/h2]
That’s right! There’s nothing quite like a good old fashioned Battle Feast to get the holiday spirit going. Enter the Battle Feast map and re-enact your favorite holiday dinners, as you slash, bash, and smash your opponents! You will have a random chance to enter either Battle Feast or the original map, Battle Falls, with each match.
Of course with a new PvP map comes…

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval-giftthulu/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5828/promo-pvpfrostvalrewards.png[/img][/url]

[h2]PvP Rewards![/h2]
A new PvP Reward set has made an appearance, alongside new seasonal rewards you can now earn!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval-giftthulu/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5830/promo-pvpblueglowset.png[/img][/url]

[list]
[*]Blue Glow Armor Set
[*]Icy Jinbaori
[*]Frostval Jinbaori
[*]Frosty Sai
[/list]
[h2]PvP patch[/h2]
We’ve listened to your feedback and made some changes to PvP balancing!
[list][*]Swiftcast
[/list]Cast Speed 70% ➔ 40%
[list]
[*]Moglomancer PvP Buff
[/list]Max Health +20% ➔ +0%
[list]
[*]New spell for all players: [b]Recall[/b]
[/list]Channel for 3 seconds to teleport back to your spawn and fully heal yourself! 
Moving or taking damage will interrupt your channel so be careful not to do it while you're in danger![b]
[/b]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval-giftthulu/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5824/avaleon-dansen.gif[/img][/url]
[h2]New "Dansen" emote![/h2]
By player request, we added the Dansen emote! Now you too can do the popular internet dance-- from, LOL, a decade ago XD
[h2]A bug for Android users?![/h2]
Right now there is a bug affecting Android users only, which means we've had to temporarily disable watching ads for DC's. Don't worry though, we're working on a fix!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval-giftthulu/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/855d60fedacd3841c1583cc46967b8828e396b18.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Thank you! 500 DragonCrystal Gift & Frostval Collection[/h2]
Be sure to login to AdventureQuest 3D before Wednesday the 23rd! You and all other players who logged on this month will be receiving a gift of 500 DragonCrystals.  And just in time-- on Wednesday we will finally be releasing the 2021 Frostval Collection.

See you in Frostval.
[b]Battle on![/b]
[b]Artix, Glisel, Rellik, and the AQ3D Team[/b]

[b]P.S.[/b] Our hearts go out to all of our friends and team members who were impacted by Super Typhoon Rai which struck the Philippines last Friday. On behalf of you, and all of the players in our Artix Entertainment video game community, we have made a donation of $5,016 USD (250,000 Philippine pesos) to the Philippine Red Cross, to help in the relief effort.

notes.title: Frostfang: With a Vengeance
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostfangsocial2021/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c9b3ac5146d771bcb52aed8ba8f4910b41bb40f9.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Frostfang has come to town![/h2]
It's the most wonderful time of the year! The holiday cheer is spreading throughout Battleon as Frostval approaches. Log in and check out all the new festivies! Battle Frostfang in the Social District, check out new Holiday crafts, visit the Giving Shrub, and more!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostfangsocial2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5818/promo-frostfangdrops-1.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Frostfang in the Social District[/h2]
From fire to ice... Battle Frostfang, the frost drake in a bad mood, to save the Social District from being frozen over! It's just barely recovered from the flames of Blaze's birthday bonfire.
Frostfang has a chance to drop the items from 2 seasonal cosmetic sets, plus some other festively fun items so challenge him now!
[list]
[*]Sinister Santa Armor set
[*]Dark Kringle Armor set
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostfangsocial2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5819/promo-holidayprizes_snowweapons.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New Holiday Prizes[/h2]
Talk to Rose in the Social District to check out all the new Holiday prizes you can craft. Rose is always happy to reward those who save Frostval from Frostfang!
[list]
[*]Gloa, the Glowing One (Sword)
[*]Lik, the Icy Death (Knuckles)
[*]Veizla, the Feast of Frostvale (Daggers)
[*]Varnaor, Herald of Ice (Staff)
[*]Hermaðr, the Warrior of Winter (Sword)  
[/list]
[h2]The Giving Shrub returns![/h2]
Yulgar’s Inn looked like such a warm and lovely place for The Giving Shrub to set it’s roots down and hand out goodies to all the good people of Battleon!
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostfangsocial2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5821/promo-harbusherreward.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The name’s Bons… Bons-Eye.[/h2]
"I see you found my undercover stakeout location here in the tavern… Since you show such a talent for finding things that don’t want to be found, maybe you could find my “License to Kale”? I’ve a feeling that dastardly Harbusher may have found it, so perhaps you could check there? You’ll be rewarded handsomely of course…"
[list]
[*]Wreath of Khan Pet
[*]Wreath of Khan Travel Form
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostfangsocial2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5820/promo-lastchance.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Last Chance at TLAPD and Dage Collection Chests![/h2]
You read that right! Get your piratical collection chest, or display your allegiance to the Legion with Dage’s collection while you still can. These will only be available for one more week!

[h2]Thank You & Coming Next[/h2]
The team is working hard to make these releases as awesome as possible so we end the year with a bang! In these final weeks of December, we have the Frostval Collection, new Battle Arenas PvP map, the return of Gift'thulu with new items, and the New Year's gift weapon. Also, look forward to an extra surprise or two...

[b]Battle on![/b]
[b]Artix, Glisel, Rellik, and the AQ3D Team[/b]

notes.title: Darkon's Birthday Shop returns!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkon-birthday-2021/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0278d63eb8786ac591f4abe4ff60ac91746f1667.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Darkon is back in Battleon to celebrate his birthday with horrifying new items![/h2]
Darkon is in town right now, relaxing on Battleon Bridge. He is selling off his collection, claiming that he has "too much of them." We aren’t sure why he calls his items "debris", but if you ask me, there’s something strange and sinister about ALL of them. You can buy these items from his birthday shop. You will also find Creatures 72 and 72.b in there. Trust them completely. And don't forget to wish Darkon a happy birthday!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkon-birthday-2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5812/promo-darkonbirthdaygear1.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Darkon's Creatures & Debris[/h2]
[list]
[*]Darkon’s Debris 11 (Spear)
[*]Darkon’s Debris 25 (Big choppy sword)
[*]Darkon’s Debris 31 (Big pointy sword)
[*]Debris Halo 31 (Spiky and floaty)
[*]Debris Halo 64 (Also spiky and floaty but red)
[*]Creature 83 Hat (We remember saying to not do this)
[*]Creature 72 Pet & Travel Form (Adorable)
[*]Creature 72.b Pet and Travel Form (Adorable in it’s own special way)
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkon-birthday-2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5813/promo-darkonbirthdaygear2.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Creature 72 and 72.b[/h2]
While it’s brother is twisted and terrifying, Creature 72.b will float around and keep you company, and definitely doesn’t need to be watched at all times!
Believe it or not, Creature 72 only has your best interests at heart!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkon-birthday-2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5814/forstsiegewar2019-1.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Frost Summoner Cometh![/h2]
Frostval Siege is now working as it’s supposed to. With the war meter fixed, you are guaranteed a confrontation with the boss... as long as you survive the waves long enough to meet him. And in the great deserts of the Sandsea, the mighty djinn Khal-No’Bir has decided to take his Magic Arrow skills down a peg for the brave adventurers who dare to face his might.

[h2]Things leaving AQ3D, for now...[/h2]
Blaze’s Birthday Bonfire is now over, as he takes his leave from Battleon Social District! It won’t be empty for long though, watch out for something different next week!
See you in Frostval.
[b]Battle on![/b]
[b]Artix, Glisel, Rellik, and the AQ3D Team[/b]

notes.title: Frostval Returns!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval-return-2021/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d942aded93dfb2453cb537ca1a25d26c6ae1a952.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]It's that time of year again. It's Frostval![/h2]
[h3]Frostval is that special time of year when heroes and moglins gather 'round the Frostval tree... and fight Yettun in their caves![/h3]
The joy and relief of heroes protecting Frost Moglins from being eaten by Yettuns is the true meaning of Frostval. Not to be confused with Frostvale, which is the wintery land that is also plagued by snow and ice creatures of all types, and Frostlorn and friends in the castle.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval-return-2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5801/holiday-shrub.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Battleon is being decorated for the holidays![/h2]
The festive mood is overtaking Battleon. The citizens of Battleon have equipped their winter best as the weather turns to frost and snow begins to pile up near the travel portal. Yulgar and his regulars at the inn are excited to celebrate Frostval, so they’ve decorated the area and started wearing their most thematic Frostval outfits!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval-return-2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5803/blizzy.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Seasonal Frostval areas are now open[/h2]
Find Blizzy the Frostval Moglin at the Travel Portal and you'll find...
[list]
[*]Frostval Labyrinth - Quick travel to the Frostval Holiday map, complete with story, dungeons, and special crafts.
[*]Frostlorn Raiders - Quick travel to the front of this seasonal dungeon in Frostvale.
[*]Battleon Frost Siege available in Battleon’s Social District.
[*]Previous collections are back! You can purchase the items from these collections individually.
[/list]
Also...
[list]
[*]Seasonal items are back in your daily treasure chests!
[*]You can play through the storyline of Frostval too!
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval-return-2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5809/frostvallabyrinth.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New to the Frostval Labyrinth? Here’s what to look for:[/h2]
Talk to Blizzy
[list]
[*]Crafts - Frosty Reagents (purchase extra crafting materials)
- Frostval Outfits (cosmetic armors)
- Yettun Crafts (cosmetic weapons)
[*]Frostlorn Raiders Dungeon (Level 18+) 
- Frostlorn Rogue Crafts (cosmetic armors)
- Frostlorn Mage Crafts (cosmetic armors)
[/list]
Dungeon Portals
[list]
[*]Left Portal: Level 5+
- Frost Labyrinth
- Yettun Cave
[*]Right Portal: Level 15+
- Epic Yettun Cave
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval-return-2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5799/decpromoplusdcbonus.png[/img][/url]

[h2]December’s promotional pet and travel form![/h2]
Say hello to Bing, the Frostval Vampragon! He likes to wander around singing Frostval carols to passersby, and has been complimented on his singing voice many times! You can obtain your Bing the Vampragon pet and travel form by making a purchase from our upgrade shop this month! Plus, you will still get an additional 50% bonus DragonCrystals with your package this month. Save those for the 2021 Frostval Collection coming soon!
[h2][b]Things leaving AQ3D, for now...[/b][/h2]
Now that Summer is long past, Dottie has returned to Camp Gonnagetcha to make repairs after all the fun and games! Hooper and his Grenwog shops and drops are taking a little break to make room for other things!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval-return-2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5804/battlefalls-frostval.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Feast your eyes on this![/h2]
The Battle Arena is also getting a festive makeover for Frostval. Illuminated trees surrounded by gifts, wreaths adorning the borders, and fluffy white snow flurries. These are a few of the festive aesthetic changes made to the Battle Arena map.
This weekend, join the PTR to enter a new PvP map: Battle Feast. This Map takes place in a Grand Feast Hall. Delicious foods with various effects are present and the bounty zones are locked until notified. Gather food to obtain the advantage and claim the feast for your whole team!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval-return-2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5805/cyberweek.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Cyber week![/h2]
We don’t just do Cyber Monday around here (as if you didn’t know that), so Cyber Week sets are still available! Get your futuristic cyberrific cosmetics while you still can!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval-return-2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5807/unknown-52.png[/img][/url]

[h2]ElectroMage Horns[/h2]

In a “shocking” move, our Community Manager, Rellik, managed to snag a very special pair of horns from the ElectroMage set, and wandered off mumbling something about “community freebies”. We weren’t quite sure what he was on about, but you convinced him to give them to everyone for free! Follow him on [url=https://twitter.com/AeRellik]Twitter[/url] to help unlock other future rewards!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval-return-2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5808/happyfrostval-artix.jpg[/img][/url]

See you in Frostval.
[b]Battle on![/b]
[b]Artix, Glisel, Rellik, and the AQ3D Team[/b]

notes.title: Blaze's Birthday Bonfire!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2482cd4a61f08f246b934ca6567c74c77fdda55f.png[/img]
[h3]"IT’S YA BOI, BLAZE! YOU READY TO GET LIT FAM?"[/h3]
Happy Birthday Blaze! This week’s release marks the very first Blaze’s Birthday Bonfire in AQ3D. We’ve been hard at work preparing for this, with FOUR different Blaze’s to fight, FIVE armor sets, THREE new pets, a new travel form, a new aura, a new gifting item, and a very special summon...

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/blazesbonfire2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5776/blazebday2-social-boss.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Who is Blaze?[/h2]
"A long time ago the raw element of fire was threatening to consume the world in flames. Blaze sacrificed his body to control the flame, imbuing him with the power to control fire, ensuring it does not consume the world. The flame slowly burns away at his body and when he uses his power, there are severe consequences. He wants to be a light to the world, but the brighter he burns, the shorter his wick."
Blaze in real life is a programmer and game designer for AdventureQuest 3D. His passion is in embracing the community and enhancing the social aspects of our game. You can follow him on Twitter at [url=https://twitter.com/BlazeAQ3D]Twitter.com/BlazeAQ3D[/url]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/blazesbonfire2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5777/blazebday2-drops.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Fire Starter[/h2]
Are you a Fire Starter, twisted Fire Starter? Prove it with this HOT new gifting mob! Use the “Fire Starter” item to summon the Gifting Fire. This large sentient flame fights people and gives out gifting rewards. You’ll be seen as a hero to your friends for spawning and fighting these, so start a fire and help put out other fires if you see them!
Drops:
[list]
[*]Wide Blaze’s Calling Card
[*]Wide Blaze (Pet)
[*]Flamewalker Armor Set Pieces
[*]BlazeCoins
[*]Blaze’s Hot Feet Aura
[*]Unbreakable Flamewalker Armor set pieces
[*]Sturdy Flamewalker Armor set pieces
[*]Spellforged Flamewalker Armor set pieces
[*]Reinforced Flamewalker Armor set pieces
[*]Hot Streak
[/list]
[h2]But What's a Hot Streak?![/h2]
Are you feeling lucky and rolling hot? Obtain this rare drop from the Gifting Fire and gain the ability to summon the Gifting Inferno! The Gifting Inferno fights people and gives out all of the same rewards as the Gifting Fire, and even more special rewards at a much higher drop rate.
Hot Streak unique drops:
[list]
[*]Blaze’s Flame Pet
[*]Cinder the Obsidian Blaze Pet
[*]Cinder Travel Form
[*]Blaze's Bapper (pay close attention to its Stats)
[*]A chance at yet another Hot Streak!
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/blazesbonfire2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5778/blazebdaybosses.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The Blaze Boss Variety Pack[/h2]
The flames spread around the Social District as 4 Blaze’s appear, spreading the burning joy and and love! Keep an eye out for Big Bad Blaze, Wide Blaze, Shadow Blaze, and you might catch a sighting of a super rare Blaze boss.
[h2]Flamewalker Armor sets[/h2]
Crash through the fire and flames and carry on with the new Flamewalker Armor sets! Available in five dashing colors, you’ll be able to pick out your favorite!
[list]
[*]Flamewalker Armor set
[*]Unbreakable Flamewalker Armor set
[*]Sturdy Flamewalker Armor set
[*]Spellforged Flamewalker Armor set
[*]Reinforced Flamewalker Armor set
[/list]
[h2]Blaze’s Bapper and the War on UwU[/h2]
[h3]"UwUse your head"[/h3]
Some are aware of Blaze’s disdain for UwU and OwO, and to those that share this sentiment he has made available copies of the mighty Blaze’s Bapper. 
Printed in the heavens above and rolled in the fires below, Blaze's Bapper truly is a relic of untold power. In the great UwU war, Blaze's Bapper was told to have bapped at least 10 million on the head. UwU's and OwO's fear this mighty weapon.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/blazesbonfire2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5780/blazebday2-quests.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Illuminate the Shadows[/h2]
Talk to Blaze in the Social District, assist him with a new daily quest to face Shadow Blaze, and be rewarded with BlazeCoins!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/blazesbonfire2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5779/blazebday2-shops.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]BlazeCoin Gift Shop and Blaze’s Birthday Shop[/h2]
[h3]"Stranger! What are ya buying?"[/h3]
Talk to Blaze in the Social District and browse through his wares.
[list]
[*][i]BlazeCoin Gift Shop[/i] - The only gift you are guaranteed to receive for defeating one of Blaze’s Gifting Fires or Infernos is BlazeCoins. These tokens can be used to purchase pieces from the Flamewalker armor sets as well as Blaze’s Bapper weapon.
[*][i]Blaze’s Birthday Shop[/i] - This is where you can buy the Fire Starter for DragonCrystals, as well as many of the gift items in case you don’t want to wait on luck.
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/blazesbonfire2021/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6fc2f20c44add4c17a16015d214d702192a6f744.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Community Events[/h2]
Looking for a group of friends to celebrate the birthday bonfire? Blaze has coordinated with our AQ3D content creators to have spawning events for the community throughout the week. Check out the schedule to see when and where to find the events.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/blazesbonfire2021/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/750b2a277935ce0c8ba50c724c81d38a1dce5546.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Other things![/h2]
It’s barely been gone, BUT NOW IT’S BACK! Get 50% bonus DC from any package once again! This time it won’t stick around for a full year, so get your DC packages while you can!
Mogloween NPCs will be leaving but you will be able to get to the Masquerade by going to the Cemetery. The Archiducissa Weaver is waiting there to lead you to the ballroom.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/blazesbonfire2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5782/blazebday2-bf-cm.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Coming soon, Black Friday and Cyber Monday![/h2]
Black Friday and Cyber Monday are just around the corner. Be sure to keep an eye on our wonderful artists’ Twitter accounts as you patiently await for the shops to arrive in Battleon next week!
See you in game.
[b]Battle on![/b]
[b]Artix, Glisel, Rellik, and the AQ3D Team[/b]

notes.content:

[h2]"We’ve uncovered more artifacts in the Sandsea!"[/h2]
Valencia has been hard at work uncovering more artifacts from the mysterious dunes of the Sandsea, visit her in Nigel’s Office to see what’s been discovered!

Once you talk to Valencia, check out her Advanced Sandstorm Capstone Rewards Shop to preview and purchase the new sets! Need help getting to Bastion? Talk to Scratch in Battleon or use your Adventure Menu to get there quickly.

[h2]Jackal Warrior’s Capstone Set[/h2]
Decorated with amethysts and rubies, the golden Jackal Warrior’s Set is a shining beacon of the Death God’s protection on the battlefield!

[h2]Jackal’s Wrath Capstone Set[/h2]
This savage breastplate is lined with supernaturally empowered gems that feed on the souls of those slain by its wearer, infusing the wearer with unnatural strength as they serve the Death God of the Sandsea!

[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/advancedcapstonesets/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/52a0c1a6b65e934aea07c5ff3030193c3c9a769f.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Veteran’s Day Shield back items[/h2]
At this time of year, we want to honor all who have defended their real life countries. Artix is in Yulgar’s Inn handing out commemorative golden shield back items emblazoned with a sword and dragons for those who have served and those who want to remember loved ones who have served. Visit his Special Gifts shop to get yours today!
[list]
[*]Bulwark of Honor
[*]Bulwark of Valor
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/advancedcapstonesets/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3d2ac8538a454037ea5aa8145c7b41da92b82daa.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Bonus XP Weekend, now with Class XP![/h2]
It’s all in the title! Play from Friday November 12th, 12PM EST and earn bonus Class XP as well as Player XP in game!
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/advancedcapstonesets/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/83b7e1f02cae0417f9c8fc1d300adc9f17f92c29.png[/img][/url]

[h2]PvP Class Changes[/h2]
[b]Ranger[/b]
Ranger's big AOE spell often takes too long to apply its damage, giving targets more than enough time to move away. This should help Ranger's damage stay more consistent.
Ranger
- Rain of Arrows
* Applies damage over 3 → 1.8 seconds

[b]Ninja[/b]
Though it may sound appropriate for a Ninja, we felt the class has too much "hidden power" lurking in its abilities. We're taking some of the more passive power away from a couple spells in order to make sure that skillful play is required to get the full benefit from Ninja.
- Tempered Blades
* Max stacks Attack +30% → +21%
- Smokestep
* Removed bonus dodge chance

[b]PVP BUFFS[/b]
Ranged and support classes are currently underperforming in PvP, so we are using the class-specific buffs to make adjustments. Currently we have a Melee buff, and we're adding 2 more categories: Ranged and Support. Classes that cover multiple categories will receive the buffs from both. The only exception is Mage since the class is already doing quite well in PvP.
- Melee Buff
* +15% Max Health
* +10% Movement Speed
* Moglomancer now receives both portions of this buff instead of only the movement speed
* Received by Warrior, Rogue, Guardian, Dragonslayer, Paladin, Ninja, Berserker, and Moglomancer

- Ranged Buff
* +10% Damage
* Received by Healer, Ranger, Pirate, and Necromancer

- Support Buff
* +20% healing output
* Received by Healer, Paladin, and Moglomancer

[b]PVP SPELLS[/b]
We're overall pretty happy with the variety of PvP Spells in use, though we want to encourage more healing from support classes (from the PvP Buffs) while not increasing fight durations too much, so we're lowering the heal from Recover. We also want Swiftcast to have usage on more classes than just Mage, so we're adding some Auto-Attack speed to make it more attractive.
- Recover
* Health recovery 15-30% → 10-20%
- Swiftcast
* Now increases Auto-Attack Speed by 30%
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/advancedcapstonesets/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b82f383a178d76d5f7e93ac8cdb68eea81a2f307.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Next week, a HOT new release[/h2]
It’s Blaze’s Birthday Bonfire! He’s taking over the Social District in Battleon with a massive conflagration of monsters, unique items, and all of the FUN! Keep an eye out for it next week, it's gonna be [i]fire. [/i]In fact you could even say it's [i]lit.[/i]
See you in game.

notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/nov21ugradepromo/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2c6f8f7fce45625b826cd58ce249d10c0fba7542.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Galvanite the baby dragon pet and travel form[/h2]

A black dragon that was born with an unnatural ability to produce electricity through the glowing parts of its body. Galvanite, or Galvin as his friends call him, is here to help, ready to bring some shock and awe to your adventures! 

This pet is included with [b]all[/b] packages from the Upgrade Shop, including Guardian and Lore Strider. Guardian packages [i]also[/i] give the travel form version. Check your Pet and Travel Form inventories on your next log in after purchase.

[h3]What if I'm already a Guardian?[/h3]
