notes.title: Enter The Temple of Death! AdventureQuest 3D’s toughest challenge yet...
notes.content:
[h3]"You think you’ve defeated me? You can’t even begin to imagine my full power!"[/h3]
Skorpienne is back, bigger and badder than before! You’ll need to gather your most powerful friends to help you face her at full power in The Temple of Death…
[h2]The Temple of Death - Raid[/h2]
Defeating Skorpienne in The Temple of Death is no easy task, with multiple phases to battle through, and new tactics that will end the fight if you fail to defeat her. Be careful, and don’t get overwhelmed by her armies! Shatter her Destruction Diamonds before she destroys the whole Temple and defeats you all.
Pick up some quests from Sekt before heading to the Great Pyramid to join the Temple of Death raid. We used a similar queue system to the Battle Arena. Make sure you have at least 751 total average power equipped. Skorpienne will only face worthy opponents. When all ten players are ready, you will be teleported to the Raid.
[b]*Note[/b]: [i]You can check your average power in the Equipped Gear section of your inventory.[/i]

[url=www.aq3d.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/96613f8521c9f18637438985117423792dca396a.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]The Rewards[/h2]
This week’s release is packed with epic rewards for defeating the fully powered Skorpienne!
Defeating her in battle gives you a chance to obtain the following from the reward chest…
[list]
[*]Hollowed Champion Bow
[*]Hollowed Champion Dagger
[*]Hollowed Champion Greatsword
[*]Hollowed Champion Scythe
[*]Skorpienne Carapace (crafting materials)
[*]Skorpienne Crystal Fragments (crafting materials)
[/list]
If you destroy all of the Destruction Crystals and prevent the temple from being destroyed, a second special chest will drop with…
[list]
[*]“Battalion” Title
[*]Extra Skorpienne Crystal Fragments
[*]Extra Skorpienne Carapace
[/list]
Of course, there are also a couple of extremely rare items in both chests, but we’ll just let you find out what they are :)
[h2]Hollowed Champion Crafting[/h2]
Visit Sekt to craft the Hollowed Champion armor set and weapons after you’ve slayed Skorpienne again!
[list]
[*]Hollowed Champion Armor
[*]Hollowed Champion Belt
[*]Hollowed Champion Boots
[*]Hollowed Champion Cloak
[*]Hollowed Champion Crown
[*]Hollowed Champion Gloves
[*]Hollowed Champion Plates
[*]Hollowed Champion Dual Daggers
[*]Hollowed Champion Greatsword and Dagger
[/list]
[previewyoutube=LTmV_ygdOII;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]The Masquerade[/h2]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LTmV_ygdOII]We made a video to show off the Masquerade of the Macabre[/url], go and watch it, and tell us if you want us to make more videos like this!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/masquerade/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4802b62eca29dac9bd243af248db188b7446d53c.jpg[/img][/url]
[h3]There are still secrets in the haunted ballroom, do you dare to find them?[/h3]
Talk to Umbra, a mysterious interloper at the Masquerade when your reputation is rank 10... 
A creature of the night made off with one of her valued heirlooms, and she needs help getting it back.

[url=https://www.artix.com/posts/dndkatmwgc/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9bf97527b061e17b1c01cd5d479d4e7c88992b40.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Dungeons & Doomknights is at Midwest Gaming Classic Convention![/h2]
Curious about Dungeons & Doomknights? [url=https://www.artix.com/posts/dndkatmwgc/]Want to meet Artix?[/url] Head over to the Wisconsin Centre in Milwaukee, WI, from November 5th to November 7th.

[url=www.heromart.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/59dadd311df7a7c78a138f1fb3f19addb2972c7f.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]HeroMart[/h2]
Check out the new real-life drops at our online shop, [url=https://www.heromart.com/]HeroMart.com[/url].
[h2]How to level up quickly![/h2]
Eager to play the challenge? Here’s a list of some of the quickest way to level up!
[list]
[*]Finish the Sandsea Saga
[*]Play some PvP
[*]Visit the Masquerade of the Macabre
[*]Play through the story
[/list]
The most efficient way to get your average power level to 751 is to utilize a combination of the following gear:
[list]
[*]Infuse pieces of the Void Sharken to +15 power offset or 15/15 infusion.
[*]Use Zhoom’s Bow; rewarded by completing the Sandsea Saga or any other weapon that can be infused to +15 or 15/15.
[*]Infuse additional pieces of Crocos gear to +10 or 10/10.
[/list]
You need at least 2 items fully infused to 755 Power level and the rest infused to 750 power level to get access to the raid. You can keep checking your average power by clicking Equip Best in your Inventory until the average equals 751 or more.
See you in game.
[b]Battle on![/b]
[b]Artix, Glisel, Rellik, and the AQ3D Team[/b]

notes.title: The Masquerade Ball is live and it's monstrously fun!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Happening in AdventureQuest 3D now[/b][/h2]
Dress sharp, bring your friends, and ready your armaments for an unforgettable night in an abandoned vampire castle. The Phantasm of the Organ is playing, and you never know who you will encounter on the dance floor next.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/masquerade/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7cc5c07c980d2c77bd9e95f092161768856a8207.png[/img][/url]

[h3][b]Featuring[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Dancing Ghosts & dance phases
[*]Summon a horrifying new secret Boss Monster (Designed by Darkon)
[*]Beautifully dark new music (by Jongaar)
[*]51+ new earnable items (by Dage, Thyton, & Winnie)
[*]47 Ballroom quests
[*]Ballroom reputation system
[*]Tongue-in-cheek story/quests (written by Artix)
[*]Secrets (for those of you who like to poke around)
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/masquerade/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/75df37b3427449c9ece63497496fa493c082103d.png[/img][/url]

[h2][b]A Reputable Affair[/b][/h2]
Earn the respect of ancient monstrous nobles as you raise your reputation at the ball. This party was designed as a single setting to keep you and your friends together as you battle on the dance floor.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/masquerade/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5a1393a1afa87eeff64b0db3b68849a31cea81c9.png[/img][/url]

[h2][b]An Evening of Quests, Rewards, and Monsters[/b][/h2]
This is a special Mogloween "farm and chill" release with 51+ incredible rewards... including a boss monster armor set that is so good, you are going to scratch your head and wonder why we did not charge DCs for it.

[url=https://www.heromart.com/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/59dadd311df7a7c78a138f1fb3f19addb2972c7f.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2][b]New stuff at HeroMart[/b][/h2]
Check out the new real-life drops at our online shop, [url=https://www.heromart.com/]HeroMart.com[/url].

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/mogloween-2021-collection-plus-xp-boost-weekend/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6a000ff08580cd64456af26debb8f72d5ed1c437.png[/img][/url]

[h2][b]Happy Mogloween![/b][/h2]
We added plenty of drops & rewards to make sure you would be well suited for the Masquerade. For even more items, and to support our weekly releases, please consider buying this year's [url=https://aq3d.com/news/mogloween-2021-collection-plus-xp-boost-weekend/]new Mogloween collection[/url]! You can get the pieces individually, or buy the entire collection to save a ton of DragonCrystals, get the badge/title, and unlock permanent year round storage to free up bank space.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/masquerade/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8bf7dadddf0fd26b90498bf1dc705cc980571382.png[/img][/url]

[h2][b]Thank you & Game Designer thoughts[/b][/h2]
This is our favorite time of the year. Thank you for spending it with us! A weeks ago, when I asked Llussion if he could build a ballroom (it looks so beautiful), the idea was to create a place where we could hang out, farm monsters, and chill with friends. Dagger came along and added phases to the dancing. The mysterious figure playing the organ switched the dance floor up. We added a crazy number of quests and a few fun side things for you to discover. This is certainly not intended to be a single sitting event! Please do take your time and enjoy it over the next week.

The team and I really hope you and your friends enjoy this Mogloween release. We will be dropping by to dance and cause trouble with you. Look forward to seeing you there.

[b]Battle on![/b]
[b]Artix, Glisel, Rellik and the AQ3D Team[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/255fe9dee82379fe9633ed3e3832ec59993949d0.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]New PvP Rewards[/h2]
[b]"Get Gourd or get Wrekt!"[/b]

Also, we went ahead and dropped 200 DragonCrystals on every character that could have been affected by that old bug. Use it to get something you like from the Mogloween collection.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/mogloween-2021-collection-plus-xp-boost-weekend/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/31939495e5c01d65ad8c14be53cfb39b7257af2a.png[/img][/url]

You are officially invited to the Monstrous Masquerade next Thursday. The event will take place at an undisclosed location. Not much about this mysterious and very formal special Mogloween event is known. Except for the fact that I am still in the process of writing it XD. The last thing I wrote was the Tower of Necromancy. This release will be a bit more... cozy. So the entire event will take place in a grand ballroom. If you do not already have a mask and formal attire, do not worry... there are PLENTY to collect from this event. So if you are in the mood for some classic AE-style "light hearted dark humor" bring some friends and join us for next week's Masquerade.

Thank you to you and all of the players supporting the game and making our weekly releases possible. If you get this year's 2021 Mogloween Collector's Chest, you will also receive a rare badge and title.

See you in game.

notes.title: Rank up and unlock new PvP titles!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlehall/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7af7e7f952b617517fc506a59b43f0557c278d38.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Battle for glory! And new shinies![/h2]
It has been less than a week since [url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlearenalive/]Team vs Team matches were released in AdventureQuest 3D[/url]. The feedback has been overwhelmingly positive, the Red Dragon server has been full, and our team has been hard at work on the improvements and requests from you and other players. While we work on the big ones, you will find new rewards waiting for you in the Battle Hall-- including 4 new titles and a wicked new animated PvP blade.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlehall/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5722/honeycam-2021-10-12-14-56-49.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]Volcanic Fury Sword[/h2]
Forged in magma, the animated fire blazes across the blade of the Volcanic Fury sword. See it for yourself in High Marshall Firebrand's battle arena shop. Use the marks of glory that you earn from PvP to acquire this magnificent blade.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlehall/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5723/pvpnpcs.png[/img][/url]

Upon hearing rumors of how many heroes have been hanging out in the Battle Hall.... Auden the traveling vendor set up shop there.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlehall/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5724/newpvptitles.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Earn 4 new PvP titles[/h2]
High Marshal Firebrand has also been granted the authority to bestow FOUR new titles upon the champions of the Battle Arena. Unlock them in the Rewards Shop by battling in PvP and reaching the required glory ranks.
[list]
[*]Rank 10 - “Skirmisher”
[*]Rank 30 - “Standing in Line”
[*]Rank 50 - “Glorious”
[*]Rank 75 - “Vanquisher”
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlehall/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5725/octobertreasurechest.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Discover new item sets in your Daily Treasure Chests[/h2]
Each day you log into AdventureQuest 3D, you get to open a treasure chest. Be on the lookout for pieces of the Brazen Buccaneer and Swallow Tail sets.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlehall/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5726/brazenbuckaneer.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Brazen Buccaneer set[/h2]
Show the world that you truly are a fearless corsair with the Brazen Buccaneer set including the Double Cutlass (weapon) and Blunderbuss (pistol), now available in your daily treasure chests!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlehall/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5727/swallowtail.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Swallow Tail set[/h2]
Parents would often tell stories of the long-lost warrior clan who protected the skies. Although it's unclear if these tales of avian knights were ever true, the stories of their selflessness and Valor have inspired generations to carry on the mantle of an azure feathered protector. Now you can too, with the Swallow Tail armor set, available in your daily treasure chests.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlehall/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5728/dummy.png[/img][/url]

[h2]"We found a new place!"[/h2]
Amala heard about the Battle Hall and decided there must be some good business there! You can now find them in the Battle Hall offering their services.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlehall/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5729/masqueradeball.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Coming soon to AdventureQuest 3D[/h2]
An anything goes, monster filled Masquerade Ball? Each year, it is our tradition to expand Mogloween with some delightfully dark and devious new adventure. Expect an invitation... and regardless of what the rules say, keep your blades and spells at the ready.
We did a little dev schedule rearranging. The current order for releases is going to be more PvP improvements, Mogloween 2021 Collection, Masquerade Ball, Skorpienne Max Level challenge fight (Be sure to catch up on the Sandsea story if you have not already completed it!), and then our next saga (in the underworld?) will begin.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlehall/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5698/cat-mogloween2021e.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you![/h2]
We love spending the spookiest months of the year with you. Be sure to check out all of this year's returning Mogloween adventures. Also, when you support the game with ANY purchase you will receive [b]Punkin[/b] the cat as a pet.
October also marks the 19th anniversary of our Artix Entertainment video game community! How about we do some giveaways from the games and [url=http://www.HeroMart.com]www.HeroMart.com[/url] to celebrate? Make sure you’re following [url=https://twitter.com/AE_Contests]@AE_Contests[/url] on Twitter and each game on social media, that way you won’t miss out on a chance to win.

[b]Also...[/b]
[url=https://gleam.io/woCoW/adventurequest-3d-giveaway]You can enter the very first giveaway for AdventureQuest3D right here![/url] One of our epic posters is up for grabs, along with the in game reward the poster comes with!

notes.title: Battle Arena
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlearenalive/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ff8cbbd8693b21a55e6fa6504ac6942f80ce9ac2.png[/img][/url]

[h2]"Team Player vs Player matches!"[/h2]
Team vs Team matches have just been released in AdventureQuest 3D. This is a major new feature. The first map is called "[b]Battle Falls[/b]". (Given how high up the walkways are, this is a VERY appropriate name!) Work with your team to control key areas of the map, and defeat your opponents for even more points! This is the first of many PvP maps.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlearenalive/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5705/blazepvp.png[/img][/url]

There are also some epic rewards available for taking part in PvP, start earning them now and show off your prowess everywhere!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlearenalive/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5708/pvpnpc.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The Battle Arena Awaits![/h2]
High Marshal Firebrand is waiting on the bridge to tell you everything you need to know about how to play our first PvP mode Control, show you the rewards, and even take you to the Battle Hall where you can queue up to join a team.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlearenalive/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5709/battlehall.png[/img][/url]

Once you’re familiar with the game play, you can use the PvP button in your game menu. This opens up the PvP “Battle Arenas” menu.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlearenalive/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5706/pvp_menu.png[/img][/url]

Here you can instantly join a queue from [i]wherever you are[/i] and be teleported into the PvP map when both teams are ready.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlearenalive/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5707/pvpmenuquickjoin.png[/img][/url]

You can also teleport to the Battle Hall to meet up with other players, track your Battle Arena Stats, and your Class Glory Levels. All of your Battle Arenas needs are in this menu.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlearenalive/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5717/pvpmap.png[/img][/url]

[h2]“Control” the arena![/h2]
In Control, you and four teammates will battle another team of five to the death to capture three zones, and gain points over time for controlling them (of course you’ll get points for crushing your enemies too).
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlearenalive/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5710/pvp_screenshot_2.png[/img][/url]

There are also temporary Bounty Zones for bonus points. The first team to 750 points wins the match!
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlearenalive/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5711/winscreen.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Always know where you stand[/h2]
At the end of each match, a win screen will show the results of the match including how well each player did within their own teams… an extra incentive to try your hardest. Of course, it also shows your loot.
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlearenalive/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5712/newarmors.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Marks of Glory rewards[/h2]
Earn awesome new rewards in the Battle Arena by taking part in PvP! Dage, Winnie, and Thyton have been hard at work making new sets for rewards. For each PvP match you play, you will earn [i]Marks of Glory[/i]. These Marks can be turned into the Rewards shop on [b]High Marshal Firebrand[/b] in the Battle Hall (PvP lobby) or Battleon.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlearenalive/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5713/pvprewards.png[/img][/url]

Dage has tapped into his wild side to create the [b]Savage Warlord and Savage Warlord Supreme[/b] sets, each with their own unique Swords.
Winnie has been channeling the light to make the [b]Knight of Radiance[/b] set including a choice of a Staff or Hammer.
Thyton felt the call to rule, no matter what, and fashioned the [b]Imperial Usurper[/b] set with a mighty Sword.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlearenalive/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5714/blazepvp.png[/img][/url]
[h2]PvP Interview![/h2]
If you have not already seen it,[url=https://aq3d.com/news/pvpinterview/] read the PvP interview[/url] with AdventureQuest 3D Devs Blaze and Rabblefroth.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlearenalive/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5715/mogloween2017.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Coming soon to AQ3D[/h2]
The big event this month will be the Masquerade Ball. You are certain to get an invitation. But no one seems to know who the host is....

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlearenalive/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5716/challengefight.png[/img][/url]

Next week on AdventureQuest3D, fight Skorpienne at her full power in the new challenge fight, and earn a new Best in Stat set with +20 infusion!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battlearenalive/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5698/cat-mogloween2021e.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you![/h2]
We love the spookiest months of the year. Thank you for being here with us. This month's reward for anyone who supports the game with ANY purchase in the Upgrade Shop is Punkin the Cat. Literally ANY purchase... even the cheapest DC package... you're getting this Punkin pet.

October is also Artix Entertainment’s anniversary! We are celebrating with multiple giveaways for our games and online store, [url=https://www.heromart.com/]HeroMart.com[/url]. Make sure you’re following [url=https://twitter.com/AE_Contests]@AE_Contests[/url] on Twitter and each game on social media, that way you won’t miss out on a chance to win.

[b]Battle on![/b]
[b]Artix, Glisel, Rellik, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

notes.title: Mogloween begins! Or... is it Tacoween? O_o
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tacoween/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c6f10b57bfca48c8c37e20752f2c3ed577b1cebe.png[/img][/url]

[h3]"The smell of pumpkin spice fills the air... with a lil' whiff of taco."[/h3]
As you read this, the fog has opened revealing a path to the haunted town of Mystcroft. Journey there and discover the haunted house, mad science lab, a graveyard of the  dancing dead, and the best drops and shops of previous years. How to get there? Try chatting with the talking black cauldron that is in the center of our hometown. His name is Myx.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tacoween/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5682/mystcroftmanor-inside.jpg[/img][/url]

Meanwhile, in the social district of our hometown, the notoriously tenacious Tito Taco has returned for [b]Taco Day[/b]!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tacoween/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5683/tacodaywasyouridea.jpg[/img][/url]

We are kicking off our dark and spooky October festivities early so that the team can focus on next week's major feature release-- team vs team PvP for all players! Receiving rave reviews from testers, our first match mode sends your team in to capture and hold locations. It is a lot of fun and the PvP rewards look awesome!

[h2]Mogloween Top 10 List![/h2]
Every year, all the content from the previous years return... then, we add something new near the end of October. Here are some things you can do right now!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tacoween/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/3445/mystcroft-center.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]#1 Town of Mystcroft[/b]
Talk to Myx the black cauldron to travel to this spookalicious town.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tacoween/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5681/hauntedhouse.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]#2 Haunted Mansion[/b] 
The haunted halls of Mystcroft Manor contain 4 wings with devilish surprises! Dare you find The Great Dreamer (of pies) Gourd’thulu?

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tacoween/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5185/raveyard.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]#3 G'Rave Yard[/b]
An 100% ebil moglin is either having a dance party, or unleashing an undead invasion. Either way, you better check it out.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tacoween/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/4460/drtrollenstein-madscience.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]#4 Mad Science Lab[/b]
Dr. Trollenstein is dying to have you come to his Laboratory for a free check up! There's loads of fun and a comparably high survival rate to his last lab.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tacoween/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5199/mogloweenfishing.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]#5 Mystcroft Fishing[/b]
Those slime pools are not going to fish themselves. Catch some spooktastic fish.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tacoween/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5207/trickortreast.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]#6 Trick or Treating[/b]
Trick or treat! Acquire the sugary goodness from knocking on doors, slaying the various ghouls and ghosts, or completing quests. Once you've collected enough, you can trade it in for bigger and better treats!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tacoween/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5684/bootalcorn.png[/img][/url]

[b]#7 Boo-talcorn[/b]
"Why ya ghost'n me, brah?" 
Be on the lookout for this rare spawn mini-boss monster. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tacoween/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/4455/headlesshorseman2.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]#8 The Headless Horseman of Mystcroft[/b]
No longer the head of his class, but somehow still a head above the rest. This rare spawn mini-boss is also located in Mystcroft.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tacoween/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5685/pumpkinlordandgourdthulu.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]#9 Gourd’thulu[/b]
If someone had told Charlie Brown he was summoning a C’thulian ancient one, he probably would have stayed clear of that pumpkin patch. Battle this epic boss in the most dangerous wing of the Haunted House. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tacoween/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5201/trollenstriensmonster.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]#10 Trollenstein’s Monster[/b]
"It's alive! It's aliiiive!" Battle this world boss which sometimes spawns outside the haunted house. Remember, Trollenstein is the name of the scientist, not the monster. Which is extra confusing since the monster is clearly a Trolluk Golem and the scientist is not a Trolluk. Weird O_O

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tacoween/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/caac5e1f7678a144e4e53e4f7395503826f17a21.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Mogloween 2020 Trove Returns![/h2]
Speak to Mayor Mc'Pumpkin to start your very own Mogloween Trove. It is a free collection which you build by turning in items.... and includes your very own UwU Pumpkin Pet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a33f62d3520a56b7db926cf3c8359ddbc876078c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Taco Day![/h2]
Tito the terrific, tenacious taco enthusiast is now back in the Social District. He's waiting to teach you how to make tacos for Taco Day. These tacos are more than just delicious crunchy goodness, they are... money. You can trade them in for items in the Taco Day Shop!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tacoween/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ee924882afba498b24663152150fa82458772436.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Coming next.... PvP & Masquerade Ball[/h2]
Each year, we kick off our fall festivities with the return of Mogloween, then we add something new. Rumor has it, there is going to be a Masquerade Ball this year. Maybe you will get an invitation? Before that, get ready for a big feature release: "[b]Team vs Team PvP![/b]" One of the PvP armor sets revealed above.

The best time of the year... begins now.

[b]Taco-ween on![/b]
[b]Artix, Glisel, Rellik, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

notes.title: The Sandsea Saga finale is live!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseafinale/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a4b45af0a79b15cc3e8edc385f6888f5efe82ec2.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The Sandsea Saga Finale[/h2]
Need a refresher on everything you've experienced in the Sandsea Saga until the finale? [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=By2i7E4iTvY]Watch this trailer![/url]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=By2i7E4iTvY][url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseafinale/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5665/sandseatrailer.png[/img][/url][/url]

[h2]The Keeper of Death awaits![/h2]
This week, it’s time to see where all the twists and turns of the labyrinthian Sandsea Saga have led to! The final chapter in the saga will see you venturing into the Keeper of Death Sanctuary to intervene in Lord Sekt’s attempt to wish for greater power! Will [b]Skorpienne, the Keeper of Death[/b] and creator of the Lamp fulfill Lord Sekt’s wish or does she have other plans for the rapidly weakening Immortal Pharaoh of the Sandsea? And what surprises could the Voidrakar have in store? After all, Vane and his minions have been cooking up a devious plan regarding the Lamp…
What will occur in the finale? You’ll just have to play to find out!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseafinale/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5661/skorpbattlesubtle-1920x1080.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Epic Final Battle[/h2]
The end of a saga also means an epic final battle! The line between friend and foe will be blurred when the fate of the entire Sandsea is at stake. Will you and your allies be able to topple a threat of the likes you have not yet seen!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseafinale/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5662/skorpiennewardrobe-1920x1080.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Skorpienne’s Wardrobe[/h2]
We know many of you are excited to see the debut of Skorpienne, Keeper of Death. That’s why we went ahead and made her outfit available to you all! To craft her set visit Sekt in his Pyramid and he’ll send you on quests to gather the materials needed to craft [b]Skorpienne’s Wardrobe[/b] from the repeatable boss fight. However, if repeat runs of this fight isn’t for you, we have made Skorpienne’s cosmetic set available to be bought for DC’s as well!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseafinale/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5660/zhoomsancestralbow-1920x1080.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Zhoom’s Bow[/h2]
Early in the Sandsea Saga, Zhoom gave you his bow to allow you to proceed in your quest to find the magic lamp. [i]Zhoom’s Ancestral Bow[/i] is famed for its quality, still able to make precise shots like no other. With high Attack and Haste stats, its wielder can quickly overwhelm any monster that crosses their path! Who knows? Perhaps it will find a new owner by the end of this tale…

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseafinale/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5663/dunescrollerpromov2-1920x1080.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New Titles and Special Reward[/h2]
Heroic efforts deserve equally heroic titles, right?! Show off your part in The Sandsea Saga and wear your titles with pride. You’ll receive the “[i]Sandsea Protector[/i]” title upon completing the Saga.
Also, everyone’s favorite historian Nigel Fuzzybum has a special gift for those who have completed the Lost Sandsea Scrolls quest line: a Sandsea Scroll cosmetic weapon and the title “[i]Dune Scroller[/i]”! Go see Nigel in Bastion and accept the quest called “A Token of Historical Appreciation” to receive your rewards.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/alphapiratefiend/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9c8572dc883b165cf5ab3fbfedf42b9e178c3888.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Alpha Pirate Fiend JUST added to the collection![/h2]
Get the Alpha Pirate fiend armor set as pieces or a part of the [b]2021 Talk Like a Pirate Day collection[/b]. Woah, woah... wait. Did you already buy the collection? Then... congratulations, you already have it! You will find the entire set has already been added to your collection. This set is also a not-so-secret clue as to AdventureQuest 3D's upcoming new saga. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseafinale/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5664/mogloweennextweek.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Coming soon to AQ3D![/h2]

After that… A new saga...

[b]Battle on![/b]
Artix, Glisel, Baleerio, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: Hoist the sail, it’s Talk Like a Pirate Day!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tlap2021/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/051f0f8e3cddab07530d5655ec53be8995c748d6.png[/img][/url]

[h2]What is Talk Like a Pirate Day?[/h2]
Shiver me timbers! This coming Sunday (September 19th) is the official International Talk Like a Pirate Day (Or "TLAPD" if ye be one'o dem abbrever-inating scallywags). It is a one-day holiday where we... well, me matey, the name pretty much sums it up. All day long, kindly be talking like Pirates! [url=http://talklikeapirate.com/wordpress/sample-page/]Created by John Baur & Mark Summers[/url], we have been celebrating it every single year across [url=umbraco/artix.com]our video games[/url]. An insider secret, our video games were the first to celebrate this holiday... and have done it every year since 2003 when Captain Rhubarb suddenly appeared in-game.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tlap2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5647/talklikeapirateday2021collection.png[/img][/url]

[h2]2021 Collection[/h2]
Th' collection be featurin’ two amazin' piratical sets crafted by our AQ3D artists, as well as a bony bird pet (Marrow), two extra fishin’ rods, and a travel form! Ye will also be obtainin' th' "[i]Stranger Tides[/i]" title and badge with yer collection!
Ye can speak to Gunpowder Mary in Battleon (or Lolosia) to unlock this year's collection or grab some booty a'la carte from previous year's collections!
[list]
[*]Marrow Pet (bird)
[*]Snaggletooth travel form (sabertooth)
[*]Cannoneer set
[*]Shark Hunter Pirate set
[*]Life at Sea Fishing Rod
[*]Buried at Sea Fishing Rod
[*]Badge and Title “[i]Stranger Tides[/i]” (only with purchase of Collector’s Chest)
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tlap2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5643/fish-tale.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New quests? In Lolosia AND Yokai?![/h2]
That’s right! Go and talk to Requin (the crazy shark lady) to start the quest to find out what happened to the Dread Pirate Roberto. Speak to Blue Bart as well, and begin the hunt for the Cursed Fishing Rod, then try it out! We also added a new fishing location on one of the islands... just watch out for the walking shark… Finally, return to the mysterious island of Yokai and complete The Shiro Special to unlock Master Shiro’s Tsunamurai Shop.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tlap2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5645/shirospecial.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Tsunamurai[/h2]
Reach deep into your centre of being and become one with the waves in the Tsunamurai set. Channel the powers of the ocean and show your foes a tsunami of blades! Consult with Master Shiro in The Shadow Of The Wind Village about the "[b]Shiro Special[/b]" to start earning the Tsunamurai Set.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tlap2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5642/dreadpirate.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Dread Pirate Roberto[/h2]
The Dread Pirate Roberto was known as a dashing, fashionable rogue of a pirate, and while his manners are inimitable, you can at least dress like him! Talk to Requin to start unlocking the Dread Pirate Roberto’s Set now in the quest "[b]Dreadful Pirate Tale[/b]"!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/tlap2021/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8e4ff51d3807aa0e0d826a74b07a2a112890d03a.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Coming soon to AQ3D![/h2]
Soon, the team will begin the endless chant of “[i]PvP! PvP! PvP[/i]!”. PVP on the PTR will soon be open to PC and mobile players (previously just PC). [url=https://discord.gg/4RfD2QF]Join the Community PTR Discord[/url] for updates.

Also… The epic conclusion to The Sandsea Saga! We hope you’re ready for the fight of your life...
 
[b]Battle on![/b]
Artix, Glisel, Rellik, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: Gunpowder Mary: Back with a BANG!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2021pretlapd/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4647e1c2192cb8e8f92446fa0c4b41392f66df84.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Avast! This week on AQ3D[/h2]
This week we’re swabbing the decks, hoisting the sails, and getting ready to fly the black flag, all in preparation for Talk Like a Pirate Day! Now that Pointe Less Isle is relatively shark free, Annette decided to head back to the beach. There also are two new item sets you’ll be able to find in treasure chests, and Gunpowder Mary is making her explosive return to Battleon! Read on to find out more...

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2021pretlapd/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5633/2019collection.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Previous TLaPD sets![/h2]
Gunpowder Mary is back with a bang! Talk to her in Battleon to get previous Talk Like a Pirate Day collections, dare ye fly the black flag and wear the piratey sets?

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2021pretlapd/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5634/tlapd-aq3d-2021.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Two new cosmetic sets![/h2]
Move with the shadows in the new Eclipse Assassin set, or hold the line with the Garnet Garrison set. You can obtain these new sets from treasure chests starting now!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2021pretlapd/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5548/sharkwar-bettereredition.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Pointe Less Isle Shark Attack Ending[/h2]
Thanks to your efforts, the sharks are retreating from Pointe Less Isle. Annette is heading back to enjoy the shark free beach, but what will they plan next year?

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2021pretlapd/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5635/sandseafinalesoon.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Coming soon to AQ3D![/h2]
The team got together and decided the finale needs to be the best it can be, so we’re delaying it for a short while. We’re committed to quality, and hope you support us making this decision! After the epic conclusion of the Sandsea Saga, we’ll also be releasing new gear sets purchasable with Sandstorm Capstones (infuseable up to +20!), and another Challenge fight.
In the meantime... Talk Like a Pirate Day begins next week (around September 19th) with new quests and new rewards. And we’re finally [b]ending the DC sale[/b] at Midnight on Tuesday the 14th (EST), so don’t miss out!
 
[b]Battle on![/b]
Artix, Glisel, Rellik, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: Now that’s how you get a-head!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/newheadmorphs/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5b5c01c442362f3e08d6391af29019155e55fa23.png[/img][/url]

[h2]A Head above the rest[/h2]
Get a-head with our new Kittarian (feline) and Zobekian (crocodile) head morphs added to AdventureQuest 3D. The Guardian Tower has also added a new armor set for the Mages in their ranks. And if you have caught up with the Sandsea Saga, you will recognize the oversized Djinn weapons Gaz is now selling for a limited time!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/newheadmorphs/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5628/headsandtails.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New Head Morphs[/h2]
Head on over to Mysterious Johnson’s House of Oddities, or Gaz’s Black Market near the gates of Battleon right meow and purr-haps get your paws on one of the new Kittarian Head Morphs, or if you feel like croc-ing out, there’s the new Zobekian Head Morph too!
[list]
[*]White Fur Kittarian Head Morph
[*]Tan Fur Kittarian Head Morph
[*]Brown Fur Kittarian Head Morph
[*]Brown Scute Zobekian Head Morph
[/list]
If you’re lucky, you can also find the following Head Morphs in chests
[list]
[*]Blue Fur Kittarian Head Morph
[*]Blue Scute Zobekian Head Morph
[/list]
[h2]Heads or Tails?[/h2]
But wait, there’s more! Each of the new Kittarian and Zobekian Head Morphs also includes a tail! As if you didn’t have enough reasons to go and get one now, right?

[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/newheadmorphs/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5629/giantdjinnitems.png[/img][/url]
Giant Djinn Weapons[/h2]
Gaz has somehow braved the Sandsea and convinced the great Khal-No’Bir to let him sell copies of the Djinn’s giant arsenal! Are you up to the challenge of wielding such massive weaponry?
[list]
[*]Giant Djinn Sword
[*]Giant Djinn Blaster
[*]Giant Djinn Bow
[*]Giant Djinn Hammer
[/list]
Gaz will offer the Giant Djinn weapons for a limited time, but the weapons can be purchased from Khal-No’Bir, too, in the lobby of the Great Pyramid!
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/newheadmorphs/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5627/guardianmage.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Guardian Mage set?![/h2]
That’s right, the Guardians Mage Battalion are searching for recruits who show a talent for magic (and not the kind involving bunnies or hats). Head to the Guardian Tower Shop, bring your Mage Class Tokens to prove your worth, and be granted the esteemed Guardian Mage Set.
[list]
[*]Guardian Mage Armor
[*]Guardian Mage Gloves
[*]Guardian Mage Hood
[*]Guardian Mage Shoulders
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/newheadmorphs/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5630/sandseafinale-nextweek2.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Next week on AdventureQuest3D![/h2]
Next week we return to Sandsea for the saga’s grand finale. After his ruthless betrayal, will Lord Sekt succeed in getting his wish granted? What awaits you in the Keeper of Death’s Ethereal Pyramid? Will Voidrakar appear to complete Vane’s plan? All those answers and more, next week in the Sandsea!

[b]Battle on![/b]
Artix, Glisel, Rellik, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

[b]P.S.[/b] The Summer War event will be ending next week, and Annette will be taking a break from Battleon to make room for the annual #TLAPD event. Get your Summer gear while you can!

notes.title: The Djinn's Challenge: The Labyrinth of Persistence
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/djinnchallenge/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b37cee6070f3f96646de4dce71ddbfde3269bcab.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The Djinn’s Challenge[/h2]
Khal-No’Bir has some new tricks up his sleeve in his new challenges, such as teleporting you out of his room, clouds of death throughout his labyrinth, and a timer that’s slowly ticking down to… Probably certain doom. Win the challenge, and you will be rewarded with Djinn Challenge Treasure! Khal-No’Bir also has a chance to drop some Epic new loot, such as Khal-No’Bir’s Crowned Turban and some Menacing Djinn weapons...

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/djinnchallenge/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5623/gauntlet-match.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Gauntlet Match Challenge[/h2]
Winning one battle can be a matter of luck, but can you handle successive victories in a day? Defeat Khal-No’Bir twice in a normal fight, and twice in the challenge fight, and you’ll be richly rewarded!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/djinnchallenge/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5624/clear-the-labyrinth.png[/img][/url]

[h2]“Clear the Labyrinth of Persistence”[/h2]
Khal-No’Bir has another quest for you… and this one you can repeat as many times as you please! Try to clear out his army of Spectral Mummies and Mummy Guards on your way to fight him in his Labyrinth, and earn Djinn Essence, gold, and valuable experience!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/djinnchallenge/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5622/aq3d-24-8-sandsea-ch2.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The Challenge[/h2]
You’ve faced him once, but not at full power! Find your way through the twists and turns of The Labyrinth of Persistence, activate the crystals, and face the wrath of the Djinn once more. Watch out for his variety of Area of Effect attacks that deal massive damage, don’t stumble into the clouds of death throughout the labyrinth, and be ready for him to teleport you away. Make sure you stock up on potions, and don’t forget to dodge!

Joined an instance with just a few people? We’ve got some tips for [i]How to Survive Khal-No’Bir[/i]:
[list]
[*]Suggested Party Composition: at least one of each class type - healing, ranged, tank
[*]Dodge the AOEs
[*]Bring some potions
[*]Don’t dally in the dungeon! Move quickly and get back to the fight.
[*]Watch out for the death clouds in the labyrinth.
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/djinnchallenge/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5621/aq3d-24-8-sandsea-ch3.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New drops and crafting[/h2]
Defeat Khal-No’Bir in his NEW challenge to accrue Solar Djinn Stones. Use these to upgrade the Sun Keeper armor set you’ve spent the whole saga collecting into the new [b]Fallen Sun Keeper[/b] set. However, you can only earn the accompanying sword from the Djinn Challenge. Each set piece features a +15 Infusion cap, putting this set on par with the Void Sharken set. And just in time for the Sandsea finale next month…

A suit of armor modeled after the one worn by Sairus, Sandsea’s fabled Keeper of the Sun. The Fallen color scheme symbolizes the Keeper’s fall from grace during her last days in Sandsea…

[h3]“Fallen Sun Keeper” Crafting Items[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fallen Sun Keeper Armor
[*]Fallen Sun Keeper Belt
[*]Fallen Sun Keeper Boots
[*]Fallen Sun Keeper Cloak
[*]Fallen Sun Keeper Gloves
[*]Fallen Sun Keeper Helm
[*]Fallen Sun Keeper Pauldrons
[/list]
Upgrade your Mystical Djinn armor set to the new[b] Menacing Djinn set[/b]. This set is red to match the menace of Khal-No’Bir in this challenge. The new menacing weapons are spectral in form and are rarely bestowed by the Djinn himself to those who earn it in combat. 

[h3]“Djinn Crafting” Items[/h3]
[list]
[*]Menacing Djinn Robes
[*]Menacing Djinn Belt
[*]Menacing Djinn Boots
[*]Menacing Djinn Gauntlets
[*]Menacing Djinn Shoulders
[/list]
[h3]New item drops[/h3]
[list]
[*]Menacing Djinn Bow
[*]Menacing Djinn Blaster
[*]Menacing Djinn Hammer
[*]Menacing Djinn Sword
[*]Fallen Sun Keeper Sword
[/list]
See you in halls of the Labyrinth!

[b]Battle on![/b]
Artix, Glisel, Rellik, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

Upgrade your Mystical Djinn armor set to the new Menacing Djinn set. This set is red to match the menace of Khal-No’Bir in this challenge. The new menacing weapons are spectral in form and are rarely bestowed by the Djinn himself to those who earn it in combat.
Menacing Djinn Bow
Menacing Djinn Blaster
Menacing Djinn Hammer
Menacing Djinn Sword
Fallen Sun Keeper Sword

notes.title: Sandsea Saga Part 8: The Djinn’s Labyrinth
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandsea8/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e2f46f4c5b7404e9f84acac21088a880f3a5a859.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The Djinn of the Lamp: Khal-No’Bir[/h2]
With the lamp reassembled, you are now able to enter the Djinn’s chamber. Seek the Djinn of the lamp, Khal-No’Bir, within the Great Pyramid, navigate the labyrinth inside, and collect the four hidden crystals. Activate them to be granted entry to Khal-No’Bir’s chamber and defeat him. Deliver the final blow to him and the wish is yours...

[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandsea8/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5615/labyrinth.png[/img][/url]
The Labyrinth (Dungeon)[/h2]
Getting to Khal-No'Bir won't be easy, as the Djinn waits for you at the end of a spellbinding labyrinth deep inside the [b]Great Pyramid[/b]! To complete The Labyrinth, you must navigate through its treacherous multi-colored halls to find a means to power up the doorway to the [b]Djinn's Chamber[/b]. Luckily for you, Lord Sekt is willing to impart on a clue that may help shine a light on your path to Khal-No'Bir...

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandsea8/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5614/sunkeeper.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Dungeon Rewards: The Keeper’s Treasure[/h2]
The Keeper’s Treasure reward chest contains Djinn Essence (crafting material), with the possibility of additional items such as [b]Mystical Djinn[/b] weapons and the final piece of the [b]Sun Keeper[/b] set.
[list]
[*]Sun Keeper Armor
[*]Sun Keeper Helm (final piece of the Sun Keeper set!)
[*]Sun Keeper Cloak 
[*]Mystical Djinn Sword (cosmetic)
[*]Mystical Djinn Hammer (cosmetic)
[*]Mystical Djinn Blaster (melee cosmetic)
[*]Mystical Djinn Bow (cosmetic)
[/list]
[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandsea8/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5616/genie.png[/img][/url]
Rematch![/h2]
Turns out the Djinn comes with a [b]Rematch Clause[/b]. This Daily quest rewards you with 10 Djinn Treasure if you can best him again. This treasure can be used to craft garments and accessories fit for a Djinn.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandsea8/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5617/mysticaldjinnset.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Djinn Crafting[/h3]
Use your Djinn Essence and Treasure to craft the [b]Mystical Djinn armor set[/b]. The set includes:
[list]
[*]Mystical Djinn Robes
[*]Mystical Djinn Belt
[*]Mystical Djinn Boots
[*]Mystical Djinn Gauntlets
[*]Mystical Djinn Shoulders
[/list]
[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandsea8/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5613/campshrade-april2018-header.jpg[/img][/url]
Camp Gonnagetcha has Returned![/h2]
Camp Gonnagetcha is here but there is no new Shrade and no camp war. You can craft all existing camp items now and still grind the Shrade monsters for those super rare drops. [b]Just head to Yulgar’s Inn[/b] and talk to Dottie, the High ArchCounselor. New Friday the 13th content will now happen in the new evergreen (permanent) Cabin in the Globe.
[b]Note:[/b] You may see a new Shrade-like monster pop up in Live Events, so keep an eye on our social media. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandsea8/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5618/soonsandseaconclusion.png[/img][/url]

[h2]-Coming Soon-[/h2]
We're just a few weeks away from not only the story's conclusion, but also a new endgame challenge! This challenge will be your means to attain a new [b]Best-In-Stat[/b] armor set with a +20 Infusion cap! And who knows, maybe there'll also be a Legendary weapon for you to find too... Guess we'll find out in September!

[b]Battle on![/b]
Artix, Glisel, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: A New Friday the 13th Adventure!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/f13slashcatchem/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2743e106f374d94c4d6ddfc0bd5ccc3bc06cf7f5.png[/img][/url]

[h2]It’s Friday The 13th and the start of a new tradition![/h2]
How do you feel about spooky cursed artifacts? The 1st one has JUST arrived at the House of Oddities. (You know, that weird shop located in the social district of town.)

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/f13slashcatchem/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5606/houseofoddities.png[/img][/url]

Welcome to the start of an all new tradition. On all Friday the 13ths Spectacular Mendretti will send in a new cursed artifact (When he remembers to pay postage) to Mysterious Johnson’s House of Oddities. See the first one, a cursed globe full of evil Dreadites today!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/f13slashcatchem/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5608/newfrieday13thtradition.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Slash Catch’em[/h2]
Slash Catch’em, legendary hero and Dreadite Slayer extraordinaire, has been working with Mysterious Johnson in his House of Oddities, facing hordes of Dreadites in the Odd Globe to prevent them from escaping to wreak havoc all over Lore! Talk to Slash Catch’em in Battleon to learn more about fighting the Dreadite demons and use your Dreadite parts to craft some slashy gear. Good, bad, he’s the guy with the Noisemaker!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/f13slashcatchem/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5609/whosthatdeadite.png[/img][/url]

[h2]“Dreadite Wrangler”[/h2]
Help Slash collect em’ all! There’s a lot of Dreadites out there; some small and squishy, and others big enough to easily squish you. Slash is kind enough to help you get familiar with all the varieties and take down a few of each! Help him out by slashing and/or catching a total of TWENTY ONE Dreadites of different kinds, and he might be nice enough to give you a brand new Slashy Coupon to use in his Pet Shop!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/f13slashcatchem/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5607/kulzandar.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Meet the Boss: Kul’Zandar[/h2]
Kul’Zandar is one big, bad, evil Dreadite, and is the driving force behind the potential Dreadite invasion! Hack and slash your way through the Cabin and spill enough Dreadite ooze to summon Kul’Zandar. Once he’s been summoned, you’ll face a giant Dreadite with a variety of Area of Effect attacks that deal BIG damage. Make sure you stock up on potions, and don’t forget to dodge. He also has a veeerrrrryyyyy small chance of dropping an extra special pet!

Joined an instance with just a few people? We’ve got some tips for [i]How to Survive Kul’Zandar[/i]:
[list]
[*]Suggested Party Composition: at least one of each class type - healing, ranged, tank
[*]Dodge the AOEs
[*]Bring some potions
[*]Get real close to Kul’Zandar’s nasty face
[*]Don’t forget your Noisemaker!
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/f13slashcatchem/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5610/dreadzard.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The Gnarled Dreadzard[/h2]
Be cautious when exploring the world inside The Odd Globe, as you may run into the horrifying Gnarled Dreadzard! IF you manage to slay this gargantuan creature, you have a chance to obtain a haul of Dreadite Remains, some Zandarian Grimoire pages, or you may be so lucky to obtain one of three rare pets...

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/f13slashcatchem/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5604/cabinintheglobecrafting.png[/img][/url]

[h2]“Cabin in The Globe” Crafting[/h2]
Well hello Mr Fancy-greaves! After you’ve put down the Dreadite menace, return to Mysterious Johnson’s Shop to turn in your quest and take your gooey Dreadite Parts to the Cabin the Globe crafting shop. You will be able to craft seven new weapons and a fresh set of Dreadite Slayer armor! Try to keep the ooze off of your new threads, yeah?
[h3]Crafting Items[/h3]
[list]
[*]Dreadite Slasher Armor
[*]Dreadite Slasher Belt
[*]Dreadite Slasher Boots
[*]Dreadite Slasher Collar
[*]Dreadite Slasher Gloves
[*]Dreadite Slasher Holster
[*]Dreadite Slasher Plates
[*]Dreadite Slasher Chainsaw
[*]Dreadite Slasher Noisemaker
[*]Dreadite Slasher Saw & Noisemaker
[*]Dreadite Slasher Chain-Axe
[*]Dreadite Slasher Dual-Saws
[*]Dreadite Soul-full Greatsword
[*]Dreadite Soul-full Staff
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/f13slashcatchem/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5605/gottacraftthemall.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Slash Catch’em’s Pet Shop[/h2]
Help Slash cull the Dreadites enough and he might show you how to tame a few to keep as pets... Can’t say that’s a smart thing to do, but who are we to judge? Just make sure you lock your cellar at night, or they’ll swallow your soul!
[h3]Pets available[/h3]
[list]
[*]Lil’ Dreadzard Pet
[*]Hangry Dreadzard Pet
[*]Shiny Dreadzard Pet
[*]Dinky Dreadite Skull Pet
[*]Flying Dreadite Skull Pet
[*]Shiny Dreadite Skull Pet
[*]Chibi Shamblin’ Dreadite Pet
[*]Shamblin’ Dreadite Pet
[*]Shiny Shamblin’ Dreadite Pet
[*]Dreadite Spiderling Pet
[*]Shiny Dreadite Spider Pet
[*]Lil’ Trolly Dreadite Pet
[*]Dreadite Trolok Pet
[*]Shiny Dreadite Trolok Pet
[*]Dreadite Evil Sapling
[*]Dreadite Evil Tree Pet
[*]Shiny Dreadite Evil Tree Pet
[/list]
[h2]Hey, what about Camp Gonnagetcha?[/h2]
Camp Gonnagetcha will also be making a return next week. Also, May the 4th shops and Commander Mogrevious have left Battleon until next year.

[h2][url=https://heromart.com/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5611/heromartfri13-2021posters.png[/img][/url]
Heromart news![/h2]
The all new Friday the 13th posters for AdventureQuest3D and AdventureQuestWorlds will be available to order at [url=https://aq3d.com/umbraco/HeroMart.com]HeroMart.com[/url] on, you guessed it, Friday the 13th! Don’t forget to get it while you can...

[h2]Happy Friday the 13th![/h2]
See you in game, at the cabin inside that cursed globe O_O....

Battle on!
Artix, Glisel, Rellik, Baleerio, and the rest of the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: Spikarox! A New Daily Boss Fight for all players
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseadailyboss/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5809c50959e6f8c9a1f4ef065fda2a318051b4b7.png[/img][/url]

[h2]All players can battle Spikarox in the new Daily Boss fight![/h2]
Not caught up on the Sandsea Saga, yet? Don’t worry. Players of all levels are welcome to join this fight. The new [b]Sandsea Daily Boss[/b] fight just went live. Join us online now for a taste of the Sandsea city of Bastion and some of its deadly desert creatures with great rewards!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseadailyboss/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5600/scorpoinbossfight.png[/img][/url]

[h2]I'll scratch your back if you scratch... Scratch's?[/h2]
Scratch is the half-cat Kitarian from Battleon. He recruits high level heroes to adventure in the Sandsea Desert. You will also find him in this week's new Sandsea Daily Boss fight. Talk to him to learn about the “Pest Invasion” and get a look at the exciting new items you can craft with your rewards.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseadailyboss/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5602/dailybossfightbutton.png[/img][/url]

[h2]How do I get to the Daily Boss Fight?[/h2]
It is super easy. Just open your side menu (you know, the one with three lines) and go to the adventures tab.

[h2]“Pest Invasion”[/h2]
It’s Smacking Day! Every so often the town of Bastion will become overrun with critters from the surrounding Sandsea desert. The residents have created a holiday to reward people for helping to put a smack down on these invasive critters. You’ll need to smack twelve small critters and one big critter. Accept this quest and, for your help, you will receive a Daily Boss Trophy and extra Bug Parts which can be used to craft new items.
 
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseadailyboss/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5601/townofbastion.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Meet the Boss: Spikarox[/h2]
Spikarox is one big critter, if you can call it that. It is a giant golden scorpion with a deadly poisonous sting. This critter not only poisons you but it spawns baby scorpion minions to do additional damage. Oh yeah, and did we mention Area of Effect attacks? You might want to stock your hotbar with potions and healing spells.
Spikarox itself may drop special items including the [b]Broken Telson[/b] which is needed to begin crafting the Telson Daggers.
Joined an instance with just a few people? Glisel and Rellik wrote some tips for [b]How to Survive Spikarox with a Small Party[/b]:
[list]
[*]Suggested Party Composition: at least one of each class type - healing, ranged, tank
[*]Keep moving/Dodge
[*]Prep a lot of potions
[*]Must have a healer of some type
[*]Use AOEs when baby scorpions are spawned
[*]Try not to trigger attacks from the other monsters in the map
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseadailyboss/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7c92fb3b88924bd51ac0546f0da84dcf1f09b436.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Spikarox Crafting[/h2]
After you have given a big smack to Spikarox, return to Scratch to turn in your quest and take your Bug Parts to the Spikarox Crafting shop. You will be able to craft four new weapons and a fresh set of Sandsea armor and a belt. All of these items can be upgraded to Epic rarity in the crafting shop with more Bug Parts and the base items.

[b]Crafting Items[/b]
[list]
[*]Telson Daggers (requires “Broken Telson” drop to begin crafting)
[*]Sandsea Curved Knife
[*]Sandsea Dual Bladed Scythe
[*]Sandsea Polearm
[*]Cochineal Oasis Armor
[*]Cochineal Oasis Belt
[/list]

See you on Smacking Day!

[b]Battle on![/b]
Artix, Glisel, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: Sharken Challenges
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sharkenchallenges/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2abca4850a846cf012200c49fc6721edfb84ce08.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Are you ready for a Challenge?[/h2]
Visit Skiffmaster Squint at any of his locations around the Sandsea for our new Sharken Challenges. These challenge versions of the sharken fights from the Sandsea Saga are a timed level 33 Sharken Challenge and level 35 Void Sharken Challenge. Unlock each one when you complete its story version. Each challenge is designed for a full party of 5 players and a prize chest drops at the end of each fight.

[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/sharkenchallenges/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5595/readyforachallenge.png[/img][/url]
Become a Sharken Slayer[/h2]
Stick around after the fight to claim your prizes! The Chest of the Sharken (Sharken Challenge) has the possibility of containing one of three Sharken Slayer weapons. The Chest of the Void Sharken (Void Sharken Challenge) has the possibility of containing the Sun Keeper Cloak or Armor, and one of two Void Sharken Slayer weapons. Both chests will always have Sharken Parts and a Sharken Filet or two.

[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/sharkenchallenges/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5596/sharkenslayersets.png[/img][/url]
Sharken Slayer Crafting[/h2]
Head to Paul DeRonn in Bastion to create your own Sharken Slayer or Void Sharken Slayer armor sets!
The [b]Sharken Slayer[/b] set only requires Sharken Parts and Bastion Bucks to craft.
[list]
[*]Sharken Slayer Armor
[*]Sharken Slayer Boots
[*]Sharken Slayer Belt
[*]Sharken Slayer Gloves
[*]Sharken Slayer Cape
[*]Sharken Slayer Shoulders
[*]Sharken Slayer Hood
[/list]
The [b]Void Sharken Slayer[/b] set requires Sharken Slayer set, Sandestine Alloy, and Void Sharken Parts to craft. This is the new Best In Slot (“Equip Best”) for level 35 armor!
[list]
[*]Void Sharken Slayer Armor
[*]Void Sharken Slayer Gloves
[*]Void Sharken Slayer Belt
[*]Void Sharken Slayer Boots
[*]Void Sharken Slayer Shoulders
[*]Void Sharken Slayer Cape
[*]Void Sharken Slayer Hood
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sharkenchallenges/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5597/swornguardian-embossedwyvernv2.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Even More New Items![/h2]
Guardians! The time is nigh to swear the oath, and wear the [b]Sworn Guardian Armor[/b] and [b]Shoulderplates[/b]. You may have seen this armor in game on Guardian NPCs like Alistair, who stands outside of the Guardian Tower in Battleon. Head to the Guardian Class Gear Shop, pick up your new armor, and become a Sworn Guardian today!
Keep collecting your daily chests. notes.title: SANDSHARK WEEK! Also Wings & Oni Syndicate
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandsea7][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5481d3ba9a53e95f0a2eaeaaf3311d8d16e44155.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Let the hunt begin![/h2] 
At the end of Part 6, a Sharken-like creature caused a literal stir in the Valley when it reportedly ate the Phara-Keet Pyramid’s treasure room, absconding with the final lamp piece. So it’s time to wrestle up some bait, craft a bundle of poison-laced harpoons, and board Squint’s skiff for a special creature expedition to settle the score with this thieving monstrosity! After you’ve reported back to Sekt, head back to Battleon. Cysero’s Forge has new sets and items to craft, and the Chest Shop in your menu has 2 new sets including Dage’s Oni Syndicate set as well as lots of colorful Butterfly Wings.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandsea7][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6070d0f4c1b3c9d73f4e44275f3929dd43146989.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Slay the Void-Sharken[/h2]
Behold the beast brought forth by the Voidrakar -- the Void-Sharken! Azella has somehow hollowed a Sharken to do the Voidrakar’s bidding. Is there no limit to the Voidrakar’s power? No time to think about that while the last piece of the lamp lies in the belly of this monstrosity! Load up your harpoons and be aware of your surroundings. This beast is vicious!

Read more about the Sandsea Saga Part 7 at [url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandsea7]https://aq3d.com/news/sandsea7[/url]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/onisyndicate][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/806f8e9a516939f05e7f68b439b6fdb37bc0ce80.png[/img][/url]
[h2]There can be ONI one![/h2]
Open the Chest Shop for a chance to start collecting Dage’s new Oni Syndicate set. Dress the part of one of Lore’s toughest crews and defend your turf against anyone who dares to defy the Oni Syndicate. Make your foes tremble at your appearance with one of four distinct Oni masks, one of which may look very familiar to longtime AE players. If you’re lucky, you might get the [b]Legendary Oni Syndicate Armor or Katana[/b], each flowing with Oni energy.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/onisyndicate][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ea7149a1cc1d8e2ecca950ba3d5e91f1e04edf7a.png[/img][/url]
Get your head in the clouds (or in the mountains?) and prepare for a showdown with the armor sets of rival factions [b]Red Cloud[/b] and [b]Blue Brass[/b] sets from Cysero’s [i]Adventure Crafting[/i] shop. And hold on to your Daily Boss Trophies so you can craft the new Arcane Jester set at Cysero’s[i] Daily Boss Crafting[/i] shop!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/onisyndicate][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/704ef5e84ee84137555b9f5f7e9eb910b31d30bb.png[/img][/url]
Get your nets ready, ‘cause it’s time for Winnie’s [b]Changeling Butterfly Wing[/b] crafting! Combine all eight butterfly wings to create a marvellous color-changing set of wings at her Tailor Shop in Battleon. Collect them all from the Chest Shop and Cysero’s Forge!

Read more about how to get these new items at [url=https://aq3d.com/news/onisyndicate]https://aq3d.com/news/onisyndicate[/url]

See you in AdventureQuest 3D...

Battle On!
Artix, Glisel, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: Sandsea Saga Part 6 and so many new AQ3D items!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseasix/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0e2d0cd3fe43b8c444a3764bd90d088bfa7debfe.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The Sand Pyramid’s Treasure Room[/h2]
Seek out the second piece of the magic lamp by journeying into the Sand Pyramid, the former home of Gar-Feld, Keeper of Sand. Prepare to think fast when you enter, as the creatures within will not be your most pressing concern. Do you have what it takes to find your way into Gar-Feld's treasure room? If so, you'll find more than just the lamp waiting for you.

And when you’re inside, you’ll realize quickly why Gar-Feld was called the Keeper of Sand. Be mindful of the dangerous quicksand and sand walls... unless you're well equipped.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseasix/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5578/gar-feld.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Gar-Feld, Keeper of the Sand Pyramid[/h2]
Trounce the threat in the treasure room to claim the Lamp! Inside the treasure room, you'll find that Gar-Feld has left a surprise or two (or three) waiting for anyone who dares to claim the lamp piece. Don't be fooled by the threat's statuesque appearance; it's more nimble than you think and eager to play a game of cat and mouse...
Should you succeed, you'll have a chance to collect more than just the lamp: Two new pieces of the Sun Keeper set (belt and pauldrons) as well as a fancy new Stone Statue Sword and Stone Statue Dagger.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseasix/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5577/garfeld-travelform.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New Daily Quest![/h2]
Venture back into the pyramid to claim a special travel form! After you've completed the Sand Pyramid, be sure to talk to the guard outside the pyramid. He'll have a new daily quest for you: "Have Fragment - Will Travel". The guard will ask you to re-enter the pyramid and collect a fragment from the statuesque foe(s) inside the treasure room. What he'll do with the fragment isn't dentist-approved, but the end result will lead you on your very own Gar-Feld Statue travel form!

[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/aq3dnewitems/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5573/gazs-cart2.png[/img][/url]
Gaz’s Black Market Cart[/h2]
Gaz has collected some new items for his cart. Some items you may have seen before but some are brand new!

[list]

[*]Alabaster Kittarian travel form
[*]Gator of Mischief Pet
[/list]
[h3]Sandsea Items[/h3]

[/list]

[/list]
[h3]Seasonal Items[/h3]
[list]

[*]Fire Neck (helm)
[*]Taco Axe (weapon)
[/list]
[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/aq3dnewitems/]
[img]https://aq3d.com/media/5576/newjellyfish.png[/img][/url][/h2]
[h2]New to the Summer Collection[/h2]
The Vetroid Jellyfish Pet now comes in two new colors! 
[b]Note:[/b] Inaccuracies in the in-game item previews will be fixed in the next game version update.

[list]
[*]Vetroid the Pink Jellyfish Pet
[*]Vetroid the Emerald Jellyfish Pet
[/list]

[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/aq3dnewitems/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5575/morekittforms.png[/img][/url]
More Kittarian travel forms![/h2]
Like the look of the Bastion locals? Kai-Lee now has six Kittarian travel forms for sale that will help you blend in, plus one is hidden away in the daily chests. And make sure you stop to talk to the Gar-Feld Pyramid guard for an extra special travel form.
[h3]Kai-Lee’s Pet Shop (Bastion)[/h3][list]

[*]Chestnut Kittarian

[*]Khaki Kittarian
[*]Umber Kittarian
[*]Sandy Kittarian
[/list]

[/list]

[/list]

[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/aq3dnewitems/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5574/guardian-aura.png[/img][/url][/h2]

[h2]Guardians Only[/h2]
Calling all Guardians! Head to the Guardian Tower in Battleon to collect your Guardian Aura. This aura has a 30 minute duration… WHOA! Fortes has yours in the Guardian Class Gear shop now!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseasix/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5581/highsandseas.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Coming Soon: Trouble on the (High) Sand Seas[/h2]
Seek and destroy a new terror in the Sandseas!
The Voidrakar’s attack on the ruins continues, but additional croc guards have yet to arrive! Every attempt by Lord Sekt (really Chombi, if we're being honest) to call in extra guards from across the Sandsea has failed… Why? Because a mysterious creature has attacked every skiff transporting the croc guards to the ruins… But now skiffs aren’t the only thing this creature has its sights on; it’s after the treasure in the Pyramid of Phara-Keet.
 
Battle on!
[b]Glisel, Artix and the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

notes.title: Desert Ruins Challenge and Sekt's Treasure Vault!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ruinschallenge/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ea9c8f4e50afc83724a13b16fd795361393ea95e.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Defend the Ruins Challenge and Search Sekt's Vault for Zhoom’s Bow[/h2]
Hop on AdventureQuest 3D for a double-dose of fun with the Vault of the Undying King and a replayable challenge version of the Ruins Defense mission from Sandsea Part 5. Plus, you can now craft your own replica of Zhoom’s bow!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ruinschallenge/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5564/vaultoftheundyingking.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Vault of the Undying King[/h2]
All the treasure that Lord Sekt is hoarding in the Vault of the Undying King isn’t doing anybody any good, so Zhoom wants you to do something about it. But before you venture into the Vault of the Undying King, Rebel Rosen has a request for you while you’re in the vault: Find Zhoom’s bow! Rumor has it that Lord Sekt is stashing Zhoom’s Ancestral Bow inside the vault, and Rosen thinks it is high time for the bow to return to its owner. After all, it’s not like Lord Sekt will notice if something from his vault goes missing… Or will he?
And before you rush into the Vault of the Undying King, be sure to get Rosen’s new repeatable “[b]Vault Hunting[/b]” quest to slay any creepy crawling things you find in the vault for their precious carapaces. Completing the quest will award you with Rebels Rubies and Deadly Desert Monster Parts.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ruinschallenge/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5566/zhoomsbow2.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Zhoom’s Make-A-Bow Workshop[/h2]
Craft a replica of Zhoom’s Ancestral Bow! No need for Zhoom to get all the spoils of the Vault of the Undying King. Upon completing the Vault of the Undying King quest chain, you’ll have access to a new Daily Quest that rewards you with the materials needed to create your own Level 35 replica of Zhoom’s bow, one that can be upgraded from Uncommon to Epic quality!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ruinschallenge/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5563/sandsearuinschallengefight.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Desert Ruins Defense Challenge[/h2]
The Voidrakar’s assault on the ruins continues, and the Croc Commander needs the help of you and up to four other allies to fend off wave after wave of Vane’s minions. Keep as many of the Croc Guards alive through this challenge’s Three Rounds, with each round having up to four waves of enemies. The more Croc Guards you can keep alive, the better the rewards you’ll receive at the end. Potions, Bastion Bucks, Titles, and even Rare Pets are yours to be had if you and your allies can defend the ruins from the Voidrakar!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ruinschallenge/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5568/crocpets1.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New Croc Pets![/h2]
Included with this release is a new assortment of Croc Guard Figurine Pets. These autonomous action figures look and move just like the real thing! Kai-Lee is selling General Gaspar and Onyx Croc Guard figurines in her Specialty Pets shop, while the Rookie, Veteran, and Elite Croc Guard Figures are rewards from the Desert Ruins Defense Challenge.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ruinschallenge/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5562/keeeperofsand.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Coming Soon… The Keeper of Sand’s Pyramid![/h2]
If you enjoyed venturing into the Crocos’ water-themed pyramid, wait until you see what Gar-Feld, the Keeper of Sand, has in store for you. Designed by Aveleon, the Sand Pyramid will test your mettle as you hurry to find your way into Gar-Feld’s Treasure Room for the next piece of the magic lamp. Don’t waste any time while you’re inside… You may not like what happens if you do.


[url=https://www.HeroMart.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8504d6089ebfb8355103fcbc6bfcf72c6c670c69.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The Return of HeroMart.com![/h2]

On Friday, HeroMart.com will be releasing logo shirts for AdventureQuest 3D, AQWorlds, DragonFable, and a ton of other things.  Shop by and check out all of the new stuff Friday afternoon.

Check out https://www.HeroMart.com

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ruinschallenge/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5567/augustfridaythe13th.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Also... a Friday the the 13th is coming next month O_O[/h2]
Next month, there is a Friday the 13th. We are changing things up a bit for what we do next.... consider thyself warned XD

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ruinschallenge/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5569/herosandwitch.png[/img][/url]

[h2]As Promised... Sub(mitted) Sand Witch Puns[/h2]

[b]@Beastoevil[/b]
If the Sand Witch moves fast, that would make her a Quicksand Witch.
[b]@Fire_Knightlord[/b]
I think my Sandwich puns are jam-packed so, I've got a butter idea! I'll just come up with a better pun about peanut butter, and jam on toast, but... It might spread. Anyways, I've finished with these puns because all that went straight over my bread!

See you in game...

notes.title: Sandsea Saga Part 5: Lair of the Sand Witch
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseav/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/83314a05528270649c6a0b652e27bf3d4e1803b5.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The Sandsea Saga continues with our latest release[/h2]
The search for the magic lamp is underway, but before you can continue your quest, Lord Sekt sends you off to deal with other troubles plaguing the desert...
Since the time you first arrived at Sandsea, something -- or someone -- has been attacking Fahad’s caravans. What malevolent force is behind the attacks, and could it be responsible for other calamities in the Sandsea? But that is not the only conflict you will find in the desert, as the Voidrakar are mounting another assault on the Valley of the Undying King. Will you be able to keep the advancing Voidrakar at bay? Can you solve the mystery behind the caravan attacks? Log in to AdventureQuest 3D to continue the Sandsea Saga part 5 to find out. The Sandsea Saga awaits for all players level 31 and over.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseav/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5557/defenddesertruins.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Voidrakar in the Valley[/h2]
Help Sekt’s guard fight back the Voidrakar who are trying to force their way into the Valley of the Undying King. Meet the Commander at the desert ruins and get into position. Keep your eyes peeled. You must defend the ruins from multiple waves of Voidrakar attacks coming from any direction.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseav/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5558/fahad.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Defend the Ruins[/h2]
The raids on Fahad’s supply caravans have gone ignored long enough. The guards are running low on supplies and can barely hold back the Voidrakar forces without help. Fahad is happy for your help but one person is not enough. You have a mutual friend who might be convinced to assist… Zhoom.
[h2]A Magical Disturbance[/h2]
Fahad believes whatever is attacking his caravan is capable of powerful magic… A witch of some sort who derives their power from the desert sands. A Sand… Witch, if you will. Zhoom has heard of such a creature and he is willing to track her down with your help.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseav/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5556/zhoom.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Follow Zhoom![/h2]
Get ready to support Zhoom in tracking down the culprit behind the caravan attacks. With Zhoom guiding the way, the two of you will scour the desert in search of the source of all kinds of magical trouble. Getting to your destination won't be easy, so be ready to assist Zhoom against whatever foe shows up along the trail.
[b]Note:[/b] Let Zhoom know when you’re ready to get going! He’ll wait for you to catch your breath after each encounter.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseav/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5554/lairofsandwitch.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The Sand Witch’s Layer… er, Lair[/h2]
Enjoy the new immersive sound effects and a new soundtrack designed specifically for this dungeon by Jongaar. Follow the sounds of the Sand Witch’s chants and cackles as you search her lair. Just be mindful of what you say to her. All that sand has made her a salty Sand Witch. Also, pay close attention to the altars in her lair. The pretty lights are more than just decoration.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseav/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5555/newdailyquestset.png[/img][/url]

Should you succeed, Fahad may need you to go back into the sand witch’s lair each day to make sure the sandy menace doesn’t return. You’ll be rewarded very well for it, and you can use your rewards at Fahad’s new Sand Witch Shop! A Lil’ Yucky Pet and Alter Ego armor set + weapon are available to purchase with your Sand Witch Leftovers. XD

[h2]See you... {insert pun here}[/h2]
By the way, if you enjoyed the Sand Witch fight, music, and all of the puns included, give a shout out to our team on Twitter ([url=https://aq3d.comhttps://twitter.com/AQ3Dgame]@AQ3Dgame[/url])! Aveleon built the dungeon experience, Jongaar wrote the music and sound fx, Yergen created the dungeon map, and Baleerio has been our writer for all of Sandsea so far!
And if you come up with any great Sand Witch-related puns of your own, Tweet them to us [url=https://aq3d.comhttps://twitter.com/AQ3Dgame]@AQ3Dgame[/url] with the [b]#sandwitchpun[/b]! We’ll include a few of our favorite puns in next week’s Design Notes.

[b]Battle on!
Artix, Glisel, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]
