notes.title: SlayWatch! Summer Shark Attack and 2021 Collection
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/summerwarcollection2021/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c738cd45dd784dedc3c05374e979779f8a316a8a.png[/img][/url]

[h2]SlayWatch![/h2]
Sharks are attacking Pointe Less Isle! Join us for a summer beach-monster war. Rewards unlock as you do quests and help increase that war meter to 100%. Also check out the brand new 2021 Summer Collection.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/summerwarcollection2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5548/sharkwar-bettereredition.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Shark Attack War[/h2]
Visit Annette in Battleon or on Pointe Less Isle to help her with the Shark Attack quests and join the Summer war. There are five quests available including a repeatable Fishing quest for those of you who just want to chill on the shores while helping. Quests give a stack of Shark Attack Tokens which can be turned into Pointe Less Trophies with the  quests. Redeeming Pointe Less Trophies boost the war meter and can be used to buy your war rewards as they unlock in the [b]Summer Shark Attack Shop[/b].

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/summerwarcollection2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5552/watermetetr.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The War Meter & Rewards[/h2]
Ready 100% to win the war! The only way to accomplish this... is together. See that war meter at the top of the screen? That war meter is shared by every player across every server. It is literally you and the community vs an army of monsters. And as you do quests and progress that meter, new rewards will unlock! Join us and be a part of it....
[list]
[*]Part Bubbles Potion (0%)
[*]Blue Diving Suit  (0%)
[*]Red Diving Suit (20%)
[*]Watermelon Bobber (20%)
[*]Green Diving Suit (40%)
[*]Purple Diving Suit (40%)
[*]Hollow Pineapple Bobber (40%)
[*]Pink Diving Suit (60%)
[*]Iron Diving Suit (60%)
[*]Frosty Floaty Donut bobber (60%)
[*]Sporty Diving Suit (80%)
[*]Dark Diving Suit (80%)
[*]Deep Diving Suit (80%)
[*]Crabby Bobby (80%)
[*]Shark Fin-atic Diving Suit (100%)
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/summerwarcollection2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5553/summercollection2021preview.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Summer 2021 Collection[/h2]
What do water blades, skeletally themed bikinis, an orange tree branch, and cthulian-looking floating Jelly Fish have in common? O_O Yeah, we don't know either. But you can find them all in this years new Summer 2021 Collection! It features 32 incredible new items from your favorite game artists.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/summerwarcollection2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5549/summer-collectionweapons.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Oceana Blades... and spherical bouncy deadly thing![/h2]
During testing, every single dev asked the same question, "Are they supposed to be that BIG!?" The answer was "The players asked for big weapons, and we want them to have [b]water-ever[/b] they want!"

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/summerwarcollection2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5550/summercollectionitems2021.png[/img][/url]

[h2]2021 Summer Collection[/h2]
I have seen a lot of chatter about that giant floppy sun hat. What are you guys planning exactly? Anyway... you can get the items individually, or save a ton of DragonCrystals and get year round free storage by buying the entire collection.... Which includes the badge and title "[b]Sunburnt[/b]".

[list]
[*]Jellyfish Egg (Vetroid Pet hatching soon!)
[*]Unstable Jellyfish (Vetroid Travel Form hatching soon!)
[*]Legion Swimwear (Armor)
[*]Tattooed Legion Swimwear (Armor)
[*]Paradise Vice Armor
[*]Patterned Paradise Vice Armor
[*]Paradise Vice Loafers (Boots)
[*]Paradise Vice Beaded Bracelets (Gloves)
[*]Paradise Vice Sun Glasses (Helm)
[*]Golden Sun Glasses (Helm)
[*]Aqua Mage Armor
[*]Aqua Mage Boots
[*]Aqua Mage Belt
[*]Aqua Mage Gloves
[*]Aqua Mage Shoulders
[*]Oceana Glaive  (Weapon)
[*]Oceana Katana (Weapon)
[*]Oceana Tidal Sword (Weapon)
[*]Beach Spiker (Weapon)
[*]Orange Tree Staff (Weapon)
[*]Old Timey Swimsuit
[*]Old Timey Swimdress
[*]Sun Sandals
[*]Boat Shoes
[*]Rosy Sundress
[*]Rosy Shirt & Shorts
[*]Floppy Sun Hat
[*]Wicker Trilby (Helm)
[*]Cornflower Sundress
[*]Cornflower Shirt & Shorts
[*]Blue Suede Shoes
[*]Blue & White Sandals
[*]Collection Badge and [b]"Sunburnt"[/b] title when you buy the Collector's Chest
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/summerwarcollection2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5551/vetroidegg2.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Vetroid Jellyfish Egg?[/h2]
The pet and travel form in this year's collection has not hatched yet. Expert Cryptozoologists believe that these mysterious blue eggs will hatch into a Vetroid. Typically they are deep sea monsters. But, what would happen if one of these eggs hatched into the open air? Experts speculate that the Vetroid would gain the ability to breathe oxygen and float effortlessly in the air-- very much the same way their deep sea relatives do in water. One thing is certain. Vetroid eggs ONLY hatch once a year and they ALL hatch at the same time. And that time... is within next week!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/summerwarcollection2021/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5547/slaywatch2021.png[/img][/url]

[h2]See you at the Shark Attack War on Pointe Less Isle![/h2]
How do you get there? Head to town and talk to Annette. And watch out for sharks, giant crabs, and katana wielding Samurai shellfish.

See you in game....
Battle on!Artix, Glisel, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: Pyramid of Crocos Challenge
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/crocoschallenge/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/24abe87fec4e1a1633b31a2ebabdd768734bc9f4.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Pyramid of Crocos Challenge is now live![/h2]
The story fight you experienced has been expanded and new mechanics have been added for a more exciting and dangerous challenge! Also, Kai-Lee the Pet Vendor in Bastion has an overstock of new Sandsea pets. Get them before they're gone!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/crocoschallenge/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5544/pyramidguard.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Crocos Pyramid Guard[/h2]
Return to the Crocos’ Pyramid and talk to the guard stationed there. He has two new quests for you to acquire related to the Crocos Challenge. Both quests are repeatable and give a large amount of Experience Points for the grind ahead. Completing the main quest, “Trouble in the Water Pyramid”, will also reward you with extra Crocos’ Teeth, which you’ll need to purchase items from Crocos’ Treasure shop. Furthermore, the guard may have something interesting to tell you about the pyramid’s water...

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/crocoschallenge/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5545/waterpyramid.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]A Challenge Awaits You in Crocos’ Pyramid[/h2]
This challenge is an expansion of the story dungeon with new mechanics and loot! But overcoming this challenge will take a lot of teamwork and resourcefulness! Take, for example, the new Gill Potions that will randomly drop from the challenges mobs. The Gill Potions will allow you to breathe underwater for a short period of time. Why would that come in handy? You’ll have to play to find out. Word of advice: You may want to bind that Gill Potion to a hotkey the first chance you get. You never know when it may come in handy. Completing the challenge will provide you with materials you can use to craft your own Gill Potions from Fahad outside Lord Sekt’s temple.Gill Potions aren’t the only fun new surprise to be found in the Crocos Challenge. Areas that were once locked or seemingly too dangerous in the story mode are open for you to investigate. What will your search yield? Perhaps there’s a quest related to that…

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/crocoschallenge/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5543/lilscorpionpet.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Let Sleeping Mummies Lie[/h2]
Somehow, someway, you’ll discover that secret hidden in the challenge that’ll allow you to complete the Pyramid Guard’s quest “Let Sleeping Mummies Lie.” Doing so will not only give you ample experience and gold, but it will also unlock an enhanced version of the challenge boss fight. Defeating this enhanced boss will reward you with an “Exalted” chest and an additional special reward chest for going above and beyond. The Exalted chest contains higher drop rates for set items, an exclusive “Crocos’ Champion” title, and a chance to get the Lil’ Scorpion Fish Pet. The special reward chest includes… well… best not to say too much about that yet other than it’ll come in handy for a future release. So, what’s the secret to completing this quest? Well, that’s for us to know and you to find out!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/crocoschallenge/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5542/keeperofwater.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Crocos’ Treasure Shop[/h2]
Bad RNG on your Crocos Pyramid runs? Take all of the Crocos’ Teeth you’ve earned back to the Pyramid Guard. You can use your collection of Crocos’ Teeth to purchase the entire Epic rarity Keeper of Water set from the Guard with Crocos’ Teeth (excluding the Alternate Armor and Belt pieces which can only be acquired from the Challenge Boss). The treasure shop is also the only place to acquire the Keeper of Water Scythe, so save up to acquire that beauty of a weapon!

[h3]Keeper of Water (Epic)[/h3]
[list]
[*]Keeper of Water Armor
[*]Keeper of Water Armor (Alt)
[*]Keeper of Water Belt
[*]Keeper of Water Belt (Alt)
[*]Keeper of Water Shoulders
[*]Keeper of Water Cape
[*]Keeper of Water Gloves
[*]Keeper of Water Helm
[*]Keeper of Water La Crox (boots)
[*]Keeper of Water Scythe
[/list]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/crocoschallenge/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5541/kailee.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Meanwhile in Bastion…[/h2]
Kai-Lee’s Pet Shop now has an overstock of new Sandsea pets! She has scarabs, she has snakes, she scorpions, and… Living Cacti?!?! Well, whichever is your fancy, they come in just about every color and price range. Kai-Lee just needs a little help first… Help Kai-Lee research the Do’s and Don’ts of handling these wild pets to make them available in her shop. And don’t forget, Skiffmaster Squint is now able to take you directly to the Rebel Camp if you have unlocked it through the saga. Simmi-Tar and Paul DeRonn’s quests have also received reward boosts.

[h2][url=https://aq3d.com/news/crocoschallenge/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5434/sandsea-header.jpg[/img][/url][/h2]
[h2]A Sneak Peek of Upcoming Releases[/h2]

As we look ahead to future content releases, we wanted to give you a little preview of what you all can expect in the coming weeks:
[list]
[*]Sandsea Saga: Part 5
[*]Summer Collection 2021
[*]Sandsea Saga: Part 6
[*]A Hidden Treasure Vault Sidequest w/ Zhoom and the Rebels
[*]A New Sandsea Challenge
[*]Sandsea Saga: Part 7
[*]An Additional Sandsea Challenge
[/list]
After that, we'll be wrapping up the final installments of the Sandsea Saga, prepping for a spooktacular Friday the 13th, and getting ready for a rowdy Talk Like a Pirate Day.

Also, did somebody say PVP?
 
[b] - Artix, Glisel, and the AdventureQuest3D Team[/b]

notes.title: Sandsea Saga Part 4! "Destroy the Rebellion"
notes.content:
[url=https://www.aq3d.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bd9f6d50d009651a8e2272faa80e484b5cde0c14.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Find the Rebels[/h2]
Lord Sekt has agreed to help you find the magic lamp, but on one condition: you must find and kill the rebel leader Zhoom! Think you’re up for the task? Well, good news, because Sgt. LeCosta has information on where the rebels might be hiding… but you’re not going to like where it leads you. So if you’re brave enough to venture into a maze-like cave infested with scorpions and other creepy-crawlies, then you’ll find your bounty. However, don’t be surprised if there’s a fight waiting for you when you do.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandsearebellion/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5529/zhoomleader.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Zhoom[/h2]
Ruthless assassin? Noble leader? Something in-between? You’ll find out who Zhoom truly is when you embark on your search for the rebel camp. How he’ll respond to your efforts to hunt him down is anyone’s guess. But don’t make the mistake of thinking he doesn’t already know who you are, which may lead to some interesting developments in your quest for the lamp.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandsearebellion/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5530/rebelhideout.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Rebel Camp[/h2]
Danger and sword fighting aren’t the only things that await you at the rebel camp. While there, be sure to seek out Brienne the Blacksmith for new level 35 armor she's wearing and Trader Josephine to trade your Bastion Bucks and leftover monster materials for Rebel Rubies.  (*Rebel Rubies are only valid in shops provided by the Rebel Camp; restrictions apply where necessary*)

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandsearebellion/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5534/rebelnpcs2.jpg[/img][/url]

Short on Bastion Bucks? Bastion's economy is booming lately and now even Bobby B can afford to send you on a quest for 50 Bastion Bucks each. You don't have to tell him what you're spending it on... XD
 
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandsearebellion/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5531/voidrakarfight.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Greater of Two Evils[/h2]
As you search for the magic lamp, the Voidrakar threat continues to loom in the periphery. High Priestess Azella promised Vane the Void King that she'd deliver the lamp to him, and she has been waiting for the right moment to make her move.How does immortal Lord Sekt's magical prowess measure up to the power of the Void? Perhaps we will find out...

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandsearebellion/][img]https://aq3d.com/media/5483/pyramidexample.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Into the Pyramids[/h2]

notes.title: Undead Legion Assault and Dage's 2021 Collection!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/dagecollection2021/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/aa6c921f2e7f1c15139306a3ea1f28f54b7920bc.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]It's time for the Legion Soul Harvest![/h2]
Dage has been hard at work in the Soulforge. This year's collection introduces full sets of Legion Ranger, Legion Priest, and couture armors. Also, dark weaponry, a giant spider travel form, pet, bow, fishing pole, and... well, see the [url=https://aq3d.com/news/dagecollection2021/]full list of 2021 Dage Items[/url].

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/legionassault/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2c212797c9be2092aedb3147fccca83e52e7eb74.jpg[/img][/url]
As Legion forces advance to harvest Paladin souls for Dage.... Lionfang's Golden Order of Paladins is fighting back! Choose a side and fight for glorious victory and epic gear. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/legionassault][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9fb7224f93f123f489057eee845e1fd80c2b8d79.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Legion VS Paladin Event[/h2]
Head to your home town of Battleon and talk to the Legion or Paladin Emissary to join the fight! They are at the base of the bridge in town. Select your repeatable quests to earn crafting tokens before traveling to this intense new 5 vs 5 map.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/legionassault][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/34a9d9bf102158c443ffcb0d9a0e9911452888a4.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Fight for your side...[/h2]
The Golden Order and the Legion start on opposite sides of a map under siege by the other. Protect your allies as you fight through and advance to the opposing side. Golden Order Paladins fight alongside ethereal Apparitions and a Pala-Tron while the Legion has monster allies.
Battle for either the Legion or the Paladins. Both sides have unique rewards. Currently, the story does not lock you to picking one faction... so you are able to earn the rewards from both. (.)

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/legionassault][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/18e311bf0bd1099fe1f4a3ecefa1211ec101b3c8.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Battlefield awaits![/h2]
The battle between the Legion and the Paladins is happening now... hop in and join the action. Just head to town.

See you on the Battlefield....

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/dagecollection2021][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/64d13fb5a95dcf25fb089c416e83146a5d6be295.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Brocas the Dreadstrider (Travel Form)[/h2]
Watch your foes flee in arachnophobic terror as you ride this glorious 8-legged travel form across the battlefield. Extra horrifying when you see it running at 160% speed.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/dagecollection2021][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7d2f6d782c3519387dea8662d4b3e025134749c8.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Long Un-Live the Undead Legion![/h2]
[b]Dage's Underworld and his Arena of Souls[/b]
If you want to officially join the Legion, travel to Dage's Underworld using the portal or the travel button in your adventure menu. Once there you can battle through his saga and face the survival challenges. The Arena of Souls is the hardest challenge so far. Fight your way through an onslaught of terrifying minions and horrifying boss monsters to prove yourself worthy of being one of Dage's Legion. There are alternating waves of different types of monsters to fight through... skeletons, spiders, skeletal dragons... but it will be worth it for those loyal to the Legion. Dage will allow those who are victorious to craft Epic level Legion Heretic gear from his personal collection.
 
[b]P.S.[/b] Last Chance for Frostval stuff. We'll be removing the Frost Labyrinth maps, Gift'thulu and its shop, and the Frost Siege until the snow returns in December. Revisit these maps for the last time until next Frostval.

Battle on!
- Artix, Glisel, and the AdventureQuest3D Dev Team

notes.title: Into the Valley of the Undying King
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/undyingking/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/649b8950db021503236256b46ae4f65f89532991.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Sandsea Part 3: Valley of the Undying King[/h1]

The level cap has been raised to 35! Just in time to visit Sekt’s Temple. At last! Board the sandskiff with Skiffmaster Squint into the Valley of the Undying King! 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/undyingking][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e04bfddb03d48a9303d0033ca2aeb8b46617b88d.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Squint’s Skiff Adventure[/h2]
Man the harpoons! If you want to get to the pyramids in one piece, Squint and Gil will need your help to protect the skiff from the Sandsea desert’s most fearsome monster yet… the Sharken! Dagger has created an exciting first-person shooter-type experience. Fight creatures on the boat and gather supplies in between Sharken sightings where you will man a harpoon. Clicking a harpoon allows you to fire at the Sharken in a first person perspective. Performing a non-attack action will let you resume control of your character.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/undyingking][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a5b2991d693369be52e8e4a626ebb42ce995f4c6.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Sekt, the Undying Pharaoh[/h2]
No spoilers, but Sekt is not a pharaoh to mess with. Stand your ground against his personal guards and he will consider your request for help in finding the magic lamp. Of course, being granted a favor by Lord Sekt comes with strings. He wants you to deal with his Zhoomer problem first.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/undyingking][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/04e89728bbc7e2a09694f470a3d612ca1da0a027.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Level Cap Raised to 35![/h2]
After completing the story, you’re going to need some new armor to go with all of that new XP! Simmi-Tar has you covered with new level 35 Mastercraft armor and weapons. If you’re not ready to head back to Bastion yet, Fahad can make you a full level 34 set of armor and a weapon made from… Cacti???
Level 35 is also our new endgame, so check out our posts on Item Infusion and Capstones to learn about all of the cool new endgame content available with this release.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/undyingking]Read the complete design notes![/url]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/iteminfusion/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e29442b4ae65002453fa42da3faa8a4f94cdc397.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Item Infusion! The Breakdown from Blaze[/h2]

Item Infusion is our newest and most exciting feature in AdventureQuest 3D. It’s also a little complex... So Blaze, the dev behind it, shared the details with me in an interview. Read on to learn about Item Infusion.

[b]Glisel:[/b] Today we are going to talk specifically about Item Infusion… or item fusion…? 
[b]Blaze:[/b] It’s Item Infusion. 

[b]Glisel:[/b] I don’t know if you know this, but item fusion was what we originally had in mind in the AQ3D Kickstarter where you can combine a cosmetic with a stat item or a lower stat item with a higher stat item to keep the better stats, but that became our current build where you can just equip a cosmetic over a stat item instead.
[b]Blaze:[/b] I actually didn’t know about item fusion.  It’s kind of funny that I came up with it totally independent of that.

[b]Glisel:[/b] So… What was, or is, your goal with this feature?
[b]Blaze:[/b] The goal is to… give players something to do at endgame and reward them for logging in every day and really staying dedicated to the game. This is for the hardcore players who want better stats. Now they are able to do that with Item Infusion.

[b]Glisel:[/b] Now let’s go into details. In PTR there was a level requirement of 35 to access this feature from Cysero’s shop. Is the level requirement staying? Can you see the option to infuse your weapon at Cysero’s shop if you are below that level?
[b]Blaze:[/b] It is not staying. It was doing that so we can test. It is a system that you can infuse at any level you want. So if you’re level 10 and you want better stats, you can do that. This system is an upgrade to the power offset system that I created a while ago. 
Some people were confused by the plus on an item. It increases the power of items when they drop from NPCs. So, like, a level 15 item would have a certain power of like 100, let’s just say. If you were almost level 16 and killed a monster at level 15, it would drop an item at the power of almost 16. So it would level with you. So that’s what the pluses were. Those are staying but you can now use the infusion system to top it off. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/iteminfusion/]Read the complete interview![/url]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/healerclass/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4b49ef9d20a0e6ddee2a2be635e0078b72eb6cb0.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Healer Class Released![/h2]

Finally! Get Healer class now in AdventureQuest 3D! 
We’re really proud of Healer. The goal was to have more heals compared to other supports and really strong buffs. Focused almost completely on empowering the party. It was always about healing those players and buffing them. We wanted one skill to feel super strong, a massive attack that feels really good. 
Because it is limited to buffing your party, we were able to make it more powerful. It should feel really good in a group, but also solo-friendly. We defined what we wanted beforehand and designed with those aspects in mind, so newer classes, including Healer, have been smoother in bringing them from concept to release. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/healerclass/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bfdc41dfce205565d88dc95f055fd57038f66c94.jpg[/img][/url]

In the official Healer Class post, AdventureQuest 3D Dev, Rabblefroth, gave us the details on what’s new to these support classes and what it took to create the Healer class. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/healerclass]Read more about the Support Class updates and Healer[/url]

[url=https://aq3d.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/25aee2ef69284d7fefc9db8ddf14bf75d7c5a998.jpg[/img][/url]

This week's release is a huge one! Good luck being on of the first to achieve level 35, obtaining the new healing class, trying weapon infusion, and exploring the newly unlocked story areas of the Sandsea! 


[h2]Coming Next Week[/h2]
We can see the finish line for Dage's big birthday release. Keep an eye out for another incredible update!

See you in game! 

[b]Battle on!
Artix, Glisel, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

notes.title: Heatwave! Sandea Weapons are so hot right now.
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseaweapons/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/530279ff64f53f71cbb870d81e6a8e0b61e2953f.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Heat Wave & 5 New Craftable Weapons![/h1]
Hunt for 5 new weapons... but beware, the Sandsea desert is under a heat wave warning. Stand in that blazing sun, and you will start taking damage. If I were you, I would fill up with water bottles before going out into the desert. The desert heat will make you faint. You should also consider activating a checkpoint -- a blue stone floating atop a pedestal. You'll see them in safe areas across the desert.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseaweapons/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3e166cac8aebf451564eb9883b8c083d6387d484.jpg[/img][/url]

Activating a Check Point will enable you to return to its location on the chance that you do faint in the desert.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseaweapons/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a462a90f738b1036efa195b8da316277841b0503.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Beat the Heat with Water Bottles and Moglinade[/h2]
Bobby B knows you shouldn't stay out in the sun too long without a refreshing drink, so he's got some Water Bottles for sale that will temporarily help you beat the heat. Fahad and Dahlia have stocked up on water bottles too so you can get refills on your quests. If you're up for a challenge, Bobby could also use your help in creating Moglinade, a potion that keeps you hydrated for longer than a regular water bottle. Finish the quest to make sure Fahad and Dahlia are stocked up on Moglinade too!

notes.title: Sandsea Saga Part 2: Just Deserts
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseapart2/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c6c28de2ab01689436e6744cc0d093bd021d32e0.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]New Story release & level cap raised to 33![/h1]
The level cap has been raised to 33 and we just released the biggest area in the world. Explore the vast desert of Sandsea with it's new monsters and many mysteries.  Even the VoidKing and his minions have taken an interest in this place. Journey to the Sandea town of Bastion to continue your adventure.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseapart2/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7c31920ffd9ee9d7d138eb9e964a002060a5e96c.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Sandsea Saga continues[/h2]
You’re starting to grow on the half-croc General Gaspar, but you haven’t won his trust yet! With Gaspar’s guards still recovering after doing battle with you, he needs someone to head out into the desert to solve problems affecting Bastion. There is a missing delivery, a missing person, invading foes, and who knows what else... you'll find out on your way to level 33!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseapart2/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/51aced65938bea940d965d061a8926e40aa48324.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Meet Skiffmaster Squint[/h2]
You want that magic lamp? The only way you're going to get it is to take a sand skiff out to the pyramids. That's where Skiffmaster Squint comes in. He's the luckiest skipper in the Sandsea. Well, he was until his first mate ran off with his lucky compass. Retrieve the compass and the kid, and he'll get you safely to the pyramids.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseapart2/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3d13104ff7d03248dd8df350f1cb8a564980edd2.jpg[/img][/url]

The main story returns! You have competition for the magic lamp.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseapart2/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a331fa6c195129dad889f75c229e6f32ac6947e4.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]NEW! Side Quests and NPC shops[/h2]
[b]Revisit NPCs for additional side quests and new shops[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Gaspar[/b] wants to bring a smile to the faces of the children of Bastion. Care to help him out?
[*] [b]Nigel Fuzzybum[/b] hasn't forgotten that you were supposed to clean the graffiti from the statues...
[*] [b]Hot Plate[/b] has opened his food shop! Bring him some ingredients and he'll cook up some powerful meals.
[*] [b]Simmi-Tar[/b] is now selling weapons for cold hard gold coins, but he'll also whip up something fancy for some Bastion Bucks and bits of monsters you killed in the desert.
[*] Also... If you enjoy learning history and lore, [b]Nigel Fuzzybum[/b] knows of some lost Sandsea scrolls that may have a clue to your quest for the magic lamp.
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseapart2/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/957cece7f22328641e2ff117e960c08b2be88037.jpg[/img][/url]

The new Sandsea desert is the largest area in AdventureQuest!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseapart2/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/fef31d4ce0819746360adf8831f78743044e2e62.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Last Chance[/h2]
We will be removing Mogloween/Mystcroft and Talk Like a Pirate Day seasonal content with next week's release to make room for upcoming seasonal releases.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sandseapart2/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/665d36c7f2a93dc0b8dd3c952314bf1fd84e2109.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you & coming next...[/h2]
Beware the Sandsharks! We hope you love this new (bigger, better, longer) release in AdventureQuest 3D. The healer class is coming soon (it is going up for testing shortly). So is Dage's birthday event, and the continuation of his saga where we will encounter the "assassin" Zhoom, the eternal Sekt, ride the Sandskiff, and step inside those treasure filled pyramids.

Dinner's over... ready for DESERT!

[b]Battle on!
Artix, Glisel, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

notes.title: DO YOU SMELL THE RAINBOW!?
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/aprilfools/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bf490801ee27ab83de67e0c73cae7cb59e107d11.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]"I, Piddie the Fool."[/h2]
No joke, Piddie the Fool just arrived in town. This disgruntled harlequin is peddling a man eating treasure chest that drops loot including his armor pieces, fools gold coins, and delicious... juice pack potions? (New from the makers of Mutatium!)

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/aprilfools/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/68b3a7667dff506f3a201bb03dfab1f09937a296.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Live Events throughout the day on April 1st![/h2]
The AdventureQuest 3D team (and prominent members of the community) will be running mini-anything goes live events and dropping bonus chests throughout the day on April 1st. You have been warned. They will start at 9am EST, happen sporadically through the day, and end when I fall asleep from exhaustion at my keyboard.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/aprilfools/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9b5f80a2a926227bbb66822e7acb1485022463ef.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]New Juice Pack Potions "Smell the Rainbow!"[/h2]
Try 4 new delicious flavor potions from the makers of Mutatium! You remember mutatium right? Those potions from last year that chaotically changed the size of everyone's body parts. Hordes of unsuspecting players thought the game was broken filling Player Support with bug tickets, " "OMG! Why does my character look weird!?"  Either way you will be happy to know, we came up with far worse potion ideas!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/aprilfools/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0eb475450034fdd2ef4700f1fd895d4145ddb21c.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]All new delicious flavors![/h2]
[list]
[*] Musical Fruit Juice
Blended from savory beans, yogurt, kimchi ,eggnog, mustard-relish, prunes, pre-pro-post-biotics, and bran with our atomic ghost pepper hot sauce. 1000% more fiber than other leading brands.
[*] Leafy Gang Green Potion
Go green and leave your mark on the environment! Sustainably sourced 100% vegan concentrate. GMO free, dairy free, gluten free, and soy free. NOTE: Dairy, gluten, soy, and antidote sold separately as DLC content. Now made with real meat. Produced by EbilCorp.
[*] Mountain Pew Energy Drank
"Pew the pew!" Are you ready to be Xtreme!? Blow away your competition in a green sierra-sized mist! Do not give a thought to the scratched-off expiration date on this discount off-brand monstrous energy drink.
[*] Skittal's Unicorn Juice - "Smell the rainbow!"
[/list]
"Smell the rainbow!" Made with 100% organic sparkle fairy dust, magic lollipops, and pink-eye flavors. Not made with real Unicorns. Probably.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/aprilfools/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2ab2945c971711e96f446073c125aae10ba73638.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Fool's Gift[/h2]
A Mimic is a monster that looks like a treasure chest but reveals its teeth and tries to eat you (or worse) when opened. Piddie the Fool is selling "The Fool's Gift" for 1,000 DragonCrystals. But this gift is really a mimic... a Fool's Gimic. Hahahaha..... although you will be delighted if someone spawns one near you. The Fool's Gimic always drops [b]Fool's Gold Coins[/b] but has small chance of dropping juice pack potions, and a very small chance of dropping a pet, armor piece, or a special mystery item. Take your Fool's Gold Coins to Piddie to buy Fool's Day items.

[h2]2021 Fool's Day Shop[/h2]
[list]
[*] Mountain Pew Potion (5 Fool's Gold Coins)
[*] Skittal's Unicorn Juice Pouch (5 Fool's Gold Coins)
[*] Leafy Gang Green Potion (5 Fool's Gold Coins)
[*] Musical Fruit Juice (5 Fool's Gold Coins)
[*] Mimic Pet (1,000 Fool's Gold Coins)
[*] Harlequin Fool Scepter (500 Fool's Gold Coins)
[*] Harlequin Fool Gun (500 Fool's Gold Coins)
[*] Harlequin Fool Dagger (500 Fool's Gold Coins)
[*] Harlequin Fool Mask (250 Fool's Gold Coins)
[*] Harlequin Fool Hood (250 Fool's Gold Coins)
[*] Harlequin Fool Armor (800 Fool's Gold Coins)
[*] Harlequin Fool Shoulders (400 Fool's Gold Coins)
[*] Harlequin Fool Cowl (250 Fool's Gold Coins)
[*] Harlequin Fool Gloves (150 Fool's Gold Coins)
[*] Harlequin Fool Belt (150 Fool's Gold Coins)
[*] Harlequin Fool Boots (150 Fool's Gold Coins)
[/list]
Oh yeah... and....

[list]
[*] Potato Pet (1,000 Fool's Gold Coins)
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/aprilfools/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c62bd1750cabde2b225dbd61d1de12db6c9b8051.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Beware April 1st![/h2]
We hope you have a fun-filled April Fools day. Especially if you join us for our live events. April 1st or "April Fools Day" is a prank filled day across the internet... and our video game network. Look for special events happening in our video games. 

[h2]Do YOU have an idea for a new flavor of potion?[/h2]
Start brain storming. Tomorrow we will run a contest for new savory potion ideas XD Maybe you can score a Gimic prize or two.

[b]Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

We hope you have a fun-filled April Fools day. Especially if you join us for our live events. April 1st or "April Fools Day" is a prank filled day across the internet... and our video game network. Look for special events happening in our video games.
Start brain storming. Tomorrow we will run a contest for new savory potion ideas XD Maybe you can score a Gimic prize or two.

notes.title: The Sandsea Saga begins!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/thesandsea/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/11616f34fa7035d14534cbad114f230211812cbe.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]The Sandsea saga has just begun in the town of Bastion[/h1]
[b]The level cap has raised to 32 and the new town of Bastion has opened in the Sandsea desert.[/b]

Valencia is waiting for you in Bastion with a lead on an artifact that may help to defeat Vane. Bastion is closely guarded from outsiders so equip your best level 31 gear and prove your worth to General Gaspar, the leader of the town guard. He has some ideas of how you can make yourself useful...

https://aq3d.com/news/thesandsea/

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/thesandsea/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3f350133523c7572b3841f6c349e2d18ca19f459.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Travel to Bastion and Level Up to 32![/h2]
Talk to Scratch at the base of the bridge in Battleon to get to Bastion. You'll know him by his colorful Sandsea garb... and his feline features. If you aren't in Battleon, open your Adventure Menu to quick travel there. This area is for you level 31 players to level up! Now you can put all those experience points into leveling up to 32, the new level cap!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/thesandsea/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6efbbc265ec641b4a2d0e24819ebf9fc2c7b8505.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]There is Something in the Water[/h2]
No. Really. Something is poisoning the well water. Aveleon has created another challenging dungeon for your excursion down the well. You will encounter new monsters including sneks, beetles, and a poisonous water monster. Bring a friend.... and don't fall into the water.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/thesandsea/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7617b9578f3bc0829ad743c13bec291c9d18102b.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Colorful Sandsea Clothes[/h2]
Talk to Paul DeRonn after you complete your quests to buy and craft colorful Sandsea armor and outfit pieces [b]with stats[/b]. His [b]Armor and Outfit Shop[/b] has a light Star Hood and comfortable Foot Wraps for gold. Earn[b] Bastion Bucks[/b] from Paul's daily quest by "Keeping the Aquifer Clean" and pick up [b]Vials of Slimy Residue[/b] from the dungeon monsters. Take them to Paul's [b]Crafting Shop[/b] to get various colorful armors and belts perfectly designed for the desert heat.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/thesandsea/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/44d0afd9d538b77c288a859c220f6dea397c93f0.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]New in AdventureQuest 3D Version 1.68[/h2]
The game just keeps getting better every week. The fan favorite feature of this release are the immersive NPC chat bubbles. See NPCs react to story-related changes in their environment and even talk smack during battle. This feature is only on some of the NPCs in Bastion and Battleon but we intend to give every NPC chat bubbles in the future.
[list]
[*] New reconnect feature!
[*] NPCs now have speech bubbles
[*] Lootbag improvements
[*] Quests are no longer level capped
[*] Necromancer summons now work in PvP
[*] Area of Effect telegraphs will now appear correctly
[*] Tons of small, handy fixes too!
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/thesandsea/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/529b918e16e4e1ee043d01b69a6a9c0395ee8f36.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Coming next...[/h2]
Wow! Thank you. It has felt really good seeing how much everyone is loving this new town and release. As I write this, the first players are already hitting level 32. This is just the appetizer... get ready for the desert. The Sandsea is our largest area in the game spanning pyramids, oases, and other treasure-filled locations. This next part of this new saga is scheduled to drop in 2 weeks. Because next week is one of our community's favorite (sorta-technically-a-holiday) Holidays, someone is creating a terrible new kind of potion.

"SandSEE you in game..."

[b]Battle on!
Artix, Glisel, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

notes.title: New Daily Boss Fight! Vampire King
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/drachusddailyboss/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2b3aa4b63fe5078e8a14452d4ff5548bb4f866fc.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Vampire King Drachus Daily Boss Fight[/h1]
[b]"So, you vant my vampire armor?"[/b]

Vampire King Drachus is back in a new daily boss fight!  Earn pieces of his legendary armor. Of course, you will need to get through his swarms of bats, army of vampire guards, and blood golems first!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/drachusddailyboss/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/12eb153b6a1b3353fc654253c2675084b68851b0.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Craft Vampire Lord Armor[/h2]
You asked for it and here it is! This is our FIRST FULL SET of armor added to a Daily Boss fight. You can earn all of the pieces of this leveled armor set and upgrade it from Uncommon to Epic rarity. The cloak is by far the most challenging piece to acquire. Alternatively, you can buy the cosmetic version of the Eternal King Drachus set for DragonCrystals.

[list]
[*] [b]King Drachus Set (Uncommon)
[*] Dreaded Vampire Lord (Rare)
[*] Undying Vampire Lord (Epic)[/b]
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/drachusddailyboss/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e2c13143f5b36a43f99c09c2347553fc96ce5453.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]What is a Daily Boss Fight?[/h2]
Gold Dragons, Cursed Pirates, NecroKnights, Lava Brakens, mysterious mind controlling creatures from beyond the known world.... each day a random daily boss fight is chosen. Each offers monsters and boss to earn special gear.

You can go to today's Daily Boss fight using the Adventure book in your main menu!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/drachusddailyboss/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5588a8e0009d78676eba7fa8782357e30fbc4306.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Talk to Count Mogula for the Crafting and Shop[/h2]
The Daily Boss Fights change each day. Be sure to check for when this one appears. When it does, you will arrive in King Drachus's throne room and be able to talk to the adorably wicked Count Mogula to get access to the quest, crafting, and shop.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/drachusddailyboss/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/499222ccbfb2c674c38cb679cb8ff9bf342dcdcd.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Also new this week in AdventureQuest 3D![/h2]
This week's release also included the "Big Unity Update" which upgraded all of the code, art, and items in the game to a newer version of Unity. It was a scary big upgrade. We do it once a year. If you spot any bugs or weirdness, please hit the report button and let us know.  We also did a round of improvements on the intro of the game to help new players. The treasure filled Pyramids of the Sandsea desert is coming next.  The first part of this new saga is going up on the PTR for testing this weekend. If all goes well, we will be heading to the cat-and-lizard-people filled town of Bastion next week.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/drachusddailyboss/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/861bc48709c99e668b2867b5f79faecb322163f3.jpg[/img][/url]

Good luck storming the Vampire King's castle...

[b]Battle on!

notes.title: Wraithmancer Ranks and Set
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/wraithmancer/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5d9a8abc1822a342105e6feb89c0068846e77d49.png[/img][/url]

[h1]What is a Wraithmancer?[/h1]
A Wraithmancer enhances their magic by using energy from the spirits of whatever is around them. At the most basic level they can draw energy from spirit beings like wraiths, ghouls, ghosts, etc... but at the height of their power... a Wraithmancer can draw the life force out of living creatures if they so choose. 

Look for Stabatha Heartless upstairs in the Tower of Necromancy lobby to begin your rank quests.

https://aq3d.com/news/wraithmancer/

At level 18 you can begin learning from Stabatha Heartless what it takes to be a Wraithmancer by earning ranksin the Tower of Necromancy. Rank up and build the complete armor set. Stabatha also offers Daily Quests to help you gather additional Wraith's Essence to rank up faster. Complete all of the ranks to unlock the full Wraithmancer set and the title "WraithLord".
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/wraithmancer/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ca9807436fa1099b5e158def8389d6fd47f01a36.jpg[/img][/url][/url]

[h2]Wraithmancer Armor Set[/h2]
The Wraithmancer's armor set was designed by Darkon, is fully statted, and has a Spirit Conduit that you wear on your back to harness the power of spirits. Full set includes...
[list]
[*] Wraithmancer Robes (level 25)
[*] Wraithmancer Belt (level 20)
[*] Wraithmancer Boots (level 20)
[*] Wraithmancer Gloves (level 20)
[*] Wraithmancer Spirit Conduit (back - level 25)
[*] Wraithmancer Helm (level 25)
[*] Wraithmancer Shoulders (level 25)
[*] Wraithmancer Staff (level 25)
[/list]

[h2]Take a Second Glance[/h2]
There are rumors of the remains of lost necromancy staffs hidden in the tower. Each staff is famous for the horrific way in which their owner perished. Will you discover the fate of the lost staves of the Tower of Necromancy? Are you brave enough to wield one yourself?
 
See you in the Tower of Necromancy!

notes.title: Earn ShadowSlayer W's Dark Armor Set
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/shadowslayerranks/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/765170488436aa252bbff5166f3a996faa703ea2.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]New ShadowSlayer Ranks available!
[/h2]
You can now unlock ShadowSlayer X in the Darkovia saga to access new ShadowSlayer ranks. Rank up to unlock ShadowSlayer W's dark armor set and a new Daily Bounty Hunt quest.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/shadowslayerranks/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2c4955316e31a8fedec2cb4aa6c398848b0318c7.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]New ShadowSlayer Ranks available![/h2]

Unlock ShadowSlayer X in the Darkovia saga to access the new ShadowSlayer II Rank Quests. Reaching ShadowSlayer Adept II rank unlocks the Daily Bounty Hunt quest. The new ranks and new ShadowSlayer items require a new Token called "Monstrous Blood" which is dropped off different bosses in the Darkovia areas (both outdoor and Dungeon Bosses). The Daily Bounty Hunt quest awards Fangs, Blood Fangs, and Monstrous Blood to help you rank up faster.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/shadowslayerranks/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/715f9fa945f74b8b068e27622a31b30846ad8a7b.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Earn ShadowSlayer W's Armor Set[/h2]

Unlock ShadowSlayer X in the Darkovia saga to begin earning ShadowSlayer W's level 31 armor. Unlike the other sets in the ShadowSlayer shop, ShadowSlayer W's set is fully cosmetic... but that's because you can earn powerful level 31 gear as you collect Monstrous Blood tokens.
  [list]
[*]   ShadowSlayer W’s Armor
[*]     ShadowSlayer W’s Belt
[*]     ShadowSlayer W’s Boots
[*]     ShadowSlayer W’s Gloves
[*]     ShadowSlayer W’s Shoulders
[*]     ShadowSlayer W’s Cloak
[*]     ShadowSlayer W’s Hat
[/list]

[h2]Meanwhile... behind the scenes[/h2]

This week, we are doing our yearly "BIG UNITY UPGRADE". This is where we update all of the code, files, art, animation, maps, and, well,  everything to the newest "long term support" version of Unity. It is a massive task and possibly one of the hardest things we do each year. It is also an important one. This is how we keep the game's code base up to date and also gain access to new tools and features from Unity. Sometimes people forget that we do not just build one set of things. We have different versions of everything for each platform: PC, Mac, iOS, and Android. We have farm of computers at the lab which we call the "cloud builder". It is pretty smart. When we create a new item, we send it to the cloud builder and it creates a version for each device using all of the right settings. So we will be using that to update every item to the newest version of Unity. Meanwhile, a massive bug hunt is underway as we make sure all of our code works. (Spoiler: It never does.) The next version of AdventureQuest 3D will be our shinest new one yet!

Also, we have put the petal to the metal on the Sandsea. You have have seen some of our art sneak peeks on social media. I will post a bunch of new ones for you here this week to see the maps and new monster races. Until then, ShadowSlayer W's wicked looking black shadowslayer armor set is up for grabs.

[b]See you in Darkovia![/b]

notes.title: The Darkovia finale is happening now!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkovia_bloodmoon/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a81c9382e911c87165c71d7cb4e17b45eccf59c9.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Vampire vs Werewolf Finale happening right now![/h2]

The Blood Moon is here.... the final conflict between the Vampires and Werewolves is happening now.  Log into to AdventureQuest 3D and be a part of the most important moment in Darkovia's history.

Full post at: https://aq3d.com/news/darkovia_bloodmoon/

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkovia_bloodmoon/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/06aaf4c45a4a03abcc8c362a23404e58c5cc4f7e.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Darkovia V: The Blood Moon[/h2]

The war between the Vampires and Werewolves has waged on for as long as eternal night has engulfed the land of Darkovia. But all of that is about to change. The Blood Moon is rising... and the prophecy says whoever holds the "Eye of Night" during it will rule absolute.

But no one expected you. Your arrival changed everything for these fanged factions. Now, under the rising Blood Moon, you created an opportunity for the one thing no one ever dared consider... peace. As you read this, the leaders of the Vampires and Werewolves prepare to meet in the town of Darkhust. All eyes are on you.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkovia_bloodmoon/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3358f8b14187217f15faa87799d891e9991cf710.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Vampires[/h2]

Safiria, Queen of the Vampires rules the vampires with her beloved husband, Vlad, at her side. He is far less optimistic about the truce. The same goes for her army of well geared and highly trained vampire knights. Hatred for the Lycans runs deep. The prophecy says that it is their destiny to obtain the "Eye of Night" by the Blood Moon... as it will give them the power to rule over all. But they are loyal to their Queen, who is risking everything for this one shot at peace.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkovia_bloodmoon/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e395cc429433aa8d4546810e150ebd8d6677714d.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Lycans (Werewolves)[/h2]

Constantine is the King of the Werewolves. Far more feral and aggressive than their undead foes, it is no secret that most Werewolves do not believe there is any chance for a truce. But Constantine is strong and wants what is best for both his families. He is the only one to keep the Werewolves in-line through the wisdom and help of his father-like mentor, Senator Sevro. The Lycans have a slightly different version of the prophecy. It says that whoever holds the "Eye of the Night" will hold the power of Lycans and Vampires in their hands.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkovia_bloodmoon/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/034af18fe3d116d32f8a7d51588596082bbedb3a.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]ShadowSlayer W[/h2]

ShadowSlayers are professional supernatural creature hunters. Towns hire them to protect them from the unspeakable things that go bump in the night. ShadowSlayer W protects the town of Darkhurst and is heralded by the townsfolk as a hero. He does not trust the Vampires nor the Werewolves. He is making a backup plan in case this meeting of "peace" under the Blood Moon goes bad.
Wes the boy in Darkovia

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkovia_bloodmoon/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1c0d8ece72dd8b14b829901a4c53b50149c2f5ef.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Wes, the Boy[/h2]

The town of Darkhurst has suffered greatly during the war. A little boy named Wes was bitten by both vampires and werewolves. There was a longshot cure and you took it... but who knows what will happen as a result. (Just a reminder: Time moves faster in that place where you took him.)

[b]Also in this release![/b]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkovia_bloodmoon/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b218e5ff9aa3c7fe503d9b0183a16fd944b8e091.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Werewolf vs Werewolf Monster Duel Arena[/h2]

"I choose you Werewolf-chu!" In this new mini-game, you are the boss of a team of Werewolves. Defeat other player's teams by choosing which of your monsters goes into the pit to fight next. You can grant your werewolf gladiators powerups to give them an edge. Win bravely and earn Ragnar's golden armor-- restored to its original, pristine condition. Talk to Keeli in the Werewolf Coliseum to begin.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkovia_bloodmoon/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/345c45e1bb960b752f8a9b7fbb79bb0f85d4d95f.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Lunar New Year[/h2]

On the topic of lunar things... this Friday is the Lunar New Year! To celebrate the Year of the Ox, Winnie created some festive gear to celebrate. You can get it from Saber in the social district.
New AdventureQuest 3D Version
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkovia_bloodmoon/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6215df3795cac1a9de80d6eff07f64b12576686d.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Mouse Cursor (New!)[/h2]

By popular player request, we added a custom mouse cursor in the newest version of AdventureQuest 3D. It changes as you mouse over things. We also fixed monster health bars, bank search, and some of those party issues.
Get AdventureQuest 3D
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/darkovia_bloodmoon/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6416b5299f01a7de77abe0b687833c4f10a45e95.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Coming next in AdventureQuest 3D![/h2]

This week's fang-filled finale is live on Steam, Apple, and Android devices! We hope you love it.  This is the moment we have all been waiting for.

And after the climactic finale of the Darkovia saga... you will know EXACTLY what you will be taking on in next week's "mystery" Challenge Boss fight. The level 31 reward gear is absolutely wicked! Also, a lot of your fellow players have been asking for a way to obtain Vampire King Drachus' armor... we will be adding a fight so that you can get that too. Then, we will begin our journey to the treasure-filled Pyramids of the Sandsea Desert. But first...

You are about to make Darkovian history! May the fates favor you on this dangerous quest. Should you manage to emerge victorious and complete the Darkovia Saga, a rune will unlock on the Dragon Portal in the center of town.

[b]Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

notes.title: Carnaval!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/carnaval2021/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/77f9151216f2f39e8e2dec07ef697cbd80ca5a86.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Head to the Social District in Battleon because Carnaval has come to AdventureQuest 3D![/h2]
Party with your friends and celebrate Carnaval in our home town of Battleon's Social District. The Carnaval Sneevils there are filled with loot and colorful carnaval feathers that you can craft with. Talk to the Adventuretainer (yep, that is their real name) to make a breathtaking Carnaval item set. They were designed by Dage and Thyton. You can earn the items in this release... or simply buy Carnaval Collector's Chest.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/carnaval2021/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/22d1377c59b1c9e8249794944e6ba8ebc37b79a0.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]What is Carnaval?[/h2]
Carnaval (or Carnival), in real life, is a week long festival celebrated across the world, but most famously in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. There are bright costumes, floats and parades, and dancing in the streets! Carnival has been celebrated in Brazil for over a century... and in AdventureQuest Worlds since 2012... it's about time we brought it to AQ3D!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/carnaval2021/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/32c9a0e9591f869c6d34f3926aae12ec6d707b3c.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Carnaval Shop - Earn the items or buy the Collection[/h2]
You can earn all of the items in this release (except the spears), or you can buy them. Talk to the Adventuretainer in the social district of town so see the shop and previews.

[list]
[*] Carnaval Collector's Chest (DCs only)
[*] Carnaval Plume Helm
[*] Carnaval Plume Shoulders
[*] Carnaval Plume Cape
[*] Carnaval Plume Armor
[*] Carnaval Plume Bracers
[*] Carnaval Plume Belt
[*] Carnaval Plume Sandals
[*] Carnaval Plume Sword
[*] Carnaval Pagode Spear (exclusive to the Collection)
[*] Carnaval Samba Spear (exclusive to the Collection)
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/carnaval2021/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/257d17ba339b8d8b0797040f9d7929e0ccbf4749.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Darkovia: Bloodmoon finale is coming![/h2]
It is almost here! Here is a sneak peek of reward items from the challenge boss fight. As the Blood Moon rises, the leaders of the Werewolf and Vampire factions prepare to meet. Korin has been burning the midnight oil on the animations. The team is building the boss fight adventure for the finale of our Vampire and Werewolf saga. We are aiming at having the release up on the testing server this weekend (cross your cold fingers) and then releasing it for everyone to experience next week. The exciting challenge fight will follow.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ylxaeartcontest/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e8134b300fc269d761559d4397e4b3eea528dc1e.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Yooka-Laylee & AdventureQuest Art Contest mashup![/h2]
The deadline is approaching. Join in on one of the most delightfully unexpected cross-over art contests. Submissions will be judged by both the devs of Yooka-Layee and the Artix Entertainment team.

See you in game....

[b]Battle on!
Artix, Glisel, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

P.S.[/b] I went on a bit of a social media posting spree the last day or so... posting real life pictures of the staff and puns. Hope you have been enjoying it. If you have ever wondered what Nythera, Thyton, Zhoom, Glisel, or I look like outside of the games-- follow me on whatever social media thingy you use these days XD

notes.title: Darkovia's Darkest Secret
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/beforethebloodmoon/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/99cc5e31a92c30dbcf0e1176f4b4de68e2c83b31.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Darkovia's Darkest Secret[/h1]
Do you know why the vampire and werewolf filled land of Darkovia is shrouded in eternal darkness? In this week's release... you will discover the truth.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/beforethebloodmoon/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7cfbe59bece345b8510db9fc91365ee9e1deb235.jpg[/img][/url]

You will find the secret in the most unlikely place... A place you likely never thought to go. Or have you? Have you ever gone into the basement in Boog's tavern?

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/beforethebloodmoon/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3abf7980570f8893b93aef9f46adc22419146059.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Blood Moon is coming...[/h2]
The Vampires and Werewolves are preparing for a mysterious event known as the Blood Moon. Many believe this lunar event will grant one side the power to rule over both... ending the war of the fangs once and for all.  At least, that is what the prophecy says.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/beforethebloodmoon/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/589758040f98c3e90b180241b9081854c6efdb9f.jpg[/img][/url]

The Vampires and Lycans each have different versions of the prophecy. No one knows which one is right yet. But one part is the same in both versions. To fulfill the prophecy... either the Werewolf King or the Vampire Queen must possess a lost artifact called the "Eye of Night." But if you have played our other games, you may recognize it by another name... *gulps* in this week's release, you are going after it.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/beforethebloodmoon/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/cb354675927c7b4ad66be9e3b148a33e054d07bc.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]And this week's "Most valuable, but rarely talked about NPC" goes to...[/h2]
The Mayor! Yes, Darkovia's Mayor is a treasure trove of hidden secrets. And he owes you a big pile of gold. Claiming to be trapped in the town and Father two two very peculiar children, questioning him may be the key to understand what is really happening here.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/beforethebloodmoon/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9db0f7fdbef12eefddb89411c22f202b4b0448f5.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Smitten with Mittens[/h2]
Stop by Winnie the Tailor's shop in town. She knitted some sort of mitten gauntlets.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/beforethebloodmoon/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3d36f2cc3aa46427777d0283b478da85d1d39f61.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Coming next[/h2]
We have been listening to feedbck and have a few noteworthy things coming soon including a non-scaling dungeon option, mouse pointer for Steam players, more bank tabs, more friend slots, and more. The next major game feature update will be next week.

Meanwhile, Korin is working on the epic Darkovia Finale cinematic cutscenes. There have been some hiccups ("bad Unity 3D, bad!") but we are fighting through them and getting close. I cannot wait for the finale! (...and the Boss challenge fight that will be unlocked after.) The Blood Moon release will take place right in the center of Darkhurst...

[b]Battle on!
Artix, Glisel, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

notes.title: Winnie's Birthday Mystery and Werewolf Boss Challenge!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/winniebirthday/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/214275d2dd952f3865c03fcdac87be43beb852f2.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Winnie's Birthday Mystery[/h2]
A thief in Battleon?! That may be the case, and it's up to you to find out who took Winnie's sewing scissors! (And on her birthday of all days!) Talk to the other shopkeepers in Town Square to find out what information they may know... or what secrets they may be hiding. Use your super-sleuthing skills to solve the mystery and make Winnie's birthday a happy one! And after solving the case, you'll be awarded a gift fitting of Battleon's greatest detective: the Supersleuth Magnifying Glass!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/winniebirthday/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/aa9bbe739abcbde6bdb6f77c948b894782a9d33c.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Winnie's Supersleuth Crafts[/h2]
But that’s not all! After solving Winnie's Birthday Mystery, you’ll also unlock her Supersleuth craft shop. With it, you can craft the full Supersleuth armor set and a new magnifying glass (just in case) using Telltale Textile. Take on the repeatable quest Supersleuth: The Hound of the Heartwood to earn the Telltale Textile crafting materials.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/winniebirthday/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/cb2b5dd69d3ae91a5cf1b229d4f6eb8a317e9d7e.jpg[/img][/url]

Don't forget to [url=https://twitter.com/winnie_AQ3D]wish the real Winnie a happy birthday on Twitter[/url]. Winnie is an official artist for AdventureQuest 3D, and has brought many new tailored armor sets and adorable pets to our game.

[h3]Happy Birthday Winnie![/h3]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/werewolfcoliseumredux/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/f3ca03924e70b897ee5788fccbecf02c5a47111b.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Challenge The Werewolf King![/h1]
Constantine is challenging Lucianus Rex to be the new king of the Lycan Conclave. Help him defeat the king in this challenge version of the epic scene from the conclusion of Darkovia part IV.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/werewolfcoliseumredux/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b5cd069572d0a4f9333299cc6d65c6cd13600894.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The Challenge! Redux![/h2]
Replay this epic scene from Darkovia part IV as a challenge with your team! The Challenge is for level 30+ players only and can be played with up to 5 party members.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/werewolfcoliseumredux/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/cda7fa38073e586b79cc2bda5afe6741d5f44156.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The Spoils[/h2]
When you successfully help Constantine, a chest will appear with the chance to drop any of the Bone Wolf and Ragnar Coliseum armor set items and weapons. It will also drop a random stack of Token of Challenge which you can turn in to the Coliseum Spoils shop to craft the items you are missing. The Coliseum Spoils shop also has two new weapons which can only be gotten from the shop: the Lycan Bone Saw and Lycan Bone Chopper.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/werewolfcoliseumredux/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/db853524fb92f334c55b5a7c9a280cff09cc1789.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Wasn't This Already Released?[/h2]
Last week, we snuck in the challenge with the Frost Siege and 2020 badge and items. Players have since found it and reported some bugs that we missed. Now those bugs are fixed and the challenge is ready for everyone.
Don't worry. We also patched the Frost Siege bugs. Don't forget to clear your cache and...

[b]Battle On![/b]
Glisel, Artix, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: Happy New Year! Get your 2020 Badge & Frost Siege
notes.content:
[url=aq3d.com/news/newyear2021][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8d65f507b499b195edeb39662969025f13b989b3.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Happy New Year! [/h2]
"We joked that you should get a badge for making it through 2021. Nobody is laughing now.... Come get it!"

Hindsight being 2020.... hop in AdventureQuest 3D and obtain your well earned badge, cape, and other presents. Then head to the door in the social district and protect the town from the Frost Summoner's Horde!  

It is time to bring in the New Year. BATTLE ON!

[url=aq3d.com/news/2021][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a7ff39a74d30f498e5b55736d09be0c37f1e01fe.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Hindsight is 2020 Cape & items!
[/h2]
Leave the flaming wreckage of 2020 behind you... both figuratively, and literally. It is an epic cape earned only by triumphantly defying the year 2020.This rare collector's cape is free, and lit (literally).

[url=aq3d.com/news/newyear2021][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/48316f5c821e18083630afd218cb0759dbc58909.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Get your "I made it through 2020 badge"[/h2]

I (Artix) am waiting for you on the bridge in town! It is my honor to bestow upon you the a badge for making it through the craziness of 2020. Heroes can only be created during difficult times. They may see us struggle... but they will never see us quit. In addition to New Year's Eve, it is also my birthday. So I got you a few extra bonus things that you might like. 

[url=aq3d.com/news/2021][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6bcf41b44fbe0a5a2ac7be8973387c7d4a2f2178.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Return of the Frost Siege  [/h2]
Protect Battleon from the Frost Summoner's Horde, and prepare for New Year's Eve chaos as Artix and the dev team join the game for live events to ring in 2021.

[url=aq3d.com/news/newyear2021][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5b598ff03948dd6b10a1e0a756184536a61eac0c.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Defend the Town[/h2]

Build catapults, siege walls, and battle against invaders from the frozen north. Earn and use Defenders Medals to buy extra help rewards.

*If this is your first time playing the frost siege war, check out the full details here in the [url=https://aq3d.com/news/siege_war/]original design notes, Frost Siege War.[/url]

[url=aq3d.com/news/newyear2021][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/131bd3a28076f7bfc3b7b2b41787ec7dfe167119.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]New Items! Snowflake Axe & Shield[/h2]
These exquisite Snowflake Mace and Shield weapons (created by Darkon) are new drops in the Frost Siege. These have a reasonable chance of dropping from the Siege Extreme Ice Dragon and the Siege Frost Warlord. You won't see this monster until the last waves of the war, so hang in there and you just might get it.

[url=aq3d.com/news/frostval_collection_2021][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7dfad21b99a24da56971745fa0a154ecf47287f8.png[/img][/url]
[h2]
Frostval 2020 Collection[/h2]
There is still time to get our 2020 Frostal collection. And our Get 50% bonus DragonCrystals with any purchase special offer is still available! 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/newyear2021/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/633a8034f0f9c7468fc9d1b50cda739d75ea0368.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New Year's Eve Live Events
[/h2]We wish you a Happy New Year! Join the devs and Artix in AdventureQuest 3D on New Year's Eve for random, anything goes live events. We will be spawning monsters, telling stories, and spawning treasure chests to bring in the New Year. See www.AQ3D.com for an updated schedule of events. 
See you in game

[b]Battle on!
Artix and the AdvetureQuest 3D Team
[/b]

notes.title: Darkovia IV: The Werewolf Coliseum
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/werewolf/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d90a6a1a9287f878e0ca451a06d5955950c6088a.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Darkovia Part IV: the werewolf Coliseum is live![/h2]
Journey to the vampire and werewolf infested forest of Darkovia to begin your journey from Darkhurst, through the crypts of Vampire Castle, to the throne room of the Werewolf Coliseum.
https://aq3d.com/news/werewolf/

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/werewolf/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6ef1b44aefc67700374b089e96662d864c678061.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]New Werewolf areas, cutscenes, quests, and items![/h2]
The original Darkovia was split into multiple questlines using our old system. We merged it all together into one, unified, easy to follow, story. this means, all players will need to start from the beginning. Which is great-- because you will get all of the story XP to help you level up, or gain level capstones.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/werewolf/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b139fbdd82128d907352faf1bd8c79d5f163202b.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Werewolf Throne Room[/h2]
The Lycans are ruled by the Were-King and the council of Senators. They are in command of the legions of werewolves who battle against the vampires.

Fans of history may note the Roman Empire-like structure of the Lycans. From their military ranks to their love of the Coliseum, their laws & honor code supersede their feral instincts.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/werewolf/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2e725c81bcb538d8ad0f48e7f01549378cdbba58.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Werewolf Coliseum[/h2]
To the Lycans, "might makes right". Theirs is a culture of strength and power. All matters are solved through combat in the arena.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/werewolf/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8efa6cfa8d513eeab797e09656534cdce20f9a2a.jpg[/img][/url]

The Coliseum is a place of blood and sand. There, one can earn their place with victory... or perhaps even ascend to the throne.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/werewolf/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8a1e4f76579939d4d859cc8a47911cecc3aad089.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Werewolf Alcove[/h2]
Darkovia forest is a place of perpetual darkness... but it has hidden beauty. Upon completing the Vampire's story, you will gain the ability to enter the giant stone wolf-head doors to this place... the Werewolf Alcove. I would not recommend eating the mushrooms.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/werewolf/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d4e6bf4cde51a078f808fc1e832c2031011687e8.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Lycan Armor Sets[/h2]
Whether you intend to embrace the curse of lycanthropy or merely ally yourself with the wolves, craft these items to show your loyalty.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/werewolf/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/52b0350704776bc2a55691036b19d35edbced767.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Werewolves have an alternative History[/h2]
Protected by their ghostly ancestors, deep with in the Lycan's library... you will find the old laws inscribed on stones. I am not saying you could stage a take-over with these rules... but, you probably will. Also, the werewolves have an alternative description of the prophecy of the Blood Moon. Things are getting interesting.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/werewolf/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8be05a201ecb029de985f08eabe67f946ae17507.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Werewolf or Lycan?[/h2]
Werewolf and Lycan... they mean the same thing. Lycan is a word that comes from "Lycanthrope", which is the curse that makes you into a Werewolf. In our world, it is appropriate to call them by either title.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/werewolf/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a435b8c04df6a43a4cd4dd4f07d35819d6b5fcac.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]3 Werewolves howling at the moon[/h2]
We hope you enjoy this new storyline release. Next up, will be the Werewolf Coliseum challenge fights with new gear. Then, it is time for the climatic finale.  Werewolves and vampires will embrace their true destiny in the climatic finale.... Darkovia 5: The Blood Moon.

Also, as promised... you are roughly one week away from officially earning the "I made it through 2020" badge! 

You got this. 

[b]Battle on!
Artix & all your friend at AdventureQuest 3D[/b]

notes.title: 2020 Frostval Collection, Gift'thulu, and Level Capstones!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval_collection_2020/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/aadf9a39a011c5881dba7604388e70a47a31fc75.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Happy Frostval![/h1]

The 2020 Frostval collection is now live in game, platyers are spawning gift monsters, new daily tasks have been introduced, Level Capstones have been added for players to earn when they hit max level, and guilds are available for all players to create!
[b]Read more at https://aq3d.com/news/frostval_collection_2020/[/b]

Humbug the Moglin says, "[i]Bah. Hope this year's collection brings you discomfort, joylessness, and the tears of all who dare oppose you.[/i]" As a chaotic evil moglin, the whole spirit of Frostval sorta flies right over his head. Maybe his heart stat is 3 sizes too small? 


[url=https://aq3d.com/news/giftthulu/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b755635eec9275341205c532ca61a452c848061c.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Gift'thulu[/h2]

Beware of players spawning Gift'thulu across the game! This gift-filled creature is summoned from an item purchased from Blizzy the Moglin. Read the full details...
https://aq3d.com/news/giftthulu/ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d53d4a59a5de20008edc6d59819ce80a21166d42.jpg[/img]

[h2]Guild Creation for All![/h2]

All players are now able to create guilds in AdventureQuest 3D! (Valencia art by [url=https://twitter.com/Jon__Eve]Jon Eve[/url])

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval_collection_2020/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c9c07dda0cea27191fa5906f11f79fc5344b183b.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]2020 Frostval Collection[/h2]

The 2020 Frostval Collection features four new weapon and armor sets by AdventureQuest 3D's top artists.  Also 3 new pets and 1 new travel form! Here is what you will find inside the collection:

Read more at  https://aq3d.com/news/frostval_collection_2020/

[list]
[*]Humbug the Moglin (Pet & Travel Form)
[*]Cuddly Blizzy (Pet)
[*]Frost Vampragon (Pet)
[*]Frozen Warrior Armor Set
[*]Frozen Warrior Sword
[*]Frozen Warrior Icicles Crown (alternate helm)
[*]Frost Tzar Armor Set
[*]Frost Tzar Saber
[*]Cold Steel Armor Set
[*]Cold Steel Masked Crown (alt helm)
[*]Cold Steel Hooded Crown (alt helm)
[*]Cold Steel Sword
[*]Cold Steel Sword and Shield
[/list]

As per tradition, you can buy any piece individually using DragonCrystals. Or, you can unlock the entire 2020 Frostval Collection for 4900 DragonCrystals. Not only will this give you year-round access saving you bank space, save you a ton of DCs, and give you the warm and fuzzy feeling of supporting our ongoing releases... you will also unlock the 2020 Frostval Collector Badge and title "Humbug".

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/capstones/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/152ce758ad9c30803e9cfb6635bde15970fdf585.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Level Capstones[/h2]
Normally, when you get to max level you stop earning XP. But not any more. With level capstones, you will continue earning XP from quests, monsters, and daily tasks. But instead of leveling up, you will earn "Capstones". In fact, you will get 20 Capstones each time you level up. Use these to acquire exclusive level-cap armor and weapons.
https://aq3d.com/news/capstones/

[h2]Daily Tasks[/h2]
[b]"The goal is to make everything more rewarding"[/b]
Yup, simple goal-- make everything more rewarding. Every day when you log in, you will be able to do tasks to earn a big chunk of XP and gold... including non-combat tasks! 
https://aq3d.com/news/capstones/ 


[url=https://www.artix.com/posts/holiday_cookie_contest_2020/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/23fa56203e92e2a7cc477570dfd6c3e753cfc8e5.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Breaking news! Creators of Cookie Clicker to just this year's Artix Cookie Contest![/h2]
The creators of Cookie Clicker, Orteil and Opti will be justing this year's cookie contest. Bake some monster cookies and join in!
Cookie Contest details at https://www.artix.com/posts/holiday_cookie_contest_2020/


[url=https://www.heromart.com/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/eca86050f894fe79161f86343f3ae6b7aae4d4f2.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]2021 Artix Calendar now shipping![/h2]

This year's new calendar is shipping now from HeroMart! 
Get yours --> https://www.heromart.com/

[url=https://www.AQ3D.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e8c3f5d2640ad8bd6e9e46b1a999df01e701a73f.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you & coming next![/h2]

What better way to get into the spirit of wintery festivities.... than to head to the Vampire and Werewolf infested forest of Darkovia! O_o Wait, what? Yes! At long last, next week's AdventureQuest 3D release is .... Darkovia Part IV: The Werewolf Collisium. (If you beat down some Lycan gladiators with a wreath, you better be posting me screenshots!)

Also, rumor has it a snowy force of monsters is on route to town. Roland and Defenders are preparing defenses for the Frost Siege! 

See you in game and... 

[b]Happy Frostval!
Artix & all of your friends here at AdventureQuest 3D[/b]

notes.title: New Chess Map in AdventureQuest 3D!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/aq3dchess/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/249381b1f3f8d39ae7bfcca0e9cbcdaad0ac8589.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]New Chess Map in AdventureQuest 3D![/h2]

[b]Social and Monster Chess Maps are now available in AdventureQuest 3D![/b]

Ok, so the story goes like this. Artix has been watching a TV series. Monday, he enthusiastically charges into the AdventureQuest 3D staff chat going on and on about how badly we need a chess board in game. "You know, like the one we built for AQWorlds!" It just so happens that some of the team needed an extra week to finish up the Darkovia release. Yergen said, "Sure, I can build it... but I want it to have the vibes of a certain wizard movie franchise." Then Dagger & Llussion start talking about how it would be cool to add monsters, but make them activate based on loose chess rules. We debated on whether it would be better to just have a social map with no monsters or a challenge... and then decided: "WHY NOT BOTH!?" Then Winnie made an entire set of Chess themed armors so you can use them in player-run Chess Matches. And this is why we are writing to beg you... STOP RECOMMENDING TV SHOWS AND ANIME TO ARTIX [url=https://twitter.com/ArtixKrieger/status/1334207179109388289 ]ON TWITTER! [/url]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/aq3dchess/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/aedcadeb1ce8e6b7322d706a7d72f292dcff4595.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]We call it "BattleOn Chess"![/h2]
It's a huuuuuge Chess Board map. The game pieces are monsters. You can only attack pawns (the little ones in the front) on your opening move. Defeating this challenge without party wiping will take some strategy... 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/aq3dchess/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/50527e569ff4cf16ec6dcf680a7abce4e1bd1996.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]"Checkmate!"[/h2]
Each side has a King. Your goal is to defeat one of them. Once you do, all of the other pieces will return to their starting position and a treasure chest will drop.  

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/aq3dchess/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/cffda2b52b8d2777085a2419a28cc3b151379493.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Your Chess Set[/h2]
The reward treasure chest will drop a random armor featuring a Chess piece on it. Perfect for use in a live player vs player chess match!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/aq3dchess/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/50299cf37f19fc15c4ca1cd9180a50cd6023219a.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Yup, we added a Chess Armor Trove for you![/h2]
You can build a trove (free collection) of all the black & white pieces. So you can switch to any chess piece if needed in a live match. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/aq3dchess/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/eec20f098860b9a0bcf11d37d3ab22ed2050b754.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you, and coming next....[/h2]
We are neck deep in Vampires and Werewolves! Prepare to enter the Werewolf Coliseum in the continuation of the Darkovia Saga... it is coming next. Also, the devs have chat bubbles, daily quests/tasks, and other features getting close to release. We hope you are enjoying our weekly releases. This week's is a small but interesting one. I love spontaneous releases like this... you can always see the heart in something that people are passionate about. Whether you know the rules to chess or not, hop in and make your first move!

[b]Battle on!
Artix, Glisel, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]
