notes.title: Guilds are now live!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/guilds-1/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3bc276b24149632d55b797bccd8ab39cc29c05a5.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Phase 1 of Guilds is now live![/h2]

Guardians currently have early access to create a new guild (Requires level 10 and 10,000 gold) before it opens to all players. Anyone can be invited to join a guild.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/guilds-1/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7743145ea2bcecfdb899dbcc6f633ce8a4f4742b.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]About Guilds[/h2]

The first phase of guilds introduces a foundation that we will continue to build on.  Guilds choose both a full guild name, and also a 3 to 5 letter guild tag which will appear next to your name. Top features include cross-server guild chat and quick transportation to your guild members. You can read all of the details on....

[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]
[*]  Create a Guild
[*]  Join a Guild
[*]  Cross-Server Chat
[*]  Quick Teleport to Guild Members
[*]  Invite
[*]  Promote
[*]  Demote
[*]  Kick
[*]  Disband
[*]  Guild Chat Tab
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/guilds-1/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ace84b1e97b176f60715fb674614d6b7fe81fa13.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Creating a Guild[/h2]

Ultimately, every player will be able to create a guild from the new Guild section of their main menu. For this initial release, we  have granted early access to Guardians. Allowing Guardians to create guilds first solves a few issues-- it rewards them for keeping our servers online, allows them to secure their guild names, and also creates a smaller number of guilds so that we can better address bugs and problems.

[h2]Guild Creation Requirements[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Guardian (Early access before it opens to all players)
[*]  Level 10
[*]  10,000 Gold
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/guilds-1/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ea11c0d8834ae79a638699111a735d7a3247169d.jpg[/img][/url]


[h2]Joining a Guild[/h2]

Any guild leader or officer can invite you to join their guild. Simply hit accept. Once you are a member of the guild, you will see the guild tag next to your name. You will also be able to access guild chat and talk to your guildmates... even if they are on different servers. We added a tab in your chat box just for guild talk. Also, of course, we added a toggle switch to ignore guild invites in case someone gets spammy.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/guilds-1/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4260a4539cfa93bb307e1fa5f16ffd72f813ba3a.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Guild Size[/h2]

We are certainly going to be increasing the size of guilds in the future. You will need a larger guild to achieve some of the guild-wide tasks we have been planning. For this initial release, however, you will have a starting max guild size of 20 players.
Promote Guild

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/guilds-1/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d7fd7ab665cd4fa8d14ba6432222c36999d3f1e3.jpg[/img][/url]
 
[h2]Guild Leaders Can Assign Ranks[/h2]

In this first release, Guild Leaders will be able to assign the roles of Members, Officers, and Leaders to members of the guild.

[h2]Leaving or Disbanding a Guild[/h2]

Yup. It is easy. Members of a guild can leave at any time. There is no penalty. The leader of a guild can disband their guild. If you are a guild leader it will ask you to give the leader position to someone before you can leave. If you want to disband the guild, remove all of the members first and then leave... which will make the guild go POOF!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/guilds-1/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c4aed4e19d3b439dbd7da382ccbc25810cd35019.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Guilds are live now in AdventureQuest 3D![/h2]

The first priority is creating a strong foundation for Guilds. Once we have done that, we will be able to add any number of features. (Some ideas include acquiring land and building a castle with your guild, PvP war with other guilds, and guild levels that come from working together on guild quests.) Long before that, we will fix whatever issues are discovered and introduce some vital (and currently missing functionality) from being able to rename your guild, assign more ranks to guild members, and all of the other things you soon desire.

We hope guilds make it easier to play with your friends. This is the most important goal of this new system.

[h2]Update: You guys are so creative! XD[/h2]

We have been watching players creating the guilds in real-time, and have been cracking up at the clever names. You have also been coming up with a lot of great suggestions for guild features you would like to see next. We have been fixing bugs and issues as they are reported and are currently working on a patch to resolve some of the bigger ones. We are off to a great start-- thank you for being a part of this.

[b]Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

notes.title: Friday the 13th... Beware Shrade-O the Clown!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/fridaythe13th-2020/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a919bace17218dd53fd524bbab0ea3d5e160f3a2.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]"Shrade's not clowning around this Friday the 13th!"[/h2]

A new Shrade has appeared every Friday the 13th... but this one is the most terrifying of all! Do you dare step foot in Camp Gonnagetcha this weekend knowing he is on the loose? (He is dropping his entire set though...)

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/fridaythe13th-2020/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b3526acd668bb57dae3be7522ae2d08f7fb80264.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Shrade-O the Clown[/h2]

Shrade-O is just as deadly as his previous incarnations at Camp Gonnagetcha. He has a more powerful alter ego too, named Shrade-O Extreme-O. Both of these clowns have a chance to drop items for their armor sets, but Extreme-O can also drop a Clown Face Kite pet and a Clown Stripe Kite Pet. If you aren't too scared, go find Dottie on the Battleon Bridge and she'll help you find your way to camp. I can't guarantee that you'll make it back out...

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/fridaythe13th-2020/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/132d38224dbe49098282ac22e5ca4b3ca368af3c.jpg[/img][/url]


[h2]The secret story behind Shrade-O[/h2]

This is a real childhood story of one of our developers. It is about Yergen. He is the lead of the content team here at AdventureQuest 3D. When he was a little boy, there was a clown that would come to his school. The clown was named Bake-O. And yes, oh yes, Bake-O peddled bacon. For real. Everytime he said the phrase "Bacon Bits" he would honk a horn for a Pavlovian response. He performed magic tricks and told jokes. He would stop in the middle of his performance and say, "Do you know what I really like? ...Bacon bits!" At the end of his show at the school he would give every child a little vial of Bacon Bits. We are not sure what psychological effects Bake-O the Clown had on Yergen... but if you catch a wiff a little bacon scent coming from Shrade-O, then... well, you are now one of the few people with the insider story.

See you at camp...

Also, be sure to read up on the [url=https://aq3d.com/news/lich_challenge/][b]level 31+ Lich Boss Challenge[/b][/url] which is now live... featuring the most powerful gear in the game. 

[b]Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

notes.title: Lich Challenge Boss Fight and Level Cap Increase!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lich_challenge/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bb86b32429cc424c557726e0c5b58089df1f4ccf.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Noxus the Lich Returns with Level Cap increase and the most powerful gear in the game.[/h2]

Can you  survive a Level 31+ Lich challenge boss fight designed by Dagger? It is going to take a well geared party, grit, and a serious amount of strategy.
Noxus Fight
https://aq3d.com/news/lich_challenge/

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lich_challenge/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/915a28dfd287706e2242a7204e23e05b2e354d93.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Challenge: Noxus' Return[/h2]

You and your party must face off against Noxus the Lich and all of his summoned creatures, with their deadly new skills. He saved his most deadly powers for this...

[b]Be warned. [/b] You can NOT do this alone. You'll need a full party and plenty of strategy for this one.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lich_challenge/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a6c7a8430976b59810f80f45931426b35a77f15e.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Level Cap Increase![/h2]

We've raised the level cap maximum to 31 for this release. The epic-quality gear you will find in this release are the most powerful items in the game. They are designed to give you a massive advantage through Darkovia and the first Pyramids of the upcoming Sandsea Desert.

Game Dev Note: Originally, the plan was to raise the level cap with Darkovia and then again with the Sandsea-- but after much debate, we decided to raise it one level now with this gear, and then we wait until the Sandsea starts where during the story it will go to 35. Every major saga thereafter will raise the cap roughly 5 levels.
Level 30+ to Enter

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lich_challenge/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2e7d7227654e9a51c9823cec99481301710a0f1b.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]You Must Be Level 31 to Enter...[/h2]

Noxus won't let anyone less than worthy face him again. This is a non-scaling level 31 challenge... you must complete the story and be at least level 31 to enter the challenge.  If you dare... walk up the steps in the lobby to find the door that will take you to the fight! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/422a4d1eb04e003e3d9f7463b3bac2f6d42730ca.jpg[/img]

[h2]Challenge Fight Designed by Dagger[/h2]

[b]"So yeah, a whole lotta high level players are gonna.. X_X"[/b]

Dagger's previous boss fights include the Tengu fight, Trollenstein's Lab, and he also designed the fight sequences for the battle concerts.  When Artix asked him if he would do the Lich fight-- crazy requests for grasping hands, bone bridges, and even some game engine level requests started. The results speak for themselves. This challenge party wiped our group made of devs a half dozen times till we started figuring out the strategy for the fight. Artix will never be able to post the video of that team test because... LOL, we would have to bleep out the whole thing XD. It is intense!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lich_challenge/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/72af1a438dec455ebbf0f671469b5cc98643079c.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]Epic Lich Rewards[/h2]

If you manage to defeat the Lich Noxus, a SKULL Treasure Chest will spawn. All of the rewards have stats for 30 level players. No Scaling. You have the chance to get each piece of Noxus' High Lich armor set, weapons, and are guaranteed some Empowered Soul Stones which you can use in the Necronomicon for pieces you didn't get in the chest... after many runs of the dungeon, of course.
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lich_challenge/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a9d9893b2281ccbc01f424ed447d7774ffc68d36.jpg[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/477934ff5c06dafe0167d8d5f9da3059457dca6f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Tips[/h2]

[list]
[*]     Bring Your Friends: Get a group together and play a private instance.
[*]     Pre-game: Don't run into straight into the fight. Especially on mobile. Take time to strategize with your party in chat if you can.
[*]     Constant Communication: If you can, use Discord or some other voice chat service to communicate with each other throughout the challenge.
[/list]

[h2]Can you and your party defeat the Lich?[/h2]

Also, this Friday is a Friday the 13th... and rumors are that "Shrade-O" will appear in Camp Gonnagetcha.

Let us know in the comments below, and...

[b]Battle on![/b]
Artix, Dagger, Fisn, Glisel, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

[h2]Treasure Chest Items[/h2]
[list]
[*] Grave Warden armor set
[*] Grave Warden Axe
[*] Grave Warden Axe and Shield
[*] Keeper of the Basilisk armor set
[*] Keeper of the Basilisk Sword
[*] Valkyrie of the Night armor set
[*] Valkyrie of the Dawn armor set
[*] Scarlet Sentry armor set
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/class_updates/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/56f65a3a08d913a1b6fab0f8a862e807952e0408.jpg[/img][/url]

Each day you log in there is a chance to score new gear! AdventureQuest 3D gives you customization to make your character appear any way you want... and the freedom to switch classes and play how you want.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/class_updates/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0b7db4cfcf19482e4d843f12a19a21bce973c9e1.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Starter Class Improvements (and Guardian too!)[/h2]
"We've heard your feedback about adding more skill to the game's combat. To address this, we've made changes to the starting classes to give them a more defined role, and spruced up the combat engine to make every encounter a more dynamic experience for you all. " - Rabblefroth

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/class_updates/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/49e1ca9b24dc51178807b55bfd738db428b477f6.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Warrior[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]War Cry (Passive[/b]) is now a resource called Fury. Every spell grants 25 Fury, and at 100 Fury the next spell has +50% Power. Base Power of spells has been adjusted to compensate.
[*] [b]Auto Attack[/b] is now a 3-hit combo that deals more damage on the final hit.
[*] [b]Sever[/b] - Aggro bonus from damage increased from 0% to 75%
[*] [b]Whirlwind[/b] - Armor Break amount increased from 15% to 30% and duration reduced from 8s to 4s
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/class_updates/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/795747bd2b9996ea9fe4a519832a287209507a7e.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Mage[/h2]
Mage has been heavily updated to be more active and give choices instead of just casting whatever spell is off cooldown. It uses Channeled spells that apply damage over time but require you to stand still, making positioning and planning important. We also wanted your Mana to matter, while keeping the feel of having an infinite amount.

[list]
[*] [b]Leylines (Passive)[/b] - Increases Haste by 10%
[*] [b]Fireball[/b] - Cast repeatedly to build Fire Aspect, increasing damage. Every third cast launches a powerful exploding fireball
[*] [b]Ice Spear[/b] - Cast repeatedly to regain Mana and build Ice Aspect, increasing Cast Speed. Every third cast launches a conjured lance of ice at your foe, Slowing and dealing Frost damage over time.
[*] [b]Lightning Storm[/b] - Channel lightning into your target, Stunning with the initial blast.
[*] [b]Meteor Volley[/b] - Channel to summon devastating meteors to annihilate your target and the surrounding area.
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/class_updates/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bf8fdab1fee876dcc63165fa3bf94924e3ccd216.jpg[/img][/url]

[list]
[*] [h2]Rogue[/h2]
[*] [b]Auto Attacks[/b] - Now a 3-hit combo that applies 2 stacks of Poison on final hit.
[*] [b]Poison Strike[/b] - Applies 3 -> 2 stacks of Poison (Rank 6: reduced from 4 to 3 stacks)
[*] [b]Poison[/b] - Power per stack changed from 16 to 20, and duration increased from 4s to 5s
[*] [b]Scorpion Sting[/b] - Power reduced from 90 to 80
[*] [b]Heavy Poison[/b] - Power per stack increased from 32 to 35 (Rank 8: increased from 37 to 40), time damage is dealt over is reduced from 6s to 4s
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/class_updates/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e63e17129983e1efbf5d6b81a0fd4c231cec8f57.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]GUARDIAN[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Dragon's Breath[/b] - Aggro bonus from damage increased from 50% to 100%
[/list]

[h2]Parties can now join dungeons together[/h2]
When party leaders join public dungeons, the rest of the party can join the same instance. This is a vital part of the upcoming dungeon finder.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/72af1a438dec455ebbf0f671469b5cc98643079c.gif[/img]

[h2]Coming next....[/h2]
Expect to visit the reaper... X_X Dagger is building a level 30 fixed challenge Lich Boss Fight. It features two brand new brutal boss skills. The rewards  are worthy of it... both in stats and appearance.  Meanwhile, the AQ3D content team has been focusing on the Werewolf Coliseum (Darkovia Part IV). The maps are nearing completion as we are fang deep in cutscenes and NPCs. The coding team is working on phase 1 of Guilds and the Dungeon finder. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/class_updates/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/13e8dfb6a2960345af85e857d8af65fbc68ee705.png[/img][/url]

Give me a follow for sneak peaks!

• [url=https://www.facebook.com/artixkrieger]Twitter[/url]
• [url=https://www.instagram.com/artix/]Instagram[/url]

See you in game... 

Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: The Tower of Necromancy is live!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/towerofnecromancy/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d3437ad29553f5c37f5682b2255af46fd6ebef10.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]13 Floors of Tests, Trainers, and Terror-ible Humor![/h2]
Happy Mogloween! Embark on the perfect new release for your spooky weekend. Journey to the Isle of the Dead and at long last... enter the Tower of Necromancy.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/towerofnecromancy/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/477934ff5c06dafe0167d8d5f9da3059457dca6f.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Tower of Necromancy[/h2]
Whether you are a heroic Paladin infiltrating the tower or a dark spellcaster looking to obtain its forbidden secrets... the time to enter the Tower of Necromancy is at hand. You will find it on the Isle of the Dead. Rumor has it that an unkillable Lich is the Tower's Master. How certain is this information? Not very. No hero nor necromancer that attempted to slay it has ever returned sane... or completely alive.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/towerofnecromancy/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d630902bc59c829b08c4876f1089aafbfeb1b765.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]How to get to the Tower of Necromancy?[/h2]
Find Stygis the Ferryman in DoomWood Forest. In addition to teaching you how to become a Necromancer, he can ferry you to the Isle of the Dead. You will find the tower there. How do you get inside? That part is up to you.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/towerofnecromancy/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9b02640e45b5fd1d8dbfbd25e5381c12f7e5981b.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]13 Floors...[/h2]
Some speculate that the tower itself is some sort of dark test. That each of the 13 floors is overseen by different types of dark casters where each floor tests you to see if you are worthy to move on to the next.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/towerofnecromancy/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/09e4ef61fdbfd22868a51e5ff6acc924fd0c16b6.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Secret of the Tower[/h2]
What is the tower? Is it really the source of all Necromancy? Who is the Tower's Master? The answers to these questions lie within...

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/towerofnecromancy/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/81e0837dc734fae1e05801145d19f3f4152cbd83.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Undead Dueling[/h2]
Summoning and commanding the undead is a key skill within the tower. Perhaps some of the skills you learn within the tower will be useful again in future areas. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/towerofnecromancy/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e8138890f7e9233f2c7f34a4d646de3df53020af.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Discover new Dark Items[/h2]
Your journey up the tower will be frought with peril and littered with dark new loot.
[list]
[*] [b]Dark Theurgist[/b] (Full Set)
[*] [b]Necro'Rune[/b] (Full Set)
[*][b]*Name is secret* Lich[/b] (Full Set)
[*] [b]Zorlock's Shrine[/b] (Back)
[*] [b]Necraxe[/b] (Upgradable Axe)
[*] [b]Necrotic Cloak of the Tower[/b] (Back)
[*] [b]Spirit Shooter[/b] (Necrotic Pew Pew)
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/towerofnecromancy/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/aa9c218e1593464d4afc51dd3515b7e0485af205.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]"Dark, Fun, and Funny!"[/h2]
Exactly the kind of humor you expect from Artix and the team. If you enjoyed the quirky characters on the Isle of the Dead, then wait till you get a load of floor 9.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/towerofnecromancy/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1261f5afc0ad8db99a2b000cd07e040adc123c99.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Re-animated Monsters[/h2]
As each trainer is unique, so are their darkly themed floors. You will be delighted to see a few "lost undead" creatures make their return to our world.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/towerofnecromancy/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4389e14f727d4ae8e2053f864023f3f24ee09ba2.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Summoned Monster vs Monster[/h2]
Monsters created from summoning circles in the tower can duel. We created a new "aggro type" to make this possible. Keep an eye out for these circles in major boss fights too.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/towerofnecromancy/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bc070d354deb89a9bb5ca4b3eaed91f8db96642f.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Pull the Lever?[/h2]
Each floor is a test... of your strength, sanity, and s..... *AHHHHH!*

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/towerofnecromancy/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a632efbc5cee6a48238063a196b9193b75291df1.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]"These Dark Delights have Dark Ends."[/h2]
May the fates favor you in this dangerous new release. Be sure to take your time and enjoy the story up the tower. Next week, as promised, we will be following up this release with a challenge boss fight (As if that boss needed to be more challenging O_O). If you are enjoying the Tower of Necromancy, please let the team and me know on Twitter, Instagram, or Facebook. With that...

[b]Happy Mogloween and onward... to Tower of Necromancy![/b]

Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: TRICK OR KEEP! MOGLOWEEN TROVE
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/mogloween_trove/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/caac5e1f7678a144e4e53e4f7395503826f17a21.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Create your very own Mogloween Trove![/h1]
Now your Mogloween treats can take up no inventory space at all with our first ever "Mogloween Trove!"

This new feature is available to everyone. Collect all of this year's Mogloween drops & crafts and turn them in to Mayor McPumpkins.  Also earn a title and an interactive pumpkin pet that gives you year round access to the items!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/mogloween_trove/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/140b157b724527d6d0d2b421932dee8ee9eacf43.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Talk to Mayor McPumpkin to start filling your trove![/h2]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/mogloween_trove/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e8c5c9e5ab1e44f8cdcb785c35ea8b13385aa91b.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]What is a Trove?[/h2]
Do you remember the "free collection" we released during the Breaking Benjamin battle concert? Players quested to add items to this free collection. It gave them permanent year round access to the items without taking up any inventory or bank space. We are now calling this a Trove. (Think "Treasure Trove.") A Trove is different from the seasonal collections you buy with DCs. Doing the quests to earn your trove will also give you a special title and an interactive pet which opens up your trove so you can get the items wherever you are!
[list]
[*] "Trick or Keep" Title & Badge
[*] uWu Pumpkin Pet (Tapping on it opens your trove)
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b] You earn the pet early in the quest line which gives you immediate access to any of the items you've turned in. If you don't complete the quests, you can continue them next Mogloween.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/mogloween_trove/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/044064b75ae799086f248a2a70952734e70fdb21.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]What's in the Mogloween Trove?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Pumpkin Staff (weapon)
[*] Sword of Candycornia (weapon)
[*] Candy Apple Mace (weapon)
[*] Arachnarette's armor set
[*] Iron Bat Armor set
[*] Hurlbat (weapon)
[*] Dark Ghoulish Gourd Head (helm)
[*] All of the Skelesuits (armor)
[*] Dark Ghoulish Gourd Bobber (fishing bobber)
[*] Grave Raider (weapon)
[*] Grave Raider and Shield (weapon)
[*] Pumpkin and Dagger (weapon)
[*] Deluxe Wolf Man Mask (helm)
[*] Friendly Raven (back)
[*] Spirit of Mystcroft (bow)
[/list]

[url=https://www.heromart.com/collections/mogloween-shop][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ca650f43185926b43e987f17f486792feb1e6fa8.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]HEROMART's Mogloween shop is up![/h2]
Bring the spirit of Mogloween home....
[list]
[*] [b]BountyHunter Armor[/b] sublimated shirt
[*] [b]DragonSlayer Armor[/b] sublimated shirt
[*] [b]Mogloween Enchanted Cauldron Myx[/b] shirt
[/list]
[url=www.HeroMart.com]Check out www.HeroMart.com[/url]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/mogloween_trove/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a74af36eb1a9503d32ea773441ba741f7a3b7e51.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Tower of Necromancy (Coming next!)[/h2]
There are many who believe that this release is cursed for real... not unlike the discovery of King Tut's tomb, or the set of The Crow.  But at long last, the 13 floors of the Tower of Necromancy are scheduled to release next week. It was originally a single-player experience, but we painstakingly rebuilt it to be a multiplayer experience. Along the way we introduced new features that you will be happy to see used more widely across the game. Also, you will note, there is a lot of extra room in the tower for future "expansions".

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/mogloween_trove/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/529067225a3dde30635c358358280637e446b97d.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]
Guilds in Development[/h2]
If you have been watching our "Game Plan" then you may already know that we are getting closer to releasing the 1st phase of guilds. It is nice seeing that guild chat tab. In this pic, you can see us in the upcoming Werewolf Coliseum (the next part of Darkovia) testing guild chat.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/mogloween_trove/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e246994af45a22eafd2c827a1454169d8b38bb5a.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Update-able Title Screen![/h2]
Thank you to everyone who suggested that we do this. The login screen is now Mogloween themed :D

[url=aq3d.com/news/2020_mogloween_collection][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/833dc4ddec0753aee4a400b6ba93dd0fff01359a.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Happy Mogloween![/h2]
Thank you for being a part of AdventureQuest 3D and our online video game community. We hope you are having fun and excited for the upcoming areas and features. Also, we have Mogloween events happening across our other games too. The Flash Plugin is going poof this year, so we created a new Artix Games Launcher which lets you [url=https://www.artix.com/downloads/artixlauncher/]download and play the games... forever[/url] O_O.

notes.title: Trick or Treat! Mogloween 2020 is LIVE
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2020_mogloween_collection/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4bfb6f0fcf04f2ce1be713b9cca84088a20e5f33.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Explore the town of Mystcroft to find all of the Mogloween treats![/h2]
With 40 craft-able items, secret drops, the 2020 Mogloween Collection, and slime fountain fishing, this is the largest number of Mogloween items ever to be released!

[h3]But first-- Flying witches brooms, Hex the cat, Goardian armor and...[/h3]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2020_mogloween_collection/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8966969ca15b05343d8ddacb3ea9f329fb1b5eaa.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The new 2020 Mogloween Collection[/h2]
Visit the Mogloween NPC on Battleon Bridge or find Mayor McPumpkins in Mystcroft Town to see the newly added 2020 Mogloween Collection.

[list]
[*] "I Scream for Mogloween" badge
[*] Ghoulish Gourd Pet
[*] Hex the Cat (Pet)
[*] Witch on a Broom (travel form)
[*] Warlock on a Broom (travel form)
[*] Mogloween Bow
[*] The Caster 74.A (cosmetic rod)
[*] Jack-O-Bobber (fishing bobber)
[*] Gourdian Knight armor set
[*] Gourdian Knight Sword
[*] Fiery Gourdian Knight Helm (alternate helm)
[*] Doctor Bloodstone's armor set
[*] Wish Dealer (weapon)
[*] Cursed Wish Dealer (weapon)
[*] Batwing Broom (weapon)
[*] Xandor's Firespike Broom (weapon)
[/list]

You can get these pieces individually, or save a ton of DragonCrystals by getting the entire collection which includes a badge, title, and permanent access to the collection from the bank (so you do not need to take up any inventory space.)

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2020_mogloween_collection/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/88d499fc4b32aee601a95bb7fa6d007fc146de6e.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Go Trick or Treating in the Town of Mystcroft![/h2]
Trade your Candy to Andy Corn for...

[list]
[*] Pumpkin Staff (weapon)
[*] Sword of Candycornia (weapon)
[*] Candy Apple Mace (weapon)
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2020_mogloween_collection/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/170efeb942410507e963e721ae1ea59ddebb4758.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Trade your Candy to Hexalina Caster for...[/b]

[list]
[*] Arachnarette's armor set
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2020_mogloween_collection/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/723c9720dec67c9726d09261583d7423ca6789e4.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Doctor Trollenstein's Lab[/h2]
"He's undead! He's undead!" Doctor Trollenstein & his creation are back! Head to the mad science lab and take on the buzz saw and laser filled challenge. The door is near the fountain in the middle of the haunted town.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2020_mogloween_collection/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0de9e314672b508f671ac1273f461427a73ac4c0.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Doctor is in![/h2]
Stop in for a check up and gather the pieces to craft the all new Iron Bat armor set!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2020_mogloween_collection/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3b60f9656f2a7ee4f9a4ffda37f28dfb7dd95ef8.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thadeus Glume the Ghost[/h2]
The spectre near the haunted mansion can help you craft the Dark Ghoulish Gourd Head! It is a flaming dark pumpkin head.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2020_mogloween_collection/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6936e65cbb55ef409e693df76cbf6ebd00560315.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Fishing in the Slime Fountain (level 5+)[/h2]
The age old seasonal sport of "bobbing for candyfish" has arrived! Turn in the Candyfish and Pumpkin Puffers you catch to Andy Corn to create...

[b]Skelesuits[/b]
[list]
[*] The Black & Bone White Classic Original Skelesuit!
[i] "Get a gang together and find a kid named Danny to fight in the parking lot inspiring a 3 movie, 2 season television series franchise!"[/i]
[*] Red Skelesuit
[*] Blue Skelesuit
[*] Orange Skelesuit
[*] Pink Skelesuit (why.... why!?!?!)
[*] Purple Skelesuit
[*] Green Skelesuit (Not pictured because it was too awesome and we did not want to hurt the other skelesuits feelings)
[*] Gray Skelesuit (Really this is just the normal skelesuit that has been put through the wash to many times and is slightly faded.)
[*] 
[/list][b]Dark Ghoulish Gourd Bobber[/b] (fishing bobber)
[i]"Trick or treat little fishy!" (Spoiler: It's a trick)[/i]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/2020_mogloween_collection/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/120813c5c5b93dc51cb40f917de07b2990c36d0c.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Haunted House[/h2]
Within the haunted Mystcroft Manor you will find a talking cauldron named Myx. Give him your pumpkin seeds to create...

[list]
[*] Grave Raider (weapon)
[*] Grave Raider and Shield (weapon)
[*] Pumpkin and Dagger (weapon)
[*] Deluxe Wolf Man Mask (helm)

notes.title: It is time for Mogloween!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/mogloween_returns_2020/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/009563f765278fe5fbc4d2f3984e469cddf6fabb.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Mogloween, our ghost & goblins filled, seasonal event returns![/h1]

The pumpkin-spice scented fog has opened a path way to the haunted town of Mystcroft. Everybody is in for a treat. (Maybe a trick.) Head there and get into the spirit of this spook-tacular holiday.

How to get there? Use your travel menu or speak to the creepy stranger who is standing on the bridge in town.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/mogloween_returns_2020/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1edcc05622b245fcfbb3684af2d345d4831fd5a3.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Mystcroft... a mysterious town that only appears once a year[/h2]

Mystcroft offers all kinds of creepy and spooky entertainment. Door-to-door Trick-or-Treating, a haunted manor, and monsters ready to jump out at you from all sides.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PZYh44Oko-s&t=2s]Watch the previous Mogloween video on Youtube[/url]

This release also brings back the seasonal events and dungeons such as...

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/mogloween_returns_2020/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/566ebb028f4b0e4a6e1089b350d8bbf8e7e9d916.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Haunted House[/h2]

Enter Mystcroft Mannor... if you dare.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IAsu0mCCm3M]Watch the original trailer video for Mystcroft Mannor[/url]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/mogloween_returns_2020/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/93e3a1f2da3161117ba65aacaf6286d1130697ac.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Zorbak's G... Raveyard[/h2]

Zorbak needs your help to deaden things up a little in the Raveyard. It's not entirely clear if he was trying to resurrect the skeletons to make an undead army and accidentally made them into a dance party or if the dancing has some ebil intent, but either way... the result is a bone-rattling dance party!

Plus, you can earn two different Mogloween-themed scytheblades for your trouble.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/mogloween_returns_2020/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bd5604619300445d7d140e088032bd84ac5add48.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Previous Mogloween Collections[/h2]

Miss out on any favorite items? You can now get previous Mogloween collection items you missed out on, such as the Headless Horseman travel form. Talk to whatever strange character happens to appear on the bridge in your home town of Battleon. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/taco_day/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/34258bc2d5ccfe3e6a9fb9eac7f88c396690bd91.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Taco Day Event is Almost Gone!
[/h2]
It was a nice departure from our darker releases... but only have one week left. Head into the Battleon Social District for your last chance to get these tasty taco items from Tito.

[url=aq3d.com/account][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5501c9bdd274a0cbb1548cf3aec45c38f79a3aaa.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Dragon Crystal Sale[/h2]

You can still get 50% more Dragon Crystals with any package that includes DragonCrystals... including Guardian.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/mogloween_returns_2020/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8d506ee65145324a7d09948fe3e2de8e1d990a0a.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Coming next week! Doctor Trollenstein's Lab[/h2]

"I can think of 999 reasons why I should kill you-- and 1,000 of them are for science!" Next week, come on down to the lab for a free check up. Who knows, maybe you will survive the "testing."  The team rebuilt the mad science lab so it was compatable with our new system. It will officially be opening next week.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/mogloween_returns_2020/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4990bbd09ebeb865c1a88534aca0210bd2c94168.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Darkovia saga coming![/h2]

The vampire vs werewolf fueled Darkovia saga (parts IV & V) are in the works. If you are not caught up on the storyline, be sure to do so now.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_z7s--YdNls]Watch the Darkovia Trailer on Youtube[/url]

[h2]Coming Soon!
[/h2]
This 2020 Mogloween collection and several gold cost items will be available in a couple weeks. Keep an eye out on Twitter for sneak peaks from the AQ3D artists, like the new pumpkin armor set from Dage.

[h3]See you in Mystcroft![/h3]

[h1]We need to have a Taco'bout this.[/h1]
[b]Taco Day? Are the players responsible for this new AdventureQuest 3D community holiday?[/b]

Players have been reminding the team daily to do "SOMETHING" for this year's Taco Day.... apparently, our community REALLY LOVES TACOS! O_O  Acaulescent (AKA Tacolescent) especially has been persistently reminding Artix (Thanks Acaulescent!)  But when Artix asked the team if they would make a taco item... things abruptly got outta hand. Hop on AdventureQuest 3D and join us in the Social District!

[h2]Taculous![/h2]
The Taculous rift has opened... and from it sprang this terrifyingly delicious Taculous monster. It drops Taco Seasoning, an ingredient needed to make tacos for crafting items in the Taco Shop. (Created by Xero.)  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e1fd0d21dd6102b8990c9e33c8ed87c0c550fb18.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Fishing is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/fishing_coming/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/70245a74ac08f85c9bf985c63dd46481c02ab1d4.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Fishing for news about AdventureQuest 3D's upcoming new trade skill system?[/h1]
We are getting super close to releasing the new fishing system. It is far more fun and rewarding than the old system, and will span our world. Fishing will also be the very first trade skill. We are aiming to begin testing this week. Read on for more.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/fishing_coming/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b351a743dd9db131af4f90f78925d3edd983ce12.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Fishing 101[/h2]
The new fishing is crazy fun. When it goes live, all you need to do is buy a fishing pole for a few gold. Then you will be able to click on fishing spots to start fishing. The mini-game challenges you to hook the fish. Catching fish can increase your fishing skill. Raising your skill higher will give you access to better poles, quests, rewards, and more challenging places to go fishing.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/fishing_coming/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/455fd9ad8a7d1f203cd20c1b93f74139bf179923.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Rods & Reels[/h2]
The artists went all out on the fishing rods! Some are themed after the zones where you are likely to get them. Each rod has a "fishing power." This will give you an edge as you fish in more challenging areas. Rods with high stats are essential to becoming a expert fisher-hero.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/fishing_coming/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/246775598fbc18edafc1f73a31b0e634b6e2745c.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Trade Skills[/h2]
The upcoming release is not just for fishing... it is a new system which will allow us to add mining, lumber-jacking, cooking, and countless other trade skills to the game. Each trade skill will allow you to harvest or create things (like fish) which can then be used to build other new things (like consumables, armor, houses, guild castles, etc). Items that you harvest with a tradeskill go into a separate tab, so they will not eat up any of your previous inventory space.

In our upcoming first release, you will be able to take your Fishing level up to 50. Then we will likely increase the cap by 5-ish each time we add a major new area with water and new fish.

[b]Note:[/b] I left mining on the screenshot for you, but you will not see that until the NEXT trade skill release XD

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/fishing_coming/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4dc8b4c018f742485a65e811825e0b4221924c71.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Fishing Locations across the World[/h2]
In the upcoming first release, you will find fishing spots appearing across the game. Higher level areas will have higher level fish. So you should train up your skill in the earlier areas. The lowest level fishing will be right when you enter town. This is also where you will meet our fishing trainer, Faith.

[b]Note:[/b] In order to add the water and fishing spots, Dagger had to surgically redo the geometry of a lot of maps. As a bonus, when this goes live, you may be able to walk to some places that you could not before. More maps will be updated to include fishing as we have time to add them.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/fishing_coming/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/45d99bafc1062be616b84ee45d697b90120f010a.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Faith the Fishing Trainer[/h2]
This story-line just went full circle! In our very first ever Artix Entertainment calendar, Faith made her debut as the fishing NPC. Then, in AQworlds she shifted towards being a beast master. All of the animals at the secret underground lab know Faith is the best. Then... in AdventureQuest 3D, she was originally the multi-class trainer. But with the upcoming fishing release, Faith returns to her original passion of taking us all fishing. On a personal note, I have never actually gone on one of Faith & Dage's legendary fishing adventures in real-life... maybe if they could create some poles like the ones we will be using in game? XD

Fishing is getting ready for testing on the PTR testing server as I write this. It should be up by Friday night.... making the live release as soon as we fix all of the issues found in testing.

[h3]See you in game!
Artix, Glisel, and the whole AdventureQuest 3D team[/h3]

"ONE OF US! ONE OF US!"

tags.feature: Fishing will also be the very first trade skill.
The new fishing is crazy fun.
When it goes live, all you need to do is buy a fishing pole for a few gold.
Then you will be able to click on fishing spots to start fishing.
The mini-game challenges you to hook the fish.
Catching fish can increase your fishing skill.
Raising your skill higher will give you access to better poles, quests, rewards, and more challenging places to go fishing.
The artists went all out on the fishing rods!
Some are themed after the zones where you are likely to get them.
Each rod has a "fishing power."
This will give you an edge as you fish in more challenging areas.
Rods with high stats are essential to becoming a expert fisher-hero.
The upcoming release is not just for fishing... it is a new system which will allow us to add mining, lumber-jacking, cooking, and countless other trade skills to the game.
Each trade skill will allow you to harvest or create things (like fish) which can then be used to build other new things (like consumables, armor, houses, guild castles, etc).
Items that you harvest with a tradeskill go into a separate tab, so they will not eat up any of your previous inventory space.
In our upcoming first release, you will be able to take your Fishing level up to 50.
Then we will likely increase the cap by 5-ish each time we add a major new area with water and new fish.
In the upcoming first release, you will find fishing spots appearing across the game.
Higher level areas will have higher level fish.
So you should train up your skill in the earlier areas.
The lowest level fishing will be right when you enter town.
This is also where you will meet our fishing trainer, Faith.
In order to add the water and fishing spots, Dagger had to surgically redo the geometry of a lot of maps.
As a bonus, when this goes live, you may be able to walk to some places that you could not before.
More maps will be updated to include fishing as we have time to add them.
This story-line just went full circle!
In our very first ever Artix Entertainment calendar, Faith made her debut as the fishing NPC.
Then, in AQworlds she shifted towards being a beast master.
All of the animals at the secret underground lab know Faith is the best.
Then... in AdventureQuest 3D, she was originally the multi-class trainer.
But with the upcoming fishing release, Faith returns to her original passion of taking us all fishing.
Fishing is getting ready for testing on the PTR testing server as I write this.
It should be up by Friday night.... making the live release as soon as we fix all of the issues found in testing.

notes.title: 100 Class Ranks Just Released!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/100_class_ranks/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8c2853a4f1ba1d0463fe60f694f297ac1c14540a.png[/img][/url]


[h2]You can now rank every one of your classes up to 100![/h2]

What's your favorite class? Paladin, Ninja, Ranger, Necromancer, Dragonslayer, Berserker, or one of the others? You can now collect and rank every class all the way up to 100! Along the way you will unlock new Legendary armor pieces, items, and the Legendary Class title & badge.
https://aq3d.com/news/100_class_ranks/ 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/100_class_ranks/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a68d8736c77bc5c01ea7df187433f7ddebbf01eb.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Everything you need to know about classes[/h2]

AdventureQuest 3D allows you to collect classes and switch between them at any time. Are you raiding a dungeon and need heals? Switch to Paladin or Guardian. This gives you the power to change how you and your group play on the fly. And just playing as a class automatically earns experience for it.... which will rank it up! In fact, you will unlock skills, passive abilities, an ULTIMATE, and even a cross skill just by reaching rank 10! Now you can continue ranking up to 100 unlocking new rewards...

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/100_class_ranks/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/76cc85f7c3db2c3daddc6770f4bd689f8e331be3.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Become Legendary[/h2]

You can become legendary in your class by ranking it all the way up to 100! It happens passively as you battle, the longer you play a class. It is not meant to be done in a single burst of play. It is intended to reward you over a long period of time as you play your favorite class. Along the way, you will unlock pieces of the new legendary class armors and weapons, and unlock the "Legendary" badge for that class once you hit rank 100!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/100_class_ranks/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/afad9fe947eb4e99634d185794022aaf44c9e51e.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Legendary Armor Sets[/h2]

Our artists created a legendary version of EVERY class armor in the game. If you see someone with these items equipped... they are the real deal. You can see which items you unlocked in your class menu, and you can pick up the items on your class trainer.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/100_class_ranks/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b294d69036c439e7663ab77867af6e3402a6d8cd.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]100 Ranks![/h2]

These ranks are the solution to the common request of wanting some progression in between releases and level cap raises. There is no more wasting experience when you have reached the current level cap. If you are a long time player at the current level cap too, it feels really good to progression like this again. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/100_class_ranks/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2e7b461b30be61a9a03709692b03aed69048212e.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Details[/h2]
[list]
[*]     All Classes now rank up to 100
[*]     You now get bonus rewards for playing your favorite class over a long period of time (this happens passively as you battle, no quests needed)
[*]     Class tokens are awarded at each rank
[*]     Legendary Armor Pieces unlock every 5 ranks (from ranks 15 to 50)
[*]     Legendary Class Title unlocks at 100 (Super long time to get!)
[*]     Legendary Badge unlocks at 100 (Did we mention this takes a super long time to get?)
[*]     To keep it fair for casual players, all rewards after rank 10 are cosmetic or for status, not power.
[*]     Each rank requires more Class experience than the last. (99 to 100 is BRUTAL)
[*]     This is NOT a single sitting quest! Class rank rewards above 10 are designed to reward you as a dedicated player.
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/100_class_ranks/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b6a264f53bc81f434945d27cbf0a29b73085a26f.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Which class will you take all the way to rank 100!?[/h2]

This release is live on all devices along with the newest version of AdventureQuest 3D. Your quest toward becoming a Legendary Ranger, Berserker, Rogue, Mage, Dragonslayer... everything... has begun!

Battle on!
Artix, Glisel & the AdventureQuest 3D Team

[b]Reminder:[/b] This is not meant to be a burst grind.  This release was created to reward you passively as you battle over time. No matter how you do it, be sure to have fun!

notes.title: Dragon Travel Forms!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/dragontravelforms/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c7dd711e15e9cc3aa8e9682730e53662e82f943c.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]"That's a lotta dragons.... Gaz."[/h2]

Everyone's favorite black market vendor rode to town square with dragons. Lots and lots of Dragons. His cart is right at the entrance to town-- can't miss him. Also in the news, terrible footwear, the dreamer is now actually a bow, the Voidrakar will soon begin their obliteration of our world, and also something about a secret order of people who worship shrubbery?
https://aq3d.com/news/dragontravelforms/

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/dragontravelforms/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e75a87d31b951d4e75dc433951e4faaccf5f03c7.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Dreamer is now available as a real bow![/h2]

One of our awesome custom weapon tier Kickstarter backer, created a bow before long before we had real bows in the game XD  A lot of people have been asking if it could be turned into a bow. Just so happened that last week, while hanging out in game I ran into the backer on Pointeless Isle. We talked about it and got permission to add a bow version. We are not changing the original version, because many people who possess that weapon wanted to keep it as is so they can equip it with any armor (not just Ranger.) Currently, the new version is available in the treasure chests.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/dragontravelforms/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/f626e3a4162216350a64f8b4df62c01bc2f2ea3f.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Assault on Dragonwatch[/h2]

The Voidrakar have one goal... to wipe everything you know and love from ever existing. As they prepare their assault on our world, finding the correct words to describe them is challenging. They are not a legion, horde, nor an army. They are best described as a Host. The assault on Dragonwatch is currently in production. It is the missing chapter between your first encounter with Vane and the town of Battleon.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/dragontravelforms/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/fe6b14ec6f2331e01ef602a09fa9c670cd9aee4e.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]"Ask and you shall re... WHY!? OMG! WHY?"[/h2]

A Mythical Derpricon has been spotted in the social district. It appears randomly in between the Megalodons. This creature has a chance to drop some really.. uh.. stylish footwear. The pretty pink pony shoes were a constant recommendation to me on social media by a player eager to complete a full pony/brutralcorn set. When Winnie said in the artist chat on Monday, "I am open, need anything?" I immediately responded, "How do you feel about pony shoes?" When talking about game devs listening to their players... did anyone ever stop to ask, "should they?" XD

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/dragontravelforms/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c1fff89bcb38f73677f8c57d0c9f03003f86cc0c.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank you & Coming next![/h2]

Thanks for all of the bugs and issues you reported during testing of the new Class Rank system. We made all of the fixes and are currently testing newest version on the PTR. The new system allows all classes to continue ranking up all the way to 100... unlocking Legendary armors, items, and a title along the way. It is not meant to be a one sitting task. It is meant to passively reward you as you battle monsters with your favorite class. Our next release window is Tuesday. Keep your fingers crossed! Also, the new Fishing system is going up for testing this weekend on the PTR too! Combined with the Tower of Necromancy and the Pyramids of the Sandsea desert, we have some great stuff coming your way.

Finally... because I am so bad at keeping secrets. If Gaz is in town square. What is in that spot where he used to be?

[b]Battle on!
Artix, Glisel, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

notes.title: Bow Crafting for Ranger!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bow_crafting/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ca459646efd29db18747a280b551f0c60a28754f.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]The world has been filled with new bows![/h1]
The world has been filled with new bows! Explore the world and craft unique bows with stats. Each one is themed from the land you create it in. The AdventureQuest 3D artists have spent the past few weeks working on these... they are beautiful, inspired, and available for you to earn in game now.
https://aq3d.com/news/bow_crafting/

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bow_crafting/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0060f2944f7ea92d62f6a1bb5282804312b4a1aa.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Where to find and craft these new bows?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Necrotic Bow[/b] - Doomwood - Stygis Crafting
[*] [b]Plunder Seeker[/b] - Lolosia - Lolosia Blacksmith
[*] [b]Arcane Recurve Bow[/b] - ArcanGrove - Arcangrove Sentinel
[*] [b]Winter's Arc[/b] - Frostval - Frostvale Village Crafting
[*] [b]Bloodsworn Bow[/b] - Darkovia Castle - Monster Stalker Crafting
[*] [b]Lycan Nightstalker[/b] - Darkovia Castle - Monster Stalker Crafting
[*] [b]Ironwood Bow[/b] - Darkovia Forest - Darkovia Forest Crafting
[*] [b]Shaman's Balanced Bow[/b] - World Tree - Soothsayer Crafts
[*] [b]Ninja Hankyu[/b] - Yokai Isle - Ninja Weapon Crafting
[*] [b]Living Branch Bow[/b] - Heartwood - Heartwood Ranger Gear
[*] [b]Guardian Bow[/b] - Guardian Tower - Fortes' Guardian Crafting
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bow_crafting/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/992ac634ae1ed58660bd4f585ce8a1378b6dabf2.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Necrotic Bow[/h2]
Talk to Stygis in Doomwood to craft this horrifying double stringed skull bow. Created by Thyton, the intention was for the arrow to shoot through the mouth of the skull. +100 bonus points for bow creativity.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bow_crafting/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ca60b70b32bb2da9ab69609a367818d189250297.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Plunder Seeker[/h2]
You are able to craft this pirate bow in the port town of Lolosia. Talk to the Black Smith there.  Using the pirate ship style ropes to hold the bow together, and a skull and cross bones hand guard comes from the creative mind of Dage the Evil.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bow_crafting/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2cdeaaf6317b39572a4d82f1d1195ae4c24ec958.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Arcane Recurve Bow[/h2]
Head to the mystical forest of ArcanGrove and find the Arcangrove Sentinel. They will teach you how to craft this magical bow. The hand guard is a magical shell like spell and the string is pure energy. Also created by Dage.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bow_crafting/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/767b393ffda2de64b5eaad0fcc9156ff660570dd.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Winter's Arc[/h2]
Travel to Frostval in the frozen north.... and find your way to the  Frostvale Village. There you can craft this bow made of wood and enchanted ice. Created by Winnie!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bow_crafting/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/406ea76fc1e2a5ad3b5d22082099d75fba89acc2.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Bloodsworn Bow[/h2]
Is it true that Vampire's suck at archery? I would not recommend finding out. The bat themed Bloodsworn bow can be found in Darkovia Castle. Look for the character that lets you do Monster Stalker Crafting. By Dage.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bow_crafting/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9326df5be1dfd5da23cae39b9cc24d65c47378fa.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Lycan Nightstalker[/h2]
The bow of choice for werewolves can also be crafted in Darkovia Castle. This feral bow is tough... and by the looks of it, requires Lycan strength just to pull. (Art by Dage)

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bow_crafting/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/39a5c02498a432576d299f060a56bdf439fbf50b.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Ironwood Bow[/h2]
Not a Vampire nor Werewolf (yet?) ... than you should seek out the Ironwood Bow.  You can craft it in Darkovia Forest. Now, you just need some silver arrows. (Art by Thyton.)

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bow_crafting/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3f3ee897ad7bb39f8fc15ec258bc17d3f40f8263.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Shaman's Balanced Bow[/h2]
If you are a Ranger who is walking the path of peace and balance, head to the World Tree to find the Shaman Bow. You can create it using  Soothsayer Crafts.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bow_crafting/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1aa7d4ddf7fe87349ff584ef452a4e2e71fe761c.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Living Branch Bow[/h2]
By far the nicest smelling of the bows in this release. Probably because this bow is living, covered with nature and flowers. Travel to Heartwood forest to craft the Living Branch Bow.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bow_crafting/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/788957bef00399f8ec4655f9a8279b6d71428776.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Ninja Hankyu[/h2]
Craft this infamous ninja bow on Yokai Isle through Ninja Weapon Crafting! (Art by Darkon)

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bow_crafting/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/87a46fb851a26651fb1a1d2cd7fc5d462dd10147.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Guardian Bow[/h2]
Guardians should report to the Fortes in the Guardian Tower to create their bow. It forced from the same metal used to create the Guardian Blades. (Art by Dage)

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bow_crafting/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/21cbd29bacbaf8a97f15d8045ee69a65c41974ef.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Rangers all wear green and have pointy ears, right?[/h2]
Nah, you have the freedom and control to be anything you want in AdventureQuest 3D. Nearly every player in this picture is a ranger! You control how your character looks and plays. Collect classes, items, and cross-skills, switch between them at any time.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bow_crafting/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ec14405b83a084511d63d7a90c30aab5a5a94343.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]More Adventure, Bows, and Features incoming![/h2]
The Ranger Class release has been getting rave reviews and we are hard at work making it even better. The artists have a second wave of bows coming including the Ashfall bow, the Death's Lair bow, and more. We are also working on the new fishing & trade-skill system, guilds, the Tower of Necromancy, the Sand Sea Desert, raising the max rank of classes with new rewards and titles, and the main storyline featuring the creatures of the Void. Keep your eyes on on the news at [url=aq3d.com]www.AQ3D.com[/url] for the latest official news!

[b]Battle on!

Artix, Glisel, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]
[b]
P.S.[/b] Have a favorite bow? Let the artist know on [url=https://www.artix.com/community/connect/]Twitter[/url] -- they are fueled by your positivity.

notes.title: Just released! RANGER CLASS
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ranger_release/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c083ec0fa060576ac98843cc90230f64bb1cb4b6.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Robina is waiting to train you as a Ranger in Greenguard Forest![/h2]
Our first bow class is finally here! Hop in game and talk to Robina to being your Ranger training. AdventureQuest 3D allows you to collect classes and switch between them at any time. Here's everything you need to know...
Read the original post at: https://aq3d.com/news/ranger_release/

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ranger_release/][h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ad0857d34d60f25f23a0733e3133c9f0f46710ab.jpg[/img][/h2][/url]
[h2]What is a Ranger?[/h2]
The Ranger class is a new Tier 1 class which exclusively uses bows. Rangers are cunning hunters, trackers, and guides who have found their calling outside the cities and villages of Lore. These agile adventurers wander the natural landscapes, bow in hand, learning the ways of the wild and living off the land. Each attack accumulates Focus that can be used to execute more powerful shots.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ranger_release/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a9c71814f78538911c53f8364471dda4ef26a461.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Ranger Skills[/h2]
This is a very versatile soloing class which can snare foes and rain arrows down upon them.
[list]
[*] Trapper's Instinct (Passive - 25% damage increase to immobilized creatures)
[*] Auto Shot (at 100 Focus, next shot will Critically hit and grant Swiftness)
[*] Empowered Shot (a single arrow that can pierce through multiple enemies in a line)
[*] Rain of Arrows (a volley of arrows that pierce through multiple enemies in the area of effect)
[*] Bloodthorn Trap (summon vines that Root and Poison all enemies that enter the area of effect)
[*] Arcane Archery (Ultimate - Arrows explode with arcane energy, granting extra focus per enemy caught in the explosion)
[*] Disengage (This is a Cross Skill which can be equipped with any class once unlocked - An evasion skill! Launch an arrow while leaping backwards to put some space between you and your foe)
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ranger_release/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0060f2944f7ea92d62f6a1bb5282804312b4a1aa.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Ranger Bows[/h2]
This week, you get your starter bow! It is the only bow available today in Robina's "Ranger Class Gear" shop. Next week... you will be able to craft new bows from around the world. Check what are artists made for you in this sneak peek Bow art post.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ranger_release/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/339695e96b1a3f9cb9ec343c86c3d2b4f2045ddc.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Bows -- a Ranger's best friend![/h2]
[b]Which one will be your BBF? (Best Bow Forever)[/b]
The Ranger class only uses bows. (Just like the Pirate class only uses pew pews.) So, when you switch to Ranger, your bow will be equipped automatically. We wanted to make switching between classes as easy as possible. Especially now that we have multiple classes that use unique weapons.... and are planning for more in the future.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ranger_release/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5b14802457dfa6f0c09cafd39fd84a0b39886dce.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]How to get Ranger Class?[/h2]
Robina is waiting to train you in Greenguard Forest! Start Ranger training with class quests and dailies, and turn in some of those class tokens to start building up your Ranger class gear!

How to travel to Greenguard Forest? Lots of options...
[list]
[*]  Just walk out of town... she is standing on the road.
[*]  Use the Adventure menu
[*]  Use the Travel map
[*]  Use the portal
[*]  Be super ultra lazy, have a friend there and use their summon code to portal to them XD
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ranger_release/][url=https://aq3d.com/news/bows_and_apple_login/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3574823357ac878dfa87f661a4d514991048ad1e.jpg[/img][/url][/url]
[h2]The "William Tell" Update[/h2]
[b]AdventureQuest 3D version 1.52.0 [/b]
This week's new game version includes Apple login, Bow support, and more.  We're calling it the "William Tell" release XD
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/bows_and_apple_login/]See what is new. [/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a0ca2a43ca68e70a136e18f6a397a62e7b68b2bb.jpg[/img]

[h2]Thank you... and good hunting![/h2]
We hope you love this new class. It is a pretty easy one to get, and a super fun one to play. Thank you for supporting AdventureQuest 3D's weekly updates. We have been making progress on the next adventure areas... keep your eyes for monster, item, and world previews! 

See you and your bow in game :D

Battle on!
Artix, Glisel, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: Undead Assault on Battleon... happening now!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battleon_undead_assault/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9c47be39120727e8f40eec2018225c15275df2fd.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Battleon's Social District is under siege by an army of undead![/h2]

Heroes! An army of the walking dead is attacking town! We have set up defenses on the bridge just outside the Social District. Join us... build catapults & defend barricades to protect our town from the undead assault!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battleon_undead_assault/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1f9a64821a8f5f8d2cfd798344d7ca46633201d6.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]BattleOn Defenders[/h2]

Talk to Defender Roland and Sarah Watterson (an NPC from the AQ3D Kickstarter). They just outside the social district of Battleon on the bridge.  They will aid you in your defense with armor set crafting and defensive equipment.
New Defender Armor Sets & Title

[list]
[*]     "Defender of Battleon" title (rank 30)
[*]     Lotus Defender (full set craft at ranks 25-28)
[*]     Lotus Siege (full set craft at ranks 25-28)
[*]     Siege Defender (loot drop)
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battleon_undead_assault/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/56dcf62fe12e7dce837b64e2606cb1b5476a3c6d.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Siege War 101[/h2]

The invading force attacks in waves. The waves will get tougher.... build up your defenses wisely. Survive each wave of monsters, collecting defender medals to rebuild barricades and prepare defenses, and equip pieces of the Siege Defender armor set along the way to better defend against the assault. For every barricade left standing at the end of the war, a Siege Chest will spawn for the heroes.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battleon_undead_assault/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b601c34e98147526fc691a2215b648b5cc002a64.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Collect Defender Medals[/h2]

Attacking monsters drop Defender Medals & other items to craft defenses. Grab em! Use them to buy extra help & weapons.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battleon_undead_assault/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/dff414de1627d0dc5660588448f90319376bdb7b.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Keep the undead out[/h2]

The undead cannot get past your barricades. Unless.... they destroy them. Which they can!  So protect the barricades, they are your main defense. Building more of them is the best way to increase the war meter.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battleon_undead_assault/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/26912ec8d17beef9d14e43159ba48426b17360e2.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Craft Defenses![/h2]

Blacksmith Sara Watterson has volunteered to provide you with defenses in this war. This includes cannons, catapults, and walls of fire! Use your defenders medals to purchase them and they will appear transparent on the map. Just click on where you want it to go and it will become a solid item. You can spawn Guardian allies at the teleportation pad which appears by the gate.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battleon_undead_assault/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/149eb1980202f30e2ffbafe30e318d570f86bf8e.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]You can build[/b]

    Barricade
    Catapult
    Flame Wall
    Guardian Golem
    Warrior Guardian
    Mage Guardian
    Rogue Guardian
    Cannonball

Note: You'll find your completed craft items and hired help waiting in your tokens inventory.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battleon_undead_assault/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/325fe4014139ec855a1d37a1ef1e1f493fc3dfe7.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Earn Defender Ranks[/h2]

Meet Roland in Battleon where he is recruiting heroes to defend our town from the undead. He also has Defender Rank quests and crafting for additional cosmetic armor sets. As you gain ranks as a siege defender you'll unlock new tiers of armor sets.

    Max Defender Rank increased to 30!
    Craft new Defender Armor sets
    You can craft all of the previous sets too!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/battleon_undead_assault/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bcb860b9dfa5561dbd70e4980da335613dfc660b.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Get Rewards! Siege Chests[/h2]

After a wave, you will get a siege Chest for each barricade left standing!

Head to the social district of town and head out the gate....

Defend our home from the undead assault...

[b]Battle on!

Artix, Glisel, & the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]


[b]P.S.[/b] Try not to get distracted by the giant Megalodon boss fight that you will have to pass on your way to the side gate.... (full disclosure, I stopped and fought him too)

As you read this, your fellow players and I are at war against monsters.

We need your help!

..because, that epic-quality ice cream cone wand reward ain't gonna lick itself.

No... what? No...

Because the WAR METER at the top of the screen is game-wide!

That's right.

Game. Wide. Event.

Every server and every "Pointe Less Isle" across the game is sharing that exact same war meter...

That meter's updated live.

Hop in the game. Do Annette's "fight things" quest on Pointe Less isle to score points and drive that meter forward for EVERYONE.

It will take the combined efforts of you and the rest of the AQ3D community to reach 100%

notes.title: Vote Kick!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/vote_kick/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e013d27641209c51c5a4006cfdde0f654ddca5fc.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The "Just for KICKS" one[/h2]
[h3]New in version 1.51.0[/h3]

The newest version of AdventureQuest 3D (allows you to punt away-from-keyboard players from your dungeon and more features including...

[h2]New Character Creation[/h2]
Who forgot to update the customization screen that new players get in character creation! We did X_X. But not any more! Not it has all the fancy pants bells and whistles that the barbershop one uses. Also, we moved around some buttons for players on those shiny new big screen phones with super wierd sizes and the weird widow's peak camera location.

[h2]Dungeon Vote Kick[/h2]
So there you are, in a public dungeon, about to take on ultra mega, super Dai Tengu.... and sure enough, that SAME PLAYER goes AFK on you for the millionth time!!! No more. The new vote kick system will allow you to punt them to make room for someone who is ready to swing their sword or cast their spells at your side.

[h3]How To?[/h3]

[list]
[*] Click on their portrait... and click on Vote Kick!
[*] Or, you can target them and type [i]/votekick <their character name>[/i]  into chat
[*] Or target a player and type [i]/votekick[/i]
[*] Available in public dungeons
[*] You can activate vote kick after 3 minutes as long as there are at least 4 players
[*] Vote kick requires 75% (rounded up) of player votes
[*] There are some anti-griefing measures
[*] This is a really good feature for the community, but, no doubt, someone will find a way to abuse it. When it does happen, their punishment will be swift, brutal and probably funny.
[/list]

[h2]New Ping System![/h2]
This feature was not near exciting enough to warrant that exclamation point. But we fixed that bonkers Lag Meter. Some times it seemed that meter has a mind of its own.  Rest assured your ping times are 68% more... um, pingy! (Note: This is not the lag fix that we are working on. But it will give you a far more accurate picture of what your latency really is.)

[h2]Live Event Shop Updated[/h2]
Did you hang onto those coins from the live events!? The live event shop has been updated. Check out the shop on Serenity in Yulgar's In.....

Wait.

What!?

Why are these live!?

I DID NOT FINISH ENTERING THE NAMES AND DESCRIPTIONS FOR THEM YET!

....they were supposed to go live with the content release later this week.

O_O

Oh man...

I, uh... oh man....

Excuse me.

I gotta get to work on those...

(Feel free to recommend names and descriptions for them in the comment section below)

notes.title: "Anything Goes" Live Events all Thursday!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/thursday_live_event/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7ea48f717fa202b65b434720731ea8d1687abcad.jpg[/img][/url]

UPDATE: This event has ended. Thank you to everyone who came. 

[h2]Join us in game at noon, 3pm, 6pm, & 9pm EST![/h2]
Hang out with Artix & the Team this Thursday in game!  Relax and have fun. We will be online every 3 hours to live spawning monsters, telling stories, and dropping treasure. 

All four of the events tomorrow are free, unscripted, live, and... really, truly, honestly, anything goes! (You were warned XD)

[h2]How do I join in![/h2]
Easy. Hop on AdventureQuest 3D at the following times. Keep a look out for Artix's red server-wide announcements which will tell you where the event is taking place.

    USA East Coast (EST / EDT) - Noon, 3pm, 6pm, 9pm (Our lab is here)
    USA West Coast (PST) - 9am, Noon, 3pm, 6pm
    Brazil (BRT) - 1pm, 4pm, 7pm, 11pm
    United Kingdom - 5pm, 8pm, 11pm, 2am
    France - 6pm, 9pm, Midnight, 3am
    Philippines - Midnight, 3am, 6am, 9am
    Australia - 2am, 5am, 8am, 11am

[h2]What to expect O_O[/h2]
If you have never been to one of these before, then... come join us for some fun. Get your screenshot key ready and expect lot of monsters, photo ops, and bizzare things you would never see happen in NORMAL game play. Artix & the AQ3D team will be talking through yellow text that appears at the top of your screen, and live spawning monsters to every room participating in the event. Sometimes the team will "re-broadcast" messages from players. You just need to be there. Periodically, Live Event Coin chests will be spawned. These contain super rare coins which can unlock some live-event only gear now... and soon, will be able to use live event coins to rank up some exclusive items.

It should be said... that these live events are somewhat dangerous. They are interactive and unscripted. So do not be too surprised if Artix makes his infamous typos revealing the staff-only commands or accidentally crashes the server for a bit (it's happened in the past.) Who cares? Let's just have fun :D

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e0f5c8c32ad127e74f8ca1279d2e2b4b3de5faef.jpg[/img]

Hey PC/Mac players! Want to help test the Nature Guardian Tower?

While you wait, the upcoming Nature Guardian Tower has just been released for testing on the PTR (AdventureQuest 3D's Public Test Server). Currently, this testing server is only accessible via STEAM. We are working to add Android and other devices for future tests. No matter how you look at it, more testing = good!  All testers will be able to enter and test the Nature Guardian Tower in HeartWood during this test on the PTR.

 
[h2]QUESTION![/h2]
Any special monster requests for Thursday's live event? Post them as a common on our official website post:

notes.title: Return to Pointe Less Isle
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/185f40dae01beeb902001be8d61fb6a76cf67b8d.png[/img]

[h2]It's almost Summer... let's go on vacation early![/h2]

You and all of your friends are hereby invited to a relaxing, sunny, and slightly monster-infested getaway at Pointe Less Isle!  Enjoy fishing, random monster spawns, new item drops, and crafting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4e26cc26b20f3f3481455c4a7f5b423d30142282.jpg[/img]

[h2]Random Boss Spawns[/h2]

The island is known for random boss monsters to appear.... and there are new drops and crafting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9a89718018be212033dc423fca0d6bc622255d15.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hey, these items seem kinda fishy to me![/h2]

"Fish ears, sword fishes, shark stuff and... hey! are you playing Koi with me?"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/959cc9ecc32ea4959162c6581340add7cb9018ed.jpg[/img]

[h2]Gone Fishing![/h2]

You can fish on the isle once you are  high enough rank.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3591da9c5d832ca4b0d6abf1d17a2b851821241a.jpg[/img]

Faith, the fishing trainer is on the isle now...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ae3181297b3c044ae5a87d8717614885d05b3f11.jpg[/img]

Oh yeah! You are going to need some serious fishing skills on the isle. Be sure to rank up your fishing in the Pirate Town of Lolosia first!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/80241ada26e2631991bee73a361e43800b5b8d2a.jpg[/img]

You can get to Pointe Less isle using your travel map, or by talking to Annette in town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/117ebedbeea9e24c5542368726feedf1f3de43f4.jpg[/img]

The isle is a place to chill. There are places to sit,  hang out, and many creative players come up with their own games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3cd4e3a036f9beda3f2bbe3b99f756e7297a7853.jpg[/img]

[h2]Brand New Items[/h2]

All of the new items in this release are drops or crafting that can be earned. We also returned the seasonal summer items.

[*]     Fish Ears

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/031db2b5e31bbc7fd63e40a51e6b41c95ad8bfe2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Have fun & Live Events next Thursday![/h2]

Have you ever been to one of our live events? A live event is when Artix or the other devs spawn monsters across the game during a live interaction with all the players online. It is pretty fun and often "anything goes". Sometimes we drop special treasure boxes too. Sometimes Artix tells stories. On Twitter last week, we figured out that we could hit almost every time zone if we did the live events at noon, 3pm, 6pm, and 9pm EST.  So we would love to give it a shot next Thursday. Hope to see you there!  I will do a post on you breaking down the times for different time zones early next week on the [url=https://www.aq3d.com]www.AQ3D.com[/url] website.
