notes.title: Call of Gloopy: Sewer Warfare
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sewer_warfare/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/146bd7b6317c0c1b3291edb556588b50be6e1e88.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Call of Gloopy: Sewer Warfare[/h1]

[b]A Player vs Parkour Challenge[/b]

Hop in the slime filled sewers for this team vs team parkour challenge.  You will be randomly placed on either the Jumper or Defender team. The jumpers have 10 minutes to find and activate three purple  valves somewhere in the sewer. But it won't be easy. The defenders are  there to mess with them by springing traps! At the end, everyone will be  teleported to a special boss fights that drops loot to craft rewards  with.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sewer_warfare/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/184a9f5ad50a5495101d17ae98c6025598391c88.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Go to to the sewers[/h2]

You will find the enterence to the sewers in the Scholar district of  the home town. You know, if you go past the port and go right-ish into that area where Warlic's magic shop and the Trainer Hall is.  There, you will find a sewer with a giant slime named Gloopy. Talk to it  to see the rewards and learn more.
Jumpers

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sewer_warfare/][strike][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/26a46e2f9ca8e22f8331ab1af471c63616cf48dd.jpg[/img][/strike][/url]

This parkour map features floating barrels, spinning gears, and all  kinds of new things never seen in previous challenges. The sewer splits  three ways. You and your team might want to split up and try to reach  the objective at the end of each path. Warning! This new map was created  by our most notoriously evil level designer. So expect to hit the  respawn button a lot! XD
Defenders

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sewer_warfare/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/60443f264a2bb7b4cea73fe12df4771bdc1deb77.jpg[/img][/url]

Do you dream of making other players cry? If you are randomly placed  on the Defenders team, you get to trigger traps. Activate valves to  trigger the traps. Pay close attention to the colors of the vales. It  gives a clue as to which trap it springs. You can also teleport around  to get in a better position to stop the jumpers.


[h2]Boss Fights & Rare Item Drops![/h2]

A match lasts 10 minutes. Then, everyone is teleported to boss  fights. The winning side gets better loot. Use the items these Boss  Monsters drop to craft special plumber armor and plunger weapons. Oh... I nearly forgot to mention the Rate item drops? The Boss fights at the end all have a chance to drop rare items.  They have a chance to drop regardless if you are on the winning side or not.

[b]These prizes include...[/b]
[list]
[*] The Golden Plumber Plunger
[*] Slerg's Rod
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sewer_warfare/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b3bd5ea7fd8a25ec60fe962fde30dc51b7fc3a32.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Glisel leveled up... and made you a gift for her birthday![/h2]

Head to Winnie's tailor shop in town to get the new outfits Glisel made for you... for her birthday.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a023f2b209f368a20655aa861508349bf92b8486.jpg[/img]

You know, it's storta mind-boggling that Artix Entertainment's  coordinator has been making these armors in her spare time for you. O_O Surprised by this, I did an interview with her for you.

https://aq3d.com/news/glisel_birthday/

[h2]How to get the items[/h2]

Get the Items at Winnie's Tailor Shop in town!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sewer_warfare/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/981a606ac84de898a873647d0e0ff8cfb5aeeebc.jpg[/img][/url]

There are two sets. The Green set is sold for gold in the "Glisel's Birthday Shop" tab,  while the purple and blue sets are in "Glisel's Birthday Crafts". To  craft them, you'll just need some dye and feathers.
Summer Sale!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sewer_warfare/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e5244aaf732fdbc699e3c0784ee44abcd4246bae.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]It is that time again. The Summer sale is back. [/h2]
Get 50% more DragonCrystals when you buy any package-- including Guardian.

[b]Wait... you just did a sale. What if I bought in between them?[/b]

No worries. We got your back. If you missed our previous sale and ordered before this one... we just went ahead and gave you the bonus too! This way no one misses out.
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/sewer_warfare/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/deadc76e743bc7d8bd51152b05f919a44d531f5d.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Art Sneak Peek[/h2]

tags.feature: Hop in the slime filled sewers for this team vs team parkour challenge. You will be randomly placed on either the Jumper or Defender team. The jumpers have 10 minutes to find and activate three purple valves somewhere in the sewer. But it won't be easy. The defenders are there to mess with them by springing traps! At the end, everyone will be teleported to a special boss fights that drops loot to craft rewards with.

You will find the enterence to the sewers in the Scholar district of the home town. You know, if you go past the port and go right-ish into that area where Warlic's magic shop and the Trainer Hall is. There, you will find a sewer with a giant slime named Gloopy. Talk to it to see the rewards and learn more.

This parkour map features floating barrels, spinning gears, and all kinds of new things never seen in previous challenges. The sewer splits three ways. You and your team might want to split up and try to reach the objective at the end of each path. Warning! This new map was created by our most notoriously evil level designer. So expect to hit the respawn button a lot! XD

Do you dream of making other players cry? If you are randomly placed on the Defenders team, you get to trigger traps. Activate valves to trigger the traps. Pay close attention to the colors of the vales. It gives a clue as to which trap it springs. You can also teleport around to get in a better position to stop the jumpers.

A match lasts 10 minutes. Then, everyone is teleported to boss fights. The winning side gets better loot. Use the items these Boss Monsters drop to craft special plumber armor and plunger weapons. Oh... I nearly forgot to mention the Rate item drops? The Boss fights at the end all have a chance to drop rare items. They have a chance to drop regardless if you are on the winning side or not.

notes.title: Wooden Stallion & Fixed Heartwood Challenge
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/wooden_stallion][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3596dadd15b2a4d247c09d7e63ff1e58b9b63e82.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Don't look a Wooden Gift Horse in the Mouth[/h2]
Join us in AdventureQuest 3D this week and Quest for the new Wooden Stallion travel form, play the Heartwood Hunt challenge, and earn the Cryptodirax armor and items!.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/wooden_stallion/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/37426896ed949b52be1feb3443177fc0b0f5b35f.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Wooden Stallion Travel Form[/h2]
Crafted from the living tress of Heartwood and given magical life through its magic. Want to make one? Find Audin the Travling Merchant in Heartwood. She has a new daily quest called "Gift Horse" to help you collect the ingredients needed to craft this 160% speed travel form.


[url=https://aq3d.com/news/wooden_stallion/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/20b74b4681dbde030aa0fce0ea4d2df16e35b195.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Fixed & Live! The Heartwood Hunt[/h2]
Finally, you can learn to become a behemoth hunter and earn the Cryptodirax armor and items. Of course, you will have to defeat the Cryptodirax-- which was bugged due to a glitch in one of the new gameplay features. We fixed it and its working now! Begin your adventure by talking to Drak in Heartwood forest. Where is he? Not far. When you enter HeartWood go left. You will see him under a canopy of yellow-leaved trees with a tiny cave behind him. Go into the cave to start the adventure!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heartwood_ruins_challenge/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/adb6058a56d9298da6b3e3ce21c8976adb04c80e.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Heartwood Hunt Items[/h2]
The Cryptodirax armor set can be built from the drops off the creature. Its stat power when it is crafted will be at your level minus one (minimum level 7). You can also purchase the Razorshell Turtle Pet from Drak.


[url=https://aq3d.com/news/kestral_maximus/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/07be793401080c35f711cbbfa54dc0eb6320cb89.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Daily Boss Maps Fixed[/h2]
Earn the Haximus set. Monsters on all Daily Boss maps are now behaving normally and arriving on time again.  And the Sunken Ship Challenge is poisonous once again. XD

Want to know why? Read the original post [url=https://aq3d.com/news/wooden_stallion/]here[/url].

[url=https://game.aq3d.com/account/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a0555e4af6b2a6e4b7205c465c425d4ff8fc48e0.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Less than One Week Left![/h2]
Just a heads up. There is only a week left in the DragonCrystal bonus "flash sale" thingy. Support the game by buying anything in AdventureQuest 3D and get 50% more bonus DragonCrystals. It is a crazy good deal. But it ends this Monday (May 4th, 2020).


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e1bc654e2d9520647a9a59d293d1b5df64e66085.jpg[/img]

[h2]Monday is "May the 4th be With you"[/h2]
This Monday is May 4th... and our yearly sci-fi/fantasy celebration of "May the 4th be with you" returns. We have a game wide monster hunt and a collection of parody items. Including one ridiculously oversized Black Samurai-looking Dark Lord helm. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/eaad2bbadc8f7b810986d8d40756c099eaeff243.png[/img]

[h2]Thank you and reminder...[/h2]
We hope you enjoy this Wooden Stallion and Cryptodirax release. Thank you for your all of your encouragement and support.

So, question for you... have you ever wanted to go treasure hunting in the Ancient Inverted Pyramids of the Sandsea Desert? Asking for a friend. XD

[b]- Artix, Glisel, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

notes.title: Become a Behemoth Hunter!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heartwood_ruins_challenge/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/20b74b4681dbde030aa0fce0ea4d2df16e35b195.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Become a Behemoth Hunter![/h1]

Find Drak, the Behemoth Hunter, in Heartwood Forest. He has two adventures where he'll teach you the ropes. Literally. Learn how to build a crafting table, create traps, and bait the Razorshell River Turtle in a special challenge adventure with new rewards including pets and a full epic quality set of Cryptodirax items.... including that cool back shell item in the pic far below!
https://aq3d.com/news/heartwood_ruins_challenge/

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heartwood_ruins_challenge/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e2b71a5e963becb8b116e1b3e80a59cbfcba82f5.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]A Craft & Hunt Challenge[/h2]

Once you have mastered the basics, gather a party and use what you learned to take on the giant Cryptodirax in the Heartwood Forest Challenge. Plus, unlock a new stat armor set to craft and the Razorshell Turtle Pet!
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heartwood_ruins_challenge/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b85f481d458d6ad33766969af85b12bbbcda652e.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Hey Elite Players! You won't blast through this release in 10 minutes... promise.[/h1]

This is a very fun and fair new challenge map. It was created for you by Llussion. He has a long history of adding new gameplay mechanics in his maps... and all of us on the staff who are testing it fell in love with this release. Hope you do to.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heartwood_ruins_challenge/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d23103fa0e06d246f8177d19c994536c6ffde553.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Drak, the Behemoth Hunter[/h2]

You'll find Drak in Heartwood Forest under a canopy of yellow-leaf trees. He's eager to show you how to become a behemoth hunter. You can also visit unlock the epic Cryptodirax Armor set (with stats!) to craft and the Razorshell Turtle Pet after completing the dungeon.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heartwood_ruins_challenge/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/adb6058a56d9298da6b3e3ce21c8976adb04c80e.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Cryptodirax Armor Set w/ Stats[/h2]

The new items in Heartwood drop around your power level... including the new Cryptodirax set.  When crafting the pieces, they will complete at your level minus one, with a minimum of level 7. So, if you are currently level 30, it will be level 29. BUT if you are under level 7, it will be level 7 because that is the minimum.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2aa42a0a6487f8c1c4a154ca19f25b932c786a0f.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Heartwood Forest Dungeon[/h2]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heartwood_ruins_challenge/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2aa42a0a6487f8c1c4a154ca19f25b932c786a0f.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Drax's tutorial mission[/b]

In the dungeon, Drax will show you how to hunt behemoths. There are new skills to learn like chopping trees for wood to create a crafting table, and learning how to make the docile Razorshell River Turtle become hostile to fight it by using bait and traps. This acts as the tutorial for the challenge where you're on your own. You must be at least level 7 to enter the dungeon.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heartwood_ruins_challenge/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b85f481d458d6ad33766969af85b12bbbcda652e.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]The Heartwood Forest Challenge[/h2]

Gird your loins, because this one is a real challenge. The Heartwood Forest Challenge takes the basics of the dungeon tutorial and applies them on a grand scale to the giant Cryptodirax, a type of Razorshell Turtle. You'll see this creature coming as it crashes through the trees, but you can't fight it while it's docile. You must use the skills you learned in the dungeon on this real behemoth of a turtle. Stock up on traps and bait. If you can't hold its aggro, it will run away and you'll have to track it down again. It may take a few tries to get a hang of this one, but it's worth it. You need the drops from the Cryptodirax to craft the Cryptodirax Armor with stats.
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heartwood_ruins_challenge/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e749122d9ca010052670c176c7a07562561925f8.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Rogues now Duel Wield and other things improved this week![/h2]

[list]
[*] Rogues now Dual Wield
[*] New, improved, Eclipsion Travel Form animation
[*] Skeletons got an art upgrade
[*] Class Images (in your class menu) Updated
[*] We fixed a lot of stuffs too!
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heartwood_release/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/81869d508f1d2d4d7e6ca1c9c9af77332e2e714b.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]What is HeartWood?[/h2]

If you are just joining us... HeartWood is the new saga in AdventureQuest 3D. Read the full post on HeartWood forest here.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/flashsale2020/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a0555e4af6b2a6e4b7205c465c425d4ff8fc48e0.jpg[/img][/url]


[h2]50% More DragonCrystals with any in-game purchase[/h2]

A great way to support our ongoing releases with a huge bonus... reload and get 50% more bonus DragonCrystals when you buy ANY package in AdventureQuest 3D. You only have until May 4th, 2020.

[h2]Begin your adventure and become a Behemoth Hunter![/h2]

[h2]Join us in AdventureQuest 3D! Just released...[/h2]
400+ female belts fixed, new Daily Boss Fight rewards (Krestal Wing and Kestral Talon) with stats, new daily treasure chest rewards (Haximus), Heartwood improvements and more.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/kestral_maximus/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4986a3bdf170f57f47c3b71fd0bbe295d3fe80a2.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Kestral Wing Set[/h2]
Get the 1st Daily Boss fight rewards that come with stats & power! Use the Daily Boss Trophies you earn and take them to Cysero to craft these new items. Dage created two sets to help us introduce this functionality.

[b]Kestral Wing Set Includes...[/b]
[list]
[*] Kestral Wing Armament (Sword & Shield)
[*] Kestal Wing Armor

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/kestral_maximus/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5f6a0ff2a3a0855ca3f470b2618ddc99e53e6b0a.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]New Daily Treasure Chest Login Rewards[/h2]
[i]"Come back with your shield, or on it, or under it. But bring that sucker back... it's gold!"[/i]

Every day you log into AdventureQuest 3D, you get a treasure chest filled with loot. Open it to score some new gear including the new HAXIMUS set!  Designed by Thyton, this set fuses Spartan, Warrior, and Epic.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/kestral_maximus/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/669b9706a0c401bf79f73bfc133238688fe412ba.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]A worthy way for Hero stuff to go[/h2]
1 Shirt = 1 Adult & 1 Child Mask.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e0f5c8c32ad127e74f8ca1279d2e2b4b3de5faef.jpg[/img]

[h2]HeartWood, Belts & Other Areas got a ton of fixes & improvements[/h2]
Thank you for all of your bug  reports! The bulk of time this week for our coders and map building team was resolving all those weird issues that materialized last week. The entire team has been working from our homes for over a month now-- and we sure have been overcoming some new game dev challenges in the process. I am really proud of the team's relentless effort on the game and hope these fixes keep your adventuring smooth and fun!

[b]Major fixes include...[/b]
[list]
[*] BELTS! Every belt (400+) in the game was manually resized for female characters.
[*] HeartWood Forest (Lots of fixes)
[*] Darkovia Castle
[*] Vengeance Bow's Challenge Dungeon
[*] Path of Fire in Yokai Forest 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a0555e4af6b2a6e4b7205c465c425d4ff8fc48e0.jpg[/img]

By popular player demand... reload and get 50% more bonus DragonCrystals when you buy ANY package in AdventureQuest 3D this week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c39b8e22c0823ead1dc0e83a84263b5e991ae91f.jpg[/img]

We have a lot of great content and features coming your way in AdventureQuest 3D. Please check the design notes I post for you on www.AQ3D.com for the latest. A lot of players have been asking for more powered gear and story-- so that is what we will be working on. Check out the new daily boss fight rewards that come with stats and let us know what you think. Of course, we KNOW those of you who already hit 30 are eager to get your hands on some REAL level 30 gear! Will have that coming your way soon too. But first, HeartWood has a new challenge for players of all levels by Llussion coming, and also the 1st Guardian Tower will be in the that forest too. On the horizon we have the Tower of Necromancy, the Paladin Temple, the Darkovia Saga, Carnax, the Pyramids of the Sand Sea, Guilds, Player Houses, PvP, new classes and more... (and we better fix some of the early game stuff pronto!) Thank you for being a part of AdventureQuest 3D's growing story.

notes.title: New Heartwood Forest Saga & Level Cap Raised
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heartwood_release/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/eaad2bbadc8f7b810986d8d40756c099eaeff243.png[/img][/url]
[h1]NEW! The Heartwood Forest Saga is LIVE[/h1]
[h3]The level cap has been raised and this release is for ALL players[/h3]
Journey to the NEW Heartwood forest. Can you defeat the VoidKnight and protect the next Mystic of Heartwood? Featuring new loot, new cinematic, new music, new quest types (escort and knockout), the 1st of the VoidKing's villains, and the level cap has been increased to 30. You asked for more "Dragons of Ashfall" quality stories and adventure... here we go!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heartwood_release/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e54404f395c9947e5d8b7d647f92f622c958598e.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Story[/h2]
Something is terribly, terribly wrong in Heartwood forest.  Creatures are corrupted, and even the plant life has become dangerous. Meet the Guardians and find Reed, the boy chosen to be the next Mystic of Heartwood. Can you protect the boy from the VoidKnight and his minions as completes his Mystic trials?

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heartwood_release/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c39b8e22c0823ead1dc0e83a84263b5e991ae91f.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]New Villain![/h2]
Face Omen, the VoidKnight. The VoidKing ordered this champion into Heartwood Forest to prevent what will happen if Reed becomes the next Mystic.


[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heartwood_release/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/aa4c1c9a28f3055a6c6baf21a6ac2dc0e7947e1b.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]New Monsters & New Quest Types...[/h2]
The VoidKing's minions have been spotted in Heartwood. Which will make our new quest types even more dangerous.

[list]
[*] Escort Quests
[*] Put monsters to sleep" Quests
[/list]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ep7mXiXlUC4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/95d3a30971f943ce576efba2e9408dbfc4841801.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Heartwood Trailer[/h2]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ep7mXiXlUC4]Watch the HeartWood Trailer video on YouTube[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/fcd496874697aba546518c9a06079ab9c93e9a04.jpg[/img]
[h2]The Guardians[/h2]
The Guardians mission here is one of the utmost importance. They know what is at stake... and something went wrong. Now, it will be up to you.

....also, there are rumors of a a lost Guardian tower somewhere within this forest.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heartwood_release/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5fb201ed7fa92685b36be602c1755295f7417887.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Cinematic Cutscenes[/h2]
AdventureQuest 3D's animators Korin and Xentry went above and beyond for heartwood. Every cinematic adds to the grandeur and excitement of the new Heartwood map and story. You've never seen action and story telling in AQ3D quite like this.
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heartwood_release/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/06c044dcf7603e63d763875a7910bbe4bcc157da.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]2 new music scores by Jongaar[/h2]
Jongaar's new soundtracks for Heartwood are like Bardic Inspiration. It captures the awe and wonder... yet makes you also want to charge into battle. Please feel free to do both.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heartwood_release/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b9963424d44b534b86dfe4a652ce3386b2115c0d.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Auden, the Traveling Merchant[/h2]
Auden the traveling merchant carries supplies to the Guardians out on missions. She's capable and she's seen a lot on her travels, but she's a trader, not a fighter. Give her a hand and she'll provide new stat-based items for you to craft!


[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heartwood_release/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e91d793a1c2dda14172cdad8daa720eabb1602ab.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]New Craftable Items... with stats![/h2]
The new items have stats and will craft at a power near your level.

    Wooden Warrior Set
    Heartwolf Hunter Set
    Heartwood Ranger Set
    ...and more

 
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/heartwood_release/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e0f5c8c32ad127e74f8ca1279d2e2b4b3de5faef.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Play Heartwood in AQ3D[/h2]
Take your first step into the NEW HeartWood Forest...

We really hope you enjoy this new AdventureQuest 3D story. It is now available for you and all players. Heartwood is a completely new area & story. Head there using the travel crystal, your travel map, or simply walk there from Greenguard! The entire team put their heart and soul into this release... I am really proud of their work, and after you play it, I hope you agree. This is the kind of storytelling AdventureQuest 3D deserves!

The level cap has been raised to 30.

[b]Battle on!
Artix & your friends at AdventureQuest 3D[/b]

notes.title: Top 15 Things to do in AdventureQuest 3D right now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bcfe72fce255be05dff50d59b97343cca35b147d.png[/img]

"Greetings and salutations! With so many new and returning faces in the game, we thought you might find this list handy. See you in game" - Artix

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/48645a19928c32fac730b2eaa6433bd22373e344.jpg[/img]

[h2]#1 Go to the ENCORE and earn the new Travel Form![/h2]

Encore! The virtual concert with Breaking Benjamin has been revived and extended. Join us in game \now for non-stop shows with rewards for players of all levels. Just head to town and use the portal.

[b]Rewards[/b]

[list]
[*] Eclipsion Travel Form!
[*] Quest to create a free Collection with 50+ items, travel forms, and more
[*] "Far Away" Badge & Title
[*] Virtual Selfie with the band
[*] ...there is a title that unlocks if you fall off a platform XD
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/23c24e5acb123b0e2b6e7f724324576c65a75e76.jpg[/img]

[h2]#2 Earn the Death Caster Set in the Arena of Souls[/h2]

High level players should head to the underworld and take on this level 20+ challenge. Battle the Devourer of Souls and craft the new Death Caster set with those amazing blue wings.

[b]Rewards[/b]

[list]
[*] Death Caster Wings
[*] Death Caster Scythe
[*] Death Caster Armor Set
[*] All of the previous Undead Legion items from the Arena of Souls
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b749187db70c271d5efa9453d0e892cfe02a097d.jpg[/img]

[h2]#3 Beat the Friday the 13th Challenges[/h2]

Last chance! Venture to our horror sleepaway camp and learn the legend of Shrade. Do the short storyline and then, if you are brave, take on the two challenge dungeons....

[b]Dungeons & Rewards[/b]
[list]
[*]Shrade X: Get some friends and enter the sunken otherworldly ship in the middle of the lake with friends.
[*] Fleshette: Enter the dreamworld and try to defeat Fleshette. Turn in the pieces of memory and dreams you collect on the way to craft your own Fleshette armor and weapons.
[*]Don't forget to pick up your winning "Blue Skulls" team back flag
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/91ebee569fdfe3dafc9518637d7ada41814a18e3.jpg[/img]

[h2]#4 Beat all of the Parkour Maps[/h2]

Find and solve all of the jumping challenges hidden across the game. Each one unlocks a special title & badge.

[list]
[*] Box Springs - Near Fort Sneed in Greenguard Forest
[*] The Mouse Hole - Look for a small mouse hole In Yulgar’s Inn
[*] Alata’s Cavern - In the Mushmen area of the Dragon Graveyard
[*] Salire Draco - Defeat the Dragonslayer storyline in Ashfall and you will unlock this challenge and you can access this right of the Dragon's lair.
[*] Underworld Parkour - Enter the underworld and go to the Underworld Gate. This one has SKULL LAZERS O_O
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9408f7dde3075b5598bde4b367152f565dd2cd61.jpg[/img]

[h2]#5 Do the Daily Boss Fight Challenge[/h2]

Hop on to fight the Boss Monster of the day. Just go to any of the Quest Boards or the Town Portal to jump right in.

[list]
[*] Item rewards are now good for you no matter what your level!
[*] Craft special items from each boss.
[*] Earn a Daily Boss Trophy. Each one earned gets you closer to an awesome new armor piece or weapon from Cysero’s Forge.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a4d0ecf4789b1fa06e6ff0377fd5eeb3309ac9d7.png[/img]

[h2]#6 Do Winnie's New Tailor Shop Quests[/h2]

You can find Winnie's NPC in Battleon at her market stall by Yulgar's Inn. She's dedicated to helping you find the right clothes to fit your personal style.

[list]
[*] The Garment Shop has a beautiful Fortune-Hunter armor set ready to purchase for gold.
[*]  Run some quests to help Winnie gather materials for two additional unique armor sets and a new sword!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/91ca7fffb70507c9f2fabe9c501ce103d7b9e1e5.jpg[/img]

[h2]#7 Get your Daily Login Reward[/h2]

Only takes a few seconds to pop on and get your daily reward. We'll never reset your progress. So you just keep making progress towards the big shiny chests.

[list]
[*] New armor pieces and weapons
[*] Free DCs
[*] Pet Feed to earn a pet of your own!
[*] Treasure Shards to help you get exactly what you want
[*] Temporary travel forms (consumables)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/275a6b356bb7e65d60daf47e8d4e91aa553a054c.jpg[/img]

[h2]#8 Get "a head" at the House of Oddities[/h2]

Wander to the left in town to find the Social District. There, you will find a little oddities shop... with quests and highly unusual items for your head.

[list]
[*]  Buy and Quest for Ridiculous/Fun cosmetic items
[*]  Have your fortune told by Madame Astra
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b9364f6760f908491ff42103f596bc7147b8c561.jpg[/img]

[h2]#9 Adopt a Pet[/h2]

Talk to Aria at the Pet Shop. She has lots of cute and terrifying creatures to adopt!
[list]
[*]  Earn a pet by collecting Pet Feed from treasure chests or daily quests
[*]  Buy pets and the Pet Handler armor set
[*]  Quest for the Master Crate and a feline friend
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a91c1afe78b79e526d6e29dc0744471bed160d07.jpg[/img]

[h2]#10 Get the "Dagger Killed Me" Title[/h2]

Dagger is the AdventureQuest 3D's game dev responsible for the most BRUTAL and deadly dungeons. You will receive the “Dagger Killed Me” title when you fall prey to one of his special traps in the “Daitengu’s Bamboo Forest” challenge on Yokai Island. Of course, you can also beat the Daitengu boss challenge to collect his Katana, Armor, and Wings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5f4f0db36fd22e20e107731c70408cc07f04e4f6.jpg[/img]

[h2]#11 The Bank[/h2]

Go to the bank and open an account... stop a bank robbery, and quest into giant vaults filled with gold.

[b]REWARDS[/b]

[list]
[*]  Free Bank Vault
[*]  Key Staffs (Because Key Swords were taken) and other rewards
[*]  "Valued Bank Customer" title XD
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d55b7becac893722ec0de82036b23bd6122cfdb2.jpg[/img]

[h2]#12 Get the Legendary "A Frogzard ate my head" helm[/h2]

Want to walk around being perpetually eaten by a Frogzard? We don't judge. But this is an EXTREMELY rare drop. You only have a teeeeny, tiny, near impossible chance of it dropping off the Mommazard.

[b]REWARDS[/b]

[list]
[*] "A Frogzard ate my head" Helm
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b6b3a8f13083ced44156a1d22b0256768eb22cb1.jpg[/img]

[h2]#12 Part II, the Sequel! Beat around the Bush[/h2]

Transform into a... Bush? If you are looking for a special item that has a 100% chance to drop and is funny as heck, find the path to that giant evil tree with all the puns near Greenguard forest. Then search around that tiny grove for a hidden box.

[b]REWARDS[/b]

    [list]
[*] Bush Travel Form (It moves at 1% speed)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5e6089ae16c265301419614f26099ac2f52443bb.jpg[/img]

[h2]#13 Revisit the original Heartwood forest before it gets replaced[/h2]

With the new Heartwood forest coming very soon, this is your last chance to see one of the oldest maps in the game before it is replaced. The new Greenguard will be larger, more beautiful, and feature 1st of the Void King's villains, cinematic cutscenes, and new gear for everyone, and more.

[b]REWARDS[/b]
[list]
[*] Nostalgia
[*]  See why we need to update it so badly! XD
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/33195fd3769b9dd8f1634ba1358c1a32574c3dc0.jpg[/img]

[h2]#14 Reach Max Level[/h2]

Ding! Hit level 29 and get access to the most powerful items in the game in addition to the bragging rights. This will also get you ready for when the level cap rises to 30.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/eba463222fd0024d056a5ee98640dc8714fea39c.jpg[/img]

[h2]#15 Unlock All of the Classes[/h2]

You can unlock every class and switch between them whenever you want. We are currently building more, but while you wait...

[b]Classes[/b]
[list]
[*] Necromancer - Summon undead minions to fight for you
[*] Paladin - Group Heals
[*] Berserker - Duel wield!
[*] Ninja - Switch jutsu's to switch skills
[*] Pirate - First class to use duel pistols... pew pews!
[*] Moglomancer - Battle using the power of adorable little Moglins
[*] Warrior - Everyone's favorite meat shield
[*] Rogue - Probably behind you right now.
[*] Mage - One word. FIREBALL!
[*] Guardian - Magical Dragon Knight (Reward for supporting the game with Guardian)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c63f2f15d89e46e909b9a6280b0ef0e6d2aa62d8.jpg[/img]

More coming soon...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/388ad0abe637edf7fa4960c4283699aacc7f0dfc.jpg[/img]

(BONUS) #16 Help Other Players!

Already done all of the above. Then you are the most elite of the elite. So now it is your duty to help out the new players. Share your wisdom, secrets, and guide new friends on

[b]REWARDS[/b]

[list]
[*]Being Awesome
[*]Feeling good about yourself
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e35d41a8e7a2a00db45404fd83b1ac4ee34c5db2.jpg[/img]

Thanks to GoldRaven for helping with this list. Check out his [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCdj4aQgApS5xhpBLqViahTA]YouTube channel[/url] for some tips on how to do a lot of these.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bc2777e5686c35f02f3a37f9672797cb870de1c1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hope you found this post useful![/h2]

Did we miss any rewards or things players should know about? Let us know in the comments or send a tweet to [url=https://twitter.com/artixkrieger/]Artix's Twitter[/url] with a screenshot and details so he can retweet you. Also, if you have not gotten [url=https://aq3d.com/news/dage_collection_2020/]Dage's Undead Legion 2020 Collection[/url] yet, there is still time.

notes.title: Equip Best!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8cfa96548dcb85f597e9d69a3bf311aa52a795b4.png[/img]
[h2]You can now equip your best gear with one click![/h2]
In this weeks new AdventureQuest 3D update, we added a new stat to your items... POWER! It's really helpful. Power is a single number that represents how powerful an sword, armor, or other item is. You're probably going to want to equip all of your most powerful weapons to do the most damage, have the best defense, and the biggest critical hits. So we also added an "EQUIP BEST" button (Pro move Rabblefroth!)

Original post at: https://aq3d.com/news/equip_best/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/86ef76fc66e116e458df4a2b9ee398ecb311c1ab.jpg[/img]
[h2]Have you seen the Equip Best button yet?[/h2]
Go to your inventory, then choose the second tab. That is the one that shows you all of the items you have equipped.

Press the Equip Best button and it will automatically equip all of your most powerful gear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c85a5534810ff23048922a8358b6918bc60138ee.jpg[/img]
[h2]But my character does not wear Helmets/Capes/Gloves/etc[/h2]
No problem! You can get invisible cosmetic items at Warlic's Magic Shop. How does it work? Wear the invisible helm as a cosmetic and it will make it look like you are not wearing a helmet! Same for the other pieces. Except for your body armor. There is no invisible body armor. We do not want to lose that T for Teen rating O_O

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/86ef76fc66e116e458df4a2b9ee398ecb311c1ab.jpg[/img]
[h2]Seeing your Power Level[/h2]
You can see your current power level in the equipped items tab of your inventory. We know. >_> Really weird that it is only there. So we are going to also put it on your character profile and also for other players when you inspect them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/12f4b9d8b7b3a594ecffc59fc2f904c676027d2a.jpg[/img]
[h2]Most Power = Best Item.... is this true 100% of the time!?[/h2]
Not necessarily. Your items still have all of their original stats. Close examination may lead you to discovering ways to get certain stats way higher. Which means you might be able to get even higher damage with items that have a lower rating.  But for casual players, the new item power stat will let you quickly determine if a new item is better and should be equipped.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4f1dbab8b5a541951af49dea67fbc61b43e21386.jpg[/img]
[h2]Listening to Feedback & Improvements Coming[/h2]

Thanks for all of the feedback so far. The next version of coming soon-- We already added levels to items that were too high to be used, and also changing the oddly labeled "sword" to the more correct "melee weapon". Also, there is a bug where your average power is lower than it should be. This is because it is factoring in your pet... and all pets currently have a power of 0.... /facepalm. If you see anything else, let us know. We will be releasing another new update with fixes before HeartWood goes live.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c32fd1e198505ffdf8839d121f84a7867899a35e.jpg[/img]
[h2]Daily Boss Fights now dropping items that are good for you![/h2]
Try out the Daily Boss fights. You should find that the item rewards are now good for your level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/86f957bb2d5f5b4cdfe84c002d3277e8bc44e591.jpg[/img]
[h2]Its over 200[/h2]
[b]There are so many things wrong this this picture.... LOL[/b]
First, you can see I literally wrote the design notes while talking in chat. (Which is actually kinda cool) Second, why am I level 50 with an average power of only 207!? XD Third... how do I have more items in my inventory than I have room for?

Who cares.

Hit that equip best button and let us know the answer to the following question...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8cfa96548dcb85f597e9d69a3bf311aa52a795b4.png[/img]
[h2]What's your current Average Power?[/h2]
Can you beat my score of 207? XD Comment here, or on the official post at https://aq3d.com/news/equip_best/ or tweet me at [url=https://twitter.com/artixkrieger/]@ArtixKrieger[/url] on Twitter.

tags.feature: In this weeks new AdventureQuest 3D update, we added a new stat to your items... POWER! It's really helpful. Power is a single number that represents how powerful an sword, armor, or other item is. You're probably going to want to equip all of your most powerful weapons to do the most damage, have the best defense, and the biggest critical hits. So we also added an "EQUIP BEST" button (Pro move Rabblefroth!)
Press the Equip Best button and it will automatically equip all of your most powerful gear.

You can see your current power level in the equipped items tab of your inventory. We know. >_> Really weird that it is only there. So we are going to also put it on your character profile and also for other players when you inspect them.

notes.content:

[h3]Town just got a whole lot happier & brighter[/h3]
Winnie's tailor booth just opened in town with new items, new quests, new crafts, and a new shop. Also, the camp war has been won! Grab your rare victory back flag for the impossibly high price of... uh, 0 gold!?

[h2]There's a new face in Battleon![/h2]

[h3]Our home town just got brighter & happier today[/h3]

Winnie is a Seamstress Extraordinaire who is looking to put you into something Amazing! Visit her market stall in Battleon for gold items and crafting sets.

[list]

[h2]Winnie[/h2]
If her name sounds familiar, that's because she is a real life AdventureQuest 3D artist! Her most recent work in a release was the majority of the Heroes Heart items, including the adorable pink Moglin and Vampragon pets. Her inspiration comes from her own real life wardrobe, her cosplays... and from you, the players! Recently she asked Twitter what kind of sets you'd like to see in AQ3D and she received a wide range suggestions she's excited to incorporate.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/winnie_npc_shop/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ed6e35fcdf071aec1ca376f3ea13c14cc107d64a.jpg[/img]
[/url]
[h2]The Shop[/h2]

You can find Winnie's NPC in Battleon at her market stall by Yulgar's Inn. She's dedicated to helping you find the right clothes to fit your personal style.  The Garment Shop has a beautiful set ready to purchase for gold. Looking for something that's tailored to your style? There are also Sewing Quests to bring her the items she needs to make Fashion Crafts or Tailoring Dyes... you know, to fit your aesthetic.

[*] Frontier Scout Wrap (back)
[*] Frontier Scout Gloves
[*] Frontier Scout Boots
[*] Frontier Scout Gunbelt (belt)
[*] Frontier Scout Outfit (armor)
[*] Imperial Alchemist Robes (armor)
[*] Imperial Alchemist Gloves
[*] Imperial Alchemist Footwear
[*] Imperial Alchemist Belt
[/list]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/winnie_npc_shop/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/86259824e20d17dce1b7c9495a616263c9e7b2c7.jpg[/img][/url]

We believe skulls are an evergreen type fashion. They sorta go with everything.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/winnie_npc_shop/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/996ad568038522bbcb2c2bc512aa18080b707694.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]See!?[/h2]

Give Winnie a warm welcome in the comments or on Twitter  and let her know how much you like her shop!

[h3]Coming later this week...[/h3]
 sneak peek of the new monsters in the upcoming Heartwood Forest (Which has sooooo too many cutscenes. Thanks & good luck animating those Korin and Xentry!)

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/winnie_npc_shop/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/272301fb80a898473383c8fa51414736d39e8cf4.jpg[/img][/url]

Get Dage's most incredible creations yet, and the warm and fuzzy feeling of knowing that you are supporting our weekly video game updates.

https://aq3d.com/news/dage_collection_2020/

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/winnie_npc_shop/]
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/screenshot_saturday_friday13th/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/59d7961aea37cde6f26aca05a34f9c957eaee40e.jpg[/img][/url][/url]

notes.title: Dage Returns + Craft the Twisted Horror Travel Form
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/crafttwistedhorror/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0e8090a935c0e11bb2f7616639e208569b0903fb.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Craft 3 new horrifying Travel Forms & a new Pet[/h2]
Less than one week left in the[url=https://www.artix.com/breakingbenjamin] Breaking Benjamin battle concert[/url]! Craft the 3 new travel forms & new pet while you still can. Talk to that little green Sneevil, Bryce Platinum, near the inn in town to get started. Also, Dage's seasonal rares have returned.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/crafttwistedhorror/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/dbcfeb85fcb0565047142dbe99d87447a20e6420.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Yes, these items are for EVERYONE to craft[/h2]
Use your [b]Heavy Metal Medallions[/b] to craft these three travel forms and a pet based on the void monsters from the [url=https://www.artix.com/breakingbenjamin]Breaking Benjamin battle concert[/url]. Everyone can earn these travel forms and pet. Want to skip the grind? Choose "Buy Now" to get these items for Dragon Crystals instead.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/breakingbenjaminbattleconcert/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1984286ad67034da782254067808eebb14ebfb65.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/breaking_benjamin_ss/][b]Screenshot by Civ[/b][/url]

[h2]The Concert Items May Return[/h2]
The monsters and map used in this special event are actually from a future release. A really smart idea to have this and all future battle concerts in areas that we are building for the main storyline-- so nothing is wasted. So you can get the items from this event now, before the game's storyline returns here. We have talked about this before. Wanted to put this reminder here that items from this event may return. We will be careful to make sure that the best of them are harder to obtain next time around.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/crafttwistedhorror/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/dadde0fb439e829d96202a7071e51456266a84bf.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Dage Returns[/h2]
The seasonal rares have returned... get any pieces you missed before the release of the new 2020 Undead Legion collection next week!

[url=https://heromart.com/collections/dage-dark-birthday-shop][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ee50d2eafd8662b980c5c6628ee8d801eff10b92.png[/img][/url]

Plus! The limited return of the two-sided Legion Undersworn and Oathkeeper shirts with rewards for AdventureQuest Worlds and AdventureQuest 3D. Let everyone know your soul belongs to Dage the Evil with the merch from [url=https://heromart.com/collections/dage-dark-birthday-shop]Dage's Dark Birthday Shop[/url]. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/dage_fanart_contest/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/828c2f7e575b3c30af846184cd6af0d6e3a0036b.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Enter the Art Contest[/h2]
Are you the creative type with a taste for the dark side? Enter the Dage & the Undead Legion art contest. Create original artwork and submit it by March 31st, 2020... winners will receive prizes and one Grand Prize Winner will receive a personalized gift from Dage himself. See for yourself...

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/dage_fanart_contest/]Dage Art Contest 2020[/url]

[url=https://www.artix.com/breakingbenjamin][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d39077dd4d4fff555d0ba9178b2566a20cd9d548.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Less than one week left![/h2]
The [url=https://www.artix.com/breakingbenjamin]Breaking Benjamin battle concert[/url] ends this Sunday... this is your last chance to experience the event. Be sure to craft all of the items including the Titan armors and the new travel forms & pet.

[url=https://aq3d.com/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5e5e4d6889b71aa07921f0ff3f18376940f3fbae.jpg[/img]
[/url]
[h2]Thank you and coming next![/h2]
We hope you enjoyed the [url=https://www.artix.com/breakingbenjamin]Breaking Benjamin battle concert[/url]. In the background we have been hard at work on the next AdventureQuest 3D release including HeartWood which will pit you against Vane the Void King's 1st General. Also we are building a new system that will let you get amazing power item drops at any level. We are working on interactive pets, new quest types, and whole lot more.

See you in game!

[h3]Battle on!
Artix, Glisel, & the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/h3]

notes.title: Breaking Benjamin Battle Concert is happening now!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.artix.com/breakingbenjamin][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/eb242e9ef106baf92896572af1767e05c228dca3.jpg[/img][/url]
https://www.artix.com/breakingbenjamin

[previewyoutube=7w_pY0uP-Lk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Happening now![/h1]
[h2]Non-stop in-game shows until March 8th[/h2]
The legendary band, Breaking Benjamin, is performing in AdventureQuest 3D & AdventureQuest Worlds right now! Join us for an otherworldly video game concert on monster infested islands floating in the cosmic void.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e7c74587de7619f353249ae5fd8c9064d96d39ba.jpg[/img]

[h2]New features, new location, new monsters....[/h2]
This will be the 1st battle concert in AdventureQuest 3D to feature parkour, portals, and titan fights. Like our previous battle concerts, this event was created for gamers of all skill levels to enjoy. It is OK if you just want to go watch, too.

[url=https://hollywoodrecs.co/AuroraBB][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e49c240240dd660fbc7d6d67482812c0c10fe465.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Special musical guest, Breaking Benjamin![/h2]
Breaking Benjamin is a multi-platinum rock band with nine #1 hit songs. Some of our favorites include The Dairy of Jane, I Will Not Bow, Angel's Fall, and Torn in Two. They just released a new album called [url=https://hollywoodrecs.co/AuroraBB]Aurora[/url]. It's a collection of their biggest and most popular songs... and one new song called "Far Away" featuring Scooter Ward of the band Cold.  Check out the official music video for "Far Away." Breaking Benjamin on tour now with Korn.
[url=https://breakingbenjamin.com/tour/]Check out their music & see their tour dates[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/eb242e9ef106baf92896572af1767e05c228dca3.jpg[/img]

[h2]Our darkest Battle Concert yet[/h2]
We converted the band members into video game characters and placed their stage on monster-filled floating islands. Explore this strange new concert venue with parkour and portals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5e5e4d6889b71aa07921f0ff3f18376940f3fbae.jpg[/img]

[h2]Earn 50+ new armors, items, and rare badges[/h2]
[b]No VIP Packages[/b]
WHAT!? Yeah. You can thank the band. All the new item rewards for this event comes from defeating the monsters or crafting. Want a virtual selfie with the band? Head to Yulgar's Inn... they are hanging out there. Talk to Ben & learn a little about the band. Also, find the quests to earn the "Far Away" badge & title and the epic, perma-rare, Breaking Benjamin T-shirt. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/789dfd67615246a48c83030da7d95a7694971844.jpg[/img]

[h2]2 Titan Bosses![/h2]
Previous battle concerts had a single boss monster, but this one has TWO massive Titan Bosses. Your actions during the show will determine if one of them becomes the final boss. It will take a little strategy and team work. Each Titan drops different rewards. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/26e11bd6b975dfdd1b209a1a29f03bbaf24912dd.jpg[/img]
[h2]Be the first to see new monsters[/h2]
The monsters in this event are a sneak-preview... you will be seeing them again in AdventureQuest 3D's main storyline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ed210a9f02188b93735ccac4f34d0d3455d24b9c.jpg[/img]
[h2]Bryce Platinum & Quests[/h2]
The concert promoter, Bryce Platinum, has brand new quests for everyone to complete during this show. (Are you a VIP from a previous show? You can find all of your quests on him too!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/62ec1e6f4e88cdde9d339aadc47e2052428b0d18.jpg[/img]
[h2]Strategy in the Pit[/h2]
During a battle concert, you stand back to back as you fight the monsters swarming the pit. But this time... you have some options. There are tons of floating rocks. You can jump around them and explore. Some things you discover may help you guarantee the titan of your choice becomes the final Boss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2f546cc7cf28a4223d145cf2a5acacb36958a318.jpg[/img]

[h2]Really... no VIP packages?[/h2]
Yes. Really. We hope this is the most unique and rewarding Battle Concert yet. If you would like to show your support to the band get the new album, Aurora on your favorite service, and see if the Breaking Benjamin tour is coming near you. Enjoying the game? Considering upgrading to become a Guardian, or getting some DCs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5e82d42d58aa7ea9ff894b14144e1a498912bb49.jpg[/img]
[h2]Songs in the Battle Concert[/h2]

[list]
[*]"Torn in Two" performed by Breaking Benjamin, Courtesy of Hollywood Records, Inc.
[*]"Failure" performed by Breaking Benjamin, Courtesy of Hollywood Records, Inc.
[*]"So Cold" performed by Breaking Benjamin, Courtesy of Hollywood Records, Inc.
[/list]
    
    
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/274916b06668bb82a6af3767eaa8e151000e5bc8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Non-stop shows happening now until Mar 8, 2020![/h2]
[b]See you in the Pit![/b]
We hope you enjoy this Breaking Benjamin Battle Concert! This event if happening across two of our games. Here in AdventureQuest 3D we are focusing on the immersive battle concert. Meanwhile, over in our 2D MMO, we are focusing on story. Have a great time and be sure to get the perma-rare items from both games before the event ends on March 8th, 2020.

[b]Battle on!

tags.feature:
[h2]New features, new location, new monsters....[/h2]
This will be the 1st battle concert in AdventureQuest 3D to feature parkour, portals, and titan fights. Like our previous battle concerts, this event was created for gamers of all skill levels to enjoy. It is OK if you just want to go watch, too.

[h2]Earn 50+ new armors, items, and rare badges[/h2]
[b]No VIP Packages[/b]
WHAT!? Yeah. You can thank the band. All the new item rewards for this event comes from defeating the monsters or crafting. Want a virtual selfie with the band? Head to Yulgar's Inn... they are hanging out there. Talk to Ben & learn a little about the band. Also, find the quests to earn the "Far Away" badge & title and the epic, perma-rare, Breaking Benjamin T-shirt.

[h2]2 Titan Bosses![/h2]
Previous battle concerts had a single boss monster, but this one has TWO massive Titan Bosses. Your actions during the show will determine if one of them becomes the final boss. It will take a little strategy and team work. Each Titan drops different rewards.

[h2]Be the first to see new monsters[/h2]
The monsters in this event are a sneak-preview... you will be seeing them again in AdventureQuest 3D's main storyline.

[h2]Bryce Platinum & Quests[/h2]
The concert promoter, Bryce Platinum, has brand new quests for everyone to complete during this show. (Are you a VIP from a previous show? You can find all of your quests on him too!)

[h2]Strategy in the Pit[/h2]
During a battle concert, you stand back to back as you fight the monsters swarming the pit. But this time... you have some options. There are tons of floating rocks. You can jump around them and explore. Some things you discover may help you guarantee the titan of your choice becomes the final Boss.

notes.title: Heroes Heart 2020, New Emotes, & Rune Portal!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/da087a2fb167efa58650200acc334aa66c921ed3.jpg[/img]

'Tis the week to celebrate your love... of adventure! It's Heroes Heart Day and for this Valentines themed release we are celebrating with new emotes, items & quests which are in-game now. Go to town and talk to the snazzy looking fellow with the lute on the bridge named Maurice.

Read more at https://aq3d.com/news/heroes_heart_day_2020/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/519f9b8b4c2d34724c1ac7284244f9e6b25c86ff.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Travel Crystal... has evolved into a Portal![/h2]
Travel in Lore will become much more intuitive for new players. Maybe for you too. The portal is "activated" by running into it, of course. It was surprising how many people just did not want to touch that blue crystal. But EVERYONE wants to walk into a portal. So that's what you do now.

Every couple of seconds, the image in the portal changes to one of a new location... Darkovia, Ashfall, Frostvale, Doomwood, etc.

[h2]Story, Adventures, Battle Concerts[/h2]
In this release, the portal will bring up the menu that lets you travel. We are in the middle of expanding it to let you access the main story (and show you your progress), and also access challenges, side adventures, special and holiday events including next week's Breaking Benjamin battle concert! (You may remember us talking about this in the previous post titled: [url=https://aq3d.com/news/world_story_design/]new World Story and Book of Lore menu[/url])

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1e5bdf36fb618badf6d94e4cfa813cb4f9e158eb.jpg[/img]

'Tis the week to celebrate your love... of adventure! It's Heroes Heart Day and for this Valentines themed release we are celebrating with new emotes, items & quests which are in-game now. Go to town and talk to the snazzy looking fellow with the lute on the bridge named Maurice.

[h2]New Emotes![/h2]
Blow a kiss.... of death? Because while this is cute, you know it is going to be used as an evil taunt. Oh internet >_<

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e1194b984ca29ee2217d9c6884daec60e877622b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Not gonna take this sitting down![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8b9b3e6f459ecc9f51dba5ad07e7c53a638c5c3b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Talk to Maurice[/h2]
He's a Minstrel of Love. He has come to Battleon to inspire the heart of every hero! "Toss a DC to your wi...." Talk to him on the bridge to get the new daily quests and the 2020 Heroes Heart collection (including a new effect potion, pets, and a travel form)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5a291633b6aafa50f4059a814b31e2e4280be1ce.jpg[/img]

[h2]2020 Heroes Heart Collection[/h2]
AdventureQuest 3D artists Darkon, Winnie, and Dage broke out the pink and red to design this new Collection. 
The [b]Rose Lord[/b] armor set by Darkon is for those valiant heroes who fight in the name of love.

[*] Rose Lord Blade
[*] Rose Lord Shoulders
[*] Rose Lord Helm
[*] Rose Lord Eye Patch
[*] Rose Lord Cape
[*] Rose Lord Boots
[*] Rose Lord Gloves

[*] Heartfelt Cape
[*] Heartfelt Hat
[*] Heartfelt Boots
[*] Heartfelt Gloves
[*] Heartfelt Belt
[*] Heartfelt Cane

[*] Heartbroken Top Hat
[*] Heartbroken Boots

The Heartbroken set and both Canes can be bought individually for gold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ab04ce4a57975fc81ca57076388c0100f6617d5a.jpg[/img]

If you're looking for love, or to simply make new friends, the "Spread the Love" daily quests will take you all around one of the districts of Battleon to meet some very special NPCs (Non Player Characters). You will earn 10 Lovely Hearts per quest which can be used to purchase any one of the 4 colors of robes and boots.

We are celebrating Heroes Heart day all week. But if you have "that special someone" in the real world, then heads up-- Valentines day is Friday! Thankfully, the team reminded me so that I would not end up on the couch this weekend, and am passing this wisdom onto you! In need of a last minute gift? >_> Or maybe some company? notes.title: Lunar New Year Shop
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunar_new_year_shop/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9d69c025400592154b9ee456b13c5cea975a4cbc.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]2020 is the Year of the Rat[/h1]

Happy Lunar New Year from your favorite Anime-style MMORPG made in... Florida, USA! XD

The official Lunar New Year is begins this Saturday, but why wait to get festive? Head to town and get items from Saber's Lunar New Year shop. There are items for gold, for Guardians, and an adorable pet mouse companion.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunar_new_year_shop/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a36873cb346eb00a94aefb266ee41d194f8fbad5.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Lunar New Year Sets[/h2]

Props to AdventureQuest 3D's newest modeler/artist Winnie for these Lunar New Year sets! Let her know in the comments section if you love them. They are available for about 8,888 gold in town now. You will notice all of the prices contain 8's. Because 8 is a SUPER LUCKY number in Chinese. Mostly because it sounds like 發 (fa) which means wealth, prospering, and fortune. For the record, I am 100% down for any and all cultural-wide puns.

[b]Cheongsam (For Girls)[/b]

Beautiful! A cheongsam is a sleek, close-fitting Chinese dress. This dress was probably not intended to be worn in combat against dragons and monsters...

[b]Changshan (For Boys)[/b]

A changshan is a traditional Chinese long tunic worn by men. But if you buy the wrong one and wear it, no one will care. We're all open minded friends in this game community.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunar_new_year_shop/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e153d7596756eb2705b3802fd9b54a1155e75cfc.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Lunar New Year Capes[/h2]

There are two versions!  A Lucky Red Dragon Cloak for 8,888 gold. There is also a Lucky Guardian cape for 1,000 gold.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunar_new_year_shop/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5f59eb407f7a6aa0b40fc8cb92378926c3cec595.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Rat of the Year Pet![/h2]

In Chinese astrology, each year is represented by an animal. The Rat is the very first one on the Zodiac. It represents being kind, generous, and super diligent.

"But... it's the year of the Rat. Why is the pet a MOUSE!?"

Hah. The Chinese the word 老鼠 (Rat) can mean either Rat or Mouse. So we went with the mouse for maximum adorableness. We also made Dage the Evil make it. Because someone as dark and evil as him making something this cute is maximum comedy! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/eba463222fd0024d056a5ee98640dc8714fea39c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Berserker Just Released![/h2]

Beserker is a brutal tier 2 class that everyone can earn right now. Head to the class trainers in town to get started. You will notice that you can earn classes faster now... especially if you are (or become) a Guardian.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/lunar_new_year_shop/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2efedcf68b6c3b81db15149c52b6978bf0aa5872.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Happy Lunar New Year and...[/h2]
Do you know what animal you were born under on the Chinese Zodiac? Check out [url=https://aq3d.com/news/art_squeak_peek/]my previous post[/url] to find out.

[b]Artix, Glisel, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

notes.title: Berserker Class just released for everyone to earn!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/eba463222fd0024d056a5ee98640dc8714fea39c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Berserker Just Released![/h1]

Beserker is a brutal tier 2 class that everyone can earn right now. Head to the class trainers in town to get started. You will notice that you can earn classes faster now... especially if you are (or become) a Guardian.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/76a9fb518734404dce1f640a66b60f3105384d31.jpg[/img]

[h2][h1]Berserker Class[/h1][/h2]

"Berserkers are often the last ones standing on the battlefield. They have learned to tap into the deep rage running through their veins and become unstoppable whirlwinds of death and destruction."

Berserker is a Tier 2 class...

It is so brutal that you need to be a Rank 10 Warrior before you can even start the quests.

Also, Berserker is a duel-wielding class!

...and it has its own custom daily dungeon called Trials of Fury?

Are you a Guardian? Because Guardians get a bonus daily quest to earn & progress classes (including this one) even faster.

Finally... as a special reward to you for being with us... Beta Berserker will be exclusively released to you and your fellow early access players when AdventureQuest 3D goes fully live on STEAM. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ab9ae45880114a7e4ebe3e2a51fce1be3bae6249.jpg[/img]

[h2]Berserker Skills[/h2]

Berserkers tap into their rage for their power of death and destruction. These are the skills you'll be able to use as a Berserker.

[h3]Frenzy (Passive)[/h3]
ncrease Haste as your Health decreases. "The more you hurt, the faster you swing!"

[h3]Reckless Smash[/h3]
A bone-crunching swing of your weapon so powerful it does damage to yourself for 10% of your remaining health.

[h3]Savage Flames[/h3]
Become a spinning torrent of flames that deal 1.5x damage when you are below 50% health.

[h3]Raging Strike[/h3]
Attack with a powerful strike which focuses your fury into your weapons, strengthening you when below 50% health. Becomes Invigorate which can be cast for a brief period.

[h3]ULTIMATE! Battle Fever[/h3]
Embrace your Berserker Rage, becoming an unstoppable force on the battlefield.

[h3]CROSS SKILL! Wild Shout[/h3]
Draw from your inner strength to grant Haste to yourself and nearby allies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/de8432f0da902af958368a1909ded3d81d65f417.jpg[/img]
 
[h2]A Better Way to Earn New Classes[/h2]

You can unlock classes even faster now. It used to take a month. Now, you can do it in only 7 days through the daily class quests. Choose carefully though, the trade off is you can only train one class at a time.

[h2]Are you a Guardian? Earn classes even faster.[/h2]

Like before, Guardians get a bonus daily tokens quest. Now, Guardians can exchange the tokens they earn and use it on another class.  This is pretty cool. We are trying it out on Moglomancer, Pirate, and Berserker first. It feels pretty good-- and when we get feedback of it in action, we will make it work for the other classes to.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/cbd9c6e6713b3ba6684cf54adadd8a3526cf21e4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Berserker Armors![/h2]

Once you rank up Berserker, you can then start unlocking the wicked full armor set.  Head to the class trainer's building in town, and talk to Rowan Varr to start your Berserker training.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b7ba73afc1d221544eeb6dcfdfecd8bbc3dde7b6.jpg[/img]

[h2]Where's the Class Trainer at?![/h2]

OK, here's a shortcut. And it works for any class. Hop in game. Click on the main menu, then classes, then Berserker. Then, under the picture there is a button that says  "Berserker, Unlock Class (or Get Tokens after it's unlocked)" If you click it, it will bring up a travel button which will teleport you to the Class Trainers. 

[h2]Is the release on all Devices?[/h2]

Yes. The release has just gone out on Android, Apple, and Steam. Be sure to grab the latest version of the game from the app store!

[h2]Help! I cannot Accept the Daily Quest.[/h2]

Did you already do your daily quest for the day? Or are you already on a daily class quest? (if it is the second one, you can just drop the quest and pick up the berserker quest.)

[h2]Duel Wielding Graphical Glitch?[/h2]

Because of the special nature of Berserker duel wielding, if you see an instance of the weapon particles (special effects) not working properly, please submit a Bug Report to artix.com/contact or through the in-game menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2362cae321f273fcae7373921c9fffb1464c373e.png[/img]

[b]See you in game.

BATTLE ON AND... GO BERSERK![/b]
Artix, Glisel & the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.content:

https://aq3d.com/news/happy_new_years_2020/ 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/happy_new_years_2020/ ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/671cbff53d6d5040c30e233715d556529f9e1de9.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Gift Boxes have just opened[/h2]
Yup. The gift boxes have just opened. Login and see what your box turned into. These are by far two of the finest items Dage has created. We hope you love them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6496d68dc577942554216bf2af5a59b4291be7e3.png[/img]

We had a feeling that someone might say that XD. The boxes now drop as loot from the Party Sneevils (Fireworks) in town! We also a few you can get from Artix in town. Now you can wield your favorite, uh, box... year round!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/16e3eb4aeb2b082714f956f5b375f4d3214f7460.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Frost Siege War!
notes.content:
[b]A Frostlorn Summoner is attacking our home town with an army![/b]
https://aq3d.com/news/siege_war/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7c47ea64be8c84d5c38afdec6210e48d2e205ba7.png[/img]

...but our NEW town of Battleon includes some brand new defenses. Use your defenders medals to place catapults and defend against waves in our new siege war system! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5b598ff03948dd6b10a1e0a756184536a61eac0c.jpg[/img]
[h1]Together We Stand[/h1]
There are no teams in this war. We are ALL fighting to protect our home. Stand together to defeat the waves of enemies in this siege outside the gates of Battleon. The map holds 10 people and is intended for players of all levels to fight side by side.
Siege War!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c8e4411b6fd83b5f20c9b5f00790ef8dc4e6d274.jpg[/img]
Siege (verb) -  A military operation in which enemy forces surround a town or building, cutting off essential supplies, with the aim of compelling the surrender of those inside.

A horde of Frost Monsters can be seen in the distance riding toward the side gates of Battleon in waves. The Frostlorn Raiders have tried taking Battleon before and you fought them back. You then went to their stronghold near Frostvale in the Frozen Northlands and fought against the Frostlorn himself. Now, Shiveroth the Frostlorn Summoner has ordered a siege on Battleon in retaliation. Battleon needs you to defend it once again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ccd385e8b8cfcf91337ad3077e9ba3200fffe421.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Win Conditions[/h1]
[b]Withstand the waves of armies[/b]
Use Defender Medals to buy extra help and weapons. Defender Medals (and sometimes craft items) are dropped as loot by enemies.

[b]Keep the enemies out[/b]
Maintain and build more barricades. This is your main defense. Barricades can hold back the Frost Monsters while you fight on the front lines, even if you're the only one left standing. Be careful though, after enough attacks on the barricades, they will break and the war meter will decrease. Building more barricades and keeping them up is the best way to increase the war meter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a567352b1d673cd8e642e034e7d857b55037b149.jpg[/img]

[h1]Craft Defenses![/h1]
Introducing Blacksmith Sara Watterson (a new NPC from the AQ3D Kickstarter) has volunteered to provide you with defenses in this war. This includes cannons, catapults, and walls of fire! Use your defenders medals to purchase them and they will appear transparent on the map. Just click on where you want it to go and it will become a solid item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ec774a45e6a83d47e3cad72ab25d720e3cef71cb.jpg[/img]
[h1]Guardian Troops[/h1]
Guardians also have the ability to hire additional help in the form of Guardian Golems, Mages, Rogues, and Warriors. You can spawn your hired help at the teleportation pad which appears by the gate.

[b]Note: [/b]You'll find your completed craft items and hired help waiting in your tokens inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b84ea9a54177fbe26fa7677e894e849d80d5a692.jpg[/img]

[h1]Unlocks from the Siege Loot Shop[/h1]
Sara also offers a Siege Loot shop with level 20 stat based armor sets. Each item of the Frost Viking and Frozen Viking armor sets are locked behind the war meter. Starting at 10%, different pieces of the sets will become available to purchase for gold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c327b413916e5c81fdd798d9dcb9c69fc82d3df8.jpg[/img]
Meet Roland in Battleon where he is recruiting heroes to defend our town from the Frostlorn Summoner. He also has Defender Rank quests and crafting for additional cosmetic armor sets. As you gain ranks as a siege defender you'll unlock new tiers of armor sets.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3b44dde0009d6b8c31c8474e9290e0e980ce698b.jpg[/img]
[h1]Frostval 2019 Collection[/h1]
[b]Battle with Cold Steel![/b]
Visit Blizzy the Frost Moglin to purchase the new 2019 Frostval Collection! You can get individual pieces or get the entire collection and save.

[list]
[*] Frostlorn Summoner (Robes, Hood, Neckwear, Shoulders, Gloves, Boots, Belt)
[*] Merry Maker Suit
[*] Merry Maker Dress
[*] Merry Maker Embroidered Gloves, Gloves, Shoes, Boots, Gloves,
[*] Merry Maker Holly Scarf
[*] Merry Maker Plaid Scarf
[*] Merry Maker Top Hat
[*] Frostwraith (Travel Form)
[*] Frost Wolf (Pet)
[*] NEW! Effect Potions (Collection includes Unlimited Supply)
[*] Chance of Flurries (Personal Snowfall Effect for 5 minutes)
[*] Cookie Dreams (Personal Gingerbread man effect for 5 minutes)
[*] Frostlorn Summoner Staff
[*] Badge
[*] Title "Merry Maker"
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b3810eab65f773bb3b11a170d871b6938b9b73ae.gif[/img]

[h1]Effect Potions![/h1]
It's beginning to look a lot like Frostval... everywhere you go!

With these new effects potions you'll be seeing flurries of snow or swirling gingerbread men, or both! They cast an effect on your character that lasts for 5 minutes.  (2 minute versions are available in Warlic's shop as well). If you get the full 2019 collection, you get an unlimited supply of "Eternal Chance of Flurries" and "Eternal Cookie Dreams". And yes... they stack together!

[h1]PROTECT OUR TOWN FROM THE INVADERS![/h1]
Talk to Roland in town to defend. This war is taking place outside the walls of the Social District of Battleon instead of the entrance gate.... but you can hop into the action by talking to Roland in town.

[b]We'll see you on the battlefield... Battle on!
Artix, Glisel & the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

P.S. This war features new game mechanics and we really hope you enjoy it. Let us know if you enjoy it and any ideas you have for how we could make it even more fun!

notes.title: This release is a NIGHTMARE! (Literally)
notes.content:
[h1]Friday the 13th is back again... [/h1]
...but you're facing a new evil in Camp Gonnagetcha. She's a nightmare!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7f0eedbaecbfb1e6bdbc0ee43967cd39a808991a.jpg[/img]

But first...

WARNING! If you are easily frightened, scared, or are not prepared for challenging, deadly, and and horrifying dungeons.... maybe you should head to Aria's Pet shop and check out:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/91d747aacffd5b0e1f6afa984380f880a2e56bed.png[/img]
[h1]Baby Noda[/h1]
Available at Aria's pet shop. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6b9d0450d580bf4ca6d084a4a7016fc5c8eb59ff.gif[/img]

OK... you were warned.... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/91f1c142052f885e3f27bbfec83005c27338e79b.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Camp War... Frostval vs Mogloween![/h1]
Return to Camp Gonnagetcha.... Choose your side with your cabin counselors Zip and Ace before you go searching for trouble. First, choose which side of the camp war you'll be on: team Frostval or team Mogloween. This war will be the same strategy as the others. Collect as many War Badges as possible by slaying monsters on the camp grounds and watch your team's war meter rise! The dungeon monsters don't drop these...

However...

This release is a nightmare...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9c8c7bbd76002d75efa547343e54d68837e9ee31.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Villain: She Sees You When You're Sleeping...[/h1]
Shrade is no longer the biggest evil threatening Camp Gonnagetcha. The campers have been awake for several days. Too terrified to sleep.

She sees you when you're sleeping... You'd better stay awake.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bb1c52b698356ab91f90078655612210871a9bdb.jpg[/img]

If you fall asleep at camp, she'll stalk you in a nightmare of her own making. If you die in the dream... You die in real life.

Her name is [b]Fleshette[/b] and even our wildest dreams have never thought of anything like her.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b04e9dd936c18be54d8a13f68718b7742f01c21c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Story Quests and Crafting[/h1]

You'll find this dungeon in the cabin with scratch marks on the door.

Talk to Kristen to learn about how Fleshette has been terrorizing the campers' dreams.

Find out what Fleshette wants and how to defeat her. Then go back to gather Dreadful Visions and Fretful Memories to craft Fleshette's armor set for your own.

[b]P.S.[/b] This new horror dungeon release is terrifying.

[b]P.P.S. [/b]Jongaars music magnifies the chill factor...

[b]P.P.P.S.[/b] If you find yourself running for the door... head to Aria's pet shop and stare at Baby Noda for relief.

See you in... our dreams!? O_O

Artix, Glisel, & the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: Frostval Strikes Back
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval_strikes_back/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/03da846880d1db3bdfabe7c2522d13c7dd4a50c8.png[/img][/url]

[h1]The Return of Frostval, our Winter Holiday[/h1]
Time to pull out your sweaters, scarves, and woolly socks because Frostval is back! You will find previous years' maps, craft items, and returning item shop. If this is your first Frostvale with us... join us and catch up!
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/frostval_strikes_back/]https://aq3d.com/news/frostval_strikes_back/[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4957e83cb6a9d4c82fd0e90247b8427e23bf3dcc.jpg[/img]

[h1]In a Land Far, Far Away...[/h1]

Frostval is a wonderful time of year when we celebrate how the Hero helped the Frost Moglins escape from the Yettun into the snowy lands of Frostvale. (Frostvale is the land, Frostval is the winter holiday) You are that Hero! So, if haven't yet experienced this story, meet Blizzy at the Travel Crystal and go to "Frostvale Cave".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1ef0f7e6e7893bbf696b2c509cdd44943150d394.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Frostlorn (Level 18+)[/h1]
You must be at least level 18 to do Frostvale quests. Not because the Frostlorn is not wearing clothes... I mean, he's not, but that is 100% NOT the reason. The monsters here are very powerful, but lower level Heroes may brave it if you dare.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/f7e8509460ddaa9b1d178188dbddbc31ca02043f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Past Frostval Items[/h1]
If you already experienced it, check out the craft and DC items from Frostval 2017 and 2018 also available with Blizzy. This includes four sets of seasonal armor, including...

Frostlorn Necro Armor, Toy Soldier, Gingerbread, and Frostlorn Warrior (with or without antlers). Frostlorn Mage and Rogue variants are available to craft. You can also buy thematic pets, travel forms, weapons, and back items like the Tangled Lights seen above.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/33a79ded62df507f7222fa9e39afec1315e083cd.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Frostlorn Boss Fight[/h1]
The heroes of our world have become considerably more powerful since the last encounter with this trio of ice villains. I almost feel bad for them. The craft shop for these armors is on Blizzy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a98d53c325367ec8080e3cc27eec0c5123344e94.png[/img]

[h1]Next week is a FRIDAY THE 13TH![/h1]
Historically on Friday the 13ths we return to Camp Gonnagetcha for a war and to face the unstoppable abdomination of horror, SHRADE. But next week, we have a new horror villain coming your way. Also a war. How does Mogloween vs Frostval sound? Which side would you fight for?

Until then... gather your coats and your friends, and...

Battle On!
Artix, Glisel, & the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.content:

https://aq3d.com/news/yokai_dragon_tengu_challenge_fights/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8328427544ce11fd3272328d5bddd5817e5aca7c.jpg[/img]

Hop in game and see this year's new Black Friday and Cyber Monday items! They are all in town now, being sold by a mysterious dark shroud stranger in town square!
https://aq3d.com/news/black_firday_2019/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/31caee3ffa8630a5f04739e296bafc116b48b54b.jpg[/img]

We have items for Gold, DragonCrystals, Guardian items, and a few secret ones you can battle monsters for too. Here's a sneak peek at few....

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/b20bb7fc28107c29cef8efafed48f8cb42c5c9df.jpg[/img]

[h1]The DoorBuster Sword[/h1]

We are launching Cyber Monday early too! The BIGGEST difference between our door busters and the ones being advertised on TV... is ours can actually be used to bust down doors! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/149e4a8137d2cb28f4dd4d86709534fb1f726af7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Wield & Shield[/h1]

These wield and shield sets equip a shield on one arm and your weapon in the other.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/07702ca182286bb5e0da4a0166d358e0fc346287.jpg[/img]

Such darkness....

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/853c1bda777da0b8978b8424d05ce236c0f60032.jpg[/img]

[h1]SECRET.... CYBERKNIGHT BOSS[/h1]

Shhhhh.... top secret! For a short time only, there is a chance that the CyberKnight boss will spawn in ANY of the daily boss fight maps. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0b25be0d872f24beeb37d221f09c4b37643ffd2e.jpg[/img]

The CyberKnight will drop ANY of his pieces-- including his Sword & Shield combo :D You can access these daily boss fights from the Quest Board in the town of Battleon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c61799de826058415e846713c7d0e54c878a482e.jpg[/img]
[h1]
Ryujin Dragon Challenge[/h1]

Ready for round two? Head back to the Yokai cliffs for a rematch with Ryujin. If you beat this challenge, you will earn the pieces of the Ryujin Dragon armor set. Or head to the Armor Shop to craft those too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bc9d1f170b059efdb8326aa4680e83667bd88dd9.jpg[/img]
[h1]Tengu Bamboo Forest Challenge[/h1]

Catch Raytengu if you can and he'll drop pieces of his armor set as a reward! Or you can just craft them in the Armor Shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/af5ebd279bedd88b4c7d29a710227d9f5058d955.jpg[/img]

[h1]Kagu-Tsuchi Sword Quest[/h1]

For crazy players only! It will take endurance and grueling effort in this quest to earn the legendary sword Ame no Ohabari from Kagu-Tsuchi (the fire elemental)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8373213ddc665aef5894489d0307347bf5700e75.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW! Animated Wings[/h1]

[b]"This Shop Will Give You Wings..."[/b]

While on Yokai Isle, Head to the Armor and Masks shop to craft your very own set of animated wings! Look for "DaiTengu's Legend" when talking to the shop keeper. There are several sets of full sized and animated wings.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/monday7_the_code_awakens/]https://aq3d.com/news/monday7_the_code_awakens/[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1d17aaa2319d5054b8cc87acab9fefa0529e7ccc.jpg[/img]

The special event with musical guest Alice in Chains ends on November 30th. If you have not experienced the Battle Concert or gotten all of the items you desired yet... hurry, you do not have much longer! 
https://aq3d.com/news/10_days_left_aic/

Artix
