We've  joked for years about our gag food pyramid above. But if you're feeling  like you've been hit by a debuff and want to min/max your real-life  character stats, here is a strategy guide:

[b]1. Drink more water.[/b]
Coffee & energy drinks won't work unless enough water is already in you. Water is like a buff for your buffs.
[b]
2. Eat more green stuff.[/b]
Veggies, not the moldy thing you unearthed in the back of the fridge.

[b]3. Stretch[/b]
Google-fu some routines. The benefits of a 15 minute stretch with proper breathing can rival some gym workouts.

If you are not already doing them, these 3 little actions can buff any  gamer's drive, focus, and reflexes. At least that is what Glisel tells  me every time she reminds me to drink more water. >_>  And if I  have to do it... you should too! Join me O_O

notes.title: UFO Sightings! The truth... is out there O_O
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4ae4de53459d2bd45e07d2cbcb0c70abf97bb018.jpg[/img]
[h1]UFO travel form and pet now available![/h1]
UFO sightings are flooding in! The truth is out there. (Mostly in Gaz and Aria's shops.) The time has come to make first contact... we are NOT alone.

[h1]Latest Sightings include...[/h1][list][*]UFO Travel Form[/*][*]UFO Pet[/*][*]Alien Juice[/*][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e4754c16b71363c0114d1798c94d4cec4f13babf.jpg[/img]
[h1]Area 51 Secrets[/h1]
If you read Cysero's [url=/news/area51/][u]Area 51[/u] design notes post[/url] last week and were excited about the possibility of alien-themed items coming to AQ3D... You are not alone! We've got something for all those who believe [u]the truth is out there.[/u] The post got such an enthusiastic response (and great item suggestions) that Xero worked quickly to put together these two fun spaceship items for the release! This week was the FULL GAME upgrade to the newer version of Unity which includes 64-bit support for Android devices. This means for the past week the team has been "content locked"-- that is, we were unable to add anything new until after the update went live (which it should be now). So Xero and the team got these in just in time.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/556922b9beed73dbb036e93dac291155bbfbaccf.jpg[/img]
[h1]To Infinity...![/h1]
The Area 51 Flying Saucer travel form moves at light speed. Actually, it moves at 160% movement speed which is standard travel form speed, but that's still pretty quick. You can buy the permanent travel form from Gaz's Black Market Shop for DragonCrystals. Alternatively, questing in Barrow Drop will also let you earn Alien Juice, a consumable potion which turns you into a flying saucer. Barrow Drop is in Barrow Point, located down the path directly right of Robina in Greenguard.

[h1]You are the Alien[/h1]
You can also opt to have a flying saucer companion by purchasing the Area 51 pet from Aria's Pet shop. This seems like a perfect idea for those of you who already have green or blue skin -- or your flying saucer travel form can be the mother ship XD.

[h1]Alternate Names for this release[/h1]

notes.title: Arcangrove "A Preview of Magic"
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/de1c0ab17746c01d64d7b99087196a15d92170f1.jpg[/img]
[h1]Arcangrove "A preview of magic" Pre-Release[/h1]
The newest version of AdventureQuest 3D just dropped, and with it... a preview of the magical forest of Arcangrove. Login and explore new areas filled with unicorns, bird-people, and magical treasures.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/67dcd9e0546a0e285d3aa8838c40f85f4ac38ca9.jpg[/img]
[h1]Rayst the Elder Evoker[/h1]
Use the travel crystal to get to Arcangrove. Upon entering the magical forest, you will meet Rayst. He is an Elder Evoker. In case you were wondering, his title of Elder Evoker means that he is of the 1st rank of Magi who are allowed access to the Restricted section of the Tower of Magic. When you talk to him, he will give quests to earn pieces of his set.

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d4d97695776a7119193080405faf665a854e189b.jpg[/img]
[h1]The Tower of Magic[/h1]
Coming with the release of the full Arcangrove Saga... you will enter the Tower of Magic. This week, you can speak to the Sentinels who guard it. They will give you quests to earn Crescent Wolf Armor.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b0ea6bf09adf2cc8940ad791e35176e598c8fcd2.jpg[/img]
[h1]Cresent Wolf Armor[/h1]
The forest of Arcangrove is stalked by arcanwolves. But there is ONE monsterous wolf, that is larger than them all. It is the Crescent Wolf. It is a more powerful wolf inbued with the power of the blue moon. When a cresent wolf falls in battle, a new arcanwolf is chosen to ascend. At this point it receives its crescent blades which it weilds from its mouth. Because... it's a wolf. No hands. We checked. You may have seen Craft the full set by doing the quests from the Sentinels who guard the tower.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/712ac612d0fc98a8ccc15f1bf19a0602fb7bbf17.jpg[/img]
[h1]Unicorn Glen[/h1]
It's real! It's really... really real! The magical place from your sister's fairy books. Except you can fight them. You know. For loot.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f8bfd2e0753f1bcfe108fef0784b20e804888019.jpg[/img]
[h1]The Herbalist Cabin[/h1]
On the Arcangrove side of the Unicorn Glen border, you can find Vesta the Herbalist at her cabin. Craft 6 new items and ingredients (for quests or for purchase) including Unicorn Dust and Brownie Parts. (Brownie like the dessert? Or brownie like the creature? YES.)

Not much else was divulged about Vesta, so I guess we'll find out together. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a5e0ffa80bdf6cc392365a1bba3cd17bc7b1f07b.jpg[/img]
[h1]Meet Todd the Derpicorn[/h1]
Oh the majestic sights you will witness in Unicorn Glen! But none is so... *gulps* articulately animated as Todd the Derp'icon. This beast is officially the toughest monster in the world.

([u]You may have accidentally experienced Todd the Derpicorn pre-release, thanks to a spoiler event by our new programmer Dagger. Todd was drawn by Dage, animated by Korin, and is pride and joy of the AQ3D team[/u].) 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/cf360a945932f5065265525b3b766066fcc6d925.jpg[/img]
[h1]Maximum Animation[/h1]
He is "hoofs-down, our most animated monster ever." Dage did the art and Korin did the animation. Together they made a truly derpy monster. Farming Todd the Derpicorn is also required to loot hard-to-find items, but he's very hard to kill (level 31!!!), so get real comfortable with looking at that derp face.
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ce44ecd329cc465aa4d85894a48952f1490956e7.jpg[/img]

You might also spot a certain unicorn bro. You know who I mean.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4087d5efc711b8fbb17e998b559566757f6d6df3.jpg[/img]
[h1]Yet another map!? Find the Ornithon Camp.[/h1]
"What [u]is[/u] an Ornithon?" I (Glisel) asked Cysero. "Birdperson. Like in the bank," he said.

Well, that explains why General Polly is a Guard Parrot. When you talk to Polly, you will find level 27 weapons (with stats!) available, and all created by Thyton. For 25,000 gold each; except for a special craftable weapon called Dark Destiny. Now you have something to do with those millions of gold you've accrued for the past 25+ levels! Let me just say, when Cysero mentioned a chakram, I got very excited. And then I saw the chakram and I'm all giddy. I'll gladly shell out gold for that beauty. The other weapons are beautiful too, but this is my fave.   

The Ornithon Camp itself is filled with Ornithon settlers and large tree houses. I'm not ashamed to say it took me awhile to realize how to get up into those tree houses. Well... maybe a little... but I can't take it back now.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0a8052824cb90b53e3d583a03d6a298d775e9856.jpg[/img]

[h1]Coming next in the full Arcangrove Saga release![/h1]
We hope you enjoy this preview of Arcangrove. It is something to hold you over while we finish the cutscenes and maps. The next Arcangrove Saga release will be the full story release. For all of you LORE lore lovers (see what I did there?).  You will find out the source of LORE's magic. You will be able to enter the Tower of Magic to continue your magic training. [u]Specifically mana-based magic (Because there are other types... like dragon magic and [u]void[/u] magic). You will also learn about the Council of Magi who are the governing body of all mana-based magic in the world.[/u][u][/u]

[b]Battle on![/b]

[b]Glisel & Artix (We wrote this one together for you!)[/b]

[b]P.S [/b]The Moglins are shipping! We have packed 6,000 Moglins so far and about 3,000 of them have been shipped.  [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/artix/adventurequesttm-moglin-plushies/posts/2553376]Read the post here[/url]. [b]
[/b]

[b]P.P.S [/b]Yes, we put , we put those level 1 starter boots back in the game. But we are not telling you where... >_<

[b]P.P.P.S.[/b] We just released a new game, [url=https://www.artix.com/posts/idlequest/]IdleQuest[/url], on the new [url=https://www.artix.com/launcher]Artix Entertainment Games Launcher 2.0[/url]. The launcher lets you play all of our web based games... and future proofs them.

notes.title: Early Access for Moglomancer has begun
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/243f983dac8d57257e821c54a66212e8c66173c0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Moglomancer released for early access[/h1]
Moglomancer is a new class that will be available for all players to earn. It was the big, final stretch goal from the [url=https://www.artix.com/moglins]Moglins Kickstarter[/url]. If you backed the Moglins Kickstarter, you get early access to the class starting now. If not, you still have time. We are shipping the Moglins now. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0622a01b8171fa1f01316d54e71aca6e39be684d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Moglomancer Class Skills[/h1]

It is a really fun class to play, and these new skills are going to add a lot of fun to the game.

[list]
[*][b]Zorbak's Bane[/b]
Call upon Zorbak to empower your weapon, dealing heavy damage and strengthening nearby allies. Increases your attack until another Moglin is called.
[*][b]Twilly's Blessing[/b]
    Call upon Twilly to heal all nearby allies. Auto-attacks heal allies and drain mana until another Moglin is called.
[*][b]Twig's Seal[/b]
    Call upon Twig to enchant your weapon, silencing your target. Auto-attacks regenerate mana until another Moglin is called.
[*][b]Passive: Moglin Reach[/b]
    Unlocks at rank 4... increasing the size of all area effect abilities
[*][b]Ultimate: MOGLIN PUNT[/b]
    Rear back and pummel a Moglin through your enemies. Don't worry, they enjoy it. The Moglins, not your enemies.
[*][b]Cross Skill: Blizzy's Blizzard Blitz[/b]
Blizzy's Blizzard Blitz is the the Moglomancer's Cross Skill. Summon Blizzy to slow all enemies nearby.  Once unlocked you can equip this on any class. We will be improving the functionality of this spell next week.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4b190fb7b52376d8fcc82239586dc9977d7ee860.jpg[/img]
[h1]27,000 Moglins just arrived at our lab[/h1]
If you have been following my [url=https://twitter.com/artixkrieger/]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ArtixKrieger/]Facebook[/url], then you probably saw photos of that truck filled with 27,000 Moglins that showed up at our "Secret Underground Lab". Which... also a secret... is apparently on the second floor XD. The entire dev team went into the sun *gulps* and worked together to unlock the truck and bring the Moglins in. We are, as you guessed, in the early stages of a packing and shipping frenzy this week. It is a pretty big deal. This is the largest order of physical products we have ever shipped out of the lab. We were surprised at how awesome the Moglins turned out. Their colors are perfectly vibrant and they are even better than the prototypes. 

Each Moglin includes a code that unlocks a matching in-game Moglin plush pet in AdventureQuest 3D. Late backers have one final chance to [url=https://www.artix.com/moglins]get them with all the Kickstarter rewards[/url]. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2eb6187089808d35b592b8e702721342203c68e4.jpg[/img]

[h1]When will Moglomancer be available for all player's to earn?[/h1]
The quests to get the full Red Moglomancer set will not be released until the Moglomancer class goes live for all players. Currently it is in early access as promised to the Moglin Kickstarter backers. After the early access period ends, this class will become available for all players to earn along with the quests for the Twilly-themed red Moglomancer armor set. Like our previous early access classes, we expect this to be roughly a month. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/cb573f84887f44b7a2f83324ed53d849024830fa.jpg[/img]

[h1]Coming next: Arcangrove[/h1]
Next week's major story release is the magical forest of Arcanegrove. It is home to the Tower of Magic. Unlike our previous multi-part Sagas, we are doing Arcangrove story in a single release. Hope you enjoy it.

notes.title: 1 vs 1 Duels are LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a50cdf675076edeb92f6456c34d4331e0bbdf45e.jpg[/img]

[h1]1 vs 1 PvP is now live! Battle players anywhere in the world.[/h1]
Town has come alive with players dueling. As you read this, a bar fight is breaking out in Yulgars. It's not perfect... but man is it exciting to watch and do! Come give it a try.
https://aq3d.com/news/duels_live/ 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0b33a84c17a81011982378483605bcaa8cdc8f07.jpg[/img]

[h1]How to Duel[/h1]
Target a player and click on their nameplate.... there is now an option to duel! Oh, be sure to turn on duel invites in the options. We disabled it by default because... well, you know why X_X

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7ec7dea5a736f79f48daddf45ec6f5d1f34e6d6c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Dueling 101: Get Gud or get Wrecked[/h1]

Bring potions, food, and buffs... anything goes. Duels are lawless and very dependent on your gear and stats. Read your opponent and choose your class wisely. There are many strategies to win, and many ways to maximize your attack and defense.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d473b7cb9d6ba38d327428551e9cd34f9439fb4f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Duel with Honor[/h1]
[b]"Why is everyone suddenly trying to duel me", says the player named Honor.[/b]
This first release of PvP dueling is super fun, but there are still a ton of things we need to improve. For example, it turns out spectators can heal... anyone. (Whoops). Please duel (and spectate) with honor and respect. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/12f4b9d8b7b3a594ecffc59fc2f904c676027d2a.jpg[/img]
[h1]Keeping Classy![/h1]
Many players say the classes Pirate, Ninja, and Mage are currently kings of the battlefield. Well, some players might argue that Necromancer, Paladin, and Rogue are beastly if played correctly too. While we will be making some tweaks, not every class is intended to be for PvP. Experiment with different classes and share your findings with the team.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7ec7dea5a736f79f48daddf45ec6f5d1f34e6d6c.jpg[/img]
[h1]Hope on an PvP in AdventureQuest 3D![/h1]
Dage has been addicted to dueling with players in town and the inn. He REALLY likes PvP. So if you see him in game, go for it. A handful of players can claim they downed him so far. He plays fair with perfectly normal stats and gear.

What's in store for the future of PvP? We have been discussing what you will be able to do in the upcoming area... from area matches, battle royale, and team vs team or faction vs faction battles.

Let us know what PvP features you would like to see in the comments section below. ([i]Co-op focused players, we can plot some new team based features in the next post.[/i]) PvP on!

For even more adventure, be sure to follow me on:
[b]Facebook: [/b]https://www.Facebook.com/ArtixKrieger
[b]Twitter:[/b] https://www.Twitter.com/ArtixKrieger
[b]Instagram: [/b]https://www.Instagram.com/Artix
[b]YouTube: [/b]https://www.Artix.com/YouTube

notes.title: "The Quest and Map one" - New AdventureQuest 3D version
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/55d79ceb2f324beb87e1ac5526d0be6a0fb2519a.jpg[/img]
[h1]"The Quest and Map one"[/h1]
[b]AdventureQuest 3D Version 1.19.23[/b]
AdventureQuest 3D's newest weekly release just dropped and now the world quests, side-quests, and other adventures can now span the entire world. And a map... so you can see that world. 

See the full post at https://aq3d.com/news/mapquest2_questmaps/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f814456ab1bb6831a3cbc1a34c8d5523f7cd39e6.jpg[/img]
[h1]New and Improved Quest System[/h1]
Previously, our games quests were designed like short stories. That is, they were completely self contained to a single story... or "saga". But now, we busted down the walls allowing the main story, side stories, and other adventures to span the entire world. It also makes it easier for you to track your quests. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/098be02e3d4f8da54056212c538c7a5d45d7cd9a.jpg[/img]
[h1]Rusty[/h1]
Professional player support Dog. Read Rusty's story here... 
https://aq3d.com/news/rusty/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7d2c3f738d6b95392ca4ae83c3e7632ba288011d.jpg[/img]
[h1]The Adventuer's Pack is our official "Starter Pack"[/h1]
Includes 500 DragonCrystals, the entire Lore Strider armor Set, gold, and XP Potions.... it is our official starter pack created for new players which costs $1.99. But if you were already a Guardian when it was released... congrats, you got it injected into your account for free!

tags.feature: AdventureQuest 3D's newest weekly release just dropped and now the world quests, side-quests, and other adventures can now span the entire world. And a map... so you can see that world.

Previously, our games quests were designed like short stories. That is, they were completely self contained to a single story... or "saga". But now, we busted down the walls allowing the main story, side stories, and other adventures to span the entire world. It also makes it easier for you to track your quests.

Includes 500 DragonCrystals, the entire Lore Strider armor Set, gold, and XP Potions.... it is our official starter pack created for new players which costs $1.99. But if you were already a Guardian when it was released... congrats, you got it injected into your account for free!

Next week, we are on track to release 1 vs 1 PvP fighting. You can test it now on the PTR along with the upcoming Moglomancer class. The magical forest of Arcangrove, Tower of Necromancy, and the Battleon Coliseum are currently being crafted by the content team.

notes.title: PTR Testing! 1 vs 1 PvP and the New Quest System
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9993c4a62b47645419bcd85e55642c87ae8e33ed.jpg[/img]
[h1]Testing New Quest System & PvP Duel System[/h1]
On the [url=https://aq3d.com/news/ptr/]PTR (testing server)[/url] we are testing the new quest system and 1 vs 1 player vs player combat... read on for more.
https://aq3d.com/news/quest_duel_testing/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/50dae4945a2fc489c9128f54eff61629691faa65.jpg[/img]
[h1]PvP! New 1 vs 1 Player duels[/h1]
On the testing server you can now start a fight with another player. Needless to say, this new feature will need a little more testing than the others. You can battle anywhere. Just target a player and click on their nameplate. 

[b]NOTE:[/b] Bug hunters looking to thoroughly test this for exploits should try to find edge cases where dueling allows you to harm NPCs, other players, or things not involved in the combat. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f814456ab1bb6831a3cbc1a34c8d5523f7cd39e6.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Quest System[/h1]
The goal is the new quest system is allow quests to span the entire world. Also, to make it easier to tell where they take place. Be sure to read the full details in the previous post about the new questing system.  Based on feedback so far, we have removed the "teleport" button. Please let us know if you think it should be put back in. 

[h1]Starter Pack[/h1]
Also, we are releasing our new starter pack next Tuesday. Are you already a Guardian or Collector's Guardian? If so... we are injecting these new starter pack straight into your character for free when it goes live. Thank you for being such an awesome supporter of AdventureQuest 3D and its updates! For those who have not yet supported the game, there is still time to get Guardian before the package is added. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/11cc27971faae7932cdf65fef05cd73e4131dac0.jpg[/img]

Let's have a little fun in the sun. This week's theme is "Hero's under the sun!" Send selfies or group photos with your friends and comment it to Artix's Tweet for a chance to score a Emperor's Chest -OR- the 2019 Summer Collection.
https://aq3d.com/news/screenshotsaturday21-swimsuit/

notes.title: New Battleon! Welcome Home.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9cd51d83883adb73b6d7d7a7bc096c6125631c74.jpg[/img]
[h1]Welcome Home... to New Battleon![/h1]
The Mages time bubble spell allowed months of building to happen in what was a mere instant to us. Behold, our burning hometown has been rebuilt into an entire city! Login and see for yourself...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7a1b29413845fd57fd1c431bb4ee86c67f37c9d4.jpg[/img]
[h1]The Districts[/h1]
Town is divided into 4 Districts and one cemetery, in a ring surrounding Guardian Tower. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7a1b29413845fd57fd1c431bb4ee86c67f37c9d4.jpg[/img]
[h1]Battleon Town Square[/h1]
The New Battleon Town Square is the main district. In this area you will find the Travel Crystal, Bank, Cysero's Forge, Aria's Petshop, Yulgar's Inn and Bev's Barber Shop. You will also find Prim, the Class Recruiter for quick access to new classes. This area is more-or-less everything that was in old Battleon all in one easy to reach district. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fe0c7eb48080c5b47a8643ad47196fe03ecb4c39.jpg[/img]

The Social District is a nice spot to grab some dinner...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9841b049c54133eba33336190bc067c720009660.jpg[/img]
[h1]The Social District[/h1]
The Social district is the future home of the Guild Hall, Battleon Real Estate where you will go to buy your own house when we release player housing. There's a stage for another band  to play at (you may or may not find several spots around the band that allow you to dance). We want to make this area a lot of fun to just hang out in and when we have parties or celebrations we hope to dress this area up extra special. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3a824a0be9a84856f2df324d6a6862c8248b27d5.jpg[/img]
[h1]The Trade District[/h1]
Next is the Trade district. This is the new home of Brigette and B.U.I.L.D. We plan to eventually make this the home player based gathering skills like fishing, mining, cooking and whatever else we can cook up. We want to have these skills play a very large part in how you play and the things you can craft so they needed their own home. If we ever able to make it a reality, this might even be the home of a player-based auction house (but that's a very big project)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0b9e3383184ba3c5b7c490f90d592464a5fa3623.jpg[/img]
[h1]The Scholar District[/h1]
Next comes the Scholar district. Warlic has his shop in this area. The Class trainers are there now too. This will also be the future home of the New Battleon Museum which you will fill up with your adventures (and might be able to see replays of historical events like the time Vane burned down Battleon), and the future home of the New Battleon Library.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/de2b8b65e142d8a33376ec2b7d615988f93a88f5.jpg[/img]
[h1]The Cemetery[/h1]
Finally, there's the cemetery. This place is dead. 

Seriously though, with the undead being so prominent a part of Lore, you can expect shenanigans. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a880100937ca4feaf8378d7548b7b11060502ef5.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Tutorial[/h1]
As soon as you enter town, you will be swept up into the new tutorial elements that new players will experience. They will be taught about classes, the Quest Board (a new piece of functionality that I'll get into in a minute), How to craft things, Death introduces you to the Portal Runes (plot stuff) and gives you a Travel Crystal Shard. 

The Travel Crystal Shard is a item that each player will receive. It cannot be removed from your inventory but does not take up any inventory space and you can use it from anywhere to return to Battleon. Much simpler than finding then using the nav menu in the settings. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/840461a80830e32ef7f68c2e8e6c37f2c1d97fdc.jpg[/img]
[h1]The Quest Board - Herald Of Hope Set[/h1]
The Quest Board is the new home for Daily Boss Dungeons, Random Adventures and two new sections Local Jobs and Level Quests.

Local Jobs will help guide you through adventurers in New Battleon. For example, you will receive a quest to help Bev in the Barber Shop and that quest will remain active in New Battleon until you complete Bev's entire quest chain. Once it's done, you can turn it in and it directs you to the Bank, and so on. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b256d297df4eeba93f75b10b77902abc218e4214.jpg[/img]

Level quests are new quests to give players something to do. They are divided into levels 1-10, 11-15, 16-20 and 21-25. Whatever level you are, the proper level option will be the last one available to you until you level unto your new bracket. These quests all reward you with LEVEL TOKENS that you can use to slowly craft the HERALD OF HOPE set at Cysero's Forge. BTW, Battle Gem and Daily Boss crafting are both now on Cysero too. 

Once you craft all the cosmetic versions of the Herald of Hope set you can use your Level Tokens and the cosmetic version of this set to craft a LEVEL 27 full set of the Herald of Hope!
[h1]LEVEL 27?![/h1]
Yeah, we raised the level cap to 27 in this release! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c2f1e95b7bdbbd513b77a20d66f2cdc64d03ff4c.jpg[/img]
[h1]This Is Just The Beginning! [/h1]
There tons of little areas to explore in the new town and we want to fill each one with something cool to do eventually but for the time being we have added a few exploration badges and tiles for you to search for.  See if you can find them all!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9cd51d83883adb73b6d7d7a7bc096c6125631c74.jpg[/img]

tags.feature: The Mages time bubble spell allowed months of building to happen in what was a mere instant to us. Behold, our burning hometown has been rebuilt into an entire city!
Town is divided into 4 Districts and one cemetery, in a ring surrounding Guardian Tower.

The New Battleon Town Square is the main district. In this area you will find the Travel Crystal, Bank, Cysero's Forge, Aria's Petshop, Yulgar's Inn and Bev's Barber Shop. You will also find Prim, the Class Recruiter for quick access to new classes. This area is more-or-less everything that was in old Battleon all in one easy to reach district.

The Social district is the future home of the Guild Hall, Battleon Real Estate where you will go to buy your own house when we release player housing. There's a stage for another band  to play at (you may or may not find several spots around the band that allow you to dance). We want to make this area a lot of fun to just hang out in and when we have parties or celebrations we hope to dress this area up extra special.

Next is the Trade district. This is the new home of Brigette and B.U.I.L.D. We plan to eventually make this the home player based gathering skills like fishing, mining, cooking and whatever else we can cook up. We want to have these skills play a very large part in how you play and the things you can craft so they needed their own home. If we ever able to make it a reality, this might even be the home of a player-based auction house (but that's a very big project)

Next comes the Scholar district. Warlic has his shop in this area. The Class trainers are there now too. This will also be the future home of the New Battleon Museum which you will fill up with your adventures (and might be able to see replays of historical events like the time Vane burned down Battleon), and the future home of the New Battleon Library.
Finally, there's the cemetery. This place is dead.

As soon as you enter town, you will be swept up into the new tutorial elements that new players will experience. They will be taught about classes, the Quest Board (a new piece of functionality that I'll get into in a minute), How to craft things, Death introduces you to the Portal Runes (plot stuff) and gives you a Travel Crystal Shard.

The Travel Crystal Shard is a item that each player will receive. It cannot be removed from your inventory but does not take up any inventory space and you can use it from anywhere to return to Battleon. Much simpler than finding then using the nav menu in the settings.
The Quest Board is the new home for Daily Boss Dungeons, Random Adventures and two new sections Local Jobs and Level Quests.

Local Jobs will help guide you through adventurers in New Battleon. For example, you will receive a quest to help Bev in the Barber Shop and that quest will remain active in New Battleon until you complete Bev's entire quest chain. Once it's done, you can turn it in and it directs you to the Bank, and so on.

Whatever level you are, the proper level option will be the last one available to you until you level unto your new bracket. These quests all reward you with LEVEL TOKENS that you can use to slowly craft the HERALD OF HOPE set at Cysero's Forge. BTW, Battle Gem and Daily Boss crafting are both now on Cysero too.
Once you craft all the cosmetic versions of the Herald of Hope set you can use your Level Tokens and the cosmetic version of this set to craft a LEVEL 27 full set of the Herald of Hope!
Yeah, we raised the level cap to 27 in this release!

There tons of little areas to explore in the new town and we want to fill each one with something cool to do eventually but for the time being we have added a few exploration badges and tiles for you to search for. See if you can find them all!

notes.title: May the 4th be with yooOOMG they burned down our town!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/eee749eb938b36750ed0676d567434f6be094740.jpg[/img]
[h1]We're just about to celebrate "May the 4th be with you"... but our home town of Battleon is now a smoldering pile of ash![/h1]
It actually happened. Vane's army burned every building in your town to the ground. In fact, Vane is on his way now to address you personally. We expect it to happen when the war meter hits 66%. Yes, there's a war meter. It fills up when you collect rocks and wood. Because, Vane can take our home from us... but he cannot take our spirits. We're going to rebuild.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/6d757d177059601b6156d7c55aace16e0d514209.jpg[/img]
[h1]Melodia & Campbell rally heroes to rebuild Battleon![/h1]
We fought to the last stone... which, apparently Gaz wants to sell. Greedly little @#$. But we NEVER GIVE UP! We're going to rebuild it. Bigger. Better. A new town? NO. This time, we're building a CITY. Help gather the resources. ALL monsters across the world now drop stone and wood. Collect and bring it to Brigitte the builder. You can find her and her crafting shop in the ashes that were once our town. You can also craft a "Last Brick" of Battleon from her for free. Because... 10g says Gaz's brick came from Falconreach.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/385aa5b01784230e94c712ef24de50cd7c085023.jpg[/img]
Be part of this Special World Event!

Login and be a part of this once-in-a-lifetime special event. New cutscenes will unlock as the war reaches 33%, 66%, and 100% on the builder. There are also new B.U.I.L.D. armors to craft. From the ashes of our former town, together, we will build our biggest, strongest, best version of Battleon ever. Heroes are defined in their most challenging moments. This moment, is ours... together, will make Vane regret ever stepping his armored foot into our home.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fbab4c01e8dce1dda433a089e821206ab8c5837b.jpg[/img]

[b]P.S.[/b] Join [url=https://aq3d.com/news/screenshotsaturday16/]this week's #ScreenShotSaturday[/url] to document this event, and also for a chance to score some treasure chests. I think there's 30 up for grabs this week. Hey, it's only two or three times per game that the town gets wrecked this bad :D


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0ca06c90239ced8a5108bcc90120525984942846.jpg[/img]
[h1]"The Target Lock One" or "The Camera One"... whichever you like better.[/h1]
In the newest version of AdventureQuest 3D, the main bad guy burns your town to a crisp while the team makes the experience of observing the carnage 26.9% more better-er. Improvements include:

[list]
[*]TARGET LOCK!!!!
[*]Camera & Targeting improvements. (Things will not pop at you when you move to close to them any more
[*]Fixed Pirate showing wrong Ultimate Skill in Class Interface.
[*]Minor quest flow fixes.
[*]Party Member target are no longer dropped based on distance.
[*]Drop target logic is now based on camera view instead of character rotation
[*]Added multi-step tutorial framework (What even is this!? Sounds fancy)
[*]If the Area of Effect target is off, the character will face the camera view instead
[/list]

These changes should make the game more fun to play on both Mobile and Computers.

Read all the newest official posts at [url=https://www.aq3d.com]www.AQ3D.com[/url]

notes.title: Updated Game Plan!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d0fdf4d6bf29b265a9710f3e6bf27dd16e3682cd.jpg[/img]

[h1]AdventureQuest 3D's Updated Game Plan!
[/h1]
We are officially in a 2-month mega sprint! I updated AdventureQuest 3D's [url=https://aq3d.com/game-plan/]official Game Plan[/url] plan so you can see exactly what we are working on.

The "BIG 3" from this list will be the world story (which revolves around the new Battleon... big enough that we should call it a citadel. ), Game improvements (combat, inventory, questing), and smoothing out the new player experience. On the Game Plan webpage, you will see a larger list of upcoming areas in our world. I do not think seeing the list will be a spoiler. Many long time players very likely expected to see a lot of these places. There are certainly a few places that WERE NOT added to that list... for good reason. XD

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4152acae43376cda8373279d037f1e42b7acaa39.jpg[/img]

[h1]"Fight to the Undeath"[/h1]
Did you ever want to summon undead and fight them? We have been experimenting with a way to do just that as a part of the Tower of Necromancy. As you unlock pages of the tower's evil spell book, you will be able to summon increasingly more powerful minions. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/12b2e9b89227347333a50f5be6a9fa1057ea08a4.jpg[/img]

[h1]One of the best April Fools events yet![/h1]
[b]...and it tested a new feature.[/b]
For two weeks we had been talking about how Cysero was trying to craft things the strange and shape-shifting substance called "mutatium". Resulting into last Monday's April Fool's gag where the mutatium got into the air. Players, pets, monster, and characters all got randomly shaped and sized... even in cutscenes. It was hilarious... See for yourself in the screenshot gallery. Many players wisely figured out that this was also a test to see how feasible it would be to eventually allow character size & shape customization.

[h1]Last weekend for April Fools items[/h1]
Hop on this weekend and get your April Fools items from the shop. The shop will disappear on Monday for another year. 

[h1]Thank you[/h1]
On behalf of the entire team, thank you for making AdventureQuest 3D possible. The next 2 months of development are going [url=https://aq3d.com/game-plan/]push our team far past our existing limits[/url]. Keep an eye on the game plan. I will keep it updated weekly for you as we do whatever it takes to make the game bigger and more fun for you. 

[b]Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

notes.title: Raise the Fallen
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/226ae57d452157d400705032cf083b700c2b4d35.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Isle of the Dead isn't finished with you yet, hero. [/h1]
We have just expanded the island!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/1895c4f96462175ff097ceadf0ab1c030f78937d.jpg[/img]

[h1]A Beacon In The Darkness[/h1]

Passing ships have become a problem for the Isle of the Dead. The Mistress of the Tower of Necromancy has commanded apprentice necromancer, Sacrum Deadsea, to come up with a solution for the problem. Help him build his beacon and he has a nice new item to give you as a reward! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/61f54ffc60d511a1281a1b3197fbf5bf84ae519a.jpg[/img]

New Exploration Badges & Titles

Three brand new exploration badges have been added to the Isle of the Dead. Search high and low until you discover all three and claim the titles for yourself! 

"Or... you know... just use people's friend codes and teleport to them like some kind of goon who is allergic to fun." - Cysero

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/313b1df1bf93cf98a1af51286cb193c033b3e1f6.jpg[/img]
Journey to the Isle of the Dead to begin your training as a Necromancer, and create the key (now upgradable to level 25) that will unlock the Tower of Necromancy in the next major release. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/df644871e3f5e7eaa9cf39cd9dcc1d0eec6e974c.jpg[/img]

[h1]NO APRIL FOOLS JOKE THIS YEAR![/h1]
[b]A selection of April Fools seasonal rares will be returning on Monday[/b]
Monday is April 1st. So I am writing to tell you, with 100% certainty, that we will not have any jokes or pranks. You're just too smart for it. You caught us two years ago when we said toddlers got into our server room replacing all of our in-game art with crayon. Or that time we turned every character in the game into a stick figure to "save on bandwidth costs". We get it. Your on to us. So nope... not gonna do anything Monday.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e8334290acd953cbf98ce2a22b75d8e0602a16b5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Cysero's Mutatium Experiments[/h1]
For the past two weeks, everyone's favorite "Mad Weapon Smith" has been experimenting with an unstable crafting material called Mutatium. Gaz sold it to him. It keeps randomly shifting and changing its form. He thought it might be easier to work with if he reduced it into Mutatium dust. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/54d0a2d4bb2ce050e9a2167b89870ff5dfa87ebd.jpg[/img]

[h1]Thank you and coming next week![/h1]
Behind the scenes, this was a huge week for AdventureQuest 3D. We are currently in early access, but have been laying out the new game plan which will take us to 100% live. Be sure to check out the official www.AQ3D.com and read the daily design notes we have been writing you. On the last design notes, Cysero sorta leaked that we had a big opportunity for AdventureQuest 3D pop up... we are going for it. Cross your fingers for it. If we pull it off, we will create the most incredible in-game experience in the history of our gaming community.

Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team

[h1]The Isle of Dead.... unlock the Tower of Necromancy.[/h1]
The ferryman of DoomWood will now take you to... the Isle of the Dead. A place brimming with sinister secrets that only you can uncover. Should you brave the undead there, and be judged worthy, perhaps you will gain entrance to the Tower of Necromancy. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/589ddab062e10c2ba1c4048a64c6334b82f2e0f6.jpg[/img]
[h1]Viscerra Vex - Master of the Spirit Crystals[/h1]
A new cast of strange characters awaits you on the Isle of the Dead. Viscerra Vex is every Paladin's nightmare. Her gift is bottling the spirit energy of the fallen into batteries... an elegant craft of evil.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e898f2ce040f18c257c55f58a22bf75928cca232.jpg[/img]
[h1]Mazrak the Mad - Yup, he's crazy. Or... is he?[/h1]
Not everyone on this island has secrets to share, however. In fact, some of them are just flat-out crazy, like Mazrak the Mad. Or... is he? I dunno, hanging out on a nearly-deserted island of the undead can do that to you.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/8a9ff26a9eb45a5379c9e1dfca06532442d877d5.jpg[/img]
[h1]Lady of the Crimson Lake[/h1]
Once upon a time, a hero sat by by the scarlet waters of the Crimson Lake. Gazing into the distance, there was a skeletal hand... reaching out as if waiting to be handed something.  Something you only thought could happen to Kings in legends.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4d8489ceeb63d440fe760317f69bdfef25959aef.jpg[/img]
[h1]The Undead Legion awaits... [/h1]
In other un-deadly news, there is still time to get this year's  [url=/news/dage_2019_arena_of_souls/]Dage Collection 2019[/url] . This sinister set includes owerful weapons of chaos and destruction... should you choose to wield them. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/313b1df1bf93cf98a1af51286cb193c033b3e1f6.jpg[/img]
[h1]Become a Necromancer[/h1]
If creating a powerful force of undead minions sounds exciting to you, talk to Stygis in DoomWood. Begin the journey to becoming a [url=/news/necromancerclasslive/]Necromancer[/url]. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/363ebae3cfc0bf6d19f3fb0ad5b65aa4ec247de3.jpg[/img]
[h1]"Mutatium could lead to a potential scientific discovery," says mad weaponsmith Cysero.[/h1]
Cysero bought a mysterious material from the shady black market sales-sneevil, Gaz. Cysero is has been experimenting on how to forge it into something useful. But it keeps changing shape! ([u]We're not actually sure where this is going... but you might want to keep up to date with Cysero's news posts.[/u])

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fd501fc49f2683b37a45a4cd13cd43edc8ae030a.jpg[/img]
[h1]Thank you & see you in the Isle of the Dead[/h1]
We hope you enjoy this new AdventureQuest 3D story release. While I promise you there will certainly be brighter releases in the future... this one begins a dark journey which will take you into realms never meant for the good, nor living.

[b]Battle on![/b]
[b]Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

notes.title: Necromancer Class! Now available for all players to unlock.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/313b1df1bf93cf98a1af51286cb193c033b3e1f6.jpg[/img]
[h1]Necromancer class available for all players to earn![/h1]
Visit Stygis and take your first step to becoming a Master of the Undead! Learn how to make your own friends. It's sorta like a healer class for really, really, really late heroes. Sorta.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4125340e8e50f03c6ce7213fbe0ee69179efe309.png[/img]
[h1]Necromancer Class[/h1]
Necromancers are magic users who have mastered control over the forces of life and death. They use their dark powers drain the souls of the living and summon undead servants which obey their every command. Using souls which you harvest upon slaying foes, you can cast the following spells.
[list][*][b]Default Cast[/b] - A ranged attack that pulls out your foes life force feeding your soul count.[/*][*][b]Soul Siphon[/b] - Rip Souls from the target, dealing damage. Deals increased damage and steals Health from enemies recently attacked by summoned minions.[/*][*][b]Dark Decay[/b] - Inflict an enemy with necrotic Decay, dissolving the target's Armor and dealing damage over time. Decay transfers Souls to the Necromancer.[/*][*][b]Summon Undead[/b] - Expend Souls and summon an undead minion to attack your target. Summoned minions do not survive long.[/*][*][b](ULTIMATE) Grand Summon[/b] - Tap into the true forces of necromancy, summoning a powerful creature with the ability to Taunt groups of enemies.[/*][*][b](CROSS-SKILL)[/b] [b]Bone Prison[/b] - Summon a cage of bone to hold your enemy.[/*][/list]

[h1]Isle of the Dead scheduled for release next week[/h1]
In the distance... you can see the Tower of Necromancy. Are you curious as to what secrets wait inside? Necromancers crave the power promised there. Paladins want someone to infiltrate it. Alas... "one does not simply walk into the Tower of Necromancy." (Fewer walk out alive.) Battle on!

notes.title: LIVE! Dage's Arena of Souls and 2019 Collection
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/092ed96b4b547aba3580a14ef4ef1b307612482a.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Undead Legion Quests, Challenge, and the Dage 2019 Collection[/h1]
[b]"Long Un-live the Undead Legion!"[/b]
Return to the underworld and continue your story with Dage the Evil and the Undead Legion. This release features something for everyone... especially players level 25!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4d8489ceeb63d440fe760317f69bdfef25959aef.jpg[/img]
[h1]Get the 2019 Dage Collection![/h1]
This... this collection is unbelievable. Featuring the combined art of Dage, Thyton, and Darkon this collection includes a legion undead horse rider travel form, the three-headed cerberus pet, a floating legion tome pet (you can see it floating in the air above), a skeletal legion dravir travel form, and the darkest array of armor and weapons that... well, there are so many that I was unable to get them all into this screenshot. Head to town or the underworld to see them for yourself. 

You can get your favorite pieces separately, or buy the ENTIRE COLLECTION of 27 items ([u]worth 14,700 DragonCrystals[/u]) for only 4,900 DragonCrystals. Which also includes a rare title, rare badge for your character page, and also gives you permanent year round access to your items saving your inventory space.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4b4d3eabc741290aef1930ac71e41d2fb5942fda.jpg[/img]
[h1]Enter the Arena of Souls[/h1]
If you completed last year's quests you found out a lot about Dage's past-- and if your soul was worthy enough to join the legion. Now, are you ready for the challenge? Continue the story to begin your training. This is worth leveling up for.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/18e039badb3562277d5eea45ed85966bdce7e458.jpg[/img]
[h1]The 1st Craftable Legendary Armor in game![u][/u][/h1]
In our previous games, Dage's quests were always designed as a challenge for very high level players who felt like they had already done everything in the game. They were incredibly grindy tests of endurance. These new quests in Dage's Arena of Souls is NO different! The reward of such efforts? The Legion Heretic armor is our very first level 25 Legendary craftable armor. The complete set is epic and wicked. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/696cea4ff9e82ef1d5b4eb502cca3eb7210ba4e0.jpg[/img]
[h1]Score a Lil' Dage pet in any of your Daily Chests![/h1]
For the next 3 months, any daily chest has a chance of dropping a Lil' Dage pet.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0c0da12d42036e0262dfd30a5f1b0edd677de756.jpg[/img]
[h1]Player vs Player Test Happening Now in the Guardian Tower[/h1]
Guardians! Come to the Guardian Tower and help us test out PvP. Next week we will be working on the next round of PvP improvements and changes based on your feedback.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0a269eb805eb7826e36c671175a3f5dab3f46e7d.jpg[/img]
[h1]Thank you & Long Un-live The Undead Legion![/h1]

We are celebrating Dage's birthday... and it's pretty awesome that for his birthday he works extra hard to create these things for you.

notes.title: Surprise! You can PvP on the public test server right now.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/51db2fc321909d13894549d91e766a29711b5be4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Player vs Player (PvP) now available for all players to test[/h1]
Well, that escalated quickly. The very first version of PvP is in testing now, and if you can play AdventureQuest 3D on STEAM, you can give it a try. Needless to say it is pretty primitive... but oh man is it a lot of fun. We need help testing, reporting bugs, and thinking up clever things to do.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f8bad8cb6574cffe0b27851545bb5727caa2f27d.jpg[/img]

[h1]PvP is... really fun![/h1]
Gotta say, had some reservations about this but OMG it is a blast. Broke my 10 year streak of not PvPing with any players.  Did not regret. Other than Owl will probably post a video of it on his YouTube channel, LOL! At least you know I was preoccupied taking screenshots and messing with stuff XD

When you travel to PvP from your travel menu, you will appear in a secret part of the Guardian Tower. You will already have been automatically assigned to a team. The enemy team is waiting for you... but that is OK, you start in a "safe area" where you cannot be hurt. Once you cross the threshold into the main room, it is anything goes. Potions work, Paladin heals work, Necromancer works. The Ninja's sprint ability is no longer a laughing stock once you use warrior, Paladin, or any other melee class. A well composed team makes all the difference. Two mages and a warrior are a wrecking ball.  It surprised me how fun it was... and there are not even any objectives yet. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/54ad79d8dada4c94cade83ba8f9b719790c98d11.jpg[/img]

[h1]When will PvP be released on the LIVE game server?[/h1]
We made a smart call putting PvP on our testing server first. A lot of stuff is going to need rapidly fixed, changed, balanced, and de-bugged. Unfortunately, it is only possible to experience this on STEAM right now. I really wish there was an easier way to do this on mobile. But it will not be long before everyone can try out PvP on the live servers from your phone, tablet, and PC/Mac/Linux etc. Again, we have a date in mind... but I do not want to say it and jinx myself (again). Currently on the public test server, anyone can try it out (even through it says it is Guardian Only). But, as promised, PvP will initially available to Guardians only.
How to access AdventureQuest 3D's Public Test Game & Server

Switching between the live and public test versions of AdventureQuest 3D is pretty easy. In your STEAM game library, right click on AdventureQuest 3D. If AdventureQuest 3D is not already in your FAVORITES list >_> this is clearly a human error and you need to "Add to favorites." XD OK, that is not mandatory... but it will certainly make it easier to get to the game later. To switch your game version, right click on AdventureQuest 3D and click on "Properties". Then choose the "BETAS" tab. Then choose "publictest - PTR". It installs super quick, the game client is surprisingly small. When you log in, it will let you know you are on the PTR version and tell you how to switch it back if you cannot find this post for some reason :D

To switch back to the normal version  simply right click AdventureQuest 3D, choose properties, choose the BETAS tab, and then choose "NONE - Opt out of all Beta Programs". This will set you back to the normal version of the game.

I highly recommend clearing your cache after switching between the normal and PTR games. This button wipes out all the map files, temp data, etc. You will automatically download the newest map files the first time you go to them.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a453f98466db2b4257f6136c4a186878b7701011.jpg[/img]

[h1]How to get to the PvP map in game[/h1]
When you are inside the game, just open your menu and choose travel. PvP is the top option. Open your Menu and choose Travel. It will take you to our little PvP testing room deep within a dungeon.

See you on the Battlefield! - Artix

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/72ee08c621c25ce837c7980d98e52db87c7705ad.jpg[/img]

I wonder where Gaz "found" these new items?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/59bb7075ae8ccf8a38c2b70bcab03822285a6fc8.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/cde73320276425365c6d3dae2d2c51bb0fb68836.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Ninja Class Just released!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9c6dd184177e146383842c1adc7d13594a1ea451.jpg[/img]

[h1]Ninja Class just released in AdventureQuest 3D![/h1]
The Ninja class has just been released! Find Thyton (the guy in the golden spartan looking helm who may or may not be a ninja...) in town. He will show you the way... of the ninja.  But beware! The path to becoming a ninja is fraught with peril... and new craftable item and armor sets. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e142c022c3042dd732accf8af2f53b08d2efbae5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Wait... Ninja released before Paladin and Necormancer?[/h1]
Rule #1: Ninjas are sneaky. Ninjas... are ALWAYS sneaky. If you saw this coming, it wouldn't be a "ninja release".

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/467c75c5dabfc51ab9b7b04150881c94228c581c.jpg[/img]

[h1]If you want to truly understand a ninja, shadow walk a mile in their shadow shoes. [/h1]
In this week's new area, there are a ton of new permanent Thyton armor and item sets that you can craft.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4090b133c2a6f9d2a857fd78d065793a55856fa5.jpg[/img]

[h1]If the Shadow Walkers are of the day, then the Lightbringers are of the day[/h1]
Because if you're only training half the day, your wasting half the day. Lightbringers do not believe perfection is attainable.. (their armor is for the record)... but they believe in the relentless pursuit of becoming perfect. In doing this, they prepare their mind, body, and spirit for unthinkable threats. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/02e7b526ca2883e526be0580fbf9ab304d5183d7.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c2a567e66cd0b16c55bd3ec6815b0eeea7ca839d.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a4f292d102eb885c135418dc29af707f831cec1b.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/195e005f6f231063dbdc1ce93a0b744f01c29040.jpg[/img]

[h1]There are LOTS of amazing Thyton-made items in this release. [/h1]
We have received an overwhelmingly positive response from players that all of the items in Thyton's new area are craftable (no $$$ required) and permanent. 

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/rekoninjavideo/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/14b24a2a42e7e8b9ca4d635f1080c7aec83546cd.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Reko's Ninja Submission Video [/h1]
Meanwhile! Reko is a long-time friend and ninja competitor. For his submission video this year he creatively used AdventureQuest 3D footage. [url=https://aq3d.com/news/rekoninjavideo/]Want to see it?[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/artix/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/bcf1a133c7bcbac56762dfb76866fce32ec6e603.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]I'm @ARTIX on instagram![/h1]
Look ma, I'm only 10 years too late to this party. But I am plastering my instagram with behind the scenes pics and videos of the team and myself. [url=https://www.instagram.com/artix/][b]Follow @artix to see all the seeeecrets[/b][/url] (and potential blackmail material). 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/bc6b92d373504864d95b3a3fe70c39466bf2ddad.jpg[/img]

[h1]Thank you & Unleash your inner Ninja![/h1]

We hope you love this week's new Thyton adventure and achieve your goal of adding the Ninja class to your arsenal. Thyton is part of a team tracking down villains with unusual powers ("Most Wanted" seen in the image above.) This is the 1st of what will be a series of yearly releases that take place on the real-life Thyton's birthday. If you have been enjoying our new feature and adventure releases, please consider supporting us by becoming a Guardian or buying some DragonCrystals. Next up, we are working on the Kingdom of Battleon and the revamp of DoomWood-- including the Tower of Necromancy. 

Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team

P.S. Meanwhile... [url=https://aq3d.com/news/vane_the_void_king/]Vane has been securing his fortress and pantheon of villains[/url]. 
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/vane_the_void_king/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/92af87e92f109c7a3691e7af8f3dc136af70586a.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: LIVE! Rank up your Classes and Unlock Cross-Skills
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e0d4e7533b002295389637e724ac1f010e8e653b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Rank every class up to 10 & Unlock all the new Cross-Skills![/h1]

In today's new version of AdventureQuest 3D you can rank up your classes and unlock special cross-skills.... yup, these are new skills you can equip and use with any class! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e96e06ad7b23291c35fd8dbf72eca906797a8d1f.png[/img]

Necromancers unlock "Bone Prison" at rank 10 which summons a cage of bone to hold your enemy in place. This would be useful to equip to any class. Necromancer will be available for all players to earn when the Tower of Necromancy goes live in DoomWood soon.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/5419004cb4665f7167eda71ec6ecffde66a7f9a4.jpg[/img]

Rogues get Affliction at rank 10 which deals double damage and poisons the target. Equip this skill to any class to add some damage over time.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/95ba127fc548734fe4b4ae35964ff2a3d1fe87bb.jpg[/img]

Paladins unlock Holy Bolt at rank 10 which is a ranged attack, dealing damage to your foe and healing nearby allies. Equip this skill on any class to add a little extra healing power.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7550cb51dfa3887ca89cbce7bab8df9a2e35c8ec.jpg[/img]

Dragonslayers unlock the Rend skill at rank 10. Ever notice how some monsters resist your damage? This skill sneaks past the armor damaging more direct damage. This version is extremely effective against Dragons. Equip it to any class to become more effective at dealing damage.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7550cb51dfa3887ca89cbce7bab8df9a2e35c8ec.jpg[/img]

Warriors unlock Seismic Slam at Rank 10 which is an area-of-effect attack hitting everything in melee range. Add this skill to any class to have an AOE (Area of Effect) that is useful for pulling, or even just tagging lots of monsters so you are assured to get their loot.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/82139e73535b83638c62f48708056d3c4079cfea.jpg[/img]

Mages unlock the Rune Siphon at Rank 10 which places a magical rune on your foe dealing damage over time. It is similar to the Rogue's, but try this one out to see how it can be extra effective with your other classes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0a4ecc87fa1c3b0143ccb18370a11ff4ef4e9aa1.jpg[/img]

The Ninja unlocks the Spint skill at rank 10, giving you a sudden burst of speed. Now any class can become an Olympic pro-athlete short distance runner :D "Run forest, run!"

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f9c153e522c7e6200096d3eca2ccb98e8c66be62.jpg[/img]

Feeling lucky? Pirate class unlocks the Lucky Shot skill at rank 10. This is a guaranteed critical hit which, when used cleverly with some other classes abilities is likely to be a magnificent balancing nightmare :D Add this skill to any class to add a wicked K.O.

[h1]Hope you love Class Ranks! We're fixing bugs and want your feedback[/h1]

The team worked really hard on this release and we hope you are enjoying it. We are already neck-deep in fixing a number of bugs including the one where you see "other people's rank ups". Like all big game-play changing releases, we listen. So let us know both the things you like and the things you think need changed in the comments section of class ranks posts on the official website. 
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/rankupandunlockcrossskills/]https://aq3d.com/news/rankupandunlockcrossskills/[/url]

Also, we are working double hard to get all of the early access classes released so you and all players can earn them. The Necromancer is coming with the Tower of Necromancy, but we might need to put all classes on the trainers with daily quests to speed up the process. Good luck ranking up all your classes!

Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team 
[url=https://www.aq3d.com]www.AQ3D.com [/url]

notes.title: Parkour Challenge! Earn 3 badges in Box Springs
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/91ebee569fdfe3dafc9518637d7ada41814a18e3.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Parkour Challenge![/h1]
I heard you like parkour challenges... So we made you a brand new jump puzzle challenge in Greenguard forest. Can you get all three of the new badges? Be devious... one of them is a seeeeeecret. 

Also released this week... ThunderKnight armor, revamp of Livingstone Caverns, de-scaled Dage's Underworld, Moglomancer armor and more. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/08fb453f30961fef6fccdb8a839fef189f1d144c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Thunder... Thunder... Thunderknight! Armor. [/h1]
[b]Now available as a drop from any Treasure Chest[/b]
When you log into AdventureQuest 3D you now have a chance of getting Thunderknight armor in your free daily treasure chests. All chest types now drop it. It is fun to wear in dark places like the recently de-scaled Dage's Underworld as it features an emissive glow on the helm and shoulders. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ba33fe8bafd1e288fa77d08ab59fe341e38500bd.jpg[/img]
[h1]Livingstone Caverns Revamped![/h1]
The cave that leads into DoomWood has just been revamped. Cysero rewrote some of the quests, added 8 new dialogues (dialogue cutscenes did not exist when we first created it), and added new rewards. The cave art got a little art bump-- now it looks pretty! The story itself is pretty much the same, just told far better. Hope new players experiencing the cave for the first time have a much better experience than we all did! LOL

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d0ac97855f1c3885829314c951c8f708dcba9a6b.png[/img]
[h1]
Moglomancer Armor[/h1]
Backers of the [url=https://www.artix.com/moglins]Moglin Kickstarter or Backerkit[/url] can now get their Moglomancer-K armor set at the bank. This green version is the exclusive variant for being a backer.  Missed out? You can still [url=https://www.artix.com/moglins]back Moglins through backerki[/url]t for a limited time. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/8687656a3e4197ccd24708b743e74d01044519f4.jpg[/img]
[h1]Dage's Underworld gets "De-Scaled"[/h1]
It's happening! The first portion of Dage's Underworld is now officially fixed at level 15. We like the idea of having special events and some permanent areas released initially as scaling content so everyone can experience it... then, later hard-set it in the world at the originally intended level. This March, during Dage's Birthday, we will expand the underworld and continue the story.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e0c615038524f7d19f6aa22efbb9375865abb224.png[/img]
[h1]
Upcoming Live Event![/h1]
You are officially invited to dinner at the Blue Ogre Cave next Wednesday at 4pm EST. This will be a 30-ish minute live event in AdventureQuest 3D where you can score some live event coins and hang with friends. Exact location to be announced day of the event.
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZheH698Lq7A][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2f847ddfc0a6af1c30e6218fd27d80a7506f4d5a.jpg[/img][/url]
[h1]
Trailer Video for Box Springs Parkour Challenge[/h1]
Just before sending you this email, I hopped on, recorded, and made you a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZheH698Lq7A][b]little trailer[/b][/url]. Thank you to all of the players who fell mercilessly to their doom to make this video :D

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/thyton/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/60722dce795eb6aad0c001e8ca82674e461be72a.jpg[/img][/url]
[h1]Thyton... the fantasy embodiment of Special Ops.[/h1]
Amongst the killer releases we have coming your way, one to keep an eye on it the story of Thyton. For more on this interdimensional ninja, [url=https://aq3d.com/news/thyton/]read the design notes post I wrote for you[/url]. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/345dd779a84b1c206d9f245cb44cae52e7dfa165.jpg[/img]
[h1]Thank you & PARKOUR!!!!![/h1]
As I write this, Reko (Ninja Competitor) is putting together his submission video for the TV show using footage from AdventureQuest 3D.  Which is really cool! Also this morning, I re-wrote the storyline for the Tower of Necromancy... which is where you will go in the revamped Doomwood to learn how to be a Necromancer. If you have been enjoying our ongoing updates and have not already done so, please consider upgrading your account and becoming a Guardian. Not only do you get access to the Guardian Tower, class, armors, and mounts... but you also get that warm and fuzzy feeling of knowing you are making AdventureQuest 3D possible. 

Enjoy the new parkour course :D and... 

[b]Battle on!
Artix & your friends at AdventureQuest 3D[/b]

Not only do you get access to the Guardian Tower, class, armors, and mounts... but you also get that warm and fuzzy feeling of knowing you are making AdventureQuest 3D possible.
Enjoy the new parkour course :D and...

notes.title: Xur's Curse! New treasure chest items including Chaos's Grasp
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9de55a0fe9a749e34435791c8f676d20dd4ccfc5.png[/img]

Every day you log in and join us in AdventureQuest 3D, you get a free treasure chest to open! Now there are even more items for you to discover including the new ones pictured above. Xur's Curse is one of our favorite new items you can score. There are two versions: one you can wield and a pet that floats and follows you. Both feature a creepy animated eyeball. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/80af4cc08d167e58a0f97cc04603e4d6e9e53b7f.jpg[/img]

[h1]XUR'S CURSE & CHAOS'S GRASP[/h1]
Wielded by a treacherous and deceptive rogue, legend says that Xur's Bane was the dagger which did Xur in. She was the only one who could get close enough to kill Xur. Others tried, oh, so many tried. But Xur's sword was all seeing, for at the center of its hilt is an inhuman, glaring eye. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/269fff6c262d1366f34d048c67006ac69f4e2017.jpg[/img]

If that horrifying blade had a name, it has been lost to history. Now the sword is simply known as Xur's Curse.  It foresaw every attack, giving Xur an unstoppable advantage. Until, of course, the rogue appeared. Beguiled by her beauty and skill, Xur took her on as an apprentice. She got close to Xur... too close. 

As Xur laid in bed, dying from her dagger wound, he looked into his apprentice's eyes and said, "Thank you... for freeing me from the sword..."

She must have lived long enough to tell that tale but after that, no one knew what happened to the rogue or the two weapons.

Until today.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3e654c9af758c89d80004ae3256b1fd19bdaec2c.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Mask in Darkon's Birthday Shop[/h1]
Darkon has set up shop in town. He will only be around for a little while longer selling his suspicious "debris." He seems to have a few new ones you should check out...  if you dare.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=evf3_3ObG-0][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9ff27529ce6efa21b137451a773006aecd8e489e.jpg[/img][/url]
[h1]Artix Game Jam 2019[/h1]
Watch the results last week's [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=evf3_3ObG-0]Artix Game Jam on Youtube[/url]! The last project is a fun upcoming surprise for AdventureQuest 3D :D

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/kingdomofbattleon2019/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3a44790573f38dbdbc22413022fc9047da1fe72d.jpg[/img][/url]
[h1]Thank you & Coming Next in AdventureQuest 3D[/h1]
The Grim Reaper of Death has chosen you as his Champion (Lucky you!). Your unique abilities & skills make you the only one capable of solving the mystery of the elusive rune portal (which technically you have not seen yet... but it's coming) and using the ancient power within to defeat Vane and his pantheon of twisted villains. 

Are you chomping at the bit to take on our world's new story? Do you want to explore the [url=https://aq3d.com/news/kingdomofbattleon2019/]new Town of Battleon[/url]? Will you survive the new DoomWood? Or... will you enter the Tower of Necromancy and learn the dark arts for yourself? 

Thank you for supporting our ongoing development. Our world is going to explode in size in 2019. Follow our progress by reading our anything-goes Design Notes each day at www.AQ3D.com. 

Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D

notes.title: AQ3D Version 1.18.5 & New Random Adventures + Items
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/cb2872441ccd22225a4d955688e39cded26dc3d0.jpg[/img]

[h1]AdventureQuest 3D Version 1.18.5[/h1]

Ever wonder why AdventureQuest 3D versions have so many numbers and periods? Me too. But this update is definitely the most "point five-iest" of them all.
[list]
[*] New Random Adventures!
[*] New Craft-able items (Use the battle gems you get from random adventures)
[*]  Fixed that issue where your Daily Chest would not load properly (It was leaving the Chest unopened and still in your inventory.)
[*] Fixed that issue where fishing nodes could get stuck and stop working. (Go fish?)
[*] Fixed fullscreen images on certain resolutions where the close button was cut off.
[*] The item panel on a Dungeon Load screen will no longer be duplicated by triggering it multiple times.
[*] Gravity should now apply immediately on moving platforms (again).
[/list]



[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2cd63eefc6f2900865a1b4501b7439e2e14ff1ad.jpg[/img]
Also, you can now craft these item's at Cyseros Forge from doing the random adventures.

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/reko_ninjawarrior/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ad79b35ad49b37cef54ccf9bbbc47f8d9f2f93c1.jpg[/img][/url]
One of our Ninja Warrior friends is using AQ3D to film his submission video... you can check out the full design notes post at 
https://aq3d.com/news/reko_ninjawarrior/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/00760cf56b5bd852c2a3d0b6b094110837031606.png[/img]
My favorite new random adventure is the bar fight in yulgar's inn. Technically you can just stand back and let them punch each other to victory.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/23058140ea53e74b70a2b7f40dcc3a675ff2b01b.jpg[/img]
We were able to bring back a lot of our previous "orphaned" areas in this release. Places like Dragonwatch Keep that are no longer in the game will appear in the random rotation.

[url=http://www.artix.com/posts/gamejam2019/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4c9fd2b34a62f37565a61b6812d704273bf3b824.jpg[/img][/url]

We did a thing last week! Read about it here... 
[url=http://www.artix.com/posts/gamejam2019/]http://www.artix.com/posts/gamejam2019/[/url]
