notes.title: Darkon's Garage Sale of Debris
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fdc1d56524c92ef4708bec0745a93b7fda9e0491.jpg[/img]

[h1]Darkon's Garage Sale of Debris[/h1]
Introducing Darkon-- former hero turned artifact collector. It has become a yearly tradition to sell off the dregs of his immense collection to make room for more valuable pieces. Good new for you. Until you look at the price tag at least. What the heck is Darkon thinking? ...and something feels "unusual" about these items he is peddling.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c63f2f15d89e46e909b9a6280b0ef0e6d2aa62d8.jpg[/img]

[h1]Class Quests! Warrior, Mage, and Rogue[/h1]
Do you wish you could look more warrior-y, or mage-y, or rogue-y? Well now you can! Visit the class trainer shop and take on some quests to earn new class specific armor. Disclaimer: Side effects may include: big mage hat,  masked rogue hood, winged warrior helm, and a rash in the armpits and unspeakable places. Check with your healer if trainer class quests are right for you. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2cd63eefc6f2900865a1b4501b7439e2e14ff1ad.jpg[/img]

[h1]Dage flexes his artistic range[/h1]
Dage is famous for his dark and evil items... but it turns out he's not too shabby at making elegant & deadly things too. You will be able to craft these in next week's release-- which will add new random adventures to the travel crystal. Which is also, let's face it, is a filler quest week while the team participates in next week's game jam. #transparency

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3b4abe83b8bf2a16250e320f3c63120bed436356.jpg[/img]

[h1]"A Hero's Home is their Castle." [/h1]
Check out [url=https://aq3d.com/news/kingdomofbattleon2019/ ]the post I made for you that is filled to Llusions concept art of the upcoming Kingdom of Battleon[/url]. This is an important part of the bigger world of Lore we will be building together this year. 
https://aq3d.com/news/kingdomofbattleon2019/ 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/132e44a37c08855fe4624eb9dacdcfd047062583.jpg[/img]

[h1]Class ranks and Cross skills[/h1]
You can collect and switch between classes in AdventureQuest 3D. In testing now, is the system that will allow you to rank your class up. When you hit rank 10, you will unlock a "Cross Skill". This is a special skill that you can equip to any class. Read more about it at...
https://aq3d.com/news/classranksandcrossskills/ 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/dd7a436b9e83222e7b839f7a40f9aa172bf218ff.jpg[/img]

[h1]Thank you and on to 2019![/h1]
Hope your year is off to an amazing start. I posted a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Qxoob5cfbyc]youtube video of the fireworks thingy we did on New Year's eve[/url]. If you missed it, or liked it, then good news-- I want to do a lot more events like this. On this topic, ff you are doing the New Year's resolution, be sure to check out the lengthy [url=https://aq3d.com/news/2019ghouls/]"ghoul setting" guide[/url] I posted for you. The undead slaying Paladin themed video game motivational success planning post you never knew you needed. See you in game!

[b]Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

[b]P.S.[/b] MJ from MassivelyOverpowered is visiting the lab this weekend. 
[b]P.S.S.[/b] Ninja Warrior competitor Reko Rivera asked for our help building his submission video this year with segments of AdventureQuest 3D footage.

notes.title: Happy New Year 2019! Fireworks time XD
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0644b0670986864d371a4ea66398bd78053d4106.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bring in 2019 with explody fireworks mayhem in AdventureQuest 3D![/h1]

Firework monsters are in town for a limit time which drop... fireworks!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fbbc9a329c8ad4b6f0085d9593812968d628d351.jpg[/img]

[h1]Battle Fireworks and get... Fireworks![/h1]

There are barrels of fireworks walking around town... actually, they are Party Sneevils. Wack the barrel to unleash the chaos! They drop fireworks and defenders medals.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3413027ce9e3ec2968ef1738540a1255e00c2891.gif[/img]

[h1]Randomness on Artix's Birthday[/h1]

It is also Artix's birthday... so you know what he will be doing on his special day off. Logging into AdventureQuest 3D every few hours to do spontaneous live events to bring in the New Year of course!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b22e0f74ca4a5ac8756d09e961417c21e9223e99.gif[/img]


Be sure to grab your daily Treasure Chest reward when you log in. You might get one of the new items we added including Thor's hammer, the Holly Knight set, and more.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e5e858e9a1f3128063baeed162af8f61940c369c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Thank you and Battle On ...into 2019![/h1]

Come join us in game as we celebrate, kapow-splody stuffs, and bring in the New Year. Comment below with your favorite memories, AdventureQuest 3D releases, items, parkour maps, live streams (Korin?), weirder design notes, live events... or whatever moments you can think of that gave you a little smile in 2018. 

Be sure to check the design notes on https://www.AQ3D.com tomorrow for the VERY first post of 2019!

notes.title: BOSS FIGHT! Battle the Frostlorn.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4192b360b32108ffbd3c7391535db59f520844de.gif[/img]

Enter the Frost Castle. Yes, the one you could see in the skyline of Frostvale. But beware... *the rest of the note is torn, bitten, and shredded by giant monster teeth* 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/09ce6cf6c0a0ce9b6404b3e594987ce619df791e.jpg[/img]

All three parts of our wintery event are now live. Explore the moglin-filled town of Frostvale, play the special events from previous years, and at long last... enter the looming Frostlorn Castle.

Centered around the idea of letting a Frostlorn Necromancer reanimate gingerbread cookies & toy soldiers, this collection features two 160% speed travel form, a ton of new items, special RARE badge and title, "The Sleigher". Talk to Blizzy in town to get the items separately-- or, get the ENTIRE Frostval 2018 Collection which includes permanent access to the items which frees up your inventory space and saves you over 50% (Save 7,900 DCs). This is also a great way to support AdventureQuest 3D's ongoing development and new releases. 

[b]The Collection Includes [/b]
[list]
[*]Title "The Sleigher"
[*]Rare Character Page Badge 
[*]Blizzy's Gift - 160% speed Blizzy Travel Form
[*]Gingerbread Person- 160% speed Gingerbread Person Travel Form
[*]Long Red Frostval Hat
[*]Full item Set - Frostlorn Necromancer
[*]Full item Set - Toy Soldier & horrifying head morph
[*]Full item Set - Gingerbread & equally horrifying head morph
[*]Frostlorn Necromancer's Frost Dragonskull staff
[*]Tangled Lights Cape- wraps lights around your body
[*]Wreath On Your Back
[*]Wreath Chakram
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d49fd1b237c143c9a223b91c7cd0cedb6b45a3b2.jpg[/img]

[h1]If you're email is verified... good news![/h1]
Players with verified email addresses were just given a red Vampragon pet, the Doomhero Scythe, and also 250 more Dragon Crystals. Did you just miss out? You can verify your email in the account section of https://www.AQ3D.com to get your reward. Please note I only write you an email once a week and just like our other games, we never, ever, give or sell your email to anyone else. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0339e175c4206c3c363c7a036f60b832b4d09724.jpg[/img]

On behalf of all of us here at Artix Entertainment, we wish you & your family fun, safe, and adventure filled holidays.

notes.title: Journey to Frostvale!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/883a02f45a6c9860088ef2ec52117c6f7f8549f5.jpg[/img]

Happy Frostval! The time has once again arrived for heroes and frost moglins alike to crowd close around the hearth, sing merry Frostval tunes, and mercilessly slaughter snow monsters. 

Travel to Frostvale and explore the new town. While you're there, throw some snowballs at other heroes, quest through the holiday releases, and be sure to get that free ugly sweater armor for free... because it's free. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e4721ca8a7ac2d5381a3242791cd0bd086abd4be.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hurl a Snowball at someone[/h1]
You will find snowballs on the ground in Frostvale. Yup, you can throw them! Monsters also have a chance of dropping Sniper Snowballs. These have a 100% chance irritating the player you want to annoy the most. Just equip them to your skill bar and let 'er rip.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b7b6489cd14fb1e191ba38f759a6ae2fa71b19aa.jpg[/img]

[h1]Craft new Frozen Items[/h1]
"Icy what you did there..." There are about 25 Glacial items you can craft in Frostvale. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fba3d3c42fc1cba0c4e047f224cf7c9327bc6291.jpg[/img]

[h1]Frost Labyrinth Returns[/h1]
Play through the events of Frostval past. The Yettun is an abominable snow monster which attacked the Frost Moglins and took control of their lands. Only the little Frost Moglin, Blizzy, was brave enough to stand up to him... but Blizzy is going to need your help.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f733a0d71a3f526a9fa233498e682a2c33264110.jpg[/img]

[h1]Challenge Fight! You vs Frostlorn Raiders[/h1]
Battle the three leaders of the army attacking our home town. Faustbite, Phrozen and Sleet hail from that massive castle you will see in the distance, looming over Frostvale. But this week, you can gather friends to take all three of them on and craft awesome gear. Next week... we will enter their castle!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ebaab21d0cc0f4d8c5f711a50fde8ba829063dab.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2dddd9e37b6746bae184dccf5e444038a5f43ff1.jpg[/img]

[b][url]https://www.HeroMart.com[/url][/b]

Since you've already seen this promo a few times, instead about talking about it, I will talk about how this may be our most blue-themed news upset ever! So much blue! notes.title: Town is under attack! The FrostLorn Strikes Back...
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d9d450e81188a6100988bcdd9de8b1856c4179d6.jpg[/img]
[h1]AdventureQuest 3D's Frostlorn Raiders II: Frost Harder[/h1]

They are attacking our town! Who leaked? The Frostlorn Raiders found out about our impending attack on their stronghold and just sent an invasion force! Come quick. Roland is here in town town rallying the defenders with a new set of "Storm Defender" gear you can earn. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f4fa307bb60c38d9690452eac785447b006288fe.jpg[/img]

[h1]Get ready for the Frostlorn![/h1]
I love movies. There are three parts this event which will bring us face to face with "THE FROSTLORN". So I came up with a few parody titles for the releases. Here they are. Maybe we should have some sort of photoshop a movie poster contest?

[list]
[*]Raiders of the Frost Ark
[*]SnowTrek: Frost Contact
[*]Snow-kyo Drift
[*]The Polar Express Installation
[*]National Harpoon's Frostvale Vacation
[*]The Snowbank Heist
[*]Episode IV: A new Ski Slope
[*]Land of the Frost
[*]The Hills have Ice
[*]50 Shades of Sleigh
[*]The Day the Earth Stood Chill
[*]21 Jump Sleet (or the Wolf of Wall Sleet)
[*]Sickle (Sick-Cool) Hand Luke
[*]Snowday of the Dead
[*]Mad Max: Flurry Road
[*]The Blizzard of Oz
[/list]

[h1]Snow Ball Fight (Sneak Peak)[/h1]
PRO TIP: Do not throw the yellow ones. Push back the attackers, and in next week's AdventureQuest 3D release we will head to the Frozen North where you can now... throw snowballs. Seriously.

[h1]Storm Defender[/h1]
"There's snow place like home." Whenever Battleon is in danger, Roland shows up to rally you and the "Battleon defenders!" He'll never give you the cold shoulder. But he will give you Storm Defender armor if you hand in the drops from the attacking monsters. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e3b1bd0966b37b686636d327ce6edb1aceff381e.jpg[/img]

[h1]LAST CHANCE![/h1]
We extended it one last weekend... this is your final chance to get the collections before they are gone. 
2018 Pirate Collection (Ends Monday)
2018 Black Friday Collection (Ends Monday)
2018 Mogloween Collection (Ends when 2018 Frostval Collection goes live)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/83b679a83b1facf85e60d24a650e3bf00ba99393.jpg[/img]

"The Korin's out of the bag." The team has been streaming on Twitch. Follow (and subscribe) the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/artixentertainment]Artix Entertainment channel on Twitch[/url] to get alerts when we go live. Maybe score yourself one of these sweet looking, recyclable, and not-so-protective helmets. 

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/artixentertainment][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/887902ca8e3cc50f2f1f1ea898c25eac30f21bd6.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Thank you and.... COME QUICK![/h1]
Normally I would write you more here... but fighting. Need help. Send reserves. And ugly sweaters. Our town is under attack by snow monsters O_O

[b]Battle on!
Artix & The AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

[b]P.P.S.[/b] Yes, it will be that big.

notes.title: You got a Treasure Chest! What's inside?
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/5565c96a4b00094551893e24ccf0a077a2eb1f7f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Login to AdventureQuest 3D and open your treasure chest. [/h1]
What's in there? Is it Dragon Crystals? Yes! What about pets, potions, armors, wicked looking weapons? Yes! There's over 130 new items. You can get them all for just logging in.... because we are giving you a new treasure chest to open every single day.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f5177d5c414ef83ba7242abd444f1f7c0c1c5a30.jpg[/img]

[h1]130+ new items added in this new release[/h1]
So, those chests contain pets, a towel, weird potions that can transform you into things, awesome new armor sets and more. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3022b389f26bbe9b772dcaa9152a52c41802866e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Get a Treasure Chest every day when you login[/h1]
At last! If you are a long time player, then you know this release is actually the "daily login reward" stretch goal that was unlocked by the Kickstarter backers. This reward... is for all players. Login every day to get a free chest containing some free DragonCrystals, potions, surprise items, and more. Every chest has a chance to drop a Legendary quality item.

Also, every 7 days you will get a special chest with even better rewards! Don't worry if you miss a day. We don't reset your progress. It will just continue from where you left off, moving you towards that glorious ultimate reward on day #28, the epic-item-filled Emperor's Chest!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/1ecd7a176678bd2cbe870b8bcd1ae4f396e058d8.jpg[/img]

[h1]Last chance! Get 50% More Dragon Crystals[/h1]
Get 50% EXTRA Dragon Crystals on any Dragon Crystal purchase from now until January 2nd! With a Frostval Collection coming up, it's the perfect time to make sure you're ready for the holidays.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/33a79ded62df507f7222fa9e39afec1315e083cd.jpg[/img]

Raid on Frostlorn Ice Castle (Coming soon!)
Last year, under the cover of a magical snow storm, the Frostlorn Raiders attacked our town. This year we will be taking the fight to them! Soon we shall journey to the Frozen Northlands where the Frostlorn Ice Castle stands like an icy blade erupting from the snow drifts that cover the land. The image above is Dage's concept art for boss monster. 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mVUUA5LrQxE&feature=youtu.be&a][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9c4ba6956ca5759068ce31490c26c945616fdb59.jpg[/img]
Watch Vesper's weekly Artix video game update video[/url]

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
When I logged into the game today, I was blown away by the sheer variety of armors, pets, and creative looking characters. Felt good. Felt like the game suddenly came alive. Combine this with amazing releases like the huge Vampire Castle, the Pirate town of Lolosia....  Well, it feels great being a part of this as the game grows and hits its stride. In the background we are hard at work on new (and many existing) areas, adventures, and improvements to nearly every area of the game. I am grateful to you and everyone supporting AdventureQuest 3D's ongoing development. The upgrades or purchases you made this holiday season are making it possible for us to continue making the game better each week. 

Login and get your daily AdventureQuest 3D treasure chest. See you in game. 

Battle on!
Artix & The AdventureQuest 3D Team

[h1]A new pet is waiting for you to come and adopt them. Come in today![/h1]
It is the grand opening of Aria's Pet Shop in Battleon and you are invited to come and find the perfect companion to accompany you on your adventures through AdventureQuest 3D.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f770e19aca1cc344d061bb7ee1370f8ed909caba.jpg[/img][img]/media/3490/ariaspetshopheader.jpg[/img]

 
[h1]Just released[/h1][list][*][b]New Map[/b] -  Aria's Pet Shop in Battleon![/*][*][b]New Pets[/b] -  14 brand new pets that you can buy with Dragon Crystals![/*][*][b]Craft Pets[/b] - 15 brand new pets that anyone can craft by doing Aria's quests![/*][*][b]New Quests[/b] -  Aria's Pet Shop Rank quests unlock new craftable pets![/*][*][b]New Daily Quests[/b] -  Aria's Daily Quest give you Pet Feed used to rank up and craft![/*][*][b]New Titles[/b] -  Rank Up get one of 3 new titles and character page badges![/*][/list][h1]

notes.title: Talk Like a Pirate Day 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/312d1eadd995ca4358b8121c9cae68787ca58834.jpg[/img]

[h1]Happy Talk Like a Pirate Day[/h1]

Login and join us in the Pirate Town of Lolosia. There's a whole lotta new faces to meet... and an epic adventure of pirating and plundering across the high seas


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/41ec9260c0d788168414229a902a0df24cb4cb97.jpg[/img]

[h1]Pirate Class[/h1]

All players can now start earning the Pirate Class through daily quests! Once you have unlocked the class, you can then use those Pirate Tokens to unlock Pirate Armor and our first free travel form.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/8b2aeef520f4a4db475cff2a0c3649a32987cbd9.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Adventure & Monsters[/h1]

Battle all new monsters like the Sea Ogre, Megadon ([u]next week[/u]), Hammerhead Zard, Deeplings, the horrifying Flyshimi Fish, Clawgmurai, and the Bilge Rats... which are technicaly "Pi-RATS" if you think about it. The main event at the end of this first part of the saga is an epic BOSS battle at sea. If you enjoyed the Fire Dragon (Akriloth) battle from Ashfall, you are going to LOVE this.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a3f00df7e23bc1860e55ab62da7bc6483aeec365.jpg[/img]

[h1]Behold [u]Untold[/u] [u]Told[/u] Secrets[/h1]
[list]
[*]Level cap raised![/*]
[*]There are new travel badges to be found.[/*]
[*]Guardians can get 5 extra Pirate Tokens per day to earn the class a little faster.[/*]
[*]And the Moglin Scurvy in town... will tell you a different story each time you buy him a drink.[/*]
[/list]

 


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d489706fc9a3687ace24a596098e262807230249.jpg[/img]

[h1]Pirate Collection 2018[/h1]

Get your favorite items individually, or get the entire 2018 Pirate Collection! This year we have Land Shark and Cursed Pirate travel forms... a wicked array of Pirate gear including peg legs, stylish armor, hand cannons, and more! The collection includes a badge and the title "Sea Marauder"


 


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ae8605af4460265f75421d4ac967ae4c6fa07033.jpg[/img]
[h1]Story, Shops, & things to "Sea"[/h1]

There are a lot of new faces in town... many of them have shops or the skill to craft items using the things you find on your adventures.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f88ae1cea067b409a811248f6c6157889f62254d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Challenge Battles Coming Next![/h1]

Play the Pirate Saga and dive into the story this week... and then, in our next AdventureQuest 3D release, get your friends together for some challenging boss fights! Also in this new release is support for monster telegraphs (projections), pets, and more.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/cd5d7647b672f755708cea5ccda8aab7b9d6a445.jpg[/img]

[h1]Ahoy! It be time to plunder, pillage, and pirate our way across the seas![/h1]

Captain Rhubarb is perhaps the most famous Pirate of our world. I mean, there's no statue of him punching a shark in the face like Peckard, but he's known far and wide. His ship is the Red Betty. You're about to make some incredible memories aboard it. "[b]BATTLE ARRRRRRR![/b]"

notes.title: Daily Boss Fights
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c32fd1e198505ffdf8839d121f84a7867899a35e.jpg[/img]

[h1]LIKE A BOSS... MONSTERS![/h1]
In this week's release you can take on our first Daily Boss Fight, walk through some grass, quest for an awesome new scythe, wand, and sword, and check out our new and improved art for Warrior, Rogue, & Mage.
[url]https://aq3d.com/news/dailybossfights/[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b0ee17071c1af9485a9f6936e04e5f0412d241aa.jpg[/img]

[h1]Carnivera, the Venus HeroTrap[/h1]
Rumor has it that something terrible is lurking in Bladderwort Glade. An enormous mutation of a seed spitter... and its seeds can turn even the most hardened hero into a mindless plant-zombie.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/18529c8b7f9cccecee1fe6cd5edb7a557480ac43.jpg[/img]

[h1]Daily Boss Fights.... OK, that "S" might be a bit pre-mature.[/h1]
Talk to Twilly in town to check out the Boss Fight of the day! He has a daily quest where you can earn a Boss Fight Trophy. Needless to say the goal is to have a different, random, boss battle each day-- but right now we just have this one. So, give it a try and we will add more bosses very soon!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/56f36c60b6dae0305f972dfe77e94e71963f2fcb.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Balrog Blade[/h1]
Artist Darkon re-imagined & crafted the AQWorld's "Balrog Blade" into 3D. All players can earn this by collecting Daily Boss Trophies.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/344ae6ef359447657b12bfe3d7c17ec698a45df4.jpg[/img]

Bladderwort Glade is officially the first place to support grass in AdventureQuest 3D for PC & Mac players. (Not to be confused with that grass we released in the intro last week that turned all of our game graphics on iPhones pink.) We made two changes to the grass shader... first, it now blends into the ground. Second it has a nice gradient and some subtle randomization. When you walk over the grass, it should react by being pushed by your feet. Feels pretty good!

We will be re-adding grass to the Town of Battleon and the Intro next week.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/75a46c0acf3536fe9ab9f1ad9bacab11491a1627.jpg[/img]

[h1]It is official... the NEW INTRO IS A WIN![/h1]

Thank you for all of the love and cheers for AdventureQuest 3D's new intro. If you have not played it yet, simply login... it will be the first thing that happens when you hit play. Our new big baddie, Vane the Voidking, certainly made an impression... so much that another video game designer called me up to tell me how jealous he was of the games new villain. After the intro went live, our numbers jumped across the board. Our day 1 retention alone increased over 25%! I am really proud of the team's hard work and creativity on this. We are already working on what is coming next...

[list]
[*]Town of BattleOn's Shops & World Story
[*]Heartwood & Livingstone Cavern revamp (Berseker?)
[*]DoomWood Revamp (Paladin vs Necromancer)
[*]Lolosia (Pirate) - September (Ninjas will make an appearance but the class will come when we do our Ninja Training Village)
[*]Darkovia Parts III, IV, & V - October-ish?
[*]Live Events
[*]Daily Boss Battles
[*]PvP
[/list]

[h1]Boss Battle on![/h1]
Good luck against Carnivera the Venus Herotrap. Let us know what you think of the first Daily Boss Battle... and any fun ideas to take them to the next level as we add more!
https://aq3d.com/news/dailybossfights/

notes.title: Death's Lair - New Intro!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/08c5cdb6c9511916bf0853522706ae0d0479da2f.jpg[/img]

[h1]AdventureQuest 3D's New Intro[/h1]

[b]"Delightfully short, funny, battle-focused, and the cinematics are AWESOME."[/b]

Your story begins! Login and discover who you are in our world as AdventureQuest 3D's main storyline begins.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/27589fa52cfc22fa8bab2c3a91ad525ba21ec5f7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Death's Lair[/h1]

[b]"You've been dying for the main story to begin... Death is excited to help you with that."[/b]

Login and talk to me (Artix) to begin your adventure. I am standing in town right next to the little red moglin, Twilly.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ba3cd9c2a63e623f9db09bc1c21480639d0785cf.jpg[/img]

[h1]This is the intro the game deserves[/h1]

We put a lot of heart into this... and we really hope you love it!  Imagine yourself as a new player as you experience it for the first time. We aimed to give existing and new players a taste of our humor, show off how big the world is (and it's going to be), introduce the main villain, and reveal your purpose. All of this... in a very short, single sitting. 

Once you complete the short intro, return to Death's Lair (called Grim Outlook) using the Travel Crystal to begin Death's Challenges. They unlock new items & titles. We will continuously be improving,  tweaking, and adding onto this as we raise the level cap. Next week we will be continuing the main storyline, adding Daily Boss challenges to the Town of Battleon, and more things-- be sure to read about them on our game website [url]www.AQ3D.com[/url] . See you in game!

Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team 

[b]P.S.[/b] Zhoom added the 1st round of LIVE EVENT commands... want to help me test it next week?
[b]P.P.S.[/b] We will be Kickstarting the Moglins very soon! Pets feature coming into sharper focus as a result.

notes.content:

[h1]Version 1.10.0 "Grassy Blades of Death" is here![/h1]
Be sure to grab the newest update of AdventureQuest 3D  from Steam or the App Store. Here is what is new...

[h1]This release KICKS GRASS![/h1]
...literally. We added support for grass and when you walk over it, it moves. However, none of the maps actually have any grass in it (yet). Grass will be added to the Town of Battleon and outside of Death's lair in the next release. You can toggle grass in the settings.

[h1]New Friends Interface[/h1]
"Let's be better friends!" From your friends list, you can now directly invite someone to your group, or goto them, or summon them, or send them a whisper. (Thank you to MJ from Massively Overpowered for making me realize how important this feature is for playing together.)

[h1]Fixed news button disappearing after map change[/h1]
Apparently, "No news" is NOT good news. This has been fixed.

[h1]Bizzaro Character Deformations Fix![/h1]
There was a glitch that caused players to bend into unholy positions and break things for other players in the game. Zhoom added checks to prevent this "asset distortion issue". 

[h1]Spy on other player's equipped items[/h1]
What the heck is that player wearing? Now you can know. When you inspect a player you can now see their equipped items-- both actually equipped and cosmetically equipped.

[h1]Dual Wield Hand Cannons[/h1]
The game now supports all the features required to release Pirate and Alpha Pirate. This is, of course, our first dual wielding hand cannon class. This is a new equip slot that all players will have. But will only be usable by classes that use hand cannons.

[h1]Mobile Features - Joystick and Auto Run Toggles[/h1]
By popular demand we have added the option to lock the joystick in place and enable disable auto run. You can auto run on mobile by double tapping the joy stick.

[h1]Combat Improvements and Balance Updates[/h1]
"Don't you hate it when devs write something like this in the patch notes and then do not give any details?" So here are the details....
[list][*]The game will now only show other players' status effect icons on your target.  Spells that only do damage / DoTs will not have their icon shown.  This is to clear up some icon clutter on the target.[/*][*]Area of Effect abilities now deal 10% less damage or healing to their 2nd target, 20% less to their 3rd target, down to a minimum of 50% damage to their 6th or more targets.[list][*]To compensate, AoE abilities have had their base power increased. The result should be that these spells do nearly the same or more damage to 3 or fewer targets, but less to a larger number of targets. [/*][*]Targets are damaged in order of highest aggro. [/*][*]Targets are healed in order of lowest percent health left. [/*][/list][/*][*][b]Class Updates[/b][list][*][b]Warrior[/b] [list][*]Whirlwind power: 90 -> 100 [/*][/list][/*][*][b]Dragonslayer[/b][list][*]Final Descent power: 275 -> 310 [/*][/list][/*][*][b]Paladin[/b] [list][*]Holy Shield damage reduction 35% -> 25% [/*][*]Divine Judgement power: 175 -> 200[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Guardian[/b] [list][*]Guardian's Hope base power: 40 -> 55 [/*][/list][/*][*][b]Necromancer[/b] [list][*]Soul Transfer: Souls on kill 10 -> 15 [/*][*]Soul Siphon power: 70 -> 60 + Enhanced power: 90 -> 80 [/*][*]Grand Summon taunt duration: 5s -> 3.5s[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]

[h1]UI Updates[/h1]
By popular request the action bar is now bigger. But the bad news is there is less space for your chat window. But the good news is the chat window pops up above the bar to give you more space if it does not fit!

[h1]Android Users![/h1]
AdventureQuest 3D now requires you to be using at least Android 4.4 (Kit Kat). A very small number of players who are not using Android 4.4 or higher need to update your OS in order to play the new version of the game.  

[h1]Support for new intro (ALMOST!?)[/h1]
The new intro "DEATH'S LAIR" requires a few new features. Most are in this build, but we need to roll out at least one more early next week in order to release the new intro and begin AdventureQuest 3D's Main Storyline. So, as a little teaser to get you in the spirit, we updated the game's title screen with a special sneaky peak for you. Battle on!

[h1]Also happening this weekend![/h1]
Check out [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Yo08IhlBSKg&feature=youtu.be]Artix Weekly Video Game Review #12[/url] featuring special birthday-girl guest, Mia J. Park. 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Yo08IhlBSKg&feature=youtu.be][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/783ca0e971f6c55bfd5bc9ffe11a33016e5c2621.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Friday the 13th! Cryo-Shrade & Twilly vs Zorbak War
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/98ab038c7fa42604a0c6780863eb432ee4b766fe.png[/img]

[h1]A real CHILLER![/h1]

Login and battle for your favorite cabin in this weekend's Friday the 13th War! The winning team will have their back flag released for all players. Beware... someone accidentally opened a cryogenic chamber releasing... *message suddenly cut off*

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/37778d0ec515b2441e2721638157e712685dc0f8.jpg[/img]

[h1]Twilly vs Zorbak Cabins[/h1]

Prepare for war! This Friday the 13th, battle for either the Twilly or Zorbak Cabins. This is the first time we have ever had a war centered around our two mascot characters. May the best (or worst) moglin win! Oh, we lowered the war meter for this one... it is going to be a fast war!

[b]Twilly - the Red Hero Moglin[/b]
Often found on the tree stump in town, Twilly is quick with a heal and a warm smile. Many believe this friendly moglin was the first to make contact with humans. Is he just a loyal friend, or does he play a deeper role in our ultimate destiny? He sure does seem little. Some people would be surprised to hear this little fella once defeated Pax, becoming High Warlord of the Death Arena.

[b]Zorbak - the 100% Ebil Blue Moglin[/b]
While most moglins are gifted with powers to help you, Zorbak is more likely to use necromancy to re-animate your food. Often found in the company of insidious villains, this little scheming blue moglin always has a secret plan.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4eae667cd115c20022e42662eb8d0ff59d74b81d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Cryo-Shrade[/h1]

We thought he was gone. But then scientists discovered a mysterious cryogenic chamber... and they made the mistake of opening it. HE'S BACK! Battle the rare spawn Cryo-Shrade to get new armor, hood, mask, hooded mask and cleaver items.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/bd1e7d58b4b94e01dd6119fe1d30e883700595d5.png[/img]

[h1]Lost Hiker Set[/h1]

"Wear this... and you can get lost too!"

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/21d2ce56f504820c92033f7998437abf692ec98f.jpg[/img]

[h1]DEATH'S LAIR! Coming next time on AdventureQuest 3D[/h1]

We hope you enjoy this special mini-war. We received a lot of messages from players asking why we did not do the new adventure for Shrade that was originally planned. Truth is, we wanted to remain focused on the game's main storyline, including the new intro "Death's Lair" which will introduce AdventureQuest 3D's new main villain, Vane. Hope you agree that putting the time into permanent game content, instead of pushing things back another week for a one-off event is the best use of our time. That being said, when the team and I saw your comments on Youtube and Twitter about not getting a new Shrade... we did not want to let you down. So the team stayed late and went into overtime. They created the new Shrade and 2 armor sets that drop for you just in the nick of time. Any haters can say what they want, but these guys love you.  Happy Friday the 13th!

QUESTION: What Cabin will you be fighting for... TWILLY or ZORBAK?
More News

notes.title: Parkour map in the Dragon's Graveyard!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/06a5990411f34258327362dbd6ccb62aa2ce1202.jpg[/img]

[h1]Earn the Dragon's Graveyard Parkour Badge[/h1]
Can you make it to the top of our new parkour map? If so, you will unlock the Dragon's Graveyard Parkour badge and and the title, "Trick Jumper". But beware, this is our craziest jump challenge yet with magically disappearing floors, deadly lasers, and and a multiple choice ending that will leave you cursing the name of this dungeon's creator... which was Yergen for the record.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/012215101ebabeaad3b75c6392da1ed24966e54d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Where is the new Parkour Map?[/h1]
The entrance to this new parkour map can be found under a massive dragon's ribcage in the mushroom people infested part of the Dragon's Graveyard.

[h1]Goto friends blocked in the Parkour Map!?[/h1]
WHAT!? O_O Nope. It is not possible to teleport to friends standing at the top of the Parkour map for... there is only one way to the top!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/83749299eeb1026fc42acbce108e4f1a4ad8dd87.jpg[/img]

[h1]Coming soon, Death's Domain![/h1]
We are building a new intro for AdventureQuest 3D. We think you are going to love it TO DEATH. In addition to a moving 3D version of our Grim Reaper, we are also building the final version of the game's main villain.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2bb1f4af96af4717aeebbd467db77f3defd52b2f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Duel Wield & Cleave is AWESOME... change my mind.[/h1]
I posted a video on [url=https://www.facebook.com/AdventureQuest3D/]AdventureQuest 3D's Facebook[/url] where I am dual wielding my axe the Blinding Light of Destiny. Rogues are getting the ability to dual wield, Warriors are getting cleave, and we are making a lot of fun changes to combat. [url=/news/cleaveduaelwield/]Check out my design notes post[/url] for more.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6qfy-Mgqcws&feature=youtu.be][u][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fe55f01f6d3883f5d93f097a138747230e478909.jpg[/img][/u][/url]

[h1]Artix Games Weekly Update #9[/h1]
At long last, Vesper gets her dream of hosting a Muppet show. Find out about all of this week's releases including MechQuest, DragonFable, and AdventureQuest being added to the new Artix Games Launcher. 
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6qfy-Mgqcws&feature=youtu.be][b]Watch Video Game Update #9 on YouTube[/b][/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ea4a41470e41b6e1cfcc3fbc352c2e325070d380.jpg[/img]

[h1]Summer Hijinx[/h1]
We hope you have been enjoying AdventureQuest 3D and our ongoing updates. We just submitted the last fix for the Unity 2018 update and have returned focus to our game features including monster skills and telegraphs, grass for PCs, UI scaling, new Sound FX, and all the features on our gameplan plan and a massive world full of things to do. If  you are enjoying our releases, please consider supporting the game by upgrading to Guardian or getting the 2018 Summer Collection.

[b]Battle on![/b]
[b]Artix & The AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

 www.Artix.com

notes.title: The Dragon's Graveyard: Part II
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ec4402e7825ac5fb89539aab265c5c8722946bbf.jpg[/img]

[h1]Zakaru returns in the epic finale of the Dragon's Graveyard![/h1]
Enter the Dragon's Graveyard and quest all the way to epic finale of the adventure. Craft new weapons and armor including the Dragon Rider items, Fairy Dragon Knight items, and Skalazar's skull staff and armor.  Also,AdventureQuest 3D has been updated to Unity 2018!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/809c53404491560595a0546758f42a092ace1a14.jpg[/img]

[h1]Zakaru the Caretaker[/h1]
At the ([u]unbeating[/u]) heart of this adventure is an undead half-dragon named Zakaru. If you are already caught up on part 1, then you already know where this deadly, dragon-filled adventure is taking you.

[b]Prepare for an EPIC BOSS FIGHT![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/de4a6605b2c906dd79246f818029d6b4f5626c30.jpg[/img]

[h1]Craft Dragon Rider Armor & Items[/h1]
There are four different Dragon Rider sets for you to craft and collect.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0618b412b87cbbeed2a3b4727017abf98bef55dd.jpg[/img]

[h1]Fairy Dragon Knight[/h1]
Designed by Winnie, the Fairy Dragon Knight set is available to craft through a daily quest.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4e94079a6d8fa1f5ad3a7dd8c45ba6af9bcead26.jpg[/img]

[h1]Skalazar Staff & Armor[/h1]
You can also battle for drops to collect the Skalazar Skull Staff and armor set. 


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/56267d122887c91bd358a00ca9ebb97589929722.jpg[/img]

[h1]Unity 2018 Update[/h1]
We updated AdventureQuest 3D to the newest version of Unity which will allow us to start using the newest tools to improve the graphics and gameplay. For this release, our goal was for the game to look EXACTLY like it did yesterday. So even though we updated literally every map, armor, item, and file in the entire game-- nothing should look different to you. If it does, let us know on the bug tracker!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/5d58a7f26afe170c295cd54f20c85bac7df925e7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Necromancer starts Early Access for Legendary Tier Kickstarter Backers[/h1]
[b]Now on Live Server[/b]

You are very likely going to see players summoning undead minions starting today. And this is good news. Now that the Legendary Tier Kickstarter Backers are getting their early access, we can start preparing to release both Paladin and Necromancer for all players to obtain in the upcoming new DoomWood.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/83c495d253bd22833ed9bb2c8542dbc8073ead41.jpg[/img]

[h1]Complete story! The Dragon's Graveyard Parts I & II are LIVE![/h1]
We really hope you enjoy the this new story release. It was honor to work with Zakaru and bring his story to life... or undeath. We will be doing a Massively Overpowered live-stream with Zakaru, his sister, and also Vesper tonight to play through the release. My favorite part is hands down the "dragon ride". I really like seeing this level of creativity emerging in AdventureQuest 3D. The entire team would like to thank Zakaru once again for being a part of this game and being so focused on making this release something fun for you to enjoy. There are a lot of neat items that he helped design for you to battle for and craft. Battle on!

notes.title: Summer Island Getaway!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ea4a41470e41b6e1cfcc3fbc352c2e325070d380.jpg[/img]

[h1]"Praise the sun!"[/h1]
Come to our new tropical paradise, Pointe Less Isle, and get some sand pixels between your 3D toes. Cast off that heavy armor and soak up some rays while chillin' out with your friends in this social "hang out" area.

Read the full post at https://aq3d.com/news/pointelessisle/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3f626b3ef9899f957b6630c58c4390aa4b61a36c.jpg[/img]

[h1]2018 Summer Shop & Collection[/h1]
In our 1st ever Summer Collection there are 31... yes thirty-freaking-one new items! Our largest collection ever includes swimsuits, shades, sandals, steins, surfin' sneevil travel form and, well, here's the full list. Also includes rare title & badge.

[list][*]Surfin' Sneevil[/*][*]Beach Ball[/*][*]Galanoth Surfboard[/*][*]Surfin' Skulls Suit[/*][*]Arm Floaties[/*][*]Unicorn Floatie Belt[/*][*]White Beachwear[/*][*]Blue Beachwear[/*][*]Red Beachwear[/*][*]Surf Ready Swimsuit[/*][*]Sea Foam Swimsuit[/*][*]Water's Edge[/*][*]Great White Axe[/*][*]Beach Tankard[/*][*]Pineapple Drink[/*][*]Summer Scrimp Skewer[/*][*]Yellow Sunglasses[/*][*]Cool Dude Sunglasses[/*][*]Candy Shades[/*][*]Flaming Cat Ears[/*][*]Green Beach Towel[/*][*]Sandy Sandals[/*][*]Fire Scion Scythe[/*][*]Fire Scion Armor[/*][*]Fire Scion Hooded Mask[/*][*]Fire Scion Shoulders[/*][*]Fire Scion Cloak[/*][*]Fire Scion Boots[/*][*]Fire Scion Gloves[/*][*]Fire Scion Sash[/*][*]Beachside Fishing Pole[/*][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3cc7ef445d984405c00d399595254aca1956408e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Surfin' Sneevil Travel Form[/h1]
Hang 10... or however many toes Sneevils have. OK, they have 10. We just counted. Surf on land and sea at 130% speed on a surfboard designed by community contest winner Yingjie.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/39ea007c882e91c1c8e84f1af94893610760f803.jpg[/img]

[h1]WHAT THE ACTUAL HECK!?[/h1]
Yet again, a mini-release intended to hold us over until The Dragon's Graveyard: Part II releases got... completely out of hand. Originally intended as a simple shop, we just kept adding more creative things. The team would laugh... and the inspiration became contagious resulting in us making more. From unicorn floaties to the subtly swaying trees-- you can feel the good vibes and love in this release.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/63240834be028bfda355152e6745c2d2688c42d0.jpg[/img]

[h1]"Life's a beach, and then you... DYE DYE DYE!"[/h1]
Come hang out with us at Pointe Less Isle! Enjoy a little fun in the sun before we return to the Dragon's Graveyard to experience its' climatic finale!

notes.title: DreadFool's Labyrinth
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f10ffe42b61399026b15578694e0adcd28e75849.jpg[/img]

[h1]DreadFool's Labyrinth is OPEN![/h1]
Maye you should wear the brown armor. Join us in game for a completely unplanned new mini-adventure featuring special guest, cosplayer/YouTuber guest, D-Piddy!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/092c1082c5a0616515d16ef818decc060590fd06.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Kat-Katana[/h1]
10/10 Purrrrrfect! Also, it is level 20... there's new stuff for players of all levels in this release.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d22909f6bffa32f57f448f6a9ecf08f1f245664a.jpg[/img]

[h1]You gotta be Jesting![/h1]
This villain RUNS. You will have to chase 'em through the Labyrinth... which is filled with traps and monsters. Did we mention traps?

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCmJyp7qrztjH8GVCJxoM8xQ][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7db1b8e02b6b2abaa41eb2788c75a07cf5b11d60.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]D-Piddy[/h1]
[b]Cosplayer / YouTuber[/b]

Fan of D-Piddy's [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCmJyp7qrztjH8GVCJxoM8xQ]YouTube videos[/url]? He is a famous cosplayer & YouTuber. Best known for dressing as a particular superhero who's movie is doing really well in theaters right now. [b]<_<[/b] If you have never seen his crazy YouTube videos (one of them has 26 Million views O_O), check them out! He is shrouded in mystery though. D-Piddy always wears a mask. No one knows what looks like in real-life. A mystery that we lovingly continued in-game...

[b]Check out his stuff[/b]
[list][*][url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCmJyp7qrztjH8GVCJxoM8xQ]D-Piddy YouTube Channel[/url][/*][*][url=https://twitter.com/_dpiddy?lang=en]D-Piddy Twitter[/url][/*][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/5bb40cd7267841521c281a7b3203b3c5d7f099cd.jpg[/img]

[h1]Craft Lotsa New Stuff![/h1]
What started out as a 1-day release got a little out of hand...
[list][*][b]D-Piddy Mask[/b] [u](Quest reward)[/u][/*][*][b]Kat-Katana[/b][u] [u](Crafting)[/u][/u][/*][*][b]Kat-Ka-Tanto[/b][u] (Crafting)[/u][/*][*][b]DreadFool Hood[/b] [u](Craft / Turn in as quest to perm unlock)[/u][/*][*][b]DreadFool Armor[/b] [u](Craft / Turn in as quest to perm unlock)[/u][/*][*][b]DreadFool Shoulder[/b] [u](Craft / Turn in as quest to perm unlock)[/u][/*][*][b]DreadFool Belt[/b] [u](Craft / Turn in as quest to perm unlock)[/u][/*][*][b]DreadFool Gloves[/b] [u](Craft / Turn in as quest to perm unlock)[/u][/*][*][b]DreadFool Belt[/b] [u](Craft / Turn in as quest to perm unlock)[/u][/*][*][b]DreadFool[/b] [b]Arrows[/b] (DragonCrystals)[/*][*][b]Tragic Fool Mask[/b] (Craft)[/*][*][b]Comic Fool Mask[/b] (Craft)[/*][*][b]Fool Minion Armor[/b] (Craft)[/*][*][b]Fool Minion Shoulders[/b] (Craft)[/*][*][b]Fool Minion Boot[/b] (Craft)[/*][*][b]Fool Minion Gloves[/b] (Craft)[/*][*][b]Fool Minion Belt[/b] (Craft)[/*][*][b]Fool Minion Armor[/b] (Craft)[/*][*][b]Mini Fool[/b] (travel form, DragonCrystals)[/*][*][b]Overcompensating![/b] (Really Big Sword, Drop)[/*][*][b]Ball Head Hammer[/b] (Sword, Drop)[/*][*][b]Chopity Chop[/b] (Axe, Drop)[/*][*][b]Staff of Ha![/b] (Staff, Drop)[/*][/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4264395ec5e366779892f529ecdda1b6597a9bec.jpg[/img]

[h1]An unlockable "free" collection... on us[/h1]
By doing the quests, you permanently unlock pieces of the DreadFool armor set in a collection. Normally, this is something that costs DCs. But since D-Piddy agreed to be in this release, we wanted to do something nice for everyone. So, every time you turn a piece of crafted armor into D-Piddy, it forever unlocks the item. 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2AfYswl21-k&feature=youtu.be][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/5db8f4c2e9e62147d69a8bb559b9d5e3eaea1b34.jpg[/img][/url]

...and beware that "EXTRA" trap Llussion added right before we released. ([u]Although it might unlock an exploration achivement & title[/u])

notes.title: GRAND OPENING! Barber Shop
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f5ea710c372486c61dc73f4f8eb7476bad6a4e00.jpg[/img]

[h1]Come in for the Grand Opening[/h1]

The Battleon Barbershop is now open! Walk in and meet our interesting and unusual stylists. This fast paced adventure will unlock new ways to customize the perfect you.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4a155f1e52248185f592d2b616391e82190d0b7f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Accessorize![/h1]

[h1]STORY! Fast, fun, and funny...[/h1]

notes.title: May the FOURTH be with you!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a7bf199d10f9b47e99716e8fe51f48a1a26c323a.jpg[/img]

[h1]The fourth is strong with this AdventureQuest 3D release[/h1]
Login and get your Star Swords, blastomech mogloid travel forms, parody armors, and more. Then, get a few friends and see if you can conquer the extreme challenge "Dream Labyrinth"-- with special boss fight THE WALL OF PAIN! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fe95b0b525ec964a35166b4e484dabe958a53e6f.jpg[/img]

[h1]2 New Shops![/h1]
A strange robotic moglin from another world is in town right now. Named M-06-L1N, he has two parody shops with seasonal rares from beyond the stars. These are only available once per year, get them while you can...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/5bd6e9c2627f8d94c26f2ae48e0ad85d29917ce3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Extreme Challenge added to The World Tree![/h1]
[b]"When we say extreme challenge, we really mean it."[/b]
It is called the Dream Labryrinth. The enterence is on that seemingly impossible to get to floating island that you can see from the World Tree. Most players will never even figure out how to enter the new Dream Labyrinth. the And that might be a good thing. Because you will need a party of skilled players to have any hope of finding the way to the center of the psychotic maze... where you will encounter THE WALL OF PAIN! It is unlike anything you have encountered in AdventureQuest 3D before. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f865db1053726244878e9e078d3322b9ef9d3aa9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Barber shop coming next week![/h1]
The Battleon Barbershop will open next week. You will finally be able to go inside and get a "new do" from your favorite Barberbarian stylist. Over 10 new hairstyles are being released including fades, afros, spiky anime-style, and more. You can unlock new styles by doing quests... including some experimental glow-in-the-dark (emissive) hairs.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/71dab150ab7c05905225ea52cc552592edc394f1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Happy Cinco De Mayo & Have an awesome weekend![/h1]
Be sure to check out all of the "May the 4th be with you" special releases happening across our other games this weekend (AQWorlds, DragonFable, and the original AdventureQuest which is going to have chupacabras!). Battle on!

[h1]BEWARE THE WALL OF PAIN![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3d864ecc61b71be8c75be87be81c63fc86034707.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Necromancer Testing on the PTR!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/5d58a7f26afe170c295cd54f20c85bac7df925e7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Undead Summoning 101[/h1]
AdventureQuest 3D's Necromancer class is now available for everyone to test on the PTR (Public Test Realm).

[h1]Paladins & Undead Slayers please look the other way for a moment.[/h1]
As a Necromancer, you summon an undead minion to fight for you. Excellent company if you are feeling lonely. But they do not last long. This first type of Necromancer can only summon a single skeletal minion for a short period of time before it collapses into dust. No worries, summoning more is the fun part. Your special summons a giant skeleton which is extra fun. Everyone is invited to help us test and give us feedback. We have been carefully reading the comments so far and are working on increasing its power, and getting a little life leach when you cast your dark magic. This class plays very differently from our previous ones!
Necromancer Release Schedule

- PTR Testing all Players (Happening now!)
- Live Release for Legendary Tier Kickstarter Backers (As promised)
- Live Release for all Players

[h1]More Class News[/h1]
We are anticipating releasing Paladin for all players in the upcoming Doomwood Revamp. We are not sure if Necromancer will be released there, opposing Paladin (which would be fun-- and I really want to add the Tower of Necromancer). Or, if we will release Necromancer in the Dragon's Graveyard. Meanwhile, Alpha Pirate (Similar to Pirate Class) has had great progress. It is our first dual wielding hand cannon class. Zhoom is adding new equip slots to the database (Bow & Guns) to support the new models and animations we have ready. Finally, Ninja has had some setbacks. The original "different skills cause different combos to start" style game-play was ultimately too confusing. Rabblefroth is trying something different. I am still crossing my fingers for shirken and double jump. Battle on!

notes.title: World Tree 2: Dream Plane
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/5beaf9a3c5f8e4447f73141fd1c79120d6336245.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Finale of Slifsgaard's Shaman Area![/h1]
The World Tree, the linchpin of multiple worlds, is still in danger! In the first half of the World Tree story, Slifsgaard taught you about what it means to be a shaman in Lore, You traveled to four different elemental crossplanes to get the permission from the elemental Aspects to enter the Dream Plane. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/55e76ee1200a463edfe7325a85324eb5fbb828c2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Our BIGGEST Boss Fight ever, new masks, weapons, and more![/h1]
Now, you must travel to the world of dreams, where the Void Knightmare is attacking the World Tree and find a way to stop the unthinkably huge beast!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2cba6432534dcd64750115b5f39a8e63c280d58e.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Dream Plane[/h1]

Have you ever had a dream where you were in your house but it wasn't YOUR house? You know that you live there but it looks nothing like the house you really live in?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/08498293949ff2ba6c055feebe8910763c590b0d.jpg[/img]

[h1]PRO TIP - Follow the Bird Tracks[/h1]
Trust us on this one...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0aeac7bc3b6fa7a8d31c92565da23659889a2889.jpg[/img]

Much like the elemental crossplanes, the Dream Plane is a kind of reflection of our world where things might look the same but things work very differently. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c9ab4b5075ff87f5f7869715bdf5180e641b591b.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW GEAR! Aspect Masks, Dream Warden and More![/h1]

There's lot of new gear in this release and you can craft ALL of it! No drops other than crafting materials and no cosmetics that you can only buy with Dragon Crystals! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/47bd7801dbbef88d3f6f4e7c5e0ac8482ccf069b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Masks of the Aspects[/h1]
Using the gems you can also craft each of the four masks worn by the elemental Aspects, Axas, Zolin, Pahua and Snek. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c2b235e1fe5e7e005145a5f5d1cdb2cf840b2346.jpg[/img]

[h1]Blade of Ancestors, Elemental Axe, & Dream Warden Robes[/h1]
You will also be able to craft the basic Dream Warden robes, belt, bracers and three mask options and the Blade and Ancestors and Elemental Axe! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/5c539226357e6efeea45ea17abeab135ac83e77f.gif[/img]

[h1]A Note To Slifsgaard[/h1]

As some of you know, this release is one of the two releases designed by our Top Tier Kickstarter Backers who each got to design a weapon, their own NPC and were invited to the lab and work with us to design a whole area and story for you guys to play through.

We weren't sure what we were getting ourselves into when we offered this option. We were bringing in fans with no professional game development experience who might have demands that were completely impossible. They might want to reach too far and break the world we wanted to build or make it harder to tell the stories we're telling... but non of that happened. 

When Slifsgaard came to the lab he let us know what he really just wanted to make something that the fans of our games, fans like himself, have enjoyed for years. He had amazing ideas that were cool and fun but not over-reaching, his vision was really in line with what AQ3D was already working toward and he was very easy to work with!

Any community, online or otherwise, will have some rotten apples but it's really great to know that the Artix Entertainment Community composed of fans like Slifsgaard who are not here to start drama or bring anybody down... but just like the games and want to make sure everyone else does too. 

Thanks, Slifsgaard, for sharing your shamanic ideas and your World Tree with us. 

[b]Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

notes.title: Friday the 13th WAR!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0aa6ac37d07efe0e4aac79a8251e389ea1a0dbcd.jpg[/img]
[h1]Special Friday the 13th Weekend Event in AdventureQuest 3D[/h1]
Can you survive Camp Gonnagetcha? Our "B-movie" story is back and the war has just begun-- will you choose to join the Wild Wolves or the Dread Spiders? Unlock new items including the roasted marshmallow staff and mega huge sickle-machete-like thing in the header image! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a458d5c7676bd7ea660d22646a36de61a054a4f8.jpg[/img]
[h1]SHRADE RETURNS... AGAIN... AND AGAIN![/h1]
[b]"Shrade is sorta like the Santa Claus of unlucky Fridays... except he carries a machete... and tries to kill you."[/b] - Said by a camper around the Campfire before sneaking off into the woods with another camper to get all kissy face, who for the record, was totally out of their league, but then neither of them were every heard from again. The origins of Shrade may be shrouded in mystery, but he keeps coming back... bigger, stronger, different, and with forbidden new loot. Think you can take him?

notes.title: The World Tree is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d17b0545250660c7bb4d032d4c09198442d210e7.jpg[/img]

Want to become a spirit raven and soar between the elemental planes? It is finally here-- explore the World Tree in AdventureQuest 3D. The Shaman, Slifsgaard, has a vision about you. You are about to begin a journey that will reveal who you really are. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/1e302dec25d30514119158163e8c4549daba59f1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Explore strange places, unlock new titles, & find secret chests[/h1]
We hid 3 new exploration points for you to find that unlock titles. Also, you may discover a few secret boxes. One containing, "The best backstory I never knew I needed to read" - Player on Twitter

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/8fae03ff8f4eb2306a50311c6a0b013f7426fbf8.jpg[/img]

[h1]Become a Spirit Raven... find secrets. [/h1]
This release uses our newest feature to allow all players to transform into something special to explore the World Tree and traverse the mysterious elemental planes. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/1f61bfcb79046025d630101682eaaeb459d51f9c.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Drops & Gear to Craft[/h1]
After a series of releases full of darkness and skulls, this new release brings us back to color and nature --with skulls!

[list]
[*]Spiritual Warrior Set
[*]Soothsayer Set
[*]Jagulope Set (half Jaguar... half Jackalope?) 
[*]New travel forms
[*]Spirit Animal Helms (Unlock after you beat the story)
[*]Unusual new items to find and upgrade --with skulls!
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b69a2fc38f6984d2ed4a52980e6e6c955367929b.jpg[/img]

[h1]The 4 Elemental Aspects[/h1]
In this new story you will be tested by the very personifications of the elements. They also have AWESOME masks. Plot aside, next we will probably beat them up for them... just saying. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a1ea60697b34eb7694cfbab038edbb8cdd6ac13a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Meet Slifsgaard the Shaman[/h1]
[b]QUEST! Say that name 5 times fast O_O Pronounced "Slif's Guard"[/b]
This adventure was designed by Slifsgaard, the first of our two "World Designer" backers from the Kickstarter. He visited the lab, helped design the release, and we had a day long face-time where he launched the release with the team-- even joined us on a live stream of the release with Massively Overpowered. He is a great guy in real life, and was most focused on us creating something fun and special for you. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ee13b18f1f87bc2ef9d2c237dc57db7c0f0a3fae.png[/img]

[h1]Thank you... and next week is Friday the 13th![/h1]
We really hope you enjoy the World Tree. It has a little something in it for everyone. Next week, is Friday the 13th! Shrade and a new Campgonnagetcha (redesigned so the cabins are the same distance) will appear. On monday we will be officially posting the two new team mascots and their banners. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/59e8a05af4c3b56d14033b58e5f642428f8d96f0.jpg[/img]

Then, the follow week we will launch part 2, the finale, of the World Tree. This will feature new cutscenes, the Elemental Axe, the masks of the Elemental Aspects, and-- I just want to say this right now, the Dream Plane is going to hands down be the most interesting map we have ever put in the game. It is insane.

[b]Battle on!
Artix & The AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

notes.title: Beat the Ogreman!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2056a8a5cb12f2e2a35f5811c9803e0ac810cd6a.jpg[/img]

Read the full design notes post at https://aq3d.com/news/ogreman/ 

[h1]"Me Ogreman, me smash gud!"[/h1]

Beware! Blue ogres have been spotted wreaking havok in the town of Battleon. Join us for this weekend's special community mini-event with GameOgre.com featuring cat ears, ogre items (including a consumable that transforms you into a blue ogre), and more!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d24f3e4b0b7a50d7ba604f18fa8d3e216d5b690d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Cat Ears “Battle Meow-n!"[/h1]

Want cat ears for your hero? You can now use the gems you get from doing random adventures to craft different color ears at Cysero’s forge. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c1f615aa70aa811b8aaa6c9b59b8b6a1ecefa05f.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Akriloth Craft Recipes[/h1]

We have been reading your messages! Having a hard time getting those super rare drops off the toughest version of the Akriloth Fire Dragon boss fight? You can now, alternatively, craft them on Senna. So if you are really, really, really, really unlucky.... you can still ultimately get the item your fiery heart most desires. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a89135d6b19484a457a24ba17648cad2bc984421.jpg[/img]

[h1]Your Collections now available at the Bank![/h1]

You can now access all of your collections at the bank. Hootenhiem thinks this is a lot safer than keeping them in Melodia’s closet at the Inn… which is really funny if you think about it. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7d553586a9280e311e3389ccec6f6d877d613537.jpg[/img]

[h1]Class Balancing... no, this is good news![/h1]

Normally I get scared when I hear the word “balancing” from game devs.

[list]
[*]Mages now do a little more damage
[*]DragonSlayers now do more damage to Dragons
[*]Guardian skills now require less mana
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9e058f5d03fa64662df2dcbbc4369841b2252a70.jpg[/img]

[h1]Thank you & Shaman Area Coming Next![/h1]

[b]"Is it a Kickstarter only area? No! It is for everyone. A Kickstarter actually backer paid us to make this next release for you. Seriously."[/b]

The next major AdventureQuest 3D release is the Tree of Life-- and based on what I have seen from the story, art, characters, new feature, and loot it is really going to surprise you. Originally scheduled for this week, we pushed it back so we had the extra time to finish it right. So, this weekend, we hope you enjoy the special release! Time to fight some ogres and get cat ears….

Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team

[b]P.S.[/b] There is also a secret /join GameOgre map if you are looking for a real challenge.
[b]P.P.S.[/b] We have been reading the "click loot bag" issues and will prioritize the fix for this.  The good news is the same items drop on the blue ogres  in town. So, if you cannot get the loot from the special map-- just head to town to do battle.
More News

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c1f615aa70aa811b8aaa6c9b59b8b6a1ecefa05f.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Akriloth Craft Recipes[/h1]

We have been reading your messages! Having a hard time getting those super rare drops off the toughest version of the Akriloth Fire Dragon boss fight? You can now, alternatively, craft them on Senna. So if you are really, really, really, really unlucky.... you can still ultimately get the item your fiery heart most desires. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a89135d6b19484a457a24ba17648cad2bc984421.jpg[/img]

[h1]Your Collections now available at the Bank![/h1]

You can now access all of your collections at the bank. Hootenhiem thinks this is a lot safer than keeping them in Melodia’s closet at the Inn… which is really funny if you think about it. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7d553586a9280e311e3389ccec6f6d877d613537.jpg[/img]

[h1]Class Balancing... no, this is good news![/h1]

Normally I get scared when I hear the word “balancing” from game devs.

[list]
[*]Mages now do a little more damage
[*]DragonSlayers now do more damage to Dragons
[*]Guardian skills now require less mana
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9e058f5d03fa64662df2dcbbc4369841b2252a70.jpg[/img]

[h1]Thank you & Shaman Area Coming Next![/h1]

[b]"Is it a Kickstarter only area? No! It is for everyone. A Kickstarter actually backer paid us to make this next release for you. Seriously."[/b]

The next major AdventureQuest 3D release is the Tree of Life-- and based on what I have seen from the story, art, characters, new feature, and loot it is really going to surprise you. Originally scheduled for this week, we pushed it back so we had the extra time to finish it right. So, this weekend, we hope you enjoy the special release! Time to fight some ogres and get cat ears….

Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team

[b]P.S.[/b] There is also a secret /join GameOgre map if you are looking for a real challenge.
[b]P.P.S.[/b] We have been reading the "click loot bag" issues and will prioritize the fix for this.  The good news is the same items drop on the blue ogres  in town. So, if you cannot get the loot from the special map-- just head to town to do battle.
More News

notes.title: Earn New Titles & Badges!
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/newtitles/][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ff08d2768b319c9f45cd28fbc6b78bdf8c6511a4.jpg[/img][/url]

See the full post at https://aq3d.com/news/newtitles/

[h1]Get rewarded for exploring all those strange places![/h1]

In this week's new release we added tons of new titles & badges.... you can earn and unlock them by exploring strange places, battling challenge boss fights, and more! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f10666a971c6088c221e007d32a08ab1e8baa1bb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Boss Challenge Titles[/h1]

These titles can be unlocked from finding or fighting special boss monsters. The names should help you figure out which ones give the titles.

    Brutal Bro
    Frogzard Hunter
    So Shelfish
    IT'S ALL TRUE!
    Terrorized
    Dreadly Serious
    The Unburned
    Winged It
    Kaiju Killer

[h1]Exploration Titles[/h1]

These titles can be earned by finding secret Exploration Scrolls around the world. When you go off the beaten path... or climb over it... a secret scroll may suddenly reveal itself. Walk over it to unlock a new Badge & Title! (Exploration Achievement Unlocked!) The names may help give clues on where to look.

    River Stone
    Death's Hand
    Spelunker
    Freeclimber
    NecroKnighted
    Infernal Tourist
    Tavern Patron
    Dimwitted
    Master of the Tower (Guardian only)


[h1]Loyalty[/h1]

These badges/titles come from supporting the game or participating in our ongoing releases. There are a lot more than the ones listed, but I am keeping this list to the ones that are currently available.

    Open Beta Hero (Everyone will get this soon)
    Founder
    Guardian
    Dragon Guardian

[url=https://www.heromart.com][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b644d51b2797e2024a90239830bf838bbe2b1b0d.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]HeroMart[/h1]

Many things form our online shop, https://www.HeroMart.com , will now unlock titles & badges in AdventureQuest 3D. We are going to try to do a little database magic to retroactively give you badges for things you have already redeemed in game. This will probably happen by the end of next week. So if you see a bunch of new titles suddenly appear on your account, you will know why!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/shamansneakpeek/][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4f8ed3af4a306d1f1b3ea45f70faf13182039c21.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]More Titles Coming[/h1]

Good hunting in finding the new in-game titles! With each release we will be adding more... rewarding the bold and brave explorers who search every nook and cranny of a new area. I suspect that not all future titles will be announced. Also... [url=https://aq3d.com/news/shamansneakpeek/]check out the sneak peak of the upcoming Shaman area[/url]. Battle on!

notes.title: Dage the Evil's Underworld Gate
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d578e3122f9e41f2308bacf69c395883b5aa6757.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Area, Story, Parkour, and Loot[/h1]
Dage is master of the Undead Legion. You have heard his name. But you have never heard his story... until now. There is a mysterious stranger named Vost in town whom you should speak with immediately. He claims to have discovered a way to the UnderWorld. Is he just obsessed with learning more about Dage and his Undead Legion-- or is something more going on here?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2ad5ae0b1983e01602533554b5cfbb3152fdb892.jpg[/img]

[h1]The armors above are drops (or from crafting)[/h1]

This new AdventureQuest 3D release has something special for everyone. The armors and weapons in the screenshot above are some of the drops and craftable items that you can earn. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/40ca8a1faa161d0023f558eda0b6f6ee2c24eddf.jpg[/img]

[h1]Under Guardian Armor[/h1]
[b]"Even the Underworld has Guardians"[/b]
The eternal enemy of the Guardians are the Seekers.... and one is in the Underworld! Guardians should be on the lookout for this being and battle him to obtain the Underworld version of their Guardian armor.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7ea82089b4c8236553bde03ae86d200d8f628e6c.jpg[/img]

[h1]2018 Dage Collection[/h1]

This collection of items is freaking amazing as you can see in the screenshot above. It includes the Legion Winged Skull & Jumping Legion Skull travel forms. It also comes with a perma-rare badge and title. (If you do not see the new title immediately, go to the title screen, click options and "clear cache")

You can buy the items individually, or permanently unlock the ENTIRE COLLECTION (worth over 10,000 DragonCrystals) for 4,900 DragonCrystals. As seen in the video below, once a collection is unlocked you can get permanent access to a shop where you can get the items at any time for 0 gold-- which frees up your inventory and bank space. All of your permanently unlocked collections are available on Melodia in the Inn.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pcS2IrvG2BA&feature=youtu.be][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/80b22030c53c75e77ec8c6cf89b7b7d72ebc37d5.jpg[/img][/url]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pcS2IrvG2BA&feature=youtu.be

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/02bee4ec2b0192a6f717861c1ca1415d04a00b93.jpg[/img]

[h1]Parkour... with SKULL LAZORS![/h1]

There is one place in the Underworld that will put your jumping skills to the test. Reach the top and claim a new title. But to do so... you will have to overcome vanishing ledges and LAZOR shooting skulls.

BATTLE ON!

notes.title: Potions for Gold, Death, Doomwood, & stuffs!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/696043d42512519382820e7fdb5a89a6c7ffb60b.png[/img]

[b]Greetings friends![/b]

We hope you are enjoying the Dragons of Ashfall: Part 3 release and boss fights! After reading the latest reviews, we made some changes and restarted the server just a bit ago to apply them

[h1]1. Potions for Gold![/h1]
You can now buy Health Potions for 90 gold from the quick potions menu. Hope this helps in your coming battles.

[h1]2. DoomWood Monster Nerf![/h1]
A lot of players are leveling up to get to play the newest adventures Ashfall. But to do so... they have to slog through the dreaded DoomWood ("GrindWood") which was made an extremely long time ago (Before we had cutscenes, sagas, challenge fights, or any of the new features that players love.) So... guess which zone I will be re-writing this weekend?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e13d88a90e6cdf6425a3680567b521e27f547cd6.jpg[/img]

To help the players leveling up now, I took the nerf hammer to a lot of the monsters in that area. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/78799f2cfe57ecdbe284b1b7f9373b252b487056.jpg[/img]

[h1]3. Custom Weapon Backers got their codes![/h1]
You may have seen some unusual weapons in game. Our Kickstarter Custom Weapon backers received their codes this week. Originally they were supposed to get 10, but we gave them 12 for being so awesome and patient. I will be rebooting the server one more time (waiting till super late so we do not disturb your game playing) to fix some of the items. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9a10b7d154bf9ea8fa6c591969e563c9b36d801e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Just a preview... DEATH SCREEN[/h1]
I miss the old DEATH and his witty banter. So Dage drew this up and we are currently working on getting it in the game. Having a speech bubble will allow DEATH to tell you if special "death rules" are in effect-- like in Extreme Mode dungeons were you cannot re-spawn until your party clears the room. Maybe we can add secret death quests? 

Battle on!
Artix
