[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/78799f2cfe57ecdbe284b1b7f9373b252b487056.jpg[/img]

[h1]3. Custom Weapon Backers got their codes![/h1]
You may have seen some unusual weapons in game. Our Kickstarter Custom Weapon backers received their codes this week. Originally they were supposed to get 10, but we gave them 12 for being so awesome and patient. I will be rebooting the server one more time (waiting till super late so we do not disturb your game playing) to fix some of the items. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9a10b7d154bf9ea8fa6c591969e563c9b36d801e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Just a preview... DEATH SCREEN[/h1]
I miss the old DEATH and his witty banter. So Dage drew this up and we are currently working on getting it in the game. Having a speech bubble will allow DEATH to tell you if special "death rules" are in effect-- like in Extreme Mode dungeons were you cannot re-spawn until your party clears the room. Maybe we can add secret death quests? 

Battle on!
Artix

notes.content:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?time_continue=1&v=yIZf8KLrx0A][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/951c9953272fcdb6915a0548715fbad529d3d103.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?time_continue=1&v=yIZf8KLrx0A]Watch the trailer[/url]

[h1]Join the DragonSlayers on their Ultimate Hunt![/h1]

[b]"Happy Valantines Day! ...and there is nothing a DragonSlayer loves more than hunting dragons."[/b]
At long last, it is time to enter the dragon's lair!  Watch the teaser Ashfall 3 trailer, then join the DragonSlayer's as they raid the Dragon's Lair. You can now become a Dragonslayer... level up to 20.... and experience our first ever 20-player Raid Boss Fight!

[url=https://aq3d.com/news/ashfall3/]Read the full design notes post[/url]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?time_continue=1&v=yIZf8KLrx0A][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b40191d1004aa8bf0d7bb4c6b9101bd7c5fb03c2.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?time_continue=1&v=yIZf8KLrx0A]Watch the Ashfall: Part 3 Teaser Trailer[/url][/h1]

[b]"Previously, on the Dragons of Ashfall"[/b]
Watch the video for the story so far. At the heart of the volcano, sleeps a Great Dragon. It is more massive than any dragon you have seen in our world. Our enemy, Talyn, plans to awaken the beast and control it. To awaken the Great Dragon from it's slumber he must gather four tributes: food, gold, an army, and a magical artifact known as... the Fire Orb. As you read this, Talyn has already entered the volcano. He must be stopped...

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3d4a7707742eb1bec6877a6a329e46bc46507e48.jpg[/img]

[h1]New in this AdventureQuest 3D release![/h1]

    DragonSlayer Class - all players can now earn the dragon slayer class
    DragonSlayer Gear
    Daily Quests
    Ashfall: Part III Story
    New Boss Fight Mechanics
    5 and 20 player Boss Raid Challenge
    75 new equippable items
    5 cinematic cutscenes (way to go Korin!)
    14 dialog cutscenes
    The snow melts in Battleon (Drooster returns)
    Level Cap increased to 20

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/eb019713d468a247d88776d23ccfba1d94ab4c3d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Become a DragonSlayer![/h1]

[b]All players can now earn the DragonSlayer Class[/b]
DragonSlayers are the elite hunters of Dragons. Their skills are finely honed giving them bonuses when battling dragonkind. Now, ALL PLAYERS, can earn the DragonSlayer class by doing storyline and daily quests to earn DragonSlayer Tokens. Talk to Galanoth in Ashfall to get started!
Read the official post on how to become a DragonSlayer. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/8d00c92f065f3a29518e729a43c275478e3779b6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Earn DragonSlayer Gear![/h1]

Once you are a DragonSlayer, you can continue earning tokens to unlock exclusive class gear including Galanoth's helmet and yes... oh yes... the legendary Dragon's Blade. We built this shop like the collections we released in the holiday. Which means once you unlock an item, you will have permanent access and be able to re-get it whenever you want. for 0 gold-- saving you that precious inventory space.  

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/28b131402c258e798eb0adf5034a6a1945c23c8d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Battle along side the DragonSlayers....[/h1]

In this epic finale to the Dragons of Ashfall Saga, you will battle alongside Galanoth, Kord, Senna and Gibbs. Each of these dragonslayers has a motivation for defeating Talyn, or the Great Dragon at the heart of the volcano. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/51f2a5c4902b03c9a7781248e148c3893130d67e.jpg[/img]

[h1]This story will impact the characters in our other games.[/h1]
...and now you know. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/13d004356e6425c2b5bc8e5b4bfe292a8aa06c48.jpg[/img]

[h1]Crafting and Ashfall Daily Quests[/h1]

Once you complete the story, you will unlock new craftable items. Be sure to check in with Senna, the DragonSlayer's Quartermaster to see all of the sets which include...

    Dragon Champion (Full set)
    Dragon Berserker (Full set)
    Pheonix Knight (Full set)
    Fire Mage (Full set)
    Fire Rogue (Full set)
    Talyn's Armor (Full set)
    Ebon Talyn Vault (VERY EXPENSIVE.... Full Set)
    DragonSlayer Gear (DragonSlayer Tokens)
    ...also, there are secret drops.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/751fc23aa0d204c73bfeb10fec4a2178d63254f5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Level Cap increased to 20![/h1]

Reaching level 20 will unlock our first raid boss fight.

[h1]5-Player & 20-Player BOSS RAID CHALLENGE![/h1]

Bring your friends and prepare for the most challenging battle in AdventureQuest 3D yet. You will all need to be max level and fully decked out. Unlike the single player boss fight, the enemy will not telegraph their attacks. So be sure to practice. I wish I could show you a screenshot of the actual fight (The screenshot above is from the first room of the story).... but Cysero told me if I posted any spoilers he would re-arrange my DNA. Check back in a few days for a post on "DEATH".

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4eafdbfee46f891989e75ba7b8b6c5f91083a804.jpg[/img]

[h1]Thank you... and prepare for the Dragon's Lair![/h1]

It has taken nearly a year to create the tools, systems, and processes that allow us to create amazing adventures and stories like Ashfall Part III. This is a special release for both the players and the team. Thank you for your loyalty, encouragement, and passion for our world. This release marks the start of many new epic adventures together (...and ones that will come much faster, LOL!) 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/05246e34a3188cea7029b01bd49f35b7f3d5d414.jpg[/img]

[h1]Coming next![/h1]

Next week we will release those two dungeons to the right and left at the top of Mount Ashfall. Then, it is time for Dage's birthday-- a gateway will open to new area of the Underworld. Heroes should be advised to be weary of signing any "contracts" in the underworld. Then the Shaman Forest and Dragon's Graveyard will quickly follow. Check our homepage daily for the newest design notes on our progress.... Oh! Every Monday we update the GAME PLAN. Feels pretty good that we knocked a few items off of that list already. It has only bee a week since it was posted.

[h1]Now, DragonSlayers...[/h1]
"It is time to enter the dragon's lair and take Talyn down... BATTLE ON!"

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?time_continue=1&v=yIZf8KLrx0A][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/bd26a860bb548a9ec92c89ed85ae2e0afe4eb67c.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?time_continue=1&v=yIZf8KLrx0A]Watch the trailer[/url]

notes.title: The Order of Dragon Slayers
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/dragonslayerorder/][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3d760b2c2935575813e7ce8a18497c492290f2e3.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]The DragonSlayers are an elite order of dragon hunters[/h1]

Early next week, you will join the DragonSlayers in their ultimate challenge... entering the dragon infested volcano in "[b]The Dragons of Ashfall: Part III[/b]". If you have not played parts one and two yet, this weekend is your chance to catch up and be part of the raid when it launches!

Read the [url=https://aq3d.com/news/dragonslayerorder/]FULL DESIGN NOTES POST on DragonSlayers[/url]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7b9c11ede815138c919338f47a6fe9c9dcf4bc43.jpg[/img]
[h1]Galanoth[/h1]
Leader of the DragonSlayers
Everyone has heard of the DragonSlayer's iconic and heavily armored leader, Galanoth. He wields the legendary sword, the Dragon Blade. However, no one has ever seen his face*. Stoic and obsessed with eliminating the the threat of dragons, he is a man of a single purpose. Now, Galanoth prepares to lead the DragonSlayers on the ultimate hunt, deep in the heart of Ashfall's volcano. Want to join them?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/05246e34a3188cea7029b01bd49f35b7f3d5d414.jpg[/img]
[h1]Talyn[/h1]
Evil Lord of Dragons
Legend says there are amulets that grant the power to control dragons. Talyn possesses such an amulet. How he got it is a mystery. However, what he intends to do with it has become horrifyingly clear. See, a DragonAmulet does far more than just allow someone to control dragons. Its ultimate ability allows you to bind yourself to a dragon. This bond is for life. It grants both the owner of the amulet, and their dragon, incredible powers and abilities.  Talyn used his amulet to do this once... but his dragon has been slain*. He is clearly seeking a new dragon, but not just any dragon. At the heart of Ashfall's volcano sleeps an Great Dragon. It is MASSIVE. It is SMART. It is... well, best left asleep. Few people in the world have ever laid eyes on a Great Dragon and lived to tell the tale. Galanoth and his second in command, Kord, have. A Great Fire Dragon. The same one Talyn is going to try to awaken and bind himself to in the volcano... 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/323e45ce23e059e86101f58abce0b226cafe2206.jpg[/img]
[h1]Kord[/h1]
2nd in Command of the DragonSlayers
Kord is strong, loyal, and charismatic commander. He is the glue which keeps the order of DragonSlayers together. He would have to be, because Galanoth can really come off as a dragon obsessed jerk. You could make a strong argument that there would not even be an Order of DragonSlayers without Kord. As new recruits flock to the iconic Galanoth because of his fame and legend-- Kord is the one who finds them a place within the DragonSlayer's ranks. Perhaps you had a similar experience when joining the DragonSlayers? Kord is one of the original members. Why is he so loyal to Galanoth? Well, Galanoth saved him when a Great Fire Dragon destroyed his home town, leaving him orphaned. Kord was just a boy back then-- and despite Galanoth's repeated attempts to shoo him away, Kord refused to leave his side. He became an expert at slaying dragons... and Galanoth's trusted, right hand man. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a010c16f1e5ddf5a5a13ec0a3b64136ecc22080f.jpg[/img]
[h1]Senna[/h1]
DragonSlayer Quartermaster
Senna is no stranger to a weapon, but her resourcefulness and charm made her a natural at trading with locals for food, supplies, armor and weapons. A Quartermaster's job is to keep the troops equipped for combat. Whatever she cannot buy, she can craft. If she secretly has a thing with Kord, they are doing a pretty freaking good job of keeping it secret. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/cbf983674c9ced706f2b706f7c272eeda8857357.jpg[/img]
[h1]GIBBS[/h1]
Demolitions "Expert"... and Brother
"I make things go boom!" Gibbs and his sister Essa are both skilled DragonSlayers. Both came to the DragonSlayer Order after, like Kord, a dragon destroyed their town and left them without parents. Since then they have done what they can to support an orphanage for victims of dragon attacks. Normally they are assigned together, but during the Ashfall campaign they were split up. His sister, Essa, was assigned to protect the people of Brimston village*. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4eafdbfee46f891989e75ba7b8b6c5f91083a804.jpg[/img]
[h1]DragonSlayers... the hunt begins next week![/h1]
Galanoth is preparing his speech to boost the morale of of the DragonSlayers before entering the volcano, Mount Ashfall. We will fight side by side and emerge victorious, or fall, as one!

[h1]Coming Next Week (Finally)[/h1]
    Dragon's of Ashfall: Part III Story Finale
    Fight alongside the cast of DragonSlayers above!
    DragonSlayer Class - earn through daily quests or buy
    DragonSlayer Class Armor & Weapons - earned through daily quests
    Dragon's Lair - Solo (Story Mode)
    Dragon's Lair Dungeon - up to 3 player (Adventure Mode)
    Boss Raid - 5 player
    Boss Raid - 20 Player
    Name Plates (New Regular, Guardian, Collector's Guardian, Kickstarter)

notes.title: The Order of Dragon Slayers
notes.content:
[url=https://aq3d.com/news/dragonslayerorder/][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3d760b2c2935575813e7ce8a18497c492290f2e3.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]The DragonSlayers are an elite order of dragon hunters[/h1]

Early next week, you will join the DragonSlayers in their ultimate challenge... entering the dragon infested volcano in "[b]The Dragons of Ashfall: Part III[/b]". If you have not played parts one and two yet, this weekend is your chance to catch up and be part of the raid when it launches!

Read the [url=https://aq3d.com/news/dragonslayerorder/]FULL DESIGN NOTES POST on DragonSlayers[/url]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7b9c11ede815138c919338f47a6fe9c9dcf4bc43.jpg[/img]
[h1]Galanoth[/h1]
Leader of the DragonSlayers
Everyone has heard of the DragonSlayer's iconic and heavily armored leader, Galanoth. He wields the legendary sword, the Dragon Blade. However, no one has ever seen his face*. Stoic and obsessed with eliminating the the threat of dragons, he is a man of a single purpose. Now, Galanoth prepares to lead the DragonSlayers on the ultimate hunt, deep in the heart of Ashfall's volcano. Want to join them?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/05246e34a3188cea7029b01bd49f35b7f3d5d414.jpg[/img]
[h1]Talyn[/h1]
Evil Lord of Dragons
Legend says there are amulets that grant the power to control dragons. Talyn possesses such an amulet. How he got it is a mystery. However, what he intends to do with it has become horrifyingly clear. See, a DragonAmulet does far more than just allow someone to control dragons. Its ultimate ability allows you to bind yourself to a dragon. This bond is for life. It grants both the owner of the amulet, and their dragon, incredible powers and abilities.  Talyn used his amulet to do this once... but his dragon has been slain*. He is clearly seeking a new dragon, but not just any dragon. At the heart of Ashfall's volcano sleeps an Great Dragon. It is MASSIVE. It is SMART. It is... well, best left asleep. Few people in the world have ever laid eyes on a Great Dragon and lived to tell the tale. Galanoth and his second in command, Kord, have. A Great Fire Dragon. The same one Talyn is going to try to awaken and bind himself to in the volcano... 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/323e45ce23e059e86101f58abce0b226cafe2206.jpg[/img]
[h1]Kord[/h1]
2nd in Command of the DragonSlayers
Kord is strong, loyal, and charismatic commander. He is the glue which keeps the order of DragonSlayers together. He would have to be, because Galanoth can really come off as a dragon obsessed jerk. You could make a strong argument that there would not even be an Order of DragonSlayers without Kord. As new recruits flock to the iconic Galanoth because of his fame and legend-- Kord is the one who finds them a place within the DragonSlayer's ranks. Perhaps you had a similar experience when joining the DragonSlayers? Kord is one of the original members. Why is he so loyal to Galanoth? Well, Galanoth saved him when a Great Fire Dragon destroyed his home town, leaving him orphaned. Kord was just a boy back then-- and despite Galanoth's repeated attempts to shoo him away, Kord refused to leave his side. He became an expert at slaying dragons... and Galanoth's trusted, right hand man. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a010c16f1e5ddf5a5a13ec0a3b64136ecc22080f.jpg[/img]
[h1]Senna[/h1]
DragonSlayer Quartermaster
Senna is no stranger to a weapon, but her resourcefulness and charm made her a natural at trading with locals for food, supplies, armor and weapons. A Quartermaster's job is to keep the troops equipped for combat. Whatever she cannot buy, she can craft. If she secretly has a thing with Kord, they are doing a pretty freaking good job of keeping it secret. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/cbf983674c9ced706f2b706f7c272eeda8857357.jpg[/img]
[h1]GIBBS[/h1]
Demolitions "Expert"... and Brother
"I make things go boom!" Gibbs and his sister Essa are both skilled DragonSlayers. Both came to the DragonSlayer Order after, like Kord, a dragon destroyed their town and left them without parents. Since then they have done what they can to support an orphanage for victims of dragon attacks. Normally they are assigned together, but during the Ashfall campaign they were split up. His sister, Essa, was assigned to protect the people of Brimston village*. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4eafdbfee46f891989e75ba7b8b6c5f91083a804.jpg[/img]
[h1]DragonSlayers... the hunt begins next week![/h1]
Galanoth is preparing his speech to boost the morale of of the DragonSlayers before entering the volcano, Mount Ashfall. We will fight side by side and emerge victorious, or fall, as one!

[h1]Coming Next Week (Finally)[/h1]
    Dragon's of Ashfall: Part III Story Finale
    Fight alongside the cast of DragonSlayers above!

notes.title: The Mouse Hole - Our Smallest Adventure Ever!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e9812eeac615ed7129efb82dd462dc74559e4e03.jpg[/img]
Read the full post at https://aq3d.com/news/mousehole/

[h1]Just released![/h1]
Did you ever notice that little mouse hole in Yulgar’s Inn? What if you could find a way to shrink down to a tiny size and go in there? Well now you can. What could you possibly find? Parkour… strange loot... a Badge? Log in and find out!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9b054cfb860e6f36f14974ab296581a7aa104da9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Parkour!? Why do the Mice have a Parkour Course?[/h1]
Keep your eyes open, and you will find a secret parkour course hidden in this new adventure. The prize for reaching the top of the course? An exploration achievement badge! But... BE CAREFUL! When designing the course, Yergen deviously add some MwP “Mess with Players” mechanics. This will allow you to do terrible things to your fellow micro-ninja-warriors.

[b]CHALLENGE[/b] - Can you beat Cysero’s fastest time of 1 minute and 30 seconds? Tweet @ArtixKrieger and @Cysero YouTube link or it did not happen :D

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/60d436994ca5d574c1fb6e12abaae8931d198710.jpg[/img]

[h1]Travel Form Foods & Potions[/h1]
New Feature! You can now craft a piece of cheese that will transform you into, um, something... “Squeek!” This is a consumable “single use” item. And yes, everyone is able to make some cheese through regular game play in this adventure. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f152ecc7f4b1150ca5e15622ffc10287473a94aa.jpg[/img]
 
[h1]“Rats off to the Vurrmen artist!”[/h1]
The Vurrmen are a race of giant rat monsters that first appeared in our 2D web game, DragonFable. Who would have believed back in 2007 as artist/ninja Thyton was drawing it, that he would be involved in creating a 3D version of it today! Granted, the Vurrmen are still small and rat sized at this point in the game’s story. But if you can become small… what is stopping them from finding a way to become big? Beware the Vurrmenator.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/110a31c53b139052d28099a64ee3354fd99bbd2f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Sneak Peek of Ashfall: Part III armors[/h1]
The wait is nearly over. Korin is finishing the last 2 incredible, fully animated cutscenes. Until then, here is a sneak peek of the Dragon Beserker armor sets that you will earn from battling the Great Dragon at the heart of Ashfall’s volcano. Yes, these armors will use your skin color.'

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4f1dbab8b5a541951af49dea67fbc61b43e21386.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Game Plan[/h1]
Over 2,000 players gave their deepest thoughts about AdventureQuest 3D to a survey that deep down inside they figured no one would read. SURPRISE! We did. All of them O_O. Read everything we learned and our new game plan.

[list]
[*]“10/10! A really gouda release!”
[*]“Love the occasional cheesy storyline!”
[*]“5 Stars! Can’t believe they squeaked out this release in time for the weekend!”
[*]“For their smallest release ever.. it is pretty big!”
[/list]

[h1]Thank you & Say Cheese![/h1]
The mouse hole was a fan favorite adventure from the original 2D AdventureQuest. It was one of those strange and memorable things that gave the game its charm. We are excited to see if you can find the way into our re-imagined adventure… maybe the Warlic in the magic shop can help? The Mouse Hole is available now, and it is the first of several adventures coming to new Yulgar’s Inn.

Thank you to everyone who has been encouraging and supporting AdventureQuest 3D’s development. If you are not already a Guardian, please consider supporting the game’s on going releases with a one-time upgrade.

[b]Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Mice[/b]

notes.title: Frostlorn Raiders Invade Town!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f733a0d71a3f526a9fa233498e682a2c33264110.jpg[/img]
Full post at https://www.aq3d.com/news/frostlorn-raiders/

[h1]Frostlorn Raiders invade town![/h1]
Who do these Frostlorn Raiders think they are?! Just as the worst snowstorm we have ever seen hits our home town of Battleon, they waltz in with their weapons drawn. We thought they needed help.  As our friends rushed out to assist them... they were struck down in cold blood, then they unleashed their army of frost monsters. Even as you read this, these icy abominations are attacking our shops and people. Defender Roland has declared an emergency and re-formed the Battleon Militia-- we need your help. Come quickly! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ef0e2d6048e9d8ff7e1ee8d545f487f22cc3907d.jpg[/img]
[h1]Frostval returns with seasonal loot drops and crafting![/h1]
They will only be here for a short time. Login and battle to get your festive “O’Tannenbush” travel form, ugly sweater capes, Yettun horns, Frostlorn items, Frost Defender Armor, Elf Armors, Santa Armor (cannot believe Dage & Yergen got this finished in time), wrapped weapons, festive scarves, and other items. Oh, and Guardians... the Raiders are dropping a Rudolf the Reindragon travel form just for you.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fba3d3c42fc1cba0c4e047f224cf7c9327bc6291.jpg[/img]
[h1]The Frost Labyrinth[/h1]
The Yettun has returned and the Frost Labyrinth is open! Battle through the Frost Labyrinth to defeat the Yettun and restore the Frost Moglins to the land they lost so long ago. Talk to Blizzy, the light blue moglin near the Travel Crystal in Battleon, to being your adventure. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/5fde128c8783a0ac87e0da4bad324b8249b0ab87.jpg[/img]
[h1]The 2017 Frostval Collection[/h1]
The first ever Frostval Collection is now available! Talk to the little blue moglin Blizzy in Battleon to get the new items individually, or get the ENTIRE 2017 Frostval Collection (save about 45%)! 

[h1]What is included in the Collection?[/h1]
The collection includes a rare badge, permanent, free access to the items year round (freeing up your inventory space) including both snowman travel forms, and that warm and fuzzy feeling from knowing that you are directly supporting AdventureQuest 3D’s ongoing development. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/58c1bb76cfd137aac64d1bf7b88becf7261b0274.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Yulgar’s Inn[/h1]
Town is not the only place getting into the holiday spirit. Yulgar & Melodia just finished decorating the new and improved Inn. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0626085e9fe8c3e6ed7863010897cfa9321e0936.jpg[/img]
[h1]“There is so much stuff to do, but all I want to do is hang out in this cozy inn!” - a player[/h1]
Come in from the cold, have a seat and warm up! Seriously, you can sit in the chairs now and the Inn’s new music is beautiful. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0dad790d00f88aa1a0cdc9f17a249891737be056.jpg[/img]
[h1]HeroMart[/h1]
Check out the new stuff at  www.HeroMart.com including the Ugly Sweater T-Shirt and our 2018 Calendar. And if you were studying this photo closely, um, yes, we decorated the lab’s tree with an Alien facehugger. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c43eb10435e0515b70225cacc4506480760b135b.jpg[/img]
[h1]Next Week… Frostlorn Boss Raid! [/h1]
The Frostlorn Raiders have three leaders…. Faustbite, Phrozen, and Sleet. Think you and your friends can take them on in a group vs group fight? We are going to find out. Next week, to bring in the new year, we are releasing a special 10-player raid map where you will battle them! You will also get the chance to craft the Frostlorn Mage and Rogue armor sets!

[h1]Thank You for 15 Years of Adventure[/h1]
We hope you are enjoying this wintery, frostval release. While the team was finishing it up, I made you a special 15th anniversary cape. It will be available for you in game next week. It symbolizes, without question, our community and team’s most significant achievement together. Pouring your life and soul into something for 15 years is a really big deal. What is important about this is not the number, but the dedication, passion, and loyalty that it represents. When you consider that the original AdventureQuest has been updated every single week for over 15 years-- it makes you stop and think “how can someone love these games that much?” Of course, YOU know. Because, if you are reading this, you do too. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/33090f67d27b97a719a96cbd6afba066bb81c264.jpg[/img]

From all of us here at the Artix Entertainment “Secret Underground Lab”, we wish you, your family and your friends all the happiness, joy, warmth and fun to be had in this holiday season. 

[b]Happy Frostval & Battle on!
Artix & The Merry AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

Login and battle to get your festive “O’Tannenbush” travel form, ugly sweater capes, Yettun horns, Frostlorn items, Frost Defender Armor, Elf Armors, Santa Armor (cannot believe Dage & Yergen got this finished in time), wrapped weapons, festive scarves, and other items. Oh, and Guardians... the Raiders are dropping a Rudolf the Reindragon travel form just for you.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fba3d3c42fc1cba0c4e047f224cf7c9327bc6291.jpg[/img]
[h1]The Frost Labyrinth[/h1]
The Yettun has returned and the Frost Labyrinth is open! Battle through the Frost Labyrinth to defeat the Yettun and restore the Frost Moglins to the land they lost so long ago. Talk to Blizzy, the light blue moglin near the Travel Crystal in Battleon, to being your adventure. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/5fde128c8783a0ac87e0da4bad324b8249b0ab87.jpg[/img]
[h1]The 2017 Frostval Collection[/h1]
The first ever Frostval Collection is now available! Talk to the little blue moglin Blizzy in Battleon to get the new items individually, or get the ENTIRE 2017 Frostval Collection (save about 45%)! 

[h1]What is included in the Collection?[/h1]
The collection includes a rare badge, permanent, free access to the items year round (freeing up your inventory space) including both snowman travel forms, and that warm and fuzzy feeling from knowing that you are directly supporting AdventureQuest 3D’s ongoing development. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/58c1bb76cfd137aac64d1bf7b88becf7261b0274.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Yulgar’s Inn[/h1]
Town is not the only place getting into the holiday spirit. Yulgar & Melodia just finished decorating the new and improved Inn. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0626085e9fe8c3e6ed7863010897cfa9321e0936.jpg[/img]
[h1]“There is so much stuff to do, but all I want to do is hang out in this cozy inn!” - a player[/h1]
Come in from the cold, have a seat and warm up! Seriously, you can sit in the chairs now and the Inn’s new music is beautiful. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0dad790d00f88aa1a0cdc9f17a249891737be056.jpg[/img]
[h1]HeroMart[/h1]
Check out the new stuff at  www.HeroMart.com including the Ugly Sweater T-Shirt and our 2018 Calendar. And if you were studying this photo closely, um, yes, we decorated the lab’s tree with an Alien facehugger. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c43eb10435e0515b70225cacc4506480760b135b.jpg[/img]
[h1]Next Week… Frostlorn Boss Raid! [/h1]
The Frostlorn Raiders have three leaders…. Faustbite, Phrozen, and Sleet. Think you and your friends can take them on in a group vs group fight? We are going to find out. Next week, to bring in the new year, we are releasing a special 10-player raid map where you will battle them! You will also get the chance to craft the Frostlorn Mage and Rogue armor sets!

[h1]Thank You for 15 Years of Adventure[/h1]
We hope you are enjoying this wintery, frostval release. While the team was finishing it up, I made you a special 15th anniversary cape. It will be available for you in game next week. It symbolizes, without question, our community and team’s most significant achievement together. Pouring your life and soul into something for 15 years is a really big deal. What is important about this is not the number, but the dedication, passion, and loyalty that it represents. When you consider that the original AdventureQuest has been updated every single week for over 15 years-- it makes you stop and think “how can someone love these games that much?” Of course, YOU know. Because, if you are reading this, you do too. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/33090f67d27b97a719a96cbd6afba066bb81c264.jpg[/img]

From all of us here at the Artix Entertainment “Secret Underground Lab”, we wish you, your family and your friends all the happiness, joy, warmth and fun to be had in this holiday season. 

[b]Happy Frostval & Battle on!
Artix & The Merry AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

notes.title: You just got +10 Inventory Spaces!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3ac870b19a69b3efa99e7dee33713a9da546bb4b.jpg[/img]

[h1]EVERYONE gets 10 more Inventory Spaces[/h1]

We heard you were running out of room, so we just added 10 more inventory spaces to your character’s backpack :D This should help a little with your storage needs while we work on a few longer term solutions to free up your main inventory space. Enjoy!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b5a92b1ac539ce306e0734f5cb085eceef7315e4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Coming next in AdventureQuest 3D[/h1]

Darkovia is currently open now for all players. Next up, the saga continues in Part II which leads us deep into Darkovia’s Forest where you will encounter a Werewolf Hunter named Little Dread-- and search for the forest’s most carefully guarded secret. Meanwhile, the newest version of the game has been submitted which will bring new features and squish a good number of bugs. Finally, we have a 1st draft of the DragonSlayer class that we are experimenting with. As promised, Legendary Backers are going to get first shot at trying it out soon. Ashfall Part III’s cinematics are making good progress. We will need to do one of those “Last time, on DragonFable Z” style recap videos before you go into the finale so the plot is fresh in your mind. Finally, OMG I cannot wait until you see the Vampire King’s castle-- I can see the throne room on Llussion’s screen from where I am sitting and it is amazing. Maybe I should post a sneak peek ealry next week. For the latest news and updates, be sure to keep an eye on my regular design notes posts here.

Read more at [url]http://www.AQ3D.com[/url]

notes.title: Darkovia! Vampires vs Werewolves
notes.content:
[url=http://www.aq3d.com/news/darkovialive/][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b5a92b1ac539ce306e0734f5cb085eceef7315e4.jpg[/img][/url]

Read the full news at [url=http://www.aq3d.com/news/darkovialive/]http://www.aq3d.com/news/darkovialive/[/url]

In Darkovia, a land cursed by eternal darkness, the vampires and werewolves have locked fangs in a deadly war. But why is their conflict centered on the small town of Darkhurst? Does it possess a secret or some sort of terrible prize? A ShadowSlayer has appeared in town to help protect the townsfolk-- but in a conflict of this size, they cannot do it alone!

[list]
[*] Level Cap Raised to 18
[*] Town of Darkhurst
[*] Boog's Tavern - sit in the chairs!
[*] 21 Dialog Cutscenes
[*] ShadowSlayer side quests-- unlock E's gear
[*] Book of Darkov side quests - secrets and lore
[*] New weapons, armor, and items
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/bbd34a3b69d3467cea1e7a2e96b622034b15ff8e.jpg[/img]

[h1]The ShadowSlayer[/h1]
[b]“I stalk the creatures that stalk the night.”[/b]
You will meet ShadowStalker W, Lore's foremost expert vampire slayer & werewolf hunter. W is the 23rd of his line and ever willing to help the victims of these creatures-- for a price. Earn his trust and begin your training as a ShadowSlayer unlocking vampire and werewolf hunting gear. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2d7004beb269c6bef9fb26e009f7a594ba976c74.jpg[/img]

[h1]Boog’s Tavern[/h1]
[b]“Wait, we can actually sit in the chairs now?”[/b]
Part 1 of the Darkovia Saga is extremely story focused, setting our new record of TWENTY-TWO dialogue cutscenes and introducing a cast of interesting and “a wee bit doomed” characters. Also, yes, you can sit in the chairs. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/11c18d4fcf1645a7467e207ab581b03b1ab824e4.jpg[/img]

[h1]More Darkovia to sink your fangs into...[/h1]
We really hope you enjoy this first part of the Darkovia Saga. The next exciting release continues where this one leaves off... granting you access to Darkovia Forest. We wrote the story arc in such a way that after Part II, we can switch back to the highly anticipated conclusion of our previous area, Ashfall. Which means, as you are reading this, Korin is animating the cinematic cutscenes for The Dragons of Ashfall: Part III while Rabblefroth is working on the DragonSlayer class!  We are also building several new features (which you can easily guess at) for the future parts of Darkovia which will make it really interesting when you can side with the Vamps and Lycans (Werewolves).

[url=http://www.AQ3D.com]Read more news at http://www.AQ3D.com[/url]

notes.content:

[h1]Combat overhaul is a literal "Game Changer"[/h1]
Read the full story at [url]http://www.aq3d.com/news/improvedclasses/[/url]

Login on any device and play the new & improved Warrior, Rogue, Mage, and Guardian classes. They now feature unique play styles with new skills, animated FX, and ULTIMATES!

[h1]New in AdventureQuest 3D version 1.6.0 code name "Pew Pew"[/h1]

We hope you love it-- every class feels more fun to play. This is a vital update, setting the foundation for us to create the next wave of classes. Login and see for yourself, or read on for the juicy details.

notes.title: Mogloween is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4ef47ccdfe0186a0e6648b367a92b5528b5eff24.jpg[/img]

[h1]Mogloween has begun![/h1]

Enter the haunted Mystcroft Manor... if you dare. ...Insert sinister "MWAHAHAHAHA" laughter here... How? Speak with that talking cauldron named Myx in town

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/021986fab5d8ea88e333af3e5b9313db7cfa48d8.jpg[/img]

[h1]Pumpkinmancer (NEW!)[/h1]

Ambitious adventurous will quest to unlock all wings of the haunted mansion and craft this year's new seasonal rare set-- Pumpkinmancer! There is also a Pumpkin Scythe and a Shadow variant of the helm.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/566ebb028f4b0e4a6e1089b350d8bbf8e7e9d916.jpg[/img]

Mystcroft manor now has a map of its own... 


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fe64e066870b9113dcc6d4709f49a581ca5554ff.jpg[/img]

[h1]"OH! YEAH! NOOO!"[/h1]

OK, we seriously need a meme of Myx busting through a wall yelling "OH! NOOO!" This talking black cauldron is always brewing up trouble... evil pumpkin spice flavored trouble. Someone (or thing) placed him in our freshly decorated town. Talk to him to travel to Mystcroft Manor, Camp Gonnagetcha, get the 2017 Mogloween Collector's Edition, and more. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/00d959d831446c4230f826ee2b9cd32a86196a44.jpg[/img]

[h1]Mogloween 2017 Collection[/h1]

Our 1st ever Mogloween collection features brand new items, armor, and two travel forms-- Skeleton and Lil’ Skelly! Both which run at 130% travel speed. Get the items separately, or get the ENTIRE Mogloween 2017 collection which  includes a rare badge, permanent access to the items which frees up your inventory space, will save you a coffin-load of (30% off = Save 2,200 DCs), and you are directly supporting AQ3D’s ongoing development.

[h1]Happy Mogloween![/h1]

Mogloween and the loot you can obtain in it is only available once a year for a limited time... and that time is now. Mystcroft Manor is vastly superior to last year. You will not fall through any *coughs* trap doors. (Last year, we used to fall straight through the map under certain situations) The Haunted Manor is now scaling allowing all players to play together. Furthermore, there is a level 12+ requirement for the higher level challenge wing Which means no level 1 players can wander in and stay there, making it impossible to clear the room. But if you do need to go, you can now leave the house at any time by existing through the red glowly indicators on the floor. The new quest systems will make it very clear where to go. Because we used a new quest chain, everyone will play from the start-- but it does not take very long.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/72eba2eabd414ed13e2c3bfa466ba82c0d5ac65d.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f98ebaadadf5727f05cbde760a602934a0dee999.jpg[/img]



[b]Happy haunting heroes![/b]

notes.title: LIVE! Friday the 13th War & Mogloween
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2771d67b141058f695205acb07e4d2ef3c13712a.jpg[/img]

[h1]LIVE! Friday the 13th War & Mogloween[/h1]

[b]“The smell of pumpkin spice and doom surrounds you.”[/b]
Happy Friday the 13th! Log and join everyone in AdventureQuest 3D as we kick off our trilogy of dark releases. Starting with a thriller double feature!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/5edec8335c8e2a95db6dc6b542dec6702208d35f.jpg[/img]

Town has been redecorated for Mogloween and the haunted house is about to open-- right after one side wins our 1st head-to-head war in the grand opening of Camp Gonnagetcha! So… which side will you fight for?

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fa481d53b01f61dbbf80844fdecda7a19be5a028.jpg[/img]

[h1]Camp Gonnagetcha[/h1]

We are putting the campy back in the iconic "B-Horror" Camp experience. Just remember the 3 simple rules for surviving a scary movie
[list]
[*]No kissy-kissy face
[*]Stay off the Moglinberry Juice
[*]NEVER… EVER… say “I’ll be right back.”
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/1852643138f3cbcabe39449b7aeb361839d69644.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Return of Shrade[/h1]

Everyone’s favorite psychopathic, machete wielding, hockey loving, epic-horror-loot-pinata is back for a sequel. He’s got new art and loot-- you better bring some tough friends. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ad7b4353ab9440a9ad6730c249e029602d5f673b.jpg[/img]

[h1]WAR! Dricken vs Frogzard Cabin[/h1]

Choose your side and become a part of AdventureQuest 3D history in our first two sided war! The first side to fill up their war meter in Camp Gonnagetcha will win, unlocking a Perma-rare black flag and opening the Haunted Mystcroft Manor for all players.

    Fight for Frogzard Cabin or Dricken Cabin
    The memes on Twitter have been hilarious
    Turn in war badges to help your side fill up their meter
    New craftable item(s) unlock at 25%
    New craftable armor(s) unlocks at 50%
    1st team to 100% wins
    Mogloween’s Mystcroft Manor will open!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f98ebaadadf5727f05cbde760a602934a0dee999.jpg[/img]

[h1]Mogloween’s Mystcroft Manor[/h1]

Mystcroft Manor is home to witches, ghosts, shadow trickers, Pumpkin Lords, and the Elder Grourd, Gourd’thulu.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/566ebb028f4b0e4a6e1089b350d8bbf8e7e9d916.jpg[/img]

It now has its own map, and a new pumpkin armor set, which will unlock after the camp war has been won!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b96640636a48837a0f3fb4bd3c078def8bf924d4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Darkovia[/h1]

Coming next! The Vampires and Werewolves have locked fangs a bitter war over Darkovia-- a land consumed by eternal night. Can you save the small town caught between the ambitions of the Vampire King and Lycan Alpha? Things may go a little differently than you remembered in this re-imagining of the iconic AdventureQuest saga.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c19162ec4ed74fe009d6fe7257ecd6fa42739fa3.jpg[/img]

[h1]T-Shirts at HeroMart.com[/h1]

Feel like taking this event a bit too far? For a VERY limited time, you can get Camp Gonnagetcha shirts from our online store, www.HeroMart.com . Says Camp Gonnagetcha with a “Hello! My name’s Shrade” name tag on the front, and your side’s team logo of your choice on the back.
Get one while you can

[b]NOTE:[/b] Stryche (who runs the shop) asked me to let you know he has been working on reducing shipping costs.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/00d959d831446c4230f826ee2b9cd32a86196a44.jpg[/img]

[h1]Mogloween 2017 Collection[/h1]

Our 1st ever Mogloween collection features brand new items, armor, and two travel forms-- Skeleton and Lil’ Skelly! Both which run at 130% travel speed. Get the items separately, or get the ENTIRE Mogloween 2017 collection which  includes a rare badge, permanent access to the items which frees up your inventory space, will save you a coffin-load of (30% off = Save 2,200 DCs), and you are directly supporting AQ3D’s ongoing development.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/abf34e691b66670c588857e58f9b4c14df48302d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Thank you & Happy 15th Anniversary[/h1]

Thank you for being an important part of our game world and making this game happen. This time of the year is so much fun! We hope you enjoy the lineup of dark releases we are making for you-- both here and across our other Artix Entertainment video games.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fe64e066870b9113dcc6d4709f49a581ca5554ff.jpg[/img]

[h1]Time for war![/h1]
Myx the cauldron is in town waiting to take you to the war. Wait… did you say you were fighting for the Dricken or Frogzard team? No matter-- when either side hits 100% and wins, the rusty iron gates to Mystcrot Manor will creak open and Mogloween will begin! 

[b]Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

[b]P.S.[/b] Pssst... Guardians. We snuck a special Pumpkin Travel form into Mogloween release for you. We think it looks smashing.
[b]P.P.S.[/b] The new Warrior, Rogue, Mage, and Guardian may be going up for testing on the PTR next week

notes.title: Talk Like a Pirate Day 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/8ad933067c0d38382a44b3948177e1a07b8a4a1a.jpg[/img]

Talk Like a Pirate Day Weekend!

Avast, ye' lilly livered land lubbers-- AdventureQuest 3D be celebrating its 1st ever Talk Like a Pirate Day. Raid a DC shop full o' booty to be walk'n the plank in style, har har.
[url=http://www.aq3d.com/news/tlapd2017/]See the full post on the official www.AQ3D.com website[/url]

[h1]What is Talk Like a Pirate Day?[/h1]

Shivery me timbers! Next Tuesday, September 19th, is the official International Talk Like a Pirate Day (Or "TLAPD" if ye be one'o dem abbrever-inating scallywags). It is a one-day holiday where we... well, me matey, the name pretty much sums it up. Created by John Baur & Mark Summers, we have been celebrating it every single year in our video games. Did you know the infamous Captain Rhubarb's arrived during our 1st  Talk Like a Pirate Day in the original AdventureQuest?

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2775/tlapd-gif.gif[/img]

[h1]Captain Rhubarb's Pirate Shop[/h1]

Captain Rhubarb is visiting the town of Battleon for a short time. Talk to him and check out his shop full of cosmetic DC seasonal loot.

[list]
[*]Pirate Hook Hand - 250 DC
[*]Eye patch - 100 DC
[*]Pirate Hat & Eye patch - 100 DC
[*]Pirate Anchor (Weapon) - 250 DC
[*]Big Pirate Cutlass - 250 DC
[*]Anchor on your Back - 500 DC
[*]King's Cutlass - 250 DC
[*]Pirate Shell Shoulders - 500 DC
[*]Naval Shell Shoulders - 500 DC
[*]Leather Pirate Coat (Armor) - 1100 DC
[*]Leather Pirate Hat - 100 DC
[*]Leather Pirate Gloves - 150 DC
[*]Leather Pirate Boots - 150 DC
[*]Leather Pirate Belt - 100 DC
[*]Naval Commander Coat (Armor) - 1100 DC
[*]Naval Commander Eye Patch - 100 DC
[*]Naval Commander Hat - 100 DC
[*]Naval Commander Gloves - 150 DC
[*]Naval Commander Boots - 150 DC
[*]Naval Commander Belt - 100 DC
[*]Naval Commander Shoulders - 500 DC
[*]Naval Commander Cutlass - 250 DC
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f9c45c4f5cfd8115f022c9d8e70002db748bf68b.jpg[/img]

[h1]GET IT ALL! Pirate Collector's Bounty 2017[/h1]

[b]Permanently unlock every item from the 2017 Talk Like a Pirate Day Shop[/b]

Want to have every item? Want to have permanent access to every item year round without using up any of that precious bank space? Buy the "Pirate Collector's Bounty 2017" for 4,900 DC. This is a special quest item-- turn it in to Captain Rhubarb, and you will permanently unlock ALL of the items from the first ever AdventureQuest 3D Talk Like a Pirate Day. It will also give you a RARE badge.

That's right! The character page badge that you get for unlocking the 2017 TLAPD collection is RARE. Each year's collection will have its own badge so this is your ONLY CHANCE to get it! 

The entire collection will be available to you through a shop which contains all the items for 0 gold (meaning you can freely get it, delete it, and get it again whenever you want.)

If ye purchase the Pirate Collector's Bounty 2017, ye can access it from Captain Rhubarb until he leaves or from Melodia in Yulgar's Inn at any time.

[h1]Kickstarter Alpha Pirate Bonus[/h1]

[b]Alpha Pirate Shell Shoulders, Gloves, and Pirate Sword Back Item![/b]

AdventureQuest 3D keeps getting better, and in our next major release we will have the new Warrior, Rogue, Mage, and Guardian classes. Once you fall in love with those, we will rapidly be releasing Dragonslayer, Paladin, Necromancer, Ninja, and... Alpha Pirate-- which will be our first ranged Pistol class. We really wanted to surprise you by having it ready for this event, but it will be worth the wait. So, for this special event, we put bonus gifts in your Alpha Pirate shop at the Founder's sanctuary to give you more pieces to your perma-rare set-- Alpha Pirate Shell Shoulders, Gloves, and a Pirate Sword Back Item!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3b024d8cb36d50bc346d12e47d9a13523a1f3e26.jpg[/img]

[h1]How to Talk Like a Pirate[/h1]

Thee first thing ye need to know ‘bout becomin’ a pirate be crucial: ye gotta believe yer a pirate! If ye don’t truly believe ye be a Swashbuckler, then ain't nobody else gonna be fooled!

[b]Best follow these steps below![/b]

[list]
[*]We pirates don’t be good at speakin’. We scowl a lot, and we like to mutter most o’ our words. Best get used to it, matey!
[*]Ye gotta run yer words together. Ye gotta slur. Don’t use no proper sentences, neither!
[*]If ye still have yer hands, use a motherload o’ gestures. Movin’ yer hands about when ye speak be key to a pirate’s life. It also be good fer ye circulation!
[*] Pirates be loud n’ lusty. Th' louder ye be, th' smart’r ye sound!
[*]Never say “you” or “your” unless ye wishes to walk thee plank! It be “ye” an’ “yer” in th' Pirate’s life! Savvy?
[*]Oh, and it be “me” and not no “mine”! Fer example, “that be me sword, ye no-good, two-toothed, thievin’ scallywag!”
[*]Drop th' “g” after words endin’ in “ing”. There be no need fer that “g” after many words, like goin’, and questin’, and fishin’, and swimmin’!
[*]Make up words if ye have to! We pirates don’t be minding a wee bit o’ hornswaggling!
[*]Never leave port without yer good luck charm, or there be mighty dire consequences! I never leaves home without me lucky skull beret!
[/list]

On behalf o’ th' Aaaaaaartix Entertainment crew, ye be ready fer Talk Like a Pirate Day! Grab ye cutlass and ye hat, and don’t be forgettin’ yer lucky charm! At any time that ye be needin’ a quick reminder, come back ‘n get a refresher! Savvy, pirate?

[b]Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]
(My [url=https://twitter.com/artixkrieger]Twitter[/url] & [url=https://www.facebook.com/artixkrieger]Facebook[/url])

See more of what we are working on at [url]www.AQ3D.com[/url]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3b024d8cb36d50bc346d12e47d9a13523a1f3e26.jpg[/img]

[h1]How to Talk Like a Pirate[/h1]

Thee first thing ye need to know ‘bout becomin’ a pirate be crucial: ye gotta believe yer a pirate! If ye don’t truly believe ye be a Swashbuckler, then ain't nobody else gonna be fooled!

[b]Best follow these steps below![/b]

[list]
[*]We pirates don’t be good at speakin’. We scowl a lot, and we like to mutter most o’ our words. Best get used to it, matey!
[*]Ye gotta run yer words together. Ye gotta slur. Don’t use no proper sentences, neither!
[*]If ye still have yer hands, use a motherload o’ gestures. Movin’ yer hands about when ye speak be key to a pirate’s life. It also be good fer ye circulation!
[*] Pirates be loud n’ lusty. Th' louder ye be, th' smart’r ye sound!
[*]Never say “you” or “your” unless ye wishes to walk thee plank! It be “ye” an’ “yer” in th' Pirate’s life! Savvy?
[*]Oh, and it be “me” and not no “mine”! Fer example, “that be me sword, ye no-good, two-toothed, thievin’ scallywag!”
[*]Drop th' “g” after words endin’ in “ing”. There be no need fer that “g” after many words, like goin’, and questin’, and fishin’, and swimmin’!
[*]Make up words if ye have to! We pirates don’t be minding a wee bit o’ hornswaggling!
[*]Never leave port without yer good luck charm, or there be mighty dire consequences! I never leaves home without me lucky skull beret!
[/list]

On behalf o’ th' Aaaaaaartix Entertainment crew, ye be ready fer Talk Like a Pirate Day! Grab ye cutlass and ye hat, and don’t be forgettin’ yer lucky charm! At any time that ye be needin’ a quick reminder, come back ‘n get a refresher! Savvy, pirate?

[b]Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]
(My [url=https://twitter.com/artixkrieger]Twitter[/url] & [url=https://www.facebook.com/artixkrieger]Facebook[/url])

See more of what we are working on at [url]www.AQ3D.com[/url]

notes.title: Greenguard Forest is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c927ef11c703a418e8cbee133626347c085d4053.jpg[/img]

[h1]The grass really is greener on this side[/h1]

"OMG! I can transform into a Bush!" - a random player who should have been talking about the world plot, cinematics, mini-bosses, surprises, secrets, challenges, puns, and ...yup, you really can find a secret that lets you transform into a bush.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/065e62a4766780ba7c9cafc29b9a3003977ef83f.jpg[/img]

[h1]The World Plot Begins[/h1]

Who is this strange scythebow weilding guy? What does that gold symbol on his chest mean? Who does his hair? Wait... scythebow? How do you use a bow made out of two scythes!? 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a8543f1a6465eb4c1f2ea99d49cd9bec9a11c978.jpg[/img]

[h1]"Feels like an Artix Entertainment game now!"[/h1]

Check out the new Greenguard and you will find we not only listened to your feedback, but also poured in a little of the secret sauce. (R.I.P "The Grind") 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/99ef5a1a35ef3b57a144a2df45154f47a8743dc2.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Zard Hunter[/h1]

Go into the field with the world's foremost Frogzard Expert. He knows them inside and out... literally.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f4a0b43c384b024de6b0ed538b7e6f1a9d1a15ca.jpg[/img]

[h1]King Sneed got himself a Frogzard Mount[/h1]

He also now lives atop an impressively tall Sneevil Tree fort. Perhaps you can claim that box crown for yourself?

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/45556cd4dcfadced7f4a930bb7849460eeb0e4f3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Brutalcorn Lives![/h1]

50% Unicorn, 50% BRUTAL!!!!!! Do you have what it takes to challenge our dude-bro version of Monty Python's Black Knight?

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/16916e0d48285fc6d6ac39f59196cad395e6e8b0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Better Crafting![/h1]

As you progress through the story you will unlock different things to craft-- starting with the Zardscale armor set. You will find it is much faster and more fun to make items now. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/8867c6fba3b05dde85d9ce7956abe90a234cb7db.jpg[/img]

[h1]Challenge Fights & Secrets![/h1]

We hid things around Greenguard forest for you... most you can handle yourself with the right gear. But to battle the Clawg, you will need to bring a few tough friends. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b6b3a8f13083ced44156a1d22b0256768eb22cb1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Beating around the... BUSH![/h1]

There is a secret hidden in the forest which... if found, will allow any hero to transform themselves into a bush at will. Excels at hiding, sneaking, espionage, and x-treme bush racing. Moves at 0% travel speed.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3698342417acfd6e5b4f4847a4682ad69433f826.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hair ye, Hair ye! Beards & Braids are here.[/h1]

Head to ye' old barber shop for all new ways to customize your hero including beards, braids, and you can now change your eye color, lip color, and we added new skin & hair colors. We also made it so you can spin your character around while customizing-- and added a random button for awesome and sometimes horrifying results!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/36fcf1fb8c6334558fdd7ee6242e593c9d01406e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Elvenguard & Green Dragon Travel Forms[/h1]

10% off this weekend only from Gaz. Transform into a Green or Elvenguard Dragon at will and hover across the land at 130% speed.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/38d34e159191f7434019debb27736e222c5e71c2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Play the new Greenguard[/h1]

Did I mention the Stone in the Sword in the Stone thing? Come play the new Greenguard with us. Simply login and choose Greenguard from the travel menu. Battle on!

[b]P.S.[/b] We (Artix Entertainment / The AdventureQuest 3D Team) are located in Tampa, Florida. We have secured the lab and are now bracing for Hurricane Irma which appears to be coming for a visit. It is the biggest hurricane in current history. Do not worry, the game servers will not be effected, they are in Texas. But the staff and I may be unavailable/offline for a few days if the power goes out, or we have to fight sharks or whatever else the hurricane hurls at us. If you see anyone ask why we/player support/Heromart has not responded right away, please let them know we will get them fixed up as soon as we are back online. To everyone in the path of the hurricane, be safe.

[b]P.P.S.[/b] If you have any problems be sure to go to options on the login screen and "Clear Cache"

notes.title: Iron Berserker set just released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/42b41dfc17ce52af21a7c5a3ee60d6f9c737e795.jpg[/img]

Craft the amazing new armor and axe set at Cysero's forge. It is rumored that the markings on this armor have a very special meaning to the Iron Berserker who live in the Frozen Northlands.  

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0da8a35025d43ebdcfe0cc0f9a5fa2eae22fa7ec.jpg[/img]

You can craft this new set using the Battle Gems that you earn from random adventures.

[h1]Something to do while you wait for.... O_O[/h1]

We snuck the Iron Berserker set into the game so you would have something to do while we finish up the next major release of AdventureQuest 3D. We will release updated Greenguard Forest 2.0 which was rewritten with the fun and humor you expect from our games, and most importantly... you will at last meet one the most important characters in the AdventureQuest 3D's main story line.

notes.title: 10 New KeySwords & KeyStaffs added to the bank!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a5f03672667baad44e91d865b4b8b83515b4dcf1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Get the perfect Key-Weapon to match your unique style[/h1]
If you have not seen the new bank yet, you just got 10 more really good reasons. After completing the "MASTER VAULT" you will be able to create Key Weapons.

[b]We just added 10 more Key-Weapons...[/b]
[list]
[*]Earthen Keysword
[*]Chaotic Keysword
[*]Purity Keysword
[*]Shadow Keysword
[*]Crimson Keystaff
[*]Platinum Keystaff
[*]Aqua Chrono-Keystaff
[*]Harmony Chrono-Keystaff
[*]Fury Chrono-Keystaff
[*]Chrono Vault Keystaff
[/list]
[h1]All of the new Key Weapons are craftable[/h1]
You will find these new Key weapons on Hootenhiem. Just be sure to complete all of the Master Vault quests first. They are all craftable using security badges. If you have been following the design notes, you already know we have some big releases coming your way. This week we have been converting all our maps to the new system, so we hope you appriciate this small "something to do while we convert every map in the game to our new system release."

[b]P.S.[/b] The new character customization options (including beards, braids, staches, lip color, eye color, and more skin colors) is coming along great so we will be releasing the new interface in the next AdventureQuest 3D release. 

Until then... onward to Key-Weapons!

notes.content:

[h1]Welcome to the Bank of Battleon[/h1]

Within the Bank of Battleon you will find The Master Vault, Security Runs, Ornithons (first look at the bird-like race), Keyblades, Keystaffs, Monicles, Nightlocke upgrades, and more. The bank is a level 6 area, with scaling adventures and rewards for heroes of all levels. 

Read the full post at http://www.aq3d.com/news/bank/

[list]
[*]Monicle (Security Rank 5)

[*]Plutocrat Long Coat (Security Rank 3, Crafting)
[*]Plutocrat Gloves (Security Rank 2, Crafting)

[*]Plutocrat Belt (Security Rank 4, Crafting)
[*]Black Raven Wings (DCs)
[*]Black Raven Head Morph (DCs)
[*]Vault Keeper Robes (Gold... and it's GREEEEEN!)
[*]The Letter Opener (Gold)
[*]Plague Doctor's Master (Craftable, Security Rank 10)
[*]Ornate Nightlocke Weapon Upgrades (Craftable, Security Rank 10)
[*]Master Vault Keyblade (Reward for completing Master Vault)

[*]Legion Chrono-Keystaff (DC / Unlocks after Master Vault)
[*]...there are other items in there too.
[/list]

[h1]The Master Vault[/h1]
Want to see the physical location where every hero's bank vault is located... including yours? Enter the Master Vault... if you can. It is and most important of the Bank's three vaults. Just be careful in there, I hear the gold portal is prone to breaking.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e37899d58b8626b4117362fba690d67239ae39c5.jpg[/img]

We listened to your feedback about Random Adventures and are trying something out in the bank release. You can now choose to run the bank's random adventures solo, 2-player, or 5-player. notes.title: Frost Castle - New Random Adventure!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/222a0cf2a6e397a64331bfaf27cbcab8541319d1.jpg[/img]

Join us in AdventureQuest 3D and go on random adventures to encounter… the Frost Castle! It is hands down our best looking random adventure are yet. New items are now available to craft at Cysero’s forge including our first ever wands. You will also notice that monsters… make noise now. Read on for details-- and see you in game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/abaab15af4c29298ac71b8ed31a577e75676a5ae.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Items to Craft at Cysero’s Forge[/h1]
Are you the type of mage, wizard, warlock, erm... magic user who prefers casting spells with wands? Then you are in luck! There are two wands among the new craftable items at the forge in town:

[list]
[*] Blue Glass Wand (Elegant and powerful)
[*] Bone Wand (for magic users who prefer… the darkness)
[*] Abyss Blade (One of Dage’s finest)
[*] Elegant Abyss Blade (Stylish?)
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/bbe97890bc58965ecd1d2e6393494a1c46f200a8.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Frost Castle[/h1] 
Now when you go on a random adventure, there is a chance you will end up in the Frost Castle. It is unquestionably the best looking random adventure/dungeon yet... and I particularly like how the bridge takes you outside, giving a glimpse of the bigger world you are adventuring in.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fd6e2a16e82a02d672ea1c2426ac07dd93555d33.jpg[/img]

[h1]The bank is run by Ornithons? [/h1]
The Ornithon race is best known for their sharp beaks, deadly talons, and accounting skills. You will be meeting them soon when the bank in town opens up (like, next).

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/70224c5496e3ae3117c1314c94747c9ca1de9c4e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Greenguard Forest Update coming![/h1]
As you may already know, we are updating every area from Greenguard to Doomwood with all of our new features to bring them up to the quality & fun of our newer “Dragons of Ashfall” areas. Check our official site and read my regular design notes posts for sneaky peeks, and clues to some of the interesting things being added… including, the game’s main storyline plot >_>. (Wait.. the game has a story plot!)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2f6e6b557097a29f9e44f3b5c76c4dd69042583c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bots/Cheats/Hacks get the Ban Hammer[/h1]
We know you would never do it, but just getting the word out there that we have taken a strict no-bots policy. Protect your account (and warn others to protect their accounts too.) 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4183ffecded410a3497829a55ef0d05228c0df83.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Sound Manager - LIVE![/h1]
Warlic did an overhaul of AdventureQuest 3D's sound engine. We now have monster soundFX, ambient tracks, and music tracks. Best of all, any object in the game can now have 3D positional sound placed on it. We added some sounds on monsters... run around and battle stuff to see what they sound like. Give us feedback, because now that we have the new Sound Manager, we are going to do a HUGE pass to improve all of the game's sounds.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d2fcacb274fe13db4d51c77a8f22fdd3393a6d50.jpg[/img]

(New players were in for an unexpected surprise)

[h1]Thank you & coming next![/h1]
Thank you for being a part of this growing world. Greenguard Forest, Ashfall Part III, and the Bank (Including the new creature race and bank vault run) are in development now. This week I approved the new female faces, and Oishii is working on expressions while Xero implements beards & braids. We plan to release new hairstyles, new face customization options (eye color, etc), and beards and braids along with the Barbershop. 

[b]Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team[/b]

P.S. We are also releasing a "Hot Fix" patch this week (depending on submission time) which will solve the TOP 5 Bugs of AdventureQuest 3D!

notes.title: Beta Berserker crafting recipes leaked!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2663/betaberserker.jpg[/img]
http://www.aq3d.com/news/betaberserker/

[h1]Leaked crafting recipes from the dev server[/h1]
In this week's AdventureQuest 3D release, we will be adding Beta Berserker to the game. It will only be available for you brave (and dark) souls playing in Beta. How to get it? Easy :D Our first ever random adventures are coming in the next release. There are only 2 dungeons to start... so the word "random" is being used loosely until we add more. Each run will earn you a shiny and highly valuable Battle Gem. (Possibly more... there is a chance on mini-bosses, and you can also find Battle Shards to craft battle gems) Collect a bunch of them and craft Beta Berserker weapons and armor pieces at Cysero's Forge. 

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2665/randomadventuredanda.jpg[/img]

[h1]It is dangerous to go alone... take, her/him![/h1]
After running the dungeons a bunch last night, they felt a bit lonely. So they bumped it up to 2 players so you will always get a random friend when you go on a run. It is so much more fun. It also drastically reduces how long each run takes. Then we thought... what if your new friend is not pulling their weight? So we are adding a small chance that a Battle Shard will drop from common monsters. These can be crafted into BattleGems to give you an advantage. Bottom line... the more active you are, the faster you will get Battle Gems. We did run into a few other issues with making random adventures multiplayer, like... what if you want to play with a specific friend? We have a solution, but we need to do a major game update to implement it. So for right now, enjoy the randomness of your battle buddy. Soon, you will be able to go on random adventures with your party. 

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2664/cyseroberserker.jpg[/img]

[h1]Beta Berserker Crafting Costs (Updated!) [/h1]

These are the crafting costs on the dev server as of 12:43pm Tuesday 6/27/2017. We added three new back items based on the weapons-- OMG they look awesome. 


    Beta Berserker Cape - 1 Battle Gem
    Beta Berserker Boots - 3 Battle Gems
    Beta Berserker Belt - 5 Battle Gems
    Beta Berserker Gauntlets- 6 Battle Gems

notes.title: Town of Battleon reborn!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2621/newtownofbattleon.jpg[/img]

Read the full post on our official site:
http://www.aq3d.com/news/battleon-reborn/

[h1]The war has been won! ...but our town WAS lost.[/h1]
The war is over! Wrythion and his dragon army have been defeated (and Dragonlord Talyn is most displeased). The forces of evil were driven off and not a single life was lost... but our beloved home was burned to the ground. 

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2628/newtownofbattleon2.jpg[/img]
[h1]A New Beginning[/h1]
Not to worry! Warlic and Cysero called in a favor from the Mistress of Time... the Chronomancer known as Sora To Hoshi. She and other Chronomancers used their time magic to build a time bubble around the husk of our destroyed down.  Meanwhile, Cysero and Warlic used their combined magic to rebuild town. It took 3 years. But since they did it inside the time bubble it seemed like just a few minutes to everyone else! The new, better Town of Battleon seemed to appeared instantly! 

[h1]Roland is in town for one extra week![/h1]
The war has ended but Roland will stick around in Battleon until at least next Tuesday in case you have any crafting that you'd like to finish up. 

Once again, NONE of the Battleon Defender items are rare so if you didn't get them all don't stress out. Roland and the Battle Defenders will return when our new town falls under attack for the first time. They do not call our home "Battleon" for nothing! 

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2620/aq3d-cysero_magic_forge.gif[/img]
[h1]A surprising number of improvements[/h1]
At first glance, it might look like we just rearranged some buildings... but the reborn Battleon is much more than that. 

[h1]Features[/h1]

[list]
[*]Better performance (Like, a lot better)
[*]Increased player cap
[*]More lively! NPCs everywhere.
[*]Easier access to The Forge, Bank, Barbershop, Inn, and more.
[*]Quests to help new players
[*]Expandable for player houses/castle
[*]Twilly & Zorbak are now both in town.
[*]All NPCs are using our new system which lets us update their dialog, shops, cutscenes, and more without uploading a new map.
[*]The statue on top of the magic breaths blue fire... just because.
[*]A few secrets and surprises
[/list]

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2625/drooster.jpg[/img]
[h1]Town Quests[/h1]
This will REALLY help new players. As soon as you enter, you will notice a new small quest chain that picks up the story where the intro (which we also cleaned up) left off, guiding brand new players through town and getting them out into Greenguard forest and the rest of Lore. You should complete these quests too and get some rewards including our first ever armor with stats on it! 

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2619/aq3d-design-notes-welcome-home-twilly-battleon.jpg[/img]
[h1]More Players and NPCS[/h1]
This town is super optimized and supports more players, NPCs, and

We've moved quite a lot of items off under-explored shops and into Cysero's shop plus a few new items. They only reach level 5 for now but Battleon is the first place you go after the intro and we really focused on the new player experience when rebuilding it. 

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2631/zorbak-secrets.jpg[/img]
You'll notice some old friends now live in Battleon...

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2630/peaches.jpg[/img]
You should look around carefully. We've hidden lots of interesting pop-ups and fun secrets in Battleon.

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2616/aq3d-design-notes-hidden-surprises-battleon.jpg[/img]

We've also given a few of the NPCs some more lively dialogues instead of flat text blocks to read... and this is only the beginning! 

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2622/campbellclasstrainers.jpg[/img]

[h1]Battleon expansion plans[/h1]

[list]
[*] Quest Chain in every shop/building
[*] Barber Shop Interior
[*] Bank Interior
[*] Yulgar's Inn Rennovation
[*] Museum (Interior)
[*] Petshop Interior
[*] Zorbak's Graveyard Quests
[*] The Well...
[*] And a whole lot more.
[/list]

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2615/aq3d-design-notes-image-battleon-reborn.jpg[/img]

[h1]Coming Next![/h1]

We have a literal game-changer coming next. Combat and leveling is about to get a lot better. In order to prepare the game for all of our upcoming classes, we are doing the final, mandatory step-- introducing our new combat stats, and re-balancing every item in the game. We think you will like it-- and not just because you are about to get stronger. Armor is officially getting stats! Be sure to check back for our upcoming post on combat and stat improvements. 

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2623/gazcart.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoyed the special event and release of this new town. A lot of truly amazing memories are going to begin in these walls. Battle on!

notes.title: Last Night of the War
notes.content:
[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2614/thelastnightofthewar.jpg[/img]

[b]Read the full official post on the AdventureQuest 3D Website[/b]
http://www.aq3d.com/news/lastwar/ 

[h1]The enemy is retreating! ...but our town is burning to the ground.[/h1]

The dragon has been slain, and his army is in full retreat. But all that remains of our beloved town of Battleon is dust and ashes. Fear not, however: our spirits can never be broken. We have won this day, and will rebuild! ...tomorrow. How can we accomplish such a feat in a single day? Well, we do have two of the world's greatest mages in town. Maybe they can call in some favors from the Chronomancers.

[h1]The war ends tomorrow (Tuesday)[/h1]

Tonight is your last chance to battle the invaders and earn Defender's Medals. When the war is over, Roland will remain in town so that you can use any of your unspent Defender's Medals on his epic gear. If you did not reach rank 20, or did not get all of the items that you wanted yet, never fear. The town of Battleon is no stranger to being attacked, and whenever it is, Roland will be back.

[h1]Special Release Tomorrow![/h1]

We hope you have had a very good time in this special "bonus" event. We would also like to invite you to join us for a special release tomorrow. It is something that we have been working on in the background for quite a while. It is an important first step of updating our old game content to match the quality and performance of our new areas, like Ashfall.
