notes.title: The final fight for Battleon!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2611/battleonbossfight.jpg[/img]

[h1]Dragons have breached the walls! Our town is on fire![/h1]

If you are reading this, we need you right now. Just moments ago, waves of fire breathing dragons breached our town’s walls. Leading this army is the massive dragon, Wrythion. The entire town is ablaze and several buildings have already collapsed. It is too late to evacuate any of the townsfolk that remain. Our only choice is to fight!

[h1]The good news is we are not alone…[/h1]

Two familiar DragonSlayers have arrived. Join us for the final battle against Wrythion and his dragon army!

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2612/kordandsennaintown.jpg[/img]

[h1]They disobeyed orders and came to help us anyway![/h1]

Kord and Senna are in town, right now, battling along side us. Both of these DragonSlayers defied Galanoth’s strict orders to remain at the DragonSlayer’s camp in Ashfall where they were planning the upcoming assault on the Volcano.  With these two helping us in Battleon… our odds at winning just got a lot better. Join them in town and take down the dragon, Wrythion!

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2610/darkdefenderset2.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Quest Item Set! Dark Defender of BattleOn[/h1]

[b]“As our darkest night falls, our darkest Knight rises.”[/b]
Charred by dragon fire and the burning buildings of our home town, the Dark Defender set is a symbol of our unbreakable courage to battle on!  Our most die-hard defenders can earn this armor set by defending town and reaching Rank 20. There are tons of other items you can unlock through his quests too.

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2599/aq3d_feature_battleon_attack.jpg[/img]

[h1]Special World Event![/h1]

The Dragon Invasion of Battleon is a special event that is happening in real time and will only ever happen once. Events like this may (OK, *this* one definitely will) permanently change our online game world in an awesome way. Join us online and become a part of our world’s history.

[b]P.S.[/b] I would like to thank the entire team for putting this event together with the tools they currently have available. If you have guessed where this event is going, then you probably also know it would have been much easier to achieve our ultimate goal without an event. But instead, the entire team went the extra mile to create an amazing, memorable experience. We really hope you are enjoying it!

Charred by dragon fire and the burning buildings of our home town, the Dark Defender set is a symbol of our unbreakable courage to battle on!  Our most die-hard defenders can earn this armor set by defending town and reaching Rank 20. There are tons of other items you can unlock through his quests too.

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2599/aq3d_feature_battleon_attack.jpg[/img]

[h1]Special World Event![/h1]

The Dragon Invasion of Battleon is a special event that is happening in real time and will only ever happen once. Events like this may (OK, *this* one definitely will) permanently change our online game world in an awesome way. Join us online and become a part of our world’s history.

[b]P.S.[/b] I would like to thank the entire team for putting this event together with the tools they currently have available. If you have guessed where this event is going, then you probably also know it would have been much easier to achieve our ultimate goal without an event. But instead, the entire team went the extra mile to create an amazing, memorable experience. We really hope you are enjoying it!

notes.title: Last chance for Dragon Transformation!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2594/bwaaaak.jpg[/img]

Last chance for Red Dragon Transformations! Something new coming... http://www.aq3d.com/news/bwaak/

[h1]The Dragon's army is over half way to our town![/h1]

A massive army lead by a Dragon is headed straight for the town of Battleon... it will arrive any time this week!

[h1]Gaz is removing Red Dragon Transformation from his shop[/h1]

As a result, Gaz, the Black Market vendor, is removing the Red Dragon Transformations from his shop this week. He had been selling these magical red dragon transformations from his cart in the town of Battleon. But with a Dragon's army on its way, and DragonSlayers likely to follow, he is wisely hiding away his remaining stash. If you have not gotten one, this week is your last chance. It will not be possible to get the Red Dragon Transformation again for about a year.

[h1]New Travel Form coming?[/h1]

By popular demand, Gaz will be offering something... much... stranger. You can *BWAK* only guess *BWAK* at what it will *BWAK BWAK BWAAAAAK* be. Wait till you see the full loaded, armored, and weaponized version O_O.

[h1]P.S. Special World Event[/h1]

There are three types of special events. Holiday events like Mogloween and Frostvale. Then there are live events-- which we have not seen yet outside of developer's spontaneously showing up and making NPCs talk and spawn monsters. Then... there is a WORLD EVENT.

A world event is something that very few other games ever do. A world event only happens once, and it will very likely permanently change the world. AdventureQuest 3D does not yet have a war system, nor a faction/rep system, nor most of the awesome event tools we made for the other games. But the team used everything they had at their disposal to create a fun world event for you that will start this week. We really hope you enjoy it. By participating in it, you will become a part of history in the making. Also, there are a lot of reward items in there for everyone! If you have been following the design notes and Artix's Twitter you likely already know why this Ashfall related world event is happening... if not, it will be a fun surprise :D

notes.title: Dragons of Ashfall: Part II is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2561/ashfall2-justreleased-partii.jpg[/img]
[h1]It is time for action DragonSlayers![/h1]
 This major story release includes new areas, items, monsters, cutscenes, and bonus challenge areas. 

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2565/ashfall2itemsets.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Armor & Item sets![/h1]

Check in with the DragonSlayer's Quartermaster, Senna for new craftable items including DrakeStalker armor, Crimson Battle Mage armor, and more. Quests & monsters will also drop new gear as you adventure. If you are up for a challenge... carefully explore the maps to discover the challenge areas and the treasures they hold. 

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2562/dragonslayerorderi.jpg[/img]

[h1]Meet the entire Order of the DragonSlayers[/h1]

Finish meeting all of your new DragonSlayer brothers and sisters. The friendship and bonds you form throughout this adventure will be vital. In the upcoming part 3, ALL of the DragonSlayers will team up (including you) to enter the Volcanic Lair together. 

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2568/theslabs.jpg[/img]

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2564/brimston.jpg[/img]

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2563/magmamines.jpg[/img]

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2566/towerpass.jpg[/img]

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2567/3newcutscenes.jpg[/img]

[h1]3 new cutscenes - Face the Evil DragonLord, Talyn![/h1]

At long last you will come face to face with Talyn, the villain responsible for everything that is happening in Ashfall. Every dragon and monster in this volcanic region appears to be doing his bidding. But what is he really up to? Play to find out... 

You are needed, DragonSlayer....
[b]BATTLE ON![/b]

[url]http://www.aq3d.com[/url]

notes.title: LIVE! Dage's Underworld Challenge
notes.content:
[url=http://www.aq3d.com/news/dage2017/][img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2421/dagedungeon2017.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Special Event just released & available for a limited time![/h1]
What the...!? There's a strange skeleton standing near the fountain in our home town of Battleon. It appears to be an apostle of Dage's undead legion. Talk to him and be teleported to a underworld challenge with a craft shop for special items.

[list]
[*] Legion Soul Spike
[*] Katana of the Soul Reaver
[*] Sheathed Soul Reaver (back item)
[*] Pale Visage
[*] Legion Visage
[*] Dark Legion Visalge
[*] PLUS two secret monster drops
[/list]

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2422/dagebirthday666.jpg[/img]

[h1]In case you are counting...[/h1]

    6 - Level 6 items
    6 - Level 10 items
    6 - Level 16 Items

[h1]A brief history of Dage the Evil's birthdays[/h1]
We are not sure how it happened. But Dage's birthday has long been one of the most hyped events of the year. Maybe it is because for a month prior to his birthday, we confine him to his desk using a magical seal where he draws and paints tirelessly through the night creating dark and wicked weapons & armor. This is the first time we have ever celebrated everyone's favorite dark game artist's birthday in AdventureQuest 3D :D Nothing is better than getting a surprise bonus release-- We hope you enjoy it! This release includes an endless undead farming area that drops crafting materials to make a lot of interesting new items. Some players asked why we did not simply sell the items for DragonCrystals to which we have proudly replied that we are committed to not having any "pay to win" in AQ3D. In future releases we will be able to have cosmetic items. 

[b]Enjoy this Undead Legion challenge... remember, Dage is watching.[/b]
http://www.aq3d.com/news/dage2017/

notes.title: LIVE! Dragons of Ashfall
notes.content:
[url=http://www.aq3d.com/news/ashfalllive/][img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2412/ashfalllive.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Ashfall is LIVE![/h1]
Our newest saga, "The Dragons of Ashfall" is LIVE for you to play on all platforms! The level cap has been raised to 16 too. A new path has opened up in DoomWood leading to the dragon infested, volcanic region of Ashfall. There, you will find a camp of DragonSlayers preparing for the ultimate dragon hunt. Can you earn their respect and join them? Or will you fall prey to monsters, dangers, or secrets of this unexplored new area?

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2404/aq3d-dragonslayer_guy_2.png[/img]

[h1]The first chapter of a 3 part saga![/h1]
Thank you for all the awesome feedback and cheers for this new story release. The opening cutscene really sets the stage for what is to come. How often is it that something actually lives up to the hype? So thank you for all of your patience, determination, and support in making this finally happen! The best part of this first release is it has something in it for everyone. From story, new characters, shops, crafting, a new "food item", random clickable objects that are just plain fun, exploration secrets, and for those of you who are simply crazy... extreme hard mode challenges! We have two more parts to our first saga. What to expect? Well, for one-- they will come out much faster, LOL! Seriously, thank you for being so awesome while we got everything working. No spoilers, but needless to say, we are obviously heading towards that volcano and... *rest of this paragraph burned to cinders by dragon breath*

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Quest system overhaul - it's better!
[*] Secret Challenge Areas
[*] Stuff to click on... with.. you know... jokes.
[*] Bonus "Senna's Challenge" for crazy players
[*] New food type: Mmmmm
[*] Lots of vital changes under the hood that no one will ever see or truly appreciate *cries*
[/list]

[h1]Battle on![/h1]
Read the full post at http://www.AQ3D.com

notes.title: Frostval Labyrinth & Yettun Cave are LIVE!
notes.content:
[url=http://aq3d.com/news/frostval-2016/][img]http://aq3d.com/media/2312/frostvale-promo.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]FROSTVAL IS HERE![/h1]
A snow storm has hit our home town of Battleon which means... Frostval is finally here. During this most wonderful time of the year friends and family to gather for warmth around the fire, share gifts of love and quietly hope for a peaceful, prosperous and above all a happy new year! Also... undead ice monsters, the Yettun and Dragons.  It's my FAVORITE time of the year. 
[url=http://aq3d.com/news/frostval-2016/]Read the Full Frostval Post[/url]

[img]http://aq3d.com/media/2305/blizzy.jpg[/img]

Blizzy is a frost moglin. He is small, blue, and you will find him sitting on the fountain in town. He needs your help. Talk to him about a beast called... The Yettun who dwells within the Frost Labyrinth. Within you will find more quests and crafting for all new seasonal gear.  You can access the new event from Blizzy or the Teleporter crystal in town. 

[url=http://aq3d.com/news/frostval-2016/][img]http://aq3d.com/media/2316/frostvalehorns.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]A NEW SPECIAL SEASONAL EVENT[/h1]

We never dreamed AdventureQuest 3D's town of Battleon would be covered in snow this year. It is the long standing tradition in our video games to get immersed into the spirit of the season. This is a limited time event, much like our previous event, Mogloween. It will last until the end of December, and likely through some of January. It features a short Frostvale tale, our first ice dungeon, and new craftable seasonal rares (including the Yettun horns below). If you are running out of inventory space, do not worry-- our new bank system is in testing now

[url=http://aq3d.com/news/frostval-2016/][img]http://aq3d.com/media/2313/frostval-aq3d.jpg[/img][/url]

Oooh and Xero (3D guy) gets some serious bonus points for adding an animated frosty breath effect to the The Yettun Horns!

[img]http://aq3d.com/media/2311/aq3d-yettun-horns.gif[/img]

[h1]NEW CONTENT[/h1]
[list]
[*]NO Dungeon Key requirements! "Happy Frostval :D"
[*]2 Difficulty Modes (Normal, Epic level locked to 13+)
[*]5 Quests (before you can being crafting)
[*]2 Dialogue Cutscenes
[*]Craftable Armor Set (Armor, Boots, Gloves, Belt, Hat) level 5
[*]Craftable Weapon in Battleon (Does not require quests to be completed) Level 5
[*]4 Craftable Weapons for Normal Dungeon (two level 10, two level 13)
[*] 2 Craftable Items for Epic Dungeon (helm level 13, weapon level 13, higher stats than Normal weapons)
[*]Our first Scaling Dungeon (Normal difficulty only)
[/list]

[img]http://aq3d.com/media/2314/frostvalearmors.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Scaling Dungons[/b]
    The ultimate solution for season and special side adventures! While areas of the main game are designed for players of specific levels, we can now also make special dungeons that automatically scale you to the right level when you enter them-- allowing everyone to play together.
[*][b]Item Compare[/b]
You can now tell if an item stats are better or worse than your equipped item.
[*][b]Questing System Improvements[/b] (Almost!)
    The questing system is now easier to use, but we have been reading your feedback on the fonts and some of the weird edge-case display issues and have already made changes for our next patch.
[/list]

[B]PLEASE NOTE![/b] ALL of the items are returning Season Rares. (None of the items will be permanently rare.)

[img]http://aq3d.com/media/2318/frostval-withfriends.jpg[/img]

[h1]SCALING DUNGEONS EXPLAINED[/h1]

This is brand new functionality that is ready for public testing just in time for the holidays. Scaling Dungeons will temporarily raise or lower your level while you are inside the dungeon to fit that dungeon, making it a reasonable challenge for all players of all levels. Don't worry, you will gain XP and gold appropriate for your REAL level while you are in the dungeon. 

[b]For Seasonal Events and Special Side Content Only[/b]
We will mostly use scaling dungeons during special events like Frostval to make sure that everyone of every level can participate in the same event without being left out. The rest of the game will be scaled as normal. 

[b]Allowing us to play special content together[/b]
It evens the field. Scaling stops a higher level player from running through a lower level dungeon taking all the XP and drops or making it too easy. It also stops lower levels from leeching a higher level dungeon without having to level lock them out of the content and miss out. Scaling also means that if you're a high level and you have a friend who has just started, you can both play together and both benefit! It's a huge step for AQ3D.

[img]http://aq3d.com/media/1477/aq3dfrostvaledragon.jpg[/img]

[h1]IN DEVELOPMENT[/h1]

[b]Bank Coming Soon[/b]
The BANK is close to ready, but not close enough. Zhoom and the Code Team say that we can expect it early next year but it isn't ready for Frostval. 

[b]Cosmetic/Costume Slots coming soon[/b]
Cosmetic Slots/Costume Slots are still in development. This system is one of our top priorities but it's not as far along as the Bank system is. You can expect to begin testing this system live in game in the first quarter of next year. 

[b]Dragons of Ashfall Saga[/b]

notes.title: Frostval Labyrinth & Yettun Cave are LIVE!
notes.content:
[url=http://aq3d.com/news/frostval-2016/][img]http://aq3d.com/media/2312/frostvale-promo.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]FROSTVAL IS HERE![/h1]
A snow storm has hit our home town of Battleon which means... Frostval is finally here. During this most wonderful time of the year friends and family to gather for warmth around the fire, share gifts of love and quietly hope for a peaceful, prosperous and above all a happy new year! Also... undead ice monsters, the Yettun and Dragons.  It's my FAVORITE time of the year. 
[url=http://aq3d.com/news/frostval-2016/]Read the Full Frostval Post[/url]

[img]http://aq3d.com/media/2305/blizzy.jpg[/img]

Blizzy is a frost moglin. He is small, blue, and you will find him sitting on the fountain in town. He needs your help. Talk to him about a beast called... The Yettun who dwells within the Frost Labyrinth. Within you will find more quests and crafting for all new seasonal gear.  You can access the new event from Blizzy or the Teleporter crystal in town. 

[url=http://aq3d.com/news/frostval-2016/][img]http://aq3d.com/media/2316/frostvalehorns.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]A NEW SPECIAL SEASONAL EVENT[/h1]

We never dreamed AdventureQuest 3D's town of Battleon would be covered in snow this year. It is the long standing tradition in our video games to get immersed into the spirit of the season. This is a limited time event, much like our previous event, Mogloween. It will last until the end of December, and likely through some of January. It features a short Frostvale tale, our first ice dungeon, and new craftable seasonal rares (including the Yettun horns below). If you are running out of inventory space, do not worry-- our new bank system is in testing now

[url=http://aq3d.com/news/frostval-2016/][img]http://aq3d.com/media/2313/frostval-aq3d.jpg[/img][/url]

Oooh and Xero (3D guy) gets some serious bonus points for adding an animated frosty breath effect to the The Yettun Horns!

[img]http://aq3d.com/media/2311/aq3d-yettun-horns.gif[/img]

[h1]NEW CONTENT[/h1]
[list]
[*]NO Dungeon Key requirements! "Happy Frostval :D"
[*]2 Difficulty Modes (Normal, Epic level locked to 13+)
[*]5 Quests (before you can being crafting)
[*]2 Dialogue Cutscenes
[*]Craftable Armor Set (Armor, Boots, Gloves, Belt, Hat) level 5
[*]Craftable Weapon in Battleon (Does not require quests to be completed) Level 5
[*]4 Craftable Weapons for Normal Dungeon (two level 10, two level 13)
[*] 2 Craftable Items for Epic Dungeon (helm level 13, weapon level 13, higher stats than Normal weapons)
[*]Our first Scaling Dungeon (Normal difficulty only)
[/list]

[img]http://aq3d.com/media/2314/frostvalearmors.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Scaling Dungons[/b]
    The ultimate solution for season and special side adventures! While areas of the main game are designed for players of specific levels, we can now also make special dungeons that automatically scale you to the right level when you enter them-- allowing everyone to play together.
[*][b]Item Compare[/b]
You can now tell if an item stats are better or worse than your equipped item.
[*][b]Questing System Improvements[/b] (Almost!)
    The questing system is now easier to use, but we have been reading your feedback on the fonts and some of the weird edge-case display issues and have already made changes for our next patch.
[/list]

[B]PLEASE NOTE![/b] ALL of the items are returning Season Rares. (None of the items will be permanently rare.)

[img]http://aq3d.com/media/2318/frostval-withfriends.jpg[/img]

[h1]SCALING DUNGEONS EXPLAINED[/h1]

This is brand new functionality that is ready for public testing just in time for the holidays. Scaling Dungeons will temporarily raise or lower your level while you are inside the dungeon to fit that dungeon, making it a reasonable challenge for all players of all levels. Don't worry, you will gain XP and gold appropriate for your REAL level while you are in the dungeon. 

[b]For Seasonal Events and Special Side Content Only[/b]
We will mostly use scaling dungeons during special events like Frostval to make sure that everyone of every level can participate in the same event without being left out. The rest of the game will be scaled as normal. 

[b]Allowing us to play special content together[/b]
It evens the field. Scaling stops a higher level player from running through a lower level dungeon taking all the XP and drops or making it too easy. It also stops lower levels from leeching a higher level dungeon without having to level lock them out of the content and miss out. Scaling also means that if you're a high level and you have a friend who has just started, you can both play together and both benefit! It's a huge step for AQ3D.

[img]http://aq3d.com/media/1477/aq3dfrostvaledragon.jpg[/img]

The BANK is close to ready, but not close enough. Zhoom and the Code Team say that we can expect it early next year but it isn't ready for Frostval.

Cosmetic Slots/Costume Slots are still in development. This system is one of our top priorities but it's not as far along as the Bank system is. You can expect to begin testing this system live in game in the first quarter of next year.

notes.content:

Read the full post at [url]http://www.aq3d.com/news/winter-is-coming/[/url]

[h1]The Frost Labyrinth releases next week![/h1]
Tis' the season for candy canes, carnage and frost moglins. Next week we travel to the Frost Labyrinth! (*whispers* Because there is no Frostvale in AdventureQuest 3D, yet.) Here is your first sneak peak of next week's winter wonderland. As a time sensitive seasonal area, it makes sense to release this frozen realm first, before Ashfall. notes.title: Dragon Transformations!
notes.content:
[url=http://www.aq3d.com/news/dragonmorphlive/][img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2270/dragontransformations.jpg[/img][/url]
[h1]Dragon Travel Form Transformations now available with promised limited time "Black Friday #2" discount![/h1]
Get them from Gaz's Cart in the town of BattleOn.There are two types: Red Dragon and Armored Red Dragon.

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2272/dragonshop.jpg[/img]

[h1]Get them before Friday!  Special "Black Friday #2" discount[/h1]
Get them before Friday at midnight to get our promised discount and save a ton of Dragon Crystals. After Friday night, they will raise up to their normal price. I sorta love this system because it rewards you for being one of the first to get it, which is the exact opposite of what most major retailers do.

[h1]They cost DragonCrystals?[/h1]
Yes, and for a very good reason. The vast majority of content in our game is free, and we do not sell "Pay to Win" items. So cosmetic items including these special transformations are how we will be able to continue building and improving the game. Buying one of these is the best way to support the games ongoing development.

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2273/dragonphotobomb.jpg[/img]

Sneak peak of Dragon Slayer armor in the screenshot above.

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2271/dragonshover.jpg[/img]

Dragon travel forms travel by "hovering" at 130% movement speed. Korin's animations for these dragons are really well done, and I really appreciate the little details that Dage and Xero added on them.

[h1]Additional Notes![/h1]
[list]
[*]If you have any issues with the Dragons, be sure to exit and update to the latest version of the game!
[*]The newest version of AdventureQuest 3D now supports both IPv4 and IPv6 (Way to go Zhoom & Warlic!)
[*]Fix for Black Knight's Cloak has been released to all devices
[*]To those of you who bought the "Dragon Note"... did you check the description yet?
[*]We are currently working on Banks, Quest System improvements, Scaling content, Cosmetic Equips, and the "Dragons of Ashfall Saga" as our top priorities.
[/list] 
[h1]Got Screenshots!?[/h1]
If you take any amazing Dragon Transformation screenshots, post them in the comments below or tweet me at [url=https://twitter.com/artixkrieger/]@ArtixKrieger[/url]

notes.title: New Area! Barrow Drop & the Acevorah
notes.content:
[url=http://www.aq3d.com/news/barrow-drop/][img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2250/acevorah-barrow-drop.jpg[/img][/url]

Last night, the sky was set ablaze by greenish fire as a meteor arced downward from the heaves and plowed unceremoniously into the area of Greenguard known as Barrow Drop. 

Cysero, who had been tracking the spaceborn anomaly, was first on the scene hoping to find some new materials unknown to Lore upon which to perform his mystical experimentation. But what he found...

[h1]Barrow Drop[/h1]
Barrow Drop has just been released. You can get there from the Barrow Point dungeon entrances off of Greenguard or /join barrowdrop and face the deadly Acevorah!

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2243/acevorah-vypie-copy.jpg[/img]


Long ago, in Legends of Lore: AQ3D, we ran a contest for players to design a monster that would show up in game. Granted, this is completely new game but we are honoring old promises and introducing the contest winner, the Acevorah, in its own single player mini-area. 

This mini-area features two modes:

* Normal Mode: Level 8 area with a short storyline, a couple of repeatable quests, a couple of craftable weapons and one drop from the Acevorah. 

*Hard Mode: Level 13+ area with one repeatable quest, a couple of craftable Acevorah themed helms and one drop off the Acevorah. NOTE: You must complete the Normal Mode to access the Hard Mode. 

NOTE: Both version of the Acevorah have a 10 minute respawn. 

[h1]THE SOLUTION TO 15[/h1]
As detailed in YESTERDAY'S DESIGN NOTES, we have removed the large XP gap between level 14 and 15. 

If you had already crossed that amazing gap and reached level 15, you have been awarded a character page badge in the Special Section and been awarded the Wrap of Determination, a rare cloak that will never be released again. 

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2247/33ae8809cb5660be9db4dc1a8560dce861196cf34ecc42599a-pimgpsh_fullsize_distr.png[/img]

If you had not yet reached 15 but had earned enough XP to hit the new 15 once the the levels had been normalized, you will also find the Wrap of Determination in your inventory as a thank you for testing and to represent the effort you had put toward crossing that massive XP gap. 

[h1]Mogloween Extended![/h1]
Mogloween has been extended until the 22nd of November so you still have time to farm for the Season Rares, but the Spectral South Wing has been level locked to 12+ heroes.

notes.title: Ashfall - SNEAK 'PEAK'
notes.content:
[url=http://www.aq3d.com/news/sneakpeekashfall/][img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2240/dragonslayerashfall.jpg[/img][/url]

Dragons, volcanoes, and dangerous creatures from the great beyond…. we have some exciting new releases coming your way this month in AdventureQuest 3D.

[h1]Sneak “Volcano” Peak[/h1]

We are working furiously on the upcoming, and yet to be named, Volcanic Dragon Saga. The image above is the first ever sneak peak. In the picture below, Llussion is turned around, looking back over the mountains at Shadowskull Tower. But what would you see if the camera was facing the other direction? Oh man. Just wait and see :D  (But wait just a bit longer, because we have to finish painting the textures first!)

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2241/ashfall.jpg[/img]

[h1]SAGA? AWESOME! But how does it work?[/h1]

This new saga will take the game to the next level. You will encounter the Order of DragonSlayers and begin a multi-part story that will unfold over several weeks... and open at least 7 new areas. Brace for new challenges, new monsters, and an all-new arch-villain. Also at least one fan favorite Dragon will fight tooth and claw to claim his place in this new world’s history. There will also be new items and a level cap raise.

[h1]Until then![/h1]

Next week we will be launching as new area featuring the Acevorah… “WHAT!? The winning entry of that monster contest from 4 years ago?” Yup! Originally we were just going to add the monster so you could fight it-- BUT... the team went overboard and made new weapons, some wicked head mounted items, monster variants, and an original storyline for the area. We also have level restrictions working on areas... so there will be a very accessable level 8 area, and if you complete the quests there and meet the level requirement, you will be able to enter the high level version.

Read the post on our official website at
http://www.aq3d.com/news/sneakpeekashfall/

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 "The Pumpkin Patch"
notes.content:
[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2211/aq3d-100-keys.jpg[/img]

AdventureQuest 3D Patch 1.0.1 just went live and it has a huge number of fixes including the dreaded "OMG!! I JUST FELL THROUGH THE FLOOR OF HE HAUNTED HOUSE!" bug. (We hope.) 

We gave everyone 100 free dungeon keys to thank you for being so awesome through the floor falling bug!

[h1]WHATS NEW[/h1]
* Haunted House Manor fixes! (You will no longer fall through the floor for all of eternity)
* Fixed 3D asset & lighting issues with Dialog cutscenes
* Music volume are now set to 50% by default.
* Camera distance no longer resets when you change maps.
* Repeatable quests fixed.
* Default quality level increased.
* Account creation now works properly.
* Players will now stop moving when they view a cutscene or use the barber shop
etc..
See Full Patch Notes Here:
[url]http://www.AQ3D.com/patchnotes[/url]

[h1]Cysero on the Importance of Level Locking[/h1]
Technical Lead Zhoom has a lot of new functionalities planned in the works, from Cosmetic Equip Slots to the ability to buy more inventory and/or an item bank... but the one that just got bumped to the top of the list is Level Locking. That is, the ability to set a certain level as a minimum requirement to get into a dungeon. 

We knew it would be needed but the Mogloween Event has made it abundantly clear. 

As you know, you can run through the normal dungeons (balanced for a humble level 5 group of three) with relative ease. Once you complete Myx's story quests, you unlock the Spectral South Wing which is where you get the crafting materials for the Pumpkin Lord set. This Epic Level dungeon has been balanced for five level +13 plus members to tackle with some difficulty.

We thought that lower level players would go into the dungeon, get killed in half a hit and go "WOW! I should not be in here until I am further along!". Seems logical. We were mistaken.

Even though this was designed as end-game content for people above level 13, there are LOTS of people trying to take it on who are level 4-10 and woefully under-powered and under-geared. They are jumping in and trying to coast on the coat tails of their stronger team members. Even if they go in with the best of intentions, they die in one hit, miss more often than not, and drag down the overall DPS of the entire team. They are taking up a valuable seat on the team that could be filled by someone level and gear appropriate which makes it harder, and sometimes impossible, to finish what should be a very manageable dungeon for higher levels. It's very rightly causing a lot of frustration. 

This is why we need to level lock content like this, especially in time-sensitive special events. You might think it's not fair to only allow top level players access to the hard to earn gear. You're wrong. It's not equal, but it is fair and those are two different things.

The higher level players have worked hard, gotten to or near the level cap and played through much of the game's content that is still waiting for you lower level players. They need and deserve new challenges to keep the game interesting for them, such as epic level dungeons with hard-to-earn gear. It's one of the benefits of putting your time into a game like this. 

So, we hear your cries of pain and, as always, we are working ways to fix it and improve AQ3D. 

P.S. Artix posted some mockups of the PC specific interface on his Twitter Thursday.

notes.title: Mogloween is LIVE!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IAsu0mCCm3M&feature=youtu.be][img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2203/mogloweenhappeningnow.jpg[/img][/url]

Watch the official [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IAsu0mCCm3M&feature=youtu.be]Mogloween Trailer on YouTube[/url]

Darkness has fallen upon town of Battleon... The glowing jack-o-lanterns illuminate the way to a newly opened haunted house! Enter... if you dare. 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IAsu0mCCm3M&feature=youtu.be][img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2204/gordthulu.jpg[/img][/url]

New, ghostly monsters have risen... and our first first seasonal gear can be obtained by crafting or questing.

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2206/mogloweenarmors.jpg[/img]

[h1]Our first ever release![/h1]

This is also... our VERY FIRST EVER AdventureQuest 3D release! I would like to give a hearty round of thanks and applause to AQ3D's team of devs, testers, and mods. It has been only 5 days since OPEN BETA launched-- and these guys are still charging ahead full power. Way to go guys!

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2208/pumpkinlord.jpg[/img]

[h1]Pumpkin Lord[/h1]

A lot of players were really surprised that PumpkinLord, the most iconic and epic armor set in this release, CANNOT be bought with DragonCrystals. In our previous games, the only way to get our artists masterpieces was strictly with micro-currency. But were are going to try changing it up with this release. Everyone who plays this event can adventure to assemble and craft this awesome set. /BroFist

[h1]Thank you![/h1]

If you are enjoying this game and are not already a Guardian, please consider upgrading to support our ongoing development. NOTE: Guardian includes 30 backpack slots and a lot of DragonCrystals.

Rumors of ghostly sightings are being reported from that creepy house on the hill. It has been abandoned for quite some time...

[*]New seasonal items to craft or buy!
[*]New monsters and BOSS MONSTER!

notes.title: Open Beta is LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]All players are hereby invited to join in the OPEN BETA! Help us build AdventureQuest 3D. [/h1]

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2186/aq3d-openbetaislive.jpg[/img]

[list]
    [*][b]STEAM[/b] (PC/MAC) - Available now!
    [*][b]Android[/b] (Tablet/Phone) - Available now!
    [*][b]Apple iOS[/b] - (Tablet/Phone) - Coming soon... just waiting for approval
[/list] 

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2187/guardiantower1stlook.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]"We sure have a lot do to, but just look how far we have already come :D"[/b][/h1]

Congratulations friends! ...and sincerely, thank you for being a part of this special day. Today, everyone can finally log in and join us as we continue building AdventureQuest 3D. And holy smokes do we have a lot to do! We have been carefully listening to player feedback and have already planning how we can implement features like key binds, the PC-specific interface, more depth to classes and combat, and the other things you want to see happen in the game as quickly as possible. We are excited that so many people see this new game's potential. Your encouragement and support is what keeps us going-- and we are committed to AdventureQuest 3D for the long haul. As of this post we are now live on two of our target platforms! The third one is just waiting on approval :D  We are also ramping up for our first ever seasonal special event... Mogloween!

[img]http://www.aq3d.com/media/2175/mogloweencoming.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Known Issues & Bugs[/b][/h1]

We have been live watching the servers and jumping on bugs the second they happen. Kudos to Zhoom and Kraken for patching the "Internal Error 500" error within minutes.

[list]
    [*] Internal Error 500 - FIXED!
    [*] Map Asset could not be loaded, Teleport to Battleon? - If you are getting this error, go to the game's title screen. Then press Options. Then press Clear Cache.
    [*] Server Cap Max Capacity - Fixed!
    [*] Friends list - User interface fix required, and need a toggle to not allow invites.
    [*] Sitting
    [*] Switching maps while sitting caused the game to crash, so we reverted to a previous version of the Inn while we fix the sitting feature. 
    [*] Key Bindings & Interface Keys 
[/list]

[h1][b]Thank you![/b][/h1]

Again, thank you to everyone for making AdventureQuest 3D a reality. Thank you to everyone who loves and supports our existing games. Thank you to all of you who had our backs during that rough time on Kickstarter. Thank you to everyone who has been following this games development on the website, twitter, and facebook. We really hope you enjoy playing this 1st release. But we REALLY hope you are even more excited for all the things we are about to do next. Keep giving us your feedback, cheers, and guide us to make this our best game ever! Tomorrow, the REAL WORK begins. BATTLE ON!
